ldan sa la bsang ba dang ni rtsomachod yon cho ga de bzhin bdud ni gzhom pa dag kyang ngo / 69 /sgo rnams bsrung riba'i don du brtul gzhugs nges pa dang ldan dag pa'i slob ma rnams ni rab dgod bya/ /dpal ldan bum pa dag gi cirnal 'byor ma rnams me dang lha min rlung dbang zur du rim pas so/ /slob dpon dpal ldan tshogs kyi dbang por 'gyur te mi bdag las kyi rdo rje can dag rab byas nas/ /slob ma med na tshogs kyi dbang po rang gis kyang ni sbyin sreg las la sogs pa dag kyang bya/ 70 /skum po'am ni rig byed zur dag rigs kyi dbang gis zhi dang rgyas pa dag gi thab tu 'gyur/ /byang ngam 7drag po'i zur dang tshogazhan yang dkar po'i sa la rtsa ba'i padma dag ni nyis 'gyur ro/ /zabs ni padma'i tshad du 'gyur te de yi nang du rtsa ba'i padma mtshan mar bcas pa'o/ /padma phyed la 7padma'i phyi ru bum pa dang bcas ral gri rin chen sogs kyi 7mtshan mar 'gyur/ 71 /de yi gyed kyis kyang ni mchu 7ste de las nyis 'gyur dag kyang kha khyer dag gi brgya skuyi cha/ /steng du rdo rje phreng ba dag kyang mchu yi phyed kyis dpangs dag tu ni nges par rab tu 'gyur/ /phyi rol 'og tu padma'i 'dab ma rnams dang ku sha'i bkod pa phyogs rnams kun tu rab tu bya/ /de yi mthar ni nub phyogs dag tu nges par re khā gsum gyi sgo gcig tu ni rab tu 'gyur/ 72 /slob dpon dag gi gdan ni nges par mnyam par 'gyur te snying po'i padma dag las nyis 'gyur ro/ /g.yon du mchod yon gdan du 'gyur te mi yi bdag po sbyin sreg snod dag gi yang g.yas su 'gyur/ /kun gyi rdo rje'i mtshan mar 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i yang na mkha' yi padma yum gyi'o / /zhal dang gsang ba dag kyang thab khung rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te rgyal po phyi dang lus 77—157

la'o / 73 /thab kyi phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor dag la khro bo'i rgyal po lha mor bcas pas bsrung ba byas nas ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dag gis bsang cib sogs dang chur bcas me tog rnams kyis rime la mchod yon nyid/ /de yi rnal 'byor ldan pas sbyin par bya ste rang snying padmar zla ba'i steng du bsgoms nas so//zhal gcig kha dog dkar po dus kyi phyag gi padma g.yon na ril ba chu skyes dag dang ni/ 74 /g.yas na dbyug pa bgrang phreng ral pa shin tu ser skya dmar ser mig ldan gos dang bcas pa ste/ /me yi snying gar zla ba'i steng du dri med 'phro byed dzaḥ las lcags kyu nges par bsgom par bya/ /de yis bkug pa'i kun 'gro ye shes sems dpa' rang gi lus la shin tu ro mnyam dag tu mdzod/ /de ltar thab la yang ni yang dag 'gyur te mi yi bdag po de bzhin me ni spyan drang ngo —/ 75 /mchog sbyin lag —pa dag gi mthe bo yis kyang me yi zhal du sbyin sreg dag ni rab tu bya/ /gtso bo'i rdo rje yan lag gis kyang mda' brgya'i yam shing 'bru dang drar ba tshamar dang 'o ma yis/ / skyil krung mdu gnas rab tu zhi zhing g.yo ba med pa'i sems ldan gsang sngags rig pa sngags kyi sku/ /slob dpon las kyi rdo rje can gyis slar yang me la bsregs ngablugs dag ni nges par sbyin par bya 76 /rim pa yis ni sbyin sreg byas nas 'thor 'thung padag kyang de bzhin me dang bdag nyid dag la yang / /dri la sogs dang spos dag bul nas rang snying padmar ye shes me ni gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /phyi nas slob ma la ni dbang bskur dpal ldan bla ma mtha' dag yon tan gter gyis nges par sbyin/ /dang por bdud rtsi lnga ni rgyal ba mchog gi rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa dag pa'i slad du'o/ 77 /rang gi sngags kyis sbyin sreg grub cing rdul tshon btab ste 77—158

sngags kyi mtshan ma rab tu bkod pa na/ /zur du shel gyi bum pa dkar po skud pa lnga yis dkris pa rnams ni yang dag gzhag par bya/ /slob dpon shar gyi zhal du rdo rje padma las skyes rab bgrod khro po'i rgyal po rnams dag gis/ /spyan drangs nas ni ye shes 'khor lo rdul tshon dag la ro mnyam du bya dbang gi don du'o / 78 /lha dang lha mo rnams ni thams cad dag 〉gi ming gi sngon du oṃ zhes bya bar 'gyur ba ste/ /sbyin sreg la ni gu hā'i mtha' sngags snying po de bzhin nyid de mchod pa dag la na maḥ'i mtha'/ /dzaX rgyu hoḥlcags kyu la sogs rim pas yongs su bkod rnams spyan drang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /mnyes la'o mchod yon sbyin pa la yang mi de groṇḍa groṇḍa 5a kai me zhes par 'gyur / 79 /rgyas pa la ni gu hā'i mtha' yi sngags su 'gyur te mi bdag zhi ba la 'di na maḥ'i mtha'/ /dgug pa la ni bo ṣaṭa mtha' tshoru 'gyur te bo dzhaṣaṭa mtha' yang dbang la 7de bzhin nyid du ni/ /snye yig mtha' can mngon spyod la ste rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis phaṭa mtha' phur bus gdab sogs la'o /dkar 5dang dmar dang dag po mchog gi gser dang mtshungs pa dag ste las kyi dbye ba dag gis 7sngags/ 80 /shar du dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje dag ni srid nag dang mtshungs byang du sku yi rdo rje dang / /sto ru gsung gi rdo rje nub tu yang ni rang rigs phyogs su gnas pa ye shes rdo rje ste/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser po dag ni rigs kyi dbang gis sa yi cha la khyab par byed par 'gyur /rlung me chu dang sa yi lha rnams dag gi skye ba'i gnas ni mi bdag i ṛ u bla'o / 81 / oṃ āḥpa ni phyag rgya gsum ste zhwa hā'i tshig dang bcas pa ring po'i dbye ba las kyang lnga/ /snye āX oṃ ho parang gi zhal rnams gzhan pa dag 77—159

kyang de bzhin gzhom du med pa lnga par 'gyur/ /a 4sogs dang bcas hre yig drug ste ro rkang na maḥsogs kyi dpal ldan yan lag drug tu 'gyur/ /zo gyi snyeyi ge sna tshogs yum gyir 'gyur te rnam bcu brtsegs ci pa'i sngags ni rgyal ba dag gi'o 82 /rdu yig ye shes sa bon snying po dag kyang brtsegs pa chen po'i sngags ni zhal dang bcas pa ste/ /ṭwāṃ yig la sogs yan lag drug po sku yi rdo rje dang por ldan pa 'di ni nye snying ngo / /lha dang lha mo rnams kyi phreng ba'i sngags ni de bzhin gzhan te las kyi dbye ba du ma yis/ /rnam mang du 'gyur shes par bya ste dus 'khor dkyil 'khor 'dir ni rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis so 83 /rin chen gser zla /me tog dang ni rnam pa tshamang po'i 7gos dang dri dang spos dang mar me dang / /dril bu me long bla re dang ni rnam mang 'bras bu ba dan sogs dang gar dang rol mo yis/ /rnam bkra mchod pa byas te gzhan pa rnam bcu dag dzokyang skabadag nyid nus pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ /slob dpon dag gi zhabs kyi rtsa bar rimachog gi bu yis yon ni dag pa'i slad du dbul bar 5bya / 84 / dag pa —gsum gyi rdzas dang bdag nyid bu dang bu mo dang bcas rigs las skyes pa'i gzhon nu ma/ / de ring nyid nas tshomi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag 0ni rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ /khyed kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ /zhes pa gser bcas me tog dag gis maṇḍal byas nas bla ma la ni gsol ba gdab par 'gyur / 85 /'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni gardo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi/ /ral gri la ni mchod 77—160

pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa dag 3ni bskyang bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni ( thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba skyed rimadzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ 86 / slob ma khrus byas dri yis rjes byugs brtul zhugs nges pa dang ldan shar gyi sar ni bzhag byas te / /dngos grub don du so shing rgyal ba mchog gi rdo rje dag gis ji mngon par bsngags pa rab sbyin bya / /rtse la'ang bdud rtsi nges par rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig dag gis spos ni dbab ri pa'i don du'o/ /sngags ni snyi gi yi ge gcig ste a ra la dang bcas pa khro bo'i gtso bo bskul ba'o/ 87 /khro bo'i rgyal po phebs na mtshon chas mdzes pa'i lag pa dag gis bdud kyi tshogs la bsdigs byed cing / /g.yon brkyang la sogs stabs /rnams dang ni rnam mang bcing ba dzo dag gis 7rdo rje'i gar gyi 5gar byed de'i/ /bzhad dang rgyu cigi yi ge 'dres skupa dgra la 'jigs pa ster ba dang ni rdo rje'i glu yang byed/ /ngo tsha med cing dogs pa med par 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis lha gzhan dag —kyang zhi ba'o/ 88 /sku phebs 5pas ni rnal 'byor ldan pa rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis sku yi bya ba byed pa ste/ /gsung phebs pas ni lha dang 'byung po lha min rnams las rnam par rgyal ba'i smra ba po ru 'gyur /zugs phebs pas ni gzhan gyi snying la gnas pa dag dang byung dang 'byung ba thams cad shes par 'gyur/ /ye shes phebs pas sangs rgyas bla ma yi yang bla ma rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i ston pa gcig pur 'gyur/ 89 /sa phebs pas ni rnal 'byor pa dag ri dang mtshungs par 'gyur te chus kyang bsil bar tshorab tu 'gyur/ /me phebs pas ni sreg ri par 'gyur te rlung gis kyang ni de bzhin skam pa dag 5tu rab tu 'gyur/ /stong pa phebs pas mi snang bar 'gyur sa steng snye77—161

du ni mkha' la spyod pa nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs la sogs pa thams cad rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis rim pa yis ni rig par bya/ 90 /dbab pa la ni nges par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po sngags pa rnams kyi bsgom /pa'i stobs dang ni/ /bsnyen pa'i dbye ba dang ni rnam mang dam tshig sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyis 'ga' zhig dag gi tshe/ /sangs rgyas ro myong 5byed pas bdud rtsi'i dbang las dkyil 'khor 'ga' zhig tu ni mchog gi bu la'o/ /rang byin brlabs pas dman pa rnam mang srid pa dag gis sngags pa rnams la dngos grub yod pa min / 91 /phebs pa btang ste phyi nas mgo bo dang ni snying ga tshospyi gtsug lte ba dag dang mgrin pa dang / /gsang bar rgyal ba dang ni rang gi rigs kyi sar gnas rang gi rdo rje gsum gyis bsrung bar bya/ /lus la ser po'i gos dag byin te mig ni bsgribs par gyur pa'i slob ma 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /kun rdzob don du brtul zhugs rab mchog bgrod pa dag / la bgrod pa de dag nyid ni sbyin par 5bya/ 92 /'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid/ /'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags skepa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di dag gopa/ /gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab sbyin bya/ /sna tshogs gtso po'i bka' 'di srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis stekyang ni bskyang bar bya/ 93 /cho lo kha na ma tho bcas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos/ /ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa lnga ni mi bya'o/ /grogs po rje bo rnams dang lha dang mi yi 7bla ma dge 'dun yid brtan rnams la /snye'akhu ba yang / /dbang po 77—162

rnams ni chags pa dag dang de ltar srid pa'i bdag po dag gi ribartul zhugs nyi shu lnga/ 94 /dpal ldan sngags kyis mngon par bsngags te lag pa'i padma sbyar bar me tog gcig ni rab sbyin bya/ /dang por lan gsum bskor te lag pa'i padma sbyar ba dag las dkyil 'khor du ni me tog dor/ /gang gi gnas su me tog bzang po lhung ba de ni mi yi bdag po de yi rigs su nges / /phyi nas dbang ni bdun po dag dang rnam gsum 'dir ni ji bzhin bla med yang dag rab sbyin bya/ 95 /klu dang bzhi yi nor bu gser gyi bum pa dag gam rgyal po sa yi rang bzhin rin chen bcas/ /sman dang dri dang ldan pa'i rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa dag gis lha mo rnams kyis khrus bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rab tu dbye bas cod pan sbyin te mchog gi bla mas nus ma rnams kyis dar dpyangs nyid/ /rdo rje dril bu nyi zla las te brtul zhugs dag kyang dbang por bcas pa'i yul gyis sbyar bar bya/ 96 /khro bo rnams kyis byams sogs ming ste gsal bar rgyal ba'i bdag pos rjes gnang 'dogs bcas rab tu sbyin/ /rdo rje dril bu rab tu byin nas rab mchog snying rje dag gis dag pa'i chos ni bstan par bya/ /nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi padma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med dbrog 97 /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bsten par bya/ / gdol pa mo sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi padmar smad mi bya / /sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus 'di sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis bsrung mi bya/ /rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba gzhan du 77—163

mtha' yas bskal pas /min par rgyal bas gsungs/ 98 /chu ni sgrol ma la sogs lha mo cod pan zhes pa rgyal ba dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs nus ma rnams/ /rdo rje dril bu nyi zla dag dang brtul 5zhugs dag kyang yul su te ming ni byams sogs sbyor ba'o/ /rjes gnang rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal mo srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo rjes su rig pa ste/ /sdig pa'i dri ma 'phrog pa'i dbang bskur bdun po 'di dag cadakyil 'khor du ni yang dag rab sbyin bya / 99 /dbang bdun dag gis rimangon par dbang bskur dge ba'i dbang gis sa bdun gyi ni dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur / /bum pa gsang bas mngon par dbang bskur slar yang phyir mi ldog pa sogs su nges par rab tu 'jug /shes rab ye shes dag gis mngon par dbang bskur srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa'i 'jam dbyangs nyid du 'gyur/ /gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis rtsa ba'i lhung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo/ 100 /rtsa ba'i lhung ba rnam par dag par 'gyur te yon tan ldan pa dbang bdun la gnas dag gi'o//bum pa gsang ba la ni gal te brtul zhugs nges pa'i dbang gis gong ma la ni dag pa med/ /rtsa ba'i nyung ba byung na tshogang zhig dag pa'i slad du slar yang dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug bya ste/ /rjes su gnang ba thob nas slar yang tshogs kyi 'dus par thu bo'i ming ni chung ba nyid du 'gyur/ 101 /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa las bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i snang ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de yi bka' la 'gongs pas gzhan du 'gyur te nges par de bzhin spun la khros pas gsum pa'o/ /byams pa btang bas bzhi par 'gyur te byang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur/ /drug pa 77—164

grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa 0ri bo ri dag kyang ma smin mi la gsang ba byin las sol/ 102 /phung po nyon mongs pa las klu ru 'gyur te slar yang dgu pa dag pa'i chos la ma dad gang / /sgyu yi byams pa dang ni ming sogs bral ba bde ba ster la rtog pa phyogs dang drag po'o/ /dag pa'i sems can dag la skyon brjod pa las nyi ma ri dam tshig thob pa gtong ba las kyang gzhan/ /bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje'i theg par gnas pa rnams la'o/ 103 /klu dang bzhi yi nor bu gser gyi bum pa dag gam rgyal po sa yi rang bzhin rin chen bcas/ /sman dang dri dang ldan pa'i rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa dag gis gdan gyi dbus su khrus byas te / /klu dag gis ci ni dpal ldan cod pan bcings 0ste nor 'dab padmar bzhi yis dar dpyangs bcing bar bya/ /phyag rgya la ni dpal ldan bum pa yis te tsho'adir ni padma dang bral re khā 9lnga po spangs/ 104/dang por kṣichu dag la ni dge bsnyen nyid du 'gyur te bum pa la yang dge tshul dag tu 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i dbang la dge slong dang ni gong ma'i byed pa la yang gnas brtan 7zhes par 'gyur ba ste/ /phyag rgya dar dpyangs cod pan dag dang rdo rje mchod phyir thogs ni bla ma mchog gis sbyin par bya/ /de dag choslob dpon slad du rang gi rgyal ba'i rigs kyi dbang gis phyag rgya rnam par dag pa nyid/ 105 /steng du bla re bkod cing sa yi mthil gyi gnas dag tu yang ri mo gsum ni kun nas so/ /de rnams bur du nor bu gser gyi bum pa 7chur bcas skud pa dang ldan padma'i kha rnams so / /dung sogs gser gyi snod dang yang na dngul gyi rang bzhin dag tu dri yi chu ni bsgrub par bya/ /snying por gser gyi rang bzhin gsal ba'i gdan dag rab tu bkod de 7de la khrus ni brtsam par 77—165

bya 106 /me tog /sogs dang cidri yi til mar nyi ma me yis smin (0pa dag gis lha la byug par bya/ /phye ma rnams kyis dril phyis byas nas ri sbrang rtsi mar dang zho dang 'o ma chu yis bkru bar bya/ / don grub ri rirnams dang mar me dag dang rnam mang 'bras bu mchog gis 'di la nges par byabs nas ni/ /de yi gnas nas bskyod par bya ste sku yang dmar po'i gos dag gis ni yang dag g.yogs pa'o/ 107 /dpal ldan dkyil 'khor mthar ni mnyam pa'i sa yi tshoganas la rgyal ba'i cha yis re khā ngalnga byas te/ /dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa rang rigs 7phyogs su gnas pa'i mtshan ma lnga yis brgyan rtepa'o/ /de yi dbus su gzhag par bya ba zhal gyi padma nub tu phyogs pa'i lha dang lha mo'am/ /mchod rten sogs dang glegs bam dag gam mthang sku zhes pa'ang cide bzhin de la mngon phyogs sngags pa'o / 108 /rgyal ba mchog dang bcas pa sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje stong pa'i rang bzhin dag tu byas nas ni/ /phyi nas sngar brjod sbyor ba dag gis zla nyi lardo rje las skyes dus kyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rig pa'i lha mo sogs dang sangs rgyas ā li tā 5li'i rigs skyes rang rang sa bon gyis bskyed rnams/ /snying mgrin lte ba gsang ba mgo dang gtsug tor 'khor lo dag la rigs kyi dbang gis bsgom par bya/ 109 /de ltar nges pa nyid du bsgom par bya ste slar yang mtha' dag lha rnams dag gi lus skul yang / /khro bo'i rgyal po dag gis 〉srid med srid mnyam ye shes sems dpa' bkug ste gzhug pa dag dang ni/ /bcing dang mnyes pa dang ni ro mnyam byed pa dag kyang lha rnams kyi ni rang gi lus la bya/ /de nas slob dpon nyid kyis zhal ni rab tu gsal bar byas pa'i lha la phyag dag 'tshal bar bya/ 110 /a sogs ka 77—166

sogs dag las lha dang lha mo rnams kyi rang rigs yon tan la gnas /sa bon gang —/ /rang gi sa bon de ni snying gi dbus su zla nyi kha sbyor la gnas sku gsung thugs ldan par/ /mtha' dag lus ri la gnas pa'i sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi ciyan lag dpe byad mkha' dang brgyad kyis te tsha/ /yi ge rnams kyis phye ba de nyid rab gsal 'dab ma 'dab mar glegs bam rnams la bsgom par bya 111 /mchod rten snying por dpal ldan 'khor lo rdo rje nor bu padma dag dang byang du ral gri kyinyid/ /bgrang phreng la ni snye gi yi ge nor bu yongs su bgrang ba rnams ni mtshan dang dpe byad rnams/ /dril bu'i sku la dbyangs ni gsum gyis bsgyur ba'i bcu rnams dag dang ka sogs sde rnams rdo rje la/ /de dag kho na mchod phyir thogs la bcu yis bsgyur ba nor gyi dpe byad rnams ni stod g.yogs la/ 112 /ka sogs sde pa dbyangs dang bcas pa mkha' ro yon tan rnams ni pus 'khyud dag la bsgom par bya/ /haṃ ha dpal ldan rna cha la ste i aḥzhes pa zung chini mgul rgyan ska tshorags dag la'o/ /de bzhin du yang a yig zung ni gdu tshabu dag la 'gyur te rkang gdub dag la ha hā yang / /7mtha' dag lus la gnas pa dku stong pa'i rnam pa lnga po dag ni thal ba dag la bsgom par bya / 113 /rang lus ye shes rnam pa lanag las rdo rje gsum dang bcas pa'i phung po khams la sogs pa kun / /lha rnams kyi ni rang gi snying ga'i papadmar rang rang sa bon dag gi rim pas tshadagod par bya/ /sa bon bkod na rab tu gnas par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po mchod rten sku gzugs sogs la'o/ /nye bar bsdu ba'i dus su lag pa'i rdo rje dag gis rang gi lus la sa bon gzhug par bya 114/'di dang dang po ru yang ri mor bris pa'i thang sku rnams kyi me long la 77—167

ni khrus su 'gyur/ /phyi nas dri dang spos dang shin tu dri bzang me tog rnams dang glu dang rol mo dag dang ni/ /gar dang rnam mang mchog gi /gos dang rnga yab ridang ni gdugs rnams dag gis lha la mchod par bya/ /de ltar rab gnas byas nas rnam mang mchog gi ro rnams dag gis dge 'dun mchod ston rab tu sbyin / 115 /khron pa rdzing dang mtshe 'ur phyogs dang phyogs bral du ni klu yi rgyal po nor rnams dgod par bya/ /chu gter bdun po rang gi sa bon gyis te sbrang rtsi chu dang ldan pa'i dri lnga gzhug par bya/ /sbyin sreg mthar ni rdzing bu la sogs dag la chu lha dkar po phyag na zhags pa bsgom par bya/ /skyed mos tshal du shing gcig dpag bsam sngon pa mtha' dag shing la gnas par dbang ni bskur nas so / 116 /cod 0pan dar dpyangs dag dang do shal gdu rmebu dang ni de bzhin rna cha ska rags la sogs pa/ /slob dpon la ni rab tu sbyin byar 'gyur te mi yi bdag po yon yang bdag nyid nus pas so/ /sbyin bdag gis ni bsod nams slad du mtha' dag tshogs kyi rigs la gzhan don don 5du gnyer bya ste/ /bsod nams 'di yis —rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni 7bla med byang chub thob par shog 117 /ji srid phyogs kyi lo ni gcig pu rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur te blta ba dang ni reg par bya/ /de nas 'khyud par bya ste ro dang bcas pa'i chu gter g.yo ba la sogs rnams ni bsten par bya/ /lo ni nyi shu yan chad phyag rgya mchog tu 'jigs byed ma ste khro bo 'byung po lha min cha / /dbang gi don du drug dang bzhi ste bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba gzhan ni bsgom skupa'i don du'o/ 118 /dpal ldan shes rab nu ma la yang dang por reg 7pa gang yin rshabum pa'i dbang ni de nyid do/ /gsang ba dag las ri bong 'dzin pa myang 77—168

ba dang ni blta ba dag gis gsang ba'i dbang du 'gyur/ /shes rab ye shes dbang la mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs kyi yan lag zhal gyi / sbyang ba byas nas ni/ /rgyal ba dag kyang 'dir ni bla mas dpang por byas nas slob ma la ni phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ 119 /rgyan rnams thams cad dang ldan zhun ma'i gser dang mtshungs shing bcu gnyis lo lon mdzes ma'i ribu mo ni/ /khrag dang ldan la shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid dag cigis rang gi rdo rje nor bus 'dod spyad nas/ /sa bon dang bcas rdo rje dag kyang slob ma dag par shes nas kha ru 'phang ba byas nas ni/ /phyi nas rang gi phyag rgya sbyin bya de nas slar yang gzhan ni du ba'i lam sogs ldan pa'o/ 120 /spag ci dang rnam par 'phrul pa'i sems ldan g.yo sgyu gzhan dbang 'gro ma nad dang ldan dang bu skyes ma/ /khro khengs nor la sred dang mi bden rtsod pa la dga' rang gi yan lag dman dang rnam dag min/ /shes rab 'di dag dbang la shin tu mkhas pa'i bla ma dag gis spang bar bya'o mi yi dbang / /sngar brjod sangs rgyas la gus bla ma'i dam tshig 'dzin ma rnams ni phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod par bya/ 121 /'dod pa skyod chipar byed pa 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dag ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur/ /gang ba yan lag mchog dag tsholas ni —ri bong 'dzin pa khu bar byas nas 7thig le bzang po 'dzag /yo'os zubakug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba dag ni gsum gyi mthar/ /blta dang reg dang 'grogs la 'dzag 7pa'i bde ba 'di dag cadaga' ba'i dbye tshab la sogs dag gis so / 122 /'dod pa dga' bar byed de dang po dag kyang mi rnams kyi ni mig gis blta ba dag la'o / /phyi nas gang ba rab tu sbyar ba la ste maslar yang mchog gi dga' ba nyid do rang 77—169

lus la/ /'bar ba thig le 'dzag pa dang ni rinaga' ba yang ste chikhyad par dga' ba rdo rjes padma la/ /yoja thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru 'gyur ba la gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rdo rje byed/ 123 /'dod dang dga' ba dang ni 'dar dang 'gyur med dag dang bzhi po yis ni sbyor ba de gcig ste/ /gang ba dang ni nus dang skye ba dag dang mchog gi dga' ba nyid ni gnyis par nges par 'gyur / /'bar ba dang ni thig le brgyal ba dag dang naslar yang khyad par dga' ba nyid ni gsum pa'o/ /o'o dang ni nā da dag dang gnyid dang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyid ni bzhi par 'gyur/ 124 /sems kyi bsam pa yis ni ma ru 'gyur te reg pa dang ni blta ba dag gis /sring mo'o/ /rdo rje zhugs pas bu mo byed pa dang bcas shin tu dga' bas tsha mo dag ni —de bzhin nyid/ /jig le lhung na chung ma gzhan gyi rigs la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor mar ni 'dod chags nyams las so/ /'di dag nernal 'byor phyag rgya drug ste sa chu bsreg 7za rlung dang mkha' dang chad pa'i dngos rnams so/ 125 /chu skyes la ni rdo rje rab zhugs rtse mo can la rlung dang thig le mi chosang mgasum pa'o/ /'di dag 7rnal 'byor gsum gyis rab tu gsal zhing nges par sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi phyag rgya ste//chags dang chags bral mthar gyur dang po mchog bde'i mugater ni rnal 'byor rnams kyis rtogs bya bzhi pa'o/ /phyag rgya rnams las de ni legs pa'i ma ru 'gyur 7te rnam bcu dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal 'di'o/ 126 /shes rab yum ni mchog gi yum ste srid gsum skyed sngom spyan la ri sogs pa rnams ni sring mo'o/ /rdo rje drug ni tsha mo rnams te 5phyugs kyi skye bo 'jigs ster tsartsi tā sogs yang tsha mo/ /'khor lo la gnas dus kun tu ni rang rigs sa la gnas rnams rnal 'byor pa 77—170

yis bsten par bya/ /zhing dang gnas dang dur khrod skye bo dang bcas skye bo med par nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ 127 /dpal ldan rdo rje can ni dpal ldan yab /ste srid gsum skyed snyemadzad sangs rgyas thams cad ming po'o/ /spyan ril sogs pa ming po'i bu ste gzhan ni rnam mang yang tsha rnams dang yang tsha'i bu rnams so/ /'khor lo la gnas rang rigs sar gnas rab dga' rnams ni rnal 'byor ma rnams dag gis bsten par bya/ /zhing dang gnas dang dur khrod skye bo dang bcas skye bo med par nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ 128 /bud med zla ba'i bzhin dang utpal mig cacan mchog gi dri yis rjes su byugs pa gang su dag /bsod nams dag gi rgyu ru dag pa gsum gyis slob dpon la ni rdo rje'i mchod pa 'bul byed na/ /sa gzhi sbyin dang glang po rta dang shing rta du ma'i bu mo rab tu sbyin las bsod nams gang / /bsod nams de dag thams cad de las ci 'gyur te mi bdag mkha' gnas zla ba nyi ma'i mtshams tshosu'o/ 129 /sgrol ma dmangs mo rnam pa bzhi ru sa yi steng du 'gyur te gos dkar mo ni rgyal rigs ma/ /sa ni rje'u 7rigs ma rnams rnam gsum mā ma tī ni gnyis skyes skye bo'i rigs skyes rternam bdun 'gyur/ /sgra zhes bya ba 'khar 7ba mkhan mo nges par ro yi rdo rje chang 'tshong ngagazugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /yang dag nges par gser mkhan mar 'gyur mi yi bdag po 'dzin ma dag la dri yi rdo rje ni/ 130 /phreng ba mkhan du parab tu grags te rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis reg bya rdo rje thags tshamakhan ma/ /rdo rje'i mtha' can chos kyi dbyings pani nor bu mkhan mor ci'agyur bar 'jig rten du ni rab tu grags/ / tsā musgri ni sha 'tshong tshamar 'gyur rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khyab 'jug ma ni rdzo mkhan ma/ /phag mo khur 77—171

ba mkhan du /nges 'gyur gdong drug ma ni smad 'tshong ma ste chudabang mo tshem bu (mim/ 131 /tshangs ma cinya pa mor 'gyur sa gzhi'i gnas dag tu yang dbang phyug ma ni gar mkhan ma ru 'gyur/ /dpal mo zla ba gang ba'i zhal ni brgyad pa tshos mkhan mar yang 'gyur te 'byung po'i skye gnas zhu so/ /rmugs byed ma ni rgya skyegs mkhan mor tsho'agyur te mi bdag rengs byed ma ni srin bal mkhan mo'ong / /khengs ma zhes bya til mar 'tshir ma rab che 7shin tu stobs ni ⑫lcags mkhan mo ste 5bzhi pa'o/ 132 /'od zer can ni ko lpags mkhan mar rab 'gyur khro gnyer can ni shing mkhan ma dag dhide bzhin nyid/ /dpal ldan tsund+ra 'breg cimakhan ma ste sa yi srid pa la gnas 9lcags sgrog hom ni jig ’ma mkhan/ /drag spyan ma ni khron pa byed mar 'gyur te bcu pa 'od ma'i gar ma shin tu sngon mo'o/ /khro po'i cha shas khro bo las skyes bud med bcu po rnams ni rnal 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ 133 /dpal ldan khyi gdong ma ni kla klo mar 'gyur mi yi bdag po phag gdong ma ni 'phyag pa mo / /ce shāspyang gdong ma gtum mo dag dang sa yi gzhi yi gnas la ri stag gdong ma ni stag gzig ma/ /bya rog gdong ma bsnyon thabs lom ste rab tu gsal zhing nges bar bya rgod gdong ma ro sreg ma/ /mkha' lding gdong ma dpal ldan gi ra 5'gyur te brgyad pa lug pa'i gdong ma dag kyang ri khrod ma/ 134 /sum cu rtsa drug rigs kyi dbye bas sa gzhi'i ciganas su rnal 'byor ma rnams dag gi rigs rnams te/ /zhing dang gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang yul dang grong mchog dpal ldan dgas su yang dag gnas pa nisto/ /rmongs 0rnams 'ching bar byed cing rab mchog sa yi steng du rnal 'byor pa ri rnams dag tshol dngos grub ster/ /bzhi dang drug dang 77—172

de bzhin brgyad dang bcu dang bcas pa'i nor dang gcig pu gcig ni rim pas so/ 135 /bzhi ni sangs rgyas dbye ba rnams te slar yang dus ni byang chub sems dpa'i rab tu dbye ba rnams/ /khro bo rnams ni phyogs kyi rab dbye sa steng ①gnas su yi dgas dbye ba rnams ni de bzhin brgyad/ /lha min dag kyang brgyad kyi dbye ba gdengs can srid par gnas rnams rnal 'byor pa yis rig ‘ ripar bya/ /gcig pu gcig ni sna tshogs gtso bo srid gsum gnas su dpal ldan rigs rnams dag gi khyab byed do/ 126 /sa 'og rnams su gtum mo brgyad de mimi yi 'jig rten phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor la ni khro skyes gnas )/ /yi dgas zhes bya yi dgas 'jig rten du ste lha mchog gnas su sgra yi rdo rje la sogs drug /tshangs pa'i yul sar dpal ldan bzhi ste rab mchog zhi ba'i grong du khams gsum dag gi yum gcig ma/ /rab tu khros pa'i zhal rnams sna tshogs yang dag sdud byed dgyes pa rnams ni skyong bar byed pa nyid/ 137 /bu mo rgan mo dar ma rnams dang lus ni dri ma dang bcas bram ze mo dang rgyal rigs mo/ /rje'u ri mo dmangs mo gyimathar skyes rnams sam mig dang lag pa dang bral rna ‘ mchu sna ni chad ma rnams/ /mtha' dag byang chub rgyu ru shes rab thabs kyis 9)mchod par bya 7ste rgyal po slob dpon snying rje dang / /bcas pa'i thugs ldan dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing byang chub spyod la rjes su zhon pas so/ 138 /dang por bud med gsang ba'i phyag rgyar 'gyur te dam tshig la ni medapal ldan skyes pa mchog 7phyag rgya / /rtsed 7mo'i yan lag las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur te dbang po gnyis kyi bde mnyam dag gis mchos 7phyag rgyas/ /pho nya mo rnams dag gi dri lnga lus dang padma la gnas de dag rnams kyi rigs lnga ste/ /rang bzhin yon tan 77—173

dbang gis gla rtsi dang ni padma gcin dang sha dang rul pa'i ri dri rnams so 139 /dpal ldan bzang mo ripadma can du nges 'gyur chu la chirgyu ma sna tshogs ma dang glang chen ma/ /dpal ldan sgrol ma gos dkar zhes byar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis mā ma tī dang spyan ma yang / /rnal 'byor pa ni seng ge ri dgas rta ru 'gyur te khyu mchog glang po rigs kyi dbye ba las/ /mi bskyod ri dpa dang don yod grub pa dri med nor bu'i phyag dang phyag na padma 'khor lo can/ 140 /yan lag phra ldan 0spa rnams phra zhing rkang lag 'jam la mnyes gshin dpal ldan shin tu bzang mo'o/ /cung zad phra ba dang ldan ring zhing mig ni g.yo ba med la spa ni 'khyog pa padma can/ /ngo tsha med cing 'dod pa drag la rtsod mang la dga' skra ni shin tu chung ba dung can ma/ /ring zhing yan lag thams cad rdzogs la nges par yang ba'i yul dang skra ni ring ba sna tshogs ma/ 141 /sbom zhing thung la yan lag brtan ldan shin tu sra ba'i yul dang spa ni sbom pa glang chen ma//pho nya mo rnams dag pa'i rigs ni 'ga' zhig dag /tu 'dir 'gyur dus kun tu ni 'dres —pa'i rigs/ /seng ge dag kyang 'brog na gnas shing yul dang rnam bral 'jigs pa med la gtong ba'i ngang tshul can/ /ri dgas mgyogs 'gro dang ldan 'gyur zhing yang ba'i yul dang skrag 5pa'i sems te shin tu 'jigs pa'o 142 /rta ni nges par 'dod la sred mapar 'gyur te gzhan dbang gcin gyi cadri dang gzhan don gnyer paba'o/ /khyu mchog rengs lapa'i mig dang dman par 'gro ldan rang bzhin yon tan blun po nya yi dri ru 'gyur/ /glang chen 'dod ldan nges par ngal bar 'gro bar 'gyur te rul pa'i 7dri dang shin tu thongs pa'o/ /sum cu rtsa drug dbye bas gye ba sa yi steng gi gnas su rigs kyi 77—174

dri yi rang bzhin no/ 143 /mchod pa'i don du 'dod pa'i bstan bcos yon tan mang po'i gnas ni rnal 'byor pa yis rig /par bya/ /shin tu dga' ba byas kyang rnal 'byor pa la rnal 'byor ma yis ma tshim dngos grub sbyin rimi 'gyur/ / mdzes ma lha mo dang ni sha za mo dang mi mo dang ni srin mo klu mo dag tu 'gyur/ / mdzes ma cadapal ldan chos kyi dbyings su 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis lha mo sgra yi rdo rje ma/ 144 /sha za mo ni dri yi rdo rjer 'gyur te mi mo dag kyang gzugs kyi rdo rje mi yi dbang / /gdug pa srin mo gang yin de ni nges par ro yi rdo rje klu mo reg bya rdo rje ma/ / mdzes ma 3 sems can phan pa byed ma brtul zhugs nges pa la dga' sdom dang bsam gtan ngang tshul can/ /lha mo longs spyod la ni rjes chags 'gyur te dri ma 7ldan zhing lhag ma la chags sha za mo/ 145 /mi mo 'dod la rjes su chags ma srin mo mi yi khrag la dga' zhing gsod pa'i sems ma ste/ /klu mo dag kyang 7'o ma'i zas can rab mchog sa yi steng du rnal 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gzhan rtedu rang bzhin rnams ni rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis rnal 'byor pa yis rig par bya//sa yi steng gi gnas su mkha' spyod sa spyod rnams ni sum cu rtsa drug dbye bas maphye ba'o 146 /chang ni shes rab rang bzhin sprang rtsi dang bcas bu ram las skyes 'bras las skyes sam shing skyes te/ /phyag rgya dang bral gang zhig 'thung byed de ni yul can du 'gyur bdud kyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /de phyir shes rab lhag ldan sdig pa'i dri ma 'phrog cing sngags pa rnams la dngos grub sbyin ngapar 'gyur / /phyag rgya gang su rung ba 'dir ni dam tshig rnam par bral ba btung ba'i saslad du rab tu bya/ 147 /rgyal po ri bong mtshan ma gcig pu thams 77—175

cad dus su bsten pa 'ji ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed na// /shes rab chos 'byung la gnas nyid mor byed pa dang bcas rnal 'byor ldan pa dag ni smos ci dgos / /mi bskyod ridon yod grub pa rgyal ba mchog bcas khyi dang chirta dang 4ba lang glang po dang ldan pa / /nyon mongs rnams kyi rdo rje dbyug pa phyugs kyi /skye bo 'jigs sbyin brgyad pa gzhan ni shin tu drag 148 /khyi rta ba lang glang po lug dang ra dang /ri dgas bong bu 'phag dang rnga mo 'di dag 7phyogs/ /kum ji ra dang sko'agron bu ku yī ra dang nya dang ma ka ra dang sbal pa rus sbal dung / /bse dang stag dang dom dang ne'u le dang bcas 'bri dang ce spyang dang ni sram dang byi la dang —/ /'brog dgon khyi dang maseng ge dang bcas nor dang bcu ste 'di ni 'byung po skyes dang khro bo skyes/ 149 /go dma byi ba shā li dzā sngata spre'u snyedang ni /ri bong gzungs rtsomo i khu rtsangs pa 'i brgyad/ /khengs ldan 'dab chags dang ni ne tsho khu byug dag dang ri skyegs rab tu gsal bar chu yi gter/ /lā ba phug ron gzhan ni bya dkar zhes bya tsa ṭa ka dang ngur pa dang ni ngang pa dang / /dpal ldan khrung khrung khu byug mig dang ra dza ki chodang bha ga ba tī ti ti ri skudang labazhad/ 150 /chu la 'jug pa dang ni chu skyar ro dang bcas pa'i nor rnams rim pa yis ni rig par bya/ /bya rog bya rgod lug pa ri dgas dgra dang gtsug pud cican dang bya gag sge tā sngo ra dang / /hor pa sngon shing dgra ni gzhan te bcu po 4khro bo las skyes khro bo yi ni rigs su 'gyur/ /mig sngon dpal ldan tsa ko ra dang a gli ri la dang gu da tshomu kha bug ki ce rkang steng nyal / 151 /rtse ruṇḍa dang i cib rī saka brgyad pa mchog gi 'dab chags su 'gyur mi yi bdag po kye/ /sum cu rtsa drug rigs kyi dbye bas sa yi srid pa la 77—176

gnas sa spyod mkha' la spyod rnams kyi / /rigs su gyur pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag rnams ni mchod pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa yis bza' bar bya/ /rmongs pas gti mug dag las gal te spangs na mi yi bdag po myur du nyams par rab tu 'gyur/ 152 /so dang spa dang pags snyepa la sogs sha bcas chu rgyus dang bcas rus pa snying dang padma dang / /shig dang ba spu srin bu dag dang rab rimachog mi yi sbyobadag po glo ri ba rgyu ma chu so dang / /bad gan mkhris sa pa chu dang rnag ri dang sna tshogs lus la gnas pa khrag dang rdul dang tshil bu dang tsho / /mchi ma dag dang mchil tshom snabs dang dri chu skuchu ser zhag dang kha dog dri dang bshang ba padang / 153 /lce dang mig dang rna ba sna dang ri bong can bcas nyin byed rnams kyis cho rnams mchod par bya/ /sum cu rtsa drug yi ge rnams ni rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams kyang / /sum cu rtsa drug khams kyi dbye ba mtha' dag lus la gnas pa'i rigs dang mtshan ma phyag rgya dang / /sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor rgyud ni sa gzhi dag la gnas rnams 'dir ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ 154 /chu dang mchod yon dri dang spos dang me tog dang ni 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang mar me dang / /lha bshos dag dang 'dir ni na bzar 'gyur te bcu po rnams ni 'khor lo 'dus pa dag la yang / /khu ba gcin dang parkang dang bshang ba dag dang sha dang mchin pa dag dang mkhris pa khrag dang ni/ /rgyu tsham pags 5pa rnams ni rgyal po rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur te 'khor lo 'dus pa dag tshol yang / 155 /rdo rje dang ni ral gri mda' dang padma 'dab ma brgya pa lnga pa 'khor lo'i mtshan ma ste/ /rgyud mangs ci dang ni me long snod du 'gyur te mi yi bdag po me tog phreng ba dag dang 77—177

gos / /drug pa chos 'byung nges par lag pa'i mthil /du 'gyur te sgra yi rdo rje la sogs mtshan ma'o/ /de bzhin gri gug la sogs bum pa zhes dang de bzhin du ni bcu gzar gos ni ser po dang / 156 /khab bam yang na tho ba rab tu gsal zhing nges pa dag tu nya yi rgya dang rtse gsum ste/ /dpal mo'i mtshan ma brgyad pa rdo bar 'gyur te mi yi bdag po 'byung po las skyes rnams kyi'o/ /thugs byed la sogs rnams kyi dmar snod nyin mor byed pa dang mtshungs dar gyi srin bu ku sha dang / /chu gri cadang ni mthil lham ridag dang spru gri zhes bya 4de bzhin shing lham dag dang gdugs dang ni/ 157 / tog tse dang ni 'od ma'i cadabyug pa khro skyes rnams kyi rang gi mtshan ma bcu ru rab tu 'gyur/ /ba lang rwa dzodang kham phor rgyud ldan 'phang —dang sha yi gsal shing lag pa'i mthil /medu 'gyur ba ste / /rgyud mangs nye ba'i yan lag dang ni mda' dang gtsug phud —can gyi mjug chom 'dir ni brgyad par 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa drug mtshan ma'i dbye ba rab mchog sa yi steng du rnal 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ 158 /slar yang dmangs rigs la sogs mtshan mar 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis tsha.utpa la 'am thong gshol lo/ /rgyal rigs ma yi rin chen dar dpyangs su 'gyur mi yi bdag po sgyu cig rin chen phreng ba ni/ /rje rigs ma yi de bzhin du ste de bzhin chu na gargyu ba dang bcas zangs snod gnyis skyes ma'i/ /yum gyi mtshan ma rnam pa bzhi ste ḍa ma ru dang rnga chen cod pan nyid dang bgrang phreng ngo / 159 /bshang ba gci ba dang ni khrag dang sha dang bcas pa lha mo rnams ni bzhi por 'gyur ba ste/ /rna ba sna dang mig dang rtse dang bshang lam dang ni bha ga sgra yi rdo rje la sogs drug /rnag dang bad kun dang ni shig dang srid bu chu 77—178

ser zhag dang ba spu skra dang brgyad po yang / /rgyu /ma mkhris pa rus pa rkang dang sna tshogs lus la gnas pa mchin pa dang ni glo ba dang / 160 /rtsa dang pags ripa rnams dang snying dang tshil bu ldan pa dag ni bcu ru 'gyur ro mi yi dbang / /rna ba dang ni sna dang mig dang kha dang bshang lam dbus dang bha ga dag dang mchan khung sogs/ /lus kyi yan lag brgyad la gnas pa'i dri ma mi yi bdag po lha min mo rnams brgyad du 'gyur/ /sen mo dang bcas so dang yan lag bcu gnyis thod cipa rnal 'byor ma rnams brgyad pa brgyad du 'gyur/ 161 /bshang ba gci ba khrag dang sha ni sna tshogs lus la gnas pa gnas kyi dbye ba dag la bzhi/ /rna ba sna dang mig dang rtse dang bshang lam dag dang bha ga gyizhing gi dbye ba la yang drug /rnag la sogs pa spa yi bar ni sa yi steng gi gnas su tshan do ha tsho yi dbye ba brgyad/ /rgyu ma la sogs tshil /gyi bar ni phyogs zhes bya ba mi bdag 'dus pa'i rab tu dbye ba rnams/ 162 /rna ba la sogs yan lag brgyad kyi lus la nges par rnam mang dri ma dur khrod rab dbye rnams/ /dus me zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan —rab tu gsal zhing nges par gnas kyi dbye ba dag la bzhi/ /sa skyes zla skyes sngags pa pa sangs spen pa gdengs can rnams ni zhing gi dbye ba la yang drug /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams dang ni sa skyes chu skyes me skyes rlung las skyes pa dag 163 /brgyad ni tshan do ha yi dbye ba rnams te slar yang de bzhin ro drug dri dang kha dog dang / /reg bya sgra ni de bzhin nyid du rab tu gsal bar 'dus pa bcu yi rab tu dbye ba rnams/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung ni zad pa dag kyang mdun dang g.yon dang g.yas dang rgyab tu ste/ /kha dog la sogs bzhi po rnams ni phyogs bral dag tu thim pa dur khrod brgyad kyi dbye ba 77—179

rnams/ 164 /gnas ni sgrol ma la sogs khyim ste gsal bar sgra yi rdo rje la tshosogs de bzhin zhing du brjod/ /tshan do ha ni tsartsi tā zhu la sogs par zurab tu 'gyur te mi bdag 'dus pa thugs byed sogs/ /dur khrod khyi gdong ma la sogs pa mchog gi sar gnas rtsa ba'i gnas dang gsang bar bcas pa ni/ /yum gyi khyim rnams gnyis te de dag rab tu gsal bar sa la mthar skyes ma dang mthar skyes ma/ 165 /gnas ni bud med gsang ba'i padmar rab 'gyur dam tshig dag la rdo rje nyid ni nye ba'i gnas/ /zhing dang tshan do ha dang 'dus pa dag dang dur khrod sa gzhi de bzhin de ltar mtha' dag go/ /gnas ni g.yon gyi yan lag dag dang mdun te gzhan dang ride bzhin g.yas pa dag kyang gyi nye ba'i gnas/ /de ltar zhing la sogs pa thams cad lag pa rkang pa la gnas sor mo'i mtha' yi mtshams su'o/ 166 /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang lha mo chu gter du 'gyur dus kyi 'khor lor rab tu grags/ / shes rab byang chub yan lag yum ste gzhan pa dag chikyang sgra yi rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug /chu gter tsho yang dag spong ba rnams dang gzhan pa chu gter rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnams te brgyad du 'gyur/ /khro bo 'olnga ni stobs rnams dag ste rab tu gsal zhing nges par dbang po rnams ni lnga nyid do/ 167 /yang dag yan lag brgyad kyi lam ni mi yi bdag po lha min dag las skyes pa brgyad du 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rab tu dbye bas srid pa gsum gyi gnas su byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams te/ /de dag 7mtha' dag rnal 'byor ma rnams sa yi steng gi gnas su rnal 'byor pa yis rig par bya/ /de ltar gnas la sogs pa thams cad mi yi bdag po phyi dang lus la yang ni de bzhin 'gyur/ 168 /sangs rgyas pa dang zhi ba pa 'am 77—180

gcer bu skal ldan zhes dang de bzhin gtsang gnas bram ze 'am/ /thod pa can dang spa 'bal dang ni gos dkar dag dang zhing skyong rigs can dang ni /thub pa dang /smyon tsho pa'i gzugs can dag dang sdig pa med pa'i sems ldan mkhas pa dang ni grags pa nyid 'gyur te / /rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub don slad mtha' dag yon tan gter te de nyid thob pa gemi yi dbang / 169 /mthe bo dang ri ni mdzub mo dag dang slar yang de bzhin du ni gung mo dang ni ming med dang —/ /de yi mthar ni nges par mthe'u chung mtha' dag yon tan gter du rnal 'byor pa yis rig par bya/ /phyag rgya'i don du ming gi dbye bar 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis sor mo rnams kyi rim pas so/ /bcing ba brjod na rdo rje bcing bar 'gyur te nges par khu tshur bcing ba la yang de bzhin no/ 170 /khu tshur brla yi steng du rdo rje gdan la gnas pa tshorgyal ba'i 7bdag po'i rdo rje'i phyag rgyar 'gyur/ / skyil krung shāl ni lag pa g.yon par 'gyur te g.yas pa pus mo'i phyogs nas sa la sod gyur pa/ /sa la reg pa mi bskyod phyag rgya maslar yang lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin phyag na rin chen gyi / /g.yon gyi steng du lag pa g.yas pa gan rkyal ngamanyam par gnas pa phyag na padma dag gir 'gyur/ 171 /g.yon pa skyil krung 7steng du gzhan pa lag pa'i mthil tshan 'jigs pa med pa phyag na ral gri yi/ /g.yas kyi khu tshur g.yas min la ste nges par slar yang gzhan gyi mdzub mo khu tshur bcings pa la / /gsal bar snying gar tshoson pa rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya gzhan pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/ /mdzub mo mthe bo 4sbyar ba gdu ri bu bzhin du gyur pa dang ni gung mo la sogs brkyang ba'o/ 172 /lag pa g.yon la shin tu gang ba'i dri med ri bong 'dzin pa 77—181

g.yas la rdo je nyi ma ste/ /nyi ma zla ba sbyar ba la gnas 'jigs byed rdo rje khro po las skyes rtse mo lnga pa ni/ /bsgoms nas yan lag la ni reg / bya cod pan dang bcas mgo nas brtsams te rkang pa'i mtha' nyid du'o/ /'di ni rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i dpal ldan mchog gi phyag rgya sdig pa'i dri ma 'phrog pa'o/ 173 /gang zhig cung zad gzung ribar bya ba'i dngos po sa skyes chu skyes mngal skyes drod gsher skyes sogs dang / /bza' ba btung ba brtson 'grus cadang bcas gli ma dang ni zhabs dag la yang phyag rgyas reg par bya/ /gang gang bya ba nye 0bar sbyor bar 'gyur ba yon tan dbang gis de la de ni sbyar bar bya/ /sa la sogs la dkyil 'khor don dang rkang pa bgrod pa la yang rnal 'byor pa yis bsdud par bya 174/lag pa dag gis rdo rje bcings pa yis ni nges par khro bo'i mgon po chen po'i phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /mdzub mo thog mtha' bcings shing khu tshur bcings pas gtso bo srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba yi / /mtshan ma'i rnam pa dag kyang lhag ma rnams te rab gsal nges par lha dang lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /lag pa dag gis rdo rje bcings la g.yo ba'i gdengs na'i rnam pa gdengs can rnams kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur/ 175 /mthe bo dzodag dang mthe'u 7chung sbyar ba padma'i 'dab ma dang mtshungs gung mo dag ni 7brkyang ba dang / /mdzub mo gnyis ni zla 5ba phyed pa ming med 'og tu bskum pa rang gi lag mthil 5son gyur pa / /phyag rgya 'di ni rdo rje can gyi rdo rje rtse mo lnga par 'gyur te bstan par bya ba'ong /rtsibs kyi rnam pa sor mo rnams te lag pa gnyi ga'i skamathil du mthe bo —la sogs mtha' dag rnams/ 176 /lag pa gnyis ni rdo rje bcings pa rdo rjer 'gyur te rdo rje khu tshur dag gis dril bur bcas/ /khu tshur gyed pa 77—182

mdzub mo dang ni gung mo mda' dang mtshungs pa dag kyang ral gri rnon por 'gyur / /mdzub mo la sogs rtse gsum slar yang bkram pa dag ste khu tshur phyed pa yis ni rtse gsum la/ /dpal ldan gri gug khu tshur bcings shing dpal ldan mthe'u /chung zla ba byed pa 'jigs pa byed par 'gyur/ 177 /rna ba'i steng du khu tshur bcings shing mthe bong gung mo'i steng du 'gyur te mda' yi mchog la'o / /khu tshur bcings shing mdzub mo shin tu 'khyog por ri'agyur ro mi bdag de bzhin nyid du lcags kyu la'o/ /rtsa bar mdzub mo ming med du 'gyur mda' dang mtshungs pa'i steng du gung mo yang ni mdung la ste / /thad kur khu tshur dbyug pa la'o lag mthil 0shin tu mnyam la mthe bo brkyang ba dgra sta la 178 /steng du khu tshur gnyis dang mdzub mor 'gyur te lha min bdag po glang chen pags pa dag la'o/ /mche ba la ni lag pa gnyi ga'i tshomathil du khu tshur bcings shing mthe'u 7chung zla ba phyed pa'o/ /khe ṭa ka la dpung pa g.yon pa rab tu brkyang zhing lag pa'i mthil ni steng du son par 'gyur/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga la khu tshur bug par 'gyur te nges pa nyid du phrag par mthe'u 5chung brkyang ba'o / 179 /sor mo bug pa med pa'i lag pa pad 'dab lta bu steng du byas pa dpal ldan thod pa la/ /gzhu la lag pa gan rkyal ngakhu tshur du 'gyur nges par dpung pa g.yon pa rab tu brkyang ba'o/ /gung mo dag ni mdzub mo 'khyog po kun du brten 5par 'gyur te nges par rdo rje zhags pa la/ /rin chen la ni sbyar ba'i sor 7mor 'gyur te mi bdag de dag rnam par phye ba padma la/ 180 /chu na rgyu ba la ni mdzub mo mthe bo dzasbyar bar 'gyur te mthe bo'i 'og tu khu tshur ro/ /me long la ni shin tu mnyam pa'i lag mthil / sor mo bug med dang 0bcas 77—183

mngon du phyogs par 'gyur/ /mthe bo la ni mdzub mo la sogs steng du 'khyog po rim par yongs su bkod pa lcags sgrog la'o/ /mgo bo la ni mthe bo la sogs bzhi po gdong dang mtshungs shing 'og tu mthe'u rizung bskum pa'o 181 /cod pan la ni lag pa dag gis dung gi ciphyag rgya mdzub mo gnyis po sbyar ba nyid du 'gyur/ /lag mthil chidag gi rgyab tu sor mo lnga po rnams ni gcig tu sbyar ba dag kyang rna rgyan la/ /lag pa'i rgyab tu sor mo rnams ni rim par yongs su bkod cing bcings pa mgul pa'i rgyan la ste/ /lag pa gnyi ga'i sor mo gsum ni phan tshun sbyar cing thog mtha' bskum pa dag ni ska tsho rags lang / 182 /khu tshur bcings nas mthe bong dag dang gung mo gnyis po skum skor lta bur byas pa rkang gdub la/ /de bzhin du ni dpung rgyan zung dang gdu / bu la yang mdzub mo phan tshun sbyar ba dag tu 'gyur/ /mthe bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dag gi mchog gi rigs su 'gyur te mdzub mo gsang ba pa rnams kyi / /dri za rnams dang gdengs can rnams kyi gung mo paming med dag ni parim par yongs su bkod pa'o/ 183 /'byung po rnams kyi dpal ldan mthe'u 7chung rab mchog lag pa'i mthil rini srin po rnams kyi rigs su 'gyur/ /grub pa rnams kyi khu tshur bcings pa mchog gi rigs te tshigs kyi mtshams 7ni lha rnams dag gi'o/ /lag pa gnyi ga'i mthil 5du sor mo lnga po phyed 'khyog rigs kyi phyag rgya sder mo can rnams kyi/ /khu tshur bcings las mdzub mo gnyis po byed 'khyog nges par mgo bor son pa rwa can rnams kyi'o/ 184 / mi mnyam 6lag pa'i mthil sal mthe'u 4chung phan tshun bcings shing gshog pa sbyar ba sgong skyes rnams kyi ste/ /sor mo lnga po rtse mo 'khyog pa gdengs can rnams kyi rigs kyi 77—184

phyag rgya khyad par 'phags par 'gyur/ /nyid zhag so so'i gtor ma la ni mdzub mo'i mtha' rnams rab brkyang gzhan pa /'og tu sbyar byas pa/ /'bar ba dag la mthe bo /sbyar te mchog gi lag mthil snyedag gi mdzub mo brkyang ba gzhan pa'o / 185 /mdzub mo bstan na legs par 'ongs sam dag kyang nges par brjod cipar 'gyur te rnal 'byor pa la yang / /gnyis kyis shin tu legs par 'ongs dang skal bzangs tshadage ba mthe bo bcings pas rab tu brjod par 'gyur / /sor mo'i se gol debs pa /khyod ni 'di ru sngags pa mchog ces nges par skyabarjod par 'gyur ba ste/ /mthe bo 7dang ni ming med dag gis dam tshig bcas pa'i chang gis khyod ni tshim par byed pa'o/ 186 /sor mo thams cad rtse mo brkyang bas skal bzangs bolegs par 'ongs pa brjod nga'agyur rnal 'byor pa la yang / /g.yon gyi yan lag reg pas rtag tu khyod ni bdag gi gnyen gcig pu dag rab tu gsal bar byed/ /skye gnas dag la reg skulas gtso bo sngamachu dang nu ma zung dang nges par sen mo 'debs pas kyang / /7sor mo phan tshun bcings shing gung mo dang ni mthe bo brkyang bas dam tshig rjod tshopar byed pa yin 187 /mchu dang smin ma mig dag yo zhing mgo la 'phrug par byed na shin tu rmongs pa brjod par byed/ /mche ba'i dbus su mthe chung dang ni snying ga 5kha ru mdzub mo 'jigs pa rab tu gsal bar byed/ /mthe bo cikhu tshur bcings pa dang ni lag pa rkang pa sa la debs gan nga yis bza' bar bya/ /rtse la reg na zos pa dang ni lto dang so la 4bsnun pa dag gis ma zos pa nyid do / 188 /lag pa'i rgyab kyis sod cig nges par rab tu brjod de mngon du phyogs pas 'dug cig gyi'adug cig 7go/ /byin pa brla la nyed na skal bzangs ri 77—185

khyod ni de /ring kho na ngal so nges par rjod par byed/ /rkang pa rab tu skyong cabs gnyid dang pus mo zung dag skyang ba bdag la shin tu dga' ba gyis/ /yan lag kun la reg par byed cing kha ru lag pa gnas pa bdag la 'dus pa med pa'o/ 189 /phan tshun lag pa bcings pas bdag gi khyim du de ring 'khor lo 'dus pa dag ni rjod cipar byed/ /mthe bo tshoming med rtse mo dag gis rnam mang dam tshig rnams kyis ji ltar 'dod par mchod par bya/ /rkang pa la ni 'phrug ngapar byed na de bzhin du ni phyi rol 'dus pa dag 7la 'gro ba yang / /mdzub mo phan tshun bcings na rdo rje'i grogs po khyod ni di 'iring 'jigs pa 'phrog par byed pa'o/ 190 /skra ni rang gi so yis gcod na mi yi phyugs khyod 'dir ni nyung bar bya ba rjod mapar byed/ /so ni phan tshun 'dar bar byed na khyod kyi sha ni 'di dag bdag gis di 5ring bza' bar bya/ /rtse mchu g.yo bar byed na khyod kyi lalus las khrag ni btung bar bya'o nges par rjod —par byed/ /mchu la so ni 'debs par byed na khyod kyi rgyu ma sto bar gnas 'di bdag gis bza' bar bya/ 191 /sgeg pa'i sbyor ba yis ni sgeg par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po bzhan pa'i 7sbyor bas bzhad pa'o/ /gar gyi sbyor ba yis ni gar du 'gyur te rnam pa mang po'i rol mo'i sbyor bas rol mo'o/ /glu yi sbyor ba yis ni glu ste mchog gi yon tan rnam mang dri yi sbyor ba dag gis dri/ /phreng ba'i sbyor ba yis ni phreng bar 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis spos kyi sbyor ba dag gis spos / 192 /mar me'i rnam pas mar me nges par mun pa bcom pa dang ni snod kyi phyag rgya bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /zhes pa de ltar phyag rgya thams cad slar yang de nas lnga yi dbye bas rnam par phye ba ste/ /gzhan pa phyag rgya mtha' yas rnams kyang 77—186

mtha' dag lus la gnas pa rnal 'byor pa yis rig /par bya/ /gang gang dngos po'i rang bzhin du 'gyur sa yi steng du de yi rang bzhin dag kyang phyag rgya rnams / 193 /pho nya mo ni 'phred la lta ribs khyod ni gang zhig nas 'ongs skal pa bzang la rjod par byed/ /mgo bor lag bzhag de yi phyogs su nges par bltas pa rnal 'byor pa yis lan ni smras par 'gyur/ /steng du lta bas khyod ni dge 'am sa yi steng du gnas pas khyod ni 'dug la ngal so cig /yon por lta bas khyod song chags pa'i lta bas pho nya mo ni shin tu dga' ba rjod par byed / 194 /zhi ba'i lta bas bdag gi grogs po khro gnyer khro po'i lta bas 'jigs pa rab tu gsal bar byed/ /spa la lta bas bdag ni ma rungs par brjod tsho skal bzangs la ni rang gi rang bzhin zur gyis so/ /mdzod spur zulta bas bdag mchog rnal 'byor ma ni sna la lta bas yon tan rab tu gsal bar byed/ /mchu la lta bas skal ba bzang 5ste nu ma zung la lta na bdag ni phyag rgya bzang mor brjod / 195 /snying gar palta bas bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid lag pa zung la lta na bdag ni rab tu satum mor brjodapa/ /phrag par lta bas bdag ni nus ma sen mo dang bcas lag pa'i mthil —la lta na srin mo'o/ /rgyab tu lta na lag 'gro ma ste lte bar lta bas mi yi dbang po bdag ni dam tshig can/ /gsang bar lta bas bdag ni dag pa brla la lta bas bdag ni shin tu dga' la gdul bar dka'/ 196 /pus mor lta bas bdag ni grub pa nges par rjod 5byed rkang par lta bas rdzu 'phrul sbyin pa mo/ /rkang pa'i mthe bo tshonges par lta na bdag ni srid par rdo rje'i sku ste dpa' mo gcig bu dang / /sor mo kun gyi rtse mor lta bas srid pa gsum gyi gnas su kun tu 'gro ma sna tshogs yum/ /77—187

pho nya mo rnams lta stangs nyid ni sa yi steng gi gnas su rnal 'byor pa yis rig par bya/ 197 /drug cha lus kyi dang nas lag pa rkang pa lus dag gi ①ni yan lag mchog kyang sbyin pa ste/ /las kyi dbang po rnams kyi ngag dang dbang po rnams kyi dang na riyon tan dang bcas yid dag kyang / /khams kyi cha shas khams kyi nang na rkang gnyis pa dang phyugs kyi tshogs kyi ride nyid cha yis gzhan/ /mchog gi phyag rgya rjes su rig pa slob dpon la ni rab tu phul na bde ba'i gnas su 'gro/ 198 /sems can gang dag rnam gsum srid par gnas rnams 'jig rten khams las ye shes rdo rje lcags kyu yis / /bkug ste de dag mtha' dag mchog gi snying rjes dkyil 'khor du ni sangs rgyas rnams dang rdo rje yi/ /bdud rtsi dzomangon par dbang bskur nas ni dri med ri bong can lus 7rdo rje can gyi mulam thob pa/ /dri ma rnam par bral zhing byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas rnams rang gi gnas su gtang 5bar bya/ 199 /rdzas rnams med pa'i mngon par dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bdag po'i bka' yis kun spangs la ni sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin du ba la sogs lam dang mtha' dag yon tan gter ni rtsa ngayi rnal 'byor ldan pa ste/ /bstan cipa'i don du lag pa'i phyag rgya rang gi snying gi dbang bon skyon rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /gzhan rnams la ni rgyal ba mchog gi snying po yum gyi mchod pa rnam —dman sbyin pa nyid mi bya/ 200 /dbang gi mthar ni dpal ldan bum pa rnams kyi 'jam zhing lus la bde ster stod kor gos —zung dag /dpal ldan rnal 'byor ma rnams dag la sbyin bya gzhan yang de bzhin stod kor dang ni gos zung dag /sgo na gnas pa rnams la rab sbyin mtha' dag yon tan / rigs la bdag nyid nus pas de bzhin gzhan/ /mthar ni sbyin 77—188

sreg byas nas rang gi snying ga'i 0padmar ye shes sems dpa' rab tu gzhug bya ste / 201 /'jig rten pa rnams rang gi gnas su mtha' dag rdul tshon dag kyang dag pa'i klung la spyan drang bya/ /ṭwāṃ bu la dang dri spos me tog 'bras bur bcas dang ras yug dag ni gzhon nu ma rnams la / /byin nas slob dpon slob mar bcas pas mtha' dag tshogs kyi rigs ni ji ltar 'dod par mchod byas te/ /slob ma la ni gnang ba rab byin rab mchog tshogs kyi rigs ni rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ 202 /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang lto 'phye'i bdag po chom rkun zhags pas 'ching ba dang / /chu gter 'khrugs pa dang ni sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang / /dbul dang bud med bral dang mi bdag 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa dang ni rdo rje thong dang don nyams pa/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni nyin zhag so sor dran byed de la rab tu nyams par 'gyur/ 203 /dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas chen po las phyung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las mngon par dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //rgyal ba skyed tshomadzad bdag gis dbang bskur bdun po rnams dang bum pa dang ni gsang ba'i dbang dag —dang / /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa rnal 'byor dag gis skyabagrod 7bya bzhi pa thob/ /slar yang rgyal ba mchog dang bcas pa sna tshogs gtso bo'i sgrub thabs yang dag par ni bdag zhu'o/ /zla ba bzang po'i tshig gsan nas ni rgyal ba'i bdag pos rdo rje can dag gi yang sgrub thabs gsungs/ 1 /zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs 77—189

te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gi padma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma bsreg /za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i 5srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de ni bsgrub par bya/ 2 /skyed mos tshal lam ri bo dang ni rgyal ba mchog gi gnas dang lha yi gnas ni stong pa dang / /grub pa'i gnas dang dur khrod dang ni mtsho dang bzang po'i gnas dang de bzhin nyid du sbas pa'i sa/ /gang du sems ni rab tu tshim par 'gyur ba der ni bsgrub par bya'o mi yi bdag po kye / /nges par 'jam pa'i mal stan dag dang gdan la nye bar 'dug nas sngar brjod bsrung ba byas nas ni/ 3 /dang por snying gar zla ba'i dbus su de nyid 'od zer sna tshogs rnams ni phyogs bcur bsgom par bya/ /kha la sogs pa dag pa byas nas slar yang nam mkha' dag la spros pa'i rgyal ba rnams la ni/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas nas sdig pa rnam pa mang po dzhabasags pa dag ni bshags byas te/ /sgrub pa po yis lus dang ngag dang sems rnams dag pa yis ni gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ 4 /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang byas 5pa/ /de dag zumatha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam grol cibyang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas 5rjes yi marang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi//rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces —'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ 5 /stong pa dngos po'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin 'gro ba 77—190

mtha' dag 'di ni dngos po dag gis rnam par dman/ /de las sangs rgyas byang chub med cing gzhan phan snying rje dag dang mtshan ma'i dam bca' med pa ste//mtha' dag de ltar shes nas de lta na yang mi yi bdag po sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni / /dpag med yon tan dkyil 'khor dbang po dkyil 'khor la ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsgom par bya/ 6 /chu yis me ni rnam par nyams pa dang por 'dir ni lus kyi dbus su sdom brtson dag gis bya / /phyi nas 'dzin ma dag ni chu ru 'gyur te lan tshwa bzhin du chu yi dbus su rab tu zhugs/ /rlung ni chu bo de dag bskams nas nam mkha' la ni snang ba min par myuras 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems ni me dang mun pa'i mtha' ma yul dang rnam par bral ba dbus kyi sa la gzhag par bya/ 7 /stong pa rlung me chu dang sa dang lha yi ri bo chu skyes zla ba nyi ma me rnams ni/ /khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas dri med 'od zer 'phro ba 'am ni rdo rje las skyes gur dag go/ / de yi dbus su rdo rje'i sa la nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phro ba ste/ /oṃ yig ye shes las skyes rgyal ba mchog gi padma zla ba dang ni nyi ma dag gi gdan/ 8 /phyi rol du ni gsung gi dkyil 'khor nor bu padma 'di ni zla ba nyi mas rnam par dman / /phyi rol phyogs dang zur gyi char ni nyin mor byed pa'i padma sgo yi dbus su shing rta rnams/ /nyi ma'i sgo rnams su ni rgyal po nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin rta babs rnams dang dur khrod dang / /snying por brgyad gnyis ka ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin tshoshin tu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo rgyal ba yi / 9 /zla ba nyi ma la yang a sogs ka sogs rdo rje dang bcas me long la sogs lnga rnams kyis / /'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed par byed cing dri ma med pa'i zer 'phro dus kyi 'khor 77—191

lo bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i lus 3dang rgyal ba'i phyag gi padma nyi ma'i dpung pa dus kyi zhal/ /mgrin pa gsum dang nyi ma'i spyan te rnam par rgyas pa'i zhal yang mche ba phyed ni gtsigs ripa'o/ 10 /dpal ldan oṃ ri yig las skyes rgyal ba'i bdag po'i padmar zla ba nyi ma me yi steng du ni/ /drag po lus med gnyis kyi snying gar largyal ba'i dbang po shin tu rol pa'i zhabs ni g.yas brkyang stabs/ /g.yas pa dmar po'i sumachog gi zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud de dkar po g.yon par yang ni drag po'o/ /dbus dang g.yas dang g.yas min mgrin pa dag kyang bung ba nyi ma dang mtshungs zla ba dag gi mdog 11 / phrag pa sngon po dang ni dmar dang ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar rigayas pa dang ni g.yon du yang / /g.yas dang g.yas min dpung pa gnyis gnyis dag ni gnag dzodang nyi ma'i lus dang zla ba'i mdog rnams te/ /de bzhin nges par mtshon cha dag dzodang bcas pa'i phyag rnams dag kyang brgyad gsum gyis 7ni rim pas so / /phyag gi padma ri bong can la tshigs gsum sor mo lnga po rnams ni —kha dog lnga rnams 'phro/ 12 /gnag tshodang dmar dang dkar ba'i rab mchog phyag gi mthil du mtshon cha'i tshogs ni yang dag gnas pa yang / /rdo rje ral gri dag dang rtse gsum pa dang srid pa 'jigs byed gri gug dang ni me yi mda'/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu nges par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa rtsom ru dang tho ba 'khor lo nyid /mdung dang dbyug pa dgra sta rnams ni rdo rje can gyi nyi ma'i phyag gi padma g.yas la'o/ 13 /dril bu phub dang kha ṭwāṃ ga ni rnam par rgyas pa'i kha dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /gzhu dang zhags pa rin chen padma chu na rgyu ba dag dang me long dang ni lcags sgrog dang / / tshangs pa'i mgo bo padmas brgyan 77—192

pa rig byed gdong ldan gang yin rgyal ba'i g.yon gyi phyag na'o/ri/ /bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dag ni zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin cing rigadong ni dman pa dag tu byed/ 14 /gser mdog rig byed zhal ldan nor gyi phyag gi padmas 'khyud pa dag ni sna tshogs yum yin te/ /g.yas na gri gug lcags kyu nges par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru dang bgrang phreng rim pas so/ /g.yon na thod pa zhags pa dang ni 'dab ma brgya pa'i padma mchog gi rin chen de bzhin nyid/ /g.yon brkyang nyi ma'i spyan dang rgyal ba'i bdag po'i cod pan phyag rgya rnams kyis rgya yis btab pa'o/ 15 /'dab brgyad la ni lha mo brgyad rnams nor gyi phyag gi padma rig byed zhal dang nyi ma'i spyan/ /de dag rnams las bzhi ni sbrul gyi rnga yab 'dzin te zur du rgyal ba'i zhal gyi tshodabye bas so/ /dbang ldan bden bral dang ni rtse mo can dang rlung gi zur du chos kyi dung dang gasnyi tshadang / /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bur 'gyur te nges par de bzhin du ni dpag bsam shing du rim pas 'gyur/ 16 /dag mo yis ni dang po'i phyag gi mthil cin spos kyi snod dang gnyis pa dag na bsil ba'i snod/ /dmar po sbyar ba gsum pa na ste myos byed dang bcas ri bong 'dzin pa g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na/ /g.yon na dril bu padma lha yi shing gi me tog dang ni me tog phreng ba rim pas so/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal dag dang cod pan dang bcas gdu 5bu rnams te phyag g.yon na/ 17 /gos dang ska parags dang ni dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i rna rgyan dang ni rkang gdub bo/ /ser mo'i g.yas kyi phyag na dung dang gling bu nor bu dang bcas ḍa tsham ru ni rim pas te/ /g.yon na rgyud mangs snyedang ni rnga dang sil sil rab tu sgrogs pa'i 'khar 7ba dag dang zangs dung ngo / /77—193

'o ma chu dang sman dang chang dang bdud rtsi ro dang 'bras bu zan gyi snod ni dkar mo yi/ 18 /phyogs kyi padmar chu gter sangs rgyas rnams ni nges par spyan dgu me yi zhal dang dus kyi phyag /zur du sgrol ma la sogs lha mo rnams dang slar yang de dag mtshams brgyad du ni bum pa brgyad/ /lha dang lha mo gnag ridang dmar dang ser ba dang ni ri bong 'dzin pa lta bur dkar ba ste/ /nag po ridakar po zla ba'i steng du yang na phyogs bral du gnas dmar po ser po nyi ma'i ste / 19 /mkha' snying la sogs rtsig pa la ni phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas reg bya rdo rje ma la sogs/ /shar dang phyogs gzhan gyi ni g.yas dang g.yas min padma dag la kun tu bzang po de bzhin nyid/ /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje nges par sgra yi rdo rje ma dang chos kyi dbyings stoni rim pas so/ /rmugs byed rengs byed khengs byed dag ste shin tu stobs shes gang yin sgo skyong 5de ni shar du'o 20 /shes rab phang par thabs ni ri bong 'dzin pa'i padma la ste lha rnams kyi yang lha mo'o/ /gnyis po dag ni rang gi phyag gi chu skyes rang rang mtshan mas mtshan pa dag gis phan tshun 'khyud/ /mtshan ma gang zhig gang gi g.yas kyi dang po'i phyag mthil mun ste 'de yi phyag rgya chu skyes dman/ /shes rab thabs kyis 'khor lo mchog gi bde bar paganas pa lapadma dang ni rdo rje'i gdan gyis 7bzhugs 21 /nag po rnams kyi g.yas kyi phyag na ral gri gri gug dag dang srid pa 'jigs byed rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi mthil snyedu phub dang thod pa dag dang kha ṭwāṃ ga ni dkar po nyid du 'gyur/ /mda' dang rdo rje lcags kyu sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa tshom ru ni g.yas kyi phyag na rim pa yis/ /gzhu dang zhags pa dag dang dri med 'phro ba'i nor bu dmar po rnams kyi g.yon na de bzhin 77—194

nyid / 22 /ser po rnams kyi g.yas kyi phyag na 'khor lo dbyug pa dang ni 'jigs byed rdo rje rim pas te/ /g.yon du dpal ldan dung dang lcags sgrog ’dang ni nges par sgra dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bur 'gyur/ /ri bong 'dzin pa lta bur dkar ba rnams kyi g.yas na dpal ldan tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon na padma dkar po 'dab ma brgya dang ldan pa dag dang me long dang ni bgrang phreng ngo / 23 /ljang gu carnams kyi g.yas su rdo rje gri gug dang ni dgra star rim pas rab tu 'gyur ba ste/ /g.yon du dril bu dang ni thod pa mtha' dag yon tan gter dang tshangs pa'i gdong pa de nyid do/ /lha mo sngon mo rnams dag gi yang cirang bzhin yon tan dbang gis de bzhin du ni rig par bya/ /gnag dang dmar dang dkar dang mchog gi gser dang mtshungs pa shar gyi sa la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams/ 24 /du ba la sogs lha mo brgyad po dor nas rgyal ba'i bdag po'i padma dag la res 'ga' ni/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo snying po'i dbus su mi yi bdag po nyi shu lnga yi bdag nyid du yang 'gyur/ /rang gi sems kyi nus pa shes nas bcom ldan tsho'adi yang rnal 'byor pa rnams dag gis bsgom par bya /dbang gi don du dzhadakyil 'khor dag ni 7rigs kyi dbang gis phyi yi 'khor lo parab tu dman par 'gyur/ 25 /phyi rol du ni brgyad pa brgyad kyis pad 'dab brgyad po rnams la phyogs brgyad lha 7mo rnams dang ni/ /tsartsi tā cisogs rnal 'byor ma rnams zla ba nyi ma dang bral rig byed phyag dang spyan gsum ma/ /shar gyi padmar tsartsi kā 5ste mer ni mkha' 'gro'i bdag pos 'gro ma phag mo gdong drug ma/ /gshin rje bden bral zur dag tu ste chu labacas rlung du rdo rje lag dang chu gter gdong ma'o/ 26 /drag mo dpal mo byang dang dbang 77—195

ldan du ste mtshon cha dang bcas thabs kyi sku la 'khyud pa'o/ /brgyad pa brgyad kyi rnal 'byor ma gang padma'i 'dab ma la gnas gtso mo'i kha dog zhal rnams so/ /shar la sogs par /dang po'i phyag gi mthil ri na gri gug dang ni rtse gsum 'khor lo be con dang / /dbyug pa ral gri dang ni mdung thung /lcags kyu dag ni g.yas kyi phyag gi padma zung la'o/ 27 /rdo rje mda' dang padma dang ni dri med glog mtshungs tshangs pa'i dbyug pa dag dang rtse gsum dang / /sna tshogs rin chen gyis bcings sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru dang padma nyid dang bgrang phreng ste/ /g.yon na thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga dang padma dung dang lcags sgrog dag dang phub dang ni/ /nges par rin po che dang zhags pa sgra ni rab tu sgrogs pa'i rdo rje dril bu gzhu dag dang / 28 /spyi blugs snod dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang sbrul dang de nas chu las tshoskyes dang rin po che nyid de / /padma nor 'dab la ni brgyad pa brgyad kyi rnal 'byor ma yi phyag gi mtshon cha de bzhin no/ /'jigs ma drag mo dus kyi mche ba me 'bar gdong ma rlung gi shugs ma dang ni rab gtum ma/ /drag spyan ma dang skosna chen ma rnams matsartsi kā ngayi padma nor 'dab la ni paphyogs rnams su/ 29 /g.yang mo sgyu ma grags dpal rab mchog rnam par rgyal ma dpal ldan rgyal ma dpal ldan rgyal byed ma/ /brgyad pa dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma nor 'dab padma la ni khyab 'jug ma yi 7phyogs kyi char/ /keng rus ma dang dus kyi /snyematshan mo tshorab tu khros pa'i gdong ma dus kyi rtse dang gtsigs ma dang / /nag mo 'jigs rung gzugs ngan ri ma rnams nor 'dab padma la ste phag lamo'i 'dab ma'i lha mo la'o / 30 /padma lus med gzhon nu ma dang ri dgas bdag pos 'gro ma rin chen phreng ba mig bzang ma/ /rul ma bzang —77—196

mo gang na gtso mo mchog gi mi byas 'gro ma'i chu skyes 'dab la rgyal po kye/ /rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje lus dang mchog gi gser ldan urba sī dang bkra ba'i /ri mo dang —/ /ra rizug med shin tu sgrol ma padma nor 'dab rdo rje lag ma lhag pa'i lha can la'o/ 31 /sna tha tī ridang padma'i mig dang nges par chu skyes can ma blo dang ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ /hā ya tī dang glog nyid dran ma dag kyang padma rig byed gdong ni lhag pa'i lha can la/ /gi rī gas dang ni rtag ma shin tu mchog tu myur ma to ta lā dang mtshon byed ma/ /dmar ser nag mo brgyad ni de bzhin gang na drag mo gtso mo'i padma nor gyi 'dab ma la'o/ 32 /dpal ldan dkar mo zla ba'i ri mo ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdong ma ngang pa'i mdog dang 'dzin ma dang / /padma'i dbang mo skar mig dri med ri bong 'dzin ma dbang ldan padma dag la mtshan mar bcas/ / de yi 9phyi rol nyi ma'i padma la ni lha min g.yo dang gshin rje me dang gdong drug dang / /gnod sbyin brgya byin chu gter gdong dang phyugs bdag rgya mtsho dpal ldan tshogs kyi dbang po khyab 'jug go / 23 /ral gri gri gug sngon shing dbang po lha yi shing gi me tog dbyug pa ral gri sha 7dang / /dbyug pa shasnyi tshadag dang mdung dang nor bu dang ni be con rdo rje nyid dang me yi mda'/ /khab dang bgrang phreng dag ni phyag gi mthil 7du 'gyur te rtse gsum pa dang mda' dang zhags pa dang / /rin chen dgra sta rdo rje dang ni 'khor lo dbyug pa 'phrog byed codag gi g.yas kyi phyag tu 'gyur/ 34 /g.yon du phub dang thod pa dkar po min pa'i nor bu dang ni utpa la dang lcags sgrog dang / /zhags pa chu skyes spyi blugs midag ni nges par g.yon gyi phyag tu rim pas 'gyur ro mi yi bdag /rin chen me long dang ni de bzhin ne'u 7le dang 77—197

bcas chu skyes rdo rje dril bu gzhu dang ni// /padma dang ni spyi blugs sbrul dang gzhu dang de bzhin klu yi zhags pa dag dang rin chen dang / 35 /zhags pa rin po che dang padma skye ba lnga pa'i dung ni lha min dgra bo dag gir 'gyur/ /padma'i 'dab ma dag ril dag pa sogs kyi nor lag tshes rnams lte ba la ni rirdzogs pa gnyis/ /mchog gi zla ba'i cha rnams thams cad stong 0dus 'jig rten dag tu lo yi sbyor bas rig par bya/ /sgor ni lha mo shing rta la gnas ral gri rdo rje 'dzin dang lcags kyu dang bcas mda' yi phyag 36 /dpal ldan 'khor lo dbyug pa'i phyag dang rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis tho ba dang ni mdung gi phyag /dpal ldan gri gug rdo rje'i phyag dang nges par phyag na dgra sta phyag na rtse gsum g.yas na ste/ /g.yon gyi phyag na phub dang sbrul te rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis zhags pa dang ni gzhu yi phyag /dpal ldan dung dang rin chen phyag dang padma ri bong 'dzin pa me long phyag kyang de bzhin no/ 37 /dpal ldan dril bu thod pa'i phyag dang nges par phyag na lag 'gro nyid dang kha ṭwāṃ ga yi phyag /'od zer can la sogs pa zhal gcig dus kyi phyag gi padma rnams ni rim pas rig par bya/ /ka ba'i 'og tu klu brgyad rnams kyang bum pa rdo rje'i phyag dang padma nor bu dag gi phyag /rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni padma gno ṭa tshosogs dus kyi phyag gi padma rnams/ 38 /khyi gdong phag gdong ma dang ce —spyang gdong ma nges par g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la ni phyogs rnams su/ /stag gdong ma ni byang du gnas te dur khrod sa gzhi 2la gnas gri gug dang ni thod pa'i phyag /bya rog gdong dang bya rgod gdong dang mkha' 'gro 7bdag po'i gdong dang lug gdong ma ni zur du'o/ /rdo rje mig dang shin tu sngon mo sa 'og nam 77—198

mkha' la gnas 'byung po'i skye gnas g.yo ba'i mthar/ 39 /yi dgas dmar dang mkha' 'gro'i dbang po ma he mi bya glang po ngang ①pa glang dang gdong rilnga pa/ /rim pas tsā mu: byul sogs pa'i padma'i rigadan du rab 'gyur phyogs dang phyogs bral snyernams su'o/ /lha min la sogs rnams kyi de bzhin nor bdag rtse mo can dang chu gter rlung dang tshogs kyi ni/ /glang po'i dbang po dang ni /lug dang —mu srin zhes dang ri dgas dang ni byi ba rim pas so 40 /rtse ruṇḍa dang khrung khrung mig sngon bshang lam gdong 7ni bya rog gdong la sogs pa'i zur mdu ste/ /bse dang dom dang seng ge g.yag skuni khyi gdong ma la sogs pa yi ste phyogs su rab tu 'gyur / /rdo rje mig gi 5rkang pa brgyad pa sa yi pashing rta la gnas mkha' la sngon mo'i shing rta yi/ /mkhar bgrod khro ba dang bcas kha dog lnga pa lus rgyas mig gsum ldan pa a ni la zhes pa/ 41 /'od zer can dang tsund+ra 9lcags sgrog ma dang khro gnyer can gyi shing rta rnams la phag dang ni/ /rta dang glang po seng ge bdun gyi grangs su 'gyur te lha dang gshin rje chu dang byang du'o / /shar du dri dang phreng ba ma ste snyegashin rje chu la gnas pa spos ma mar me sgeg mo dang / /bzhad ma'o gar ma 7rol mo ma ni nor sbyin sa gzhi la ste mkha' la glu ma 'dod ma'o/ 42 /snying por brgyad ni kha khyer la ruste mkha' dang 'og na gnas pa rta babs 'og tu nges par sbyar/ /gzungs ma rnams ni snam bu la ste gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa'i phyir 'dod ma rnams kha khyer la /dbye ba dang ni bskyod pa ci'adod mar 'gyur te mi yi bdag po de bzhin rgyas dang tshorengs 'dod ma/ /lha mo sgrol ma la sogs dag pa yis te srid gsum skyed ma gsod pa dang ni skyed 'dod ma/ 43 /rol mo 'dod ma dang ni rgyan —77—199

'dod mar 'gyur mi yi bdag po zas 'dod ma dang de bzhin nyid / /dri 'dod ma dang gos ni 'dod mar 'gyur te nges par 'khrig pa 'dod ma dag ni drug pa'o/ /lus la 'phrug 'dod ma dang kha na gnas pa'i mchil cam 'dor dang lus kyi dri ma 'dod ma dang / /gar 'dod ma dang stan 'dod ma dang chu dang mal stan dag la rkyal dang bsnyes par 'dod ma dang ri/ 44 / tsā musmo sogs brgyad kyi bya ba rnams te de bzhin sa la khro skyes rnams kyi 'dod ma yang / /kun tu gdung dang 'ching 'dod ma dang nges par 'jam por smra ba dang ni skems dang sgrod 'dod ma/ /reg dang dgug pa dag dang 'ching dang mi yi bdag po phur bu 'debs dang rgyug pa /'dod mar 'gyur/ /yan lag thams cad bskyod par 'dod ma rab tu gsal zhing nges par bshang gci zag par 'dod ma dang / 45 /sems can rnams la slu 'dod ma dang nges par rtsod pa mang po lnga pa lhag ma za ba dang / /g.yul 'dod ma dang sbrul 'ching ma dang byis pa khro bar 'dod ma rnams ni lha min rigs la 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa bdun phyir 'dod ma rnams slar yang de nas phyi rol dkyil 'khor dag gi kha khyer la//nyin zhag so so'i dus su gang zhig cung zad sems can bya ba rnal 'byor ma yi bya ba 'dir/ 46 /zhes pa de ltar rdo rje can gyis srid pa gsum po mtha' dag rnams kyang dkyil 'khor rnam par gsungs/ /phyi dang lus dang gzhan la yang ni spro dang sdud pa skedag la dngos po'i skye ba yang dag gnas/ /de la rtag pa mkha' yi rdo rje rnam gsum srid pa la gnas mi rtag nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /'byung po'i tshogs ni rtag pa min par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po mig 'phrul ji bzhin nyid du'o / 47 /rtag dang mi rtag mthong ste de lta na yang blun po'i blo can sems 77—200

ni dag pa'i don slad du/ /sgrub /thabs dag ni brjod par bya ste snying por gyur pa 'ga' yang 'dir ni bsgrub par bya ba med/ /gang zhig bsgrub bya sgrub pa po de 'khrul ba zhes pa rdo rje can gyi sgrub thabs mtha' dag gang / /de phyir rgyal po rang sems dri ma rnam par bral ba dag ni dkyil 'khor dbang por rirab tu bya / 48 /dpal ldan rdo rje can ni thugs kyi rdo rjer 'gyur te mi bdag dkyil 'khor sku yi rdo rje'o/ /lha rnams 'khor lo ā li tā lali'i rigs skyes gsung gi rdo rje zla ba nyi ma'i steng du'o/ /rtsa ba sdong bu dag ni a yig 'dab ma dang ni de bzhin ge sar rnams kyang u yig go/ /dbus su dpal ldan lte ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rnam ci gnyis rkang pa'i gnas dag ma yig go/ 49 /ho yig thog ma tha ma'i snying po bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ste/ /de ni shes rab chags pas zhu ba khyab bdag rdo rje can yang ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin bltas nas / /lha mo rnams kyis glu tshodag mdzad de tshabacom ldan khyod ni sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa po/ /bdag cag srungs shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod/ 50 /rdo rje can des glu dag gsan nas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag rnams kyang mig 'phrul lta bur ni//gzigs nas skyed skepa mdzad de skudri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba rang gi mtshan ma spros byas nas/ /rdo rje'i rgyan dang ldan zhing rgyal ba'i bdag po'i cod pan shes rab kyis ni 'khyud par gyur pa yang / /lashes rab thabs kyis rgyal po paslar yang dkyil 'khor ma lus pa ni rab tu spro ba dag kyang ngo / 51 /'od zer sngon po 'jigs pa'i sku ste rab tu bzhan pa'i zhal dang mche ba phyed ni gtsigs pa dang / /sgra drag sgrogs —byed nyi ma'i spyan dang gnyis lhag pargyal ba'i 77—201

phyag ste rig byed zhal dang zhabs gnyis pa/ /shes rab thabs la /rab byung mtshon cha rnams dang bcas pa rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta dag la gnas/ /rgyal ba'i dgra ni 'joms par byed pa rdo rje shugs te ye shes 'khor lo'i slad du bskul bar bya/ 52 /dri med 'od zer 'phro ba ye shes 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dag ni rinye bar lcags kyus bsnun byas shing / /phyag rnams rang gi rdo rje gdengs can dag gis de bzhin rab bcings mtshon cha rnams kyis 'jigs byas te/ /mtha' dag bsgrub byar byas shing 'khor lo bzang po bskyod par byas nas 'di ni slar yang 'gro ba ste/ /gzhug dang bcing dang mnyes pa dang ni ro mnyam byed pa dag ni rmugs byed la sogs rnams kyis byed/ 53 /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor dag la sems ni nam mkha' dang bcas snying po'i padmar me yi steng du 'gyur/ /shar du dpal ldan nag mo 'bar ma mchog gi pad 'dab la ni lho ru dmar mo 'bar ma ste/ /byang du dpal ldan dkar mo 'bar mar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis nub tu ser mo 'bar ma'o/ /mer ni du ba da nu'i bu yi phyogs su smig rgyu ma dang dbang ldan phyogs su mkha' snang ma/ 54 /rlung du dpal ldan mar me ma ste nor bu dang ni shing dang chos kyi gasnyi tshodag dang dung //me dang rlung dang lha min dang ni 'phrog byed phyogs su de bzhin bar gyi gzur gyi cha la'o / /shar du 'du byed dang ni sa dag nges par padma la gnas lho ru tshor ba chu dag go/ /byang du 'du shes dang ni me ru 'gyur te nub tu yang ni rlung dang bcas pa'i gzugs nyid do/ 55 /me yi phyogs su rlung dang gzugs su 'gyur te lha min bdag por me dang 'du shes gnyis po'o / /dbang ldan du ni chu dang tshor ba dag ste rlung du 'dzin ma 'du byed phung por ldan pa'o/ /lha mo 77—202

sangs rgyas par rnams su ni le tshe /brgyad kyi gnas su bdud rtsi'i ro yi bum pa rnams /slar yang 'phar ma phyi ma la ni shar du sna dang dri ste lho ru mig dang gzugs dag go / 56 /byang du lce dang ro ru 'gyur te chur ni de bzhin nyid du lus dang reg bya dag tu 'gyur/ / sa 'og tu rini rna ba sgra ru 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis lho yi sgo yi g.yon du'o/ / nam mkha' la cani nges par sems dang chos kyi dbyings su 'gyur te shar gyi sgo yi g.yon du'o/ /dang por thabs ni drug po dag kyang rgyal ba'i dbang gis dkyil 'khor gyi ni lhag pa'i lha ru 'gyur / 57 /phyi nas shes rab la sogs drug ni rab tu gsal bar bdag po kyirang rang padma'i gdan la'o/ /shar gyi sgor ni rab gtum ral gri 'dzin pa shin tu stobs te de yi phyag rgya rengs byed ma'o / /g.yas su rmugs byed dang ni nga rgyal mar 'gyur nor sbyin du yang khengs byed dang ni rmugs byed ma/ /chu ru rengs byed dang ni mtha' yas brtson 'grus mar 'gyur sgo yi —dbus na gnas pa'i padma la'o/ 58 /dbyug sngon 'od zer can dang mi g.yo zhes dang khro gnyer can ma brtson 'grus mtha' yas lcags sgrog ma/ /'dod pa tsund+ra shing rta la gnas lha dang nor sbyin gzhan dang lho yi sgo yi dbus su ste/ /gnod mdzes drag spyan ma ni 'og tu 'gyur zhing mkha' la gtsug tor dang ni shin tu sngon mo nyid / /shar gyi sgo yi steng dang gzhan du yang ni nges par 'gyur te gnyis pa dag gi shing rta yang / 59 /gsung las skyes pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni nor gyi phyogs su 'byung po las skyes rnams kyi gdan du 'gyur/ /shar du tsā musmo dang dbang por 'gyur te rtse mo can du khyab 'jug ma dang rig byed gdong / /gshin rjer skaphag mo drag por 'gyur te lha min bdag por gdong drug ma dang bgegs 77—203

kyi mgon po'o/ /nub tu dbang mo 0bden bral du 'gyur rlung du nges par dus kyi gdong ma dang ni khyab 'jug nyid/ 60 /gnod sbyin du ni drag mo gshin rjer 'gyur te phyugs kyi bdag por dpal mo nyid dang gdong drug pa/ /phyi rol gyi ni dbang po'i sgo yi g.yas su lha min bdag dang de yi 5phyag rgya srin mor 'gyur /me ni rlung dang rab gtum ma ste me dang chu lha mo yang lho yi sgo yi g.yas su'o/ /lha min bdag por dpal ldan gdong drug pa dang dpal mor 'gyur te nub tu dbang po rlung lha mo / 61 /rlung du tshangs pa dang ni glog mar 'gyur te nor sbyin du yang rgya mtsho dang ni phag mo'o/ /dbang ldan du ni tshogs kyi dbang po gzhon nu ma ste nor sbyin gshin rje'i sgo yi g.yon gyi char/ /drag po dus te khyab 'jug dang ni nor sbyin zhes pa lho ri dang nub kyi sgo yi g.yon du'o / /de dag rnams kyi phyag rgyar rab grags ri sras gshin rje ma dang dpal mo nor gyi dzodabang mor 'gyur/ zhin /phyi rol du ni lha dang gshin rje nor sbyin nub kyi kha khyer dzodag la klu rnams mtha' dag ste/ /padma dang ni stobs kyi rgyu dag g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong ni/ /me la gnas pa dag ste chu yi steng du rigs ldan mtha' yas klur ni rab tu grags par 'gyur / /de bzhin sa yi dkyil 'khor la gnas rigs kyi dbang gis 'jog po dang ni padma chen por 'gyur/ 63 /de rnams shes rab rab gtum ma rnams dur khrod sa la gnas pa mkhyi gdong ma la sogs pa ste/ /de rnams thabs ni padma la sogs gzhan gyi rigs kyi dbang gis bde ba dam pa'i don du 'gyur/ / shar gyi 'khor lor rtse mos 'thags pa'i dur khrod du ni g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas mkhyi gdong ma/ /gshin rje dag tu nges par ro ni bsreg 4par phag gi gdong ma 77—204

byang du rul pa dang bcas par/ 64 /stag gdong ma ste chu ru rnag gi drir ni de bzhin nyid du ce 3 spyang dag gi gdong mar 'gyur/ /me dang lha min bdag por lhag ma dang ni mi bzad g.yul du bya rog gdong ma bya rgod bcas/ /rlung du sbrul gyis zos par mkha' 'gro'i bdag po'i gdong ma dbang ldan du yang byis pa shi bar ni/ /'khor lo la gnas lug gdong ma ste sa yi dkyil 'khor la gnas zla nyi dag kyang bsgom par bya/ 65 /g.yon brkyang ba ni yum gyir 'gyur te mnyam pa'i stabs ni 'dab ma dag gi ri mo'i tshogs kyi'o/ /bcu dang nor gyi tshogs dag gi ni g.yon brkyang sa ga lha min mo rnams kyi yang skum po'o/ /g.yon brkyang dag la gnas pa rnams kyi snyoms par 'jug pa g.yas brkyang stabs su nges par 'gyur ba ste/ /sa ga la ni sa ga nyid ces bya bar 'gyur zhing nges par skum po la yang skum po'o/ 66 /dkyil 'khor du yang lhag ma'i lha rnams rab tu 4rigasal zhing sunges par rdo rje gdan gyis phyoganas pa ste/ /rang rigs phyogs gnas lha mo rnams ni rang rang padma zla ba'i steng du padma'i gdan gyis gnas/ /gdengs can rigs dang tshobacas pa rang rang phyogs kyi bzhon 7par gnas pa'i lha rnams rdo rje gdan gyis gnas / /lha rnams 'dab mar lha mo rnams ni rol pa'i stabs te 'byung po las skyes rnams kyi de bzhin nyid/ 67 /g.yas pa bskum pa dag kyang sa gzhi la ni nges par bkod cing rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang 7ba dag /phyed dang bcas pa'i khru gnyis pa ste mi yi bdag po de ni g.yon pa brkyang ba'i stabs su 'gyur/ /g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis ni g.yas brkyang du 'gyur rkang pa zung ni mnyam pa dag kyang mnyam pa'i stabs/ /yon tan dbang gis pus mo zung ni rab tu brkyang ba dag las sa ga dang ni skum por 77—205
