'gyur zhin /cung zad pus mo phyed ni 'khyog pa rol par 'gyur te lhag ma dag ni rab tu grags pa nyid/ /slar yang rnal 'byor pa yis bha ra ta las shes par bya ste rdo rje gar gyi slad du'o/ /cod pan dag la phan tshun rdo rje yi ni /rdo rjer 'gyur te sangs rgyas lnga rnams re 'ga' na/ /gzugs kyi steng du mi bskyod pa ste gsal bar padma 'dzin pa'i rnam par snang mdzad nyid du 'gyur / 69 /rin chen dbang po'i chu skyes 'dzin dang don yod grub pa'i cod pan la ni rab mchog nor bu'i phyag /drug gi cod pan ral pa zhes byar ri'agyur te yon tan dbang gis lhag ma'i 'khor lo yi yang gzhan/ /sa las 'khor lo rab tu skye bar 'gyur te chu las padma dang ni me las nor bu'o/ /rlung las ral gri dang ni stong pa dag las rdo rjer 'gyur te 'gyur med las ni gri gug go 70 /gos dang bdud rtsi'i snod du 'gyur te nges par me long dang bcas phreng ba dang ni rgyud mangs dang / /drug pa chos 'byung nges par sa dang chu dang bsreg za rlung dang nam mkha'i zhi ba dag las so/ /phub dang mdung dang mda' dang dgra sta dang ni ḍa ma ru dag mtshan ma lnga ste de bzhin du/ /dbyug pa zhags pa lcags kyu dag dang nges par de bzhin tho ba dang ni rtse gsum dag tu 'gyur 71 /gzhu dang utpa la dang slar yang de bzhin mgo bo dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga dang dril bu dang / /de bzhin lcags sgrog la sogs chu na rgyu ba thod pa stag lpags dang ni glang po'i pags pa ste/ /'dir ni lhag ma nye ba'i mtshan ma sa dang chu dang bsreg dzoza rlung dang nam mkha' las skyes pa/ /de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis shes par bya ba nyid de mu dang lha mo rnams kyi'o/ 72 /gang zhig bla skel sogs pa sum cu'i dbyangs ni sa chu bsreg laza rlung dang nam mkha' 77—206

las skyes pa// /thung ngu ring po'i rab dbye rnams kyis rim par yongs bkod ringes par padma la gnas zla ba dang / /nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa de dag mtha' dag ca'akhor lo la sogs mtshan ma rnams kyikyi rang gi sngags/ /gang zhig kho nar mtshan ma drug par gyur pa der ni yon tan dbang gis gzhom du med par 'gyur / 73 /nā da dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur te mi yi bdag po thugs kyi rdo rje a yig go/ /i yig thung ngu ral gri ldan par 'gyur te slar yang ṛ ri yig dag ni phyag na rin chen no/ /u yig thung ngu snang ba mtha' yas su 'gyur slar yang 'dir ni bla 7yig rnam par snang mdzad do/ /bsam pa'i rab tu dbye bas dbyangs kyi tshogs pa ring po mtha' dag rgyal ba drug gi rim pas so/ 74 /dpal ldan yum ni gzhom du med pa zhes par 'gyur te de bzhin ā :yig las skyes nam mkha'i khams/ /rlung dang me dang chu dang sa rnams la ni smi dzā lca sngo thams cad rim pas muganas par 'gyur/ /mchog gi rgyal ba'i tshabadag po pasna tshogs yum ni —bde ba'i don du phan tshun lus tshadang bsam pa ste/ /mi bskyod stong pa'i khams dang phyag gi padma ral gri dang ni spyan ma lus dang bsam pa'o/ 75 /rin chen dbang po ma mā tī dang gsal bar pad 'dzin gos dkar mo ni lus dang bsam pa ste/ /de bzhin 'khor lo can dang sgrol ma rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis thung dang ring ba'i dbyangs kyis so//i yig kun tu bzang por 'gyur te yon tan tshodabang gis a yig dag kyang phyag na rdo rje'o/ /e yig thung ngu nam mkha'i snying po ar yig dag kyang de bzhin yang dag sa yi snying por 'gyur/ 76 /o yig 'jig rten mgon po al yang de bzhin 'dir ni rnam par sel bar 'gyur te lus la'o/ /ā ri yig chos kyi 77—207

dbyings /su 'gyur te nges par de bzhin aḥ kyiyig las skyes sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /i yig reg bya rdo rje ma ste lus kyi dbye bas ār yig las skyes ro yi rdo rje ma/ / riyig gzugs kyi rdo rje mar 'gyur nges par de bzhin āl —yig las skyes dri yi rdo rje ma/ 77 /dpal ldan bzang po chos kyi dbyings tshadang phyag na rdo rje dang ni sgra yi rdo rje ma dag zung / /nam mkha' snying po dri yi rdo rje ma dang 'jig rten mgon po ro yi rdo rje ma dag zung / / sa yi snying po gzugs kyi rdo rje ma dang reg bya rnam par sel ba dag ni zung du 'gyur/ /de ltar rigs ni drug po rnam dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis yang dag par ni rig par bya/ 78 /haṃ tshoyig gtsug tor 'khor lo can 'gyur lus kyi dbang gis 'dir ni haḥyig shin tu sngon mo'o/ /ha yig thung ngu gnod mdzes su 'gyur nges par de bzhin ring po las skyes drag po'i mig ma'o/ /yam̐ lā rim pas rab tu gsal bar shin tu stobs dang rengs byed ma ste gnyis po dag kyang zung rte/ /re āoṃ 7bugs byed nga rgyal ma ste waṃ dang 5rāḥ zhes pa ni khengs byed rmugs byed mar 'gyur ro / 79 /lo yāḥ rengs byed shin tu brtson 'grus mar 'gyur ya wa ra la dbyug pa sngon po mi g.yo ba/ /'dod pa dang ni mtha' yas brtson 'grus su 'gyur lus kyi dbang gis lha mo rnams kyi ring po ste/ /yā wā rā lā pade bzhin glang po rta dang seng ge dang ni phag gi shing 4rta dag la 'gyur/ /dbyug sngon 'od zer can dang mi —g.yo zhes dang khro gnyer can ma brtson 'grus mtha' yas lcags sgrog ma / 80 /'dod pa tsund+ra 5zung du 'gyur te mi bdag dkyil 'khor la ni bde ba dam pa'i don du'o/ /a yig dag dang i dang rnam par bcad pa ha dang haḥdang ha hā las skyes nus ma brgyad/ /bum pa rnams la de bzhin ha yig rlung dang 77—208

me dang chu dang sa yi dbyangs /kyis phye bar 'gyur/ /oṃ rgyu risto āḥdung dang dri med yon tan nor bu dang ni rkang 'thung chos kyi gasnyi'o/ 81 /ha yig tsā musmo riste haṃ dang haḥ zhes bya ba 'dir ni dbang phyug ma dang phag mo'o/ /hā dang kṣa ṭhā kṣ-i kṣaX dbang mo mkha' 'gro'i bdag pos 'gro ma tshangs ma dpal mo gzhon nu ma/ /tī hṝ rgyu tsā rgyab tu padma mchog gi 'dab tshom la ste thung ngu'i dbyangs rnams mdun du'o/ /tī : 7skya sgro 7de bzhin nyid de parab tu gsal zhing nges par thung ngu'i skudabyangs rnams de bzhin no/ 82 /shar dang g.yas dang g.yas min chu dang me dang lha min dbang ldan dang ni rlung gi padma la/ /'dab ma drug la ya sogs dbyangs drug gis phye thung ngu ring po rnams ni rim par yongs bkod pa/ /hi kṣi la sogs la mtha' thams cad nor ni gdengs can gyis bsgyur lha mo rnams kyi 'dab ma la/ /rigs kyi dbang gis mngon phyogs tsā musmo cil sogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur te sngags kyi dbye bas so/ 83 /rta na 5brgya byin chu gter gdong ste pi maḥzhes pa rgya mtsho dang ni dpal ldan tshogs kyi dbang / /ṭaṃ ṇaḥme dang gzhon nu dag ste rtsa dang nya zhes bya ba srin po'i dbang po dag dang rlung / /kai daḥkhyab 'jug dus te 'phrog byed ces dang nor sbyin dag kyang dang 'dir ni naḥnyid do/ /tsa sogs sde pa dbyangs dang bcas pa rnams ni lha yi padma'i 'dab mar lha mo rnams spyir 'gyur/ 84 /nag pa'i zla ba sogs kyi tshes rnams dus kyi nges pa'i dbang gis stong pa drug dang me yi grangs/ /de nyid la zhon laha yig rlung me chu dang sa rnams dag la shar la sogs pa'i klu rnams kyi/ /sde bdun brtsegs pa la gnas kṣa ya ra wa lar ldan dur khrod du ni lha min mo rnams kyi/ /shes rab thabs kyi lus dang bsam pas 77—209

rigs kyi dbang las 'dir ni gang zhig dbus su mngon phyogs 'gyur/ 85 /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang kun bzangs rigs kyi dbang gis rdo rje 'dzin pa phyag na rdo rjer 'gyur/ /don yod grub dang nam mkha'i snying po dri med nor bu'i phyag dang sa yi snying po yang dag go/ /phyag na 'khor lo rnam par sel bar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis 'od dpag med dang 'jig rten mgon/ /dpal ldan yum dang chos kyi dbyings te sgra yi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma 86 /dpal ldan sgrol ma reg bya rdo rje ma ste rigs kyi dbye bas gos dkar ro yi rdo rje ma/ /mā ma tī dang gzugs zhes grags par 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis spyan ma dri yi rdo rje ma/ /khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs dang rgyal ba'i bdag por 'gyur te kun tu bzang po de nyid do/ /gtsug tor mi bskyod pa nyid 'dir ni slar yang shin tu stobs dang don yod grub par rab tu grags/ 87 /mugs byed dang ni phyag na rin chen du 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis khengs byed dang ni 'od dpag med/ /rengs byed dang ni rnam par snang mdzad du 'gyur stobs ldan phyag na rdo rje dag dang gnod mdzes so/ /mkha' risnying dang ni dbyug pa sngon po rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis sa yi snying po 'dod pa'o/ /rnam par sel dang shin tu brtson 'grus su 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis 'jig rten mgon po mi g.yo ba/ 88 /yum dang khro bo'i dbang po'i phyag rgyar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis chos kyi dbyings ni de bzhin nyid/ /stong par grags pa shin tu sngon mo rlung me chu dang sa la sogs pa mtha' yas brtson 'grus dang / /rmugs byed ma dang khengs ma rengs byed mar ni rim pas rab tu gsal zhing nges par rab tu grags/ /drag spyan sgra yi rdo rje mar 'gyur 77—210

rigs kyi dbang gis lcags sgrog ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma/ 89 /'od zer can dang dri yi rdo rjer rab tu 'gyur te khro gnyer can dang tsund+rar rab grags pa//rigs kyi dbye bas nges par ro yi rdo rje ma dang gzugs kyi rdo rjer rim pas shes par bya/ /'dir ni rengs byed dus mthar byed pa nyid de slar yang shin tu stobs dang bgegs dgrar rab tu grags/ /mugs byed shes rab mthar byed dag catu rab tu 'gyur te de bzhin khengs byed dang ni padma'i dgra/ 90 /rlung me chu sa tsā musmo zudang phag mo dbang phyug ma dang de bzhin dbang mo bzhi pa ste/ /dri dang gzugs dang ro dang reg bya zhes pa g.yo ba 'phrog byed lha min mer ni gnas pa yang / /tshangs pa dang ni rnam par snang mdzad du 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis rgya mtsho dag dang 'od dpag med/ /me dang dpal ldan phyag na rin chen du 'gyur rlung dang don yod grub pa dag ni de bzhin nyid/ 91 /mi bskyod pa dang lha min dgra bor 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po dang ni bde byed rab tu grags/ /rnam par sel ba gang de brgya byin du 'gyur 'jig rten mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po de bzhin nyid/ /sa yi snying po gdong drug par 'gyur dpal ldan mkha' snying da nu'i bdag por rab tu grags pa yin/ /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje dus su 'gyur te drug pa kun tu bzang po nor gyi bdag po'o / 92 /rig ma drug dang phyag rgya 9drug ni rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis de rnams rang rang phyag rgya ste/ / phyag rgya rig ma dzol sogs nyi ma lha yi mchog gi bdag rnams dkar po nag po rdzogs pa'o/ /de dag rnams kyi pad 'dab la ni nor lag tshes 7te mchu yi zla ba la sogs gang de rnams/ /zla ba drug ni snga ma drug tu 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis lha mo rnams kyi phyi ma yang / 93 /klu 77—211

brgyad gang de bum pa rnams te khyab bdag padma'i 'dab la yi/nus ma de rnams rab gtum ma/ /dpal ldan du ba bya rog gdong mar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis bya rgod gdong ma smig rgyu ma/ /mkha' snang ma ni lug pa'i ( rigadong ma ridapal ldan mar me mkha' 'gro'i bdag po'i gdong mar caskurab tu grags/ /nag mo 'bar ma khyi gdong ma ste dmar mo 'bar ma shin tu rnam 'gyur bzhin 5ldan phag gdong ma/ 94 /dkar mo 'bar ma stag gi gdong mar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis ser mo 'bar ma ce ( sispyang ma/ /de bzhin sgeg mo la sogs thams cad rab tu gsal ba rnam bcu ( sna tshogs yum ni 3dalhag ma'o/ /lha mo sangs rgyas rig ma shing dang bcas shing bum pa dang bcas rgyal ba yi ni dag pa'i sku / /khro bo'i dbang po byang chub sems dpa' nges par 7ro yi rdo rje ma ni chos kyi sku de nyid/ 95 /rnal 'byor ma rnams longs 7spyod sku ste rab mchog shing rta la gnas lha ni nyi mar rab grags pa/ /klu ni brgyad po rnams dang rab gtum ma rnams 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi ni sprul pa'i sku/ /de bzhin slar yang rgyal ba'i sku ni dbye ba gnyis su 'gyur te phyi rol dag dang dang na tshoyang / /mngal nas skyes pa ji lta ba nyid de bzhin kho na dkyil 'khor la ni nges par rab tu 'gyur/ 96 /ston pa lha mo sogs dang bum pa lhan skyes rgyal ba'i sku ste dkyil 'khor snying po'i dbus su'o/ /sangs rgyas la sogs chos kyi sku ste nges par ro yi rdo rje ma sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /khro bo sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur te yon tan chadabang gis dkyil 'khor gyi ni snying por yang dag gnas/ /phyi rol du ni tsā su: pal sogs pa lha mo brgyad po 'khor dang bcas pa dag pa'i sku 97 /lha la sogs pa chos kyi sku ste mtha' dag gdengs can rigs kyang 77—212

'dir ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /gtum mo rnams ni sprul pa'i skur 'gyur mi yi bdag po sems can kun gyi don gyi slad du'o/ /sku yi rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i sku ni zung du 'gyur te gzugs ni rdzogs pa'i slad du'o/ /gsung gi rdo rje dang ni chos kyi sku yang zung du 'gyur te chos nyid bstan pa'i don du'o/ 98 /thugs dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang zung du 'gyur te sems can kun gyi don ni byed pa po/ /ye shes dang ni sprul pa'i sku dag zung du 'gyur te srog chags rnams la thar pa ster ba nyid/ /shes rab thabs kyi lus dang bsam pa mnyam dang mi mnyam rigs ni nyi zla ka sogs a sogs dang / /rnam gsum srid pa la gnas ye shes rnam shes dbye ba dag gis rnal 'byor pa yis rig par bya/ 99 /rdo rje gu hā'i mtha' ldan dag gis mgo dang mgrin pa snying ga rinye ba gsang ba spyi bor te/ /'di dag gis rini byin brlabs ciyan lag rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag po lha mo rnams kyis bkru bar bya/ /stong pa chos kyi dbyings dang rdo rje gsum gyi dus dang ye shes mchod pa rjes su chags pa la skyabs su 'gro ba gsum nas sgrub pa po yis ta ta swa bhā ba ā dzoko3 0ha brjod par bya/ 100 /bum pa rnams dang du ba la sogs brgyad po rnams kyis snying gar skuchos kyi 'khor lor rab tu 'gyur/ /rig skum rnams dang sangs rgyas nyid kyis mgo bor rtsibs bcu drug pa lhan cig skyes par rab tu grags / /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs nyis 'gyur mi bdag rnams kyis mgrin par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lor 'gyur/ /'jigs ma la sogs nor ni cigadengs can dag gis bsgyur ba rnams kyis lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'gyur/ 101 /lag pa rkang pa'i tshigs la lha rnams kyi dzini las kyi 77—213

'khor lo dgu bcu dus kyis bsnun pa ste/ /klu dang gtum mo mi yi bdag po rnams kyis sor mo'i tshigs kyi mtshams nyal bya ba zhes byar 'gyur/ /dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi bdag lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye bas so /thugs kyi rnam pa nyi ma ma yin nyin zhag so so'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni rnam par dag 102 /rlung gi dag pas du ba la sogs rang gi snying ga'i padmar rtsa yi 'khor lo la gnas rnams/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyi bdud/ /dung dang gasnyi ma ṇi ljon pa zhes pa dag kyang de bzhin sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis/ /bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis te rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub sems sogs kyis/ 103 /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gci ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas/ /khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams kyis/ 104 / tsā mu sogs thun brgyad kyis te padma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod kyis/ /lha min la sogs nyi ma'i zla bas padma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs kyis so/ /gsang bar mi bdag nyis 'gyur chu tshod rnams kyis /klu rnams dang ni gtum mo rnams kyang rnam par dag /de bzhin 'dod ma la sogs de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya bas rnam par dag 105 /skra —rnams kyis ni grub pa mtha' dag ba spu rnams kyis dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 77—214

'byung po'i tshogs/ /de nyid rnams kyis gtso bo'i mtshon cha rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khams kyis /phyi yi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rjes nang gi phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kur zla ba'i steng du yang dag gnas pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang sna tshogs yum ni rnam gsum srid gnas 'gyur med ye shes dbye ba las / 106 /dpal ldan dag pa las ni chos skur 'gyur te chos las nges par longs spyod rdzogs sku bzang po'o/ /longs spyod las ni sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i sems can kun don byed pa po/ /bzhi pa'i gnas skabs shin tu gnyid log nges par slar yang gzhan dang lus kyi dbye bas sad pa ste/ /de ltar lus kyi carab tu dbye bas srog chags rnams kyi lus la yid ni rnam pa bzhi ru gnas/ 107 /sprul par yid ni longs spyod byed pa po ru rab tu 'gyur te lus dang ngag gi gyidabang pos so/ /longs spyod rdzogs la ma mthong sems par 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis chos kyi sku la gnyid kyang ngo / /dag pa la ni bde bar rab 'gyur 'dir ni nyin mtshan dus su thig le grol ba gsum gyi mthar//de phyir de ni nyin mtshan dus su rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya ste 'gyur med don du'o/ 108 /g.yon du srog ni rab tu rgyu bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du ni g.yas pa bskum pa gang yin pa/ /de ni g.yon brkyang stabs te mnyam pa'i stabs dang gzhan pa g.yas brkyang me dang nyi ma'i rgyu ba las/ /sa ga dang ni skum po nyid dang 3mchog gi rol pa'i stabs dang padma dang ni rdo rje'i gdan / /nam mkha' sogs la rab tu rgyu ba mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod pa dag la srog rlung rnam pa lnga/ 109 /gtum mo lte ba'i 'khor lo dgu yis bsnun pa'i lag 'gro tsartsi kā 7sogs lhag pa'i lha dang ldan/ /ho yig ye shes snying po la ni dri med 77—215

glog dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes me ni rab rgyas pa/ /lte bar rnam par snang mdzad la sogs bsreg cing mi yi bdag po spyan ma mig la sogs pa rnams/ /thams cad bsregs nas mgo por zla ba bzang las thig le'i gzugs ni 'dzag ripa gang de rdo rje can/ 110 /shes rab chos 'byung dag la gnas pa mtha' dag slar yang spro ba byas te nges par thig le yis/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan zhing me long dag la gnas pa lta bu'i ye shes 'khor lo rang byung ba/ /'dod pa dang ni gzugs dang gzugs med srid pa rnam pa gsum po dag ri kyang rim pas sbyangs byas te/ /phyi nas ye shes me rtse dag gis srid pa gsum po mtha' dag dus gcig tu ni dgug par bya/ 111 /zla ba nyi ma a sogs ka sogs tsharnams kyis rnam gsum bgrod gnas sku yi rdo rje sogs bzlas pa/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs drug gis gser bzang padma la ni sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor te/ /dga' ba la gsogs rnams kyis rdo rje chu skyes dag la ro mnyam gyur pas bsgom pa tshordo rje gsum/ /shes rab padmar sems kyi thig le dag la lhan skyes bde ba'i dbang gis bsgom pa gzhom med 'gyur/ 112 /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyis bsnyen pa ste/ /so sor sdud pa sogs dang rdo rje padma las skyes bdud rtsi yis ni nye ba'i sgrub par 'gyur/ /dga' ba la sogs rnams kyis rdo rje gsum dang chu skyes ro mnyam gyur pa bsgom 7pa sgrub par 'gyur/ /shes rab sbyar la gang tshe 'pho med phra mo'i rnal 'byor dag las nges par sgrub pa chen por 'gyur/ 113 /dang por stong nyid byang chub nges par slar yang de nas zla ba thig le dag ni yang dag 'dzin/ /de nas gzugs dag bskyed cing rab mchog ro yi rigs rnams dag gis yi ge dgod ske77—216

pa nyid yin te/ / 'di ni spyi yi bsnyen pa /chu yi gter gyi rdo rje rnams kyis sgrub pa dag ni 'bring po ri yang / /'di la thabs ni rnam bzhir 'gyur te dman dang brtan pa bsgrub ripa'i yan lag dag la cide bzhin nyid/ 114 /so sor sdud pa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur zhing rnam pa bcu ste bsam gtan mi bskyod pa nyid do /srog rtsol ri dag kyang ral gri can no slar yang rnam pa bcu ste 'dzin pa phyag na rin chen no/ / gdol pa kyimo la rjes su dran pa padma 'dzin par 'gyur te dpal ldan ting 'dzin 'khor lo can/ /re re dbye ba lnga rnams kyis te slar yang gang las a sogs ka sogs rnams kyis phye ba'o/ 115 /so sor sdud pa lus la yul dang yul can bcu po rnams ni rab tu 'jug pa med pa'o/ /bsam gtan dag kyang shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dga' dang g.yo med bde ba rtse gcig sems pa'o / /srog gi 7rtsol ba 7dag kyang lam ni gnyis po bskyel mazhing dbu mar srog ni zhugs pa dag tu 'gyur/ /thig ler srog ni rab tu zhugs shing gnyis ga'i rshabagrod pa bcom ste rtse gcig sems pa 'dzin pa'o/ 116 /gtum mo'i snang bar gang zhig gyur pa nges par lus dang nam mkha' la yang rjes su dran par 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyi 5bdag nyid kyis ni 'gyur med bde ba'i dbang gis ye shes gzugs la ting nge 'dzin/ /'di dag dman pa la sogs dbye ba rnams kyis sna tshogs gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum du 'gyur//phyag rgya gsum dang gnas skabs gsum ni rnam gsum bgrod pa'i dbang gi palas dang kun rtog mchog rnams so/ 117 /so sor sdud pas rnal 'byor pa ni yul dang rnam par bral ba sngags rnams kun gyis byin gyis rlob/ /mngon par shes pa lnga ni thob par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po bsam gtan sbyor bas dag pa'o/ /77—217

srog gi /rtsol bas dag pa ri bong can dang nyi ma dang bral ribyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod/ /bdud dang nyon mongs la sogs nyams shing stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur te 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis so/ 118 /rjes su dran pa legs par dag pa dri med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag kyang ye shes gzugs las so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis dag pa nyin zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis ye shes lus ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs rnams kyis gal te sngags pa rnams kyi 'dod pa grub par ma gyur na/ /nā da goms pas btsan thabs chu skyes su gnas rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas bsgrub par bya / 119 /bsnyen pa la ni dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam bcu mkha' la 'khor lo can gyi khro po'i lta bas so/ /bgegs mthar byed pa'i lta ba ribadud rtsi'i lam du son pa yis kyang nye ba'i sgrub la yan lag drug /shes rab la spros zla ba thig le rdo rje nor bur gnas pa'i 'gyur med gsum ni sgrub pa la/ /bde ba ma nyams gcig pu zhi ba'i 9lhan skyes ye shes rnal 'byor 'dir ni sgrub pa chen po la 120 /srog gi rtsol ba 5kun nas bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba ji srid mgo yi bar du 'dod pa ste/ /de las steng du 'dod pa ma yin 'i'achi ba'i 'jigs pa byed pa 5phung po nges par 'jig pa'i rgyu/ /gtsug tor sgo ni phug nas 'gro na mchog gi bde ba'i go 'phang ladag la nges par sbyar bar bya/ /sung po med kyang rnal 'byor pa ni bde mnyam 'jug ste 'on kyang 'jig rten du ni grags pa min 121 /dbus su srog ni rab tu zhugs pa sna tshogs yum la yul dang rnam par bral ba'i ci'akhyud pa ste/ /padmar zhugs pa'i rang gi rdo rje spro ba dag kyang de bzhin zla nyi'i dbus su rab zhugs pa / /bde ba sa bon ma lhung ba la 77—218

rab dga'i dga' bar gnas pa rnal 'byor rnams kyi /rnal 'byor 'di/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub don slad khyab bdag gi ni dpal ldan gsang ba las kyang mchog tu gsang ba'o/ 122 /gtsug tor du ni rdo rje rtse mo lnga par 'gyur te phyi rol rtse mo dag ni nyis 'gyur gyi/ /rdo rje chos kyi 'khor lor 'gyur zhing nyis 'gyur gzhan ma dang ni de yi nyis 'gyur dag kyang gzhan/ /de yi yang ni nyis 'gyur gzhan du 'gyur te lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i 'khor lor ro/ /de yi snying por rtse mo gcig pa bde mnyam 'bras ster gsang ba'i padma'i khongs su gnas pa'o/ 123 /rnal 'byor pa yis nyin dang mtshan mor srog gcod pa dag bya ba de ni srog nyams par gsungs te/ /sgra ni gang zhig zhal gyis dman pa dag kyang snying la gyur pa de ni brdzun du smra ba nyid/ /gang zhig thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sa ni 'dzin pa dag kyang rnal 'byor pa yis brku cibar gsungs / /thig le ma lhung ba las bde bar 'gyur ba chags bral min las gzhan gyi bud med bsten pa'o/ 124 /srog gi rtsol ba'i me yis ri bong can ni zhu ba dag kyang btung ba chang ni 'thung ruba'o/ /mthe bo'i tshigs nas gtsug tor dag tu nya yi mthar ni rang sems 'gro ste tshes kyi dbang gis so/ /gtsug tor nas ni sor mo rnams su slar yang 'di nyid tsho'agro ste nag po'i phyogs kyi mtha' ru'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams spyod pa gang de nyid zhag so so'i dus su 'dod pa'i dngos grub rab ster ba / 125 /bsam dang 'dod dang lus la rims dang kha mchog padma skam dang zas la rab tu mi 'jug dang / /'dar dang spyo tshodang rab tu rmongs par 'gyur dang yid ni rnam par 'khrul dang drag tu brgyal ba dag /rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs rab gsal rnam pa bcu ste srog 77—219

chags lus la 'jig rten du/ /rab tu gsal zhing nges pa de rnams yid srubs 4gnas skabs su zhig rgyal ba 'dod pa de ni su/ 126 /nyin dang mtshan mor thig le dag las dkar po'i rgyun 'bab gang zhig mā ma tī ste richang ma yin/ /go ciku la sogs mig la sogs pa nyin zhag so sor spro ste sha gzhan res 'ga' dag kyang min/ /rang rigs sa la gnas pa'i lha rnams dag gis dag pa'i lus la bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsnyen pa ste/ /stong par sems ni rab tu zhugs pas ro mnyam byed pa 'khrig pa de ni skye gnas la ma yin/ 127 /nor ni gtong ba risbyin pa yid dang bud med 'grogs pa las kyang 'pho ba med pa tshul khrims te/ /bzod pa sgra la sogs pa mi 'jug pa ste rlung gi gnyi ga'i bgrod pa 'jig pa brtson 'grus nyid/ /bsam gtan shes rab dag kyang lhan skyes bde la gnas pa'i sems dang kun tu 'gro ba kun gyi skad/ /de las sems can don dang rdzu 'phrul srid pa mthar byed mi skye 'thob ste gzhan pa bzhi rnams so/ 128 /gcig bu'i sku ni nus pa dang ldan gnas dgu dang bcas nyi shu lnga yi dzo bdag nyid la sogs pa/ /bsgoms na phyag rgya la sogs grub pa rnams su nges par nyin zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis yang dag 'gyur/ /rengs pa dang ni zhi dang dbang dang srid pa 'jig pa dag ni zhal gyi dbye ba rnams kyis byed/ /'byung ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas lha min lag 'gro'i rigs 'di bsgoms pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ 129 /dkar po yis ni zhi dang rgyas pa byed de tsharang gi yid la dmar po yis ni dgug dang dbang / /ser pos rengs dang thongs pa dag ste nag po'i sprin dang mtshungs pas gsad 7pa dang ni bskrad 7pa'o/ /bsgom 7dang bzlas pa de bzhin nyid du rang gi yid la byed de —sku gsung thugs dang rdo rje 77—220

ni/ /'byung ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag las kyi dbye bas bsgrub par bya/ 130 /phyogs ni lhag pa las byung bung ba dang ni gser dang mtshungs pa g.yas dang cig 3)shos dag gis ni/ /gung po'i bdud la 0glang chen pags 4pa dag kyang ma lus bshus te rkang pa zung zhig dag nas 'dzin/ /lha min dbang po'i khrag gi thod pa rab mchog phyag mthil na ste 'chi bdag bdud kyi gdong gi phyag /ston mongs bdud ni zhabs kyis bsnyel ba gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag ni gzhan gyi don du bsgom par bya/ 131 /de la yum ni zhal gcig zung gi phyag gi padma dag la gri gug dpal ldan thod pa ste/ /nyi ma las ni zla bas rang gi rgyu ba bcu gnyis lhag pa'i gcig rgyu bgrod pa'i dbang gis so/ /de phyir lus kyi rab tu dbye bas rgyal ba'i bdag por 'gyur te sna tshogs yum ni de bzhin nyid/ /shes rab thabs kyi lus dang bsam pa bde mnyam 'bras ster zla ba nyi ma'i rab tu rgyu bas so/ 132 /gcig la sogs pa mtha' yas zhal te phyag dang zhabs mang du ma'i kha dog mun pa dag gi mthar/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid nges par bde mnyam ster te rtsa ni zla ba nyi ma 'gog pa las/ /sa la sogs pa rnams ni kun nas 'jigs byed dri med nor bu dang mtshungs stong pa gcig pu ste/ /thog ma med cing mtha' med dbus kyang med la yul med yul ni bsgrubs pa dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ 133 /khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs ni gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag dang rig byed zhal dang zhabs gnyis pa/ /dmar ser spyan dang dbu skra dmar ser rgyal ba'i bdag po'i cod pan mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa ste/ /sbrul gyi rgyan dang rab mchog stag gi pags tshopa'i sham thabs dang ni gtso bo'i bzhin du mtshon cha'i phyag /spyi bor mtha' 77—221

dag rgyal ba'i rigs kyi thod pa kha dog lnga rnams dag gis /phreng ba nges par bcings 134 /dri med 'od zer 'phro ba sna tshogs chu skyes nyi ma'i steng du dkyil 'khor sna tshogs mdog la ni/ /zhabs gnyis dag gis 'byung po'i mgon po lhag pa'i stobs kyis mnan cing g.yas brkyang stabs kyis yang dag gnas/ /'byung po rnams dang lha min gdengs can lha rnams skrag par byed cing ye shes sems dpa' gcig gyur pa/ /bsgoms rin zla ba gcig nyid kho na dur khrod sa la gnas pa 'byung po'i tshogs ni bsgrub par bya/ 135 /klu rnams chu skyes 'dab brgyad la ste rgyal dang rnam rgyal dag ni nyi ma'i steng du bsnyel byas nas/ /zhabs dag gis ni gdengs can bdag po zung dang padma'i 'dab mar gnas pa rnams kyi mjug ma yi/ /rtse mo thams cad mnan nas sprin gyi rigs ni sto ba dag nas nges par kun tu spro byed pa/ /de ltar khro bo'i dbang po bsgoms pas nyid zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis sprin gyi tshogs ni bsgrub par bya/ 136 /zhes pa la sogs mi yi bdag po lha rnams dang ni lha mo rnams kyi sgrub thabs so so ru /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni rang gi rgyal ba'i rigs kyi dbang gis las kyi dbye ba mtha' dag rnams kyis 0'gyur/ /rengs dang zhi ba dag dang dbang dang gzhan nor 'phrog dang gsad pa dang ni bskrad pa dag la yang / /sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gyur te slar yang bzlas dang sbyin sreg rang gi /sa bon gyis/ 137 /zhi ba la ni bsam gtan dag kyang zhi ba ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar lha ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag po la yang bsam gtan drag po dang ni sprin nag dang mtshungs lha rnams drag po nyid kyi gzugs/ /dbang du bya la bsam gtan chags pa dang bcas nyin shāmor byed pa'i sku ste lha ni chags pa'i 77—222

gzugs /rengs pa la ni bsam gtan rmongs pa dang bcas mchog gi gser dang mtshungs pa'i lha rnams rengs pa'i gzugs/ 138 /zhi dang rgyas pa dag kyang sras bcas rgyal ba'i rigs dang rgyal po lha mo rnams kyis 'grub par 'gyur//dbye dang bskrad pa dag kyang rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khro bo las skyes rnams kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /dbang sogs 'byung skyes rnams kyis rab gsal lha min rigs la phur bus gdab pa'ang lha min mo rnams kyis/ /yum dag gis ni las rnams thams cad gnyi ga'i rdo rje'i rigs la gsad /pa dang ni gso ba yang / 139 /dang por dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang ni srid gsum skyed ma 'bad pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nas sa gzhi'i gnas dag tu ni gang zhig zhi ba la sogs las rnams dag kyang bsgrub par bya/ /pha dang ma yis rnam par dman pa'i bu ni yod pa min par dus kun tu ni 'jig rten grags/ /de phyir bde mnyam 'bras ster gnyis po bsgrub par bya ste rnam pa gzhan du las ni 'grub pa min/ 140 /gtso bo'i thugs khar padma'i dbus su ri bong can dang nyi ma me yi steng du rdo rje ni/ /hūṃ riyig ye shes las skyes 'jig dus sprin dang mtshungs pa rtse lnga 'od zer dang bcas dgod par bya/ /de yi dbus su dzaḥyi ci gas kyu'i 'od zer rnams kyis srid pa gsum po mtha' dag bkang byas nas / /rnam gsum srid pa la gnas ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas rdo rje'i lam du rab tu gzhug bya ste/ 141 /thams cad zla ba zhu ba dang mtshungs rang gi rdo rje'i kha nas yum gyi padmar spro bar bya/ /de ni nyi mar rab tu zhugs pa ro mnyam dag tu 'gyur te a sogs ka sogs rab ldan pa/ /de yi dbus su zhi ba la sogs las kyi ye shes sa bon du 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis so/ /de 77—223

yis rdzogs pa'i lha mo 'am ni lha yang rnal 'byor pa la 'bras bu ster ba nyid du 'gyur / 142 /dzaḥ / hoX skurim pas lcags kyu zhes dang rdo rje dang ni rdo rje zhags pa dril bu ste/ /oṃ aḥ /hoḥ de bzhin du gsungs zla ba nyi ma rdo rje de bzhin nyid du 'gyur med do/ /khri sbo u thā ri ride bzhin nyid du rab gsal ya ra wa la rlung me chu dang sa rnams so/ /haX haṃ ri za nyi ma dang ni rdo rje zla ba dag dang gri gug tu yang de bzhin gsungs/ 143 /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus su ā li kā li dang bcas chu yi sa bon bdag nyid chu skyes te/ /de las rdzogs pa'i lha mo zla ba'i mdog can zhal gcig ma ste zung gi phyag gi padma can/ /glang chen dkar po la zhon phyag na chu skyes dkar dang mi 'jigs pa dang gos ni dkar po dang / /dkar ba'i rgyan dang ldan zhing rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal ni bsgoms nas bsgrub bya'i khyim du bskul bar bya/ 144 /de nas bsgrub bya bzung nas slar yang khyab bdag dkyil 'khor du ni yang dag rab tu gzhug par bya'o ri/ /gtso po'i bka' ni rab tu thob nas spyan ma la sogs rab dgyes rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa yis/ /—bsgrub bya de ni bkru 7bar byed cing rab mchog rnam pa bcu yi rtenus ma rnams kyis mchod par byed/ /gzugs la sogs pa rnams kyis gso bar byed cing rab gsal sgeg mo la sogs bcu yis tshim par byed 145 /'byung por grags pa rnams kyis pa'ajigs pa med byed rab mchog rnam cibacu khro skyes rnams kyis skyong bar byed/ /klu mo 5rnams kyis 'o dag byed cing 'chi med na chung bcu gnyis rnams kyis 'khyud pa dag tu byed/ /gtum mo rnams kyis bsrung ba byed de 5mtha' dag sa gzhi dag la zhi rgyas don gyi slad du'o/ /de ltar bsgrub bya yi ni mchog gi bde ba byed pa thams cad rnal 77—224

'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ 146 /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus su trīḥste utpal kha ma bye 1)ba'i mda' nyid dang ni mi ba'i rigazhu/ /de las rdzogs pa nyi ma ltar gsal phyag ni gnyi gas gzhu dang mda' ni rna ba'i bar du bkang / /padma dang ni ri bong 'dzin par g.yon brkyang rta la zhon pa bsgrub bya'i khyim du bskul bar bya/ /bsgrub bya yi ni snying ga lte ba gsang ba dag dang mgo dang kha la mda' yis bsnun byas shing / 147 /mgrin par gzhu yis bcings nas de yis bskyod pa dag kyang dkyil 'khor du ni khrid par byed pa ste / /gtum mo rnams kyis gos dang bral ba byas shing klu mo rnams kyis kyang ni nges par bkri tshob byas/ /lha mo rnams kyis spyo bar byed cing khro skyes rnams kyis gtun shing 7dbyug par bcas pa dag gis bsnun7/ /'byung po rnams kyis 'jigs 7par byed cing sgeg mo la sogs rnams kyis kyang ni sen mo rnon po'adebs / 148 /rdo rje ma rnams kyis ni blo gros nyams byas sa dang chu dang bsreg skuza rlung rnams dag gis bcings/ / nus ma rnams kyis gos bral rgyags pa mtha' dag bcom zhing gtso bo yi ni zhabs la snang bar byasang/ /de ltar dbang du byas nas slar yang khyab bdag dag gis tshim par byas te der ni bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin zhags pa lcags kyu dag gis khams gsum po nas dgug pa'i las ni rnam pa mang por 'gyur/ 1ga /nyi ma zla ba'i dbus su sprin dag dang mtshungs snye yig ring po las skyes ral gri bsgoms byas nas/ /de las byung ba bung ba'i mdog can phyag gi padma ral gri dang ni sdigs 5mdzub zhags pa'i phyag /rnga mo'i steng du g.yon pa brkyang zhing rab tu khros pa'i zhal ni bsgrub bya'i khyim du bskul bar bya/ /bsgrub bya zhags pas bcing ba byas nas khros pa'i zhal gyis 77—225

dkyil 'khor gyi ni sgo ru khrid byas te/ 150 /yaḥyig las skyes rnga mo mgyogs pa rlung ltar bgrod pa de la gtso bo'i gsung gis bsgrub bya ni/ / zhon pa 4rtse mo can dang g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor ji srid nyid du rang bzhin gyis ni bskul bar bya//de ltar lha yi bdag po dag kyang nges par bskrad par 'gyur na mi rnams dag ni smos ci dgos/ /dbye ba la yang rnga mos dman zhing rtsod mang byas pa dag ni g.yas dang g.yon du bkri bar bya/ 151 /nyi zla'i dbus su laḥzhes bya ba yongs gyur 'khor lo bzang po kha dog ser po bsgoms byas nas/ /de las byung ba rizhal gcig pa ste mchog gi gser dang mtshungs pa phyag na lcags sgrog 'khor lo can/ /rus casbal la ni lha min gdan gyis gnas shing shin tu dal 'gro bsgrub bya'i khyim du bskul bar bya/ /bsgrub bya 'khor los 'jigs par byas nas sa la rab tu bsnyel te lcags sgrog gis ni rkang pa bcings/ 152 /dkyil 'khor du ni kun tu khrid cing rgyal ba'i bdag po'i bka' yis 'dzin ma la ni bsnyel byas nas/ / de yi steng du bsgrub bya'i lus la lhun po mchog gi tshogaser gyi rang bzhin dgod bya rengs la ste/ /phur bus gdab pa'i don du tshigs drug la ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin phur bu 7rnams kyis gdab par bya/ /rmongs pa la yang sbrul rnams kyis ni kun tu za bar byed cing sa la 'gyel bar bsgom par bya/ 153 /nyi ma zla ba'i dbus su dri med glog dang mtshungs pa'i gri gug zo gyi skerang bzhin bsgoms byas nas/ /de las byung ba'i rab tu gtum mo 'jig dus sprin dang mtshungs pa phyag na gri gug thod pa can/ /rta yi dgra yi steng du g.yon pa chabarkyang zhing cigos dang bral bar bsgrub bya'i khyim du bskul bar bya/ /bsgrub bya'i skra —rnams dag las myur du bzung zhing de yis —77—226

dkyil 'khor du ni gos kyis dman pa yang / 154 /kun tu khrid de /dpal ldan dur khrod dag tu rgyal ba'i bdag po'i bka' yis bya rgod bya rog dang / /ce rispyang rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i yan lag kun las khrag 'thungs sha dang de bzhin du ni khams kun zos/ /de ltar ma lus pa ni rab mchog sa yi gzhi la bsgom par bya ste gsad capa dag la'o/ /bsam gtan 'di yis brgya byin dag kyang gshin rje'i grong khyer 'gro na mngal nas skyes pa smos ci dgos/ 155 /zhi dang rgyas pa la yang rigs kyi dbang gis chu yi sa bon las ni bsam gtan dkar por 'gyur / /dbang dang dgug pa la yang dmar po lus ni sreg par byed pa me yi sa bon bdag nyid do/ /dbye ba dang ni bskrad pa la yang 'jig dus sprin dang mtshungs pa rlung gi sa bon bdag nyid do/ /rengs pa rnams ni phur bus gdab pa sogs la gser zhun dang mtshungs sa yi sa bon rang bzhin no / 156 /stong pa'i sa bon las ni sngon po'i mdog dang ljang gur 'gyur te gsad dzodang gso ba dag la'o/ /sa yi zad par kun nas chu yi gter du 'gro ba la ste rlung gi zad par char pa ni/ /nyams pa'i don te me yi zad 7par dag kyang sa yi dkyil 'khor bzhu ba'i don te me dag kyang / /nyams pa'i don du chu yi zad par du 'gyur stong pa'i zad par mkha' la 'gro dang snang min la 157 /glang po'i bdag po gzhom pa la ni me yi sa bon nyid las gdong palnga pa yi bsam gtan 'gyur/ /klu yi dbang po gzhom pa la ni mkha' ring dkar po chu yi sa bon bdag nyid can du 'gyur/ /bse dang seng ge dag la rkang brgyad 'jig dus sprin dang mtshungs pa rlung gi sa bon bdag nyid can/ /rta yi dgra la bse zhes grags pa sa yi rigs kyi dbang gis lha min gzhom la khro bo 77—227

skyes / 158 /khyab bdag gi ni dpal ldan sngags dang sangs rgyas gzugs kyang rnal 'byor pa yis dang por bsgrub par bya/ /phyi nas nyi ma'i dbye ba rnams kyis gnas pa yon tan dpag tu med pa'i las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags dang gzugs brnyan ma grub par 〉ni srid gsum gnas su ci yang 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid ma yin/ /de phyir rgyal po rang sems dri ma rnam par bral ba dag la rijigs dang gzugs ni bsgrub par bya/ 159 /dpa' bo g.yul gyi dus su lhung bar gyur pa zhes pa'am ni de bzhin chom rkun dpyangs pa dag /brgyad dang 'byung po'i mtshan mo mi yi bdag po ro bsreg sar ni bum pa brgyad kyis bkru bar bya/ /dri dang spos dang mar me dang ni rnam mang kha zas me tog dmar po rnams kyis rab mchod nas/ /mgo dang snying ga zudang ni spyi bo lte ba la sogs su yang rdo rje dgod pa rab byas te/ 160 /thab khung zur gsum du ni rdul tshon dmar pos snying po'i padma gang zhig mtshan mar bcas pa dang / /'dab mar rgyal rnams mtshan ma phyogs su phyogs bral du ni de bzhin lha mo rnams kyi rang mtshan ma/ /phyi rol re khā gsum la phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor du ni de bzhin khro bo'i mtshan ma rnams byas nas/ / de yi g.yas min du ni yi dgas lag pad tshoral gri dkyil 'khor las ni g.yas su rkang pa'o/ 161 /sngar brjod ma mo'i skyon las rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rdo rje rnams kyis bdag nyid bsrung ba skorab byas nas/ /sngags pas thab kyi g.yas su khrag dang bcas pa'i sha rnams dag gis sbyin sreg nyid ni rab byed pa/ /de yi sngags ni oṃ spyo za mephaṭa kyi mtha' ste bcu yis bsgyur ba'i brgyar lani sbyin sreg 7bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung tshabacas nas 'chi med ri bo bzhin du g.yo ba med pa nyid du mtshan mo 77—228

phyed / 162 /sbyin sreg rdzogs na ro 'dzin ral gri lta bur 'khyug cing 'bar la mche ba rnon po mig gsum pa/ /gang zhig sgra sgrogs sa yang rirkang pas rnam par 'goms cashing sgrub pa po ni 'jigs par byed pa de / /thab kyi mtha' ru gnas nas ka ha ka ha dgod par byed cing 'jigs pa'i lus kyis gar byed de / /de mthong nas ni 'jigs pa'i sngags pa sems nyams skad cig gis ni gshin rje'i grong khyer 'gro bar 'gyur/ 163 /ro bsreg tshoganas su sngags pas dngos grub rgyur ni lha min dbang po las kyang 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /g.yo ba med pa'i sems mthong nas ni slar yang bsgrubs pa'i 'byung po'i mgon po 'di skad smra bar 'gyur/ /dpa' bo bzang po khyod kyis bdag ni grub bo mtha' dag smos 7shig da ni bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ /de skad brjod na sgrub rtepa po yis gzhan gyi don du rang yid la 'dod don du gnyer bar bya/ 164 /ral gri reg pa bcud kyi 5dbang po bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu'i ril bu cir tsa na dang mig sman dang / /rkang pa byug dang shing lham dag dang 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub brgyad po khyod kyis bdag la stsol/ /dbye dang bskrad pa dang ni srid pa gzhom pa nyid dang rengs pa dang ni dgug 5pa dag dang dbang / /bdag gi dngos gru( thams cad mdzod cig de yis slar yang 'di dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi'o smra/ 165 /'byung po'i dbang po bsgrubs nas mi yi bdag po sgrub pa po ni sa thog dag dang bar snang dang / /lha yi mchog gi khang pa dang ni lhun po'i rtse dang rgya mtsho'i pha rol gang yin der 'gro ste/ /de la zhon pa phyag na ral gri thogs pas sa yi steng gi gnas su 'jig rten bya ba byed/ /de phyir sems can don gyi slad du mchog gi snying rje yis ni lha min dbang po bsgrub par 77—2 29

bya / 166 /ming gi dang po thugs kyi rdo rjer 'gyur te mi yi bdag po lha dang lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /gsung gi rdo rje ming gi yi ge /thams cad ride las lhag pa dag kyang sku yi rdo rje ste/ /de las yan lag so so'i sngags ni rnam pa mang por 'gyur te bklags pas grub pa brgya lam na/ /bsgom bya mchod bya bzlas bya rang gi rgyal ba'i rigs kyi dbang gis thugs gsung sku yi dbye bas so/ 167 /so sor sngags kyi rigs ni nges par bye ba bzlas par rab tu 'gyur te rab tu grags pa'o/ /sbyin sreg de las bcu yi cha shas rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis grub par 'gyur ba ji srid nyid/ /phyi nas zhi ba la sogs rnams la 'bras bu ster bar rab 'gyur rnam pa gzhan du 'grub mi 'gyur/ /bsam gtan dang bcas bzlas dang sbyin sreg brtul zhugs nges ldan rnams kyi )sngags kyi skye gnas sgrub tshopar bya / 168 /grub pa lcags tshogasum gyis bcings mkha' la 'gro ba'i sha yi ril bus thamakha' la spyod pa nyid dag ster / /khyi dang rta la sogs pa'i sgron ma rnams kyis lus la bkros skom la bsogs mund rnams 'phrog par byed/ /de dag rnams kyi mig dang mkhris lapa rnams kyis mi mchog rnams kyi mig sman sa ni rab 'byed dang / /mi snang ba dang dbang du bya ba na chung yid 'phrog dpal ldan dur khrod du ni bsgrubs pa'o/ 169 /nag po'i brgyad kyi mtshan mo dag gam yang na ma nu'i nyin zhag la ni dkyil 'khor bzhengs byas nas/ /bsrung snyeb dag kyang kun nas byas te de yi dbus su sha yi ril bu dag gam mig sman ni//byas nas shin tu dri bzangs 4me tog rnams kyis yang dag mchod de ri sngags kyi bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /ji srid mkha' la nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer 'phro ba'i bar te de nas blangs la gzung hobar bya/ 170 /'tsho bar pho nya de ni 'tsho la 77—230

nam mkha'i phyogs su gnas na sos zin 'chi ba thob par 'gyur/ /pho nya'i dri ba mi mnyam pa gang nges par bde ba'i 'bras ster mnyam pa 'chi ba ster bar brjod//pho nya sbrul la sogs pa'i ming dag rab tu :brjod na de las sos zin 'chi ba thob par 'gyur/ /gal te srog ni rab tu 'jug la dris na dge bar 'gyur te 'byung ba la ni dge min 'gyur/ 171 /pho nya'i rkang pa g.yon pa mdun na na chung mar brjod g.yas pa mdun du yin na skyes pa'o/ /lag pas rang gi yan lag dag la gang du reg pa'i phyogs 'dir mi de so yis zin pa ste / /mig dang kha ni rab tu gdangs pa dag dang rna ba'i rtsa bar nag po yang ni 'chi bar brjod / /gal te snying ga'i padma dkar por sgra ni cung zad gyur na de ni rab tu bsdu bar bya/ 172 /dang por bsrung ba'i cho ga so yis zin pa dang ni bdag nyid la yang bde ba byed par 'gyur/ /sa chu me rlung de bzhin nam mkha' dag kyang mthe bo la sogs la ni nges par sbyar bar bya/ /la la sogs pa ha yi mtha' rnams rim pas brla dang sto ba snying ga kha nang dpral ba la/ /lhu ’ gya tsho sgyu la sogs klu bcu mi mnyam mnyam pa thung ngu ring po'i rab tu dbye ba yis / 173 /g.yon gyi lus la sa bon thung ngu rna ba mgrin pa la gnas ma na khung dku —dang brla phyogs la/ /g.yas kyi lus la gdengs 7can rnams kyi ring po nyid du rab 'gyur spro dang bsdu ba'i dbye bas so / /rgyal ba zhes grarges sor mo 5shin tu mnyam pa'i 'dam ngabu sbrul gyi pas bon ldan pas bsrung byas nas / /lhu ’ 7ldan pas snying gar /shin tu bsnun na myur du / so yis zin pa stobaskyod par byed par 'gyur/ 174 /sa yi sa bon dpral ba la ste mkha' skyes rkang par gnas pas myur du rengs par byed par 'gyur/ /spyi bor chu dang rtse mo can 77—231

ni sto bar rab tu bcug na dug ni med pa nyid du 'gyur/ /dpral bar rlung gi sa bon dang ni snying gar /rtse mo can gyis nges par dug ni 'pho ba ste/ /spyi bor stong pa rab tu zhugs zhing sa ni rkang par gnas pas 4nges par dug ni gcod par byed/ 175 /dpral bar thig le dkar po yis ni rnam pa gsum gyi dug kyang nges par dug ni med par byed/ /dmar pos bskyod cing nag po'i sprin dang mtshungs pas 'jug pa dang ni kha dog ser pos rengs par byed/ /tsha ba gsum po cisbyar ba'i sdong bu srog ni rab tu 'bab par dug dzomed byed la sbyar byas te / /yang na 5kha ni rnam par phye ba'i lce'u chung la sor mo yis ni ṭaṃ ga ṇa sbyar zubya/ 176 /dzā tī bsgyu chogazhon nu tsha pab gsum dang lan tshwa laṅga lī dang de ba dā li tshadang / /bratī kṣu 5ro a shwa garnya cinyin mor byed pa dang bcas bad dzha gasko ṭa ki dang / /bshang ba sha tshodang khu ba khrag ni mnyam pa dag kyang mi bskyod pas btags ril bu rnabyas pa ni/ /sna ru bkod pas 'byung po 'am ni 'byung po rims dang brtan dang ltos 'gro'i dug ni nges par 'joms/ 177 /nyi ma la sogs gza' bdun dag ni nyid dang mtshan mo'i dus te bdun gyi cha yi mtha' ru ni/ /spen pa nyi ma'i dbus su stong pa rigs ldan ma dag 'chi gzugs chu tshod phyed ni rab tu rgyu/ /de la klu snyedang rtse bar mi bya rnam pa gsum po dag gi dug kyang bza' bar mi bya ste/ /de nyid la ni sbrul gyi cesos zin 'byung pos btab dang mtshon gyis phug pa gshin rje'i grong khyer 'gro/ 178 / nyi ma gung dang mtshan mo phyed la 5nyin mtshan dus su rtag tu rgyu ba'i sarab tu dbye ba dang / /tho rangs dag dang nyi ma nub pa la yang de bzhin du ni 'chi ba'i dus kyi chu tshod de0/ /thun mtshams dbus su stong pa chu gter 77—2 3 2

dag la rigs ldan dus kyis :sos zin chu tshod gcig rab rgyu/ /'di dag sgra gcan gdong pa rnams su nyid zhag so so'i dus su yang dag par ni rig par bya 179 / nyi ma la ni mtha' yas longs spyod nyid dang mtshan mo'i dus su nyid mo'i dang po'i cha la'o / /phyi nas lhag ma can te 'dir ni sto 'phye rnams dag gza' bdun rab tu dbye bas 'char bar 'gyur/ /mkha' dus mkha' dang bug pa mkha' mda' mkha' dus mkha' nor mkha' ri mkha' me dag gi chu tshod rnams / /nyi ma la sogs byulas kyang gdengs can nor rnams dag gi longs spyod rilongs spyod dbye bas dug tu 'gyur/ 180 /mtha' yas rigs ldan zhes pa bram ze kha ba'i mdog ste nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong rgyal rigs dmar/ /padma chen po dang ni de bzhin nyid du 'jog po rje rigs mchog gi gser dang mtshungs pa'o /stobs kyi rgyu dang padma dmangs rigs sprin nag dang mtshungs mthar skyes dag ni kha dog sna tshogs so/ /de dag rnams kyi skye gnas dag kyang chu dang rtse mo can dang 'dzin ma rlung dang nam mkha'i khams/ 181 /mkha' lding zhes pa rkang pa nas ni dpyi mthar ser po de bzhin lte ba'i mtshams su kha ba'i mdog /mgrin pa'i bar du kha dog dmar po sprin nag dang mtshungs smin ma'i 'khri shing ji srid nyid du ste/ /de phyir nges par kha dog sna tshogs gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa de nyid lnga yis rgyas btab pa/ /bsgoms dzod de yi phyag rgyas gdengs can dug dang 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa dag kyang nges par 'phrog 182 /rang gi snying ga'i tshapadma dag la nyi ma'i steng du ska gyi 7yi ge 'dab chags mgon po ni/ /klu yi rgyan dang ldan zhing mtha' dag rigs kyi dbang gis kha dog lnga rnams 'phro ba bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'dab chags mgon po'i sngags muni dang 77—233

por oṃ yig dag dang pa kṣi gu hā'i mtha' can te/ /de ni bye rib phrag gcig bzlas nas gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa'i 'dab chags mgon po bsgrub par bya/ 183 /mkha' lding grub na gdengs can dbang po rnams dang gdengs can bdag po'i bu rnams mngag gzhug nyid du 'gyur/ /rab mchog sa yi steng du 'byung po gnod sbyin gdon rnams dag dang mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo rnams /sngags kyis dgug par rab tu 'gyur te rigadon gyi tshogs pa mtha' dag dus kyi sos zin rjod par byed/ /de phyir sems can don gyi slad du dang por mi rnams kyis ni mkha' lding dbang po bsgrub par bya/ 184 /rig byed dang ni 'dab brgyad nyid dang mi yi bdag po so dang chu gter drug dang gnyis skyes la/ /snying por bsgrub bya rang gi phyogs su dang por i ma gezung ste i la sogs pa 'dab brgyad la/ /e ya la sogs bcu drug la ste ka sogs gsum gyis bsgyur ba'i bcu dang ha kṣa gnyis skyes la/ /thun mtshams 'dab ma rnams la bsgrub bya tshes kyis bsgyur ba'i dus la la mtha' dbyangs dang bcas pa rnams 185 /a sogs dbyangs ni re re dag gis chu srin bum pa'i dbang las ring po thung ngu dag kyang lnga/ /phyi rol 'dab ma sum cu gnyis la bdag gi snying po badzra tī tshol sogs yi ge rnams/ /de dag rnams kyi phyi rol du yang zhi sogs las la wa ya ra la dkyil 'khor rnams nyid do/ /snying por yi ge g.yan lag mchog dang rtse mo can dang g.yo bar / rkang pa dbang dang dgug pa la / 186 /zhi ba sogs la snying por rkang pa dang ni me dang rlung du thamago bo sngags pas bri bar bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa srid pa gzhom pa dag dang bskrad dang dgug dang dbang du bya ba dang / /rengs pa dang bcas rmongs pa dag kyang 77—234

srid pa gsum gyi gnas su 'khor lo 'di ni byed de /'dir/ /sngags brjod bzlas pa sbyin sreg rnams kyis dang por badzra tī cil sogs sngags chen bsgrub par bya/ 187 /rtsibs brgyad la ni phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas bcu gnyis rtsibs dang bcu drug rtsibs la bar du yang / /bsgrub bya zur rnams su ste dbus su rab 'gyur ya ma rā dza sa do me ru ṇa las yo/ /de nas snying po'i rtsibs kyi dbus nas da ni ra ya kṣe tstsha de nas mthar ni ni ru 'gyur/ /de yi phyi rol oṃ spyo ༈ cadang bi kṛ tā na na las rnam gnyis rgyu dang phaṭa du 'gyur / 188 /re mig nas ni re mig bar la 'gyur te mi 7yi bdag po bsgrub bya'i ming dang sngags 'di'o/ /dbye dang gsad skyadang dbang la ya ma rā ni rab tu 'gyur te kṣe da me do sa tsa sogs/ /rengs dang dgug dang rmongs pa dang ni stobs ni byed pa dag dang zhi ba dang ni bskrad pa la/ /der ni snying po ngag nas ya yig 'gro ste yon tan dbang gis phyi rol thams cad snga ma bzhin/ 189 /yi ge rnams kyi yan lag mchog las mdun du dbyangs kyis sku'akhyud pa dag ni ma ru rab tu 'gyur/ /yi ge rnams kyis —sde mtha'i yi ge rdo rje rigs kyi dbang gis lnga pa haṃ dang tsha du gsungs/ /thig le gnyis kyis dbyangs mchog sbyar ba la ni 'di yang bdag gis mashes rab yi ge u ru 'gyur/ /mi mu rta huX —muḥms nyid ni padma nor 'dab la ste nyi ma'i 'dab ma la/ 190 /phyi rol du tshoshrī badzra sgo ṣaXs dang ldan pa'i manta bha dra hūṃ dang phaṭa du 'gyur/ /bsgrub bya 'dir ni lte ba la ste che ge mo yang mdzod cig dpal ldan zhi ba sogs la bskul/ /de bzhin sngar brjod 'khor lo rnams dag la yang rtag tu bsgrub bya'i ming ni bri bar bya bar 'gyur/ /'di dag thams cad bdag gis 5drin las rgyal ba'i 77—235

bdag po'i bka' yis mi rnams kyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ 191 /sgra ni gang zhig snying ga'i /phyogs na yod pa mi mchog rnams kyi rna ba'i bu gas thos gyur pa/ /de la mi yis risems ni gcig tu gyur par sbyar ba dag kyang ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba ste/ /'jig rten kun du sgra ni gang zhig srid par skyes pas brjod pa de dang de ni de bzhin thos/ /khyab bdag gi ni rnam shes nyid dang ring du thos pa dag kyang rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ 192 / skyil krung cibacing ba byas nas phan tshun so dag reg pa min par kha ni rnam par phye ba yis/ /phyi rol rlung dag bkug ste de dang bdud rtsir bcas pa lte ba'i dbus su rab tu bcug pa yis/ /kun tu gdung pa dang ni bkres dang skom pa 'phrog cing mchog gi lus la dug kyang yang dag 'gog /dpral bar thig le dkar po dbyangs kyis yongs su bskor ba bdud rtsi sgro bar byed pa yis kyang ngo / 193 /kha yang bkab ste 0sna yi bug sgyupa gnyis ka dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung ni ma lus pa//srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas pa/ /dus kyis goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las zla ba nyi ma me yi dbus su ro ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /lus la zas la sogs pa dang ni bkres skedang 5skom pa 'phrog ste 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ster/ 194 /nyi ma las ni gzhan du phyogs te nyi la'od la gnas rang gi grib ma brtan pa'i mig gis blta/ /phyi nas nam mkha' dag la mngon par brtags 5na ro mnyam skyes bu du ba'i kha dog lamathong bar 'gyur/ /zla ba drug tu goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las sa la gnas pa'i gter ni sa yi —gu gar mthong / /yang na shing gi grib mar skarab tu zhugs te nam mkha'i mthil skodu thig le'i phreng ba bsgoms pas so/ 195 /77—236

nus ma gang zhig lte ba'i dbus nas gzhan gyi gnas su bcu gnyis mtha' dang cha yi mthar 'gro ba/ /de ni lte bar 'gog pa dang bcas dri med glog dang mtshungs pa dbyug pa'i gzugs can langs pa yang / /'khor lo nas ni 'khor lo'i bar du nges par dman zhing rol pa'i bgrod pas dbu ma'i rtsa la bskyod/ /ji srid gtsug tor bug par btsan thabs nyid kyis phyi rol gyi ni pags napa dag la khab bzhin reg 196 /de yi dus su thur du sel ba mchog gi btsan thabs nyid kyis steng gi lam du bskul bar bya/ /zung gi rlung dag 'gags ripa na ni gtsug tor phug nas mchog gi grong khyer dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ltar yid la rdo rje rab tu sad pas yul dang bcas pa mkha' la spyod pa nyid du 'gyur// mngon shes lnga yi rang bzhin du 'gyur slar yang 'di ni rnal 'byor pa rnams dag gi sna tshogs yum / 197 /phyag rgya sgyu ma'i rjes su mthun pa yid dang nam mkha' la ni me long dag la gzugs bzhin te/ /'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed cing dri med glog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro bar byed/ /phyi dang lus la dbyer med yul dang rnam par bral ba snang ba tsam ni mkha' la gnas pa yi/ /sems dang sems byung la ni bdag gis 'khyud de 'gro ba du ma'i gzugs kyis de ni gcig bu'o/ 198 /snying 1ni rtog pa dang bcas las kyi phyag rgya 'di dag brtags —pa'i ye shes phyag rgya gtang 7bya ste/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub slad zudu rgyal ba mchog gi skyed ma mchog gi phyag rgya gos pa med / /rnam par 'gyur ba med cing mkha' mnyam mun bcom khyab byed rnal 'byor dag gis bgrod bya brtsegs par zuganas/ /ye shes gzi brjid srid pa'i dri ma 'phrog cing dus kyi 'khor lo ngarjes su rig 5pa bsgom par bya/ 199 /77— 2 37

srid gsum phra rab gzugs min 'dir ni rnam par shes pa /de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid med de / /sangs rgyas shes rab gang du'ang gnas pa ma yin zhes pa'i tshig ni sangs rgyas pa rnams ston par 'gyur/ /gang gis 'gyur med dang bral mi rnams kyis ni stong pa nyid de bzung nas stong par lta byed pa/ /des na gtso bos gang zhig 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi theg par bstan / 200 /cab lang bse rta glang po'i mgon song mchod sbyin dus su lus kyi yul la khyod kyi dbang po ni/ /bde bar bzung bgyi gang de yul dang yul can rnams ni ye shes sbyor ba dag la 'gog pa ste/ /bslab ldan rnams kyi ba lang pags par so ma balli'i ngabatung ba khrag dang bcas par gyur pa migang //de ni spyi po'i zla ba'i bdud rtsi bha ga'i rdul la gnas shing kun tu 'gro ba dga' ba'i gzugs/ 201 /tshangs pa 2srog chags rnams kyi lus dang 'phrog byed ngag ste khyab 'jug kyang yid de dag skurig byed gsum/ /ci yig de dag tshayi ge gsum ste 4zla nyi bsreg — za de dag rnams dang skuyon tan rtsa gsum mo / /rigs can lus kyi rigs la gzhan pa yul dang yon tan la gnas srid srung nā da'i gzugs can te / /de yi dbus su gzhom med gang de yul dang rnam par bral zhing yon tan med pa'i 'gyur med do/ 202 /rig byed mtha' las gsang ba 'di dag tshangs pa yis ni rnal 'byor pa rnams dag la sngon brjod de //dus kyi :shes pa rab nyams thub pa rnams kyis 'dir ni srog chags rnams la gsod pa dag kyang bstan/ /mi rnams mtho ris don du de la rab tu 'jug ste dmyal ba ngan pa'i 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur/ /sol ba 'o ma'i rgyun gyis mngon par bkrus pa 'dir ni zla ba'i mdog tu 'gar yang 'gyur ma yin/ 203 /77—238

sbyor ba med pa'i rig byed tshig ni shadam tshig rnam par bral ba dag gis bslus pa'i mi rnams gang ci/ /de rnams gzhan gyi bu ni mi skyed cadon du nyin mtshan dus su rang gi bud med bsrung ribyas nas/ /bu yis byin pa dag kyang yi dgas kyi ni 'jig rten du song pha yi sbyin par 'gyur ro lo / /des na bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba 'dod pa'i sbyin pa 'di ni gdug pa'i bram ze rnams kyis sbas / 204 /gal te rigs kyi rta yis rgod ma bzang mo la ni rta mchog skyes bu gzhan du gyur pa na/ / dpal yang tsho'adi yi mthu las slar yang 'gyur te / bdag po yi ni rnyed pa dag kyang cis ma yin/ /gang gis chags pa can rnams nyid zhag so so'i dus su rang rang bud med dag ni gsung bar byed/ /shi bar gyur na khyod su 5khyod kyi rang gi bud med su ste kye ma mi dge'i las kyis bcings / 205 /ba lang sbyin dang sa gzhi sbyin pa de bzhin gzhan yang mi yi 'jig rten du ni longs spyod ster/ /sman dang kha zas sbyin pa dag ni mtha' dag nad 'phrog bkros pa dag ngani skom pa dag kyang 'phrog /'dod pa'i sbyin pa thams cad du ni bde mnyam 'bras ster 'khor lo'i dus su smos kyang ci zhig dgos / /yid 'ong chung ma sring mo skal bzangs tshabu mo rnams kyang gsang ba sbyin pa la ni rab sbyin bya/ 206 /smad 'tshong dzodam pa rnams kyi skulas kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur zhing gsang ba'i mi mo gzhan gyi bud med dam tshig ste/ /rang dbang chos kyi phyag rgya yul ni mang po la dga' rang gi chung ma ye shes phyag rgya'o/ /smad 'tshong 7dam pa bcu gnyis lo lon mchog gi bde ba la dga' gzhan gyi bud med bcu drug lo/ /rang dbang lo ni nyi shu lon pa bu mo dang bcas rang gi chung ma sum cu'i lo ru 'gyur/ 207 /sngon tshe sangs rgyas rnams kyi 5'dzin ma 77—239

dang ni glang chen rta dang shing rta du ma gser gyi khur / /sangs rgyas nyid kyi slad du byin zhing slar yang mgo dang khrag dang sha rnams dag kyang rab tu byin//'di rnams kyis ni bzhed 0pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du ma gyur de nas 'dod pa'i sbyin pa rab tu byin/ /gsang ba'i sbyin pa de yis skyes bu rnams ni rgyal ba skyed byed cirigs la sangs rgyas nyid du 'khrungs/ 208 /zangs ma yis ni gser dang mtshungs shing mching /bu dum bus lha yi cod pan nor bu dag tshadang mtshungs /smad 'tshong 5dam pa'i 'dod pa'i sbyin pas 'chi med rigs kyi bu mo pags 5pa dum bu skem rtsi ste/ /bong bu yis ni rigs kyi rta dang ra yis rab mchog glang chen bdag ngo gal te 5rnyed pa na / /chung ma'i sbyin pas rgyal ba skyed —mdzad rigs cil lha mo de la tsho'adi ni rnyed pa cis ma yin/ 209 /byams pa'i gnas la sbyin pa dag ni bde mnyam 'bras ster ma yin sems can mtshungs pa'i mthu las te/ / ltos pa dang bcas gnas la de bzhin rab mchog rgyal ba'i rigs la sems can bdud kyi rang bzhin phyir/ /snying rje dga' dang bcas pa 'i gnas ni zung la gzhan gyi don du bde bar gshegs pa pa rnams kyis//rab tu byin na dman pa nyid dang mchog nyid phyir na tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs mi zad bde 'bras ster/ 210 /gang la rigs ni tshad mar gyur pa de la mi yi bdag ngo rig byed dag ni tshad mar 'gyur/ /gang la rig byed tshad mar gyur pa de la nges par sa gzhi'i gnas su mchod sbyin tshad ma ste/ /gang la mchod sbyin tshad ma de la rnam mang phyugs dang mi rnams dag la 'tshe ba tshad mar 'gyur/ /gang la 'tshe ba tshad mar gyur pa de la dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa byed pa'i sdig snyepa tshad mtho/ 211 /gnas ni 'dzin pa'i don du bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal 77— 240

ldan gtsug lag 〉khang gi rab gnas bzhed par gsungs/ /de la sman dang kha zas sbyin pa nad ni zhi bar byed pa sbyin pa po yis sbyin no zer / /sbyin pa med na gtsug lag khang 'di sa yi steng gi gnas su dud 'gro rnams kyi gnas sa ciste /gang du dge 'dun gcig ni 'dzin par gyur pa der ni mi yi bdag po chos dang sangs rgyas kyang / 212 /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la ni mi rnams thar pa'i slad du skyabs su nye bar 'gro bste/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang na gnas pa 'di dang yi ge bris pa'i glegs bam chos nyid dang / /dge 'dun ngur thig 'dzin pa mchog gi khyab bdag bde ba skye ba 'bum phrag rnams kyis ster ba min/ /slob dpon das ni sangs rgyas nyid de rab mchog sa yi gzhi la chos ni de yi bstan pa'o/ 213 /dge 'dun gang zhig der gnas rab tu dga' ba'i snying dang sems can kun la rjes su brtse ba ste/ /de 'dir tshornam bzhi rnam pa gnyis gsungs 'dir ni slar yang nyan thos pa dang bla na med pa'o/ /dge slong rnams dang dge slong ma dang slar yang 'dir ni dge bsnyen chen po dag dang dge bsnyen ma/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor pa rnams lhan skyes bde ba la dga' dge bsnyen ma dang dge bsnyen yang 214 /bsod nams ye shes don gyi slad du rtag par mchog tu 'dod pa'i sbyin pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyang / /nyan thos rnams la mchod ston la sogs rnal 'byor pa la mchog gi bde byed 'dod pa'i sbyin pa yang / /sbyin pa ngo gang rab tu dga' ba'i snying dang dus kun du ni chags pa'i sems kyis sbyin byed pa/ /dedag mubasod nams ye shes rdzogs te mchog gi bde ba'i gnas su skye ba 'di la 'gro bar 'gyur 215 / slob dpon dang ni rgyal ba la yang mkhas pa min pa'i nyan 77—241

thos gang dag gsal bar smod byed pa/ /de dag ri bgegs kyi mgon pos ri bsad de cimachog tu 'jigs pa byed pa'i mnar med du ni myur du 'gro/ /gang la rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag pos sngags kyi mthu rnams kyis ni rang nyid byin gyis brlab pa mdzad/ /mi rnams dag las dge slong su zhig brtul zhugs nges pa'i gnas la de dang tshangs par spyod pa mtshungs / 216 /mchog gi bde ba la dga' dge slong dag gam kun tu rgyu dang gcer bu mgo skum ral ‘ pa can/ /thos dang klog pa la dga' mkhas pa lam nyams thams cad byed po dang ni bdag tu zhen pa dang / /'dir ni rtag tu rang gzhan gyibu dang chung mar zhen dang bza' dang bza' ba min par zhen pa dang / /rigs dang rigs ni min pa la dga' snod dang snod min dag tu zhen pas dka' tsho ba byed pa'o/ 217 /sangs rgyas zhing ni sangs rgyas dang bcas bde mnyam 'bras ster lus dang ngag dang yid dang chags pa ste/ /'di dag kun tu bor nas sdig pa'i blo yis khyab bdag gzhan pa dag kyang yang dag tshol byed de / /zhing 5dang 'jug ngogs yul gzhan dag tu brtul zhugs nges pa brgya dang bskung choganas ri las mchong ba cidang / /lagayul dang nyi ma gza' yis zin la yul gyi bde 'dod du ma'i mtshon dang me la mchong bas so/ 218 /5bdud rnams dag gis khrag ni btung ba'i slad du 'di dag mtha' dag sngon gyi tshe yang —bkod pa ste/ /'jug ngogs bsang ri gnas dag gis shi bar gyur dang g.yul du bsnun pa nyid dang ba lang 5nyi ma ni/ /grol ba'i don dang khyim dang nor gyi 5yul dang bram ze'i bya ba dag la shi ba mtho ris so/ /de yi phyir na rang dang gzhan gyi rulus ni bde ba mnyam pa'i gnas 'di bsrung bar bya ba yin/ 219 /gang zhig rgyud 77—242

kyi rgyal po las ni rgyal ba mchog gi spyod pa thos shing dbang ni blangs nas kyang / /slar yang phrag dog byed na de ni dmyal ba brgyad pa /ji srid nyid du rab tu 'jug 'gyur te/ /gang la khab rtse'i sa la mi dge'i 'bras bu'i dbang gis dmyal ba rnams ni kun du rgyu bar byed/ /de phyir mi rnams sems la phrag dog yod kyi bar du dbang ni blang bar bya bar mi 'gyur ro/ 220 /rgyal ba skyed rimadzad rigs la sbyin pa tshul khrims rab tu rdzogs dang bzod pa brtson 'grus rdzogs pa dang / /bsam gtan shes rab dang ni thabs dang smon lam dag dang stobs dang ye shes rdzogs pa chung ma yi / /sbyin pa 'di yis myur du rab tu dga' ba'i yid can rnal 'byor pa yi skye ba 'di la ste/ /gang zhig rmongs pa'i mi de rnams kyis de la rjes su 'ching ba byas nas dmyal bar nye bar 'gro/ 221 /sa dang dpal 'byor slad du shin tu g.yo ba'i snying ldan snar ma yis ni ral gri rnon po dag /bzung ste kun nas 'thab mo pa yis dkrigs pa'i yan lag bzhi ldan g.yul du rab tu zhugs pa na/ /glang chen tshogs pa mthong nas 'jigs pa ci 3de yi lag pa'i mthil nas ral gri dag ni lhung gyur pa/ /de la ral gri'i skyon du 'gyur ba ma yin ji lta /de bzhin nyid du sngags kyi rigs kyi'o/ 222 /sngags dang dpa' bo'i rim pa yis kyang lha min gdengs can lha rnams drag po'i sa la bsgrub par bya/ /rang byin brlab —pas lha mo dam tshig rigs la gnas rnams bsam gtan bzlas pa sbyin sreg dag gis kyang / /dag pa'i rim pas dbang ste sngags pa yis ni rgyun chad med par dga' ba chen po'i sems kyis so/ / ye shes yid bzhin nor bur gang zhig rab tu gyur pa mede las kyang ni brgyal ba'i lam 'di'o/ 223 /me ni dngul chu'i dgra nyid yin te me dang rnam par bral 77—243

na nam yang dngul chu 5ching ba med/ /ma bcings na ni gser byed med de ’gser dang bral na smra po rnams la longs spyod med pa nyid/ /de bzhin bud med sbyor ba bral na rtag tu rnal 'byor pa rnams dag gi sems ni 'ching mi 'gyur /bcings pa med na lus 'bigs med de ma phug lus kyis 'dir ni lhan skyes bde ba ster ba min/ 224 /skyed rimos tshal lam ri bo dag ni skye bo ri dgas bral bar zhi ba'i sngags rnams bsgrub par bya/ /drag po rnams ni drag po'i dur khrod du ste lha mchog gnas su rengs pa dang ni rmongs pa yang / /dbang dang dgug pa sngags pas mchog gi sa la bde ba phyag rgya kun dang rab tu sbyor ba la/ /gnas gzhan dang ni skye gnas gzhan du mi rnams kyi ni skye ba 'bum phrag gis kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ 225 /khyim dang grong du bgrang phreng dag gis nyin dang mtshan mo'i dus su sngags kyi bzlas pa byas nas ni/ /ngal zhing rmongs te chags pa dang bral slar yang 'di ni sngags kyi dngos grub med pa rjod byupar byed/ /gnas dang stong pa dus dang mchog gi mtshan mo la gnas yang chodag par ni shes pa min pa nyid/ /rkang pa'i sor mo rnams kyi nad la spyi bor sman rnams kyis ni rab tu byug pa byed pa bzhin/ 226 /bsam gtan dang ni sngags kyi bzlas pa byed pa dag dang dkyil 'khor chen po rnams dang gdan rnams dang 0/ /sbyin sreg sngags kyi rab gnas rdul tshon la ni rgyal ba'i rigs rnams spyan drangs bskul ba med par yang / /bud med sbyor ba rnam par spangs nas rab mchog khyab bdag bde ba phyag rgya'i dngos grub ster bar byed/ /de phyir de ni nyid zhag so so'i dus su rnal 'byor pa yis thar pa'i slad du bsgom par bya/ 227 /rang gi sems ni brgyal dang gnyid la rab tu zhugs pa mi 77—244

yi bdag po rang bzhin med par 'gyur/ /sad la rang bzhin dang bcas gsal bar byed de /de dag srog chags rnams kyi thar pa'i lam ma yin/ /dngos dang dngos med kyis phye sems kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor pa rnams dag la bde mnyam ster ba min/ /gang zhig mkha' yi rishes rab la 'khyud lhan skyes bde bar gnas pa'i rang sems de ni thar pa ster/ 228 /oṃ ā:lhu choho rim par gnas pas dang por 'dir ni rtag tu chang ni sbyangs nas rtogs par bya/ /rab tu 'bar bar byas te ri bong can ni zhu ba bzhin du rim pas bsgom par 0byas nas ni/ /snod de nas ni thig le dag gis lag pad ri bong can gyi ming med rtse mos sa dag la/ /phyi rol tu ni zur gsum byas nas de yi dbus su nyin mor byed pa dang mtshungs skum po'o/ 229 /de yi dbus su 'di yi ye shes 'khor lo srid gsum gnas pa dag kyang /sngags pas bsgoms byas nas/ /mthe bo —dang ni ming med dag gis nyin zhag so so'i dus su tshim par byed pa la sogs bya/ /yul dang grong gi bdag po rnams la thog 7mar 'dir ni gtor ma dang po dbus mtha'i ming gis te/ /'phrog ma la ni chang bu gnyis dang slar yang sngags pas khro bo'i rgyal po la ni gtor ma'o/ 230 /pho nya mo rnams dag la zas kyi phud ni 7sa steng rnams su bdag po rdo rje rnams kyis sbyin/ /'byung po rnams la zos ṅkapa'i lhag ma slar yang dge ba'i don du sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad 'di skabaklag go/ /mgo dang mgrin pa snying ga pate gsang gtsug tor du ni rang gi rdo rje rnams kyis 7yan lag dgod/ / gnyi ga'i snyerigs la gnas pa'i yan lag sgo rnams kyis ni gnyid kyi dus dang mchod dang 'khrig pa la/ 231 /lha yi dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon 77—245

sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mngon sum min na rjes su dpag pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni brtags pa gang / /de ni ri mo sogs la blta bya yongs su ma smin blo can rnal 'byor rnams kyi bsgom :pa'i don/ 232 /gzugs sam yang na dkyil 'khor dag kyang dang por bris sku la ni de nyid min pas bsgom par bya/ /nam mkha' la ni de nyid sbyor ba dag gis rang sems ma tshang med pa mtha' dag mthong gyur pa/ /lo yi phyed dang lo gcig bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gis ji srid nyid du brtan par 'gyur nagyi bar/ /de nas phyag rgya'i sbyor bas nyid zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis ca'agyur ba med pa nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ 233 /rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad las ni nges par rdo rje'i tshig 'di rnal 'byor pa rnams dag nel gsungs/ /byis pa rnams ni smin par byed pa'i don du mchog gi snying rje dag gis sna tshogs gtso bos sbas/ /de phyir de ni dbye ba byas nas nyin zhag so so'i dus su rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub don slad rgyal ba mchog gi skyed dzomadzad gzhom du med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'o 234 /dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas chen po las phyung ba dpal dus kyi 'khor lo —las/ sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rgyal ba mchog dang bcas pa gang zhig khyod kyis gsungs pa dag ni cung zad shes/ /slar yang bdag ni nyan par 'tshal lo lha mi'i bla ma khams kyi dbye ba rnams kyi skedakyil 'khor dang / /sangs rgyas rnams dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dag gi rigs drug ā li kā ngali dag la gnas pa nyid/ /77—246

zla ba bzang po'i tshig dag gsan nas rgyal ba'i bdag pos khams kyi dbye bas dkyil 'khor la sogs gsungs/ 1 /ka ba rnams dang rdo rje phreng ba sa yi dkyil 'khor cijig pa nyid ni rus pa rnams kyis mdzod/ /sha khrag chu dang bshang ba rnams kyis lha dang gshin rje nor sbyin gzhan du rdul tshon gdab pa ste/ /mkhris ripa bad kun gyis ni nyi ma ri bong can yang de bzhin chu rgyus rnams kyis chu skyes rnams/ /ra ba lnga yi re khā sa dang chu dang bsreg za rlung dang dam mkha' las skyes rnams kyis so/ 2 /dus kyi rtsa yis gtso bo'i chu skyes g.yo ba me yi dkyil 'khor tshol sogs pags rnapa la sogs kyis/ /nyi ma'i sgo rnams bug pa rnams kyis nor bu'i rang bzhin bkod pa so yi phreng bas de bzhin nyid/ / dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor tshal gnas rnams ni sor mo rnams kyi sen mo yis/ /ba spu rnams kyis rdo rje me lce dkyil 'khor gyi ni mtha' ru phyogs dang phyogs bral dag la choganas/ 3 /de ltar nges par sku yi rdo rje mchog gi yon tan rnam mang dkyil 'khor gyi ni rnam par gsungs/ /gsung gi rdo rje a sogs ka sogs lha yi rnam pa nyid ni mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs rnams kyis/ /stong pa drug gi pathugs kyi rdo je rnam pa gsum gyi lasrid pa la gnas —gtso bo'i rnam pa nyid spya/ /de bzhin du ni ye shes rdo rje 4srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa sna tshogs yum gyi rang bzhin no/ 4 /sde pa ka la sogs pa drug po rim pas yongs su bkod pa rnams kyi rigs ni rim pa yis/ /rdo rje ral gri rin chen 'khor lo chu skyes de bzhin gri gug nyid ni rgyal ba rnams kyi ste /slar yang sde pa re re la yang mtha' dag rgyal ba mchog gi dbye ba lnga rnams dag gis dbye/ /so sor yi ge'i dbye ba sa dang chu dang bsreg gza rlung dang 77—247

nam mkha'i dngos po dag las so/ 5 /dang por stong pa'i rab tu dbye ba dag kyang snang nya ṇa ma na dang ri dang dang po'i dbyangs/ /rlung gi dbye ba mi yig gha dzha snyo bha dha sha rnams te me yi dbye ba ṛ cal sogs/ /chu yi dbye bas casku yig wa kha tsha ṭha pha tha wa ste sa yi dbye ba bla la sogs/ /de ltar mchog gi rgyal ba'i rigs ni rnam pa lnga yi ka la sogs pa'i sde rnams rnam par phye/ 6 /gtsug tor stong pa lnga ste rigs gsum dag kyang de bzhin sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'o/ /a sogs phyag rgya'i rigs te ha ya ra wa la dang ldan pa'i ka sogs sde pa mtha' dag rnams/ /'jig rten snang byed dbyangs dang bcas pa'i ha ya ra wa lar ldan 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'o/ /rig 9sngags 'chang gi dbang po mtha' dag tu 'gyur ka sogs sde pa brtsegs pa la gnas 7brgyad rnams so/ 7 /ka sogs yi ge sum cu ha ya ra wa lar ldan kṣa dang bcas pa sum cu rtsa drug nyid/ /dbyangs kyi rnam par 'gyur bas phye ba ro yis bsgyur ba'i ro ni 'khor lo'i mgon po rnams su 'gyur/ /sku ni gcig pa nges par gcig gi 5'khor dang bcas pa gnyis ni shes rab dag gis 5'khyud par 'gyur/ /lnga yi bdag nyid lnga yis 'gyur te 'khor dang bcas pa dgu ni 'khor lo'i mgon po dgu bdag nganyid/ 8 /dbyangs kyi grangs kyi bdag nyid bcu gsum dgu dang phyogs rnams kyis kyang sum cu rtsa drug bdag nyid de / /ya la sogs pa rnams kyis sgo skyong mtha' dag tshogs kyi rigs ni lhag ma'i dbyangs rnams nyid kyis so/ /khro bo drug tu ha sogs kyis 'gyur rang rigs phyogs su gnas rnams rlung gi dbyangs sogs dbye ba yis/ /so sor yi ge'i dbye ba rnams kyis ro yis bsgyur ba'i ro ni rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor rgyud/ 9 /de bzhin yi ge so 77—248

so ro yis bsgyur ba'i /ro yi dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor dbang po ste/ /sung po 'byung ba dbang po la sogs dbyangs kyi dbye bas mtha' dag tshogs kyi rigs ni sbyang ribar bya/ /stong pa gzhom med la sogs mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs rnams kyis ni lha rnams brgya riyis gdab pa ste/ /gtsug tor nas ni chu skyes mtha' ru mi mnyam mnyam pa'i cirigs la 'khor lo'i dbus kyi gdan la'o / 10 /rdo rje rnams kyis zhal gyi dbye phyobar 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rnams dbyangs kyi dbye ba yis/ /de nyid rnams kyis phyag rgya'i rab tu dbye ba gzhan yang de bzhin sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis/ /sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor rgyud ni dpag med yon tan yi ge du ma'i rab tu dbye ba can/ /yi ge so so'i ming can mnyam dang mi mnyam rigs la lha mo dang ni lha rnams dag gi'o/ 11 /sa bon gcig pu dpa' bo gcig pa rdul la ro mnyam pa ni shes rab dag gis 'khyud par 'gyur/ /phung po rnams kyis lnga yi bdag nyid sa yi khams sogs rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dgu pa yang / /bshang lam la sogs dang ni mig la sogs pas yongs bskor 'di ni nyi shu rtsa lnga'i /bdag nyid kyang / /de bzhin so ni rab tu skyes pa slar yang so rnams dag gis dbang phyug mtha' yas 'khor lo can/ 12 /dag par yang dag dag pa'i chu las ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar padma'i mtshan ma 'od dpag med/ /nga rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug rta yi shing rtas 'gro ma mā ma tī dang gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /drag mo chu gter tshogs kyi dbang po gnyis skyes gdengs can dang ni stag gdong ma dang lug par bcas//'di dag 7dpal ldan g.yon gyi zhal nas mchog gi snying rje yis ni rdo rje can gyis spros skupa'o/ 13 /chos la yang dag dag pa'i rlung las phyag gi padma ral gri 77—249

don yod grub pa sgrol ma dang / / mkha' yi :snying po reg bya rdo rje ma dang shin tu stobs bcas tsartsi kā dang lcags sgrog ma/ /bden bral dang ni rlung zhes bya dang dmangs rigs klu dang de bzhin khyi gdong ma dang bya rog bcas/ / de dag nges par byams pa'i thugs kyis srid pa gsum gyi bdag pos shar gyi zhal nas spros pa'o/ 14 /longs spyod rdzogs par dag pa'i me las nyi ma 'char ka cidang mtshungs rin chen 'dzin dang gos dkar mo/ /sa yi snying po rmugs byed dang ni ro mchog rdo rje ma dang phag mo gdong drug me yi lha/ /gdengs can dbang po rgyal rigs gnyis dang rab gsal khro gnyer can dang phag gdong ma dang bya rgod bcas/ /'di dag dpal ldan g.yas kyi zhal nas mchog gi dga' ba yis ni sna tshogs gtso bos spros pa'o/ 15 /lte bar yang dag dag pa'i sa las mchog gi gser dang mtshungs pa'i thub pa phyag na 'khor lo dang / /spyan ma dang ni rnam par sel ba tshorab mchog mi yi bdag po rengs byed dri yi tshardo rje ma/ /'od zer can dang dbang mo brgya byin dus kyi gdong pa dang bcas rje rigs klu la sogs pa kun/ /gtso bo yis ni btang snyoms dag gis nub kyi zhal nas skye bo kun la phan rnams spros pa'o/ 16 /gtsug tor dag pa'i stong pa las ni phyag na mchog gi rdo rje mi bskyod dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /gtsug tor dang ni chos kyi dbyings te nam mkha'i yon tan dbang gis phyag na rdo rje la sogs gzhan/ /gsang bar dag pa las ni mtha' dag bde mnyam ster rnams sgra yi rdo rje ma la sogs pa yang / /steng dang thog tu yon tan mang po'i gnas rnams srog chags rnams kyi thar pa'i rgyu ru maspros pa'o/ 17 /phyogs kyi 'dab mar spyan ma la sogs phyogs bral 'dab ma la gnas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa ste/ /nyi ma'i 77—250

steng du g.yon brkyang /u ma dang bcas dbang phyug mnan zhing 'jig pa'i dus kyi sprin dang mtshungs/ /thod pa rnams kyis riphreng ba bcings shing chu yi gter gyi zhal dang nyi ma'i phyag ldan he ru ka /phyag rgya sgrul dang stag gi pags capa mi bzad glang po'i bdag po'i pags pa rlon pa bshus pa 'dzin/ 18 /gnag dang dmar dang dri med ri bong can lus lha mo rnams kyi phyi rol du ni 'khor lo gsum /rdo rje drug ni khro bo las skyes phyag gnyis zla zhal rnams dang de bzhin 'byung po skyes rnams kyis / /sgor ni gtum mo ro la gnas shing phyag na gri gug thod pa phyogs bral du yang nges par ro / /dpa' bo rnams kyis —rig byed phyag na rdo rje ḍa 7ma ru dang dril bu rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ tshog/ 19 /dpal ldan lhun 2po'i phyogs brgyad du cini sa chu'i dkyil 'khor dag la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas kun te / /zhing dang tshajo ha dang 'dus pa can dang dur khrod sa ni me dang rlung gi dbus su yang / /de bzhin yul dang grong khyer la ni phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas lha rnams rig par bya ba ste/ /shes rab rgyud kyi mngon par brjod pa srid pa gsum gyi bla mas shar gyi zhal nas spros pa'o/ 20 /lasnying por 'khor lo cha dgu pa ste dkyil 'khor las ni phyed kyi cha shas zla nyi padma la/ /rdo rje ka ba'i phreng ba dag gis spras pa yang ni sung po khams kyi lhag pa'i lha chen po/ /phyi rol du ni ra ba'i rtsig pa dag la yul dang yul can zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la gnas/ /sgo skyong rnams ni nyi ma la gnas gzhan pa tshogs kyi rigs ni kha khyer —dag la kun nas so/ 21 /'di la sogs pa la ni 5de bzhin tshornal 'byor rgyud kyang 'dus pa rnam pa drug tu gsungs pa ste/ /zur du khro bo rnams dang logs su yul dang yul can dzi bha la ni phyag na so ba bsnams / /ngag dang rkang lag bshang 77—251

lam bha ga /nyi ma ribong canarnams dus kyi rtsa yi rang bzhin te / /shes rab dang ni thabs rnams mtha' dag zhal gsum ro yi phyag ldan g.yasakyi zhal nas spros pa'o/ 22 /snying por 'khor lo chu gter zung byu du 'gyur ༄te mi yi bdag po dkyil 'khor las ni gsum gyi cha/ /gung po khams rnams lhag pa'i lha nyid slar yang 'phar ma gzhan la sgra yi rdo rje la sogs brgyad / phyi rol du gnas dkyil 'khor la ni phyogs bcur bkod pa nyi ma la gnas khro po'i tshogs rnams te/ /der nir ba'i jig pa dag la dus la chu gter gyis bkun 0byang chub sems dpa' mtha' dag rnam sa/ 23 /sgyu 'phrul dra ba tshodabye ba gsum ste zhal gsum ro yi phyag ni lha yi smu yi dbye ba las/ /rtog pa la sogs gang yin mtha' dag blun po'i snying gi smodabang gis g.yon gyi zhal nas smos pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rjes su ris pa'i rgyud dang 'dir ni nyis 'gyur sdom pa chen ngo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi / /'khor lo drug dang skurigs drug chomi bdag dur khrod sa rnams kyis ni panub kyi zhalanas spros pa 'o 24 /sgrig ni drug dang bug pa'icha shas g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khoral sanas rnams kyis dkyil 'khor thig btab nas / /snying po sa ni drug drug charnams kyis te padma'i 'dab ma byed kyis lte bar ldan pa skeyang / /gri gug 'khor lo chu skyes rin chen ral gri mchog gi rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis gnyis cha rnams kyis /nyi ma rnamasakyis 7sgo dang sgo khyud dus dang ro rnams kyis kyang kha khyer shadang ni do shal sa/ 25 /gsum gyis kyang ni ra ba lnga yi re khra rtse mo can gyis do shal rtsa bar snam bu'o/ /nyi ma rnams kyis logs dang 'a 4ma ste sum 'gyur nyin byed rnams kyis ka ba'i steng du rta babs so/ phyogs dang phyogasabral dag tu sgo nibargyad rnams bya ste dkyil 77—252

'khor chen po 'di ni sgrom po'o/ /dbus su chu skyes sna tshogs mdog ste lte ba la ni nyi ma ri bong can dag sbyar ba'i gdan/ 26 /'khor lo dang ni phreng ba sngon po sa ni ljang gu /dag dang sa gzhi dag po 'khor lo ser/ /sa gzhi dmar la 'khor lo dkar dang sa ni dkar po phreng bar bcas pa'i 'khor lo dmar po dang/ /sa ni ser po sngon po dag dang 'khor lo dkar po min pa dang ni ljang gu'i rimadog tu 'gyur/ /cha drug gis ni mtshon 5gyi sa ste skyed byed zhal gyi dbang gis sgo yi 'khor lo de bzhin no/ 27 /phyi rol du ni brgyad gnyis durakhrod rnams te rigs kyi dbang gis de bzhin snying po'i lha mo brgyad/ /'dab ma la ni thod pa bdud rtsi'i ro dang ldan pa brgyad de ca'adab ma brgyad la lha mo rnams/ /phyir ni sgeg mo la sogs lha mo phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas de bzhin klu yi rgyal po brgyad/ /de yi phyi rol du ni sa chu me dang g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang rdo rje'i phreng ba'o/ 28 /ring po thung ngu'i dbyangs rnams kyis kyang sa ta pa ṭa tsa ka sa sogs stong sogs yi ge rnams/ /rlung sogs rtsibs rnams la ni nyi ma'i rgyu ba'i dbang gis ring po sa sogs khams kyi rang bzhin rnams/ /steng sogs rtsibs la zla ba'i rgyu ba'i dbang gis thung ngu rang rang 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi steng du'o/ /sgo dang sgo yi bar du ha kṣa dang ldan nam mkha'i mthil tshon gnas pa'i sde par bcas pa rnams/ 29 /mkha' 'gro ma rnams thung ba'i dngos po ri bong 'dzin pa'i zhal dang phyag ni rtegri gug 7thod pa can/ /g.yas pa brkyang zhing rang rang snod rnams kyis ni lha min khrag 'thung skra grol gos dang bral ba ste/ /rkang pa rked pa dpral ba dang ni rna ba mgrin pa lag par g.yer ka bsogs dang rus pa'i rgyal/ /mgo dang rked pa'i ngos la 77—253

thod pa'i dum bu rgyal ba 0rnams kyi kha dog lnga yi phreng ba'o/ 30 /mkha' 'gro zhal gnyis phyag na rdo rje mchog dang ḍa ma ru dang rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 5dril bu / /mgrin pa dpal ldan mgo phreng mgo bor cod pan la yang rdo rje dar dpyangs dang ni nor bu'o/ /dpal ldan mgul rgyan rkang la rkang gdub phyag la phyag gdub dang ni ska rags dag dang rna rgyan te/ /rdzogs pa'i thod pa rnams kyi phreng ba mche ba can gyi mtha' dag lus la gnas dang thal ba'i rgya / 31 /gtso bo'i dbu la thod pa rnams kyis 4phreng ba mgrin par gdong brgya rnams kyis skamago yi phreng ba'o/ /zla phyed rdo rje'i cod pan la ste larang gi rked dang phyag gnas stag lpags glang ngo 'i pags pa 'o/ /zla nyi bsreg tshoza'i dkyil 'khor la ni zhabs kyi rtsa bar snyobadud dang dbang ldan lus la thal ba ste/ /phyag rgya klu yi dbang ngo dang ldan 'jig dus rtse mo can mtshungs mkha' 'gro ma la 'o tshodag byed 32 /phyogs kyi 'dab mar snyemakha' 'gro rnams kyi lag pa ḍa lam ru dang rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga nyid des/ /bshang gci khrag dang mi sha rnams kyis phyogs bral 'dab ma la gnas khu ba'i snod kyang phyag na'o/ /de bzhin du ni lha mo brgyad kyang kun nas gnyi ga bde la snyoms par zhugs pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /ser dang dkar po dmar po'i mdog dang nag ngo ljang gu'i 0lus dang sngon po'i mdog rnams rang phyogs su/ 33 /rgyal ba skyed mdzad rigs la gtso bo'i kha dog mtshan ma rnams ni sngar bzhin spyan gsum dag gi tshogs/ /phan tshun du ni 'khyud pa dag kyang rang gzhan rigs kyi dbang gis rig par bya ste kun nas so/ /sbyin pa sogs dang phung po 'byung ba yul dang yul can tshogazhan yang dbang po lnga la sogs pa dang / /phyogs sa phyogs kyi stobs dang dpal ldan rgyal sras dbang 77—254
