rnams kyis kyang lha mo rnam par sbyang bar bya/ 34 /lhun po'i phyogs su dbye ba brgyad kyi /phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas gnas dang nye ba'i gnas kun dang / /zhing dang tshajo ha dang 'dus pa dur khrod sa dang khyim ni rlung gi phyed kyi mtshams su ste/ /'di dag sangs rgyas sa ni nyi ma phra mo lus skyes mi dang 'byung po lha dang lha min dang / /nus dang gtso bo cinyin gcig rigs ldan ma ni rnam par rgyu ste nyi zla'i rab tu rgyu ba las/ 35 /rgyab tu lha mo dbang byed thim pa zhes 'dir mdun du de nyid lnga yi rang bzhin rnams kyis te/ /rlung dang dbang ldan lha min me dang 'og dang mkha' dang lha dang gshin rje gnod sbyin nub tu yang / /gtsug tor snying ga'i phyogs dang mgrin pa mgo bo la gnas lte ba dang ni gsang ba'i 'khor lo la/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'og dang steng du nyid zhag so so'i chu srin nas ni dus sbyor gnyis gnyis bar/ 36 /gtso po'i chu skyes rdo rje kun dang 'gyur med thig le rnams kyis rdo rje nor bu la gnas pa / /kun nas dga' ba thams cad rdo rje can gyi bde ba mnyam pa'i gnas te dus ni mthams cad do / /zla ba zhu ba bla ma'i zhal de ru muni gang zhig zhugs pa dus kyi 'khor lo de nyid de / /bdud rnams kyi ni dus su gsungs shing 'ji ba'i 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo 'di dag go/ 37 /shes rab thabs kyi yi ge dag gis gnyi ga'i rigs kyi dbang las mkha' 'gro ma dang mkha' 'gro'i ming / /rdo rje gsum po rkang pa gzhan dang bcas pas thog ma dbus dang mtha' cimar phye ba bzlas bya ste/ /srog gis byin gyis brlabs pa gang zhig gnyi ga'i bgrod pa'i dbang gis rang rang las kyi rjes mthun ngapa'o/ / ro yi —'gro rnams la gnas mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams ni myur du 'grub par 77—255

'gyur 38 /dbugs rnams gang dag skye ba'i dus su dbu ma la ni rkang pa dang bcas ro dang mngar gyur pa/ /de brgyad rnams kyis 'khor lor 'gyur te 'og dang mkha' yi dbang gis sgo yi dbus gnas lha mo rnams/ /rkang pa gcig gis bskyed pa srid pa gsum gyi yum ste phyag na gri gug dang ni thod pa can/ /bdud rtsi bde ba'i cha yis 'khyud mipa nyi ma zla ba'i steng du g.yas brkyang dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ 39 /lnga gsum me rtse yul dang yon tan dbang gis zla ba nyi ma'i gdan rnams chu gter rkang pa las/ /gza' bdun dang ni rdzogs pa nyi ma nyin mor byed dang ri bong can gyi gdan ni gzhan pa rnams/ /dag po dkar po'i rdzogs pa nyi ma nyin mor byed dang ri bong can gyi gdan ni gzhan rnams dang / /'di nyid la ni ri bo'i gza' rnams mnyam dang mi mnyam gnas la nyi ma zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ 40 /zla ba nyi ma'i rkang pa rtsibs rnams dang ni padma'i 'dab ma sgo bzhi zur gyi ro rnams te/ /slar yang rkang pa nyis 'gyur de dag rnams ni nyid mor byed dang ri bong can gyi gdan rnams nyid/ /rdzogs pa gza' dang nyi ma'i rkang pa mnyam dang mi mnyam gnas la chu gter rkang pa gdan rnams te/ /nyi ma 'am ni gang ba'i zla ba la 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis gtso bo yang na kha sbyor la/ 41 /rlung la reg bya'i zhal gcig dang ni yon tan gzhan gyis cadabang gis rgyas gdab zhal ni gnyis pa'o/ /rtse mo can la gzugs dang reg bya'i zhal ni gnyis su 'gyur te rgyas gdab zhal ni gsum pa'o/ /chu la zhal yang reg bya dang ni gzugs dang ro yi zhal te rgyas gdab zhal ni bzhi pa'o /sa la dri la sogs pa reg bya'i mtha' yi yon tan zhal te rgyas gdab zhal ni lnga pa'o/ 42 /nam mkha' la ni zhal yang stong pa rnam pa lnga ste rgya yis 77—256

gdab pa'i zhal ni drug pa'o/ /de bzhin du ni ye shes khams la 'gyur te yon tan dbang las stong pa drug gi /zhal rnams so/ /gcig ni bzhi la bsres pa bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba dag ste gnyis dang gsum ni bsres ripa lnga/ /shes rab thabs ni zhal bcu yon tan rnam pa gsum gyi dbang gis rizhal ni bcu gnyis rnam cupa bzhi / 43 /thun mtshams dbye bas rnam pa bzhi ste rnam pa gsum gyi zhal yang dus sbyor dbye bas kha dog gsum/ /dus sbyor phyed pa phyag gi dbye ba mi mnyam mnyam pa 'khyud pa dag kyang lus dang sems la ni/ /thun mtshams cha shas snga phyi las te dzozhal gsum ro yi phyag ni 'khyud pa dbu ma'i cha shas la/ /shes rab sbyor dang snyoms par zhugs pa dag kyang dgod —pa la sogs rnams ni thun gyi mngon mtshams la'o/ 44 /shes rab yan lag dmar dang ser po la ni nges par dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsam pa rab tu 'jug /rdo rje can gyi g.yon mdun yan lag dkar dang sprin dag mtshungs pa dag la shes rab bsam pa'o/ /mchog gi lus la shes rab bsam pas gye ba g.yon dang mdun gyi yan lag dag ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /drag po g.yas dang rgyab kyi yan lag mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i bsam pas phye ba de bzhin nyid/ 45 /shes zurab kyis gye rgyal ba dag gi rab mchog tshogs kyi rigs ni gnyis kyi rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab kyi ni gtso pos phye ba nges par phyogs bral du yang rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs nyid de / /g.yas dang g.yas min nyi ma dang ni ri bong can gyi sku dag zung ste shar dang nub nyid kyang / /nag po ser po dag ste sngon po ljang gu chadag kyang de bzhin mkha' dang sa 'og yang dag gnas/ 46 /dkar po rnams kyi shes rab dmar mo padamar po dzirnams kyi ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar 77— 257

de bzhin nyid/ /ser po rnams kyi kha dog nag mo dkar min rigs rnams kyi yang mchog gi /gser dang mtshungs pa'o/ /sngon po rnams kyi kha dog sna tshogs slar yang ljang gu rnams kyi sngon mo rnams su de bzhin gsungs/ /de bzhin nges par lha mo rnams kyi rang rigs phyogs su gnas pa'i lha rnams dag tu rig par bya/ 47 /shes rab rgyud ni shar nas slar yang rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa nyid ni nub kyi zhal nas so/ /g.yas kyi zhal nas rgyal ba'i bdag pos rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs g.yon gyi zhal nas bya ba la sogs so/ /shar nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid de :slar yang nub kyi zhal nas nges par dbu ma mtha' dag go//mdo sde pa ni g.yas kyi zhal nas gsungs te dkar po'i zhal nas dag pa'i bye brag smra ba'o/ 48 /nub kyi zhal nas nges brjod rig byed dang ni rgyal ba'i dbang pos g.yon gyi zhal nas mchod sbyin gsungs/ /g.yas kyi zhal nas snyan tshig rig byed mchog gi bsreg bya'i rigs la srid srung shar gyi zhal nas so/ /shar gyi zhal nas rigs can rgyud de slar yang nub kyi zhal nas mkha' lding dang ni 'byung po'i rgyud/ /g.yon gyi zhal nas zhi ba'i mtha' ste nyi ma 'char ka dang mtshungs g.yas pa nas ni khyab 'jug chos/ 49 /rgyab nas 'phral la ldog pa mchog tu dkar ba'i zhal nas g.yon gyi lha /dang rab tu gnas pa ste/ /g.yas nas rig pa drag po min dang slar yang rlung gi zhal nas rlung skyes tshangs pa zhi ba dag /stong pa'i zhal nas stong pa dbang phyug dag ni srid gsum bdag pos 'jig rten pa yi don du spros/ /rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dang ni gzhan pa rtsod dus rgyab kyi zhal la sogs pa'i dbye ba las/ 50 /de bzhin dpa' bo'i rim pa sogs dang nyi ma'i bgrod pa'i dbang gis thun mtshams thabazhi 77— 258

po nyid dag dang ①/ /kha zas dag ni g.yas kyi zhal nas mchog tu 'jigs pa dag kyang rgyab kyi zhal nas spros pa ste/ /mdun gyi zhal nas 'khrig pa nyid do mchog tu dkar ba'i zhal nas rgyal po mi lam dag dang gnyid/ /rgyab nas rje rigs gnyis skyes mi yi bdag po dang ni de bzhin dmangs rigs dag kyang rim pas 'gyur/ 51 /rgyal ba'i bdag pos mdun nas thams cad yod par smra ba gsungs te g.yas nas mang pos bkur ba'o/ /rgyab kyi zhal nas gnas brtan pa ste slar yang dge 'dun phal chen pa ni g.yon gyi zhal nas so/ /mdun gyi zhal nas mi rnams dang ni slar yang rgyab kyi zhal nas dud 'gro rnams ni nges par spros / /g.yas kyi zhal nas 'byung po lha rnams mchog tu dkar ba'i zhal nas dmyal ba rnams dang lha min rnams/ 52 /mdun gyi zhal nas spros pa dag kyang snying ga'i 'khor lo nas 'gyur rgyab zhal lte ba'i 'khor lo nas/ /g.yas kyi zhal nas longs spyod rdzogs pa nas 'gyur kun tu g.yon gyi zhal nas lhan cig skyes pa nas/ /'khor lo rnams kyi rizhal gyi dbus nas lus la dngos po spro ba dang ni sdud pa nyid du 'gyur/ /'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag rnams kyang rgyal ba skyed byed zhal gyi dbye ba rnams kyis yang dag go/ 53 /dpal ldan zla ba zla ba chu shel rnam par rtog pa med pa'i rang tshobazhin las ni chu 'byung ba/ /de bzhin 'jig rten du ni rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phung po la brten dzhathams cad mkhyen pa'i chos 'dzag ste/ /chu ni sa bon khams la kun tu brten nas ro mnyam 'gyur ba ji bzhin nyid du chos dag ni/ /sems can rnams kyi dag pa'i sems kyis mernam pa mang por 'gyur te sngon gyi las kyi mthu las so 54 /srid gsum gnas na sems can don gyi byed po dang ni yid bzhin 77—259

nor bu la yang bsam pa med/ /sems la gnas te ༷ mi dge 'bras bu'i dbang gis sdig pa'i las can sems can rnams kyis ri mi mthong ste// /yid bzhin nor bu'i skyon min mi dge ba dang dge ba'i 'bras bu sems can thams cad rab tu spyod / /sems ni dag na mi de yang ni rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur te rgyal ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ 55 /gang gis myu gu 'di skyed skyed capar byed pa de ni dngos po skyes nas rnam par nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams pa de yis skyes par /rab tu 'gyur te slar yang sa bon rgyal po dag gi tshaskyed 7byed do/ /snga ma gang de gzhan gyi dngos las shi ba zhes pa'i tshig ste rang gi ngo bos skyes pa min/ /gang gis stong pa nas ni sa la 'ongs pa bde ba'i skad cig de yis stobs bcu dku'agro bar 'gyur/ 56 /bde nas bde la rjes chags skad cig 'dir 7ni lhan skyes dngos po gzhan la rjes su chags pa min/ /sung po gang dag de yis bskyed brnams slar yang bde ba'i skad cig de yis skyed 7par byed pa ste/ /dag pa las chos de las gzhan te slar yang de las gzhan dang de las rnam par dag pa'i /dag pa'i sa la sa bon btab pa las ni rtsa ba rnams dang lo ma me tog 'bras bu bzhin/ 57 /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang ro dang mchog gi ro ste phra rab dag 7ni rnam pa drug /dri la sogs pa re res dman zhing —yul dang rnam par bral ba mtha' ma 5ye shes blta bya rnams/ /'dod pa gzugs dang gzugs med rnams ni zung dang zung dang ri bong can te mtha' ma chos kyi dbyings /rnam pa kun ldan de dag kun nas rtag tu 'pho med bde ba lhan skyes rten du gyur pa'o/ 58 / slar yang sa sogs khams la phan tshun du ni gtso bo'i dngos po dag la chung ba'i snyedangos rnams gnas/ /phan tshun phung po 77—260

'byung ba dang ni yul dang yul can rnams dang phan tshun bdud dang ma rig pa//’phan tshun rjes chags lnga ni ro yi 'gro rnams la gnas sdug bsngal dang ni ribade ba'i skad cig gi / /rnam pa thams cad pa rnams kun nas gzhan gyi yon tan mi dga' mi byed rdo rje yang dag gnas/ 59 /de dag rnams kyi dus kyi 'khor lo rdzu 'phrul rab tu gsal byed chen po du ma sprul pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'phro ba rnams kyis 'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa lha min dang ni mi rnams dang / /longs spyod rdzogs pas gzugs can rnams dang mkha' la rgyal ba'i sras sogs dgra bcom rnams la chos sku yis/ /stong pa'i cha yis srid gsum mtha' dag stong pa'i zad par rlung rnams kyis ni rlung gi zad par te —/ 60 /me yi cha shas rnams kyis me yi tshozad par chu yang 'gro la spros pa'i chu yi cha rnams kyis/ /'dzin ma'i cha shas rnams kyis sa yi zad par tshogs pa'i yul rnams kyis ni dngos po'i rang bzhin kun/ /kun nas nam mkha' dag dang mtshungs pa gcig gi bdag nyid 'di ni dag pa'i sa la ston par byed / /de ltar sangs rgyas skur 'gyur bde ba gcig pu'i rang bzhin phyir na 'chi bar yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ 61 /de gcig pu las rnam pa lnga ste mtha' dag rgyal ba mchog rnams kyis ni mngon rdzogs byang chub 'di / /rnam pa nyi shu'i rang bzhin dang ni slar yang de nas sgyu 'phrul du ma'i rang gi ngo bo'o/ /de yi skad cig gcig ni bde mnyam 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur te las gzhan gyi ni rang bzhin min/ /'dir thabs 'pho med skad cig gang yin 'dir ni 4lhan skyes chos kyi dbyings su rab tu zhugs pa la'oci/ 62 /mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing rnams dang pani dpag med yon tan rnams dang nam mkha' la sogs khams rnams 77—261

dang / /gnas dang skye dang nyams pa rnam gsum zhes pa'i srid pa dang ni 'gro ba drug tu sems can kun/ /sangs rgyas khro bo lha sogs rnams dang snying rje'i thugs ldan byang chub sems dpa' btsun mor bcas rnams te/ /'di dag rnams ni srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas rgyal ba ci bde 'byung gcig pu'i 'khor lo ri gcig yin no/ 63 /spu dang pags pa sha khrag ro dang bcas pa dag kyang ( tshode bzhin rus pa dang ni rkang dang rtsa/ /de dag rnams la srog sogs rlung ste kun nas rlung gi dbus su nyi ma zla ba'i bgrod pa'o/ /zla ba'i dbus su dri med nor bu bzhin du dngos po kun gyis 'khyud pa'i rnam par shes pa ste/ /de ni dngos dang dngos med gnyis med nyid dang mchog gi bdud rtsi'i go 'phang khyab byed gzhom med do/ 64 /spu la sogs pa zla ba'i mtha' ni mtha' dag lus la gnas rnams gang zhig sa bcur gsungs pa rnams/ /sde pa drug dang la sogs gzhan rnams de dag dus kun rnal 'byor rnams la bde mnyam 'bras bu ster/ /de phyir bla ma'i zhabs la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis ni thar pa'i slad du btsal bar bya/ /lus las ma gtogs gang zhig khyab byed thar pa ster ba'i sangs rgyas gzhan ni 'ga' yang yod pa min/ 65 /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas yin te sangs rgyas chen po gzhan 'dir 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin / /de rnams mnyes par byas pas dpag med srid pa gcod par byed tsho de 7rnam par mi rtog pa las so/ /rnal 'byor pa ni 'khu bar byed na dmyal ba 7ngu 'bod la sogs 5chen po'i mtha' ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sems ni dag pa na yang skomakhas dang mi mkhas skye bo rnams la 'gal ba mi bya'o/ 66 /sems can dag dang 'grogs pa thob nas mi yi bdag po dag pa'i byams pa la 77—262

sogs sems su 'gyur/ /mi dge'i yon tan dang ldan 'khor ba pa ni drug po rnams kyi zhe sdang chags sogs sems su 'gyur/ /dus kun tu ni byang chub sems kyang 'gro ba dang ni 'gro bar 'dod pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /thar par 'jug pas dman zhing smod 3pa rnam par spangs pa dag ni thams cad dus su bdud kyi sems/ 67 /srid pa gsum gyi gnas su bdud rnams zhi ba min pa dang ni byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba byed/ /bdud kyi dbang po rdzu 'phrul gyis dman mchog tu 'jigs byed yin te ston pa gcig pu rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /bdud rnams kyi ni bdud kyi blo dang skyob pa rnams kyi bde ba'i blo gros gzhan gyi snying la 'jug /de phyir sangs rgyas mthu rnams kyis ni srid pa gsum po mtha' dag sgyumatha' yas dus su 'jug par 'gyur/ 68 /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'jig rten khams la tshad gsungs gang yin de yang mi rnams rin shes nyid ma yin / /sangs rgyas rnams la lhan skyes lus kyi dbang gis khru ni gcig dang du ma dag gi tshad med de / /las kyi sar ni srog chags rnams la sems can rjes mthun tshad dag rtag tu rab tu gsal bar byed / /gal te tshad 'di bdag cigi 'dod pa brjod na lha rnams kyis 'di med pa pa zhes brjod par 'gyur/ 69 /gang gi tsho rgyal ba'i dbang po skyed 4cing nyin zhag so so'i dbang las gang gis mngal nas nges par 'byung / /skad cig gang gis 'gyur ba dag dang rnam par bral ba grub cing g.yo ba g.yo ba med gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bya ba de spangs nas ni bde mnyam dang bral stong pa gzhan dag gang zhig sgom byed pa/ /de yi bskal pa 7bye ba du ma rnams kyis sangs rgyas nyid dang lhan skyes bde ba dag kyang ring / 70 /nim pa'i shing las kun 'brum min te dug las bdud rtsi dang ni tshangs pa'i rmu77—263

shing las 'dam skyes dang / /stong pa las ni myang 'das bde ba mi 〉 dge'i dbang las dge ba srog chags gsod las grub pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin dag las phyugs rnams mtho ris mchog tu zhi ba'i go 'phang ri dbang po rnams ni 'gog las 4min/ /rig byed las ni kun mkhyen gsung dang 'gyur med bde ba g.yo med 'gyur ba ma dag sems las min/ 71 /sems can rnams kyi sdig pa'i sems ni mi yi bdag po bdud kyi tshogs kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur /bsod nams ye shes rjes chags bde ster dag kyang rtag tu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin brlabs pa'o/ /gang phyir bde ba'i dam tshig dbang gis bdud dang nyon mongs bcom nas mya ngan 'das par 'gro byed pa/ /de phyir bdud rnams nyi ma so so'i dus su de dag rnams la du ma yis ni bgegs rnams byed/ 72 /rgyal ba'i lhan skyes bde ba 'di ni 'phel ba'i don slad dang por las kyi phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /de nas nyi ma'i gzugs ni lus dang gdong dzodang rkang pa gtsug tor yan lag thams cad rdzogs pa ste/ /glog gi dbyug pa'i rjes mthun —'pho med bde ba skyed par byed ma mtshan nyid yan lag rab tu rdzogs/ /rdo rje rnams kyis zurab tu snang bar byed ma srid gsum gnas lus chos kyi skadabyings ni de nas 'gyur/ 73 /'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba'i 'bras ster phyag rgya bzhi po 'di rnams grong dang 'brog dgon dur khrod dang / /mi gtsang ba dang gtsang ba'i gnas dang khyim dang lha yi khang pa thams cad du ni dus kun tu/ /shin tu dga' ba'i dga' ba la gnas 'jig rten lam las rab grol rigs dang rigs min mngon spyod cing / /lus stobs bde ster bza' ba btung ba la sogs longs spyod dang ldan rnal 'byor rnams kyis bsgom par 77—264

bya/ 74 /rlung ni yang dag phrad pa rnams kyis glog gi me yi rtse mos spyi bo'i zla ba zhu bar byed/ /jig le gang gang zhu ba 'di las mgrin pa snying ga la son lte ba gsang ba dag ril 'gog /thig le las ni g.yo ba'i khu ba rdo rje nor bu la gnas rgyal mtshan rtse la 'gog cipa gang / /de ni shes rab ye shes skad cig gal te thig le'i phreng ba 'pho ba med pas bde ster na'o/ 75 /de phyir g.yo med bde ba'i skad cig lhan cig skyes pa 'dir ni chos kyi dbyings kyis ster byed do // srog gis ro yi 'gro ba rnams la gnas pa rithams cad bkug cing nyon mongs bdud rnams bcom byas nas/ /rdzu 'phrul kun mkhyen sa dang srid gsum bla ma nyid ni rnal 'byor rnams kyi skye ba 'di las te / /gal te lam du rab zhugs shi bar 'gyur tshan de tshe de yi 'dzin pas skye ba gzhan la'o/ 76 /gang zhig yon tan med cing dngos chung yul dang rnam bral de ni sku yi phyag rgya rnam pa gnyis/ /de nas chags pa rjes chags dang ni yon tan gter gzhan dag kyang gsung gi rang bzhin rnam pa gnyis/ /gnag dzodang dkar la rjes chags yul gyi yon tan la dga' thugs kyi phyag rgya rnam pa gnyis la'agyur te / /brgyad dang gnyis dang lnga dang lnga dang gsal bar mkha' dus dang ni stong pa rig byed dag gi lo / 77 /rin chen dbang po mi 'byung bar du rgyal ba mchog skyed lam ni rnal 'byor pa yis bsrung bar bya/ /rin chen dbang po rab tu 'byung ba'i dus su mtha' dag yon tan gter gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs byas nas/ /sangs rgyas byin brlabs pasngags rnams kyis ni gsang ba'i padmar bde mnyam sngags dang bcas pa spro bya ste/ /gsang bar bsrung tshob rab tu byas nas rdo rje nor bu la gnas byang chub sems ni myang bar bya/ 78 /de la gang zhig bu ru gyur pa 77—265

rgyal ba skyed 0byed sras po de ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /shes rab lhag pa las ni 'ga' zhig tshe na bu mor 'gyur te nges par sangs rgyas yum du 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan ma me tog gsum gyi padma dkar 'dzin dzi bha la dang phyag na rdo rje ste/ /me tog brgyad kyis gzhan brgyad phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas rdzu 'phrul tshad ldan khro bo'i rgyal po rnams/ 79 /zla ba de la rdul gang rab tu byung ba de ni slar yang 'jam dbyangs rab tu skyed pa ste/ /lo ni nyi shu dag gi bar du so so'i rdul la byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs chen po ste/ /de nas stong pa dang ni rig byed bar du cung zad snying stobs cha shas dman par rab tu 'gyur/ /slar yang lo ni nyi shu'i bar du de bas kyang ni snying stobs chung zhing brtson 'grus chung ba'o/ 80 /de nas skye gnas la ni rdul med yul ni rab tu bcom pa'o de nyams pa las dbang ’ ma yin / /'on kyang sa bon nyams pa la 7ni shes rab dbang bskur rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gsung gis sbyin par bya/ /de dag rnams kyi sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i yon tan rgyal ba'i yan lag dag gis 7btsal bar bya/ /byang chub sems kyi bsnyen pa 'di ni sems can don gyi byed pa mo ste 'bras bu mang por 'gyur/ 81 /gang zhig khrag ni 'thung byed rab mchog lha mi rnams kyi zang bu de ni bdud rtsi gcig pu ste/ /skyugs rshapa snying ga pagasang ba'i kha nas rdo rje nor bu la gnas chu skyes nang du rab zhugs min/ /bshang ba gci ba khrag dang sha ni mchog tu ro mnyam smyugs pa'i dbus su rab tu zhugs pa ste /'di dag rnams ni ye shes bdud rtsi srid pa gsum gyi bla ma yis kyang rgyud rnams kun tu bstan/ 82 /shes rab chos 'byung la ni gang zhig lhung ba'i bde ba dag kyang rab tu 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /de yis sems can gang 77—266

dag su zhig byung 3ba de ni rgyal ba'i rigs la byang chub sems dpa' nyid/ /de phyir de ni nyid zhag so so'i dus su bdud kyi pho nya srin po rnams kyis za ru 'jug/shes rab me tog dang ldan zos pa zhi ba bde ba'i 'bras bu ster bar ston du 'jug par byed/ na /mchog gi bde ba la gnas rdo rje ma 'khums nyid kyi bar du chu skyes las ni dbyung mi bya/ /gang tshe 'dod pa grub pa de yi tshe na 'di ni sangs rgyas byin gyis brlabs par rab tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje chu skyes dag nas gzhug bya rang gi rdo rje'i snying gar ye shes 'khor lo rab bcug ste/ / 'di yis 'od zer rnams kyis gnyi ga'i lus ni gang bar byas nas rnam pa thams cad pa nyid byed/ 84 /gal te 'di ni grub par ma gyur rdo rje nor bu la ni yang dag gnas pa bza' bar bya/ /shes rab kyi ni chos 'byung gnas la mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs ni bsrung ba'i don du dgod par bya/ /shes rab ldan pa la'o de nas gcig pu la ste slar yang gsung 9ni rab gsungs sangs rgyas sku/ /gang su 'di ni nyams la mngon par dga' byed g.yon can de ni rdo rje can gyis gsod par byed/ 85 /srid pa gsum gyi dzobadag pos drag po'i las kyi rang bzhin du ma'i sngags rnams rab tu gsungs pa gang / /de dag 7thams cad bdud kyi phyogs nyams 'jigs pa skyed byed 2srog chags rnams la nam yang ma yin no / /gang zhig dran pa rnams kyi ngabyed po g.yul gyi yul la dga' zhing 5gsod byed gzhan yang mu stegs pa/ /de rnams la ni mchog gi rgyal sras rnams kyis srog chags bsrung ba'i don du de dag pasbyar bar bya/ 86 / mkha' 'gro rdo rje sngon rnams phyugs kyi skye bo gsod la sangs rgyas pa yis tshagasol ba gdab mi bya / /sems can rnams ni bsrung riba'i don du srid pa gsum gyi bla mas 'jig 77—267

rten khams su spros pa ste/ /de phyir de rnams nyid zhag so so'i dus su srung /bar byed cing sgrub pa po la ldang bar byed/ /bsgrub bya dag ni las kyi mthu yis shi bar gyur na 'di ni sgrub pa po yi bdud yin no/ 87 /skyes bu rnams kyi sems ni kun nas mi dge'i 'bras bu'i dbang gis phran tshegs rig pa la rjes chags /rig pa 'di yis srid pa gsum po mtha' dag skad cig gis ni bdag gi dbang du byed pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i bsam pa brkam ci gas sems kyi yeshes sbyin pa rurnam par spangs nas dmyal bar rab tu 'jug / rgyab tu rdzas dang rang gi khyim thab gzhan gyi dbang 'gyur /kye ma ngan —pa'i chos la rab tu 'jug 88 /shes rab ma yin thabs kyang min pa 'di ni lhan cig skyes pa'i sku ste chos kyi skur gyur pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nges par mun pa dang bral ye shes dang ni rnam shes dbye ba las/ /'di ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste sgra brnyan lta bu sems can du ma'i don ni byed pa po/ /sems can rnams ni smin pa'i slad du slar yang 'di ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur/ 89 /rdo rje sems dpa 'a gcig pu 'di ni dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa he ru gar ni byung bar gyur/ /gdug pa rnams ni smin pa'i don te de yang dam tshig rgyal ba rmongs pa rnams ni bde ba'i don/ /rin chen dbang po sdug bsngal ldan pa rnams kyi de yang pad 'dzin chags can rnams kyi chags pa'i slad/ /bgegs rnams dag ni gzhom pa'i don du phyag gi padma ral gri don yod grub par byung bar gyur 90 /zhe sdang las ni sna tshogs yum gang dus mtha'i rtse mo can mtshungs de ni mkha' 'gro mar byung gyur/ /gti mug dag las spyan ma zhes bya mchog gi snying rje mā ma tī ni nga rgyal rgyu las so/ /chags las de ni gos dkar zhes bya 77—268

mtha' dag yon tan gter te sgrol ma yang ni phrag dog las/ /sna tshogs gzugs can gnyis po 'di dag yul dang yul can gzhan rnams thams cad du yang byung bar gyur/ 91 /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin rnams kyis rdo je btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs pa brtse ba yis/ /nges pa rnam par ma bsgrubs bsod nams min pa /bsags pa'i sems can rnams ni smin pa'i don du ste/ /gtsang ma'i gnas la sogs par bcom ldan gang zhig rnam par bzhugs pa nyan thos rnams kyi slad du'o/ /gang zhig e waṃ yi ge la gnas mchog gi nges pa can rnams mchog la dgod pa'i don du'o/ 92 /sems can rnams ni smin pa'i slad du sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dbye ba rnams kyis dus kun tu/ /nges par rdo rje can gyi bzhugs pa rnam rigasum phyi dang dang dang gzhan du yang ni rab tu 'gyur / /phyi rol sna tshogs phyogs su 'gyur te mchog gi lus la srog gi rlung ni rab tu rgyu ba'o / /khyab bdag gi ni sa sogs dkyil 'khor dag la rab gyur gang de rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la/ 93 / sgra la sogs la gang zhig rang sems 'gro ste yul med pa ciyang gzhan ni de bzhin kho na'o/ /gang zhig e waṃ yi ge la tshoganas mchog tu bde ba'i gnas la sku gsung thugs ni zhugs pa'o/ /gcig pu rdo rje can ni dbye ba gsum ste yul dang yul can khams rnams 7kyis kyang bskor ba'o/ /dus gsum gnas gsum du bzhugs srid pa gsum du'ang gnas pa sems can du ma'i don gyi slad du'o/ 94 /rgyud rnams dag las 'di skad bdag gis thos zhes gsungs pa gang de 'di ltar bdag gis shes pa ste /rdo rje can ni la ba zhu las rdo rje chogang zhig spyi lamagrin —sgring ga'i chu skyes lte gsang dang / /bud med 7rnams kyi bha gar de ni thig le grol ba gsum 77—269

gyis mchog gi padma la gnas pa / /de 'dir sangs rgyas zhing du rab tu zhugs pa bcom ldan 'das su rnal 'byor rnams kyis rig par bya/ 95 /skye ba snga mar rang gi snying gis bskyed pa'i zhi dang chags pa la sogs dngos po rnams kyi ni/ /bag chags stobs kyis 'khor lor gnas pa gcig ni du mar mthong ste smon lam yon tan dbang gis so/ /don gcig du ma'i skad ni rang rang dngos po rnams kyis srog chags rnams kyi snying la rab tu 'jug /gnas can rnams kyi bsod nams slad du 'khor lo la gnas bsod snyoms la ni rnam par rgyu ru gshegs 96 /dud 'gro yi dgas lha min rnams dang lto 'phye lha dang mi ni 'phags pa bod la sogs rnams la/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur da ltar byung ba rnam pa gsum dang rtag tu bden pa'i chos ni gsung byed cing / /rang rang skad gzhan dag gis srid pa gsum po ma tshang med pa lam la yang dag 'god byed pa/ /'di ni bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung ste lha yi skad kyang ma yin no/ 97 /sangs rgyas rnams kyi'ang rtogs bya min pa dpag med yon tan dang ldan sangs rgyas sprul pa sgyu ma ni/ /srid pa gsum gyi gnas su bdag nyid ston par byed de cabargya byin gzhu ni ji bzhin nyid du'o/ /sna tshogs dngos rnams kyis phye rgyal ba dang bcas lha mi rnams kyi rang rang sems la rab zhugs pa/ /'di ni ma skyes chos te chu la nam mkha' bzhin du 'dir ni skye bar 'khrul pa ster ba'o/ 98 /rgyal ba'i sku yi rdo rje yul dang yul can rnams kyi bgrod bya min pa rnam pa thams cad pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje sems can thams cad rang snying skad rnams dag gis chos ni go bar byed pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi thugs kyi rdo rje sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rang bzhin mtha' dag sa la gnas/ /77— 270

dri med nor bu lta bu dngos po rnams kyi 'dzin byed gang yin de nyid ye shes rdo rje'o 99 /sbyin pa la sogs bde mnyam 'bras ster drug dang bzhi rnams nus ma bcu po de dag rnams su gsungs/ /de dag rnams kyi thabs ni dag pa mchog gi rnam bcu ①sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa de dag rnams / /bdud dang nyon mongs nyams pa 'dod pa zhes dang 'phrog byed rdo rje'i tshogs ni ljon pa la sogs rnams / /phyag rgya drug rnams stong pa drug ste srid gsum skyed 4par byed pa ye shes rnam shes gcig pu'o / 100 /'khor lo srid gsum kun nas dang ba zhes pa bde ba rin chen 'di yi chags pa nyid dag ni/ /padma'o nyon mongs zad pa ral gri rdo rje dag kyang ye shes sku chen rnam par mi phyed pa'o/ /mi shes gcod pa gri gug mchog gi rigs drug rnams te 'di dag rnams kyis bskyed pa gang yin pa /phung po khams dang dbang po la sogs mkha' bzhin ro mnyam de dag rnams kyang de bzhin rig par bya/ 101 /gang du nges par rigs kyi gzugs ni nyams pa nyid du gyur pa de ni chen po'i gzugs su gsungs/ /gang du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyams pa nyid du gyur pa de ni tshor ba chen por gsungs pa ste/ /gang du 'khor ba'i 'du shes nyams pa nyid du gyur pa de ni rdo rje'i 'du shes chen po'o/ /gang du 'khor ba 'phel ba nyams pa nyid du gyur pa dag /ni rdo rje'i —'du byed kho na'o 102 /gang du gnyid la sogs pa'i gnas skabs nyams pa nyid du gyur pa de yang rnam par shes par gsungs/ /gang du shes pa min pa'i dngos po nyams pa nyid du gyur pa de ni thub pa'i ye shes nyid/ /'di dag skornam par snang mdzad la sogs mchog gi 2rgyal ba mchog ni rnam pa drug ste rigs drug rnams/ /gzhan gyi khams drug dbye ba rnams te sa dang chu dang me cidang rlung dang nam 77—271

mkha' zhi ba rnams/ 103 /gang du gti mug mtha' dag nyams pa nyid du gyur pa spyan ma yin te de ni 'dzin ma'o / /gang du nga rgyal mtha' dag nyams pa nyid du gyur pa mā ma tī ste de ni chu nyid do/ /gang du chags pa mtha' dag nyams pa nyid du gyur pa gos dkar mo ste de ni me yin no/ /gang du phrag dog mtha' dag nyams pa nyid du gyur pa sgrol ma yin te de ni rlung yang ngo / 104 /gang du zhe snang mtha' dag nyams pa nyid du gyur pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang jig ma ste mkha' / /gang du ser sna thams cad nyams pa nyid du gyur pa sna tshogs yum ste de ni 'gyur med do/ /mthong dang ma mthong gzugs ni yid dang nam mkha' la yang lta bar byed pa gang yin de ni mig /ring nas sgra ni rab tu gsal ba bzhin du thos pa 'di ni rgyal ba'i rna ba chen po'o/ 105 /mchog gi bde ba byed pa'i dri ni cithams cad 'dzin pa de ni khyab bdag gi yang sna bzang po/ /rang gis zla ba'i bdud rtsi bde ster dag kyang rtag tu myang bar byed pa gang yin de ni lce/ /rdo rje'i reg 0bya kun nas 'phrog pa gang yin de ni rtag tu rdo rje lus kyi dbang po ste/ /thabs dang shes rab rab tu 'grogs las bde mnyam la 'jug yid gang yin pa de ni 'di yi chos / 106 /dbye ba drug gis phye ba'i yul dang yul can 'di dag byang chub sems dpa' btsun mor bcas pa rnams / gzugs la —gzugs la sogs pa 'di dag rgyal ba mchog gi yul rnams rnam pa drug ste kun nas ni/ /dang zhing ma skyes ma 'gags mchog gi bde byed gos pa med cing ye shes kyis ni rtogs bya ste/ /khams gsum dag tu gzhan gyis gzung bya dang ni mtha' dag 'gro ba'i dbang po'i sgo yis rtogs bya min 107 /ye shes dgug par 5byed pa 'dir ni slar yang shin tu stobs te de 77— 27 2

ni gzhug pa rmugs byed kyis/ / rengs byed de ni bcing ba nges par mchog gi bde ba'i ridabang gis khengs byed kyis ni mnyes pa yang / /ye shes 'khor lo dag la 'khor lo ro ci ni mnyam par byed pa rdo rje shugs kyis byed pa ste/ /de bzhin khro bo'i lha mo rnams ni rab gsal nges par rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud kyi sku la'o / 108 /srid pa gsum gyi gnas su bdud rnams dag la bsnun pa nges par dbyug pa sngon pos byed pa ste/ /bcing ba khro bo mi g.yo dus mtha'i nyi ma dang mtshungs mtha' yas brtson 'grus kyis ni phur bus gdab/ /'dod pas de yis 7brtson 'grus nyams pas tsis gzhi la gnas rengs par byed pa gnod mdzes nyid kyis so/ /gtsug tor gyis ni rdzu 'phrul nyams pa rab tu gsal zhing nges par sngar bzhin khro bo'i lha mo rnams/ 109 /yi dgas rnams ni smin pa'i don du de nas tsartsi kā la sogs pa spros par gyur pa ste/ /skye bo rnams ni bsrung chiba'i don du dbang po la sogs lha rnams de bzhin phyogs dang phyogs bral du/ /klu rnams smin par bya ba'i don du gdengs can rigs ni mtha' dag rdo rje can gyis nges par spros/ /lha min rnams ni smin par bya ba'i don du khyi yi gdong ma chen mo la sogs rnams kyang spros/ 110 /gzhan gang cung zad spros pa yod pa dag kyang khyab bdag dkyil 'khor la ni 'byung po las skyes mthar/ /sems can kun gyi don du mchog gi yon tan rnam mang 'di dag rang gi lus la rig par bya/ /de bzhin rgyud dang sngags ni rnam mang rigs la gnas rnams rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor dbye ba ste / /'di ni dbang bskur rnam pa gnyis kyang bu yi yon tan dbang gis 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'o / 111 /gang zhig shes rab kyi ni nu ma la reg gzhan pa bdud rtsi myang dang 77— 27 3

'khyud pa gang yin dang ’/ /shes rab dang 'grogs byang chub sems ni zhu ba dag la bzhi pa'i skad cig bdud rtsi rtogs pa gang / /de ri dag thams cad nges par 'jig rten pa ste mchog gi snying rje yis ni lam gyi rgyu ru bstan/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang gang rimachog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rgya mchog la rjes su sbyor ba'o/ 112 /sems kyi snang ba tsam ste rang gi yid las skyes pa me long gi ni gzugs brnyan lta bu nyid/ /gang zhig mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsten pa rnal 'byor dbang pos bsten bya ste/ /ye shes me cartse rab tu rgyas pa de ni cabadud tshogs yul dang bcas pa mtha' dag sreg byed cing / /lus la chags pa la sogs kyang ste rnal 'byor rnams la lo yi sbyor bas bde mnyam ster bar byed/ 113 /shes rab ye shes dag ni sems dang de yi snang ba dag kyang rnam pa bcu po nyid du 'gyur/ /dbang ni )dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bu 'di la zhugs pa gang yin pa/ /de las mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba 'pho med lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur ri med nyid ni bzhi pa ste/ /sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi snying dang kha tshol gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ 114 /nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzums lardo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /stong pa las ni du ba smig rgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang / /'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur /de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ 115 /nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yis bgrad 2pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste/ /ri khā nag po dri med 77— 274

'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar gyur gyi bar du'o/ /de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bu gos pa med pa kha dog sna tshogs te/ /rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral nyab dag go sems ni gzhan pa min pa nyid/ 116 /gzugs ni mthong bar gyur na nyid zhag so so'i dus su srog gi rlung ni 'gog par carab bya ste/ /'od zer 'khor lo rang gi lus la yongs su bskor cing byu〉'khor bar byed pa mthong gi bar du'o/ /zla ba drug gi sdom brtson rnams kyi ri rireg byas dman pa'i bde ba mnyam pa lam gyi sems su 'gyur/ /chags dang chags bral mtha' thog la gnas skad cig ma yang khyab bdag gi ni dbugs kyi grangs 'phel lo/ 117 /o 'bar ba'i bar dang khyad par dga' ba lhan skyes dag dang ye shes rnam shes tshodag gi dbus/ /gnyid dang gnyid yur mtshams 7su rdo rje padma dag gi gnyis gnyis sbyor ba la ni bde ba gang / /de yi 'phel ba rab tu bya ste bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gis 'phel 'gyur 'di la ngo mtshar med/ /nyon mongs bdud rnams bcom nas rgyal ba'i bdag por 'jug ste lo yi sbyor bas rnal 'byor bzang ngapo'o/ 118 /sa yis skurnam pa sra ba min zhing zhu ba chu lus khu ba min te gsher ba nyid min phyir/ /me yi rnam pa me min cogayo ba rlung gi lus ni gang zhig g.yo ba min pas rlung ma yin/ /stong pa'i rnam pa yin yang blta bya dkar dang ljang dang kha dog sna tshogs chen po kha dog min/ /rnam pa thams cad pa yang blta bya 4min te rang snying dri ma nyon mongs bdud kyi mthu las so/ 119 /nā da thig le cha dang ye shes bdud rtsi'i gnas su son pa lu gu rgyud du bcings pa'i rtsa/ /srog dang thur sel lam gsum rnams te rdo rje dang bcas padma rdo rje chu skyes ldan pa nyid/ /rlung gnyis —77— 275

yang dag phrad pa'i dbus su yul rnams /yul can rnams ni ( 'byung dang rab tu 'jug pa ste/ /du ba la sogs rnams kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa dag kyang gang zhig 'di dag rithams cad gsang bar bya/ 120 /dbu mar srog ni rab gzhug nyi ma dang bcas ri bong can gyi bgrod pa g.yas dang g.yon la bcing / /phyag rgya rab tu 'grogs la sems dang mchog gi bde ba la gnas rdo rjesang dag bslang ba yang — /padmar rdo rje'i sgra'am rang gi lag pa'i chu skyes dag gis gsor ba bde ba'i slad du ste/ /sa bon gtong ba min pa'i bde ba de ni 'chi ba'i 'jigs 'phrog 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal/ 121 /sa ni chu la rab tu 'jug cing chu yang 'bar byed la ste gtsang bar byed pa rlung la'o/ /rlung ni stong pa la ste stong pa nges par mtshan ma rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur zhing mtshan ma ni/ /rnam pa thams cad pa ru 'gyur te mi zad mchog gi bde ba gzhom du med pa ye shes sku/ /ye shes las ni rdzu 'phrul dngos grub tu 'gyur mi bdag skyes bu rnams kyi skye ba 'di nyid la'o/ 122 /'dod pa sprul pa'i skur ni nges par rab tu 'gyur te rdzogs pa dag ni de yi gsung nyid do/ /'bar ba sprul pa'i thugs te 'di yi mchog gi bde ba byed pa'i ye shes dag ni chos cinyid/ /dga' ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste mchog dga' dang bcas khyad par dga' ba rim pas 'di yi ni//gsung dang thugs so lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyid kyang bde 'byung 'di yi ye shes rdo rjer 'gyur/ 123 /'dar ba nyid ni srid pa gsum gyis btud pa chos kyi sku ste 'byung ba de yi gsung du 'gyur/ /gnyid yur gnyid ni chos kyi thugs te gnyid ni 'di yi srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms ye shes kho na'o/ /yi ge nyid ni dag pa'i sku ste dbyangs dang bral ba'i cha dang thig le nā da rim pa yis/ /77—276

bde 'byung dag pa'i sku yi gsung dang thugs dang ye shes rdo rje rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'o/ 124 /sad pa dang ni mi lam rang bzhin slar yang gzhan pa 'di ni gnyid dang bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ni / /lus la gnas dang dbugs la zhen pa yul rnams rnam par dpyod chicing g.yo med sems la zhen pa ste/ /ye shes la gnas bud med rab tu 'grogs las byang chub sems ni zhu ba la yang skad cig 'gyur/ /sprul pa la sogs dag gi sems kyi rdo rje rnam pa bzhir ni rim pas nges par rab tu 'gyur/ 125 /de ltar sems ni rnam bzhi srid pa gsum la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi thig le'i dbus su ste / /rnal 'byor dbang po rnams kyi ribade mnyam 'bras ster khyab byed dag ni thar pa'i slad du bsrung bar bya / /thig le btang na rnal 'byor rnams kyi skye ba'i sa bon mchog gi bde ba song la thar pa gang / /de phyir 'khor ba'i bde ba'i skad cig 'dir ni sdom brtson rnams kyis thams cad dus su dor tshobar bya/ 126 /gang phyir —ma sogs ka sogs ri bong can dang nyin byed gcig nyid 7rdo rje can gyi gdan min zhing / /sne yig nyid kyis mtshan ma dang ni yongs su gyur pa gzhan pa kha dog gzugs dag mi 'dod de / /'gyur med dag gis bskyed cing 'gyur ba nyams par gyur pa mchog gi dbang po dag dang ldan pa ni/ /rnam pa kun ldan thig le mtha' dag rgyal ba'i bdag po sna tshogs sgyu ma 'dzin pa 'di la'o/ 127 /bla 5sogs dbyangs brgyad gang dag yul gyi 6yon tan du 'gyur padabyangs gyed kyis ni rnam par dman pa rnams/ /phan tshun dbye bas phye skyab rkang pa dang bcas ro dang mda' rnams dbu ma'i dbugs ni 'bab pa ste/ /dus sbyor gnyis pa la ni yul gyi tsoyon tan dbang gis ring po phan tshun dbye bas phye ba rnams/ /slar 77—277

yang thun mtshams gsum pa la ni shin tu ring po yul gyi snyeyon tan dbu ma'i dbugs rnams 'bab/ 128 /de ltar thun mtshams ribazhi la mda' dang bcas pa'i ri bo ro rnams dbu ma yi ni dbugs kyi dbyangs/ /ka la sogs pa'i yi ge sum cu sum cu'i rab tu dbye bas rab tu gsal bar dgu brgya nyid/ /dbyangs drug gi ni dbye bas phye ba mkha' mkha' dus dang mda' rnams dus sbyor gsum gyi rtsa gsum la/ /de bzhin ring pos rab tu phyi rnams phyi rima'i nyin mo'i bgrod par dus sbyor gsum gyi rtsa gsum la/ 129 /slar yang dbyangs drug dag gis phye ba rnams ni mtshan mo'i dus su dus sbyor gsum gyi rtsa gsum la/ /de bzhin ring pos rab tu phye rnams phyi ma'i mtshan mo'i bgrod par dus sbyor gsum gyi rtsa gsum la/ /nyin zhag so so'i dus su dbugs ni 'byung dang 'jug pa mkha' mkha' drug dang zla ba mig rnams 'bab/ /snga ma stong pa rnams bsdus nas ni mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod par dbu ma dag la sbyar bar bya 130 /phyi rol du ni gang zhig chu tshod brgyad pa'i phyed gyur sgra gcan longs spyod dag las gzhan du gnas/ /de ni rang gi lus la dbugs byed nges par mun pa dang bral 'jig rten thams cad snang ba ste/ /snga ma phyed ni mun pa dang bcas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag stong pa dag tu thim pa'o/ /de phyir de ni phug rtonas dus kyi 'khor lo rnal 'byor ldan pa gcig pu mun pa bral bar 'jug 131 /zla ba dman zhing nyi mar lhag gang khyab bdag mchog gi cha de 'dir ni thun mtshams —bzhi la ste/ /thun dang thun la nyid dang mtshan mo'i dbang gis bgrod cing dus sbyor phyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba yis/ /sum cu rtsa drug dus kyi pho nya nyis 'gyur mi bdag gzhan rnams tshes ni brgyad gnyis dbye ba 77—278

la / /gza' rnams kyi yang brgyad kyi dbye ba la ste slar yang gzhan rnams du ma tshigs kyi tshogs /tshola'o/ 132 /rig byed dus kyi dbugs kyi lhag ma srid gsum 0skyed par mdzad ma mkha' 'gro ma ni sna tshogs gzugs/ /zla ba'i dbus su dman pa gang de mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rang gi phyag rgya rnam gnyis 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyi ma la gnas de ni brgyad dbye phyogs dang phyogs bral 'dab mar thun tshod longs spyod mtha'/ /lhag ma 'khor lo'i lha mo mchog tu 'jigs par byed pa gzhan rnams mtha' dag phyi dang lus la'o/ 133 /spen par bug pa mun can nyid zhag ces bya lha yi 5bla ma'i phyed bcas mig dang mig gi grangs / /phyed bcas drug dang rig byed du 'gyur de rnams mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i thugs rdo rje las skyes/ /sa skyes stong pa sbrul zla nyi ma gza' lag pa sangs mjug tsho rirings —la yang stong pa sbrul mkha' gcig /mkha' mig mig dang gcig tu gyur pa de rnams mchog gi khyab bdag gi ni dag pa'i gsung las byung / 134 /gang zhig zla ba'i dus kyi longs spyod mkha' mkha' zur me de rnams sku yi rdo rje dag las byung / /mtha' dag gcig tu gyur pa ro drug sbrul 'idang dus rnams dag ste gyed kyi chu tshod de bzhin nyid/ /mkha' 'gro dus kyi gzugs can mtha' dag lus la gnas shing srog chags rnams kyi srog ni 'phrog byed ma/ /de phyir nyin zhag so so'i dus su rang gi lam ni dgag par mebyas nas de rnams bsgrub par bya/ 135 /ji srid gza' rnams dag gi longs spyod rang gzhan bgrod pa la gnas dbugs grub —dbugs 'byung rgyu ba las/ /de srid dus kyi pho nya khyab byed ma gang khams gsum du ni mchog dag ster bar 'gyur ram ci/ /pho nya phra mo rab tu rgyu ba bla ma'i gsung la gnas pa byang chub sems 77—279

dang 'gyur med la / /sdig chibral rnal 'byor ldan pa rnams kyis shes par bya ste gzhan du 'dod chags sems kyi ma yin no/ 126 /nyi ma dang ni zla ba'i rkang pa rnams la gnyi ga'i bgrod pa'i dbang gis sred pas bsnun pa rnams/ /yan lag rnams kyis bgos pa'o lhag ma'i rkang pa de ni sgra gcan 'jug pa la yang mjug rings za/ /thun mtshams kun dang thun brgyad nyin zhag so so'i dus su srog chags rnams kyi yan lag bcu gnyis rnams/ /dus sbyor re re la ni dbugs rnams dag kyang nyis 'gyur dgu brgya'i srog rnams 'bab par ciyan lag gsungs/ 137 /yan lag gnyis gnyis rnams la thog ma'i nyin zhag dbang gis dang po ma rig yan lag bcu gnyis par/ /de phyir dus la sogs pas yan lag rnams te gzhan ni dgu pa sngar gzhan tshogang yin de rnams so/ /de ltar rnam pa lnga po rnams kyis dus su yang ni kun nas zla ba gnyis gnyis dag las —'gyur/ /gang du zla ba'i cha gcig nyams pa nyid du gyur pa 7dang po'i zla ba de nyid kho na'o / 138 /zla ba drug dang dus gsum gyis ni 'dzin par 'gyur te rten cing 'brel pa yan lag bcu gnyis kyis/ /drug pa nyi ma'i dus kyi dbye ba rkang pa'i bgrod pa'i dbang gis zla ba'i dbus su rab tu zhugs/ /reg pa'i yan lag dbus der sgra gcan gyis ni ci ba nyi ma dag gi rkang pa de 'dzin no /nyid dang mtshan mo'i dus su sgra gcan dag gis bltas pa'i sman rnams gang yin de dag lagrub pa ster/ 139 /sa skyes khu ba 7gza' lag zla ba gnyi ma tshogaza' lag pa sangs sa skyes sngags pa nyi skyes spen / /sngags pa lug la sogs pa'i 5khyim pa nyin zhag so so'i dus su zhing can rnams te dus kun tu/ /zhi la zla nyi'i khyim ste gza' lag pa sangs sa ciskyes sngags pa nyi skyes khyim ni rgyas 77—280

pa dang / /dbang dang dgug pa 'bral dang gsad 3pa dag la rab 'gyur gal te 'dir ni zhing can gyur na'o/ 140 /zhi la dkar po'i zhal te dang por rgyas pa la ni dkar dang ser mtshungs thun tshod lag pa las rengs pa ser po me yi thun la'o rmongs la gser dang nyi mtshungs chu gter la ste dgug pa la/ /dmar po lnga pa snyedag las ri 'gyur te dbang la nyi ma chu gter dang mtshungs drug pa'i thun la'o/ /gsad la nag po'i zhal te ri bo la'o bskrad la gnag tshodang dkar 'dir sprul khol mtshan mo'i mthar/ 141 /sa chu me rlung ri bong can dang nyi ma lha ste 'di rnams srog ni longs spyod byed po min/ /'di rnams srog ni longs spyod po yang mi dge sku'abras bu'i dbang gis bdag ni longs spyod sems par byed/ /sred pa sdug bsngal rjes chags 'byung po'i tshogs ni gza' dang lag 'gro lha rnams dag la don gnyer byed/ /gang gi drin gyis thar par rab tu 'gyur ba yid kyis zhi ba de ni byed pa ma yin no/ 142 /dang po'i dbugs ni yon tan med pa'i bdag nyid rnam gsum yon tan dbang gis de yang gsum grangs 'gyur/ /de yang yul gyi yon tan dbang gis tshes zhes bya bar 'gyur te de rnams slar yang sum 'gyur 5ni/ /'byung ba chu gter grangs 'gyur slar yang de nas rgyu ba'i chadabye ba rnams kyis bsnun pa de dag rnams/ /chu tshod phyed kyi dbugs kyi grangs rnams dag ste slar yang nyis 'gyur chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs rnams so/ 143 /gnyis gsum chu gter mda' dus ri brgyad gza' dang bcu rnams kyis ni dus kyi rtsa 'di 'phel ba ste/ /de nas sde yi rab dbye rnams kyis rnam gnyis lam la gnas pa dus kyi rtsa ni 'jig rten gsum/ /kun nas gang bar byed do bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba zla ba nyi ma'i rab tu rgyu ba las//77—281

ji srid rig byed sbrul /dang me ste nges par phyag na gri gug thod pa can du rab tu 'gyur — 144 /'khor lo mda' dang chu gter grangs ni yul dang yon tan dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi rab dbye yis/ /gtso bo srung bar byed de bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba du ba la sogs lha mo brgyad rnams so/ /de ltar nyi ma la gnas gtso bo mchog gi ri bong can gyi cha yis 'khyud pa sna tshogs gzugs/ /lha mo sangs rgyas 'chi med rnams dang yul dang yul can sgra gcan zla ba nyi mas phyag thos pa'o/ 145 /gtso bo yi ni phra mo'i ngo bo mchog gi yon tan yul te dang dang phyi rol phyag rgya gang / /de rnams khams gsum du ni mchog tu 'jigs byed khro po'i sems las rab skyes mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /gtso bo'i dbang po gang dag rnams dang rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ste/ /de rnams rang gi yul bcas yon tan gyis 'khyud bkra shis la sogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'di rnams so/ 146 /gzugs dang sgra dang ro dang dri dang gzhan pa dag kyang de nas reg bya du ba rdul dang ni/ /snying stobs sems la rim pas rab tu gsal bar yang ni de bzhin sgra gcan /gyis kyang 'khyud pa ste/ /de dag rnams kyi dal rkang drug dang myur 'khyog la sogs rgyu ba las ni rnam mang bgrod pa 'di /brgyad po rnams kyi rkang pa drug la yul dang yon tan brgyad rnams yang dag gnas pa —'khor lo'i tshul/ 147 /dang po'i dbugs ni dbye ba brgyad de 7yul dang yon tan la gnas kun nas du ba la sogs pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dag gis bskor zhing rnam gsum bgrod pa'i dbang gis 'khyam ste pa'agro ba drug tu gnas/ /de yi dbus su dus kyi 'khor lo bdud rtsi 'phro ba'i cha yis 'khyud par gyur pa dag pa'i sku/ /gang zhig dbugs ni bcad nas rgyal ba'i sku 77—282

la 'jug pa de nyid kho na /dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ 148 /dbugs ni bcad ripa'i mtha' ru rnam gsum bgrod pa 'di dang rnam pa drug kyang yod pa ma yin te/ /thig le bkab ripar gyur na kun nas mchog gi khyab bdag bde ba mtha' yas dus su 'jug par 'gyur/ /'khor ba dag gi bde ba spangs nas mchog gi bla ma'i zhal ni carnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ /spyod pa sgeg pa'i gzugs dang mchog tu 'jigs pa byed la rnal 'byor ma rnams dgyes pa ma yin no / 149 /gtso po'i dbugs la gza' yi tshogs kyi rkang pa mtha' dag dus kyi sbyor ba dag gis thim 'gyur te/ /dbugs ni mkha' mkha' nam mkha' mkha' mig me dang chu gter song na thams cad stong par skul bar byed/ /lo 'di rnams kyis phyi rol du ni mchog gi khyab bdag rkang pa spro dang sdud pa'i ngo bo la//rang rang tshan kyis rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rkang pa dbugs kyi dbus su 'gro dang gnas pa shes par bya/ 150 /stong pa la ni spen pa 'jug pa rang gi nyin zhag bgrod pa'i dbang gis dus kyi mthar 'gyur te/ /stong pa nam mkha' mkha' mtsho chu gter zla ba'i nyid zhag longs spyod lhag ma rnams kyis nam gru'o / /rang gi bgrod pa 'gro ba'i nyin zhag mkha' mkha' nam mkha' mkha' mtsho mig gis dzoder ni sgra gcan 'jug /rang gi bgrod par 7'gro ba'i nyin zhag mkha' mkha' nam mkha' mkha' dus dus kyi lha yi blon po 'jug 151 /nam mkha' mkha' dang stong pa mkha' brgyad lasbrul chodang mig gi nyid zhag rnams kyis bkra shis 'jug pa ste/ /mkha' mkha' nam mkha' mkha' mig me dang chu gter grangs kyi nyin zhag rnams kyis nyi ma la sogs 'jug /mkha' mkha' nam mkha' mkha' mtsho brgyad dang zla ba mda' yi nyin zhag rnams kyis zla ba der 'jug ste/ /77—283

de yi /dus su rgyal po'i 'gro ba dag ni rang rang tshad kyis rnam par nyams par rab tu 'gyur/ 152 /de nas zla ba nyi ma shar ba la yang rtsa yi kun tu spyod pa 'di ni rab tu 'gyur/ /gcig gnyis gsum dang chu gter mda' dang ro dang ri bo nor rnams 'phel bar gyur pa rigasang ba'i rtsa/ /bug pa zhes bya sgo yi rtsar 'gyur bcu pa phra mo'i rtsa ni slar yang steng gi lam du'o/ /de ni sde yis phye ba yon tan dang bcas yul dang bcas pa hūṃ ci'akhor lo'i rtsa rnams dag tu 'gyur / 153 /gtsug tor snying ga'i ri phyogs dang mgo bo ri bong can gnas mgrin pa'i phyogs te nyi ma'i rgyu ba dang / /lte bar 'khor lo'i rtsa ni dus dang lag 'gro mi bdag sum cu rtsa gnyis de yi nyis 'gyur rnams / / zla ba'i rkang pa rnams kyis tha dad ma yin tshamatha' dag nyi 7rkang bsres pa yis kyang tha mi dad /brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gcig gang zhig lag rkang la gnas tshigs kyi rtsa ni gnyis kyi dbye ba rnams/ 154 /gtsug tor snying ga'i 5phyogs dang ri bong can dang nyi ma'i rkang pa mgrin pa'i 'khor lor lhag ma rnams/ /brgyad cu rtsa gcig mtha' ma rab skegasal rnam bcu gang yin de dag zhi chodang drag po'i gza' rnams te/ /de dag rnams kyi thog tshamatha'i cha ni khyab bdag zhabs la gnas pa dus kyi rtsa yis longs spyod cing / /gza' yi mtha' yang srid pa gsum gyi skyed tsham rdo rje sku yi mkha' 'gro ma —yis longs spyod do/ 155 /dang por gang zhig stong pa'i ngo bo yul dang yon tan la gnas de yi rang bzhin dag tu 'gyur/ /khams dang sung po rnams la rab zhugs slar yang mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams la mnyam pa ste/ /sad dang mi lam la sogs la zhugs mchog gi bde mnyam gzhom du med par yang dag rab zhugs pa/ /rig ma sangs rgyas yum de 777—284

rdo rje yi ni tshigs tshol gnas pa rnal 'byor pa /yis btsal bar bya/ 156 /gtso bo'i sku yi mthu las rnal 'byor pa rnams dag gi mchog gi lus la lha yi spyan du 'gyur/ /de yi gsung gi mthu las rna ba de yi thugs las gzhan gyi snying la gnas pa shes par 'gyur/ /shes rab sku yi mthu las rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sngon gyi skye ba rjes su dran par 'gyur/ /shes rab kyi ni gsung gi mthu las mkha' mnyam thams cad dus su kun 'gro'i rdzu 'phrul du rab 'gyur/ 157 /shes rab ye shes sbyorang bzhin las ni gang zhig bde mnyam thams cad dus su gzhom du med par 'gyur/ /lha yi spyan gyi mthu las mig gis ma mthong ba dang srid pa rnam pa gsum yang mthong bar 'gyur/ /lha yi rna ba dag gi mthu las srog chags kyis brjod snying dang kha yi sgra ni thos par 'gyur/ /de bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba dag las mi yi bdag po reg bya la sogs thams cad 'gyur/ 158 /rtsa ni gang zhig thur sel dbus su rnam gsum lam gnas gci ba bshang ba khu ba 'bab pa rnams/ /srog ni de dag rnams kyi rab tu rgyu ba rnam pa dgu ru 'gyur te mtha' ma sangs rgyas zhal/ /rna ba sna dang mig la rnam gnyis shes par 'gyur te rtse'u chung ni rtse dang bcas pa dang / /thig le gtsug tor dug par 'gyur te bcu pa shes pa min pa rnams la rgya yis btab pa gang / 159 /srog dang thur sel 'gags par gyur na ri bong 'dzin pa bskyod pa nyi ma'i gzugs su rab tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje padmas rab tu sad na slar yang 'di ni nyi ma'i gzugs kyi me rtses zhu bar byed/ /rlung dang zla ba nyi ma 'gags par gyur na rnam par shes pa dang ni ye shes gcig tu 'gyur/ /de ltar de ltar dang ni de bzhin de ltar rnam gsum du 'gyur gzhan ni cung zad yod ma yin/ 160 /77—285

zla ba nyi ma'i gzugs ni zos na mkha' la nyin mo dang ni mtshan mo nam yang min pa nyid/ /thun mtshams mide ni lus kyi dbus su rnal 'byor rnams kyi ri dus kun bdud rtsi'i rgo 'phang la gnas pa'o/ /phyogs zad zla ba mkha' la gnas pa nyi ma'i gzugs la ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba ji lta bar/ /srog dang thur sel zad par gyur na gsal bar yang ni lus la dngos grub dus su de 'gag bo 161 /zla ba nyi ma'i rgyu ba nyams shing lam ni gnyi ga yi yang srog gi rlung ni chen po 'gag /chu skyes rdo rje rab tu sad cing ri bong can zhu nyi ma'i gzugs chen la ni rab tu zhugs/ /dngos dang dngos med gcig gyur rnam gsum srid pa la gnas gzhom med legs par rab tu rtogs 0gyur pa/ /de yi dus su rnal 'byor pa ste gang la gnyis ni cung zad med pa mchog gi go 'phang 'gro 162 /khro bo sangs rgyas lha mo dang bcas nges par tshor yi rdo rje rnams dang sa yi snying po sogs / /rab tu dga' ba'i thugs rnams rnal 'byor pa la grub pa'i dus su nam mkha' la ni mngon sum 'gyur/ /de yi 'dod pa'i dngos grub ri bong can gyi zhag gi tho rangs dang ni mtshan mo byed la 'gyur/ /rin po che 'am me tog char ni mchog gyur dus kyis 7sbyor bas sa yi steng du 'bab par 'gyur 163 /lus ni dang zhing rdul phran nyams pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyis rab rdzogs 'gyur/ /sna tshogs 'jig rten gsum po nyid ni dang zhing sgrib pa rnam par bral ba rmi lam bzhin du snang / /skad ni kun nas chad pa med cing du ma'i skad gzhan dag gis gzhan gyi snying la 'jug pa ste /sems ni dam pa 'i bde bas gang zhig mi g.yo thams cad dus su lhan cig skyes pa sa 'khyud pa'o/ 164/sa las chu dang rtse mo can dang rlung skogi rdul phran 77—286

bye nas chu yi khams la 'jug par byed/ /chu las sa me rlung phye rtse mo can la rtse mo can las sa dang chu dang rlung phye ste/ /rlung la'o rlung las sa dang chu dang rtse mo can dag phye nas las kyi /rlung yang stong pa la/ /rnam gsum srid pa'i dbang gis gang zhig las kyi rlung gis bsnun pa gzhan rnams zhing gzhan dag tu 'gro / 165 /sangs rgyas zhing ni ma lus las can min par srid gsum skyed par mdzad pas rnam par gzigs nas ni / /gnyi ga ro mnyam dag pa'i rdul la sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba ste/ /so so re re'i ro yi rdul la gnyi ga'i rigs kyi dbang gis rdo rje'i sras po rnams kyis bskor/ /sa la sogs pa'i rdul la ma lus rigs la gnas pa mtha' yas mi g.yo sogs la rab zhugs rnams/ 166 /de dag rnams dang thabs cig rdo rje sems dpa' 'chags pa'i dus kyi bar du mkha' la rnam par bzhugs/ /yang dag 'dzin par byed pas sa dang chu dang bsreg /za rlung dang stong pa'i rang bzhin rdul phran 'dzin/ /srub par byed pas tha dad rdul phran mtha' dag gcig tu gyur gyi bar du srub par byed pa ste/ /slar yang de dag rnams ni phan tshun sbyor bar 'gyur te gtso po'i dngos la chung ngu'i dngos rnams so/ 167 /dbyibs kyi rlung ni chen po thams cad dag gis sangs rgyas zhing rnams mtha' dag rnam par 'god par byed/ /'jig rten khams ni so so dag la slar yang khor yug ri bo chen po dag ni kun nas so/ /de yi dbus su las kyi sa ni chen po dag gi rang bzhin 'jig rten khams su rab tu 'gyur/ /lhag ma longs spyod rang bzhin yul gyi bde ba byed pa rin chen kun gyis rab tu gang ba rnams/ 168 /mtha' dag ri yi bdag po'i shar ni dag pa'i ind+ra gri la lho ni padma rā ga 77— 287

ste /nub ni gaṅge ta na 1ser po byang ni ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar zla ba chu shel lo/ /dbus ni ljang gu de yi snying por de yi rinang du chud ri pa 'dir ni dkyil 'khor chen po ste/ /dang por thugs kyi rang bzhin de nas dbus snam las ni nyis 'gyur dag kyang gsung gi rang bzhin no/ 169 /de nas gzhan ni nyis 'gyur dag ste mda' la bcu yis bsgyur bar gyur pa'i dpag tshad stong phrag go/ / de yi ciphyi rol dus rnams dag gis 'khor lo'i ngo bo de nas 'jig rten khams kyi rang bzhin no/ /'khor lo drug dang rigs drug gis te rig byed 'bum gyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor ro/ /brgyad gnyis ka ba mi bdag ri bong can gyi cha yis khang pa brtsegs pa skum po skye gnas gzugs / 170 /rgyal ba'i bdag po'i gtsug tor nas ni mdzod spu'i dbus su phyed dang bcas pa nyi ma'i sor du 'gyur/ /de nas mgrin pa'i chu skyes de bzhin snying ga /dang ni de nas lte gsang chu skyes de bzhin no/ /zhabs kyi 'og ོ dang rje ngar brla dang dpyi yang ma nu de nyid de nyid rig byed rnams kyis te/ /brang phyed phyed bcas nyi mas rang dpung dpung lag rnams ni mkha' mig rgyal po nyi ma'i tshad kyis so/ 171 /nyi shu 'ga' zhig 0lhag pa'i brgya phrag gang zhig dus dang dgu yis mi 5rnams kyi ni 'jig rten tshan/ /rig byed phyed dang bcas pa'i bzhi dang chu gter chu gter phyed dang bcas pa'i rig byed rig byed kyis /gtsug tor mgo bo 'og tu 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i dpal ldan dpral ba dag dang shangs dang ni/ /shangs kyi 'og tu ko sko'i skumatha' dang de nas mgrin pa dag ste mgrin pa'i rtsa ba'i chu skyes dbus/ 172 /de nas snying ga blte ba gsang bar mi yi bdag po phyed bcas nyi ma rnams kyis rim pas 'gyur//77—288

gsang ba'i chu skyes lte ba'i rtsa bar rdo rje dag kyang thub pa yis /ni steng gi gtsug tor nyid/ /mdzod spu gsang ba'i chu skyes dbus su khu ba'i thig le mi 'gyur bde ba skyed byed gnas pa gang / /dpal ldan rdo rje'i sa 'di gnyi ga'i rigs kyi dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo dag la'o/ 173 /phyed bcas nyi ma nyi shu rtsa lnga de las nyis 'gyur dag kyang thugs gsung sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /thugs kyi byed ni sor drug rkang pa dang bcas snying ga ril gnas lhan skyes ye shes 'khor lo'o/ /gsum po dag las sgo rnams bya ste nor bu'i rang bzhin gyis spras dkyil 'khor rnams las brgyad cha'o/ /'gro dang thong bas steng dang 'og tu sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'khor lo cinyis 'gyur dag tu 'gyur / 174 /lhun por gnas pa la yang rgyal ba'i bdag po'i sor mo phyed ni dpag tshad stong phrag dag tu 'gyur/ /de bzhin lha yi ri bo dag ni lus kyi tshad du 'gyur te rgyar ni byed kyi tshad yin no/ /de yi steng du rdo rje'i rnam pa brtsegs pa cha gsum pa ste de yi yang ni byed du 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'og tu 'dzin ma chu dang me dang rlung dang me rtse dang bcas rdo rje phreng ba'o/ 175 /phyed bcas nyi mas rgyal ba'i bdag po'i thugs kyi 'khor lor 'gyur te lte ba mgrin pa'i chu skyes dbus/ /gsung gi 'khor lo sku yi 'khor lo rdo rje nor bu'i gnas nas steng du mdzod spu phyed kyi mtshams / /sgo khyud mthar ni dpal ldan 'gram par 'gyur te mi bdag dpral ba'i steng du gtsug tor dag gi mtshams / /phyed bcas nyi ma rnams kyis sa chu me rlung dkyil 'khor me lce dang bcas rdo rje phreng ba'o/ 176 /steng dang 'og tu sangs rgyas sku 'di mnyam par 'gyur te sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'khor lo'o / /kun nas rlung gis /bgrod pa'i dbang gis thad ki'i tshad kyis gsum 77—289

rnams kyis sam de bzhin drug rnams kyis/ /rtsibs brgyad mtshan ma dang ni rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rkang pa dang bcas sor mo drug gis 'khor lor 'gyur/ /sgo brgyad rnams kyis bskor zhing rang gi lag mthil /sen mo rnams kyis dpal ldan dur khrod brtag par bya/ 177 /steng 'og zhal dang gsang bar gnyis dang chu gter tshad kyis bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor dag tu 'gyur/ / padma phyed la snying po'i dbus nas gsum rnams kyis kyang de nas phreng ba dang bcas 'khor lo drug /sgo la sogs pa dag dang 'gram par ri'akhor lo kun nas lnga cha dag gis nges par rab tu 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku ni mchod rten gzugs 'di kun nas shes rab ma yin thabs kyang ma yin no/ 178 /lhun po'i phyi rol du ni 'og gi sa gzhi'i gnas la dngos grub brgyad po yang dag gnas pa ste/ /shar du ral grir 'gyur te ro yi dbang po bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu ril bu mig sman ro tsa na/ /lho ru dpal ldan rkang mgyogs mi zad mtha' dag gter ni dkyil 'khor dag gi me yi zur du'o/ /dbus su mchod phyir thogs pa dag ste lha dang mi yi bla ma'i tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni de nyid do/ 179 /nor bu gtsug tor dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga'i tshoganas dang lte ba gsang ba la yang rdo rje ni/ /gcig gnyis chu gter mda' dang klu —yi dbang po dgu bcas nyin byed sor rnams dag gis rim pas so/ /dbus dang steng 'og gsum gyi cha ste zum pa dang ni rnam par gyes pa zhi dang drag po la / /dril bu dag kyang de bzhin cha gsum steng ni rdo rje dang mtshungs ba lang kha dang padma'i mugazugs/ 180 /khyod ni de yi sum cha zhal dang bcas pa'i lte ba 'dab ma dag kyang de yi sum cha las/ /rwa ni khyod dang mtshungs pa phyogs dang maphyogs bral du ste cir yi 77—290

skum po dag ni bzhi 3cha'o/ /phyi rol rwa yi sum cha 'og ste steng du ba da rī yi tsher ma'i rnam pa sbyor ba'o/ /dril bu'i zhal rnams de bzhin 'dab ma rdo rje yang ngo ba calang kha la sogs pa de bzhin nyid/ 181 /gsang ba'i chu skyes mdzod spu'i mtha' yi cha yis mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i mchod rten dpangs kyi tshad/ /de yi phyed kyis gdan gyi rgya ste sa bzhin shin tu nyams pa de yi sum chas phyogs cha rnams/ /phyed dang gnyis mthar phyir byung chu skyes snying gar son pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogadan gyi tshad kyis skum po'o / /padma'i mtha' las cha skodaman gzhi dang mnyam pa brang ste tshode yi phyogs cha yis kyang mgrin pa'o / 182 /gdan gyi 5byed kyi — yis gdong ste sa bzhin shin tu mnyam pa de yi sum chas phyogs cha rnams/ /gsang ba'i pachu skyes dag las phyed bcas nyi mas dpangs su pashin tu mnyam pa'i gdan gyi tshad 'gyur te / /gdan nas padma'i mngon lha mtshams 9 snying gar son pa'i dkyil 'khor samatha' dang de nas mgrin pa'i rtsa ba'o/ /de nas gdong gi mthar ni de bzhin chu gter dus dang byed bcas ri rig byed rnams kyis dum bu gsum/ 183 /gdan las rig byed dag gis padma snying gar son pa'i dkyil 'khor mgrin pa'i tshad kyang de bzhin te/ /byed bcas brgyad kyis gdong pa'i tshad dang de yi steng du gdugs kyi phreng bar 'gyur ro mi yi dbang / /mdzod spu'i mtshams nas dpral ba dag dang mgo bo cide nas 'dir ni gtsug tor dag sga mthar thug 'di/ /de ciltar nges par 'jig rten khams ni mtha' dag rgyal 4ba'i sku ste 'khor lo mchod rten rang bzhin no/ 184 /gser ni sa yi khams su 'gyur te dngul ni chu dang zangs ma dag kyang me yi khams yin no/ /lcags ni rlung ste zha nye dkar nag 'di 77— 291

ni stong pa dag /dang 'dres pa'i /khams kyi rang bzhin no/ /rin chen ser po sa ru 'gyur zhing dkar po chu dang rin chen dmar po yang ni me yin te/ /nag po rlung ngo sngon po dang ni ljang gu ride yang de bzhin 'dres pa'i khams las byung ba'o 185 /lan tshwa sa dang mngar 4)ba chu ru rab tu 'gyur zhing tsha ba me dang kha ba rlung yin te/ /skyur dang bska geba'i ro ni 'dres pa dag go slar yang zhing gi rngo rnams dag gi skye gnas dang / /sman rnams rnam pa drug gi ro dang mchog gi ro ste khams rnams gzhan pa nor bu'i dbang po rnams/ /sa la sna tshogs reg pa rnams dang mtha' dag nad ni 'phrog pa nyid kyi chu rnams yang dag go 186 /sa yis zug gzer 'phrog par byed cing dug kyang chu yi khams kyis 'phrog par byed de me yis ni/ /'byung po rlung gis rengs pa nam mkha' yis kyang gdug pa'i lta ba rab tu lhung /ba 'phrog par byed/ /ye shes kyis ni thams cad 'phrog ste de bzhin mi bdag rnams kyi lus la gnas pa'i nor bus kyang / /chu dang ro dang nor bu reg pa sngags dang sman rnams dag gi mthu rnams thams cad bsam mi khyab/ 187 /bcom ldan ye shes 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can ni kun nas sangs rgyas zhing du rab tu 'jug 'gyur zhing / /slar yang thams cad tshogs pa'i sbyor ba dag las 'bras bu'i dbang gis sems can rab tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /rang gi nyid bgrod dbang gis yan lag bcu gnyis de dag rnams kyis zla ba lhun po rdzogs pa 'dir/ /mchod rten rnam pa steng du brtsegs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin mi bdag de yi snying po'i 7dkyil 'khor ro 188 /phyi rol du ni rgyu 7skar 'khor lo rnams te las kyi sa la sa gzhi la gnas mi rnams so/ /longs spyod sa la gling drug bdud rtsi'i ma'abras bu'i ro yi 77—292

kha zas can gzhan lha 4)la sogs pa rnams/ /ra la rjes su gnas pa brgyad rnams lha yi bdag po me dang dus dang lha min chu gter rlung / /gnod sbyin dang ni drag po 'og dang steng du 'khor dang bcas pa khyab 'jug nyid dang chu gter gdong / 189 /'dir ni chu srin rnam shes dang ni stong pa'i khams te bum pa dag ni 'du byed nyid dang rlung / /nya dang lug dang glang dang 'khrig pa tshor ba me ru rab tu 'gyur te 'du shes chu dang ni/ /gzugs dang sa dang 'gyur med dag dang lhan cig skyes pa kun ṭa la sogs pa'i khyim rnams so/ /'di rnams mtshan ma rdo rje la sogs ka tsa ṭa pa ta sa ring po thung ngu 4lhag pa'i lha/ 190 /lug dang 'khrig pa kun ṭar ni zla ba dkar po nyi ma seng ge bu mo srang rnams so //sa skyes sngags pa sgra gcan rnams te gza' lag spen pa gdengs can sdig pa gzhu yi thog mthar ro/ /de ltar sa la sogs pa'i khams ni kun nas phan tshun sbyor bar 'gyur ro mi yi bdag po kye/ /'gro ba 'di ni sems can rnams kyi las kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur rin chen kun gyis rab tu gang / 191 /gang dag sa la dpag bsam shing dang ro dang mchog gi ro dang sman dang ro yi dbang po gzhan/ /mtha' dag nad 'phrog rdul phran rnams kyis rab tu bskyed pa de rnams sems can rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ /gang zhig phal pa'i rtsa dang shing dang chu dang ri rdul dang rdo ba dang ni lcags rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ /yi dgas rnams kyis chu ni me chen dmyal bar song ba'i mi rnams dag gis kun nas gcod 'bigs so/ 192 /'di rnams sgrol ba'i slad du sras dang bcas pa rgyal ba'i bdag po las kyi sar ni rab zhugs te/ /mngal ni rab tu bzung /ba mdzad cing mchog gi thugs rje dag gis byang chub bskyed pa mdzad nas ni/ /77—293

nyon mongs dang ni bdud rnams bcom nas sa yi steng gi gnas su chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor te/ /sprul pa sgyu ma mdzad nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das ni dag pa'i sku can de nyid kho na'o/ 193 /de phyir rgyal ba'i bdag po'i sku ni skyes shing ma nyams :srid pa gsum po la yang gnas pa ste/ /bcom ldan de yis thams cad dus su sems can don ni mi 'dor las kyis bcings pa ma yin no/ /de ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug bdag ni srid pa gsum gyi gnas su las kyi sar gnas nyi ma kye/ /sems can rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs 'phrog lha gzhan dag cani nam yang ma yin no/ 194 /gang dag chos la mngon 'joms rang lus gzhan gyi lus dang rang gi bud med dag la rjes su chags /shi bar gyur na bu yi me yi sbyin sreg dang ni gnyen gyi bsod nams dag las mtho ris te/ /mchod sbyin la ni phyugs rnams 'tshe dang g.yul du shi bar gyur na mtho ris 'jig rten dag tu 'jug /'jug ngogs lus po lhung las mchog gi go 'phang 'gro ba de rnams thar pa ster ba'i chos ma yin/ 195 /de nyid lam ni rnam par spangs nas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa khyod kyi ma gang pha ni gang / /mchog gi bu dang bu mo spun zla chung ma sring mo rnams dang rje 0bo gnyen gyi sde ni gang / /bdag gis byin gyis brlab pa'i drang srong 'di rnams 'khor lo'i dbus 'dir gang gis thar bar 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de yis nyi ma khyod kyis thub pa rnams ni bdag gi tshig las rigs gcig dag la 'jug par mdzod 196 /gal te lus la dbyug pa bsnun pas sdug bsngal 'gyur na de la dbyug pa dag ni nyes pa can/ /dbyug pa 'di ni ma yin lag pas rab tu bskul te 'dir ni nyes pa mtha' dag lag pa yi/ /'di ni ma yin sems kyis bskul te 77—294

sems kyang 'dir ni gdug pa chen po khro ba'i me yis so/ /de phyir khro ba'i me 'di 'gro ba'i dgra bo bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsod par 'gyur/ / 197 /chags las snang sogs skyon te rab mchog lha mi rnams kyi rang 'dod chung ma gzhan dang 'grogs las so/ /de ni rtsa nas dbyung slad mtha' dag rgyal sras rnams kyis de ni 'dod pa'i sbyin la rab tu byin/ /de phyir sbyin ril rjes su chags pa bde mnyam 'bras bu ster ba bsod dmas dag gi tshogs 'di ni/ /'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen du gyur cing thams cad dus su skye bo rnams kyi dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog 198 /chags pa gang gis sems can rnams ni nyams par gyur pa de yis skyob pa rnams ni grol ba ste/ /sems can rnams kyis nyin zhag so so'i dus su gang zhig srung byed de ni skyob rnams ster bar byed/ /sems can rnams kyis rang snying la gnas bde ba gang zhig gtong byed de ni rgyal rnams srung bar mdzad / /des na rgyal ba mchog gi spyod pa 'di ni lha klu lha min rnams kyis bya ba dka' bar 'gyur / 199 /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' yon tan yid dang blo dang ngar 'dzin srog dang ni/ /gzugs la sogs dang mig la sogs pa yul dang yul can rnams dang las kyi dbang po lnga rnams te/ /phyugs dang bcas pa mi yi lus la khyab byed 'di rnams dag las rigs ni thu bo gzhon nu gang / /mi bdag dang bcas mi yi bla ma rigs dregs nga rgyal can khyod gang gis rigs ni thu bo yin/ 200 /bsreg bya sa dang dri ma med pa chu ru rab tu 'gyur te tub ka ni me nyid do/ /rlung dang dam mkha' 'dres pa'i khams ni g.yo ba dang bcas ri bong can dang mtshal ni bdun pa yang / / kā kṣi kā shi sa dang mu zi mnyam dang mkha' rlung me 77— 295

dang chu ni ldong ros ba bla ste/ /btsag ni sa 'o lan tshwa gang zhig ze tsha 4rgya mtsho skyes dang rgyam tsha rinag po thab kyi tsha / 201 /'di rnams sa sogs khams te slar yang 'dir ni nā bsu ra ya bakṣar cas dang / /tsha la tā tsa las skyes de rnams mkha' dang rlung me chu dang sa rnams dag gi rang bzhin no/ /rdo yi chu ni sa ru 'gyur te ri bong can gyi chu ni chu dang me yi chu ni me/ /rlung dang stong pa'i rang bzhin dag gi dug gi chu dang gzhan pa gri gug gsum gyi rang bzhin no/202 /gla snang ser po sa yi khams te shaku ri ka dang rwa can dag po chu dang me dang rlung / /dag po brtsegs pa stong pa zhes bya gzhan pa nye ba'i dug ni rnam pa lnga po rig par bya/ /rdo dang srog gi ngo bo rnam pa sna tshogs 'bras bu dang mtshungs mgo dang dung la sogs pa'i gzugs/ /de dag tsharnams kyi lcags ni rnam drug lhang tsher skyes dang de bzhin lha dang khab len rnam pa bzhi/ 203 /ro ni grub dang grub pa ma yin rnam pa gnyis su 'dir 'gyur 'bugs byed dang ni 'bugs byed min/ /grub pa lcags ni 'bugs par byed de slar yang de ni zos pas lus kyang 'bugs par byed pa'o/ /gang zhig 'bugs byed min pa'i dngul chu ro de bskol ba dang ni bsgyur bar gyur pa dag gis kyang / /lcags ni 'bugs shing rjes su 'bugs te mtha' dag nad 'phrog rus skupa'i lcags ni rnam par spangs nas so/ 204 /dang por du ba'i rang bzhin dag gis 'gro ste me la gnas shing bskol ba de ni rim pa yis/ /sgra dang rab tu 'phar ba yis te de yang 'dar ba dang ni 'dar med nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /sgra ldan 'phar ldan 'bugs par byed pa ma yin de yang 'dab ma 'bugs byed 'dar dang bcas pa ste /'dar ba med pa mdung gis 'bugs byed rnam chogasum 'dir mayang sgyur 77—296

byed rnams kyis bsgyur bar gyur pa'o/ 205 /mchog gi sman gyi stobs kyis stobs dang ldan par snarab tu 'gyur te lcags rnams thams cad bzhu ba'o/ /su zhig de rnams med na sa yi steng gi gnas su 'di yi bcing ba dag ni gang zhig byed/ /bcings nas rimakha' la spyod pa nyid du 'gyur zhing de bzhin zos na 'chi ba dag kyang nyams par 'gyur/ /ye shes med na sa bdag rnams kyis ro yi dbang po 'di ni rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ 206 /de dag rnams kyi rdzas ni du ma glu dang rol mo'i mngon par sbyor ba la yang 'god ripar 'gyur/ /gang zhig chud zos de ni mi bdag ro yi yul la ma bsregs chos kyi bya ba la ma byin/ /gang zhig rdzas ni sdig pa'i slad du zad par byed pa de yis de ni sdig pa dag gis bcings/ /de phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems can dag gi don gyi slad du ma lus pa ni zad par mdzad/ 207 /gang zhig byugs pas 'phral la zangs kyi 'dab ma'i dri ma 'phrog par byed pa dag ni sman yin te/ /mtha' dag nad 'phrog lcags rigs 'ju bar byed pa de ni skal ldan rnams kyi cas la mthong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan dag rnams kyis 'di yi bcing bar rab tu 'gyur ba gang de nges par lo dus bar dang ni/ /bdug dang dgod pa'i sbyor ba rnams kyis de ni stong phrag gcig 'bugs ridag las lhag par mi 'gyur ro/ 208 /sman rnams thams cad shin tu tsha ba'i ro rnams dag dang 'gyur byed sde dang skyur ba'i sde rnams dang / /bslang bar gyur pa'i rtsab mo dag gis rtag tu mnye dang bdug par yang ni rab tu 'gyur ba ste/ /dngul chu rnams ni dngul du bya ba la yang me tog btab pa rnams kyis sa bon dag pa'o/ /gnyis sbyor tsha la mching bu byi ba rta sen dug rnams kyis so snum gyis bran pas 'jam pa nyid/ 209 /77—297

glang po mi yi chu ni lan /bdun blugs pa dag gis chu shing tsi ri tra la sogs thal ba dang / /'gyur byed kun dang tsha ba rnams dang slar yang nye ba'i ro ni 5sbyangs pa de rnams sbru bar bya/ /yang nas yang du me yi tsha ba dag gis slar yang lan brgyar sgru bar bya zhing bskam par bya/ /de bzhin dung gi phye ma brgya phrag sbyar bar gyur pa 'di ni mu zi dag gis bsres pa yang / 210 /lcags rnams zhu bar byed pa'i don du bi ḍa 'di ni dngul chu dag gi brgyad kyi cha shas 'gyur/ /khyogs kyi bdug pa mtshan mo brgyad de ro yi snying gar tshoganas pa zhu bar gyur pa ji srid nyid/ /drag por bskol bas dri ma med pa 'di ni mnyes shing bzhus dzapas stobs dang ldan par rab tu 'gyur/ /lcags gcig zhu bar gyur na nyi ma ri bong can gyi lus kyis 2lcags rnams thams cad kha sgyur byed/ 211 /khyab byed sgyur ba de yang chen po dang bcas zha nye gsha' ngatshe spra tshil bcas pas 'jug pa ste/ /de ltar gang zhig dngul chu'i las ni 'chad par 'gyur ba dag gis nyin zhag so sor byed pa na/ /dus gzhan dag gis 'ching ste gsal bar lci zhing sra ba nyid dang skyon rnams kun las rab tu grol/ /de yi tshamachog gi lus la nad dang 'chi ba dang ni dbul ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'phrogs lapar byed 212 /khru byed gser gyi padma nor gyi 'dab ldan dag la lte bar snying po'i dbus su rdo rje ste / /lha dang gshin rje nor sbyin dag tu dag pa'i ind+ra rī la padma rā ga chu shel lo/ /nub tu rin chen na ta ste me dang lha min 'phrog byed du ni rnon po zangs dang dngul/ /rlung gi 'dab ma dag la gser dang gser gyi lhang tsher dag las ciskyes pa'i gdan ni 〉lte ba la/ 213 /snying por de steng gser las skyes pa'i rdza 0bha la ni phyag gnyis ne'u le dang bcas mchog sbyin pa/ /77—298

'dab ma rnams la gser las skyes pa'am dngul las skyes pa'i lha mo brgyad de /chu skyes mchog sbyin phyag /cod pan sangs rgyas rin chen dbang po nor bu mchog sbyin phyag ste gnod sbyin mo rnams de bzhin nyid/ /ha sogs thung ngu ring po phyogs dang phyogs bral 'dab ma rnams la yi ge brgyad rnams rim pas so 214 /dri dang me tog rnams kyis nyid zhag so so'i ridus su thun gsum zla ba'i snod du mchod byas nas/ /oṃ rdza swā hā'i mthar ste cadabus su bha la dang bcas dza lerna kyiya zhes pa sngags 'di yis/ /rgyal po rab dga'i yid kyis gser 'gyur mkhan rnams dag gis srung /ba'i don du chu ni rab sbyin bya/ /de ltar bsrung ba'i mthu yis 'byung po'i mgon dang klu yi mgon pos ro ni 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ 215 /so phag 'gyur byed skyur ba'i sde rnams dag gis nyi ma bcu ru ro ni mnye zhing bdug par bya/ /de nas slar yang snyigs ma dag la gnas pa phye mi nas bsre bar bya ste thams cad dus su'o/ /slar yang gal te snyigs las de ni ma phyed ro ni 'chi ste de yang de la bzhu bar bya/ /dngul chu rang gi skye gnas za na de ni slar yang gzhan gyi skye gnas thams cad rab tu za / 216 /zha nye rnon po ra gan zangs dang lhang tsher skyes sam gzhan pa zhing las skyes pa rnam dag pa/ /mnyam pa gcig tu bsres 5pa'o dngul gyi bya ba la ni lhang tsher dkar po las skyes gsha' 5tshe mnyam/ /dang por drug cu'i cha shas zas ni 'ju bar 'gyur zhing de nas cha re bskyed pas 'phel bar bya/ /rkang pa'i cha shas ji srid nyid du rab tu 'gyur te de las lhag par glurab tu sbyin mi bya/ 217 /phyogs gcig gis ni nyis 'gyur 'ju bar 'gyur te slar yang 'di ni de bzhin sa bon rnam par dag /de ltar gnyis gsum brgyad 'gyur 'ju bar 'gyur te slar 77—299

yang zhu ba 'di ni bi ḍa mchog rnams kyis/ /ma zhu na ni ro la ji srid mtshan mo brgyad kyi bar du 'khor lo'i dugs su /rab tu 'gyur/ /reg pa mchog gi sman rnams dag gis me la gnas pa lhang tsher lcags ni kha med 'ju bar 'gyur 218 /lhang tsher dag las lcags ni brgyad 'gyur stobs su 'gyur te de ni zhu ba na yang brgyad 'gyur ro/ /de yis ri ris bon la yang brgyad 'gyur yin te slar yang de las rdo rje rin chen brgyad 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lcags dang rin chen rnams dang nye ba'i ro dang caro rnams ji srid khol bar gyur gyi bar/ /me yi nang du bskol bar bya ste de nas de ni 'bum phrag du ma 'bugs par rab tu 'gyur 219 /reg rdo sman dag med na mchog gi bi ḍa mnye ba dag dang dug gernams kyis kyang 'ju bar 'gyur/ /'dar ba med pa ji srid nyid de ride nas sgyur byed gser ni mnyam pa dag tu rab tu 'gyur/ /slar yang gzhan ni gnyis ( dang sum 'gyur gser bzhu'i khu ba 'bru mar dngul chu dag la blugs pas so/ /rdzas kyi don du zha nye brgyad cha gser zhun khu ba dag la rab tu 'bad nas blugs par bya/ 220 /gser dngul bya ba dag la gser rnon sprul zangs zha nye mtshal dang ldong ros mu zi dag gis dang / /gsha' 7tshe zla ba de bzhin lhang ⑫tsher skyes kyang skab bla dang ni bsreg pibya dag gis bsad byas nas/ /mnyam pa'i 'gyur byed dug dang lan tshwa nye ba'i ro rnams dag dang lcags dang mnyam pa'i dngul chu ni/ /mkhris —pa par po dag gis nyin zhag bcu ru mnyes nas de ni rdo ba'i dbus su blugs byas te/ 221 /sa yi dang du zla ba drug tu steng du me dang bcas pas mthams cad dus su bdugs gyur pa / /dngul chu de ni bcu drug cha yis dbyangs kyis tshodangs pa 'bugs par byed par rab tu 'gyur 77—300

te slar/ /zangs dang zla ba gser mnyam dge ba'i gser 'di gser 'gyur mkhan rnams dag gi sdug bsngal 'joms pa ste/ /dngul ni brgyad kyi cha shas byin na dag pa'i zangs ni phug pa dngul du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ 222 /'dzin ma la ni rdo ba gang dag 'bras bu'i lus dang mtshungs shing dung dang mgo la sogs pa'i gzugs/ /de yi skye gnas de rnams la byin mar dang sprang rtsi dang bcas drag po'i rlung gis bzhu bar bya/ /de nas slar yang btags 3pa dang ni tsha la 'gyur byed sde tshan rnams kyis dag par byas nas ni/ /lcags kyi skye gnas de ni shes nas nyis 'gyur ri dag kyang ro la gser 'gyur mkhan gyis bzhu bar bya / 22na /nyid zhag bdun du snod ni dag par 'gyur te 'bras bu gsum po ro mnyam bskol ba'i chu dang ni/ /sman gyis bsad pa'i lcags kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dag dang bcas pa dngul chu dang bcas dang / /ba yi 'o ma gsar pa rnying ri pa sna li zan ni lo ma skyur pos dman zhing lan tshwa dang / /rnam bral nya dang 'bru mar sogs las grol ba zos pa dag gis phyogs kyi nang du mi rnams kyi'o 224/stong phrag 'bugs pa brgya yis bsgyur ba'i brgya dang bye ba 'bugs pa ji srid par yang shes byas nas/ /nyin zhag so so'i dus su bza' bar bya ste yungs kur ri cha las mtha' ma skye tshe ne shas so/ /khang bzangs dang ni sa yi khang pa grang ba rlung dang tshad pa dag dang bral bar rab tu 'gyur/ /'bring po 'di ni zla ba drug gis lha yi lus po skra dkar gnyer ma dag dang bral bar byed / 225 /gno ṭī dang de ba dā lī tsha gsum sbo ha tī dang nim pa ki rā ta tig ta tsho)/ /bskol ba 'thungs te slar yang ma zhu ba la nyid zhag gsum du bsnyung dzobar gnas pa tsorab tu bya/ /de bzhin zla ba'i chu la sogs pa me dang dug gi chu 77—301

dang rdo dang bha ta yi chu/ /ngan pa'i dri dang sa dang rdo ba dug gi sha dang brtags pa gzhan rnams la yang sngags pas so/ 226 /gang zhig zos na drag tu rgyal rib ster byed dug dang mtshungs pa de rnams mtha' dag sman yin te//phye mar byas nas de ni cicung zad mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bcas bza' bar bya ste de bzhin nyid/ /gsal bar rimi phyugs sems can rnams kyis gang zhig za bar cibyed pa de ni grub ster sman ma yin/ /de dag rnams la 'chi ster mchog tu 'jigs byed gang yin de ni rnal 'byor rnams la bdud rtsir 'gyur/ 227 /daṇḍitpa la sā li pa: chu skyes sna ri dag gi rang lus 'dab tshoma'i khu ba yis/ /ro dang mu zi mnyam pa khab len snod du lcags kyis nyin zhag gsum dag tu yang mnyes byas nas/ /gang zhig zla ba drug tu nyin zhag so so'i dus su ṭa ga'i rkang pa 'i tshad ni za byed pa/ /de ni mdze la sogs pa'i nad las grol zhing skra dkar gnyer ma dang bral brgyad gnyis lo lon dbyibs/ 228 /po'i ṇa dang bar snang shaku pa'i ra'i mchu 5yis rab g.yo dngul chu dag kyang gsad skyapar bya/ /sman gzhan dag gis gsad cipa la ni dmar ring tshalhang tsher skyes dang gser dang khab len mnyam pa dag /gcig tu byas nas srog bcas dri ma rnam bral dngul chu dag la srang drug gis ni gong bu ste/ /sngar brjod khab len snod du chur 5khu dag gis bskol bar gyur pa gnyer ma dang ni skra dkar 'phrog 229 /zla ba drug dang gnyis gcig zla ba mi bdag dang bcas nyid zhag bcu dang zhag bdun zhag gsum dang / /zhag dang skad cig gcig gis 'di yi mthu dag las ni lus la dngos grub tu yang rab tu 'gyur/ /thun mong ba dang 'bring po 'jigs 7pa dag dang rnam par bral ba mchog ni —ye shes grub pa ste/ /mchog sman ri skyes 77—302

bu'i rang gis byas pa'i dge dbang las te skye ba gcig gi rjes /'bugs dag las min/ 230 /gang la 'khri shing smon pa gzhan gyi dngos dang nyin zhag so so'i dus su dud ca'agro rnam par rtsod / /ral gri dag la padma'i skud pa'i sdong bu mi yi snum gyi mar mes gter ni gsal bar byed/ /der ni nyin zhag so so'i dus su 'byung po'i bdag po dag gi sngags kyi bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /ji srid bsko ba'i mtshan mar gyur gyi bar te de nas sngags pa rnams la rdzas kyi dngos grub bo/ 231 /dang por rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa skye gnas drug gi sngags rnams bsgrub par bya/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams bsgrubs nas slar yang sa gzhi la ni zhing du smra ba rnams kyang bsgrub par bya/ /klu mo rnams ni bsgrub tsho pa byas nas bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu'i ro dang sman de rnams ni bsgrub par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams bsgrub /pa byas nas mchog tu 'jigs par 7byed pa'i lha min rnams kyang bsgrub par bya/ 232 /klu la sogs rnams bsgrub / pa byas nas rab mchog lha dang mi rnams rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub par bya/ /du ba la sogs bsgrub pa byas nas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa —byed pa'i dbu ma dag ni bsgrub par bya/ /srog la sogs rnams bsgrub pas byas nas ri bong 'dzin pa zhu ba'i thig le rnams ni bsgrub par bya/ /dam pa'i bde ba bsgrubs nas lhan cig skyes pa rgyal ba'i sku ni kun tu 'gro ba bsgrub par bya/ 233 /sems can rnams la 'chi ster gang de grub pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mtha' dag bdud rtsi ste/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gang zhig bgrod bya min pa de yang srid gsum gnas su bsam gtan bgrod bya'o/ /ye shes gang zhig rnyed dka' dag kyang rdo rje padmar bde bas byin brlabs larnyed pa sla ba nyid/ /77—303
