de lta de ltar rdo rje can te srog chags rnams la thams cad dus su bde mnyam ster gyur cig 234 /sgra gcan me dang zla ba nyi ma bzhi por brjod de rdzis chu bsreg za rlung dang stong pa gang / /lnga po dag go migaza' yi tshogs pa cig shos dag ni drug po lhun po 0'di yi phyogs rnams su/ /gling rnams dag ni bzhi por rab tu 'gyur te yul rnams dag ni lnga por phyi rol dag tu gsungasari / /snying stobs la sogs yon tan rnams ni gsum po gzhan pa 'di'o lus kyi dbus su de bzhin nyid/ 235 /padmar rnam shes dga' ba khrag dang bdud rtsi ( rizhes pa dang por bzhi ngo dag go de las ni/ /gang zhig rus pa la sogs mtha' dag /rnams kyang lnga po de nas mig la sogs pa drug po ste/ /lag pa rkang pa dag ni bzhi po lag pa rkang pa la gnas sor mo rnams ni lnga po'o/ /de rnams tshigs ni gsum ngo gang zhig 'dir ni rim pa mtha' dag rigs 'di la ni rig par bya/ 236 /sa 'dzin de nyid rab dzodabye rnams dang ro yis bsgyur ba'i ro dang nyi ma nyi shu zhes pa dang / /dbye ba drug cu mi rnams dag gi mtha' dag lus la gnas pa bug pa drug dang zla ba'i grangs/ /de dag thams cad bsdus pa sum 'gyur dgu ru 'gyur te lnga bcu rtsa bzhi srog gi rgyu ba dang / /gza' rnams dag gi rgyu ba gang de slar yang cig 2shos rnams kyis rnal 'byor ma yi rgyu bar brjod / 237 /ye shes nam mkha' gnyis dang slar yang gzhan pa 'di ni theg pa dag dang dkon mchog gsum po yang / /nyon mongs bdud dang gnas rnams dang ni slar yang nges par rdzu 'phrul rkang pa zag pa rnams dag dang 7/ /mi 'jigs pa dang bden pa rnams dang slar yang de bzhin dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yang dag par/ /bsdu ba bzhi yi mtha' rnams rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rdo rje 77—304

rnams kyis ①rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ 238 /mngon shes lnga dang stobs dang lta ba rnams dang rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag po dag gi spyan lnga dang / /de bzhin sung po dbang po dran pa zhes pa drug dang byang chub yan lag bdun dang mchod pa ni/ /bdun te lam gyi yan lag brgyad rnams so sor legs 'jug gzugs can rnam par thar pa brgyad rnams dang / /bug pa zhes bya yan lag dgu ni gsung rab mchog ste sa rnams dag ni phyogs kyi tshad yin no/ 239 /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyogs kyi stobs dang gsal bar dbang bcu dang ni yan lag bcu gnyis rten 'brel dag /skye ba dang ni 'gog pa dag go de bzhin nyis 'gyur dgu ni ma 'dres pa yi sangs rgyas chos/ /rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag po'i mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dag dang dpe byad rnams kyang brgyad cu ste/ /khyab bdag mchog gi go 'phang ca'adi dag mtha' dag sngags pa yis ni lus la bsgom par bya ba yin / 240 /zla ba'i rang bzhin gcig ste zung dang lag pa mig dang 'khrig pa phyogs dang bgrod pa dag ni gnyis/ /'jig rten dus dang yon tan me ni gsum mo chu gter dus dang rig byed dag ni bzhi ru brjod / /mda' dang 'byung ba dbang po rnams ni nges par lnga ru rab tu 'gyur te ro dang dus ni drug /gza' dang ri bo thub pa zhes pa bdun gyi grangs te de bzhin klu dang nor ni brgyad yin no/ 241 /rtsa dang bug pa gza' dang gter yang dgu ste phyogs ni bcu dang dbang phyug dag ni bcu gcig go/ /nyi ma lus med ma nu srid pa gang dang tshes dang mi bdag bcu gnyis nas ni re re 'phel /nyes pa 'di dag bcu brgyad yin te rgyal ba mchog ni ma lus de rnams nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de nyid ces grags nyi shu rtsa lnga yin te gnyis skyes ces 77—305

pa sum cu rtsa gnyis nyid du 'gyur/ 242 /rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad dag tu nges par rdo rje'i tshigs ni rdo rje can gyis sbas pa ste/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas su ni srog chags rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du ma lus pa yang mngon sum gsungs//de phyir 'jig rten 'jig rten ri'adas pa dag las mtha' dag ma tshang med pa'i rgyu cini bla ma ste/ /dpal ldan rgyud ni dang po'i sangs rgyas mtha' dag rgyal ba'i bdag po'i mngon par brjod pa zla ba bzang / 243 /gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'ji dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang / /reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ /sa bon dang ni gsal ba'i dus med mtha' dag srid par sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ /mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnam bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ 244 /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje /skyes bu dpe zla 7med cing thams cad du ci 'gro spros pa med/ / brtsegs pa la gnas rna ba sna dang kha dang mig dang mgo ste thams cad nas ni phyag dang zhabs / /'byung ba'i mtha' ste 'byung po'i mgon po srid pa gsum po mchog pa'adzin rgyu rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gi bgrod bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dzodus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ 245 /spro byed nus pa'i ngo bo glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/ /ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang tshobagrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/ /bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i sngo'ajigs pa 77—306

'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ 246 /sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te / /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi bzad /rnams la mi bzad pa/ /gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de yi 'bras bu de skyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum skyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo / 247 /gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam mnyam pa g.yas dang ri rigayon dang mdun dang rgyab / /steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi tshogazugs te thung ngu ring po dang / /shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'ang skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun gyi rten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de 7khyod la 'dud/ 248 /gang zhig mi yi 'jig rten dag na dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sdig bral de bdag ste/ /de la gnod pa byas pas srog chags rnams ni nges par dmyal bar 'gyur te 'di la ngo mtshar med/ /de mnyes pa yis bdag ni mgu ste de la khro ba'i me yis 2khros pa zhes pa chen po'o/ /de nyid sems can rnams la thar pa bde mnyam 'bras ster bu rnams dag gi phyag 'os mchod 'os so/ 249 /sdig can gang yin gang zhig dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad bzang po dag —la dus gsum phyag mi byedapa/ /mi shes gang yin —gang zhig rnam mang me tog rnams kyis dus gsum du ni maṇḍal mi byed tshopa ci/ /myur du mnar med 'gro ba gang yin gang zhig bde mnyam ster byed bla ma skyo ba skyed pa po / /shes rab ye shes thob pa gang yin ma nyams gang zhig mchog gi 77— 307

bla ma'i zhabs ni mi spong ba / 250 /nyams pa gang yin (migang zhig rtsa gsum dag la gnas pa'i rlung ni mtha' yas dus su bsad pa'o/ /dpa' bo gang yin gang zhig mnyam dang mi mnyam lam la srog dang zur sol rlung ni gsod byed pa'o/ /sbyin bdag gang yin gang zhig dpal ldan bla mar rang lus bu dang chung ma la sogs thams cad ster / /ma rabs gang yin gang zhig slu byed rang gi rusnying gi rig pas drangs pa'i sems dang g.yo sgyu can( sku/ 251 /dpal ldan dpal gyi chos kyi 'khor lo lha yi mchog gis bcud pa'i gdan ni kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /de la sangs rgyas lha dang mi yi bla ma nye bar bzhugs pas zla ba'i zhu ba rtogs pa na/ //sems can don gyi slad 7du mi yi skyabadag po rgyud kyi rgyal po dang po'i sangs rgyas skagasungs pa gang / /de yang da lta bdag gis de rnams rmu.ā li kā li lanyung ngu'i rgyud du tshabakod do nyi ma kye/ 252 /sangs rgyas kyis ni gsungs pa dag las dus kyi 'khor lo bdag gis phreng 'dzin sdeb sbyor bcings pas —brjod/ /—padma dkar po rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis 'di ni stusngags pa rnams la bstan pa nyid du mdzod/ / ji ltar 7nyi ma dang bcas bub pa'i rigs rnani shes rab ye shes thob pa 'di las byung gyur pa / /lornam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni chodus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las de bzhin 'gyur bar shog 253 / nyi ma khyod dam mi dbang phyi mar gyur pa'i srid par 0dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor gcig nyalas ni/ /〉tshangs pa'i rigs 'di las skyes mi yi bdag po 4grags pa bdag ni 'jam dbyangs snye bdag gi dga' ma ni/ /dpal ldan sgrol ma 7pad dkar can ni yon tan kun ster — 'jig rten mgon po chu skyes mtshan ma can/ /utpal sdong bu yis ni rang gzhan 77—308

la gnas srid pa thams cad don ni ji lta bzhin du stos/ 254 /utpal sdong bu yis ni rang gzhan /ril gnas srid pa thams cad don ni ji lta bzhin mthong nas / /thub pa'i dbang po rnams dang lhan cig nyi mas cod pan bcas pa'i mgo dang lag pa dag gis ni/ /rigs ldan zhabs kyi padmar phyag dag 'tshal nas 0smras pa ston pa gcig pu mchog gi thugs rje yis/ /thub pa'i rigs ni 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dag las phyung nas ye shes lam la gzhag par mdzod / 255 /khyod ni rgan yang gzhon nu mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras po yin yang thog mar dang po'i sangs rgyas khyod/ /bud med sbyor zhing tshangs par spyod ldan mchog gi zugs rje dag gis 'jig rten gnyen te gshin rje'i dgra//khyod ni zhi yang rdo rje bzang po 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa khyod ni rtag tu bdud kyi bdud/ /khyod ni grol yang srid pa 'dir ni 'gro ba smin pa'i don du grags pa khyod ni rab tu 'jug 256 /tshangs pa'i rigs las nyi ma bdag ni thub pa'i rigs kyis btud par gyur pa zhabs kyi rtsa bar lhung / /sems can rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du dus kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag sa la rab tu gsal bar byas / /rigs ldan rigs la khyod ni nyi ma sa bdag gis btud dpal ldan grags pa dpal ldan ka lā par/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi padma dag la 'jigs rung 'khor bas 'jigs pa dag tshoni skyabs su lhag par mchi/ 257 /sa ga'i zla ba'i nya la mtshan mo'i dus ni 'das shing nyin par rab tu ma zhugs pa dag la/ /thub pa'i skye bo dang bcas nyi ma sna tshogs gtso bos byin gyis brlabs pas phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob/ /sems can rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du bdag gi thugs kyi rdo rje mtha' dag sa la gnas pa bzhinang/ /7dus kyi 'khor lo'i 77—309

mthu las sems can nyid rnams dag gi mernam gsum srid pa dag la gnas zhi gyur cig 258 /sems can kun don mdzad ri pa po yis mchog gi pyithugs rje dag gis rgyud kyi don ni bstan mdzad nas/ /sras po padma dkar po rab mchog yon tan dag gi gter la gnang ji ba stsal ba nges par ni/ /dang por khyod kyis rgyud kyi rgyal po mtha' dag ma tshang med pa glegs bam dag la gnas pa zhu 3dang — /de nas rang gi 'dod pas )'grel bshad tsho byas nas gzhan gyi gnas su bgrod par bya'o 'jig rten gnyen/ 259 / gang dag 7steng na 'obadud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed byang chub sems dpa' rnams /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas pa rnams / / gang dag mas 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po lagadon tshogs mi dge thams cad dus su 'ching byed pa/ /de dag 2thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig 260 /rgyud ni dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo shin tu bsdus tshi pa ma lus rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /thabs dang shes rab gcig sbyor rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rdo rje dag gis de nyid rnam pa bcu drug pa/ /sems can rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba'i bdag pos gsungs shing bdag gis kyang ni bstan pa gang / /bsod nams de yis sems can thams cad 'gyur med mchog gi bde bar gyur cig rnade la 'dud gyur cig 261 /dang po'i sangs rgyas /nga grakā bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las ye shes kyi le'u lnga /chowa// gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las rgyung rtsob/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus 77—310

snying po zhes bya ba/①༄ga / rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra ta(sta ra tant+ra : da ya nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar chichos dbyings dkyil 'khor dri med sku la 0'jam dpal gyis ni dge dang mi dge bas/ /sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs pa dag lha rnams dang ni cadamyal ba nyid ces gang thos pa/ /rgyal mchog pho brang sha rilar grags ka lā tshopa ru ngag gi dbang phyug seng ge yi/ /gdan la 7bzhugs nas / rgyal pos rgyud kyi rgyal po slar yang thub pa rnams la gsal bar bstan/ /byung gyur zhes masogs bden te lha mchog bla ma khyab 'jug lha yi mdabang po dang / /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan me lha sa stengs ngalha yul nam mkha' skubasod nams sdig las byung tsha/ /mi rnams pha rol srid par yi dgas tshadamyal ba gang zhig bkag pa sha yi dam tshig can/ /rig byed pa dang 77—361

thod pa can gyi rgyud kyi sdig pa'i bya ba de ni brdzun ཿpa ste/ /gang du gcan chen bdun la risogs pa ridage dang mi dge'i dbang gis bram ze rnams kyang der/ /skyes la sngar gyi lus po spangs canas lus gzhan sar pa nges par 'dzin par 'gyur ba ni / /thub pa shed bu'i tshig las srog chags rnams kyi gsod byed za ba'i mthar thug brgyad du 'gyur/ /sha zos pa las bram ze rnams kyang lha las sa stengs 'dir lhung de ni bden pa ste/ /bzang po tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug rnams kyi rig 9byed zhi chos lakhyab 'jug ches bla ma/ /sha yi kha zas bkag la sha yi dam tshig can la rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor 7rgyud/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bcu 5lnga sogs par bde gshegs dam tshig can la sangs rgyas byang chub ni/ /sangs rgyas pa yis kun nas sha mi bza' zhing bdag gi ba yis skubasrung mi bya/ /srog 5chags rnams la srog chags 'du shes gsod tshapa'i yid kyis nye bar brtsams pas 'dir nyams pa/ /yan lag lnga yis srog gcod 'gyur gyi nam mkha' tsam ni srog chags rnams kyi byed po min/ /srog gcod lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rgyu rnams gsum gyis 'grub —la de la longs spyod cing — /skyed byed bdag nyid sems kyi rgyal po srog chags rnams ni las longs spyod pas 'jig par 'gyur/ /seng ge sbrul dang ne le 5stag dang bya rog skye gnas yan lag lnga yis srog gcod 'gyur/ /rgyal po dang ni skye dgu 4rnams ni byed dam byed du 'jug dang yi rang gsum gyis 'gyur/ /dge slong snying rje med pas rtse la sha yi ro myong ro la rjes su tshol byed cing / /bdag nyid gsod pa la 5sogs skyon gyis dge slong rnams dang dge tshul yang ni dmyal bar 'gro/ /dge slong nad pa la ni sman pas sha bstan na yang bya khra rnams kyis gsad cipa 77—362

dang /pha yi ched du bsad dang mchod sbyin thog dang me dang chu dang ma zhu'i skyon gyis shi ba rnams/ /sbyor ba 'di rnams med par gyur na gang du de tshe bza' bar bya bar /gsungs pa rnams/ /dge slong rnams la sha gang de ni stobs bcu ldan pas nad 'joms phyir yin 'chi bslur min/ /sha la risogs pa zos na nges par sa yi 'og tu lus chen rnams su sdug bsngal ci'agyur/ /srog chags yi dgas la sogs skye gnas dka' thub khyim pa rgyal po nges par rang khyim du/ /gzhan gyi khyim dang chung ma longs spyod dang ni bu mo gnyen 'dun tshogs dang rang khyim rnams/ /shi ba rnams kyi lus ni gang yin chung ma bu dang bu mo gnyen 'dun tshogs ni gang / /'dir ni rdo la gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya nyid ni rnam par blta/ /tho por shes pa yod la rang gzhan rnam pa /bral ba nyid las 0rdo ba'i 7tho 5yor phung por 'gyur/ /sa steng gnas su srog chags rnams kyi rig pa nyams pa'i lus la'ang yod pa nyid/ /srog chags rnams kyi srog rgyu ba ni rang gzhan rnam par bral bar 6legs par sad las shes/ /sha 5la yi nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs phung 9po khams dang dbang po 'gro ba rnams/ /'gro ba'i gzugs kyi khams la cisogs pa sung tshopo thams cad rdul phran rnams kyi rnam 'gyur te/ /longs spyod byed pa rnam par rig pa tsam ste rang gzhan bral zhing rtog med de rnams kyis/ /longs spyod byed min srog chags rnams kyi snang byed gang gis mun pa bral nas sad par 'gyur / /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dus kyi 5me dang mun pa gcig tu casnang bar byed pa yang / /sa sogs dri sogs mig la sogs cadang gzhu dang char pa glog dang rlung sogs 4drug pa gnyis/ /de ni lus la sung po drug dang yul dang yul can de yi bya ba drug pa gnyis/ /de 77—363

rnams longs spyod byed pa /)srog chags phung po gnyid log gyur 'dir snang byed (mikyis mibaslang ba/ /phyi yi bdag dang nang gi bdag dang gsum pa mchog gi bdag rnams bzhi pa las rab byung / /sprul sku longs sku dang ni de bzhin chos kyi sku rnams bzhi po las ni rab tu byung / /khong stong min zhing gcig pu mchog gyur 'byung ba las gyur tsam gyi cigasum sogs gethim par gyi'agyur/ /de bzhi ri gsum la sogs pa gcig pu mchog gyur chos kyi dbyings su nges par thim par 'gyur / /phung po khams dang dbang po'i yan lag skye mched mun pa snag po snang ba 'od kyi mdog /rnam par shes pa srog gi de nyid srid gsum 'gro bar rtogs 5pa'i mtha' yas byang chub chos/ /dri rnams nam mkha'i me tog bzhin du yod min mkha' tsam rdul phran chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ /gang phyir 'gro ba 'di rnams bdag dang gsum la sogs pa sangs rgyas sku gsum la sogs 7pa/ /yan lag dang nas nyon mongs ma rig par 'gyur slar yang len pa dang ni srid 7pa yang —/ /las ni 'du byed srid par 'gyur la 'dir ni gsum po zung bcas rgyu chos sdug bsngal ni/ /rnam shes la tshosogs rnam pa lngar 'gyur de bzhin bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa yang yin/ /gsum las zung la zung las dpag tu med pa'i srid par chos bdun 'bras bu'i yan lag rnams/ /shing las me tog me tog las kyang 'bras bzhin gang zhig 'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa las las de las sdug bsngal sdug bsngal de las nyon mongs mtha' yas 'khor lo ma lus rgyu las byung / /chos rnams 'gag pa med pa nam mkha' tsam las 'byung ba'ang med pa nyid pas mde yi phyir/ /srog chags srog gi rdul phran phung por bcas shing 'gro ba gzhan du rtag min mi rtag min/ /sbyin pa la sogs gang zhig dge 77—364

bcur ldan pa stong ༅zhing byang chub phyogs kyi stong pa nyid/ /gang zhig de dag byed pa por 'gyur rgyal mchog sras bcas srog chags rnams kyi bdud kyi ris/ /de las phung po rnams las de las slar yang srid gzhan 'pho min sung po'i mtshams sbyor ni/ /mar me kha ton /rgya dang dri med chu dang sgra dang nyi ma chu shel sa bon par / /gang du rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku dkar po'i chos kyi tshogs las byung ngo zhes bya 0bden/ /chos las longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa ma lus sgra yi tshogs rnams te/ /phung po sprul pa'i sku la mchog tu 'gyur med bde ba chos sku min zhing de yi phyir/ /gang zhig sku yi mtshan nyid 'dir ni sangs rgyas pa yi slob dpon klu yis gang gsungs pa/ /gang zhig gcig min du ma min la ri bdag gzhan la phan phun tshogs chen po'i rten gyur pa/ /dngos min ri byedangos po med min nam mkha' bzhin du ro mnyam rnam par dpyad dka'i rang bzhin nyid/ /gos med rnam par 'gyur med zhi ba mtshungs pa med pa mnyam zhing khyab la rjos pa med/ /dpe med so so rang gis rig bya rgyal ba rnams kyi chos kyi sku la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig 'jig rten las 'das bsam mi khyab pa legs spyad tsho'abras bu bdag nyid phun sum tshogs/ /blo ldan chen por gyur pa mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs gsung mdzad cing / /'jig rten kun la khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad ba rgya che'i dam chos sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku chos kyi rgyal po chen por gnas pa de la 'dir ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig sems can rnams kyi nga na pa'i rgyur gyur la lar 7me bzhin gsal bar snang ba dang / /slar yang la lar mngon par byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu zhi ba gang mthong ba/ /rnam pa du 77—365

mar 'gro ba'i gzugs kyi thabs kyis 'jug cing srid pa gsum gyi 'jigs pa 'joms /phyogs bcu'i rjes su 'jug pa don chen thub pa rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam par gyur pa dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /dag cing zhi la rnam dben mchog tu zhi la rang bzhin rnal 'byor nyid kyis rtogs bya ba/ /rtogs dka' brtag par dka' la zhi ba mi mnyam mnyam par khyab cing mtshan ma med pa nyid/ /mi mnyam ribade ba rnam par mi rtog sku gcig rgyal ba rnams kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mtha' yas rdul phran yon tan las byung ma lus 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /zla ba nyi ma la sogs skye gnas lha yul sa stengs nam mkha' rdo rje btsun mo'i mthar/ /bud med skye gnas chos kyi dbyings su bde 'gro ngan 'gro dus kun du ni rnam par bzhugs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas srog chags phung po yul gyi yon tan ldan pa bsod nams sdig pa'i mthus/ /khu ba khrag dag rig ma'i bha ga'i padmar chud cing srog gi rlung dang rtsol ba'i rlung / /de ni ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can du 'gyur ba'i skyes bu rig ma yang dag ldan/ /yul gyi yon tan las byung de longs spyod pa'i gzugs sku ma yin khams la rab brten pa /skyes pa bud med ma ning lha klu khyab 'jug rgyal ba thub pa rang las mthu las byung / /gang gi de nyid de nyid lnga dang rigs gsum go 'phang yang ni gcig tu gsang ba yi/ /zhal brgya rig 'dzin dbang po zla ba sa sogs /yul dang yul can bdag po chos kyi dbyings/ /zhal brgya pa de rgyu las gnyis skyes lag pa rkang pa'i yan lag sor mo'i tshigs rnams la/ /de las —tshor ba gsum la tresogs pa nub par 'gyur ba sgra bzhin myur du 'gro bar 'gyur/ ske /gang zhig lnga 77—366

dang gsum las yul dang yul can dri dang lus la /sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sa la risogs pa lnga dang zla ba nyi ma mun pa rnams kyis khams rnams rgyas btab des — /gcig gi du ma'i khams las gnyis skyes lag pa rkang pa'i sor mo'i tshogs rnams gang zhig du/ /thams cad zla ba'i rgyu las mchog gi rigs brgya rgyas btab skyes pa dang ni bud med dag /rten gyi 'byung ba'i tshogs ni rang bzhin yon tan yang ni 'jig med rdul gyi phung po ste/ /srog gi rgyu ni dbyangs yig la gsogs rang bzhin yang ni 'jig pa med pa'i srog gi khams/ /khu ba'i rten ni zla ba nyi ma yang ni rdul tshoyin las lani srog chags phung po yi/ /de yi thabs kyis sad par byas pas bsod nams sdig pa'i mthu las 'bras bu sa gzhan du/ /rang gi las kyi sung po lngar longs spyod cing slar yang gzhan du'ang slar yang sogs ngapar byed/ /de yi dkar po'i bsam gtan bstod pa nges pa brgya yi skulas kyi sung po zad pa min/ /gcer bu pa ngani las kyi phung po rnam par 'jig pa'agyur sreg byed me ni 'ba' zhig gis/ /dkar po'i bsam gtan dgra bcom sngags dang bstod pa nges pa brgya phrag sems dang lalus ngag las /padma khyab byed snying po ze —'bru'i dbang phyug dgra bcom thig le bzang po sgom par byed/ /de dbus lus po sbas pa rtse rtemo brgya phrag 'bar ba kun nas gsal bar byed pa can/ /lha rnams gsang ba'i mdzod gyur mchog gi go 'phang 'di ni brgya byin rgyal po mchod 'os pa/ / yon tan tsho'adi ni sreg blugs 0za bas ma lus las kyi sung po sreg par 'gyur bar mthong / /gang zhig gnod pa'i bsam gtan la zhugs gyur pas nyin dang mtshan du de yi sdig 'phel 'gyur//gang zhig gnod pa'i bsam gtan las ldog gyur pas nyin dang mtshan du de yi 77—367

sdig nyams 'gyur/ /gang zhig drag po'i bsam gtan la zhugs gyur pas nyin dang mtshan du de yi sdig pa 'phel/ /gang zhig drag po'i /bsam gtan las ldog gyur pas nyin dang mtshan du de yi sdig pa nyams / /gang zhig chos kyi bsam gtan la zhugs gyur pas nyin dang mtshan du de yi sdig pa nyams/ /gang zhig chos kyi bsam gtan las ldog gyur pas nyid dang mtshan du de yi sdig pa 'phel/ /gang zhig dkar po'i bsam gtan la zhugs gyur pas nyin dang mtshan du de yi sdig pa nyams/ /gang zhig dkar po'i bsam gtan las ldog gyur pa sa nyin dang mtshan du de yi sdig pa 'phel/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan du 'tshe ba la zhugs gyur pa de rnams sdig pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyin dang mtshan du 'tshe ba ldog par gyur pa de rnams kyi ni bsod nams 'phel de bzhin sha dang chang dang gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa dang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rnams dang nges par khro ba nga rgyal 'dod pa rnams kyis 'gyur/ /gang zhig sbyin pa la zhugs gyur pas nyid dang mtshan du de yi bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig sbyin pa las ldog gyur pas nyid dang mtshan du de yi rig pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa nyin dang mtshan du 'gyur la rdo rje'i brtson 'grus de bzhin du/ /shes rab thabs dang smon lam stobs kyi sbyor bar ldan zhing stong nyid ye shes rdo rje rnams /dngos dang dngos med byed po bsgribs dang nam mkha' 'phrog par byed pa dang ni mchog gi bdag /nam mkha' med na byed po gnas min 'dir ni gang zhig stong nyid tshosmra ba rnams kyi tshig /sems can rnams kyi byed por ma byas bsod nams sdig pa dus rnams kun tu rnam par 'phel/ /rgyal ba stobs 77—368

bcu ldan pa ye shes can dang lha rnams longs ma spyad par 'jig pa min/ /so sor sdud la 3 sogs pa drug po stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pas stong nyid bsgom par gsungs/ /mtshan mo du ba la sogs sbyor bas slar yang nyin mo nam mkha' mar me cil sogs pas/ /so sor sdud pas rnal 'byor pa yis dus gsum dngos po nam mkha'i dkyil du son par mthong / /bsam gtan gyis kyang de la shin tu sems brtan byas pas phyi rol dngos po rnam par spong / /srog rtsol gyis ni srog gi rlung dag nyi zla'i rgyu ba bral nas mun par rgyu bar byed/ /dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug bral zhing slar yang 'dzin pa'i yan lag gis ni thig le 'dzin par byed/ /rjes su dran pas rang gi gzugs las zla ba bzhin du nam mkha' dzi'od mang 'phro bar byed/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis khu ba rdo rje nas brtsams mgo bo dri med bde bas rab gang 'gyur/ /nam mkhar bltas pas gti mug rnam par 'jig par 'gyur te sna tshogs /stong pa nyid mthong bas/ /dang gi bdag nyid bltas pas 'dod chags 'jig par 'gyur te srog gi rlung dag bkag pas so/ /yan lag med par —bltas pas zhe sdang 'jig par 'gyur te khu ba dri med bde ba yis/ /sna rtser bltas pas nga rgyal 'jig par 'gyur te gzhom du med pa tshangs pa'i gsung palas so/ /srog dang rtsol ba bkag pas sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dri ma bral ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag pa/ /gsang ba lte ba snying ga skemagrin pa mgo bo rdo rje rnams su rim bzhin sa zung re/ /khu ba gyen du song zhing khrag kyang 'og tu 'gro la tshangs dbyangs gzhom du med pa las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dri ma cigasum dang skabral ba gang gis ston pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /khyi la lasogs pa'i sha yi mig dang rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lha la —77—369

sogs pa'i lha yi spyan/ /rang rgyal nyan thos dag gis gzhan gyi sems rtogs shes pa sangs rgyas spyan te gsum pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dri ma bral ba rnam medag bzhi pa shes rab spyan du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thams cad gzigs pa dri ma gsum dang bral ba lnga pa ye shes spyan/ / rgyu mthun ridaga' ba khu ba rdo rje yang ste de 'dzin pas na nges par rdo rje 'dzin / /lus kyi sa bon khu ba 'pho ciste 'khor lo 'dzin pa lte ba'i 'khor lo'i bde ba gang / /mtshon bya de nyid mtshon bzhin pa yi snying ga sgra bcas bde ba mgon po 'khor ba 'jig /gang gis mgrin par de rig g.yo med bde ba 'dzin pa de ni tshor byed rin chen 'dzin/ /gang gis mgo bor zla ba 'dzin pa 'di ni khu ba dri bral bde ba shes rab 'dzin/ /gtsug tor tshangs pa'i bu gar 'gyur med mchog gi bde ba dga' ba bcu drug rab gang ba/ /gang gis shes rab rang bzhin med pa mchog gi zla ba cha shas bcu drug rdzogs pa'i mtha'/ /de ni dpag med gang gis rig pa mgo bor rdo rje dang bcas drug pa rdo rje sems/ /snang ba ye shes khams su 'gyur te gang zhig spyi por 'gyur med rdo rje skyes bu la/ /dri bral sa yi thig le mgo bo'i skyes bu de ni chu dang nyi ma 'grib pa /yang / /sgra gcan me dang rnam smin snying ga 4sgra bcas bde ba rlung dang lte ba mjug tsho rings te / /gsang ba'i 'khor lor mun can bcom pa'i bde ba stong pa can ni skustong pa mun pa'i khams /gang zhig mig chil pasogs pa yul can drug po lha mo rnams las sa snying la —sogs gang / /gzugs kyi 7phung po la risogs gang zhig yul drug rnams kyang lha ru brtags tshopa de rnams kyis / /dag pa'i dbang po la sogs yul can drug po gang zhig gnod samadzes rgyal po la sogs pa / /de rnams khu 77— 370

ba mi 'pho la /sogs yul drug rnams kyang sngon po la risogs de rnams so/ /gang zhig khro bo gshin rje gshed ni zla ba dang bcas srog —rlung rab tu bcom gyur pa / /nyi ma dang bcas srog rlung rab tu bcom 'gyur gang zhig khro bo padma mthar byed do/ /sgra gcan dang bcas srog rlung rab tu bcom pas gang zhig khro bo bgegs mthar byed pa ste/ /mjug rings dang bcas srog rlung nges par bcom pa gang zhig khro bo shes rab mthar byed do/ /srog rlung 'gags pas phyag gnyis dgyes rdor zhi ba 'dir ni nga rgyal 'joms pa rdo rje sems / /srog rlung bkag pas phyag bzhi pa yi dgyes rdor byin za zhe snang 'joms pa /byang chub sems / /dgyes pa'i rdo rje 'dod chags 'joms pa zhal gsum phyag drug dbang phyug sems dpa' chen por 'gyur/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi gti mug 'joms pa tshangs pa bde ba dang bcas dam tshig sems/ /lte bar srog rlung bkag pas madri ma gsum bral rdo rje sems dpa' de ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /snying gar skabakag pa 〉dri ma gsum bral byang chub sems dpa' rang rgyal de ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /mgrin par nyi ma de bzhin 5dri ma gsum bral sems dpa' chen po nyan thos nyid du 'gyur/ /dpral bar —rlung gi dbang po 'gags pas bde ba dang bcas dam tshig sems dpa' ston pa'i sras/ /lte ba'i 'khor lor mi 'gyur mchog gi bde ba gang zhig khro bo'i dbang po'i rtsa bzhi dang / /sum cu —rtsa gnyis dang ldan ro la ro yis bsgyur ba gang zhig bde mchog 'khor lo gsum/ /lag pa rkang pa'i rus pa'i dum bu brgyad dang lag mthil sor tshigs dum bu rnams/ /'khor lo drug gi rtsa rnams 'dir ni nyis 'gyur bde mchog chen po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la/ /gtsug tor rtsa bzhi rnams su 'pho ba rnam par bral dang de bzhin 77—371

chos kyi 'khor lo brgyad/ /mgrin pa ri sum cu ri rtsa gnyis rnams su 'gyur te drug cu rtsa bzhi lte ba'i 'khor lo ru/ /gang zhig zla ba'i cha yis gang ba mgo bo dkar po de gyi'adir gsang bar dkar po'i cha/ /'khor lo'i rtsa rnams yang ni mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba dus kyi 'khor lo lhag pa'i lha/ /dus ni drug cus lhag dang bcas pa'i brgya phrag gsum ste tshigs mtshams rnams kyang rdo rje'i sku/ /rgyu skar rnams kyi dbyu tshog nam mkha' lag pa rgyal po de yang dang po'i sangs rgyas gsungs / /zla ba'i cha shas sum cu nam mkha' nam mkha' gdengs can zla ba'i rtsa ni zla bzang ngo tsho/ /rtsa dang ba spu gang zhig ma lus lus la gnas pa rdo rje myu gu'i ming can te/ /rdo rje chu dang bshang ba khrag rnams lus kyi stong pa nyid kyis rtse yis bldag 5par 'gyur/ /byams pa'i tshems kyis gdong dang lag pa rkang pa'i sha rnams zos pas des na drag po la/ /mngon shes lnga yi zhal chen yul gyi phyugs kyi tshogs rnams zos pas des na seng ge ste/ /bsod nams ye shes tshul khrims dam pa dri ma gsum bral dus kyi 'khor lo spyan gsum pa/ /dpal ldan 'dus par sku rnams gang zhig yul dang yul can srog chags las kyi mthu las byung / /der ni 'ga' zhig khams rnams de dag lha ru rtag tu bdud kyi ris la gsal bar mdzad/ /rtsa dang sha dang rus pa khu ba khrag rnams rdul phran 'dus pas lha rnams kyi ni gnas/ /srog chags so so chasangs rgyas lha yul bar snang sa steng cirang rang gnas su gtso bor laganas/ /mdor byas brdzun gyi —rim pas 'gyur la yul dang yul can sgrub byed rdo rje'i ji bzlas pa yin/ /rang byin brlabs pas srog rlung ri bong can du bzhi pa 'dir ni mngon par byang chub 'dod / /'dir ni lnga pa zung 'jug rim pa mchog tu gyur pa dpal ldan gsang 77—372

ba 'dus par yang / /bdud rnams yang dag gzung 3phyir srid pa gsum gyi bla mas lha yi bskyed pa'i rim pa gsungs/ /gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' dge ba bcu yi lam dang sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs las skyes/ /skyes pa skye bar 'dod par 'gyur gyi yid tsam min la brtags snyepa ridang ni bdag kyang ngo / /bdud kyi tshig ci'adi dag ni rang gi yid la byed cing de 'dra'i khyab pa'i rang bzhin gyi / /bsam gtan rje bo 'ga' yang yod min lha yul sa stengs kyibasod nams tshul khrims rnam par dman/ /stobs bcu mchog dang ldan pas rdzogs pa'i lha dag chos kyi dbyings la yang dag gnas pa ste/ /bsten par bya yi lcags kyu rdo rje mda' gzhu dril bu ral gri zhags pas bsgrub pa yin ri/ /bkug cing 'dir ni bzhugs dang mchog tu 'jigs par gyur pa brdungs zhing lag pa bcing ba yi/ /bsam gtan 'dis ni dge ba rnam par ngabral dkunas bdud rnams shi nas ngan nga'agror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas pa yi lha rnams dri ma gsum dang bral zhing sems can kun gyi don mdzad pa/ /de ni shin tu dri zhim me tog dri dang spos dang mar me dang ni lha bshos dang / /gsang sngags bzlas dang bstod pa nges pa brgya yis bsten bya sgrub tshapa po la rab dgyes nas /sa 'og 'jig rten lha yul sa steng —bar snang rnams su grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa ster/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rtsa dag bkag cing nyid mtshan dus su srog gi gsang sngags gang zhig ni/ /zla ba gcig la nam mkha' mkha' /snyedang stong pa brang 'gro dus ro mun pa tshodabyer med bzlas/ /steng dang 'og gnyis 'dzin pas lam tshogasum bral bas srog rlung gang bas rlung dag khyer bzhin pas/ /grub par 'gyur te ri bong 'dzin pa lta bu nam mkha' 5'gro bas rig pa 'dzin pa ste //77—373

bsod nams don du byang chub sems dpa' thugs rjes rgyal srid chung ma bdag gi sha yang gtong / /ye shes don du dus gsum dngos po stong pa'i gzugs brnyan mi migayo dri bral blo byed cing / /tshul khrims don du khu ba rdo rje mgo bor khyer la mgo nas tshangs pa'i bu ga ru/ /bsod nams ye shes tshul khrims yang dag dri ma rnam par bral nas rdo rje sems dpar ri'agyur/ /shin tu skyon can skye bo gang zhig rgyal srid sems kyis ster ba len pas longs cimi spyod/ /yon tan ma lus ldan pa'i chung ma sems kyis byin yang gang zhig len pas longs spyod min / /sha dag sems kyis byin yang gang zhig sha yi dam tshig can gyis len pas longs spyod min/ / de yis byang chub sems dpa' gal te stobs bcu ldan pa de tshe cadaman rigs cis mi 'gyur/ /byams pas dka' thub tshomachog ni tho rangs dus su chang gi don du chang —'tshong tekhyim du 'gro/ /nyin byed 5dus su mchog gi thugs rjes mnya yi don du nya pa rnams kyi tshong 'dus rshasu/ /dgongs kyi dus su bud med la 'jug phyir du dga' bas bran mo rnams kyi khyim du 'gro/ /chang nya mabud med rnams kyis 7dri ma gsum bral a ba snye tī dmangs 7rigs cis ma yin/ /gang dag dngos po du mar gyur pa ser skya ba ni gcig pa nyid du dam 'cha' la/ /gang gi bsgrub bya med pa nyid la brtan g.yo'i 'gro ba yod pa nyid du dam 'cha' ba/ /gang tshe tshogatan tshigs bsgrub bya dang mtshungs gyur 5pa de tshe sgrub pa po yis bsgrub bya min/ /gal te bsgrub bya gzhan la gtan tshigs kyang gzhan gyur pa de tshe de yi dam bcas 4nyams/ /sgra rnams rtag par dam bcas canam mkha' lta bur byas pa'i lus med par grub de bzhin du/ /sgra rnams mi rtag dam bcas 0bum pa lta bur byas te shin tu rtsol bas byung ba'i 77—374

phyir / /nam mkha' las ni rtag par grub kyang khyod kyi kha las sgra rnams mi rtag nges par grub/ /gzugs dang reg bya dri dang ro yi yul rnams bzhin du lnga pa sgra yang cis ma yin/ /de ni gang gis thog mar rtogs pas sa steng cabar snang khams su sgra des slar yang ni/ /rna bas sgra rnams rab tu rtogs par 'gyur ba de ni sgra rnams rtag pa nyid yin lo / /gang gis thog mar don rtogs gyur pas sa steng bar snang khams su slar yang de tshul gyis/ /rna bas don rnams nges par rtogs par gyur pas de ci gzugs rnams rtag pa nyid yin nam/ /rtag pa gsal bya gcig pu tshoyon tan ma lus rang bzhin sgra zhig rna ba'i bug par gnas/ /mgrin pa nas brjod gsal byed sgra yi tshogs rnams slar yang rtag par gyur pa ma yin la/ /gang zhig brjod pa gcig gis nyan byed rna ba'i bug par sgra yi ku cor 'gyur min nam/ /rtag par mngon par gsal bya de ltar 'gyur gyi gzhan la ltos pas nus pa'ang min/ /dngos po'i byed po'i rgyu ni slar yang mun pa gsal bar byed pa gzhan na gnas pas ni/ /rtag par mngon par gsal bar byas pa gang zhig rgyu yis bskyed pa 'dir ni byas 5pa ste/ /byas pa dang ni gzhan pa gang dag chos mi mthun pas grub par nga'agyur ba nyid ma yin/ /chos mi mthun pa 5de phyir byas pa rnams ni yod par 'gyur la cig pashos de med do/ /gang zhig mngon par gsal bya'i rgyur gyur mngon par gsal byed de ni ci yis rgyu ma yin/ /mun par thim par gyur pa gang dag de yis mngon par gsal byas de yis —'bras bu cis ma yin/ /sgra dang don dag gal te gcig par gyur na de tshe don nyams pa ni sgra nyams 'gyur/ /spyi dang gsal ba tshode bzhin 'gyur te nam mkha' tsam dang gzhan pa nyid dang gcig pa nyid/ /stong pa sgra dang ldan par 77—375

gyur na de tshe 'jig rten gsum por rtag tu sna sgra med 'gyur/ /gang gis dam mkha' yod pa nyid na brtan dang g.yo ba'i 'gro ba des na med pa nyid/ /gal te nam mkha' dang ni 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi rgyu dag chos mi mthun las grub 'gyur rin /de yi rgyu las sgra dang sgra min dman par nges par sgrub pa ri ripo la nges par 'gyur /nam mkha' sa stengs dag tu gza' dang rgyu skar dag dang byol song dang ni mi rnams dang / /lha dang srin po rnams ri dang rang gi rigs kyi dam tshig can gyi yi dgas lha min klu/ /sngags kyi yi ge rnams kyi rang bzhin yon tan dbang las dbyibs dang kha dog rang bzhin gyi/ /don gcig du ma'i sgra yis kha cig tu yang don rnams mang po de ni sgra gcig gis/ /dngos med stong pa'i rgyu las brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po rgyu tsho las 7grub pas na/ /dpe ni nam mkha'i me tog dang ni sa dang shing dang me tog de der rang rang grub/ /mo gsham 7bu mo nam mkha' tsam las skyes pa nam mkhar 'gyur la bu ldan las skyes pa/ /bu ni 'gro ba ma lus par 'gyur shin tu phra ba'i rdul phran sung po'i sa bon las/ /sa dang chu dang me rnams lha yi de nyid khyad par rnams ni phyi dang tha dad min/ /gal te lhan cig rab tu 'jig par gyur na de tshe tha dad gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /sa dang chu dang me rnams lha yi de nyid gcig pa nyid du rab tu 'jig pa min/ /srog chags so so'i lus ni 'jig pa rnam par bral ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyi lha rnams te/ /sa dang chu dang byin za rlung dang nam mkha' sbyor bas gang zhig rnam lnga'i bdag nyid 7lus/ /lus can rnams la yon tan bral ba'i lha rnams rnam lnga der ni mthong min yod ces grags / /srog chags rnams ni sngon gyi lus po spangs nas slar yang lus gzhan bsam pas pa'adzin par 77—376

'gyur/ /gang zhig sa la /sogs pa'i lha rnams de yi sngon gyi lus po zhig pas rab 'jig 'gyur/ /srog chags gzugs gzhan glog gi phreng ba chen po bzhin du rab tu rgya chen gzugs can te/ /srin bor nas ni bar snang dag la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis 'gro/ /srog chags srog dang lhan cig bems mipo'i lus dang bral ba tshor ba la casogs rab ldan pa/ /srid pa sum cu gertsa gcig gyirnams su dge dang mi dge'i dbang gis gcig pu kho nar 'gro / /gcig min rnam pa lnga po yul dang bral ba dang gi bdag dang mchog gi bdag nyid ni/ /nam mkha' las 'das mi gsal min zhing mi gsal 'bras bu med min nus pa dman pa min/ /sems las 'dod pas rang bzhin skyes bu 'byung ba min zhing srog rlung med na sems med la/ /srog chags sems dang lhan cig bde 'gro ngan 'gro dag tu las kyi 'brel pas 'jug /phan tshun ltos phyir rig pa dang ni /bems 7po dag dang rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid dag dang / /phan tshun ltos phyir 7gang tshe 'byung ba'i tshogs rnams yongs su gyur par rab tu 'byung ba nas / /ther zug pa yang 'gyur ba nyid pas de tshe 'byung ba'i tshogs skurnams 'gyur bar nges pa —yin/ /thams cad 'gyur med rtag pa'i rang bzhin sku'agyur yang mgang zhig rtag pa nyid ni 'gyur ba med/ /ther zug pa dang zer zug dman pa'i skyes bu khyab bdag gis ni srid sgrub tshal bshad de/ /phan tshun ltos phyir rigs rtsi pa dang ni rigs dag 5kyang ni rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du 'gyur//phan tshun ltos phyir byas pa min dang byas pa dag kyang rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du 'gyur / /phan tshun stos phyir byas pa dag dang byas pa yang ni rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du 'gyur / /thams cad rnam par rig pa tsam ste sa dang chu dang me gyudang 77—377

rlung dang snanam mkha'i khams/ /gzugs dang reg bya dri dang sgra dang ri bcas pa'i bde ba rdul phran sung por gyur pa min/ /rnam par shes las 4'bras bu'i dngos po rang 'byung ba las min zhing med dang 'dren mas min/ /sa bon las ni myu gu la sogs bzhin du 'gyur gyi rang las min zhing rgyu med min/ /rkang dang rus pa chu ba sha dang khu khrag tshil bu pags pa rdul phran sung po min/ /rnam par rig pa tsam zhig spangs nas slar yang srid pa gzhan du rnam rig tsam zhig 'gro/ /der ni lus len slar yang srid pa gzhan du de yang tshonam rig tsam po —de nyid de/ /'dod chags gnyid log gyur na rang gzhan bral ba rnam rig tsam po rnam par nyams/ /gal te 'gro ba rnam 7rig tsam du gyur na 'dir ni don gzhan rnam par rig tsam du/ /de 'gyur gal te 'gro ba rnam 5rig tsam na de tshe gnyis med min te de gnyis phyir/ /gang zhig 'di yi ma rig glo 7bur ba ste lhan skyes gyur pa de ni rnam rig min/ /sngon du rnam rig ngarnam par dag pa palhan skyes bems 4po yang ni rig par rnam tshadag 'gyur/ /bems 5po ma lus rnam par rig pa tsam du 'gro bas sad pa'i tshe na rab tu rtogs pas grub/ /de yi rnam rig mi snang bar 'gyur yang na rang gnas tshangs pa dbang phyug la /tshosogs 'gyur/ /bye brag par gyur yang na ser skya'i 'dod par 'gyur te sa bon nang na myu gu sogs/ /gcig phyir 'bras bu yod par smra bar 'gyur te brgya la rtag pa cung zad yod ma yin/ /thog mar phra rab rdul gyi phung po 'gro ba'i cha med gang gi rdul phran nam mkha' la/ /phra rab rdul rnams 'dus pa'i 'gro ba las kyang 'gro ba 5srid pa rdul phran phung po min/ /rdul phran bral te nam mkhar gnas pa las gzhan 'gro ba rnams kyi rnam par 'jig pa min/ /gal te lus po 77—378

rdul phran phung por gyur pa /de tshe su yi lus po 'jig par 'gyur/ /'byung ba brtags pa med las gzhan du rdul phran bral min gang gi rdul phran de rdul kyang //sdud dang skyed pa bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil la gnas te rlung dang ldan dang mi ldan pas/ /phra rab rdul rnams cha shas drug la slar yang cha shas drug ste slar yang gang gi cha shas drug /de yi cha shas phra rab richa yis nam mkha'i cikhams 'di gang bar cis mi 'grub/ /dngul chu nor bu'i rdul phran cha bcas cha med tshad ma dag gis bsgrub byar gyur pa min/ /cha dang bcas na zangs ma 'bigs min rdo yang min la rdul phran sung po cha med min/ /dngul chus zangs ma reg cing gnyis skyes nor bus rdo ba lha yi ririn po cher 'gyur la/ /rnam par shes pa rnam rtog drug gis /nye bar nyams pa rdul phran phung po'i rnam 'gyur min/ /phyi rol sngon po'i gzugs ni dzogang zhig rdul phran phung por de yi tshad mas grub pa min / /rnam par shes pa'i bag chags dag las nam mkha'i dkyil du mi lam dang mtshungs mthong zhes grags / /gang phyir dmus malong mig med —yid kyis de ni mig dang ldan zhing ma yin de phyir min/ /mig gi rnam shes khams las mig dang bcas pas phyi rol gzugs las yin gyi bag chags min/ /gang zhig sgra rnams ma lus rna bas mthos pa de yang la'on pa rnams kyis thos ma yin / /sna nad snyebacas pas gang zhig dri yi rdul phran 'dus pa min zhing nad med pas de 'dzin / /rtse yi nad can ro mi myong la de nyid la yang nad med rtse yis myong bar byed / /rnam par shes pa skye mched bcu gnyis rnam par bral ba tshad mas bsgrub par bya ba min/ /rdul phran 'dus pa'i 'gro bas kyang ni 'gro ba mthong nas mi shes pa yis tshad ma yi / /drag po dang ni tshangs pa'ang seng ges kyang ni shes pa 77—379

rnam par rig pa tsam du byas/ /rdul phran rnams kyi bral ba mthong nas thim par 'gyur ram bsdus sam yang na 'gag /par 'gyur/ /skye ba med cing 'gag pa med la mang po 'dus sam 'dus pa min par rab tu byung / /'di ni thub pas nam mkha'i tshad ma byas la rgyal ba rnams kyi stong pa nyid kyi yang / /rang rgyal rnams dang nyan thos lha dang lha min klu dang bdag lta bu yi rgyal sras rnams/ /gza' dang rgyu skar rnams dang nam mkha' sa steng dag tu skyes pa bud med drang srong rnams/ /khro bo rnams dang srin po sha yi dam tshig can gyi stag gzig byol song dmyal ba rnams/ /gang zhig rnam par mi rtog dang ldan rang gzhan bral ba stong nyid dus gsum ngo bo nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad rdul phran gyis stong nam mkha'i dkyil ltar son pa'i rimi lam sgyu ma bzhin/ /gang zhig thams cad mkhyen pa gzigs pa dri ma gsum bral rnam par mi rtog de ma yin/ /gang gis de rtogs sems la dri med dri mar ldan pa mkhyen pa nyid ni sangs rgyas te/ /gang zhig sbyin pa la casogs lam dang dge bcu lam dang byang chub phyogs sogs chos rnams dang — /byams pa la sogs gnas dang rang bzhin bral ba stong pa la sogs rnam par thar pa dang / /tshul khrims la sogs phung po gang zhig yul dang bral ba'i rnam pa kun tu mi rtog pa/ /de rnams byed po gang zhig stobs bcu'i stobs ldan nyan thos rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' min/ /gang zhig gzugs sogs khams drug de ni yul drug kyang ste rdul phran phung po'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /phyi rol sngon po'i gzugs la sogs pa'i yul can rang lus sa dang dri la sogs pa drug /stong pa snang dang mun pa sa gsum gnas su rnam pa kun nas rnam par mi rtog pa/ /snang bas rab tu sad pa rab rib rnam par bral ba 'gro drug gnas 77—380

pa'i srog chags min3/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyal po bde gshegs dam tshig can la sangs rgyas lam ston mdzad pa po/ /klu sgrub rdo rje can kyang srid pa gsum gyi bla mas chos kyi dbyings su lung bstan /cing / /nyams pa rnams kyi gos sngon can la sha yi dam tshig can gyi ston pa byang chub rdo rje ste/ /ye shes mtha' can nag po'i ming can gzhan yang ma ji ma ti srin po'i dbang po 'byung / /ye shes ming can rdo rje dril bu lag gdub ridag kyang de bzhin thod par chang 'thung zhing //kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rus pa'i rgyan cha chang snod lacang te'u ster ba nag po'i ming can no/ /slob ma rnams la gos sngon dang ni kun tu rgyug pa ster ba na bza' sngon po can//sha yi dam tshig can gyi thod pa can la rdo rje'i phyag rgya ster ba byang chub rdo rje'o/ /gos sngon can ni rta mchog bdag po dpal ldan ha la sogs pa'i ming can gyis bsnun 'gyur/ /ye shes rdo rje'i skyon gyis slob dpon rab tu 'khrugs pas mig gnyis sa la nyung bar 'gyur/ /rab tu khros pa'i kha can thod pa can gyi pho nya gzhon nus dag po'i khrag 'thung byed/ /sha yi dam tshig can gyi spyod pa 'gal ba de dag sangs rgyas pa rnams spong mi 'gyur/ /mchog gi thugs rje can gyi 'jigs byed kyis bstan thod pa can gyis rgyal po las 'doms pa / /gang gi ming gis rnam rtog yid kyis thugs rje min zhing sems can phung po byams pa min//de rnams bzang po'i thabs ni sna tshogs sha yi kha zas gzhan gyi nor 'phrog 'dod pa ni/ /log par g.yem pa dge ba rnam par bral bas skye ba 'di nyid la ni 'grub 3 par 'gyur/ /skyes bus mtho ris gnyis skyes 'jigs byed la sogs phyugs kyi sha yi tshamachod pa'i mchod sbyin gyis / /de thos sangs rgyas lam ni seng ge 'phrog byed kyis bshad tshangs pa'i chos ni rnam par spangs / /khro bo'i dbang 77—381

po srin po'i dbang po gnyis skyes phyugs kyi sha yis rgyal pos /mchod par 'gyur//gang yang rung ba blo gros dman pa dge ba rnam bral de ni bdud kyis bslus par snye'agyur /khro bo dbang po srin po'i dbang po'i cisha yi dam tshig can gyi rgyal pos mchod par 'gyur/ /mtho ris dbang phyug 'dod phyir gnyis skyes phyugs kyi sha dang khrag gis bsgos pa'i mgo bo yis/ /nges par mnar med dmyal ba rtag tu'ang sdug bsngal dmyal ba pa la ster bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang las bskal pa'i rgyal po stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug rnams kyis nges par 'thon par 'gyur /bdud kyis sha yi dam tshig can gyi yi dgas mkha' 'gro rnams la sgyu ma byed ('gyur zhing / /sems can bslu /phyir kha cig tu ni 'jigs pa min par bdag nyid gzugs ni ston par byed/ /lha rnams sha yi tshadam tshig can gyi lha ma yin rnams zad par bya phyir sgyu ma byed/ /sems can rnams ni bskyang phyir kha cig 5tu yang bdag nyid gzugs ni 'jigs —byed ston par byed/ /long ba brlag paphyir 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lha'i la'ajigs —byed dus ni me lha rab tu byung — /bde byed kyis bsang lha ma yin te khrag kyang srin po rnams kyis 'thungs par gyur / /nya dang rus sbal phag rgod mi yi seng ge lha ma yin rnams brlag tshophyir lakhyab 'jug skyes/ /nya dang de bzhin ri dgas la ri sogs 'o ma nags tshal dgon pa khyab 'jug gis mi bza'/ /sa gsum bla mas yi dgas mkha' 'gro rnams ni smin phyir he ru ka yi gzugs su byas/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba'i bdag pos rā ma na yi chung ma dbrog phyir gnas 'jog gzugs su byas/ /'jigs sde med pas skya bseng 'bu rnams sha yi dam tshig can gyis sabram ze'i gzugs kyis bcings/ /gir mi ri yis sha 0yi ched du sum cu'i stobs can srin po'i 77—382

rigs kyi chos byed cing / /lha dang klu yi dbang po rnams kyis /dam tshig 'dir ni rgyal po chen po rig par byos/ /lha bshos 'bras chan khur ba zho dang 'o ma mar dang bcas pa 'o thug sha khar rirnams/ /khro bo rnams dang srin po rnams la phyugs kyi sha yi gtor ma 'bras chan khrag dang chang / /sangs rgyas rnams la snying po lnga dang bu ram zhor bcas 'bras can lhung bzed dka' thub la/ /khrus bcas sbrang rtsi mar sar 0za zhing tsandan me tog dag gis mgon por bcas pa mchod / /gang gis chang sogs mchod pa de dang de yis lha dang 'jigs byed dam ni nye ru ka la min/ /srin po'i dbang po mtshan mo rgyu ba'i dam tshig dpal ldan rgyal po /zla ba seng gis spyad/ /mdung can ma dang dro mepa ti dang 'di dag rigs skyes bud med min 2te khro zumo lnga lnga yang —/ /gzhan yang thod pa can gyi chang snod nang gi chu yis cigatsang sbra ant+ra la masogs yul/ /si 'i yul na ba glang 7sha za kha ba can ri gnyis ciskyes rgyal po'i mi rnams chang 'thung zhing / /hā re la sogs na ma he sgro sha ma kha bar bar mi se red rta glang sha /de dzin stag dang mi sha za la po skar yul du sabong bu rnga mo khyi yi sha /bram ze la snyesogs rnams kyis sha mi bza' ba yul 'khor chen po gtsā cir yi yul/ /nyid dang mtshan gyi dus su dmangs rigs la 5sogs khyim du lachang 'byung bkag la rigs skyes 'thung snye/ /bud med rnams kyi dbang po skyes pas mo rtags 'jib par byed cing gnyis skyes kyis ri bshad kyi / /khrus dang gtsang spra mi byed 'dir ni chags pa'i spyod pa pi ra'i yul la sogs pa rnams/ /pha dag shi na ma dag bu yi chung mar bag mar 4len pa nges par go kha'i g.yul/ /rug mer 4spun zla'i tsha mo len la ma khar yang ni spun zla'i bu mo rang gi bus/ /so ra me dang 77—383

tsam pa ka la /sogs par tsha mo'i bu mo dang ni tsha mo'ang yin/ /spun zla'i bu mo chung mar len pa yul 'khor chen po na ta la sogs par ro ma yi tsha mo chung mar len la ma cal yang ste khol mo len pa ra ra'i yul/ /bod ( na khrus dang gtsang sbra med la pa ru ku kyi lan ta ra go stan rigs ngan yul/ /skyes pa'i bka' yis gdengs can dbang po nyid dang mtshan gyi dus su chu yi char 'bebs byed/ /gal te yul chos spyod pas grub par gyur na de tshe rig byed ngag dag bden pa min/ /sha yi dam tshig can gyi ri sha za'i lus tsho can phru gu sha dag spong bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang zhig rig byed byed pa drang srong mchog gi dka' 'ithub can gyi rig byed ngag de gnyis/ /mtho ris don du mi dang ba lang tshagasod cing bha gar dkrugs pa pazhi ba'i btung / /zhi ba'i rig byed ngag de dag gis sems sun 'byin pa cirab tu mkhas pa rnams/ /ba lang pags skupa'i zhi ba'i btung ba bha ga mchog tu dkrugs lapa rta yi pho rtags bcad pa la/ /khu ba khrag gis rnam par bsgos —pa sprang dang mar du bcas pa rtse yis ldag 7par byed/ /de lta'i sha za'i spyod pas gal te mchod sbyin rig byed ngag gis gnyis skyes rnams kyis grub/ /nges pa dang ldan zhi ba'i sems dang snying rje ldan pa'i daṇḍi mtho ris rnam par nyams/ /pha la tshosogs pa'i don du 'tshe ba byed cing khyim pa mchod sbyin dus su phyugs dag gsod/ /dka' thub rnams ni 'tshe ba spong zhing dka' thub nges par brdung zhing gong ma goms sogs yod/ /daṇḍi dka' thub rnams kyis mtho ris mchod sbyin 'gegs par 'gyur te de yang gang gis 5phyir/ /shes par sagrol bas de phyir sna tshogs phyugs dag gsod pa gnyis skyes rnams ni ngu 'bod 'gro/ /lha la bsogs pa mchod pa nyid pas gal te sha zos pa las dzi77—384

nyes pa mi skyes tsan/ /bcu gnyis pa dang nya dang bcu bzhi klu yi tshes dang nyi ma 'pho ba'i dus dag tu/ /khyab 'jug la sogs mchod phyir 'di rnams nyi mar bram ze rnams kyis ci phyir sha mi bza'abyu/ /pha la gnas su sha dang rnam par bral ba'i chang bu ci phyir ster byed mkhas pa rnams/ /'tsho ba'i pha dang ma dag gang zhig shi bar gyur na sngon gyi rigs rgyud rnam par spangs/ /bsod nams sdig pa'i mthu yis mtho ris ngan song dag tu rab tu skye la lus bsregs nas/ /gnas dang gnas su rus pa'i dum bu 'jog cing chang bu dag kyang ster byed su zhig ni/ / su zhig ma yin su zhig pha yin de ni lus dang bral nas skye gnas gzhan zhugs tshopa/ /bram ze la —sogs mchod pas gal te de yis 7pha ma mumachod par rig byed las grub na/ /bram ze la sogs ma zhu chib yis de tshe shi ba la yang ma zhus gnod par 'gyur/ /gang gis 5pa dag dge dang mi dge'i dbang gis yi dgas skyes nas dad pa'i kha zas —slong / /nges pa'i bu yis rab tu 7byin pa'i chang bu len par gyur tshol chu yang len par byed/ /tshangs pa la —sogs gtso bo nyi ma lha mchog bdag po nyi ma de ni ci yis bza' sems can rnams la sdug bsngal ster ba 'chi ba'i 'jigs bskyed galha rnams ci yis zhi bar 'gyur/ /zla ba lha min dbang po'i gtso bo sems can dang sabacas gtso cibo ci zhig zla ba bza' de ni/ /sems can rnams la bde ba ster zhing mchog tu 'jig —'joms ci yis lha ma yin rnams skrag snye /gang zhig mtho ris lha rnams mi dang phyugs kyi sha yis bram ze rnams kyis 0mchod bya ba/ /gang zhig yi dgas sa yi khor yug gtogs par yod pa de rnams gnyis skyes spyod yul min/ /sa la — sogs pa lha yi de nyid nye bar zhig par gyur pa dbang po'i spyod yul min/ /77—385

tshangs /gzugs sna tshogs nam mkha' tsam yang seng ge dbang phyug gtso bo tshangs pa de nyid de / /yi dgas la cisogs rlung gi lus po rang bzhin yon tan dbang las rags pa'i kha dog dman/ /sa dang chu dang me yi lus can sa dang bar snang dag tu kha dogs rags sogs ldan/ /rlung gi reg bya'i lus can sa dang chu dang me rnams mig gis gzung bya'i kha dog gzugs/ /dri ni sna yis gzung bya 'dir ni rtse yis ro myong dzodag pa'i rna bas sgra rnams so/ /rig byed tshig las gal te rlung gi gzugs ma grub cing rig byed rtog ge'i tshad ma yis /gzugs med de yis sa dang bar snang dag tu de tshe 'byung ba'i tshogs rnams bskyod pa min/ /mo gsham 7bu dang mtshungs pa nam mkha' tsam la nam mkha'i rgyu tsam yon tan med pa gang / /gzhan dag gzugs can bzhi ste sa dang chu dang byin za rlung rnams ro yi dbang po gnyis/ /bram ze sogs kyis mthong gyur khyim ni mun pa can du mtshan mo mar me med na yang / /byi ba la ngasogs phyogs dang mtshams su son pa'i gzugs kyi dngos po ma lus snang bar 'gyur/ /srin po dang ni yi dgas la 5sogs tshogs pa mtshan mo'i dus su lha rnams ma lus kyang / /bram ze la —sogs rnams kyis de ni mthong zhing nyi ma shar na skar ma ma lus kyang / /bya rog srin bya ce paspyang khyi rnams ma lus pa'abyung dang 'byung 'gyur byung ba ma lus ston/ / de bzhin lhag ma'i chang bus bsgrubs pa'i the brang dag gis skyes bu rnams la yang / /byol song rnams ni gang du rang gi sems la bab pa'i sa phyogs der ni gnas 'cha' la/ /de dag shes pa bram ze rnams la srid pa gang las mig gis gzung bya'i rgyu gzhan min/ /lha mo gzhon nu ma la zhugs na byung dang 'byung 'gyur 'byung ba ma lus ston par byed/ /7bram ze shi 77—386

nas yi dgas gyur pas rmongs pa'i lus la zhugs nas rig byed 'don par byed / /sbyin bdag srin por gyur na khyim du bong ba so phag rus pa'i dum bu 'phen par byed/ /blo dang ldan pa'i dpyod 0pa can rnams nye bar nyams par 'gyur ba'i yi dgas spyod la ristos/ /mun pa bsal ba min par gyur la mun las khu ta de yi bshang ba las byung ba/ /mya ngan med skyes khyab 'jug 'phrog byed skyed 5byed des na mes po khu ta mchod par 'os/ /ba glang rgyab dang ra yi kha dang gnyis skyes bong bu'i rkang pa bud med bha gar phyag byed cing / /khams rnams gtong la gnyis pa mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa ldag pa gang zhig bram ze rnams/ /sgra med yi ge med las nam mkha' tsho'agyur te nam mkha' rlung gi rten du gyur pa las/ /rlung las me la me las chu yin chu las sa ste sa las 'bras bu'i kha zas rnams/ /zas dang chu dag zos dang 'byungs las rdul phran yon tan rang bzhin g.yo ba'i lus 'di dag /bsod nams sdig pa'i mthu yis bde 'gro rnams dang ngan 'gro'i srog chags phung po rab tu 'byung / /mo gsham 5bu yi bu bo mchog las mchog gyur mchog gang rdul phran 'bum gyi cha ltar phra/ /nam mkha' las ni mchog gi bdag nyid yul dang bral zhing yon tan med pa nam mkha'i rtags/ /rtags kyi gnas ni sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i dngos po de rnams so/ /gang yang 'di dag kun nas thim zhing nam mkha' sa stengs dag tu zizhi 5ba'i grub mthar ldan/ /gang zhig de yi —nus pa bha ga zhes bya rnam —gsum lam ldan skur mo 'jigs cubyed ma/ /de ni nam mkha' las 'das tshonam mkha'i dbang phyug mchog gi mchog gyur rtsa bcings 'khyil pa can/ /nam mkha'i mtha' can thig le'i phreng ba mgo nas bshang lam bar du ba thag 77—387

dang mtshungs ma/ / mchu 'phyangs skar ma'i shi mig can gnas dang 'jigs pa skyed byed za byed rnams kyi za byed ma/ /gsal dang mi gsal gcig mim rig ma ririgs min gzhan yang gcig tu mkha' spyod 'khor lo ma/ /rig ma'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rigs dang rigs min gyur pa'i thar pa ster ba'i dbang gis 'thags / /mi gsal bya rog rwa yis cigazhu la 'dir ni rang gi yon tan rus chisbal spu yis byas/ /nam mkha'i me tog lcags mda' ( rimada' gzhus gang dag 'bigs pa des ni rgyal po dbang bskur 'gyur/ /gal te skye dang 'jig pa'i 5 rgyu ru /sgyu ma chen mo byed dam he ru kur 'gyur na/ /sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs pa dag khyab 'jug gam 0ni rtag pa'i sgyu ma ji ltar min/ /'di ni thub pa'i tshig las srog chags srog ni rdul phran byed dam byed du 'jug pa med/ /sems can rnams kyi bsod nams sdig las bde dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin 'bras bu 'byin par 'gyur/ /gang zhig srin po yi dgas mkha' 'gro bdud kyi ris kyi sha yi dam tshig can gyis bsgrubs/ /grub pa'i tshig gis skye bo gzhan rnams kyis ni snyede rnams nges par 'bebs par byed pa ste / /stag la masogs pa 'gos la chu la me 'bar glang chen rengs byed mtshon cha sogs kyis min/ /sngags kyi —the brang la —sogs rnams kyi pas yi khor 7yug gtogs par rje bo'i bya ba byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang phyug lha min lha klu rnams ni sangs rgyas pas bsgrubs nas / /gang gis grub pa'i ngag gis de rnams sa yi steng du 'dod pa'i dngos grub skye bo rnams la ster/ /skal ba ngan dang nad kyi 5sdug bsngal 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa byed pa thams cad 'joms par byed/ /seng ge la cisogs 'jigs pa rab tu dang ba'i yid kyis zhi ba la gsogs byed par 77—388

'gyur/ /byang chub don du gcig tu sbyin pa la /sogs lam ni dge bcu ldan las gzhan ma gsungs/ /dbu ma'i dga' ba migacig pu bha ga dkrugs pa dang ldan 'grub ca'agyur lam gzhan gyis ma yin/ /bde gshegs dam tshig can gyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdo rje'i sa gzhi byang chub shing las gzhan du min/ /sha yi dam tshig can gyi grub pa yi dgas sa gzhir shing gcig las ni gzhan du min/ /bde gshegs dam tshig can gyi byang chub lha las gshegs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la 'jug /sha yi dam tshig can gyi /grub pa'i yi dgas 'jug pas phran tshegs las la rab tu 'jug /sangs rgyas lhas 'jug pa na tshabade gshegs dam tshig can la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar ston/ /grub pa'i yi dgas 'jug pa sha yi dam tshig can gyi ma mo'i 'khor lo la ston byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 7stobs bcu bskyed sku par mdzad 5pa bya rgod phung po las gzhan ri la min/ /grub pa rnams kyis —yi dgas rigs bskyed ston pa 'jigs byed ri las ri gzhan la ma yin/ /5dpal ldan 'bras phung chos kyi dbyings su stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' sangs rgyas pa yi rshargyud rnams bstan/ / gang zhig dzhadrag po'i mdur khrod dag tu phyugs kyi skye bo stobs can thod pa can rgyud ston/ /rgyal po'i rgyal srid lha khang sa steng sa tsholas 'byung ba de rjes lha yi rgyal srid do/ /gsal bar mgon po'i 'khor lo legs par bzhag par gyur las thar par snyerab tu 'byung bar gyur / /rgyal po srog gcod pa las dmyal bar rab tu 'jug par 'gyur gyi gzhan du sangs rgyas bka' ma yin/ /rgyal po bram ze la sogs gsod pas mtho ris 'jug gi gzhan du grub pa'i tshig ma yin/ /sha yi kha zas longs spyod byed pas slar yang srid pa gzhan du lha min rigs su ོ/ /sha 77—389

yi kha zas longs spyod byed pas slar yang sdig gzhan lha yi rigs su 'di skye'o/ /mgo skum dang ni yugs sa mngon spyod byed pas slar yang bong bu nyid du rab tu 'gro /mgo zlum dang ni yugs sa mngon spyod byed pas slar yang srid gzhan 'jigs byed nyid du 'gro/ /sems can phan pa byas pas bsod nams nyid la gnod pas sdig par bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /sems can gnod pa byas pas bsod nams nyid la phan pas sdig par dam mkha' tsam pos ston/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'jigs byed skyes pa bud med gdengs can rnams kyi bstan pa lha rten gang / /g.yul du zhugs pa'i stag gzig byurnams kyi rta yi tshogs kyis de rnams ma lus 'jig par byed/ /de rnams rigs gcig gzhan gyi nor mi len cing bden par smra dang gtsang sbra rab tu 'jug /gzhon nu gzhan gyi chung ma spong zhing dka' thub nges pa dang ldan rang gi chung ma bsten/ /khrus byas gang zhig 'dod pa'i sgra gcan mtshan mo so so'i dus su nyid gung phyed yol dang / /srod dang thun gsum dag dang nyi ma ri la shar bar gyur nas lan lngar phyag byed cing / /sa steng 2lha yul dag tu stag gzig mamu stegs dag la mun can dbang pos gcig tu skyob/ /drag po'i g.yul ngor pha ltar skyob par byed cing bu dang bran bzhin 'gyur la rgyal po ni/ /rgyal rigs 'thab rshamo mun papas gnyis skyes phyugs kyi sha yis 'jigs byed la —sogs mchod nas su/ /sna tshogs sems can gnod pa byed cing gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa yis gdung rgyud mi 'chad pa 'byung / /grub pa bya ḍi dbang po sbyin pa mi phyugs zhabs dang dum bu zhes bya thod pa can/ /dge slong klu casgrub zhes bya yon tan ma lus 'byung khungs sems can kun la phan 'dogs pa/ /slob dpon blo tshobartan zhes bya gcod byed 77—3 90

chu yis grub pa stong phrag bcu dang bcas pa rnams/ /gzhan yang de ltar rab tu grags kyang kye ma de lta na yang dam par gyur pa rmongs pa yod/ /dge bcu rilam gyis grub par gyur pa 'phags pa rilha dang lu ba'i na bza' rta dbyangs dang — /phyogs kyi glang po gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa btsun pa zla ba padma'i myu gu zhes/ /pong go sa la rtog pa'i rgyal po ma lus nag po rgyal po ind+ra ཿ ti dang /de bzhin gzhan dang de rnams mthong yang mi bdag 'jigs byed 'phrog byed risogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /sa dang chu dang me dang /rlung dang nam mkha' mkha' tsam gdong lnga pa la yan lag drug /de yi dbyangs yig ring dang thung bas 'gyur gyis dzogazhan la dbyangs yig yon tan la sogs min/ /nyi ma gang du tshangs pa'i sa bon nye bar 'jigs 5par 'gyur ba des na dus phyi mar / /sa gzhi skyong ba mchod na 'dir ni g.yul ngor kla klo dang ni mu stegs 'jigs 5par 'gyur/ /thung dang ring ba ngalnga rnams rang bzhin yon tan mtshungs pa dbyangs yig 5yon tan la lasogs min/ /a sogs ma ning dbyangs yig 7stobs bcu mnga' bas cigasung ste nyi ma 'thab mo zad phyir ro/ /ring dang thung ba mtshungs pa gang du a ko ka ni tshoring po phyugs bdag tshig las 'gyur /de phyir ma ning yod la 0mi ko ya ṇa tsa mi byed po'i phyogs nas des par bskyod/ /thog ma'i lo nas nam mkha' mkha' dang gzhan yang zla ba tsin tsi ni yi dbang phyug 'byung / /de yi bka' yis yi dgas dbang sgyur 4dus la ka 5sogs grogs ldan sgur mor byin brlabs 0pa/ /phyi nas sa steng son pa'i gnas dang zhing gi lha gang drug cu rtsa brgyad kla klo yi/ /mgon po ma sgro ma ti bu dang bu mo spun zla skyes pa rnams kyis 'jig ripar byed/ /der ni bco 0brgyad 77—391

lo la brgya yis brgya la bsgyur bas ma kha la /sogs 'phags pa'i yul/ /kla klo rnams dang lha gang mun can nyi mar rtogs ripa gang de nga ri yis brlag par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs gsum cho gas skye dgu rnams ni der bzhag nas/ /bde la 0bkod de ka lā pa nas lha gnas dga' ldan mchog tu nyi ma 'gro bar bya/ /nam mkha' mkha' dang dus dang dbang po mig gis dus kyi dus su son pa'i cilo yi tshad/ /slar yang skye bo rnams ni kla klo 'jug ste ji srid bcwa —brgyad lo la bsgyur dang bcas 7pa'i bar/ /yang nas yang du nga yis rtsod pa'i dus der byung nas de rnams gzhig par bya ba nyid/ /ji srid sa dang chu dang me rlung nam mkha'i yon tan nam mkha' nyi zla skar ma rnams/ /phyogs skyong phyogs kyi gdon dang phyogs lha nam mkha' sa gzhir yi dgas bram ze ba glang gsogs/ /sa 'og klu dang lha min rnams ni sa yi bdag pos zhi ba'i don du 'di rnams mchod/ /don kun grub phyir rtag tu rgyal po mi dang bcas pas sangs rgyas pa dang rgyal ba rnams/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang stong pa nyi mar bcas pa mchod rdzas rnams kyis mchod/ /slob dpon mchog la gzhol bas bsrung chib lnga po rab tu dri zhim me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /sngon du khrus byas gos sngon snga dro gso sbyong blangs pas nyid dang mtshan du nges par pagadon/ /klog mkhan bzhi dang lnga pa gang zhig zhi bar byed pas nyin dang mtshan du bya bar 'gyur /slar yang de la bsrung bar —bya zhing nyi ma bcu ru zhi dang rgyas pa dag kyang bya/ /zho dang 'bras chan nyi mar rta dang glang po'i gtor ma pa'abras chan 'o ma zla ba la/ /'bras chad la sogs mig dmar gza' lhag /cime tog bcud dang bcas pa tsho'abras chan gza' lhag 0la/ /'bras chan ser po bu ram sogs kyi 77—392

gtor ma lha yi /bla ma 'o thug sha khar 5gyis/ /pa wa risangs la zan dron mar nag bcas pas spen pa'i nyi ma bdun par de bskyon la/ /nyi ma slar yang phyogs dang glang po rnams kyi gtor ma bya zhing khur ba 'bras can gyis / /glang po rta mchog rnams kyi tshozhi dang rgyas pa'i don du sbyin sreg nyi ma la sogs gzar — /'bru dang mar sar so ma drur tshob mda' yi ciyam shing brgya dang 'o ma'i mchod yon btung pa/ /sbyin sreg rjes la dung por gang ba'i zhi ba'i chu yis rta dang glang po khrus bya'o/ /yi dgas la sogs gtor ma sran chan sha —dang chang rnams nyin mtshan dus su risbyin par 'gyur/ /srin po la sogs yungs ker tshodang ni rdo rje phur bus phyogs mtshams gtogs 0par phur bus gdab /slob dpon gyis ni bsrung ba lnga yi cho gas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa bsrung 5bar bya/ /gang dang gang gis yul mtha'i bar gyi skye dgu :nyid dang mtshan du zhi dang rgyas 'gyur ba/ /thog mar dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang las padma lnga yis bskor/ /gang zhig rang bzhin yon tan dbang las sa dag kha sbyar zur brgyad de bzhin phyi rol du/ /gang zhig zur rnams dar dpyangs bcing ba saphyogs dang phyogs mtshams de las rdo rje 4phreng bar 'gyur/ /rgyal chen phyogs kyi zur la ma lus yon tan rang bzhin ri yi rgyal po phyogs dang mtshams rnams su / /de dang skum po'i :snam bu phyogs dang homatshams su de la snod dang rtse mo'i phyed ri du 'gyur/ /padma'i ge sar cha la 'dir ni dgra sta lcags kyu zhags pa dang ni dung nyid do/ /chu skyes 'dab mar bsrung :'khor gang zhig snying po yang ni de bzhin gnyis pa gsum par de/ /de ltar padma gnyis la gyur rsāte nye ba'i snying po chu skyes 'dab ma chen por garnam 77—393

gnyis der/ /klu rnams zung gi bar du phyogs dang mtshams kyi 'dab mar bar du /de bzhin lha dang lha min dang / /gnod sbyin rnams dang gza' dang ma lus 'jigs pa 'joms pa'i ma mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams/ /bsrung 'khor 'dis ni thams cad bsrung 4bar 'gyur te khrag dang gi wang la sogs rnams kyis bri/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang ma lus rgyal sras rnams kyis bsrung ba lnga sogs bsrung ri'akhor gsungs pa yin / /bud med bu 'dod pa las bu tshadang rgyal po dgra dang g.yul 'gyed pa rnams tshargyal bar 'gyur/ /nad pa nad las grol bar 'gyur te sa yi steng du dbul po rnams kyis nor rnyed 'gyur/ /skyes pa bud med rnams kyis 'bras bu ster bar gyur pa 5sngon gyi bsod dmas mthu yis so / /bsod nams sems can rnams la phan btags chadage bcu'i lam 5gyis mchod las nam mkha' sogs las 7min/ /bram ze gang zhig chang 'thung 'gyur dang gcer bu pa 'am ral pa can nam dbyug tshog can/ /dge tshul dang ni tshogs dpon dge slong dge ba rnam par bral ba 0grub mtha'i spyod pa nyams — /sum cu'i dam tshig can gyi mi yi dbang pos de rnams yul nas cibaskrad par bya/ /gang phyir de dag rnams kyis dge dang mi dge'i las byas drug cu'i ci shas rgyal po yin/ /yugs sa mo rnams gang zhig 'khrig pa spyad lanas ngan pa dmyal ba'i 'bras ster me la btso bar byed/ /gang du yul na bdud ris de yod rimi bdag 0dpung bcas der ni nam yang grub ma yin/ /rgyal po sa yi steng du rgyal srid dang ni dgra dag 'joms dang nor rnyed bsod nams kyis//skal pa bzang dang tshe dang grags pa dpal ldan lha yul sa steng grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin / /sa steng ma lus mi yi rgyal po sbyin las byung ba tshul khrims dang 77—394

bcas lha rgyal po/ /bzod pa :tshul khrims skyong la nyin dang mtshan du rtsod pa las ni sbyin pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu bsam gtan la gnas mchog tu rang bzhin rnam par bral ba shes rab kyis thabs 'phel/ /shes rab thabs kyi mthu las smon lam dang yang stobs dang stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'o/ /chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang gal te 'khor bar byon pa ma yin na / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yul dang yul can lhan cig nam mkha'i khams rnams su/ /de cani brdzun gyi tshig la de bzhin bcom ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar bzhugs zhes pa/ /'dod chags la sogs skyon spangs dri ma gsum dang rnam bral rdo rje sems dpa' las gzhan —min / /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams sa stengs 5dmyal ba'i dmyal bas 'dir ni mazhi ba la chosogs kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma lus tshe yi tshad rnams rang rang grub mtha'i chos su gsal bar byas/ /tshangs pa la pasogs bsod nams longs spyod mthar ni lha yul sa stengs dzodag nas lhung snyebar 'gyur/ /srin pos byin brlabs 〉rnams kyis de la rnathar pa 'dod pa de ni nam mkha'i shing 'bras bzhin/ /byis pa rnams la rang rang ma yis brdzun tshig 'jam pa snyan pas 5bdag nyid drung du khrid snyepa ra byed/ /chang pa stong pa ston cing bdag gi lag la ril bu yod pa long zhig bu zhes brjod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bdud kyi salag nas shin tu snyan pa'i tshig gis bdag nyid drung du 4khrid / /nam mkha' tsam zhig ston cig 0bdag gi rigs kyi mya ngan 'das pa long zhig bu zhes gsung / /sems can rnams kyi bsam ri pa'i dbang las rgyal bas srin po rnams la gso sbyong gsal bar mdzad/ /de rnams de yis sangs rgyas 77—395

nyid na thub pa'i bka' yi gsang sngags theg pa bden ma yin/ /gang zhig bskal pa dpag med byams dang dge bcu'i lam dang sbyin dang tshul khrims rab rdzogs pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' stobs bcu ldan pas sangs rgyas ribyang chub lung bstan to/ /mo gsham bu ni lus med ma lus yon tan rang bzhin gang zhig rdul phran 'dus pa rnams/ /srog ni nam mkha'i me tog min te gong du rags pa'i lus la zhugs nas klog cing dgod/ /srog chags bya rog rwa min bsod nams sdig pa'i dbang gis gang zhig 'gro ba rnams su 'khor/ /srog chags gang zhig rdul phran phung po'i lus ni sa stengs sna'achi ba'i tshe na mi cing med / /rgyud kyi rgyal por stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pas sangs rgyas pa yi gang zhig lam bstan pas / /rgyal ba 0stobs bcu ldan dang ston pa'i sras dang sangs rgyas pa yi skolha klu dri za skulha min dang / /khro bo srin po sha yi dam tshig can dang stag gzig rnams dang mu stegs spyod pa rnams/ /de kun sha cil zhes bya ba pargyal mchog bzhugs gnas der ni nyi ma bdag gis bsten /dpal ldan 'bras phung dzochos kyi dbyings su stobs bcu mnga' bas gang zhig bdud rnams btul mdzad pa/ /de kun sha pal yi dpal ldan ka lā pa yi skyed mos tshal gyi dus 'khor gyi/ /don chen gser gyi dkyil 'khor 0khang pa'i sgo yi phyi rol thub pa nyi ma'i shing rtas dris / /dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs rin chen seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa stobs bcu mnga' ba'i mdzad spyod gsungs / / dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud las phyung ba'i tshodapal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po —rdzogs sol// //0shākya'i dge slong gnyen chung dharma grags kyis bsgyur ba'o rte// //tsho77—396

bya ba'i rgyud kyi snying po/’༄ gi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra ga nā ma tant+ra/ bod skad du/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi snying po/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku/ /nyid mor byed pa'i 'od lta bu/ /padma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba'i spyan/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lha yi mchog gis phyag byas pa/ /spyi bos gtugs te ciphyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po zla ba bzang pos zhus/ /yan lag padma sbyar ba ni/ /yan lag mchog la bzhag byas te/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba ni/ /rtsod pa dag gi dus kyi ni/ /mi rnams grol ba'i rgyu ru'o/ /so sor sdud pa rnam pa bcu/ /rgyal ba yi ni dbang por 'gyur/ /de bzhin bsam gtan mi skyod pa/ /srog dang rtsol ba ral gri can/ /slar la yang ni rnam pa bcu/ /gzung ba rin chen phyag rgya can/ /g.yung mo rjes su dran pa ni/ /padma 'dzin pa ru ni 7)gyu//07 /

dpal gyi ting 'dzin 'khor lo can/ /re re yang ni lnga ru dbye/ /slar la yang ni gang dbye ba/ /a la /sogs dang ka la sogs/ /so sor sdud pa yul dang ni /yul can rnam pa bcu po rnams/ /lus la 'jug pa med pa'o/ /shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa'o/ /dga' ba mi g.yo bde ba dang / /bsam gtan sems ni rtse gcig pa'o/ /srog dang rtsol ba gnyis kyi lam/ /mi 'khrug pa ru 'gyur ba ni/ /dbu camar srog ni 'jug pa'o/ /thig le ru ni srog 'jug cing //gnyis ka 'gro dang 'ong ba dag /gzung ba yid ni sems gcig pa/ /gtum mo yi ni snang ba gang / /lus la nges par gsal 'gyur ba/ /nam mkha' de ni rjes dran 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid kyi/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bden dbang gis/ /ye shes sku ni ting 'dzin te/ /'di ni chu sogs dbye ba yis / /gsum du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sna tshogs bdag po'i sgrub thabs so/ /phyag rgya gsum dang tshad ni gsum/ /rnam pa gsum gyi srid dbang gis/ /las dang kun rtog bzang po yi/ /so sor sdud pa rnal 'byor pa/ /yul du rnam par bral ba dang / /sngags kun gyis ni byin gyis brlabs/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba dag pa yis/ /mngon shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /srog dang rtsol ba dag pas ni / /zla ba nyi ma dag pas bral/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod/ /gzung ba yi ni stobs kyis ni/ /nyon mongs la sogs bdud 'joms shing / /stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /dri med 'od 'phro dkyil 'khor te/ /gzhan yang ye shes sku las so/ /de phyir dag pa ting 'dzin gyis/ /nyi ma cung zad tsam gyis ni/ /ye shes sku ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /so sor kun la gsogs pa yis/ /gal te gzir bar de 'gyur na/ /sngags pa rnams kyis 'dod mi 77—408

'grub / /sgra la goms pa yan lag ma'i/ /pad song /rdo rje nor bu yiri / /jig le bsgrub ri pa casong bar bya/ /bsnyen pa dang po sbyor ba ni/ /nam mkha' zhuru ni rnam pa bcu/ /'khor lo can ni khro lta ba'o/ /bgegs ni mthar byed kyi lta ba/ /bdud rtsi lam du song ba yang / /nye ba'i bsnyen pa yan lag drug /shes rab las 'phros zla thig le/ /gzhan yang rdo rje nor bu ste/ /yi ge gsum ni bsgrub ri )par 'gyur/ /bde ba ma nyams gcig zhi ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa ru ni 'gyur/ /sgrub chen ye shes sbyor ba'o/ /srog dang rtsol ba kun nas ni/ /mgo bo'i bar ni phan pa ste/ /mnyam pa'i bde ba 'bras ster ba/ /de las steng ni mi phan pa/ /'chi ba'i 'jig cipa byed pa'o/ /sems can nges par klog pa'i rgyu/ /gtsug tor sgo ni gug nas su/ /mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang du/ /'di ni sbyar ba 3 bya ba nyid/ /phung po med pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mnyam pa'i bde ba la bzhugs mod/ /'on kyang 'jig rten grags pa med/ /dbus su srog dang 'jug pa ni/ /yul dang rnam par bral ba nyid/ /sna tshogs yum gyis 'khyud pa'o/ /padmar 'jug pa'i rang rdo rje/ /spro ba yang ni de bzhin te/ /rdo rje dbus su gzhag par bya/ /sa bon ma lhung ba bde ba/ /shin tu chags pa'i chags par song / /rnal 'byor pa yi 'byor pa nyid/ /mchog tu yang ni khyab pa'i bdag /dbal ni gsang las gsang ba po / /gtsug tor du ni rtse lnga pa'o/ /rdo rje yi ni 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi yi rtse mo nyis 'gyur du/ /'gyur ba chos kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de ni gnyis su 'dres pa dang / /de ni gzhan yang nyis 'gyur ro/ /de yi yang ni gzhan nyis 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa yi ni 'khor lor ro/ /de yi dang du rtse gcig go/ /77—409

mnyam pa'i bde ba'i 'bras ster ba/ /gsang ba'i padma'i nang gsang ba'o/ /rnal 'byor pa dang srog gcod pa/ /nyid dang mtshan du phye ba ni/ /de ni srog 'jigs 0pa ru gsungs/ /sgra gang kha dang bral ba ni/ /snying la yod par rab 'gyur ba/ /de ni brdzun du smra ba nyid/ /kun mkhyen gyi ni ye shes sar/ /'dzin par yang ni dbye ba gang / /rnal 'byor pa la de gsungs so/ /bde ba'i thig le ma lhung ba/ /gzhan gyi bud med du ni 'gyur/ /bsten ripa chags bral min pa'o/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i me yis ni/ /ri bong can la zhu ba yi/ /btung ba chang gi ribatung ba'o/ /mthe bo'i tshigs nas gtsug tor du/ /tshes ci kyi dbang gis 'gro ba ni/ /nya mthar thug par rang gi sems/ /gtsug tor gnas nas mthe bo ru/ /yang ni 'dir ni 'gro 'gyur te/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi mthar thug par/ /rnal 'byor ma spyod pa des ni/ /nyi ma re re'i dus su ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub rab tu ster/ /spyod dang 'dod pas lus tsha na/ /mchog gi kha yi padma las/ /tshig mi 'byung dang gnyid log dang / /'gul dang na ba lkugs 0pa dang / /yid ni 'khrug dang brgyal ba ni/ /du ba la sogs rdo rje can/ /de rnams gsal ba rnam pa bcu/ /srog can lus kyi gnas skabs so / /'jig rten 'dod pa'i gnas skabs ni/ /nges pa kho nas gsal ba las/ /su zhig rgyal ba su 'dod pa/ /thig le dkar po'i rgyun ni gang / /nyid dang mtshan mor nyung ba ni/ /mā ma tī ni de chad do / /go tshoku la ngasogs mig la 7sogs / /nyi ma re re bzhin spro bas/ /sha gzhan re pa'aga' yang ma yin/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsten pa ni/ /rang gi rigs kyi sar song ba/ /lha rnams dag pa'i lus las so/ /stong pa'i sems de rtsod pa yis/ /lhan cig skyes pa 77—410

khyab bde bas/ /de ni skye gnas 'khrig pa med/ /nor gyi sbyin pa btang ba dang /bud med sbyor la yid kyis ni/ /mi 'dzag ripa ni tshul khrims so/ /bzod pa sgra sogs mi 'jug pa/ /gnyi gar 'gro ba'i le lo ni/ /rnam par 'jig pa brtson 'grus so/ /bsam gtan shes rab sems dang ni/ /bde ba lhan cig par song ba/ /kun 'gro thams cad brjod pa'o/ /sems can don du de rdzu 'phrul/ /srid pa don ni med byed pa/ /thob pa gzhan ni bzhi pa'o/ /lus gcig la ni nus ldan pa/ /cha dgu dang ni lhan cig pa/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga bdag nyid sogs/ /bsam gtan phyag rgya'i gnyis dag nyid/ /cung zad tsam gyi nyi ma yis / /dngos grub yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhi ba dbang dang rengs pa dang / /srid pa 'jig par byed pa ni/ /zhal gyi dbye bas phye ba nyid/ /'byung ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /lha min lag 'gro dag gi rigs/ /'di bsgoms nas ni bsgrub par bya/ /dpal dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las gsungs pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba las thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bkol ba'i dum bu'o/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bha dra bo dhi'i zhal snga nas dang / bod // shā ṅge/ / rdo // pa zla ba'i 'od 0zer gyis 'bro dge slong gi phyir bsgyur cing 77—411

sa gi /rgya gar skad du/ she ka pra kri ya/ bod skad du/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ril phyag 'tshal lo / /phab pa btang ba'i phyi nas mgo bo dang ni snying ga cagyi gtsug rnams dang lte ba mgrin pa dang / /gsang ba rnams su bsrung ba rgyal ba rnams kyis rang gi rigs gyur rnams la rang gi rdor gsum gyis/ /slob ma rnams kyi lus la gos ser skon zhing mig rnams bkab nas dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /kun rdzob don du rab mchog lam nas gshegs nyid rnams la brtul zhugs rnams ni sbyin bya rtag pa ru/ /bsad cadang mi bden pa dang gzhan gyi bud med rnams tshospangs de bzhin gzhan nor chang la'athung dag kyang ste/ /'khor ba'i rdo rje zhags pa rang gi dge ba 'joms par byed pa sdig pa lnga po 'di nyid rnams/ /gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba'i lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi ming gis rab tu sbyin byas 77—414

pa'i/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' stsal 'di yis srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pas khyed rnams kyis kyang skyong bar gyis/ /rgyan 'gyed kha na ma tho bcas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min chos rnams dang / /ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha dang mi rnams bla ma lnga ni gsad mi bya/ /grogs dang rje bo dang ni lha dang mi yi 5bla ma dge 'dun dbugs 'byin rnams la 'khu ba dang / /dbang po rnams kyis yongs su chags rnams min te srid pa'i bdag po'i brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// //dpal ldan sngags kyi rumangon par bsngags pa lag pa'i padma kha sbyar du ni me tog gcig byin te/ /dang por lan gsum bskor te lag pa'i padma kha sbyar gnas pa'i me tog dkyil 'khor du ni dor/ /gnas gyur gang du me tog bzang po lhung ba de nyid de yi rigs su nges so mi bdag kye/ /phyi nas dbang bdun rnams dang rnam gsum 'dir ni ji lta ba bzhin bla 0med yang dag rab tu sbyin/ /klu rnams kyis sam bzhis te rgyal ba rnam rgyal bcas pa'i bum pa nor bu gser gyi bum pa'am/ /sa las byung ba rnams su rin chen sman ldan dang ni dri ldan rnams kyis lha mo rnams kyis khrus bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rab dbye rnams kyis dbu rgyan spyan te mchog gi bla mas nus ma rnams kyis dar dpyangs nyid/ /rdo rje dril bus nyi ma zla ba nyid de /brtul zhugs kyis kyang yul dang dbang po sbyang bar —bya//ming gis khro bo rnams dang byams sogs dang ni rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rjes gnang phyi mor bcas pa sbyin/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu rab tu byin nas mchog gi snying rjes dag pa'i chos rnams bstan par bya/ /rdo rje'i rigs su nges pa srog gcod zupa dang ral grir mami bden pa yi ngag brjod bya ba dang / /ri/ che/ ༵ ni

gzhan nor 'phrog dang mchog gi padma'i rigs nyid du yang gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog /'khor lor chang dang mar me sangs rgyas rnams dang yul rnams mtha' dag shin tu bsten par bya'o / /gri gug tu ni gdol pa mo la sogs pa bud med mtha' dag mkha' yi padma smad mi bya/ /sems can rnams kyi don du nor dang lus bcas sbyin bya ci'adi ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya ba min/ /rigs kyi bu rnams gzhan du bskal pa grangs med pas kyang sangs rgyas min par rgyal bas gsungs par nges/ /chu yis sgrol ma la sogs lha mo rnams dang dbu gergyan rgyal ba rnams te dar dpyangs nus ma rnams/ /rdo rje dril bus nyi zla dag dang brtul zhugs yul sogs rnams dang ming gis byams pa sogs su gyi sbyong / /rjes gnang rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal ldan srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dus kyi 'khor lo rjes khyab pa/ /de ltar dbang bdun rnams kyis sdig pa'i dri ma 'joms pas dkyil 'khor nyid du yang dag rab tu sbyin/ /dbang bdun rnams kyis dbang rnams bskur na dge ba'i dbang gis sa bdun dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /phyis ni phyir mi ldog la sogs pa nges par rab tu 'jug pa bum pa dang ni gsang ba'i dbang / /shes rab ye shes dbang rnams bskur bas srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa'i 'jam dbyangs nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /'gro ba g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis rtsa ba'i nyung ba byung na 'di nyid la yang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'gyur /rtsa ba'i nyung ba byung na dbang bdun la gnas yon tan can gyis bzlas pas rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /gal te bum pa dang ni gsang bar brtul zhugs nges pa'i dbang ste gong mar dag pa yod ma yin/ /gang zhig la ni rtsa ba'i snang ba byung na dag par bya ba'i don du dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug bya/ /77—416
