rjes gnang thob pas phyi /nas tshogs kyi rigs su 'gro na rgan pa zhes pa las ni gzhon pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i snang ba bu rnams kyis te dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs sun rgyung ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de yi bka' las 'das pa gzhan te de bzhin du ni spun la khro ba gsum par nges par 'gyur/ /byams pa spangs pas ribazhi par 'gyur te gzhan yang byang chub sems nyid rab tu spangs pa las ni mda'/ /grub mtha' smod rig drug pa nyid de gzhan yang ma smin ciskye bo rnams la gsang ba byin pa ri / /phung po nyon mongs pa las klu ru 'gyur te gzhan yang dag pa'i chos la ma dad dgu pa'o/ /sgyu yi byams pa phyogs te ming sogs bral ba'i ri bde ba ster la rtog pa gang yin drag po'o/ /dag pa'i sems can rnams la rab tu skyon brjod nyi mar 'gyur te dam tshig rnyed pa spangs na gzhan/ /bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje theg pa la gnas rnams kyi'o/ /phyogs kyi lo ni gcig nas rnam pa bcu yi bar du lta dang reg dzopar bya ba yin pas te / /de nas 'khyud bya rnams ni rgya mtsho rnams dang ro bcas bsten par bya ba g.yo ba la sogs pa/ /nyi shu'i lo yi 'og ma'i phyag rgya rnams ni mchog tu 'jigs byed khro bo'i 'byung po lha min rigs/ /dbang gi don du drug dang gsum gyis bde mnyam 'bras ster ba dang gzhan ni bsgom pa'i don du'o/ /gang zhig dang por yang ni dpal ldan shes rab nu mar reg pa de nyid bum pa'i dbang du brjod/ /ri bong 'dzin pa myangs dang gsang ba mthong bar byas pas gsang ba'i dbang du rab tu 'gyur ba'o/ /mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs kyis yan lag kha rnams sbyang bar bya ste shes rab ye shes dbang sbyin bya/ /rgyal ba dpa' bor cibyas te slob ma'i don du phyag rgya sbyin dang gzhan yang bla ma 77—417

la yang 'dir/ /rgyan rnams thams cad ldan pa'i gser zhun dang ni mtshungs pa'i lo nyid bcu gnyis ma ste bu mo mdzes/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid ldan pas rang gi rdo rje nor bus spyad bya nyid ni chags bcas la/ /slob ma dag pa shes nas rdo rje sa bon bcas pa khar ni yang dag gzhug ①par bya ba nyid/ /phyis ni rang gi phyag rgya bu la byin nas de nas rigazhan yang du ba'i lam la sogs ldan yang / /skrag dang 'khrul pa'i sems dang g.yo dang gzhan gyi dbang du 'gro ba dang ni nang ldan bu bcas cadang / /khro ldan khengs shing 'dod la chags dang brdzun dang rtsod pa la dga' yan lag nyams dang ma dag pa/ /de lta bu rnams shes rab ye shes dbang du shin tu 'bad de bla mas spang bya mi 0dbang po/ /slar gsungs sangs rgyas bla ma dag la gus ldan dam tshig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod par bya/ /'gro ba rnams kyi rang gi yid nyid 'dod chags kyis ni 'khrugs par byed dang gang bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /yan lag mchog la gang ba las ni 'bar bas ri bong 'dzin pa zhu nas yang dag 'dzag pa nyid/ /o'o cidagug par rab tu byas pas mchog gi bde ba ster ba thig le thar pa gsum gyi mthar /snang reg 'dus dang 'gyur dang bde ba rnams te dga' ba'i dbye ba la sogs pa yis de ltar ro/ /dang por yang ni mi rnams kun gyis mig gis bltas pa 'di —yis 'dod chags 'khrugs pa dga' ba ste/ /phyi nas gang ba rang gis lus la rab tu 'dus pa mchog tu dga' ba 7nyid du 'gyur ba'o / / 'bar ba yang dag rol pas rdo rje las ni padmar thig le 'dzag pa khyad 5par dga' ba'o/ /oṇḍa sardo rje las ni thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru bde ba 'gyur byed lhan cig skyes dga'o/ /'dod dang dga' dang g.yo ba dang ni mi 'gyur ba ste 77—418

bzhi rnams kyis ni de yi sbyor ba gcig /gang ba nus pa dang ni skye ba nges par yin te mchog tu dga' ba nyid rnams gnyis pa'o/ /'bar ba dang ni thig le dag dang yur ba dang ste khyad par dga' ba nyid rnams gsum pa'o/ /o'o dang ni sgra tsam nyid de gnyid dang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyid rnams bzhi pa'o / /sems kyis bsam par bya ba ma ste reg par bya zhing 'khyud pa yis ni sring mor 'gyur ba'o/ /rdo rje rab tu zhugs pa bu mor brjod de byed bcas shin tu bde ba de bzhin tsha mo'o/ /thig le lhung cib chung mar 'gyur te chags bral gzhan gyi rigs su gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma nyid do/ /de ltar rnal 'byor phyag rgya drug ni sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' chad pa'i dngos/ /chu skyes su ni rdo rje rab zhugs pa dang mer ni rlung dang thig le ma lhung rim pa ste/ /de ltar rnal 'byor gsum gyi rab tu gsal bar nges par sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /chags dang chags bral mtha' dang sngon du bde ba dam pa'i gter ni sbyor bas go cha bzhi pa'i/ /phyag rgya rnams la yum gyi mchog gyur rnam pa bcu po de ni dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal 'di'o/ /rnam pa bdun dang rnam pa gsum ste bcu po 'di ni 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dbang ste/ /de ltar de bzhin yang bzhi pa zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni gsum pa shes rab ye shes ma yin te / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhes smos pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin yang zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gang zhig shes rab kyi ni nu mar reg pa nyid dang gzhan yang bdud rtsi myong dang 'khyud pa'o/ /shes rab dang ni 'dus pas byang chub sems nyid zhu ba skad cig ma bzhir bdud rtsir gyur pa gang / /de rnams thams cad 'jig rten pa yi lam 77—419

gyi rgyu ru snying rje mchog gis nges par bstan pa'o/ /gang zhig 'jig rten las 'das dbang ni rgyal ba'i bdag po dam pa'i phyag rgya bzang dang rjes 'dus pa/ /las kyi phyag rgya dri ma dang bcas sems g.yeng byed de tsa)ye shes phyag rgya rnam par rtog yin pas/ /yang dag spangs te rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni rgyal mchog skyed byed phyag rgya bzang po bsgom gyipa ni/ /gos pa med cing mi 'gyur mun 'joms kun la khyab pa mkha' mtshungs rnal 'byor pa ri yi go bya ba/ /lus la gnas pa'i ye shes gzi brjid srid pa'i dri ma 'joms pa dus kyi 'khor los rjes khyab pas/ /sems kyi snang ba tsam ste rang gi yid las skyes pa me long gi ni gzugs brnyan lta bur nges/ /ma lus rgyal sras rnams dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsten pa rnal 'byor dbang po rnams kyis bsten ༅byas na/ /ye shes snang ba de nyid rab tu shar bas bdud dpung yul dang bcas pa mtha' dge bsregs pa dang / /chags pa la sogs rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa rnams lus la lo gcig sbyor bas bde mnyam ster bar byed/ /shes rab ye shes zhes pa sems kyi snang ba nyid de de yang rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur ba'o/ /dbang 'dir zhugs pa gang zhig dri ma med pa'i ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bur nges/ /de nas bde ba 'dzag pa med pa lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med bzhi pa mya ngan 'das par reg /des na sangs rgyas zhal ni gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas pa de nyid dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /nam mkhar chags pa'i sems kyi kyimig mi 'dzums )pa dang ni rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs rnams kyis/ /stong pa las ni du ba smig rgyu rab tu gsal ba dri med srin bu me khyer mar me dang / /'bar dang nyi ma zla ba rdo rje rnams kyang gzhan yang mchog gi cha dang thig le nyid rnams so/ /de yi 77—420

dbus su sangs rgyas sku ni yul dang rnam par bral ba longs spyod rdzogs sku du ma'on/ /chu 'dzin bral ba'i mkha' la snang ba rnal 'byor rtse gcig gnas pa'i lta bas lta ( bar bya ba ni/ /ji srid nges par ri mo dag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba mthong ba dus kyi rtsa yis so / /der ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku ni chu dang nyi ma bzhin du rtog pa med pa sna tshogs mdog /yul dang rnam par bral ba'i byurnam pa ma lus rang gi sems te gzhan gyi sems nyid ma yin no/ /sku rimathong gyur nas nyin zhag so so'i dus su srog gi rlung nyid rab tu dgag par byas pa dang / /brtul zhugs can rnams lam gyi sems ni zla ba drug gis reg bya bral nas bde mnyam 'gyur ba'o/ /ji srid nges par rang gi lus la 'od zer 'khor los yongs su 'khor bar byed pa mthong ba'i bar/ /chags dang chags bral mtha' dang dang por song ba'i skad cig ma nas khyab bdag dbugs kyi grangs 'phel lo/ /mtha' dang 'bar ba'i dbus dang khyad par dga' dang lhan cig skyes dang ye shes dang ni rnam shes dang / /gnyid dang brgyal ba'i dbus su gnas pa'i rdo rje padma dag gis gnyis sbyor bde ba gang yin pa/ /de yis 'phel bar rab tu bya ba bla ma'i nges pa'i stobs kyis 'di nyid 'phel bar the tsom med//bdud dang ston mongs 'joms shing rgyal ba'i bdag po la gnas rnal 'byor pa yis lo gcig sbyor ba yis/ /sa yi rnam par snang yang sra ba min dang chu yi gzugs su snang yang chu min gsher ba med pa'i phyir/ /me yi rnam par snang yang me min rlung gi gzugs su snang yang g.yo ba med pas rlung ma yin/ /stong pa'i rnam pa yin yang mthong ste dkar dang sngo ba la sogs mthong yang sna tshogs kha dog min/ /rnam pa kun ldan yin yang mi mthong rang sems dri ma nyon mongs dang ni 77—421

bdud kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /sgra tsam thig le cha dang ye shes rnams ni bdud rtsi gnas su 'gro dang lcags sgrog bcings pa'i rtsa / /srog dang thur sel lam gsum rnams nas rdo rje padmar bcas dang ripadma rdo rje ldan pa yis/ /dbus su rlung dag 'gro ba ci'ajug pa yang dag 'dus pa yul dang yul can med par 'gyur ba dang / /du ba la sogs mtshan ma rnams ni gang zhig gzung dang 'di rnams 'dzin pa thams cad gsang ba chen po'o/ /dbus su srog gzhug pa ni nyi ma dang bcas zla bar gyur pa g.yas dang g.yon pa bcing ba dang / /phyag rgya dang ni sbyor ba'i sems kyis mchog tu bde gyur pa dang rdo rje yang dag sad pa dang / /bde ba dam pa'i don du padmar rdo rje bskyod dam rang gi lag pa'i padmas gsor ba yis /sa bon ma btang bde ba de ni 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal nyid do/ /sa ni chu la 'jug 'gyur chu yang me la de bzhin me ni rlung la 'jug par 'gyur ba'o/ /rlung ni stong pa la ste stong pa mtshan ma rnam pa bcur 'gyur mtshan ma rnam pa kun ldan du/ /rnam pa kun ldan mi 'gyur bde ba dam pa gzhom du med pa ye shes sku ru 'gyur ba'o/ /mi yi bdag po ye shes las ni rdzu 'phrul dngos grub 'gyur ro skyes bu rnams kyi skye ba 'dir/ /'dod pas sprul pa'i sku ru nges par 'gyur te gang ba rdzogs pa gsung du rab tu 'gyur ba'o/ /'bar ba sprul pa'i thugs te oṣṭha las ni mchog tu bde bar mdzad pa'i ye shes zhes su brjod/ /dga' ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste mchog dga' khyad par dga' dang bcas pa dag gi rim pa yis/ /gsung dang thugs te lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba sogs las ye shes rdo rje la sogs 'byung bar byed/ /g.yo ba nges par chos kyi sku ste srid gsum phyag byas pa dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba de yi gsung //77—422

gnyid rtsoni nges par chos kyi thugs te turya de yi ye shes nyid yin srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms/ /yi ge nges par dag pa'i sku ste dbyangs dang bral ba'i cha dang thig le sgra tsam rim pa yis/ /gsung ridang thugs dang ye shes rdo rje srid pa rnam cigasum la gnas dag pa'i sku ru skyed par byed/ /sad dang gli lam rang bzhin dag dang gzhan yang de bzhin gnyid log pa dang turya'i rang bzhin rnams /lus gnas pa dang dbugs nyid thim pa rnam par rgyu dang yul las bskyod pa med pa'i sems thim pa/ /ye shes gnas kyang bud med dang ni rab 'dus pa las byang chub sems zhu gyur pa'i skad cig ni/ /sprul pa la sogs rim pas thugs kyi rdo rje rnam pa bzhi ru nges par rab tu 'gyur ba'o / /de ltar sems ni rnam pa bzhi rnams srid pa rnam gsum gyur pa'i srog chags rnams kyi thig le'i dbus/ /khyab byed bde mnyam 'bras ster thar pa'i rgyu ru rnal 'byor dbang po rnams kyis bsrung bar bya ba ni/ /rnal 'byor rnams la mchog gi bde ba bskyed par sa bon thig le btang na thar par ga la 'gyur/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i bde ba skad cig ma 'di brtul zhugs can rnams kyis ni rgyun du spang bar bya / /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshigs su bcad pa sum cu lhag pa'i stong phrag gcig pa las mdor bsdus pa dbang rab tu byed pa rdzogs so // //rgya gar gyi paṇḍi /ta mkhas pa chen po sa manta shrī dang / lotstsha dzob dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa // //77—423

par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgru ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud phyi ma/3༄7rna /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba bu sa ma yo ga nge gi gri dzā la sasba ra nā ma utta ra tant+ra / bod skad du/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang cimanyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud phyi pim dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu rab tu phye ba'i lha/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /chags med chags dang bral ba min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya/ /'di ni gnyis med theg pa'i mchog /sgyu ma dag ni thams cad pas/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par che/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mthu dag gis/ /rang bzhin gyis ni de 77—426

'grub pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum 'dir bud med 'dis/ /gus par byed pa dag tu 'gyur/ /rnyed dang bde dang dga' kun gyis/ /ngan par spyod pa'ang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bo yongs bsgyur na/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu mas 'grub/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes brdar bstan to/ /ḍā ni nam mkhar /'gro ba zhes/ /khams las mngon du brtags pa ste/ /nam mkha' kun tu spyod 'grub pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /thams cad ma lus phyag rgya yi / /thams cad ma lus bde mchog gis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /de ni nam mkha' 'gro ba zhes/ /sangs rgyas khams las rnam par brtags / /kun tu 'gro bar grub pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /shaṃ zhes bya ba bde bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde chen yin/ /sgyu ma thams cad rab sbyor ba/ /mchog tu bde bas bde ba'i mchog /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /sangs rgyas la sogs brtan g.yo kun / /kun gyi dngos por bdag gyur to/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /de bzhin bdud dang bdud las rgyal/ /de ni byang chub sangs rgyas yin/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin nyid dang / /de bzhin padmo padmo 'chang / /nor bu nor bu 'dzin nyid dang / /de dag gi yang rigs yin no/ /de nyid 'dod chags 'dod chags bral/ /'dod pa dang ni grol ba'ang yin/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum dang / /'jig rten gsum dang khams gsum dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad pa'i/ /gnas pa thams cad de nyid do/ /'gro ba dag ni ma lus kun/ /thams cad du ni 'di 77—427

'gyur ro/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i /dbyings kyi mtha' mas pa'i/ /dngos po thams cad de yin te/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs rin dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog go/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med par/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ma zuthob pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis thob 'gyur bca/ /de nyid bdag gis dzibartag par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag bde ba'i mchog /bdag nyid shin tu bsgrubs pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag bde mchog go/ /rnal 'byor yang dag ma yin sems/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa dag /rnal 'byor gzugs brnyan rang bzhin te/ /lugs ma la sogs rnal 'byor skye/ /yang dag mchog sems rnal 'byor pa/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa dag /rang gi dam tshig bdag sbyor ba/ /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan lugs la sogs pa la/ /rnal 'byor skye bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /de bas thams cad bdag sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo thams cad bdag yin no/ /de bas bdag nyid lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /de yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnams kyang thams cad dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'as de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas 77—428

thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma /bde ba'i mchog las de ṭā shā nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rtog ripa ste dang 'di ni rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' chubadag sbyor bas/ /dbab pa thams cad rab tu 'grub / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde ba che/ /de ri bas bde ba nyid kyis neni/ /sangs rgyas bde ba kun 'thob bo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde chen po/ /'di la khrus dang sdom tshomi dgos/ /dka' thub dka' ba spyad mi dgos/ /dka' thub sdom pa med pa dang / /bde ba dang ni dga' tshobs 'grub/ /de bas ji 7ltar 'dod spyod cing / /kun za de bzhin thams cad spyod/ /spyad pa ji ltar 'dod par 7byed/ /g.yo ba dag kyang ci dgar 5byed/ /langs pa dang ni 'dug pa'am/ /'chag gam ji ltar gnas kyang rung / /dgod skudam rab tu smra yang rung / /gang na ji ltar spyod kyang rung / /dkyil 'khor du yang ma rmuzhugs pa'am / /sgrib pa kun dang ldan pa'ang rung / /rang gi lhar ni bdag sbyor na/ /bsod nams chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nyid rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /thams cad sgrub par byed pa na/ /ngan pazos ngan spyod thams cad kyis / /nyes pa dag tu yong skumi 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye bar mi thob 7pa/ /sangs rgyas dam pa thams cad de/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga sngodag gis ni / /bsgrubs 77—429

na kun tu thob /'gyur ba/ /bdag nyid grub par byed pa'i mchog /'di ni bdag gis brtag par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpar bdag sbyor ba/ /cha lugs ji bzhin bsgyur ba yis/ /thams cad sna tshogs phyag rgya'i bdag /bsod nams chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgya 'di bsgrub pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlob/ /shin tu byin gyis brlabs rin ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'du bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang gis ldan pa 'di mthong zhing / /rnam pa kun tu mchod byed na/ /de yis sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /mthong zhing mchod pa byas par 'gyur/ /'di dang sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs pa'ang / /bden pa dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /sangs rgyas dngos grub thams cad 'grubaca/ /'di dang sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rnal 'byor thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /bud med dag kyang rnam grol zhing / /sangs rgyas byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid rnam pa thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dngos grub par/ /de yi bdag nyid mthong bar 'gyur/ /'di ni bdag nyid kun gnas pas/ /mchod pa'i sprin chen thams cad kyi / /bkod pa rab 'byam tshogs dag gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa mdzad/ /thams cad bdag nyid sbyor mchod dpal//77—430

rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /bde ba'i /mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor kun la nyer sbyor bas/ /dpal ni gzhir 'gyur 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor kun ni bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /de yi nye bar sbyor ba ni/ /khams gsum ma lus thams cad do/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi longs spyod kyis/ /ji ltar bde bar sten byed cing / /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag nyid rab tu mchod par bya/ /rjes su sbyor bas mchod byed cing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi bde ba dag /bdag nyid kun tu myong byed na/ /shin tu sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur —/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid kyi/ /ra sa ya na bde ba 'dis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal tshe dang / /lang tsho nad med bde mchog 'grub/ /kun tu kun nas thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /rtag tu de ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro 4sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las dpal skyardo rje sems dpa' kun tu sbyor ba'i rtog mapa ste gnyis pa'o// //'di ni rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /cirdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor pa / /dpal ldan rang gi dam tshig bde/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde ba che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bsam/ /mthu nyid kyis ni thams 77—431

cad du/ /phyag rgya bde ba chen po kun/ /so so rjes su rang 'grub 7'gyur/ /rdzurdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas / /mthu nyid kyis ni thams cad du/ / rnal 'byor bde ba myos pa kun/ /so so rjes su rang 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas/ /mthu nyid kyis ni thams cad du/ /bde ba'i myos pa'i dngos grub kun/ /so so'i rjes su rang 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas/ /mthu nyid kyis ni thams cad du/ /bde ba myos pa'i dbang phyug kun/ /so so'i rjes su rang 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas/ /mthu nyid kyis ni thams cad du/ / rinam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' yas pa'i/ /bud med mchog rnams skye bar 'gyur/ /de yi dam tshig ri rmede byung ba / /sdug pa'i dam tshig bdag rjes 'brang / /shin tu sbyor dang sbyor chen po/ /thams cad bdag nyid dam tshig mchog /gcig bzhin du ni gcig spyod pa/ /lhan cig spyod pas rjes spyod sdug ri /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba / /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma mchog tu 'bar/ /thams cad dga' ba ma lus pa'i /phyag rgya thams cad bde ba che/ /rtag pa dam pa lha mo yi / /rgyal mos mchod pa thams cad mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' mesbyor ba dang / /thams cad lha mo 'dus pas ni/ /ma lus skal cib bzang po kun/ /bde bas 5so so rjes su 'grub/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab pa las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' che ba'i lha/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 7klas pa'i/ /lha mo bde ba chen mo 7kun/ /thams cad rnal 'byor bde bas myos/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon 7du/ /phan tshun du ni rab dga' bas/ /skyes bu'i tshul gyis dga' bar byed/ /dbang po kun nas byung ba yis / /mchod pa'i zin chen thams cad kyi/ /77—432

bkod pa rab 'byam tsatshogs rnams kyis/ /thams cad bdag nyid mchod par byed/ /rnal 'byor bde ba thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur bde chen las byung ba/ /rin chen tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /rab tu rmongs pas dbang bskur 'gyur/ /lha mo kun gyi longs spyod la/ /ci bde bar ni bsten bya ba/ /bdag ni che ba'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag la bdag gis rab tu mchod/ /rnal 'byor thams cad bde ba yi / /rjes su sbyor bas rimachod byed cing / /rtag tu myong rtsabar byed pa na/ /shin tu sbyor bas rab 'grub 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid kyi/ /ra sa ya na bde ba des/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal tshe dang / /lang tsho nad med bde mchog 'grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku chen dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung snyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchod pa che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal chen po//rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi gtso/ /rin chen dbang rgyug kun gyi bdag /de dag dang ni dga' spyod na/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /lha mo thams cad grub chen po/ /'khor los sgyur ba rab tu 'grub/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas klas par/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde myos pa / /de las rgya chen mchog gzhan med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde chen des/ /'di la tshe 'di nyid kyis ni/ /rnam pa kun tu mi 'grub pa'i/ /dngos grub kun gyi tshobade myos —pa/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /dbang phyug kun gyi bde myos tshapa/ /dam pa rgya chen gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 77—433

mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog des/ /'di la tshe 'di nyid kyis ni /rnam pa kun tu mi 'grub med/ /ces /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las/ lha mo thams cad dang //sdu /shā sbyor ba skal rib mchog bzang po dpal rdo rje dam tshig gi rtog pa ste 'di ni rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /lha mo kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /skal ba bzang mchog 'dod pa ste/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i bde myong ba/ /'dod chags zer zug brtan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzugs chen cadang / /dbyangs dang dri dang ro dag dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi reg bde mchog /rang gi spyod par rab spyod do/ /sangs rgyas pha rol phyin grub pa/ /gzungs dang sa rnams de bzhin du/ /dga' bar spyod na lha dang mi'i / /skal bzang bud med ci zhig smos/ /lha yi dngos grub dga' ba dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub bde chen po/ /skal ba bzang po bde myong bas/ /so sor 7rjes su rang 'grub 'gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad las byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dpal/ /skal ba bzang po'i 7longs spyod kun/ /rang gi spyod 5par de spyod do/ /rdo rje can gyi grub mchog dang / /'jig rten dang po mchog gi dpal/ /sangs rgyas dga' bas bde dam pa/ /phrogs munas nye bar spyod par byed/ /khams gsum dag na ma lus pa'i/ /77—434

sangs rgyas rgyal srid chen po kun/ /rtsal gyi stobs kyis ngo 'thon :du/ /phrogs nas nye bar spyod par byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi grub chen po/ /mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa dag /kun nas phrogs nas de spyod na/ /longs spyod gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /mthu chen las ni bkra shis brtan/ /phrogs las grub dang dran las ridaga'/ /ngo 'thon stobs kyis phrogs nas kyang / /de ni dad la sbyin par byed/ /ma lus 'jig rten gsum rgyal srid/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kun dang bcas/ /ngo 'thon stobs kyis phrogs tshonas kyang / /de ni dad la sbyin par byed/ /tshangs pa 'jug sel dbang chen gyi/ /mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa dag /kun nas phrogs te rnamyur sbyin na/ /longs spyod gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /de yis mi sbyin ci yang med/ /sangs rgyas don du bya ba kun/ /mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ /sbyin pa dang ni byed pa'ang yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /phrogs munas kyang ni sbyin byed na/ /las mchog dang ni rab 'byam dang / /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /dngos grub mchog ni gdon mi za/ /sde rnams thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi grub chen po/ /'khor los sgyur 5ba rab grub pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdzu 'phrul che/ /rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu 'jug /la lar byang chub sems chen po/ /la lar spyod pa mthun 7par 'gro/ /la lar dga' ldan lha dag las/ /dam pa shin tu 'pho ba'o/ /la lar skye ba rnam par dag /la lar nges par —'byung bar gsal/ /la lar byang chub chen por gshegs/ /la lar bdud las rab tu rgyal/ /la lar byang chub mngon 'tshang rgya/ /la lar 77—435

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /la lar pha rol mu stegs rnams/ /chos dang mthun kyipar tshar gcad rido/ /la lar 'jig rten gsum rgyal ba/ /grub pa kun gyi dbang phyug nyid/ /la lar rtog pa thams cad mchog /grub pa'i dbang phyug bla na med/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /sangs rgyas kun bdag bde mchog gis/ /'dul ba'i thabs su nges pa'i gar/ /rnam par sprul pas dgyes cishing rol/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /brtan pa dbang rgyug chen po'i bdag /gzugs dang tshe dang kha dog stobs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin /'gro ba dag gis bsnyen bya zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis mchod / /lha mo kun gyi dpal ldan mchog /rdo rje sems dpar rab tu 'grub/ /sems can khams ni du ma dag /ma lus par ni phyag rgyas 'debs/ /lha dang byang chub dka' ba rnams/ /brtan par sems can dag la smin(ge/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag bde mchog gis/ /sems can kun 5gyi don byed cing / /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /bskal pa kun tu srid par gnas/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las sna tshogs thams cad kyi /kā rsha lta/nga po mchog gi dngos grub ces bya ste/ dpal dam tshig gi rtog ( pa 'di ni rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid/ /ji tsho ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar/ /77—436

rtog pa'i cho ga thams cad la/ /grub pa dam pa mchog gi mchog /sna tshogs las kyi /sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga sna tshogs 'dod pa yi/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul ba dang / /bde ba thams cad 'grub pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor de nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam 'phrul bas/ /sems can kun don rnam 'phrul na/ /myur du shin tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyin re'am yang na zla re 'am/ /yang na de bzhin lo re ni / /ci bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas kyang —/ /sangs rgyas bde mchog gar bya'o/ /khams kyi ngo bo thams cad dang / /de bzhin srog dang rtsa las 'byung / /rang gi lha yi cha lugs su/ /bsgrub cipa'i phyag rgya gerab tu bya/ /dkyil 'khor gang dang gang bsten pa/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya'i mchod pa yis/ /slob ma'i tshogs kun de dang der/ /mchod pa byas nas des bsgrub bo/ /de las gzhan yang rtog kun gyi / /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam sprul pa/ /ci rigs par ni sprul byas pa'i/ /gtam dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gis tshodagyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /'di ni rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /rtag pa dam pa brtan skupa ste/ /rtag tu da ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ /ngo bo nyid ni 'da' bar dka' / /cho ga sna tshogs 'dod rnams la/ /las kyi sbyor ba sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin la sogs/ /'dul ba'i phyir ni byas pa yin/ /sangs rgyas la sogs brtan g.yo kun/ /kun gyi dngos por 'di 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /sgyu ma'i spyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs kun gyi mchog /sems can kun gyi 77—437

don mchog rnams/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'dul bas 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje sem/ /ṭī dī ṭā /pas naphyu byedab /nga// ba/ /ba//dag nyid chen po /rtag pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu stong pa nyid la brtson/ /'gog pa'i chos nyid la sbyor bas/ /'gags shing yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /grol ba thams cad rnam sbyang phyir/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa kun tu bskyed/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /thabs dang risnying rje bdag nyid rnams/ /de bas de ni snying rje'i thabs / /shes rab pha rol phyin par gsal/ /rtog cipa med pa'i chos rnams la / /sems can don du yongs brtags pa/ /rnam par mi rtog la mos pas/ /thams cad rtog pas brtag par bya/ /brag cha tshoyi ni sgra 'dra ba( / /chos kyi tshig tu de 'gyur te/ /de las theg pa chen po yi/ /yang dag yon tan rgyas pa'i glus / /dus gsum pa yi dam tshig gsum/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bstod/ /mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshotshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod pa'ang min/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba skurnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub 77—438

mchog rnams nges par spyolasna/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa'i thugs rje'i /shugs las byung — /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rirab tu brtson sapa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral bas shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog spyol mdzad/ /thugs je spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ /ye ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi dang na go 'phang mchog brnyes pas / /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum tshadangos grub dam pa bdag la spyol— /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan cig rtsi tsam ni brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur / /sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid sbyor bas/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di nyid kyis/ /dus gsum pa yi rgyal ba kun/ /dam tshig gsum gyis 'grub par 'gyur /sku ni lta bas mi ngoms pa/ /thams cad bdag nyid bstan nas kyang —/ /legs so zhes nas dngos grub ni/ /mchog rnams kun ni rab smin mdzad / /thams cad bdag nyid 'grub dga' dang / /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas 'grub pa mchog kun dang / /rnal 'byor dam pa'ang sbyin par mdzad/ /de nas de yis bsgrub ngapa dang / /shin tu rtag pa'i dngos grub dag /gang gis srid pa 'di nyid la/ /dngos grub shin tu rtag thob bshad/ /rdo rje se gol gtogs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu 77—439

bar bya/ /thal mo legs par sbyar ba yis / /thal mo lan gsum rnam par brdab /dbang po gang dang chigang lam gyur/ /de dang de yi ngo bor bya/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor zhing / /ji ltar mos pa'i chags pa dang / /ṣa ḍa pa la sogs pa yis / /ci nas yongs su ma skyo bar/ /rtag tu tshad med bzlas par bya/ /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni / /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /sangs rgyas kun tu dngos grub pa/ /rab tu mthong zhing mchog grub pa'o/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /de bzhin dpa' bo thams cad dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan bsngags pa rgya che ba / /bstod pa'i rgyal po mchog ni lan cig glur blangs pas/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor dam pa rtag pa'i mchog /dngos grub mi zad bde ba'i mchog nyid thob par 'gyur/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid dbang phyug mchog /sna tshogs kun gyis rnam 'dul ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun grub ste/ /de bas dam tshig gsum la sogs/ /rtog pa bla med thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi mtha' 7klas pa'i/ /sems can kha~Xs ni rnam par grol / /dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbugs phyung pa/sa// pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /'gro ba'i tshul du sngon byung ba/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu khro gtum gdug par 'gyur / /shin tu gdug par khro ba yis/ /'o dod 'bod par lhung bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'phos 77—440

nas sems can de/ /bag chags kyis ni mtshams sbyor bas/ /shin tu gdug pa chen por gyur/ /blo ni bdud kyis byin brlabs ①nas/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /phra med rim dang gnod sbyin rigadon/ /bdud dang rnam par log 'dren nyid/ /shin tu gdug pa chen por 'gyur / /gnas gsum po ni 'jigs byed cing / /sgrub pa po rnams la yang za/ /lha la sogs pa'ang 'pho bar byed/ /bstan pa dag kyang 'jig par byed/ /de nas dbang por bcas pa'i lha/ /tshangs pa'i drung du nye bar dong / /tshangs pa'ang lha dang dbang por bcas/ /'jug sel la yang skyabs su dong / /tshangs dang 'jug sel lha rnams kyang / /lha chen drung du nye bar dong / /tshangs pa 'jug sel dbang chen yang / /rdo rje can la skyabs su dong / /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje se gol phyag rgyas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpung pa gnyis ni rdo rjer bcings/ /rdo rje se gol brdabs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu mdzad na/ /de yi bka' tsam gyis skrag nas/ /'khor dang 'khor lo'i tshogs bcings pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /rdo rje se gol gtogs pa yis / /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyis til 'bru bzhin du rgyas/ /shin tu gdug 7par gtum po la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo yi/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag sreg gyed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma 77—441

lus smos ci tshodagos/ /de nas sna yi rtse mo la/ /yid ni brtan par yang dag gzung — /sna yi dbugs ring dro ba las/ /rgyal bas phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 0byung / /bcom ldan de nyid rnal 'byor ba/ /rdo rje khro bor gyur nas byung / /dpal chen rdo rje he ru ka /'bar bas thal bas rab tu 'jig /sems dpa' sngon por 'bar ba'i ngang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar por 'bar/ /'jig shu pa chen po'i dus ltar drag /dur khrod kyi ni me dang 'dra/ / 'bar ba chen po sgra 'bar ba /cithod pa mang po'i dbu rgyan can/ /'jig gepa chen po'i ri dus ltar drag /dur khrod bzhin du rab tu 'jigs / /khro la sogs pa'i tshul ldan pa/ /zhal rnams sna tshogs 'gyur ba dang / /smin ma khro gnyer bcas par 'gyur/ /'bar ba'i lta bas gar byas pas/ /gu lang dbang chen nye dbang bcas nyi zla gshin rje tshangs par bcas/ /gnas gsum dag ni 'bar byas nas/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu bshig /rdo rje rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ tsho ga /dril bu'i sgra ni gsil skab yis /thams cad phab nas slar yang ni/ /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed / /de yi 'bar ba nyi ma las/ /byung ba'i grib ma mi bzad 7pa/ /bskyed nas ma lus bdud rtel sogs/ /gdug pa rnams kyi khrag za nus/ /rgyal po de ni de dag dang / /lhan cig dur khrod rnam par rol/ /thams cad rdo rje mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor 'bar ba yis/ /shin tu gdug cing khro drag pa'i/ /sems can khams ni rnam sbyangs nas/ /dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dag la bkod/ /rdo rje 'dod khro la sogs kyi / /rtog pa bla med thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 7klas pa'i /sems can khams ni rnam par sbyangs/ /dpal nye ru nas dbugs glu77—442

phyung pa/sa// pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab /la/ /'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba/ /de tshe thems can thams cad ni/ /log par lta la gnas par gyur / /shin tu lta ba ngan pa yis/ /'o dod 'bod pa chen por lhung / /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /byang chub sems ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /padmo chags par sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje chos su gnas par 'gyur/ /ji riltar padma cadamar po 'di/ /tshon gyi nyes pas mi gos pa / /de bzhin bag chags khams gsum gyi/ /nyes pa sna tshogs rnam par dag /'dis ni kun tu gzigs pas na/ /rgyal ba dbang rgyug nyid du 'gyur/ /dpal ldan spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'dod chags thams cad dag pas na/ /mchog sbyin dam pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'dul ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /sna tshogs pa ni 'dul bar sgro/ /kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal/ /padma gar gyi dbang phyug gyur/ /padmo'i rgyal po mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog des/ /padma tshogar dbang la sogs kyi/ /rtog pa bla med thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' dzhakras pa'i/ /sems can khams ni rnam par sbyangs/ /dpal padma tshagar gyi dbang phyug gis dbugs rgyung ba'o// //'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /shin tu gdug cing brkam par 'gyuram/ /shin du 'thungs par gyur pa yis/ /yi dgas larnams dang dmyal bar lhung / /de 77—443

nas 'phos nas slar yang ni/ /shin tu dbul por / skyes par gyur/ /bkres dang skom pa'i skyon rnams kyis/ /de dag phan tshun gsod par byed/ /shin tu gdug pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor de ni bcom ldan 'das/ /dam pa'i don ni nor chen po/ /rdo rje nyi ma byung bar gyur/ /dam mkha'i snying pos thams cad phyogs/ /kun gyi re ba yongs rdzogs rimadzad/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /mkha' las rin chen thams cad 'bebs/ /shin tu gdug cing khro ba la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi nyi ma ni/ /rab tu gdung ba kun bsgrubs pas/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /dbrog pas kyang ni khyad par du/ /rgyal bar byas nas gnas gsum gyi/ /nor gyi tshogs kun sdud par byed/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal la sogs kyi/ /rtog pa bla med thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /sems can khams ni rab tu dgrol / /dpal rdo rje nyi mas dbugs phyung ba'o// //'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /brtson 'grus shin tu chung bar gyur / /shin tu brtson 'grus chung ba yis/ /mnar med pa yi dmyal bar lhung / /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /drag shul sbyor ba'i tshul dag tu/ /rtag mchog dpal ni byung bar 'gyur / /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon gdu/ /pha rol gnon pa'i rtsal dag gis/ /shin tu gdug cing khro gtum pa'i/ /sems can rnam pa mang po'i khams/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'jig /byi ba rkun 77—444

po chom po yis/ /thams cad rnam par sbyong bar byed/ /brid /pa dang ni sgyu dag dang / /ngo 'thon ristobs kyis de bzhin du/ /dgra cha lnga yis brgal nas ni / /de tshe 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /skye 'gro gnas pa 'gro ba rnams/ /mtha' dag btul nas 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dul ba'i thabs rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /rang gi rgyal srid rtag tu skyong / /g.yem pa rnams la g.yem par 'gyur / /khro ba rnams la khro ba'i mchog /zhi ba rnams la zhi ba'i mchog /drag shul can la drag pos gnon/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon du/ /dbang phyug dam pa rab mnan nas/ /lha mo gi mo phrogs nas ni/ /de tshe longs spyod rang gir spyod/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon /du/ /mthu bo che yang rab mnan nas/ /rug mi ni yang laphrogs nas ni/ /de tshe longs spyod rang gir spyod/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon 2du/ / skye dgu'i tshabadag po rab mnan nas/ /lha mo rab tu zhi ba 'phrogs / /de tshe longs spyod rang gir spyod /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon pas/ /'dod pa'i lha ni rab mnan nas /dga' sdug mi yi dbang phyug ma/ /phrogs lanas de tshe nye bar spyod/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 7klas par/ /rdo rje las mchog rnam gnon pa/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu gnas/ /thabs dang rtsal gyi 5grub pa yis/ /drag shul sbyor bas bsgrubs na ni/ /khams gsum rgyal srid ma lus par/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa des thob nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas mchog /drag shul sbyor bas grub par byed/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon 7du/ /rtsal gyis 77—446

pha rol gnon pa yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu 'grel/ /lha yi dngos grub dka' ba dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub bde chen po/ /go 3)'phang mchog gi rtag pa dag /rang gis rnal 'byor gyis thob nas/ /sems can khams ni du ma dag /ma lus par ni rgyas 'debs shing / /'chi med byang chub dka' ba dag /sems can rnams la brtan par sbyin/ /rta mchog rnam par sprul pa yis/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /bskal pa kun tu srid par gnas/ /sems can kun gyi don kyang byed/ /de ltar rta mchog dpal la sogs/ /rtog pa bla med thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' snyems pa'i/ /sems ca/ khams rnams rab tu bsgrubs/ /dpal rta mchog gis dbugs phyung de bal ༄so//gas pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /rang byung rnams kyi gegatam gyi rtags /nam mkha' /kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu gnas /grub pa'i dbang phyug rab grub pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid 'jug par byed/ / zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas de skad gsungs so /ngasangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par / sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las gtam gyi phyag rgya zhes pa rtog pa ste lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang thams cad du/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mchog 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde mchog bshad/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi dzodangos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde 'byung ba/ /77—446

gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snang ba bde/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha rdzas mchog /rin chen rgyan la sogs pas spras/ /dril bu rgyal mtshan mchog ldan pa'i/ /bla re dam pa bres pa min/ /rdo rje glu dang mchod la sogs/ /glu dang sil snyan rnam par 'phrul/ /me tog bdug pa'i sbyor ba dang / /mar me dri dang sogs ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog bsgrub / /yang na bdag gi gnas dag gam / /skyed rimos tshal la sogs par bsgrub / /der ni dang por gdan gshams te/ /'jam zhing reg na bde 'gyur ba/ /sna tshogs padma ciras kyis g.yogs/ /de ni thams cad dag pa'i gdan/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /spyor ba'i dbang phyug rnam 'phrul bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha/ /de na rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad/ /stan de dag ni thams cad la/ /ci ( )ltar gnas pa bzhin du dgod/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes par byas/ /rdo rje rin chen padma sogs/ /sgo srung tshodang ni ldan par byas/ /rang gi lha dang 'dra ba yi / /bud med dag ni legs bsgrubs pa//skal bzang rang gi phyag rgyas mtshan/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor brtag 7par bya/ /mi yi mtshal 7ni grub pa la/ /dmar chen po zhes bya bar bshad/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mthu dag dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni de grub pa'ong/ /rdo rje'i chu dang rdo rjer bcas / /mtshal chen po dag bsgrub lapa ni/ /mthu yis rab tu grub pa ste/ /padma'i masnod kyi dzadang du bzhag /chags pa chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i thugs/ /dam 77—447

tshig /'di ni 'da' bar dka'/ /de yi mtshal spyadang khu ba dang / /mtshal chen po ni bsgrub ripa dag /chags pa chen po las byung bas/ /dmar chen po zhes bya bar bshad/ /dmar chen dang ni ga bur bcas/ /tsandan dmar por sbyar ba dag /tshogs kyi dbus su bzhag pa ni/ /ra sa ya na cikun slong ba/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ldan pas/ /srin lag dang ni mthe bo'i rtses/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na / /rtag pa yi ni dngos grub thob/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid kyi/ /ra sa ya na bde ba 'dis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dang gzhan/ /nad med pa dang bde mchog 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gis/ /'dus pa der ni zhugs pa dag /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /sangs rgyas la sogs brtan g.yo kun/ /kun gyi dngos ngo ra de 'gyur ro/ /'dis rini bsrung tshob byas pas dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro bde mchog gis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid 'grub/ /de nas khrus byas dri zhim lus/ /ci 'byor pa yi gos dang rgyan/ /sna tshogs gos bzang bgos nas ni/ /me tog phreng ldan kha dri zhim/ /sna tshogs kun gyis 7skal bzang pos/ /slong bas dal gyis dal gyis su/ /gos dgab pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi 'byung ba bskul bar bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla rnams/ /shar ba dag ni mthong ba yis//sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /bsod nams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur /nges pa'i lam dang kun ldan pa/ /rnam par 'das pas rnam par brgyan /brtan zhing grub pa slong byed pa/ /kun nas slong ba'i bde ba ni/ /77—448

stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthus/ /nam mkha' nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs 3su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag /'di dag nyid kyi glur blangs na/ /shin tu mya ngan yongs 'das pa'i/ /shi ba'ang slar ni slongs ri'agyur na/ /yang srid pa lta ci zhig smos/ /lam bzhi dang ni mnyam ldan pa/ /rnam par 'das pas mdzes par byas/ /sna tshogs 'brang bar cirab tu 'grub/ / 'jig rten gsum ni rab bsgrub pa/ / 'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /'jig rten gsum gyi ston pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum la gaskyid sbyin pa/ /'jig rten gsum po bdag la bsgrubs / /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal ཿsbyor ba/ /lha mo kun dang 'grogs pa yis/ /sna tshogs kun gyi skal bzang po/ /a ra li ni kun 'grub 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /lha mo kun dang bde myos 7pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag rdzogs/ /nyi ma zla ba gsal bar 'char / /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag sbyor/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog 'byung /lan cig dmigs pa tsam gyis kyang / /bde ba'i dngos grub kun 'byung ba/ /brtan zhing grub pa slong byed pa/ /sna tshogs 'brang bas de bzhin du / / gan sarba dang ṣa ḍa ba'i / /glu dbyangs sna tshogs glus bsgrub papo/ /de nas de nyid dam pa yis/ /thar ba thams cad rmongs pa yi / / rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid dpal / /glu 'di yis ni bskul bar bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i rnam mang dga' ba'i padma 7ni / /rnam dag mchod pas gsal bar rjes su mchod byas nas/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas bde 2grub snyemadzod / /kye ma'o mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba 77—449

shin tu rnal 'byor skal bzang mchog dgyes pa/ /rang gi 77dam tshig skyon med dag la rol cig rol cig ho/ /kye ma mchog tu gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi dam tshig ni / /yin pa'i phyir na rab tu gsang ba'i lha mo mchog rnams so/ /'gro ba'i rgyud ni rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul ba'i thabs ni cigasal bar mkhyen/ /dam tshig thams cad dngos po brtan dang gyirigayo ba kun gyi ngo bor gyur/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid rnal 'byor bde ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma ho/ /kye ma dam pa )rtag pa'i dngos grub chen po rab tu sgrub tsho pa ston/ /dzaX sne baṃ hoX mun ma'o bde mchog bde bar drongs/ /rnam par sprul rgyu snang bar mdzod/ /a la la ho/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs kyis/ /slob ma dag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /glu yi rgyal po 'di dag ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal la gnas/ /kun gyi sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /ma lus lus pa med par ⑩'grub /glu 'di dag ni len pa na/ /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam 'phrul ba/ /ma lus lus pa med par snang / /rnam pa mang po'i 'dod chags rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma'i bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /te tshan te te snye/ rnam pa comang po parab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyis lasems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam rol sprul cig sprul / /rgyu hūṃ rgyu/ rnam pa mang po khro bo'i pargyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /ru lu ru lu rgyu spyo 'i rgyu/77—450

rnam pa mang po srog gi rgyud kyis /sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /hūṃ shi gyi gi ṣa snye/ de la sogs te rimatha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa'i/ /nam mkha'i pyidabyings kyi mtha' ri klas pa'i/ /rang byung rnams kyi glu yi rgya/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la ni gnas/ /grub pa'i dbang rgyug rab grub pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid grub par 'gyur/ /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa dang / /lha mo kun gyis rab bskul nas/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid 'grub/ /dbang po kun las byung ba yi/ /mchod pa'i khrin chen rnam bkod pa/ /rab 'byam tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /kun gyi bdag nyid mchod par byed/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gis/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid lus/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /ston pa'i phyag rgya phab pa yis/ /bud med dag kyang bsgrubs nas ni/ /rdo rjer bcas pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor mar ni tshorab tu 'gyur/ /de dag rang gi lha rnams dang / /'dra bar byin gyis brlabs bsgrubs nas/ /sngon med rol mo'i sil snyan gar / /rnam par 'phrul bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha yi gzugs dang sgra dang dri/ /ro dang reg bya bde myos 7pas/ /bdag nyid rang gi lhar mthong zhing / /mchod pa dag kyang byed par 'gyur/ /lha yi mchod pa mnyam sbyor ba/ /skal bzang mchog gi 'dod chags can/ /rnam pa kun tu skal bzang po'i/ /bde ba yang dag sgrub 7par byed/ /sangs rgyas sgyu mas byin brlabs pas/ /skordo rje sems 77—451

dpa' mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ba rnams/ /dkyil 'khor mthong dka' myong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tsamanyam sbyor ba'i/ /mthu nyid kyis ni thams cad du/ /sna tshogs kun gyi skal bzang po/ /rang gi bde ba nyid kyis 'grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzugs chen dang / /dbyangs dang dri dang ro bde bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid du/ /de yis rab mthong mchod par byed/ /mchod pa thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /skal bzang mchog gis 'dod chags can/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag sanyid kyi / /dngos grub ma lus lus med 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid gar/ /rnam par rol pa mchog tu snang / /de nas yang dag rab gsang bas/ /bud med dag ni bzhi rnams dang / /gar gyi phyag rgya mchod pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /rab tu dga' ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /oṃ snye/ dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ rgyu/ mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /oṃ hūṃ/ mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ / glu yi phyag rgya 'di ni dpal / /rdo rje sems dpa' la gnas te/ /mchod pa ma lus lus med pa'i/ /rab 'byam tsholas la'ang sbyar du rung / /gang dag grub par ma gyur dang / /mchod pa dag ni mi 'byor ba/ /phyag rgya 'di yis mchod byas na / /mchod pa thams cad myur du 'grub/ /mchod pa'i sbyor ba 'di dag dang / /lha mo bzhi po dag gis ni/ /me tog la sogs mchod byas nas/ /slob ma thams cad gzung skyabar byas / /dngos grub 'dod pas ci 'dod par / /snyim pa'i gar ni kun 77—452

bskyod nas/ /de dag gdong ni mdzes pa yi/ /ras kyis g.yogs te gzung bar bya/ /dngos grub ji /ltar 'thob 'dod par/ /slob ma me tog 'thor du gzhug( ri /lha mo gang la lhung ba ni/ /lha de de la 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas gdong ni bkrol nas kyang / /yon gyi mchog ni blang bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur bas/ /ci rilta bar ni dbang bskur ro/ /dmar chen po dang ga pur bcas/ /tsandan dmar po cisbyar ba rnams/ /tshogs kyi dbus su bzhag pa la/ /g.yon pa mtshan 'dzin rdo rje bcas/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor ldan/ /srin lag dang ni mthe bong rtses/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na/ /rtag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i tshogs kyis kyang / /rgyas mi thebs shing mi rmongs te/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas mna' ni bsgags dzobyas nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthun pa yis / /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' stsal pa/ /dam tshig sdom pa sbyin 7par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /sdom pa nyams par khyed byed pa/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha dag dang ni mi rnams dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor grub pa po / /de dag la ni snying rings nas / /snying las khrag chen 'thungs pa bzhin/ /sems can khams ni ma lus don / /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du ba ba par bya / /bdag gi ngo bo yongs spangs shing / /dka' thub kyis ni gzir mi bya/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar spyad / /'di ni phyi dus sangs rgyas yin/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la/ /cis kyang mi 77—453

'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /rig pa med kyis yokhyed ma 'jigs/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /grub pa gcig pu gcig la spyod(mi/ /lhan cig spyod dang rjes spyod sdug /sangs rgyas byang chub bla med yin/ /yang dag nyid kyis rtag tu bsten / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /de skad bka' stsal dpal ldan gyis/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /rdo rje can gyis bka' stsal to/ /rnal 'byor bcas dang gsang bcas pa'i/ /bdag gi ye shes rgya bsgrubs nas/ /ci cilta'i tshul bzhin gar byed pas( ri/ /slob ma rnams la bde bar sbyin/ /slob ma dam pas de phyin chad/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes rjes bzung nas / /rnam par snang mdzad mchog bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ri bdag nyid grub/ /de nas ro dang zas dang gnas/ /glu dang sil snyan la sogs pa/ /de dag mgon po rnams la dbul/ /rdo rje bla ma chen po dang / /bdag dang gzhan la 'dod dgus mchod/ /'dod don 'bras bu phun tshogs 'grub/ /de nas bdag nyid rab bsgrubs nas/ /kun gyi slob dpon rab gnas pa/ /ci lta'i tshul bzhin 'jug pa yis/ /bden pa'i chos ni brjod par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi tshul/ /rtog pa thams cad rab bsgrubs shing / /rtog pa kun la tshorab sbyor ba'i / /ngo bo nyid phyir chen po'i mchog /sna tshogs las kyi sbyor ba dang / /'dul ba'i bdag nyid sna tshogs pas/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /de las gzhan pa'i tshul du bstan/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /thar pa thams cad rnam sbyang phyir/ /'gro skyaba'i mkha' 'gro byung bar 'gyur / /rang gi lha dang 'dra ba yisa'i/ /rang gi byin rlabs cobasgrub mapa'i rgyas/ /phyag rgya ci ṇi77—454

bzhin rjes mthun 0pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /dam tshig la sdang rnam cisbyang phyir/ /thams cad rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'byung bar 'gyur / /gzhan yang shin tu rnal 'byor pa/ /ma lus padma 4rnam sbyang phyir/ /skal bzang dam pa mi 'gyur ba/ /padma sgyu ma 'byung bar 'gyur / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das/ /nor gyi mchog gis rnam sbyang phyir/ /dam mkha' kun gyi bdag po che/ /rdo rje nyi ma dpal 'byung 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /drag shul sbyor ba sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rta mgrin pha rol rab gnon pa/ /rta mchog rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rang gi lha dang 'dra ba yis//rang gi byin rlabs bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gzugs brnyan ngo bor sbyor ba yi / /phyag rgya'i sbyor bas gar bya'o/ /dam tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ //de ltar rnam par spyod na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog 'grub/ /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /sangs rgyas 'phrul pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /sangs rgyas la sogs brtan g.yo kun/ /kun gyi dngos por de 'gyur ro/ /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag nyid rnam par 'phrul pa ston/ /lha mo kun dang 'dus pa yis/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ma lus par / /sangs rgyas sprul pa grub par byed/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa sgyu ma yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa ston/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma gar byed pas/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus par/ /dngos po kun tu de 'gyur ro/ /padma 7sgyu ma rnam 'phrul pas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 77—455

'dzin la sogs/ /sna tshogs gzugs byed rim pa yis// /'gro ba thams cad mgu bar byed/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che/ /mjal ri dum g.yul 'gyed ri grub pa dag /rgyal srid sgyu ma rnam 'phrul pas/ /bya ba thams cad ston par byed / /khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che/ /bdag skul phod sapas mnan nas ni /'gro ba thams cad rab 'joms ( par/ /rta yi gar gyis ston par byed/ /de la sogs pa mtha' pas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' glas pa'i/ /sna tshogs kun gyi bde mchog gis/ / nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dpal dgyes tshorol pa rnam 'phrul ba/ /sna tshogs kyis ni rnam par rol/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skal bzangango / /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog gis/ /'dul ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can khams ni rab tu bsgruba'o/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 7klas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung ba'i mchog /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gnas te/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rab bsgrubs pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid grub par byed/ /ces tshabacom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las lha/༷ /kta //sdu /da mnyam par stor ba mkha' 'gro bsgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi pade nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha/ /rnam 77—456

pa sna tshogs kun gyi mchog /'khor lo thams cad rnam sprul pa'o/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na / /thams cad bdag nyid rjes su bsgrub / /dben pa yi ni gnas dag gam/ /rang gi skyed rimos tshal sogs par/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal cabazang po/ /kun tu sna tshogs bde mchog gis/ /kun tu sna tshogs dgos pa'i rirnams/ /ci bde bar ni bsgrub par bya/ /rten dang dgon pa gtsug lag khang / /ri yi rtse rnams thams cad du/ /rnam pa du ma sna tshogs pa / /sangs rgyas dgos pa bsgrub par bya/ /dur khrod dang ni lha rten dang / /ma mo'i gnas la sogs 'dug na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgos pa dag /rnam pa du mar 'grub par 'gyur/ /padmo'i skyed mos tshal dga' dang / /chu bo dag gi tshomado dag tu/ /padma —'dzin pa'i dgos pa rnams/ /yang dag par ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dga' ba dang / /rgyal po'i skyed skomos tshal dag tu/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /rgyal po'i dgos pa bsgrub par bya/ /mkhar skuni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin chu bo'i 'gram dag gam/ /rgyal khams gzhan las grub pa ru/ /rdo rje rta ni bsgrub par bya/ /cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /sgrub pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dgos pa la/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs rab tu sgrubaci/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi padma rmudamar / /phyag na rdo rje sna tshogs la/ /'jig rten dbang gi kha dog dkar/ /rdo rje nyi ma dpal gyi gser / /kha dog kun dang ci 'byor ba/ /bla re rgyal mtshan rgyan gyi 5rnams/ /thams cad rab tu sgrub tshopa dpal/ /rta mchog rdo rje can gyi'o/ /gnas dang 'khor rnams ci 'dra dang / /bkod dang 'gro ba ci 'dra dang / /'khor rnams bkod pa ci 'dra bar/ /de 'dra'i 'khor lo mchog 77—457

gis mdzad/ /ci rdo rje sems dpa'i ri lha rnams kyi/ /'khor lo mngon sum mthong ba las/ /bsod nams brtag di pa ci 'dra ba/ /gyis bris pa yang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor thig btab shes rab can/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid bsgrub cacing / /shar nub byang gi phyogs dag tu/ /thig bzhi btab pas dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag ci 'dra bar/ /rab tu rtag gepar su zhig nus/ /rang gis lha yi ri tshorang bzhin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor brtag pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rang gis 0lhar sbyor bas/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang na'ang tsho〉/ /nyes pa med de 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /kun tu sna tshogs 'khor lo can/ /kun tu sna tshogs grub 7pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu sna tshogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor skum po sangs rgyas kyi/ /rdo rje can gyi zla gam bzhin / /padma'i 7dbang gi padma'i 5dbyibasam/ /rin chen mchog gi rin chen dbyibs /ji ltar 'dod pa ci 'byor pa/ /ci melta'i dus dang ci bde bar/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu gnas par dpal/ /rta mchog phyag rgya rdo rje'i 'om/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dag /gsang ba yang dag mi shes pas/ /bsgrubs kyang ci yang mi 'grub po/ /srog chags gsad 7par mi bya zhing / /dkon mchog gsum ni yong mi spang / /byang chub sems ni mi gtang paste/ /slob dpon skal bzang yong mi gtang ⑫/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang por/ /bdag rang bsgrubs pas skal ba bzang / /bdag med chos nyid dang ldan pa/ /dam tshig la snang skal ba ngan/ /srid pa shin tu bsgrubs pas na/ /skal bzang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /skal 77—458

ngan nyan thos 'jig rten na/ /shin tu yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa thams cad bsgrub / pa'i phyir/ /skal bzang phyag na rdo rje dpal/ /stong pa nyid la rab sbyor bas/ /rang rgyal rnams ni skal ba ngan/ /'dod chags thams cad rnam dag pas/ /skal bzang spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /log par lta dang ldan pas na/ /skal ngan 'jig rten mu stegs na / /dam pa'i nor mchog sdud pa'i phyir/ /skal bzang rdo rje nyi ma dpal/ /bdag gi bu yang ma chags pas/ /skal ngan dka' thub spyod pa kun/ /rgyal srid mchog rnams kun bsdus pas /rta mchog dpal ni skal ba bzang / /bdag med yongs su 'dzin med pas/ /thub pa thams cad skal ba ngan/ /bde ba thams cad bdag sgrub phyir/ /kun gyi slob dpon skal ba bzang / /lta ngan dam tshig la snang pa'i mi/ /slob ma thams cad skal ba ngan/ /gsang ba'i don ni yang dag nyid/ /'di ni gsal bar shes pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas kun tu 'grub par gyur / /kun gyi slob dpon la gnas pas/ /'khor lor 'jug par byed pa na/ /dkyil 'khor 'dod pa'i slob ma la/ /gsang ba yang dag mtha' yas mchog /thog ma nyid du gsang brjod pa / /kye khyod ci la dga' zhes dri5 sna/ /skal ba bzang la bdag dga' zhes/ /'jug pa pos ri )kyang smra bar bya / /gsang ba'i yan lag 'dir shes na/ /ci tsholtar 'dod par rab tu gzhug /gsang ba yang dag mi shes te/ /g.yas pa yis ni gzhug par bya/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ /de bzhin shin tu yon dbul —rte/ /gsang ba'i cho ga nyid shes pas/ /mi 'gyur pa yi mchog 'grub bo/ /kun tu sna tshogs bla ma la/ /yonamachog dag ni dbul bar nges/ /gang la yongs su 77—459

gtang /dka' gang / /de ni mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /gang dang gang ni sdug pa'i mchog /yang na shin tu khyad par can/ /de dang de ni bla ma la/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pas dbul/ /yang na de ni 'dod 'gyur ba'am/ /'on te sems la dgos pa dag /de sbyin yang na dgos pa bya/ /de ni chung yang mchog yin no/ /de la gal te mchog bdog la/ /de yang ngan pa'i yon 'bul na/ /kun gyi slob dpon brnyas pas na/ /de ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob/ /bu mo shin tu brgyan pa 'am/ /de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /bul nas rin gyis blu chub ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog sugi yon/ /ma 0chen dag ni phul nas su / /slar yang rin gyis blu ba ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin dpal sbyor ba yi / /'on tshote mchog gi yon yin no/ /mu tig bzang dang nor bu dang / /shin tu dkar ba'i ras zung dang / /de bzhin rta ni dkar po dag /padma 7can gyi yon mchog yin/ /rgyal srid longs spyod gter rnams dang / /gos dang rgyan gyi tshogs rnams dang / / de bzhin mchod pa thams cad ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i yon yin no/ /shin tu brgyan pa'i rta dag dang / /glang po shin tu brgyan 7pa dang //shing rta rin chen gang ba dag /rta yi rgyal po'i yon yin no/ /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dang / /srog dang rtsa ba'i de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur ba/ /mkhas pas rnam pa sna tshogs brtag /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba dang / /'gram cipa gnyis dang ltag lapa ru/ /sangs rgyas rin chen thams cad kyi/ /dbu rgyan mi 'gyur dam pa'o/ /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dam/ /srog dang rtsa ba'i —de bzhin te/ /thod pa rin chen dbu rgyan nam//sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag snye /kun tu sna tshogs bla mar ni/ /kun gyi 77—460

slob dpon kun la bya/ /rgyal srid thams cad rnam dag la/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rin chen ngo mtshar gcig las byas/ /de bzhin sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /sangs rgyas padma'i dbang bskur bas/ /slob ma thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /sangs rgyas rin chen rdo rje byed / /rdo rje rigs la rdo rje yin / /spyan ras gzigs kyi sangs rgyas sku/ /nor bu 'dzin gyi nor bu yin/ /sangs rgyas rin chen padma cadang / /rdo rje nor bu de bzhin du/ /thams cad mchog ni rta mchog la/ /rang gi dbang bskur bsdus pa'o/ /blugs pa dang ni byas pa 'am/ /brdungs pa'am yang ni bris pa'ang rung / /sna tshogs rab tu legs 0pa yi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya rab tu brtag /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /rang byung rnams kyi mtshan ma'i rgya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /lha mo rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /gzhu dang mda' dang de bzhin du/ /skal ldan de bzhin skal ba bzang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /rdo rje rgya gram de bzhin no/ /padma /rgya gram dpag med tshe'i / /sangs rgyas kun gyi tshe bsgrub 7pa/ /lha mo tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya tshogs sgrub bzhin/ /mda' dang de bzhin tshangs pa'i mgo/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i gluphyag rgya dang / /rdo rje tri shul 4phyag rgya'i mchog /dpag bsam 5shing dang kug ma dang / /padma tsharta mgrin 'phang —mtho ba/ /rta mgrin ljang gu de bzhin no/ /phag gi mche ba grub pa dang / /zla ba nyi ma de bzhin no/ /rin chen sna tshogs snod chen du/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi ra sa ya / /thams cad bdag nyid myong skal bzang / /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs bzhin no/ /gling bu dang ni pi bang kun/ /ku maṇḍa tshodang mu ra dza/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /sna 77—461

tshogs dri rnams de bzhin no/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i 6)dbyings kyi mtha' ( klas pa'i/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dam pa'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid la gnas/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rab grub pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid grub par 'gyur/ /chos gos dang ni lhung bzed dang / /de bzhin du ni 'khar gsil rinang / /dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam dag( /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs gzhan no/ /de bzhin rtse yi phyag rgya dang / /cha lang dang ni rnga dag dang / /rdo rje dang ni rin chen snod/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i tshogs gzhan no/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dang / /me long dang ni rlung yab dang / /rdo rje ser ba sprin dang bcas/ /de bzhin mig gi phyag rgya dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba kha ṭwāṃ tshorig /thod pa kham ngopor de bzhin no/ /dmar chen dang ni snying rje dang / /sha chen po yang skyade bzhin te/ /rnon po mda' dang de bzhin 'dren/ /chang dang chu dang de bzhin te/ /kug ma rlung gis bskyod pa dang / /ras dang de bzhin me dang ni/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po'i dpal /gdug pa thams cad za ba yi/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya grub pa'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub rab sgrub pa'o/ /padma pasna tshogs dmar po dang / /ljang gu 5de bzhin dkar po dang / /mthing ga bser po le brgan dag /padma stumatshan mchog rnam pa bdun/ /padma sgyung po bud med rgya/ /de bzhin chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /gsal zhing —dpal bskyed rdo rje dang 7/ /padma 7mtshan ma'i tshogs gzhan tshono/ /gzhu dang mda' dang ral gri dang / /de bzhin du ni 'bar ba'i me/ /dbang bskur gter dang rgyal mtshan dag /mchod pa'i 77—462

mtshan ma bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin sna tshogs padma /dang / /rdo rje rgya gram de bzhin te/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya grub pa yis/ /rgyal srid thams cad 'joms pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa/ /dngos po brtan g.yo rim lus kun/ /rang byung rirnams kyi mtshan ma'i rgya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' ciklas pa'o/ /de skad bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyis gegasungs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par ri 7sbyor ba/ /mkha' byu/ / kta rdo// // mchog las dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'i de nas gzhan dag bshad pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha'i/ /rnam pa kun tu sna tshogs mchog /mchod pa thams cad rnam sprul pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes par bsgyur/ /dpal ldan g.yon pa 'gying ba'i thabs/ /g.yas pa tshob dan gsum du bya/ /sri zhur bcas pa'i steg pa'i mchog /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /'dzum dang bcas pa'i mig gis blta/ /bsam pa g.yos pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje padma 7'dzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pas/ /skad cig gis kyang phyag byed na/ /khengs pa gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ / nyi zla gshin rje tshangs par bcas/ / btud de rab tu phyag 'tshal nas/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dpal gyi thal mo bsgyur/ /bsam pa g.yos pas phyag byas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa legs byas na/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /zin ma g.yon du 'deg 77—463

tshul gyis/ /ru lu ru lur bcas bgang med/ /tshangs pa nye dbang drag por bcas /khams gsum pa rnams phyag byed 'gyur/ /thal mos padmo kha 'bus bzhin / /rang gi sbyor ldan snying gar ribacing / /mthe bo camathe'u chung 'dab rim bzhin/ /rgyas pa btud pa'i phyag kyang bya/ /lus kyi yan lag thams cad ni /sa la bsnyal te phyag bya ba/ /snying ga kha dang spyi gtsug tu/ /thal mo sbyar te phyag bya'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'gying ba'i thabs/ /'dzum pa'i mig gis phyag byas na / /khams gsum pa yang phyag byed na / /mthu bsnyems gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /gar gyi rgyun rnams ci snyed dang / /de bzhin bya ba'i tshul ston kun/ /de dag rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya/ /rang gi don rnams grub rtebyed pa'o/ /'gying dang bcas pa'i tshul byas nas/ /ci 5lta'i tshul bzhin gar byed cing / /bskor ba'i gar rnams chasna tshogs kyis/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis / /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur te/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo khu tshur bcang lke/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum par byas / /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang 'grogs pa dang / /dngos grub chen po mchog kun gyi/ /dbang phyug chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang 'grogs pa/ /dpal skal ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /snyems 'dzin chen por bcas pa yi/ /sbyor tshobs 0de nyid bteg nas su/ /'gram pa'i phyogs su yongs bsgyur nas/ /spyi bo'i mtshams su gzhag par bya/ /thams cad 'bebs pa'i gar byed pas/ /gar byas de nas phab nas su/ /skal rubazang rghaṃ zhes bya ba'i lusas /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang 77—464

mnyam par 3sbyor ba skal ba bzang po bde ba chen po zhes cibya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur ba'i//rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas su/ /de bzhin g.yon du bsgyur bar bya/ /de ni spyor bas bteg nas su/ /spyi bo'i mtshams su gzhag par bya/ /skal bzang oṃ zhes bya ba'i glus/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /dpal rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur te/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du dgrol/ /mchod pa'i gtor ma kun gyi tshul/ /dur khrod cha lugs gar byed pas/ /phyag rgya 'di yis gar byed cing / /skal bzang rdo rje drag por dgod / /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /dpal rdo rje he ru ga'i thod pa'i thal mo ste mchod pa'i gtor ma thams cad kyi cho ga'i/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur te/ /g.yas g.yon thal mo brdabs pa yis//mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya/ /dpal padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi thal mo'o /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis/ /mdzub mo mthe'u chung mdzes bsgyur te/ /rdo rje rin chen thal sbyar nas/ /mchod pa thams cad dbul bar bya / /re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 2byed pa gludapal rdo rje rin chen zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /gyen du 'thor zhing thur du 'bebs/ /bskor zhing de bzhin nyug pa dang / /me tog bdug pa mar me mchog /dri yi skemachod pa 'byung ba'o/ /gang ba'am ci'on te stong pa'ang rung / /yang na ci 'byor pa yis kyang / /dam tshig mnyam par bsgrub 4pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams bcings nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams 77—465

cad mchod par 'gyur/ /dngos grub dbang jig grub pas kyang / /kun gyi bdag nyid mchod par 'gyur/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i /dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /rang 'byung gyirnams kyi mchod pa kun/ /gang dag de yis ma byas shing / /spel bar yang ni ma gyur pa'i/ /rlabs chen dam pa gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba'i dbang phyug bde chen dang / /dngos grub las dang bde ba dag /'di yis mi 'grub gang yang med / /mchod pa rab 'byam ( 4grub pa rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub / /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rimakha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las sna // ༵ / dīkā /kā /nga tshomanyam par sbyor ba dpal skal ba bzang po dam tshig de nas gzhan yang bshad pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha'i/ /kun tu sna tshogs mchog rnams kyi/ /phyag rgya thams cad rnam sprul pa'o/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes —pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /bde ba kun la zhen pa dang / /dngos grub 7thams cad rnam dag phyir / /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /zla ba nya ltar rtsa dmar sku/ /'dod chags kun la chags pa'i phyir/ /chags pa chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /7rdo rje sems dpa'i skuphyag rgya 'di/ /dmar po sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /khams gsum dag na rin chen gzhan/ /sangs rgyas rin chen lta bu med/ /sangs rgyas kun 77—466

gyi rin chen che/ /dbu rgyan can ni bde ba'i mchog /gzhan gyi nor min 'di 3mi 'phrogs ci/ /lha yi chu 'dis dag pa ste/ /mthu dang ngo bo nyid dag dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni de 'grub bo/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu can/ /kun nas nyon mongs 'jig rten dbang / /mi mjed la sogs de 'grub bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /lha mo kun dang 'dus pa yis/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad 'grub/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje padma ci'adzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa / /rgyas btab rmongs pas bslang rinas ni/ /las rnams kun la sbyor bar byed / /phyag rgya 'di yis btab pa ni/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /lha mo kun mchog dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /mchog tu dga' ba la rab tu sbyor ba skal ba bzang po dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog rol pa zhes bya ba mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba yis no/ /bde ba'i cha lugs gar byed cing / /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /dpung rnams thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ngo / /zla ba'i kha dog 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /dngos grub thams cad dag pa dang / /padma'i tsho'adod chags rnam dag phyir/ /brla yi dbus ni dmar la dkar/ /phyag mchog lo ma sngon po 'dra/ /de bzhin bde ba'i dbang phyug dang / /bde bar reg pa'i dbang phyug pas/ /dkar zhing ser ba'i brla dang ldan/ /lha rdzas sna tshogs kha dog mchog /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs tshapa'i 'od/ /padma 7sna tshogs la gnas pa/ /thams cad dag par rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas padma pal sogs mchog /rin chen sna tshogs 77—467

rgyan dang gos/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yin/ /mi mjed la sogs brgyan 3pa bzhin/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /'phrog pa dag kyang lhag par mdzod / /bdag la 'khyud ripa'i phyag rgya yis/ /yan lag thams cad 'phrog par 'grub/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ri rini/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /dpal ldan 'dod pa kun la dbang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub / /mchog tu dga' ba la rab tu sbyor ba skal ba bzang po dpal rdo rje mda' bde ba'i mchog rol pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dam tshig chags / /bde ba'i 'bebs pa'i gar byed pas/ /bdag la 'khyud ripa'i phyag rgya mchog /dbus kyi lha mchog chen po yi / /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /bde chen dbang phyug dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /mchog tu dga' la rab sbyor ba /skal ba bzang po dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig /bde ba'i mchog rol pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga bzung ste/ /bdag la 'khyud —pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /pad bcas rdo rje rgya gram mchog 1 /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /rnal 'byor kun gyis mudabang phyug rgyal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /mchog tu dga' ba la rab tu spyor ba skal ba bzang po dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor bde ba'i mchog rol pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi kham phor ska'agrub /bdag la 'khyud rshapa'i phyag rgya yisam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /dbus kyi lha mchog chen po'o/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /dpal ldan tshe dang gzhon 'grub pa/ /rdo 77—468

rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /mchog tu dga' ba la rab tu sbyor ba skal ba bzang po dpal rdo rje tshe bde ba'i mchog rol pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 3klas pa'i/ /rang byung 5phyag rgya sna tshogs rnams/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gnas te/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rab grub pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid 'bab 'grub 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang rimanyam par 4sbyor ba'i mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog gi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /gtsug lag ci lta'i rjes mthun pa'i/ /dpal rdzogs rgya chen gar dag gis/ /mda' bzhi yongs su 'phangs na ni/ /bdud bzhi dag las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa chen po'i mgo dpal rdo rje mda' zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rkang pa 'deg cing phab pa dang / /gshibs te mchongs pa'i stabs ridag gis/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgyas bstod nas ni/ /khams gsum dag las mchongs par 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje mthu bo che zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /phrogs 7pa dag gi khyad 7par du / /sna tshogs phyag rgyas gar byed cing / /khams gsum dag ni bsdu bar bya/ /dpal rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ces bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lhug ma gang yang rung bzung nas/ /bdag la 'khyud skepa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bud med thams cad rtsed na ni/ /dpag bsam shing ltar rtag tu 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje 'dod pa'i lha mo zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /myang ba btung ba ltar byas pas/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje mtshangs bcas pa'i / /'jig rten gsum dag skams tshopar byed/ /dpal rdo rje rta gdong zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /77—469

sna yi myang ba'i rngub pa yis/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje tshangs bcas pa'i/ /khams gsum yang ni sdud par byed/ /dpal rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mig tshugs zhen par blta dzo )ba yis/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje tshangs bcas pa'i/ /'jig rten gsum yang za bar byed/ /dpal rdo rje spyan nyi zla zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /thams cad bdag nyid myangs pa yis/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje ritshangs bcas pa'i/ /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho sa bar byed/ /dpal rdo rje kun gyi bdag nyid khams gsum slar 'tsho ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /gling bu len pa'i tshul ston cing / /ji ltar babs gepa'i gar byed pas/ /tshangs dang nye dbang drag por bcas/ /'gro ba gsum dag dbang du byed/ /dpal rdo rje gling bu'i dbang byed ces gyibya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /pi bang ( len pa'i tshul ston cing / /ji ltar babs pa'i gar byed pas/ /las rnams grub par rab 'byam tshodang / /dngos grub ma lus myur du 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje pi bang 7bde bas rmongs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /cang te'u tshul ston rnal 'byor pa/ /ji ltar babs pa'i gar byed pas/ /rims dang gdon dang dug zhin pa'i/ /sdug bsngal thams cad myur du sel / /dpal rdo rje cang te'u sdug bsngal thams cad sol bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /tshu rnga'i tshul ston rnal 'byor pa/ /ji ltar babs mepa'i gar byed pa/ /gnas gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /skad cig tsam gyis 'bebs par byed/ /dpal rdo rje rdza rngas bcas par byed pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /mchod pa thams cad byas na tshani/ /rang byung gar gyi sbumachod pa rnams/ /ma lus lus pa 77—470
