med par 'grub4)/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug byadami/ /phra mimed gdon gyi gnod pa rnams/ /bskor ba'i gar rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /skad cig tsam gyis zhi bar 'gyur/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje tshangs bcas pa'i/ /rgyas btab thongs byas zos pa dag /skad cig tsam gyis 'tsho bar byed/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam capa'i/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' ( rims pa/ /rang byung lha mo phyag rgya rnams/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gnas te/ /dngos grub dbang phyug rab grub pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid babs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi5 3/ /rab tu grub pa'i glu rnams kyis/ /bla med pa yi dngos grub 'thob/ /de nas phyag rgya ye shes 'di/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mchog gi glu/ /las rnams thams cad rab grub cing / /srid pa shin tu bsgrub ri pa ni/ / kye kye tsho)rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen skal bzang tshadapal khyod bdag la bsgrub la rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ /kye mde bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag nyid bde ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul mchog sgrub pa bdag la grub 7par chamadzad du gsol/ /a tshal la ho / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs gar rnams bstan du gsol/ dzaX hoḥs/ kye bde mchog bde bas zung tshal rnam par sprul/ /snye snang bar mdzad du gsol/ a la la :ho/ de bzhin gshegs kun sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sgyu mas slob ma gzung du gsol/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /kun tu kun nas thams 77—471

cad du/ /'di nyid kyis ni myur du 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs /thar pa thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya dpal du gnas /'dod dam rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /btso ma gser gyi kha dog bzhin /chags med la sogs chags chen phyir/ /dkar zhing sna tshogs gsal ba'i mdangs/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab bsgrubs pas/ /rin chen chos las lhag pa med/ /de bas theg chen byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba rdo rje rin chen dag /g.yas pa'i mthe bo cigang mo gnyis/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa yi / /sor mo kun la reg pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya yin par grags/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gsal yin/ /byang chub sems chen skye ba dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ste/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' rnaklas par/ /rab tu bsgrags nepar 'gyur ba yin/ /byang chub sems chen bskyed pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ste/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rig par bya/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /gang gis ldan pa 'di mthong zhing — /rnam pa kun tu mchod byed pa/ /de yi sangs rgyas rtag pa'i mchog /mthong zhing mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /sems ni bskyed ma thag tu yang / /chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor / /dpal dam tshig ces bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i yan lag gnon pa yis/ /g.yon pa'i yan lag kun las rgyal/ /sems dpa'i skyil tshomo krung ngabacas na / /bdud rnams thams cad rab tu 77—472

'joms / /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i kyil mo krung mingo / /rdo rje khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pas bkab pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun blo dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /de bzhin dpal ldan he ru ku'i/ /rdo rje khu tshur chen po dgabaci / /dpa' bo 'dod pa'i cadangos grub rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /padmo'i bud med khu tshur ni/ /de bzhin g.yon pas bkab na yang / /byang chub spyod rab 'grub pa rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rin chen 'dzin pa'i khur tshur yang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni/ /sangs rgyas nor kun dngos grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /sangs rgyas khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tshe 'grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /bud med phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni/ /dngos grub thams cad myur 'grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rta gdong dpal gyi khu tshur yang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni / /thams cad 'gugs par rab grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub / /dpal grub spyan /gyi khu tshur yang / /lag pa g.yon pas bkab na ni//snang ba thams cad rab grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /dang po sangs rgyas kun snod pa / /gnyis pa de bzhin dpa' bo yin/ /gsum pa kun tu bzang po'i 'o/ /bzhi pa mi zad snod yin no/ /sangs rgyas yan lag kun ldan dpal/ /de bzhin zhal bzang gzungs tsham yin/ /sprin chen mo ni bdun pa ste/ /brgyad pa dam mkha'i spyan yin no/ /gzungs ma thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya shes pa 'di dag gi/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i glu tshamachog ni//77—473

'grub par 'gyur ba byed pa'i mchog /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub 43pa/ /slong bar byed pa brtan sgrub pa/ /de bzhin sna tshogs rgyas pa dag( /drug pa'i dbyangs kyi glu blangs nas/ /de ba ta yi glu blang ngo / /'jig rten khams mang rdul phran grangs snyed khyab par 'phros pa yi / /rgyal ba'i don rnams rab tu phra ba'i rdul gyi grangs snyed pa/ /sprul pa yi ni gyi/sku rnams phra ba'i rdul gyi grangs snyed ni/ /srid pa bde chen de bzhin gshegs kun rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis / /rdul phran grangs snyed 7de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par sprul ri mdzod ho / rnam snang 7sbyor ba a skyal la ho de ring grub par mdzod/ /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa yis/ /nam mkha' thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /de nas bud med bzhi rnams dang / /rang gi yang dag gsang ba yis/ /cho ga rgyas pa'i tshul bzhin du /me tog la sogs mchod pa bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya shes ⑫pa'o /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /dam tshig la sdang rnam sbyang phyir/ /dur khrod dpal gyi phyag rgyar gsal / /shin tu gdug gcing gtum po la/ /zhi bas 'phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi marnal 'byor gyis/ /rnal 'byor bde mchog dam par 'gyur//sangs rgyas khros byung khro bo ni/ / thal bar 'jig 7pa mchog yin te/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'bar ba can/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar por 7snang / /gzhan gyis tsham yin mi 'phrogs 0pa/ /lha rdzas chu yis dgang ba ste/ /'di ni rang bzhin nyid dag dang / /mthu dang ngo bo nyid kyis 'grub/ /gos chen po dang blugs pa che/ /sha chen po dang sprang rtsi che/ /dur khrod kun gyi 'byung po 77—474

yi/ /phyag rgya dpal ldan dbang phyug mchog /shin tu khro gdug gtum po 3)yi/ /sems can khams rnams rnam sbyang phyir/ /'di ni dpal ldan nye ru ku'i/ /rdo rje rgyal chen dbang phyug mchog /thod pa'i phring snyeba'i dbu rgyan dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /rgyal srid thams cad rab bsgrub ci pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer zhibacas/ /dril bu dkrol ba'i sgrar bcas pa/ /dpal ldan he ru ka babs pa'i/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs rnam sprul pas / /sangs rgyas rdo rje padma ga'adzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas de zos nas/ /thal bar gyur )pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /dpal ldan ( snardo rje he ru ka rdo rje 'bab pa rnam par 'phrul pa/ padma gar gyi dbang rgyug ces bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /se ral kha yi tshul dag tu/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga tshol rgyab rten byas/ /lag pa g.yon na thod pa thogs/ /g.yas pa ba dan rtegasum par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i phyag rgyas rnal 'byor pa/ /nam mkha' kun tu 'gro bar 'gyur /bud med la sogs rin mchen mchog /dngos po thams cad mkha' las 'byin/ /phyag rgya 'di yis yongs btab nas/ /bde bar lhag pa'i tshul ston pas/ /nam mkha' las ni kun lhags te/ /bdag gi spyod par de spyod do//drag mapo dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla mkha' 'gro mi bzad tshogs / /mkha' las sgyu ma kun blags nas/ /lus pa med par de za'o/ /nam mkha' thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ / skal ba tshabazang po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i rshabade ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i spyor ba yis/ /bde bar 'bab pa'i gar byed pas/ / kyil mo spung 7ni phyed bcas la/ /rkang pa rang gi brla bsdams sngon / /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla 77—475

gshin rje tshangs /bcas pa/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas bslang ( rinas su/ /gar tsubyed cing ni cade za'o/ /de nyid kyi ni sbyor ba yis/ /de nas bde bar brla bsdams pas/ /legs par bsdams te byer btags nas/ /rab tu bkram ste btung bar bya/ /sgyu ma de dag nyid kyis ni/ /de nas brla ri phrag bskyod tsho pa yis / /skal bzang lha dang mi rnams kyi/ /bud med kun la de spyod do/ /bde bar reg pa thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba skal ba bzang po dpal rdo rje drag po gnas pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal ldan he ru ka babs pa'i/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs gnas pa'o/ /zhi dang drag po rmongs pa'i mchog /dga' ba'i gar byed 'gyur bar bcas/ /shi ba ldang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /zhi dang drag po thongs byed dang / /gyen du dbugs tsho 'byin gar byed lus/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya grub pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i sbyor ba bde mchog gis/ /me tog bdug pa'i sbyor ba mchog /chang dang chu dang lhug ma dang —/ /ras dang me gtong grub pa yis/ /khyad par du ni rgyas 'debs so/ /rtse gcig mnyam par sbyor ba yis/ /sbyor ba'i gnyer ba bde ba sbyin/ /mngon par gtor zhing se gol rdob / /dal bus gyen du dbugs 7'byin pas/ /g.yon du blta rtezhing lag pas drangs/ /'o byed 'khyud pa de bzhin te/ /gar byed rab tu rmongs pa dang / /zad zudang gsang ba'i lus rnams dang / /tshangs pa chen po'i mgo dang ni/ /de bzhin 'jig rten gsum las rgal/ /de bzhin sa ngalas 'dren pa dang / /rang gi phyag rgya'i tshul ston dang / /dur khrod dag gi gar byed dang / /de bzhin rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /rab tu 77—476

'jigs yi par sreg pa'i me/ /las kyi phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /dang po rgyas 'debs ma yi rgya/ /snying 'dren ma yi riganyis pa'o/ /gsum pa shin tu rmongs byed ma'o ri/ /de bzhin bzhi pa 'degs byed ma'o/ /lnga pa gar byed pa yi rgya/ /drug pa gsod ma'i yin par bshad/ /bdun pa za ba mo geyi rgya/ /brgyad pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /de nas phyag rgya 'di kun gyi/ /phyag rgya'i lan rnams bla na med/ /phyag rgya'i bdag nyid kun 'joms pa/ /khyad par du ni bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje padma ri slong / /gar dag byed cing byas na ni/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas zos pa dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /de nas phyag rgya shes pa 'di/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sbyor ba'i glu5 / /las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub tsho pa/ /khyad par du ni bshad par bya/ /gzigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i rgyas thob la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'o byed 'khyud pas rmongs mdzad de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog ston kun gsol pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog ngo mtshar bstan du gsol/ /rgyas btab ltarmongs byas mnabs 7su gsol/ /bde mchog ngo mtshar bde ba zhugs/ /snye a ci la la ho gnang sabar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bde mchog sgyu mas sprul/ /dam tshig dag la 'jug tu gsol/ /nyon mongs kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /ma lus pa dag mnabs su pagasol/ /nyon mongs thams cad bsal tshabar mdzod/ /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa yis/ /rdo rje thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /gdon mi za bar 'grub 7par 'gyur/ /dpal he ru ma'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya zhes bya'o / /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'dod chags thams cad rnam dag phyir/ /padma'i 777—477

phyag rgya dpal du gnas/ /mi 'gyur dam pa grub pa'i phyir / /shel sgong shin tu dag pa 'dra/ /'dod chags thams cad bsal ri ba'i phyir/ /'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas tshe ni rin chen sprasabyu )/ /gos dang sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yis/ /bde ba can bzhin dam par 'gyur/ /gar stabs 4rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /yongs su bsgyur zhing gar byas pas/ /padmo'i mtshan mchog padmor bcas/ /phyagani ( rgya mirnams 'khor lo bskor/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje padma ci 'dzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa/ /padma sgyu mas rnam sbyangs nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sgrub par mdzad /'dul ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs pa'o/ /skal tshob bzang po dpal padma ོgar gyi dbang phyug ces bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis// skyil mo krung ni byed thamar gnas/ /rgyal po'i skyil mo spung bcas nas / /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed/ /dpal padma margyal po gnas pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /bsnyems —pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /padma dzhadamar po ci bder bzung / /rang gi snying gar 'dren pa'i tshul/ /padma rta'adab ma kha 'byed pa'o/ /bsnyems pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /padma gyisngon po ci bder bzung snye/ /rang gi snying gar ci'adren tshul gyis/ /bud med phyag rgya bcing lobar bya/ /bsnyems sapa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /padmo dkar po ci bder bzung / /'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor /bsnyems pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ / padma mthing ga gci bder bzung ri rme/ /g.yas pas rab tu gar byed pa/ /dpal gyi phyag rgya ba dan gsum//bsnyems pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /padma ci ser po ci bder bzung ri / /77—478

g.yas pa rab tu gar byed pas/ /chu srin tshul du bsgreng bar bya/ /bsnyems sgyu pa'i lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /padma snyen brgan ( mchog bzung ri ciste/ /rang gi snying gar ( 'dren tshul gyis/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /rnam par gzigs pa'i rnam dag dpal/ /sgrol ma'i byang chub mchog yin no/ /rgya chen ma yi 'khor lo bskor/ /khro gnyer ma ni phyag rgya'i lan/ /padma ( gnas pa'i dpal chen yin/ /'dod pa'i dbang mo'i 'gro ba gsum/ /dpal padma'i rgyal po'i rig pa'i lha mo chen mo rnams so/ /de nas phyag rgya shes pa 'di/ /padma dzi rgyal po dpal gyi glu / /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub 7pa/ /khyad par du ni bshad par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la sogs pa'i gzugs mchog sna tshogs 'dzin/ /sems can rnam pa snatshogs 'dul mchog dngos grub mchog mnga' ba/ /kye sems dpa' padma tshadaga' mchog sgyu ma'i dga' ba bstan du gsol/ /ma la la la 4ho/ kye gar dbang thar dga' dga' rshaba'i gar mdzod cig /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bdag tshangs pa 'jug sel dbang phyug bdag /nyi zla bdag lags a la la la 2ho/ /padma sgyu ma rshasna tshogs 'dul mdzad dag pa'i tshul gyis gar mdzad pa/ /padmo dam tshig dbang phyug sangs rgyas gar rnams mdzad du gsol /'dod chags rnam par sbyong ba thams cad du ni rtsi rnam par sbyongs/ /padma 'dzin pa de yi spyan sngar gar mkhan gar mdzod cig /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa yis/ /sna tshogs padma rtsomanyam sbyor ba4//mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal padma gar gyi dbang sabyug gi phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /nor mchog rnam par sbyang 77—479

ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan nyi ma phyag rgyar gnas/ /nam mkha'i snying po thams cad phyogs/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /rin chen thams cad mkha' las 'bebs/ /shin tu gdug cing gtum po :la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi nyi ma ni/ /dam pa'i don du drag por gyur/ /drag pos 'dul ba'i 'jig rten rnams/ /drag po nyid kyis sgrub par byed/ /nyi ma'i gzugs dang spyod lam dang / /tshul dang gzi brjid chen pos ston/ /rdo rje gzhu dang mda' mchog dag /shin tu legs par 'gengs pa ste/ /mdangs gsal 'dzum dang bcas pa'i spyan/ /g.yon pa 'byed cing gyen du 'deg /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas nyi zla gshin rje tshangs pa yi / /'jig rten gsum po ma lus par / /drag shul nyid kyis 'dul bar mdzad/ /dpal khams gsum las ( )rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje pus mo gnyis bcings te/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung ri bcas nas/ /bdag ni stan la 'dug nas ni/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhig par bya/ /dpal rdo rje skyil mo spung dngo / /dbang bskur 3pa khodang gter bdag dang / /rgyal mtshan mchog ldan mchod pa che/ /ci tsholta'i tshul dag ston pa dgasku /rang gi don rnams 'grub pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya shes pa 'di /rgyal po'i sgyu ma mchog gi glu/ /las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub 7pa/ /khyad par du ni bshad par bya/ /khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid sna tshogs mchog gi nor ldan pas/ /mjal dum g.yul 'gyed rnam tshamang khyad par sangs rgyas tsha'adul ba ste / /rnam pa sna tshogs mjal dum rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan can /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po bde mchog sgyu ma bstan du gsol/ /sems can srin 777—480

la byang chub mchog sbyin sna tshogs char 'bebs pa/ /bdag gi re ba kun sgrubs ①myur nyuston a la la la ri ho/ /mi zad gter gyi dbang bskur khyad par bdag la stsal du gsol/ /khyad par rin chen 'di dag thams cad bud med rin chen rnams kyi phyir/ /rin chen tshogs kun dang na bud med rin chen gcig pu mchog /bud med rin chen dag pa dam pa'i don du thams cad 'gro/ /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa yis/ /rgyal srid thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /gdon mi caza bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje nyi ma'i phyag rgya shes ji pa'o/ /rnal 'byor de nyid bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /drag shul sbyor bas rnal 'byor dpal/ /rta yi phyag rgya rab tu gnas/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis / /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon ( ridu/ /rab tu gdon pa'i rtsal dag gis/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /'dod chags can la g.yen tshopar ston/ /gdug pa rnams la gdug par ston/ /zhi ba rnams la zhi bar 'gyur/ /drag shul can la drag shul sbyor/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa la mig pa tshobazhi / /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ /dbang phyug dam pa grub par 'gyur / /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo khu tshur gyis/ /dpal ldan padma 5sna tshogs 'dzin /rdo rjer 7bcas shing slong ba sgrub/ /g.yas pa ba dan gsum par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /shin tu lhung chibar gyur pa yang / /de ma thag tu kun bslangs munas/ /ldang ba thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /thams cad dag pa mnyam par sbyor ba skal ba bzang po/ /dpal rdo rje slong ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o / /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /brkyang bskum 7pa yi tshul byas 77—481

nas/ /khro bo'i kyil /mo krung snyebacas te/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu bshig /dpal rdo rje khro ribo gnas pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya shes pa 'di'i/ /rta mchog dpal dang ldan pa'i glu/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa/ /khyad par du ni bshad par bya/ /myos byed stong las ri lhag par bde ba 'dod pa'i gzugs ston pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis gshin rje stong las 4lhag par rab tu 'jigs /zhi ba'i sku yang tshangs pa stong pas shin tu lhag par ston/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog tu de bzhin gshegs kun 'grub par mdzod/ /thams cad rnam par dag pas ngo 'thon stobs kyis gnon pas rinon/ /hi ho he he he dbang phyug thams cad rab shig rab tu shig /rab kyi rtsal gyis gnon pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon dbang phyug non/ /sbyor chen hu lu hu lu mig gsum pa las gsum grub drongs/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis gnon pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon mthu chen rnan/ /mnyam sbyor ru ṭa ma ṭa snying las dpal mo drongs shig rab drongs shig /rab kyi rtsal gyis gnon pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon mtshangs pa non//sbyor chen tshangs skalas grol ma drongs shig sma ra ṭa/ /rab kyi rtsal gyis gnon pa'i stobs kyis ngo 'thon chodaga' dbang non / /mnyam spyor kun gyi bdag la dga' drongs a la la la saho/ /gdug cing khro la rab tu tsogatum pa'i 7sems can bsgral ba'i phyir/ sgrub zhugs a la la la 4ho/ /oṃ gsu ni su di phaṭa phaṭa/ /mdza' bo mi la bya 'am mi bya yongs rtog chode dag med kyang mcho / /de 'dra'i mdza' bo sgyu ma yin pas de la mdza' bshes su zhig zer/ /rgol ba la yang bya 'am mi bya yongs su rtog pa med kyang sla / /de 'dra'i rgol ba sgyu ma yin pas de la dpa' zhes su zhig zer/ /glu 'di blangs pa tsam gyis ni/ /rta mchog 77—482

mnyam par sbyor ba yi )/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur( / /thams cad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes ripa'o/ /mdzub mos mthe bo 4)mnan nas ni/ /rang gi mthe ( bos mdzub mo mnan ri/ /dpal grub spyan )gyi phyag rgya ste/ /mdzub mo mig gi 'bras bur bya ci/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /rdo rje spyan ni gnyis dag tu/ /khong stong du ni sbyor tshobar bya//dpal grub rdo rje'i spyan yin no/ /'dis stoni sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /de bzhin dpa' bo thams cad dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal grub spyan 7ni grub pa ste/ /sems can thams cad dbang byed pa/ /las kyi dngos grub rab 'byam 7rnams/ /ma lus dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar te/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /mthe bo'i rtse mo mnyam par gzhag /khong stong mi 'gyur dam pa'o / /spyi bo'i mtshams su rab bzhag nas/ /'di yis bsrung ba byas na ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub ma lus pa/ /lus pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i gtsug tor gyi 6phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du dbye/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /mthe bo skuganyis kyi mche ba gtsigs/ /'jigs pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ /'grub pa bdud la sogs pa za/ /de bzhin du ni rmongs par byed/ /dbab pa thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /de bzhin rnam par shes pa sgrub/ /gter rnams 'byin par byed pa dang / /de bzhin nor kun 'phrog par byed/ /ngal bso 7po ni dpal mnan 7te/ /dpal mo dag kyang phrogs skunas ni/ /mngag gzhug mar ni byed pa dang / /gnod sbyin ma dang dga' ba 7 spyod/ /gnod sbyin dag gi sde dpon du/ /'dis ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /77—483

dpal rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /gung mo mnyam par rab tu bsgrub / /mthe bo mthe'u michung 'dab ri ma bzhi/ /padma ri dri med rab tu rgyas/ /'dis ni sdig rnams 'byang bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byang na rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mngon sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur/ /dpal ldan padma'i gephyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar dzil/ /mdzub mo mnyam par phyir bkug tsho riste/ /mthe bo 3)rdo rje g.yogs pa ni/ /rdo rje dpal gyi nor bu —ste/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /nam mkha' thams cad rab 'grub ste/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /mkha' las dngos rnams thams cad spyod/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar nas/ /mthe'u chung srin lag mnyam par brkyang / /mdzub mo rtse mnyam skyabakug pa ni/ /dpal mchog rta 2zhes logrags pa ste/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab 'brel na/ /thams cad dga' bar byed pa'i dpal/ /lha yi skal skebazang smos ci dgos/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi/ /mtshan pa'i phyag rgyar ldan —byas te/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi lhar ni bdag nyid bya/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas thams cad dpal/ /de bzhin dpa' bo thams cad dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun 7bdag tshodangos grub ni/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 4klas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog 'dis/ /mi 'grub 'byor pa ri mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dam pa rgya chen gang yang med/ /dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /rdo rje 77—484

sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba'i/ /ji lta'i gzugs dang dbyibs su ldan/ /bde ba nyid 3kyis tsho kun gyi bdag /kun gyi bdag la zhugs par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro thong lding / /rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba skal pa bzang po'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /chags pa med cing ma chags med/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu sbyor 'di/ /gnyis su med pa'i theg pa'i mchog /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /dpal ldan sgyu ma kun gyi bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /sgyu ma thams cad kyi lha mo'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /yod pa ma yin med pa'ang min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ri ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab 'grub pa'o/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /ji ltar sgyu ma thams cad du/ /mthong ba dang ni reg par 'gyur/ /dmigs su yod pa'ang ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'gro ba kun gyi tshul /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong sding //bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /mkha' las dngos rnams thams cad spyod//dngos po med par bdag sbyor bas/ /nam mkha' kun dang mnyam spyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /shin tu rtag par 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar padma rmedamar po 'di/ /chags pa'i nyes pas mi gos pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'ang de bzhin du/ /gnas kyi nyes pas yong mi gos/ /shin tu gdug cing 77—485

drag po la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba ni/ /rnam par rgyal phyir rab tu drag /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /sdig med stobs kyi ngo 'thon du/ /drag shul spyor bas mnyam sbyor ba/ /'jig rten thams cad gzhom par bya/ /sbyor ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /sbyor ba ji snyed yod kun dang / /byed pa rnam ripa sna tshogs la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi rgya/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub ripa'o/ /byed pa'i phyag rgya 'di rnams kyis/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /chags pa chen po dbang phyug dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal pa bzang po dpal dam tshig ces bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /bya ba dang ni bzlog pa dang / /khyad par du ni 'phrog pa dang / /yan lag kun tu byed pa yis/ /de ni nor rnams kun kyang phrogs /'o byed 'khyud la sogs pa yis/ /khams gsum pa yang rgyas 'debs so/ /thar bar byed cing gsod par byed/ /shi yang ri )mod la sos par byed /sbyor ba'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /gnas gsum po ni ma lus par /rgyas btab rmongs byas bslang ci 1nas su/ /gar byas nas ni za bar byed / /sbyor ba kun gyi bde myong bas/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas ཿzos pa dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang tsho 'tsho bar byed/ /sbyor ba thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o / /lha mo kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /mdzes pa'i zhal ni rnam bsgyur zhing / /bde ba myong ba borab sbyor ba/ /mdzes par lta ba'i gar byed pas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje padma pa'adzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa/ /rgyas btab thongs byas zos pa dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /bud med mkhas pa sgyu ma che/ /mdzes pa'i bzhin ni 77—486

rnam bsgyur ༷/ba/ /rim gror bcas shing steg pa'i mchog /mdzes par lta bas gar byas pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rirdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas bslang nas ni/ /zos nas slar yang 'tsho bar byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mnyam sbyor ba/ /rab tu dga' bar lta zhing ri'adzum/ /shin tu srid pa yang dag sgrub/ /gsang bar lta la gnas na ni/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje tshangs bcas pa'i/ /srid pa kun tu kun bsgrubs nas/ /rigs gsum dag ni sgrub par byed/ /steg kyil sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /mdzes pa'i bzhin ni rnam bsgyur zhing / /rim gror bcas shing steg pa'i mchog /steg pa'i lta bas gar byed cing / /mdzes pa'i tshul dang thabs rnams kyis/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje tshangs bcas pa'i / /'jig rten gsum dag sgrub par byed/ /mche ba cung gzad gtsigs pa'i kha/ /khro zhing 'dzum dang bcas pa'i 7bzhin/ /khro la 'gyur bar bcas shing 'dzum/ /gsal bar blta zhing legs par gnas/ /drag po dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /nyi zla gshin rje tshangs bcas pa/ /rgyal po sgyu mas rnam rgyal nas/ /khams gsum dag ni sgrub par byed/ /'dod chags myos pas g.yem spyo ba/ /mdzes pa'i bzhin ngani rnam par bsgyur/ /'di ni bzhin gyi phyag rgya mchog /khams gsum dag kyang dga' bar byed/ /drag po mche ba rnon po gtsigs / /gdug pa za ba 'jigs tsha'ajigs lta / /g.yas pa'i bzhin gyi phyag rgya yis/ /khams gsum dag kyang za bar byed/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /rab tu dga' bar lta zhing 'dzum/ /g.yon pa'i rmubazhin gyi 7phyag rgya yis/ /khams gsum dag kyang thar bar byed/ /spyi bor rta 77—487

mgrin gsang mtho ba/ /rta gdong /ljang ser kha dog ru gsal/ /so gtsigs pas ni mchu mnan na/ /'jig rten thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /bzhin gyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /lha mo kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /mdzes pa'i ma (rimachu 4sos mnan te/ /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par byed/ /'dod chags bde bas g.yem spyo ba/ /steg pa'i ma mchu sos mnan pa'i/ /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang dga' bar byed/ /sbyor ba kun gyi bde ba mchog /mdzes pa'i ma mchu g.yo bar byed/ /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang dga' bar byed/ /sha chen gyi ni ro myong zhing / /ma mchu so yis mnan pa yis( / /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang za bar byed/ /bde ba kun gyi ro myong zhing / /ma mchu rnam par mdzes byas pa/ /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /'dzum pa'i phyag rgya mchog shes pa'o/ /bde ba myong bar rab sbyor ba/ /zam zim lta ba rnams bsgyur bas/ /rgyas btab thongs byas zos pa yis / /khams gsum dag kyang 'tsho bar byed/ /bud med mkhas pa sgyu ma'i mchog /mdzes par blta —ba'i gar byas pas / /rgyas btab rmongs byas bslang tshanas ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang sgrub par byed/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mnyam sbyor ba/ /lta ba rab zhi bde bar gnas/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /bud med thams cad dbang du byed/ /smin mtshams khro gnyer 'gyur bcas pas / /lta ba rab 'bar —rnam par bsgyur/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang 'bar bar byed/ /khro zhing 'gyur bar bcas pas pa'adzum/ /lta ba gsal 77—488

la bde ba gnas/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya'i 3 mchog 'di ni/ /khros tsho pa thams cad rab tu sgrub(0/ /steg la sogs pa'i ro dang ldan/ /steg bcas lta ba'i gar byed pa/ /lta ba'i phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang gar byed 'jug /lta ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /na ma sna sasba bu spyoḥ ci zhes pa'i phyag rgya la gnas na/ /las dang mchod pa ma lus pa/ /lus pa med pa ri thams cad 'grub / /rang byung rnams kyi mchod pa kun/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha' ridabyings kyi mtha' klas pa/ /lan cig chibarjod pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya 'dis/ /gang dag byas par ma gyur cing / /spel ba dag tu ma gyur pa'i/ /dam pa rgya chen de dag med/ /oṃ ru ru sgru ru dzwa tshoril tiṣṭha si tshalo tsa ni sablo sā 〉dha ni gā hā/ chos kyi phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /sems can thams cad dbang byed pa/ /stobs kyis myur du bkug nas ni/ /bran bzhin du ni byed du 'jug /su bha gā ste mem hā na de bi nyi 7ri/ mi ri/ ri ti sko/ ni ri thi —ye gā hā/ chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa 'di/ /'dod pa'i bde ba kun sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ tā re tu re tu re swā hā/ chos kyi phyag rgya la gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrubs snyen/ /bud med gzhan lta ci zhig smos / /ṭwāṃ 0bha ba ṭā ṭā/ tra ṭa tra ṭa / re ba 5thams cad kun nas —rdzogs / /chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa 'di / /re ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /shrī chabadzra padma bhaṇḍa bha :mu kha yo gri shwa ra nyi nyi hi gnyi gyi / chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa 'di/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'jig /chos kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /skad kyi gsang ni mthon snyedaman dang / /gre sgyur snyebacos shing bzlas pa dang / /dus cirab zhi ba samachog rnams kyis / /snye la sogs pa'i glu 77—489

blang zhing / /tshig rnams kun gyis 3ci 'dod par/ /ji ltar kro bar glu kun gyis /rgyu gi glu yi phyag rgya dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab sgrub ( pa'o mo kun gyi lha mo mchog /cha lugs bzhin du gar bya zhing / /ka ka la shang ③snya lil sogs/ /glu rnams thams cad rjes su blang / /oṃ gyi glu yi phyag rgya ni/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis ci dgar blangasari / /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /sems can thams cad thar bar byed/ /rdo rje drag po gad mo che/ /mkhur ba'i dbugs kyis rlung 'byin cing / /'brug gi sgra ltar zab pa yi/ /ru lu ru lu'i sgra byung na/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /khams gsum dag kyang rgyas 'debs shing / /thar par byed cing ri gsod ri par byed/ /shi ba mod la 'tsho bar byed/ /rdo rje drag tu bzhad pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /ṭi dzo zhes bya ba'i glu yi rgya/ /thams cad dag par sgrub 7pa'o/ /nyi zhes bya ba'i 7klu yi rgya/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /ka ka la phye dang tso mara'i dbyangs/ /de bzhin rab tu gdangs 7snyan dang / /ka ha gsha yi glu yi rgya/ /'joms pa thams cad grub pa'o/ /glu yi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /gling bu dang ni rgyud gcig dang — /de bzhin rgyud mangs skurgyud snag dang / /sil snyan phyag rgya bshad pa rnams / /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ /cha lugs bzhin du gar byed pas /ma brdungs par yang rab tu 'grub/ /las rnams kun la mchog tu ni/ /brdungs na dpal ni bzhi 'gyur 'grub/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig mdang / /bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rnam par sel la sogs pa'i thabs/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub —pa'o/ /dzaḥ misto rus mas/ sma rā ra ṭa/hu lu hu lu/ pra sica/ (mi : dzaḥ gri ni snyo ni snye sum̐/ ṭakki snye dzaḥ hu lu 77—490

hu lu/ a la la la ho/ shu si / da ri ṣā ya sab na ṭa sge sge/ ṭa ṭa rtse rtse lhe/ ṭa rghaṃ ṭa/ ke gi gi gi/ ṭa ta kai/ ṭa ge/ rtswa ṭo ṇa/ ṭakki rgyu dzaḥ/ge te ge sgo na/ ṭakki snye rlu/ a la la la ho/ rus mas/ thal mo brdab pa brtag pa'o/ /ṭa ste ṭa snye/ ṭa sge sge/ ṭa ke na ṭa/ sto sto sto/ ṭa sto sto ṭa sto/rgyun gyi rnga'o/ /spre rghaṃ spre/ : : ṭwāṃ/ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ dhe dhe dhe/ dam tshig gsum gyi rnga'o/ /dhe rghaṃ rghaṃ rghaṃ rghaṃ/ dhe badzra badzra rgyang / kong kong kong / rgyu spyo rgyu spyo rgyu spyo rgyu spyo/ ru lu ru lu rgyu rgyo lha/ sgong stong sgong / sto rghaṃ rghaṃ rghaṃ rghaṃ/ zlo/ko kai kai/ dpal rdo rje he ru na'i rdo rje rnga'i phyag rgya'o/ /padma padma hri/ padma padma shī/ padma padma hrang / dpal padmo brdabs pa'i rnga'o/ /ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ bha bha bha bha bha bha bha/ ta ṭa tā ṭā ṭā ṭā ṭā ṭā/ ṭwāṃ tā tā tā/ tā tā tā tā tā/ traṃ ṭaṃ ke ta skud tra/ tus nd+ra/ rgyal po'i rnga'o/ /ṭakki rgyu dza ༷ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ ṭakki rgyu dzaḥ stems pa'i 'gros so/ /yis tā tā tā tā tā/ myur zhing rab tu myur ba'o / /ta ṭa bha ta/ ba kun/ ta thā ga te/ ba rgyu/ ta ṭā bha ta ta bha nyi na dpal rta mchog rnam par rol pa'o/ /ta tā bha ṭa ṭa bha tā das/sa shin tu myur ba'i rnga'i phyag rgya ste/ /sil snyan gyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag /sbyor bas/ /lag gnyis rdo rjer bcings ripa yi/ /rdo rje se gol ri brdabs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /de yi bka' tsam gyis skrag nas/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun kyang 'du 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig smos/ /g.yon pa'i se gol brdabs pa dang / /thal mo dal bus brdabs pas 'grub/ /g.yas pa'i thal mo yin par gsungs/ / gnyi ga kun tu sdud pa yin/ /thal mo'i sbyor ba 77—491

rab sbyor bas/ /las kyi tshul bzhin 'brang ba dang / /thal mo dal bus bku ba dang —/ /glu dang sil snyan gar byed pas/ /steg ①dang dpa' dang snying rje dang //rgod dang khro ridang 'jigs pa dang / /mi sdug ngo mtshar zhi ba yi/ /nyams kyis ciphyag rgya dang don sgrub/ /steg la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya'i gar byas pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rgyar sbyor nyabs/ /dbab pa thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' steg pa la/ /dpa' snyel dpa' bo de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa snying rje la/ /rgod tsho pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog /rdo rje nyi ma khro ba la/ /rdo rje drag po 'jigs pa la/ /shākya thub pa mi sdug pa / /ngo mtshar la ni a ra li/ /rab tu zhi la sangs rgyas rtag /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba'i phyir/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin gyis /nye bar gnas shing byin gyis rlobs / /lta bas mi ngoms pa yi gzugs /thams cad bdag nyid ston par mdzad/ /legs so zhes bya 'grub pa yi/ /mchog tu gyur pa parab tu stol/ /thams cad bdag nyid grub pa'i mchog /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun tu 'gyur ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor dam pa ster bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya spyor tib 'di dag gis//rang gi mchod pa rab tu sbyar/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha'i / /sbyor ba thams cad rnam 'khrul ladang / /phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan rnams dang / /sna tshogs phyag rgya rnam sprul —pas/ /yid la bsams 7pa kun rdzogs phyir/ /mchod pa dam pa 7sbyar bar bya/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /kun gyi slob dpon bdag nyid bsgyur/ /kun 'byung la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /rgol ba bdag dang gar byas te/ / de nas rgol ba ci rigs pa/ /rtsosangs rgyas thams 77—492

cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas slar ni rgol yo)ba yang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por bsgyur/ /rgol riba'ang de nas tshul bzhin du/ /padma cigar 'byung mchog tu bsgyur/ /de nas slad cidu rgol ba yang / /rdo rje nyi ma mchog tu bsgyur/ /de nas phyir yang rgol ba ni/ /rta mchog 'byung bar bsgyur bar bya/ /de nas slar ni rgol ba yang / /bdag nyid 'byung bas ci cirab tu 'grub/ /de nas phyag rgya shes pa 'di/ /sdom pa thams cad rab ston pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi glu/ /khyad par du ni bshad par bya/ /la lar dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor stong las ri mdzes pa'i gzugs su rnam par snang / /la lar rab tu 'jigs pa'i nyi ma bye ba phrag dgu'i 'od zer mchog pas 'jigs/ /la lar mdangs bzang gzi che bde dang zhi bar ldan pa rgyal ba'i gzugs su snang / /la lar 'gro ba thams cad mnyam par 'jog pa'i gzugs ldan gsung mchog ldan par ston / /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub phyir 'dul la mkhas pa ma lus bde ba'i mchog rnams las/ /a ra li rnams tshomanyam sbyor grub dzomadzod ru ṭa ma ṭi 7a la la la maho/ /rnam pa mang po 'dul bar mdzad pa'i tshul la gar mkhan mchog gis gar mdzad pa/ /dam tshig gar gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas gar mdzod a la la la maho/ /rnam mang bde mchog rab tu gar mdzad pa yis thar pa'i bde ba'ang thob par mdzod/ / 'di dag glur ni blangs pa yis / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /'grub par 'gyur bar dzogadon mi za/ /de ltar rab tu gar byas te/ /de las gang zhig pham gyur pa/ /tshogs la de yis tshogs kyi tshams/ /yon dang rtsibacas par dbul bar 7bya/ /mchod pa'i cho ga 'di dag gis/ /sdig pa kun las thar 77—493

bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rtag par bsrung /bar 'gyur/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gros gtse dang gdon rnams dang / /bdud ri dang sems can dmyal ba'i rirnams/ /'di yis rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub rnams dang phun sum tshogs /dga' dang de bzhin bdag po dang / /sangs rgyas dam pa thams cad dang / /phyag rgya'i mchog rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /gar gyi phyag rgya shes pa'o / /rab tu dga' ba rjes su rab ci gas dga' ba'i mda' gzhu rab tu phra ba'i rgyas btab pas/ /rab tu dga' bar sbyor ba'i bde bas smos pa bde ba thams cad bdag la grub par mdzod/ /rab tu bde mchog rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng tshoba'i longs spyod dang / /rab tu dga' ba'i dbang phyug tshe mchog grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa zhugs ho rta mchog ho/ /rab tu sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog la rol cig ho/ /bde bas slong la rnam par rol snye snang bar rimadzod/ /a la la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sna tshogs kyis/ /slob ma tsho rab tu pagazung 7du gsol/ /kye ma'o tshabade lamachog grub par mdzod/ /kye mtho bde ba bde ba stsol/ /dam par rab tu zhugs par mdzod/ /bdag la rab tu dgyes par gyur/ /a la la la laho/ e ma'o/ /shi shi zhugs shig zhugs shig /mkha' 'gro bde mchog yongs bskor kun tu zhugs/ /'di dag glur ni blangs tshapa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /grub 7par 'gyur bar tshogadon mi za/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sdud pa dang / /rdo rje rin chen bla med pa/ /rdo rje chos ni gsungs pa dang / /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /77—494

rgyu rdo rje las kyi mda' gzhu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje chags pa'i dam tshig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga rab tu 'jigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje dril bu rab tu 'khrol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la lar rab tu drag cing skye bor /9)drag la drag pa'i bud med sku ltar rab tu snang / /'gro ba mtha' yas 'dul phyir la lar rab tu rno ba'i 'khor lo phyag na bsnams pa'i sku/ /la lar rab tu des zhing zhi ba mi 'gyur sbyin pa tshangs pa'i skur yang ston par mdzad / /la lar rab tu 'bar ba'i chags pa padma rgyal po'i dam tshig bdag la grub par mdzod/ /thams cad dbang bskur dbang phyug dam pa mi zad gter mchog bdag la grub pa rimadzad du gsol/ /kun mchog rgyal mtshan rnam rgyal bsgreng ri riba'i rdo rje rin chen shin tu che ba bdag la grub par mdzod/ /la lar mkhas pa'i gzugs kyang 'dzin/ /la lar dus mtha'i dus ltar drag /la lar rgyal ba'i dbang po bzhin du zhi/ /la lar rta mchog sbyor bas 'dod pa sgrub/ /rdo rje sku'i risumachod pa'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /me tog dkar dang dmar ba dang / /mthing ga )ser po kun bsdus pa/ /me tog phyag rgya mchog 'di ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spro/ /rgya skegs mthing ga ljang khu'i lhamadog /tshon ngasna bzhi yis btsos 7pa dang / /dkar po lnga yi phyag rgya dag /snga ma bzhin du mnyam par sgrub/ /khams las byung ba thams cad dang stu/ /srog dang rtsa ba'i 6de bzhin te/ /rnam cipar mdzes shing dri zhim pal/ /snga ma bzhin du mnyam par bsgrubastu/ /tsandan gnyis dang gla rtsi dang / /ga pur na tshag sha la gi/ /bdug pa bu ram dang sbyar ba/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ / gan dar dri dang gu gul dang / /sang ga bur gla rtsi dang / /rdzas 'di dag las 77—495

btsos pa'i mar/ /me mar byas na snang ba skye/ /tsandan gur gum 75 ka dang / /ga bur dang ni gla rtsi dang / /bcas pa bdug pa grub pa ste/ /spos kyi phyag rgya spos mchog 'gyur/ /gakko ril dang sug smel dang / /gla snang ga bur gla rtsi dang / /'di rnams zhib tu btags pa ni(ge/ /seng ldeng bu ram dag kyang ri risbyar / /shing tsha pa twa lo drwa dang / /na le sham dang ga bur sbyar/ /sa ha ka re tsho shing mngar gyis/ /sprus pa kha yi spos yin no sku/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya sbyor ba'o/ /me tog dmar po sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang la me tog dkar/ /ser po mkha' las byung ba la / /tsandan bdug pa sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la du ruska/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ka pi ta/ /ce 7pog rdo rje nyi ma la/ /mar me phreng ba sangs rgyas la /rdo rje can la mar me mdun / /spyan ras gzigs la mar me brgya/ /stong ni rdo rje nyi ma la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tsandan spos/ /rdo rje can la gur gum yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la tsandan dmar/ /ga bur rdo rje nyi ma la/ /me tog kun dang bdug pa kun/ /de bzhin mar me thams cad dang / /spos rnams thams cad ji ngasnyed pa/ /rdo rje rta la dbul mdu rung / /mchod pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /sgeg mo dang ni na chung dang / /myos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang / /gcig tu dpa' chodang 'dod chags sra/ /g.yon can bran mo de bzhin te/ /lan tshwa la sogs ro kun dang / /kha ra la sogs bdud rtsi bzhin/ /bdag nyid kyi ni par sgrub papa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub//sha dang chang du ldan pa yi/ /bza' ba sna tshogs grub pa ni/ / dga' ba'i 7longs spyod skal mchog ste/ /tshe yi dam pa rab tu 'grub/ /a ma mazin dang 77—496

rgun 0 'brum ji dang / /pa na sa dang ni ri ke ra / /ar ka ri la sogs 'bras bu yi tsho/ /phyag rgya'i mchog ni 'di rnams te/ /dngos grub 'bras bu thams cad 'thob/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi byugs pa yis / /a ma tshal sogs tshig gus byug /sa ha ka ra'i tsomar la sogs/ /mnyam pa'i dri yis bsku bar bya/ /yungs dang rgya skegs 7la sogs pa'i/ /tshon gyis mthun 6par kha bsgyur nas/ /shun pa gro ba la sogs byas/ /mchod pa'i tshe na dbul bar bya/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams la bshos dbul bar / /sha dang chang ni rnam par spangs / /glu dang sil snyan grub pa dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /sha dang chang du bcas pa ni/ /gtor ma'i mchog ste sna tshogs pa'o/ /bdag gi phyugs chen skal bzang po/ /rdo rje'i las ni dpal grub pa'o/ /bshos dang gtor ma dkar po dang / /padma'i me tog ldan pa ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gtso bo la/ /phul na dgos pa thams cad 'grub/ /rgyal po'i kha zas sna tshogs pa/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa dang / /glu dang sil snyan skal bzang dag /rdo rje nyi ma'i 'khor la dbul / /kha zas kun gyi ro rnams dang / /sha dang sha yi mchog rnams dang / /sha yi sbyor dang sha skam dang //bshos dag rdo rje rta la dbul/ /mchod pa dang gtor ma thams cad kyi cho ga'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe bo 7sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /mdzub tshomo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mor 7sbyar/ /sangs rgyas rin chen phyag rgya 'di/ /rang byung rnams kyi dbang bskur ba/ /rgyal srid thams cad ma lus pa/ /lus pa med par samyur du 'grub/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba dang / /'gram pa gnyis dang ltag —par ni/ /sangs rgyas 77—497

kun gyi rin chen mchog /dbu rgyan kun tu brgyan par bya/ /dbu rgyan bcings pas 〉bcings nas ni/ /'gying zhing mtha' mas midagrol bar bya/ /dar gyi mtha' ma dpyangs pa ltar/ /byas nas thal mo brdab par bya/ /sangs rgyas padmo rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa/ /de yis dgra med sdig med par /bdag gi longs spyod nyid du spyod/ /'di yis bsrung chib byas nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos grub che/ /'khor los sgyur zub rab tu 'grub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /nor bu rin po che'i dbu rgyan mnyam par sbyor ba skal pa bzang po dpal gyi phreng snab zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sor mo thams cad dang du bsnol/ /sor mo rtse mo kun sprad nas/ /mthe bo rdo rjes mnan pa ni/ /sna dang mig phugs lta bu ste//padmo'i rin chen phyag rgya 'di/ /bdag nyid chen ngo ra dbang bskur ba/ /rgyal srid thams cad ma lus pa/ /lus pa med par myur du 'grub/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral pa dang / /'gram pa gnyis dang ltag par sbyar/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i 7 dbu rgyan mete/ /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu 'bar/ /dbu rgyan bcings pas kṣibacings nas ni/ /'gying ba'i mtha' nas dgrol bar bya/ /dar gyi mtha' ma dpyangs pa 5ltar/ /byas nas thal mo brdab par bya/ /'di yis bsrung ba byas na 7ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal dang 'dra/ /khams gsum dag ni rgyal srid che / /'khor los sgyur skab rab tu 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje he ru ka padma tshanor bu rin po che'i dbu rgyan dzomanyam par sbyor ba skal 7ba bzang po dpal gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar te/ /lag gnyis nor bu rin chen du/ /ji ltar rigs tshopar mnyam sbyar nas/ /mdzub 7mo mthe bo kyi rtse mo 77—498

bzhi / /yongs su bsgyur te bteg tsa nas risu/ /dpral bar legs par gzhag rin ༅ni/ /khams gsum bdag po rgyal ba dag(ge /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub / /dpal rdo rje rin chen gyi kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa shin tu brkyang ba yi / /mdzub nu /mo gnyis pa'i mdud par bcing / /gung mo mthe bo'i rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su bsgyur/ / yongs su bsgyur tshote bteg nas kyang / /khro gnyer du ni legs bzhag na/ /rgyal srid thams cad legs 'grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /'di yis bsrung 7ba byas na ni/ /rdo rje las kyi dpal dang 'dra/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rab bsgrubs pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'gyur / /ma mo dang ni byad skum dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yang lhag par 'grub/ /dur khrod dngos grub thams cad dang / /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje he ru na'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe bo tshadapa' bo'i kyil mo spung —/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgugaci /gung mo gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar/ /lhag ma rdo rje thal mo'i 'od/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag rgya 'di/ /rang byung rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /'jig rten dbang po dam pa kun/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /'di yis bsrung stob byas na ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad dpal dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tshe —'grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa mamed par 'grub/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar la/ / mdzub mo bsnyams 7te phyi rol dgug /mthe bo gnyis ni rab tu brkyang / /rdo rje nor bu zhes kyang bya / /dpral bar myur du bzhag pa ni/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /rgyal srid thams cad rab sgrub 5pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 77—499

'grub /dpal nor bu rin po che dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas rin chen padmo dang / /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen mchog /rta mchog rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyag rgyas rab tu dbang bskur /ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /sor mo phan tshun ri bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mo yin par bshad/ /sor mo thams cad bsdams pa ni/ /rdo rje bsdams pa yin par bshad/ /rdo rje bsdams pa byas na cani/ /mdzub 0mo mthe bo'i nang dag tu/ /g.yas pa'i mthe 0bo'i mtshan ma 'di/ /rtse mo bcug la bsdam par bya /dga' chen dpal gyi phyag rgya ste/ /phyag rgya thams cad rang byung tsho ba/ /rab 'byam las rnams dngos grub ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par tsho'agrub/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje bcings nas ni/ /gung mo bcings pa'i dang du gzhug /mthe bo —mthe'u chung rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su bsgyur/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /de bzhin dpa' bo thams cad dang 7/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal bde ba chen po 2rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de las gung mo lcags kyu ni/ /bdag gi snying gar skesbyar bar bya/ /'di cini thams cad 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /de ma thag tu phyag rgya 'dis / /sangs rgyas padmo rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje nyi ma khams gsum pa/ /bkug ste dbang du byas nas tshani/ /las rnams kun la sbyor bar byed/ /dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams tshapa byas nas ni/ /gung mo bcings pa'i nang du gzhug /mthe'u chung mthe bo 7rtse mo can /rdo rje'i phyag rgyar yongs bsgyur na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpar yang — /sbyor ba 'di yis mi dka' skun/ /dngos grub gzhan dang las kyi 77—500

mchog /rab 'byam 3)gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings pa las/ /sbyor ldan thal mo khong stong sbyar/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /de ma thag tu 'bebs par byed/ /dpal rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rno rje'i phyag rgya bcings pa las/ /gung mo de bzhin bkug nas ni/ /rdo rje rdo rje zhes brjod de / /gung mo nam mkha'i rdo rje mchog /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'gro 'ong lding / /dpal ldan 'dod pa kun gyi bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje snying po'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa la gnas te/ /mthe bo'i rtse mo de bzhin mnyam / /mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dgug /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /dag pa kun la rab tu gnas/ /byang chub sems ni mtha' yas mchog /dngos grub thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje rab tu gnas pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje'i padmor byas pa las/ /gung mo bcings pa'i dbus na gnas/ /mthe'u chung mnyam pa'i rtse mo mde'u/ /rdo rje mda' ni yongs su 'phang —/ /phyag ( rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /tshangs pa nye dbang dga' byed bcas /mthu yis myur du brgyal byas tshonas/ /khams gsum dag ni sgrub tshapar byed/ /dpal rdo rje mda'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs bcings nas / /gung mo bcings pa'i phyi rol gzhag /rdo rje sna tshogs dpal gyi rgya/ /ldang ba thams cad rab grub pa'o/ /rdo rje'i 5phyag rgya thams cad bshes pa'o/ /ā li tā li mnyam byas nas/ /mkha' yi thad skar bsdu bar 7bya/ /de —yi thog tu ri mo rnams/ /yi ge thams cad dgod par bya/ /gug skyed dag gis pa ga 77—501

mar bya/ /yi ge ra ni myu gur 3bya/ /klad kor ( )zla ba kham ༅pa dang / /tsheg ri gnyis zla ba gnyis su bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi( / /phyag rgya mi 'gyur dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyi ri mor bshad/ /yi ge dag kyang mi 'gyur mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyi lha'i/ /bstod dang bcas pa'i mtshan bris na/ /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams ri cithams cad rab tu 'grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor zhes/ /rab tu chags pa'i mtshan bris na/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /bde ba thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /chags chen grol ba dpal zhes bya'i( 3/ /chags pa'i mtshan dag bris na ni/ /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /grol ‘ chib kun la rab tu gnas/ /snying rje dri med khro dpal zhes/ /bstod dang bcas pa'i mtshan bris na / /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchog kyang 'grub/ /padmo chags pa dpal dag ces/ /chags pa'i mtshan dag bris na ni/ /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /dag pa thams cad rnam par dag /rdo rje nyi ma'i dpal mdangs zhesakyi/ /bstod dang bcas pa'i mtshan bris na/ /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /longs spyod kun la rab tu gnas / /rta mchog pha rol gnon dpal zhes/ /chags pa'i mtshan dag bris na ni /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /dbang phyug thams cad rab tu 'grub / /brjod pa dag kyang de bzhin te/ /las kyi dngos grub rab 'byam dkudag /ma lus par ni myur du 'grub/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang gang gi/ /slob dpon gang mdang gang yin pas/ /de dang de yi mtshan dag ni/ /dpal gyi tshig dang ldan par brjod/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor btsud nas kyang / /yon gyi 77—502

mchog dag blangs nas ni/ /rdo rje ming gi /dbang bskur bas/ /de bzhin gshegs par de lung bstan/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di dag gis/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu gnas/ /de nas sangs rgyas su yang 'gyur/ /bstod pa dang bcas pa'i ming gi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /spyi bor zhug pa gang yin pa/ /phyag 'tshal bar ni ston pa yin/ /dpral chibar reg par byed pa ni/ /phyag lan riyin par shes par bya/ /smin ma bskul ba gang yin pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gnas pa'i brda / /g.yas pas nam mkhar 'gro ba 'grub/ /g.yon pa rnam par rgyal ba yitsho / /rang byung rnams kyi brda ོyi rgya/ /mig gnyis g.yo bar 'grub pa ste/ /g.yon pa bud med bzang mo yin//g.yas pa skyes pa bzang po'o/ /rna ba dag la reg pa'i brda ’/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis ka de bzhin te/ /g.yon pa legs par blangs pa'i sku / /g.yas pa legs par smras pa'o/ /sna yi bu ga gnyis kyi brda / /sangs rgyas thams cad gnas pa ste/ /g.yas pa bdag la bdug bapa slong / /g.yon pa bdag la dri slong ba'o/ /lce ni ldag mepa ltar byed pa/ /brda 4yi phyag rgyar paganas pa ste/ /g.yas pa sha yi phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa chang gi phyag rgya yin/ /mche ba g.yas dang g.yon pa yi/ /bar du ma mchu mnan pa ni/ /g.yon pa bud med reg na bde /g.yas pa de bzhin skyes pa'o/ /lkog mar reg pa'ang de bzhin te/ /brda 7yi 4phyag rgyar gnas pa ste/ /theg pa chen po bla med pa'i/ /rtog pa thams cad smra ba'i mchog /snying gar tshoglen du 'dren pa ni/ /rang byung phyag rgya'i brda 7grub pa/ /rdo rje thams cad 'dren pa ste/ /'khor ba shin tu sdud pa'o/ /lte ba'i dkyil du reg pa ni/ /brda 5yi 5phyag rgyar gnas pa ste/ /77—503

dbu ma'i nan tan bsgrubs pa yis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil/ /rang gi dbang po bsgreng /pa ni/ /rang byung rnams kyi brda ( yi rgya/ /de las de bzhin bde ba yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /phrag pa gnyis ni kun bstod pa/ /brda yi phyag rgyar gnas pa ste/ /g.yas pa 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa slad du gtong ci ba'o/ /dpung pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka yis / /bdag la shes rab 'khyud pa yi rme/ /g.yas pa thams cad 'grub pa yin / /g.yon pa dbang phyug thams cad 'grub/ /khu tshur g.yas g.yon gnyis ka yis/ / khu tshur bcangs dang dgrol ba dag /g.yas pa rgyas 'debs phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa mi rnams thong shig ripa'o/ /brla tshotshoganyis rab tu bsdams pa ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa de bzhin te/ /g.yon pa 'dod la rab tu brtson//g.yas pa chos la brtson pa'o/ /pus 7mo lha nga'i brda 7dag kyang / /g.yas dang g.yon pa de bzhin te/ /g.yon pa 'dud pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /g.yas pa rab tu phyag 'tshal ba'o / /pus mo g.yas g.yon gnyis dag gis/ /brda yi phyag rgyar rab tu gnas/ /g.yas pa bcing ba'i 5phyag rgya ste/ /g.yon pa thams cad rnam par dgrol/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis sa gnon pa/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa de bzhin te/ /g.yon pa thams cad gnod par byed/ /g.yas pa thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /dngos grub las dang bde ba dgam /'di yis mi 'grub —gang yang med/ /rang don las rnams rab grub pa/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /brda piyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /oṃ a ti ku zhes bya ba'i brda //'di ni phyag 'tshal ba zhes pa'o/ /pra ti oṃ rnyi gyi zhes pa/ /phyag lan rtsoyin par shes par bya'o/ /sems dpa' sngon dang mtha' med pa/ /rdo rje sems 77—504

dpa' bde ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas ①phyag rgya bde ba riyis e ma'o bde ba yin par bshad/ /e ma'o bde ba dpal gyi mtshan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gang brjod pa/ /sdig pa kun las thar bar 'gyur ri/ /bde ba thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /bde mchog ye ma'o bde ba dang / /sgron ma de bzhin shi shi dag /rgyas 'debs ma dang rmongs byed dang / /za ba mo dang tshe 'phel ma sangs rgyas byang chub chos 'khor lo/ /de bzhin khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ /'dod pa'i smyug ma thams cad kyang / /phyag rgya brda yi phyag rgya'o/ /rta dang rdo rje'i zhal dag dang / /de bzhin rdo rje snang ba dang / /thal bar zlog pa'i ro langs ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda yin no/ /gling bu dang ni rgyud rnams dang — /de bzhin du ni rgyud gcig dang / /stug po dang ni rdza rnga dag /sangs rgyas brda 7yi phyag rgya'o/ /me tog mchod dang bdug pa'i mchod/ /de bzhin mar me'i mchod pa dang / /spos kyi mchod pa gla 7rtsi dag /longs spyod phyag rgya'i brda yin no/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 7klas pa'i/ /lha mo kun gyi brda yin no/ /smin ma bskyod pa mda' bzhi yin/ /bha ga ling ga e ma'o bde/ /thod pa padma ci yin par bshad/ /kha ṭwāṃ pag yang rgyal mtshan che/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya padmar gnas/ /bde ba kun gyi bdud rtsi yin/ /sangs rgyas brda yi phyag rgya yis/ /shi shi sangs rgyas kun tu bshad/ /dkyil 'khor la ni 'khor lor bshad/ /de nyid dam tshig yin par bshad/ /lha rnams thams cad tshogs pas na/ /skye bo dam pa kun tshogs pa/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni / /mdza' ba thams cad 'dus pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda tshadag rtegis//77—505

de bzhin mdza' bar /ri'adus par gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal spyor bas / /dkyil 'khor thams cad yin par bshad/ /lha mo thams cad kun 'dus pas/ /thams cad sna tshogs skal ba bzang / /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas kun tu bdag sbyor bas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen shes pa'i phyir/ /kun gyi slob dpon yin par bshad/ /kun gyi slob dpon rab gnas pa/ /lha mo thams cad 'dus pas na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog dag gis/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po'o/ / de yi ( )slob ma grub pa ni/ /grub pa'i rjes su grub pas na/ /sangs rgyas brda yi ri gsang ba yis/ /rgyal mtshan yin par rnam par bshad/ /de las gzhan pa'i sgrob ma kun/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'i rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda cadag gis/ /byang chub sems dpa' yin par bshad/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen mchog /dbu rgyan mi 'gyur dam pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid mchog /yin par rang byung rnams kyis gsungs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /sangs rgyas brda riyi phyag rgya yis / /dpal gyi padma'i tshul du bshad/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin grub gcig snyedang / /de bzhin padma'i tshorang bzhin gcig /thams cad dbang bskur dbang bskur che /yin par don kun grub pas gsungs/ /yon gyi dam pa grub pa ni/ /nor gyi dbyig tu bshad pa ste/ /snying yang nor gyi mchog yin par/ /sangs rgyas brda ltayi phyag rgyar bshad/ /ga pur tsandan dmar po dang / /sbyar skab khrag ⑫chen yin par bshad/ /tshogs kyi dbus su bzhag pa dpal/ /thams cad ldang ba'i ra sa yin/ /bag zan las ni byas pa'i rgyugs/ /tsandan dmar pos 77—506

bskus pa dang / /bag phye'i zan las byas pa'i sha/ /rgyal po'i zan zhes gang bshad pa'o/ /de nas grub pa'i mna' bsgag sgyu pa/ /dam tshig ces par gnas pa'o/ /bde mchog bde mchog ces gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas bde mchog thams cad kyis/ /phyag rgya'i bde ba mchog tu gsungs/ /de bzhin e ma'o bde ba dang / /snang ba shes pa'ang rab tu gnas/ /shi shi srid pa'ang srid pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang / /'da' bar bya ba'ang ma ri yin pas/ /sangs rgyas brda riyi phyag rgya yis ri/ /phyag rgya dam tshig yin par bshad//phyag rgya'ang spyor ba yin par bshad/ /sbyor ba'ang 0phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba thams cad yin par bshad/ /nga ni sna tshogs dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas brda yi phyag rgya yis / /spyor ba thams cad yin par bshad/ /de yi nye ba'i longs ri spyod ni/ /khams gsum thams cad ma lus pa'o/ /de yi gzugs dang sgra dang dri /ro dang reg pa bde myos ཿpa'o/ /gzugs ni ri mo yin par gsungs / /sgra ni glu yin zhes bshad do/ /dri ni rab tu tshim par gsungs/ /ro ni ra sa ya na yin/ /reg pa bde ba yin par bshad/ /rab tu reg pa dga' ba'i bde / /sangs rgyas brda skoyi phyag rgya yis / /chos ni spyor ba yin par bshad/ /spyor ba'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /ji ltar bde bar sten pabyed cing / /bdag gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyar ba/ /rang gi mchod pa'i dam tshig yin/ /rjes su sbyor bas mchod na ni/ /sbyor ba kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas brda ོyi phyag rgya yis / /bde ba chen po yin par bshad/ /lha mo kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'o/ /ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug tso77—507

pa / /rnal 'byor zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas brda mi yi phyag rgya yis/ /ting 'dzin rab tu sbyor ba'ang bshad/ /lha mo kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlab bo / /dga' bar spyod pa grub par bshad/ /rjes su sbyor ba rjes su grub / /skyes pa ltar byed dga' spyod pa/ /slar yang rjes su grub par mdzad / /lha mo kun la bde 'jug ri )pa/ /sbyor ba kun la mos pa ni/ /kun tu sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /ra sa ya na bde bar bshad/ /thams cad ldang ba kun 'gro ba/ /dngos grub dam par rab tu bshad/ /dngos grub chen po ldang ba cher/ /sangs rgyas brda ri riyi phyag rgyar bshad/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po bla na med/ /sangs rgyas dam pa kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda /yis bshad/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po bde ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba'i dbang phyug bde chen po / /khrag ni me tog yin par bshad/ /mdangs ni bdug pa yin par bshad/ /sha chen dag ni mar me ste / /thal mo dag ni spos su bshad/ /chang ni sgeg mo yin par bshad /rab tu myos pa sprang rtsi'o/ /bu ram chang ni myos byed gsungs/ /rgun chang dag ni bdud rtsi yin/ /bdud rtsi lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda 5yin no/ /rgyan dang sbrang rtsi mchog tu dpa'/ /tshwa ni 'dod chags sra ba yin/ /skyur po'i khu ba g.yon can yin/ /ka bal ni bran mor bshad / /chur skob zla ba nya ba yin/ /sha ni sman lagyi mchog yin te/ /dbang phyug dam pa kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda payis bshad/ /dngos 77—508

grub chen po kun gyi ①mchog /chang ni ra sa ya nar bshad/ /zas ni tshe zhes bya bar bshad/ /bza' ba sna tshogs grub pa ni/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa dag /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal bzang po/ /tshe yi dam pa yin par bshad/ /a za rgyan 'brum pa na sa/ /na li ke ra a ru ka /'bras bu chen po'i khyad par dag /bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu yin par bshad/ /sa za smin 0pa grol bar bshad / /de bzhin bde bar nyal ba dang / /bde bas rab tu rmongs pa dag /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda 0yin no/ /'bras bu chen po pa na sa/ /rgyan 'bru'i ( khu ba khu ba'i mchog /na li ke ra'i dngos grub che/ /dam chos 'bras bu ma ru na su /glu yi tshig tu brjod par bshad/ /dar dir dag ni sil snyan yin/ /sangs rgyas brda yi phyag rgya yis/ /gar ni rnam par rol par bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal spyor ba'i/ /glu dang sil snyan gar byed pa/ /brda ngayi dam par bshad pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam sprul pa'o/ /rab tu zhi ba'i sil snyan glu/ /dur khrod glu dang sil snyan dang / /gar ni shin tu rnam sprul pa'o/ /chags bcas glu dang sil snyan dang / /gar ni shin tu rnam sprul pa'o/ /mi yi dbang po'i sil snyan glu/ /gar ni shin tu rnam sprul pa'o/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sil snyan glu/ /rang gi rtsal gyi gar byas pa/ /rta mchog rnam par sprul pa ni/ /brda 7yi dam pa parab tu bshad/ /hā zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro yi/ /khams gsum 'dir ni rnam par brtags / /nam mkhar 'gro ba'i phyag rgya dag /mkha' 'gro zhes ni rab tu grags/ /kun tu sna tshogs phyag rgya ni/ /thams cad nam mkha' pa'agro ba ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /sgyu ma'i gar dbang grub pa ni/ /a ra li zhes ming du 77—509

btags / /mkha' 'gro ma yang a ra li/ /sangs rgyas brda shu yi ci phyag rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /sgyu ma kun gyi gar byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dam tshig mchog /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /rdo rje sa ra li ( zhes bshad( / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /sems dpa' sngon dang mtha' med pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas brda yi phyag rgya yis/ /de ni skal ba bzang por bshad/ /gang zhig rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan/ /skal ba bzang po zhes brjod na/ /shin tu srid pa kun 'grub cing / /de ni dbang phyug chen po 'grub/ /ṭakki ru 'dod sngu yin par bshad /dga' ba ki tsholi ki la yin/ /byams pa chu srin yin par bshad/ /'dod pa'i dbang po dbang rgyug mchog /rdo rje dril bu ⑩phyag rgya dag /dam tshig gsum gyi dam pa yin/ /oṃ dang ku khaṃ kun bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas brda skya yi phyag rgya yin/ /drangs te bcug tshanas bcings pa dang / /zhugs nas dbang du gyur pa ni/ /dzaḥ hoḥbashad pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda ngayin no/ /e nyi ya nyi zhes bshad pa/ /tshur spyod phar bzhud ces bsgrags mapa'o / /ti dziha tshoha zhes gsungs pa ni/ /longs tshal drongs shig drongs shig pa'o / /kha kha khra hi tshozo shig 4pa'o/ /a pi zhes pa 'thung zhig pa'o/ /da ra da ra byin zhes lapa'o/ /ru ta ma ta rol cig pa'o/ /hu lu hu lu zhugs shig pa'o / /a ra ra rar skul :cig pa'o/ /ye ma'o bde mchog ngo mtshar ni/ /a la la ruho zhes bshad pa'o/ /bde mchog rgyas 'debs phyag rgya yin/ /e ma'o bde ba rmongs byed ma'o/ /snang ba zhes pa za ba mo / /rgyu shi shi ni tshe 'phel 77—510

ma'o/ /shin tu brtan dang rab tu brtan/ /kun tu brtan dang cher brtan pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /'jig rten dbang dang mkha' las skyes/ /shes 'gyur dag 'gyur 4)grub par 'gyur/ /zhugs la dbang du 'gyur bar mdzod / / oṃ oṃ (kyis a kun bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas brda ri yi phyag rgya yin/ /thams cad mkhyen par gyur pa dang / /de bzhin bde bar mkhyen pa ni/ /oṃ sa thad ces bshad pa ste/ /sangs rgyas brda byuyi phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ ru ru sgru ru dzwa ( )la tiṣṭha sid dha ri )lo tsa ni sab arsha sā dha ni gu hā/ 'khor lo mchidangos grub mkhyen pa dang / /don dam nye bar zhi ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rang byung —bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam snang mdzad chen gtso bo ni/ /sangs rgyas brda tsho yi phyag rgya yin/ /skal ba bzang po zhes bshad pa'o/ / ko ṭa kṣa / ko ṭa ba/ko ṭa brtsi/ ko sbo ri skam /ko la ga kṣa/ ko la ba/ ko la/ ko la brtsi/ko mal bha sta thā/ phyag na rdo rje rang don gyi/ /mtshan 'di rnams ni gang brjod pa / /de la rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /bran bzhin dngos grub ster mabar 'gyur/ /rgyal srid dang ni longs spyod dang / /gter gyi rnams kyang lhag par ster/ /dgos pa thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dgra yang med par byed/ /mig dang rna ba sna dag dang / /rtse dang lus kyang de bzhin te/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dag dang / /ro dang reg kyang 6bdag gi don/ /rdo rje mtshon cha be di dang / /dgra bo dag tu rab grags pa/ /de yis mephyag na rdo rjer pa'agyur/ /lag na rdo rje zhes kyang bya/ /nyon mongs thams cad gang zad dang / /dgra rnams kyang ni gang zad pa/ /phyag na rdo rjes dzo'adul ba'i phyir/ /de ni yakṣa yin par bshad/ /he ru dpal ni rdo rje che/ /thal bar 'jig pa'i mchog yin 77—511

te /sangs rgyas kun gyi khro bo che/ /brda rkiyis rab tu bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rab tu 'jigs/ /kha ṭwāṃ ri ga ni rgyal mtshan che/ /thod pa kham por ri mipadma'i snod/ /khrag chen dang ni zang rtsi che/ /dkar mo lisku byed rab thongs dang —/ /ro langs dang ni sbos 5byed dang / /gtum mo skudang ni sme ma dang / /lha mo bdun ni brda yin no/ /srungs tsho shig myur du rnam rgyal dpal/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu lhogs/ /haṃ haṃ hri te kun bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas brda yi phyag rgya yin/ /rol cig dgongs shig de bzhin du/ /rol du chug cig mgasod du chug /mār ziṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda 7yin te//rgyal po chen po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbang phyug medam pa'i rig pa ni/ /sangs rgyas brda 7yi phyag rgya yis/ /skal ba bzang po yin par bshad/ /rgyal po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /'jig rten dbang phyug ces 7bshad de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda dag gis/ /de yang skal ba bzang zhes bshad/ /dag dang grub dang de bzhin blo/ /rdzu 'phrul 'phel dang 'byor pa dang / /rnam par lta dang sgrol ma dang / /rgya chen ma dang khro gnyer ma/ /padmar nu tshoganas zhes bya ba dang — /rdo rje padma'i dbang rgyug ma/ /padma ci mo rigs chen te/ /sangs rgyas brda yi saphyag rgyas bshad/ /nam mkha'i snying po thams cad phyogs/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /skal ba bzang zhes rnam par grags/ /rdo rje nyi ma nor bu che/ /ṭwāṃ dang 2ba ba ṭa ṭa dang gyu/ /tra ṭa tra ṭa 7kun ri grags pa / /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda yin te/ /dbang bskur ba dang gter dag dang — /rgyal mtshan rtse mo mchod chen po/ /sna tshogs padma ri thams cad spyan/ /de bzhin 'jig rten thams cad pa/ /byang chub kun gyi sems chen po/ /sna 77—512

tshogs rdo rje bla na med/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /'jig rten thams cad rab 'jigs pa/ /rta mchog padma dpal dang ldan/ /skal ba bzang zhes brda sna yis bstan/ /brda riyi phyag rgya 'di rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor bas nges pa ni/ /grogs po mkhas par bcas pa yis / /dngos grub thams cad 'grub capar 'gyur/ /brda yi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /rjes su chags par bya'o zhes/ /cha lugs shes pa bzhin byed cing / /dngos grub kun la rjes chags pa/ /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid rtag tu rnam pa kun/ /las kyi dngos grub rab 'byam dag /ma lus par ni myur du 'grub / /rjes su chud par bya'o zhes/ /cha lugs shes pa bzhin byed pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mchog /cho 'phrul dag ni ston par byed/ /rjes su chud par bya'o zhes/ /cha lugs shes pa bzhin byed pas/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rjes su sbyang bar bya'o zhes/ /cha lugs shes pa bzhin byed pas/ /sgrib sbyang /rithams cad dngos grub rnams/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /rjes su yi rang bya'o zhes/ /cha lugs shes pa bzhin byed pas/ /bud med la sogs rin chen mchog /mchod pa'i las kun myur du 'grub/ /rjes su gzhom par bya'o zhes/ /cha lugs shes pa bzhin byed pas/ /rtul phod las rnams thams cad ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /ye shes kyi 7phyag rgya shes pa'o / /rdo rje sems dpa' 7dpal sbyor ba/ /dbyibs dang gzugs ni ci 'drar ldan/ /thams cad bdag nyid rgyar sbyor bas / /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bdag nyid rtag tu 77—513

rnam pa kun/ /pra 4se na yi skudangos grub mchog /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gis / /yang dag bden pa tshul bzhin du/ /mthong ba dang ni thos par byed/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang / /khams rnams kun ni 0thams cad las(ri/ /thams cad mthong zhing thos par byed/ /rnam par shes pa kun 'grub cing / /kun tu thams cad kun gyi bdag /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad dang / /rnam par shes pa'i las kun la/ /thams cad mthong zhing shes par byed/ /padmar chags par rjes chags shing / /sna tshogs padmar ( ris 'byed pas/ /pra tshose na ni sna tshogs pa/ /mthong ba dang ni thos par byed/ /me tog bdug pa mar me mchog /spos dang mchod pa thams cad la/ /rnam par shes pa kun grub pa/ /thams cad mthong zhing thos par byed/ /reg dang ma reg rdo rje che/ /ral gri me long mda' gzhu dang / /shing dang chu dang 'bab chu brag /gzugs brnyan byung ba'i khyim bdag skolas/ /bya dang de bzhin mi bya dang / /stor ba dang ni ma stor dang / /phrogs ji pa dang ni ma phrogs skudang / /de bzhin rnyed 7dang ma rnyed dang / /gson pa dang ni shi ba dang / /de bzhin rgyal dang pham pa dang — /don yod dang ni don med dang / /de bzhin grub dang mi grub dang / /bde dang mi bde cho ga bzhin/ /lha yul dag gi chodon rnams dang / /sangs rgyas zhing gi don rnams kyang / /kun tu kun nas thams cad ni/ /bsams tshopa mthong zhing thos par byed/ /rnam par shes pa'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ci 7lta'i dbyibs dang gzugs ldan pas/ /dur khrod lha yi gnas rnams dang / /ma mo gnas kyi thal ba mchog /thams 77—514

cad dpral ba'i bsrung yi ba ni/ /thig le sor ( riris gsum du bya/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa bcings na/ /bsrung sku ba kun gyi bla med pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje thal ba'i dam tshig ces ci bya ba'i bsrung riba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ci rnyilta'i dbyibs dang gzugs ldan pas/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i gzugs chu'i 'gram/ /lha rdzas zhi ba'i chu mchog gis/ /gtor ba dang ni drugs pa dang / /khrus byas pa dang 'bogs pa yis/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa bcings na/ /bsrung rib kun gyi bla med pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi dri ma med pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba / /ci tsho lta'i gzugs dang dbyibs ldan pas/ /mi yi thod pa'i nang du ni/ / yungs kur khobaskyed nas blang bar bya/ /lo ma yungs lha mar zas su bza'/ /mgo bskus de bzhin 'bras bu yis/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa bcings na//bsrung stub kun gyi bla med pa'o/ /dpal don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ma mchu so yis legs mnan nas / /dpal ldan g.yon du 'gying dang bcas/ /gsal bar phyogs su 'khor lo'i tshul/ /bla thog tu ni byin brlabs zun/ /gnas gsum dag ni rgyas 'debs so/ /gzhug dka' bdag nyid ngan pa'i rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor 'grub/ /thams cad kyi mchog gnas kyi dbang jig byin gyis brlabs pa dpal skal ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /lha mo kun dang 'dus pa yis/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po/ /bde bar rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgya 'dis btab ma thag tu ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs 'gyur/ /shin tu byin gyis brlabs 'gyur sngalas/ /77—515

sangs rgyas kun dang phrad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pas na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 4)mnyam sbyor ba//dpal skal ba bzang po'i dam tshig ces snyebya ba'i bsrung kyiba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag sbyor ldan pas/ /phyogs su legs par 'khor lo'i tshul/ /bla dang 'og tu byin brlabs cirinas/ /'di yis bsrung ri ba byas na ni/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus par/ /gzhug dka' bdag nyid ngan pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis tsho byin brlabs ci'agyur/ /thams cad kyi mchog gnas kyi dbang phyug dpal zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ho ru dpal gyis rnam sprul pas/ /thams cad kun tu kun gyi bdag /thams cad bsrung tshob mi 'gyur che/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /mkha' 'gros gtse dang gdon 7rnams dang / /bdud dang ngan khrid thams cad ni/ /mod 7la rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje he ru ka dbab pa rnam par sprul pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo je sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ci 5lta'i dbyibs dang gzugs ldan zhing / /sna tshogs padma dhikha 'byed pas/ /sgrib pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam par grol/ /dag pa thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /dag pa thams cad rnam dag na/ /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i padma 5zhes bya ba'i bsrung ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal spyor ba / /'bar ba blta 7ba'i tshul zhugs na/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i me/ / /rab tu 'jigs pa mi bzod 'gyur/ /'di yis bsrung 7ba byas 77—516

na ni/ /bskal pa yi ①ni me ltar 'bar/ /'di yis gangan 'gro rnams ( rigasum dang —/ /khams gsum dag kyang thal bar rlog /rdo rje chen po'i me rab tu 'jigs pa 'bar ba mi bzad 4pa'i dam tshig chen po'i dpal zhes cibya ba'i phyag rgya'o / /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba/ /ci lta'i tshul bzhin byed pa yis/ /rdo rje chukhu tshur gnyis bcings cinas/ /go cha bgo ba'i thabs su bya/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral bar gnyis/ /glo gnyis dang ni rgyab tu gnyis/ /rdo rje phreng ba bcing ba dang / /sangs rgyas gtsug gi nor bu dag /dar dpyangs tshothabs su bcings nas ni/ /'gying dang bcas par mtha' nas dgrol/ /dar dpyangs pa 7yi thabs byas nas/ /thal mo brdabs pas brtan 7par bya/ /'di yis bsrung tshib byas na ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal dang 'dra/ /mi chod pa dang mi byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rab tu 'grub/ /rims nad dug dang dbyig dug nad / /mkha' 'gros gtse dang gdon rnams dang / /yan lag ma rung byed pa kun / /'di yis bsrungs na yong mi tshugs/ /dpal rdo rje go cha zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /bsrung 7ba thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /chos sems dpa' stuyi tshul ston cing / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dag dang / /zhi ba'i lta bas bltas nas ni/ /rims dang dug rnams thams cad sel / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mthe'u chung lcags myu lta bur bcing / /mdzub mo mnyam papa'i rtse mos mnan/ /nad rnams thams cad zlog 7par byed/ /yongs su bsgyur te bteg nas ni/ /dpral bar bde bar gzhag par bya/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yis / /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed/ /dpal rdo rje smin mtshams lus kyi nad gso ba'o/ /rdo rje bsdam 5pa byas pa las/ /mdzub mo phan tshun 77—517

mngon phyogs pa/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /zug rngu kun las grol bar 'gyur / /bu nad lhog rgal skran dag dang / /dmu rdzings 4)la sogs kun las thar —/ /'di nyid grub par gyur nas ni/ /nad rnams kun gyis gnod pa med / /zug rngu rithams cad med par byed pa'o / /grub pa dpal gyi spyan bcings te/ /'di yis mig gnyis phyis na choni/ /phyag rgya grub pa ji mchog 'di yis /long ba dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid sbyor bas ldan byas la / /rdo rje khu tshur dam po yis/ /drang ba'i tshul du klad ( /pa nas/ /kha phyogs drang zhing btung bar bya/ /rims dang dug dang gdon rnams kun/ /rdo rje khu tshur dpal gyis bzung / /bdag gi /lhar ni sbyor / ldan pas/ /'thungs na thams cad med par 'gyur/ /klad ci pa'i sman no/ /ta thā ga ta ga sta masi ho//'di na cin bar bzlas pa'i mchog /zug rngu med cing myur du thar/ /zug rngu thams cad sbyin pa po'o / /g.yas pa yi ni lag pa yis/ /sems pa'i tshagatsug tor —bcings na ni/ /byis pa nad med 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /thams cad bsrungs shing bde ba thob ci/ /gzhon nu gso ba'o/ /g.yas pa yi ni lag pa yi /klu yi gdengs ka lta bur bya/ /'bar ba'i tshul ston 'bebs 7bcas na//dug gi las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /'bar dang 'dul dang bcings pa dang / /za ba'i dug rnams med par byed/ /gdug zupas zin dang lu ta dang / /shi ba sos par byed pa'i mchog /gdengs ke'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i mthe bo stogung mo gnyis/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa yi/ /gung mo la ni reg byas na /gdon rnams kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /dug gso ba dang gdon gyi cho ga'o /ba dan gsum po gnyis bcings nas/ /gung mo gnyis ni mdud par 77—518

bcing / /mdzub /tshomo mthe'u chung rtse mo can/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs bcings la/ /yongs su bsgyur te bteg nas su/ /smin ma'i mtshams su bzhag ripa ni//mkha' 'gro'i las rnams ma lus pa / /lus pa med pa thams cad 'grub/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /gnas gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas thos pa dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /dpal rdo rje nye ru rka'i khro gnyer zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ste ma mo shes pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' kyedapal sbyor bas/ /rta rnams thams cad zhon na ni/ /rta rnams nad med sos tshopa dang / /nyam skye mthar —zhing mgyogs par 'gyur/ /dpal rta mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas/ /glang po kun la zhon na ni/ /glang po thams cad nad med sos/ /nyam skye spro ldan mos / par 'gyur/ /shrī badzra sa twa st+waṃ 5si ho/ /'di ni rna bar bzlas pa'i mchog /bya rnams nad med 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /mi yi skad du smra bar 'gyur/ /bya gso ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas/ /'byor pa kun la rjes chags na/ /shing rnams nad med mi bskams shing lke/ /rtag tu pame tog 'bras bur ldan/ /shing rnams bskyed —pa'i gtsug lag las/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga gang bshad pa/ /phyag rgya 'di yis thams cad ni/ /yid la bsams —pa bzhin du 'grub / /shing bskyed lha pa'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /'khrul 'khor gyis 'phangs ma 'phangs dang / /de bzhin lag pas 'phangs pa dang / /'phangs nas slad du bzung 7ba dang / /stobs su 'gyed pa lnga yin te/ /rang byung rnams kyi dgra cha'i dpyad/ /phyag rgya lnga lnga tshorab tu gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gyis bshad /dam pa de dag bshad par bya/ /dbyibs dang bde blag sbyor ba 77—519

dang —/ /kun tu sbyor dang 'dren mar gyur0/ /'gengs dang 'phen dang gsal ( ba'o /rkang pa gshibs pas sa mnan cing / /rkang pa 'gyed pas sa gnon to//dkyil 'khor dag kyang mnan par bya/ /brkyang bskum gyis kyang gnas gsum gnon /dbyibs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /mi stod 0pa dang sran gzugs dang / /mnyen zhing yan lag bstan pa dang / /rgya cher 'gengs shing rnam par dag /lus kyi phyag rgya bde blag can/ /'di yis lus la gnon pa dang / /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gros gtse dang gdon rnams kyis/ / nams kyang tshugs par yong mi 'gyur/ /rgya cher 'gengs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rang gi snying gar 'dren tshul du/ /bde blag 7can gyis gzhu bzung nas/ /g.yas pa rab tu gar byed cing / /mda' 'phangs na ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i'o7/ /lag pa g.yon pa legs bsrang ⑫la / /skyon med pa yis skegayas pa dgug /gzhu rgyud dal bus drangs nas ni/ /'gro ba thams cad dgug par bya/ /thams cad dgug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rna drung cibar du skum por ni/ /ji ltar rigs par legs bkang skal/ /yi ge oṃ tsam rang gi khar/ /bzung tshan 'gro ba 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'dzin pa'i phyag rgya'o / /ji ltar rigs —pas drangs nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bzung nas kyang //der ni cung zad dbye bar bya/ /'gengs pas mthams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'gengs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /chang pas 'ben ni 'grib 7par bya/ /'dzum dang bcas pa'i mig gis blta/ /lta ba chang pa la gtad nas/ /myur du 'phangs na dam pa 'grub/ /mda' gzhus rgyal bar bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /gru bzhi pa la rno ba dang / /de bzhin kun nas bskor bar bya/ /g.yas phyogs nas ni mnga' 77—520
