bskor nas/ /snad yi)de de bzhin bstod pa dang / /rkang pas mnan tsho cing mig ripas gnon( / /'thags pa bcu yi rgya mchog gis/ /khams gsum rgyal srid chen po dag /bde bar thub nas nye bar spyod/ /dpal khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'o( / /rab tu 'phangs dang mnyam par 'phangs/ /de bzhin glog ltar 'phangs pa dang / /glog ltar 'khrug pa de bzhin te/ /phyag rgya thabs rnams sgrub pa'o / /thabs thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /nyam nga lag dang bde phyogs dang / /thad ka de bzhin gyen du 'debs/ /'di dag bzlog pa'i phyag rgya ste//gnas gsum dag ni bzlog par bya/ /nges par bzlog tshopa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o / /thams cad 'debs dang nges par 'debs/ /kun 'debs gyen du 'debs pa'i gar/ /'di dag 'phrog pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /gnas gsum dag kyang 'phrog par byed/ /'phrog pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o /kun tu kun nas thams cad kyi/ /rtag tu bdag nyid rnam pa kun/ /mda' gzhu'i dpyad kyi phyag rgya'i mchog /mi 'gyur dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /dgra cha thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /srin lag gnyis kyi nang du ni/ /mthe bo legs par gzhag par bya/ /de nas khu tshur bcangs nas ni/ /mdzub rtemo legs par dgug dkupar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur dpal gyi rgya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal la gnas/ /las kyi dngos grub rab 'byam rnams/ /ma lus par ni myur du 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur legs bcangs rnal/ /bdag gis khomathe bo'i nang du gzhug /zhi ba'i las rnams rab grub pas/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur ro/ /rdo rje khu tshur legs bcangs la/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni rab brkyang rinas/ /77—521

mkha' 'gro'i las rnams thams cad ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje he ru ga'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgya'o/ /bdeg pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa las / /mthe bo /dag la gung mo bzhag ri /dpal padmo'i 0khu tshur grub pa ste/ /thams cad dag pa'i las la sbyar/ /dpal padmo'i )khu tshur ro/ /khu tshur rdo rje rin chen mchog /'bebs pa thams cad yongs gardzogs pa sku/ /rang don las rnams grub pa ni / /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /dpal rdo rje rin po che'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dpal bcangs la sor mo thams cad yongs su bzung / /rtul phod las rnams thams cad ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /las thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /rkang pa brkyang dang gnon pa dang / / bskum nas bteg cipa'i stabs /dag dang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba yis/ /gzugs rnams thams cad gnon 7par bya/ /rig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon 5du/ /rnam par snang mdzad dpal mnan nas/ /kun tu byang chub yongs bkug ste/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal mnan nas/ /kun tu grub pa yongs bkug ste/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /rig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon ༄du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dpal mnan nas/ /kun tu dpal mo yongs bkug ste/ /bdag gi paspyad par de spyod do/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon rshadu/ /rdo rje nyi ma dpal mnan 7nas/ /kun tu longs spyod yongs bkug ste/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon ⑫du / /rta mchog dam pa dpal mnan nas/ /thams cad dbang phyug yongs bkug ste/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /byang chub pha rol phyin pa dang / /77—522

grub dang gzungs /tshodang sa rnams dang / /rig dang phyag rgya rnams mnan nas/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /sdig med stobs kyis dngo 'thon ( du/ /dbang rgyug dam pa mnan nas ni/ /mig gsum pa las gsum grub bkug /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon ri du/ /mthu bo che yang mnan nas ni/ /snying las dpa' mo yongs bkug ste/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod dori / /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon du/ /skye dgu'i tshobadag po tshomanan nas ni/ /mos las grol ma yongs tshabakug nas/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /sdig med stobs kyis ngo 'thon du /rab dga'i dbang phyug mnan nas ni/ /kun gyi bdag las dga' bar 5bkug /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do //'jigs la sogs pa'i lha mo dang / /ma mo byad rima'i ma mo dang / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams mnan nas ni/ /bdag gi spyad par de spyod do/ /de bzhin ku be ra la sogs/ /rig pa 'grub pa spyod pa dang / /mi yi rgyal po la sogs kyang / /mnan nas bdag gi spyad pa spyod/ /'gro ba dang ni mi 'gro ba'icho/ /dngos po thams cad ma lus pa'ang / /rnal 'byor bdag nyid des mnan panas/ /bdag gi spyad par snyede spyod do/ /dpal rdo rje gnon pa'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /khu tshur snying gar tshobacangs pa ni/ /bud med phyag rgyar de bshad de / /bud med sbyor ba ma lus pa/ /lus pa 1med pa'ang thams cad 'grub/ /g.yon pa 'gying ba'i mtshul byas nas/ /lag g.yas bdag gi snying gar ni/ /gyen cidu drang ba'i mtshul byas nas / /bud med thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje 'gying ba'o/ /dpal ldan sna tshogs padmo —'dzin/ /g.yon pa brdog pa'i khu tshur dang / /g.yas par ldang bar gyur pa dang / /sangs rgyas dbang 77—523

phyug ting 'dzin bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad du 'phar ba'o/ /g.yon pa dril bu'i /rim sgrogs shing / /g.yas pa yi ni lag pa yis/ /rdo rje gyen du gsor zhing bskor/ /sgyu ma thams cad 'byung bar bya/ /dpal rdo rje sgyu ma'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /g.yon pa g.yon pa'i brla la bzhag(mi /lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo yi ri/ /rtse mos padma dam pa 'dzin/ /g.yas pa'i brla la lag ngar bzhag )mi dge ba thams cad sel ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /bdag gi snying gar ci 'dren tshul du/ /g.yon pa nor bu rin chen 'dzin/ /g.yas pa re ba kun rdzogs pa'i/ /bud med la sogs rin chen 'dzin/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o /bdag gi snying gar 'dren tshul du/ /padma tsho sna tshogs dam pa 'dzin/ /g.yas pa rdo rje 'gying —ba yis/ /dbang phyug dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug gi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ / zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las 7kun tu rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rtog rtepa ste mdagu pa'o// //de nas kun tu sna tshogs 'di/ /phyag rgya shes pa'ang grub pa ni/ /kun tu sna tshogs spyor ba yis/ /kun tu sna tshogs bshad par bya/ /smin ma mig dang so dang mchu/ /kha dang lus dang rkang lag gis/ /cha lugs bzhin codu gar byed pas / /phyag rgya thams cad yongs su dgrol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor bas / /lha mo kun dang 'dus pa ni/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal mabazang po/ /ra/7 rji sdus 4bar 'grub —par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /sangs

rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlob/ /legs par byin gyis brlabs na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pas na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sbyor ba'i/ /mthu nyid kyis ni thams cad du/ /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /so so dag nas grub pa ste/ /blta khyabs mi ngoms pa yi sku/ /thams cad bdag nyid ston par mdzad/ /legs so legs so zhes grub pa'i/ /dam pa dag kyang rab tu stsal —/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /grub pa kun mchog nyams dga' ba/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod du/ /thams cad kyi ni bdag nyid stsol / /dang po kun las byung ba yi/ /mchod pa'i sprin chen thams cad kyi/ /bkod pa rab 'byam tshogs rnams kyis ri/ /thams cad bdag nyid mchod pa mdzad /dpal ldan g.yon pa 'gying dang bcas/ /dpal ldan lag pa g.yas pa yi/ /padmo khu tshur dpral bar bzhag /bdag gi mig ni gyen du blta / /'di ni rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ /gyen du 'phar ba'i dngos grub dang / /rab 'byam /rilas rnams myur du 'grub/ /phyag rgya 'di yis btab na ni/ /khams gsum pa dag ma lus pa/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas zos pa dang / /thal bar gyur pa'ang 'tsho bar byed/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas 7de skad gsungs so/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal bzang po / /dpal rdo rje padma shāgyen du 'phar skaba'i spyan zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ste/ rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan zhes bya'o / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yis/ /rtag tu dpag med tshe dang ldan/ /nam mkha'i 77—525

dbyings kyi mtha' /klas pa'i / / bden pa'i 5tshig ni rab tu casmra/ /mtha' yas pa dang mu med pa'i/ /rtog pa kun dang 'di yi ni/ /mthu dang yon tan bsngags pa'i mtha'/ /brjod pa dag tu yongs ri mi nus/ /mthu dang rang bzhin dag gis grub/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rtag tu 'grub( / /so sor 7rjes grub bde ba ster/ /'di ni gsang mchog mchog gi mchog /sems can don phyir las rnams sbyong ba dang / /rnam par dag par rgyal ba yong mi mdzad/ /'di la bgegs med bdud kyang yod ma yin/ /rtog pas mi 'grub thar bar yong mi nus / /mi brtan pa dang bdud du nga mi 'gyur/ /brtan 9par bya ba'i phyir yang nga mi 'doms/ /gang zhig rang gi bde bas nga —sgrub na/ /dngos grub mchog gis nga yi bstan par byed/ /kun tu sna tshogs pas ni de skad gsungs / /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu dgyes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sdis legs kāsungs la/ /mngon par bstod cing rab tu dgyes par // /mang/ byeX sdu/sdu bye/da/ga' ba'i padmo rnam dag mchod pa dang / /rta mchog rnal 'byor bde bas gsal bar rjes ngasu mchod na ni/ /rab tu bde ba'i rnal 'byor dam pa skal bzang dga' ba'i mchog /rab mchog bde ba'i rang bzhin dam tshig bde bas rjes 5grub pa'agyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas —de skad gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rtog / pa/ rtog pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo bskor ba chen po bde ba chen po rdzogs so// //77—526

rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba mkha' 'gro sgru ma bde ba'i mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/’sa na /rgya gar skad du/ sarba gawa sa mutstsha ya nā ma sarba bu sa ma yo ga ḍā ki gri ridzā la sasbra ra utta ra susta ra tant+ra / bod skad du/ rtog pa thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad phyag 'tshal te/ /ma lus lus pa med par grub / /rnam rtog med pa'i sems la ni/ /de kho na nyid nges par gnas / /sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs / /'dod chags chen po bde chen po/ /bde chen rdo rje chen po bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang lhan cig pa'i/ /bde gshegs mgon mchog rnams kyis bzhugs /thams cad mchog 'gyur 'dod chen gyis/ /dngos grub dbang phyug 77—550

rab grub phyir/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rtog pa 'dus pas bka' stsal 'tshal/ /rnam par mi rtog chos bdag las/ /rtog pa'i don 'di ’gang la gsungs/ /ci yi slad du'ang rgyud phyi ma/ /dang po'i sa mchog ji ltar lags / /gdod ma tha ma med nyid yang / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin te/ /yig pa'abru ji ltar gsungs pa lags/ /sngags phyung ba yang ci 'dra ste/ /shin tu dga' dang bzang nyid de/ /rdo rje snying po gtso bo gtso/ /sems dang sems dpa'i ting 'dzin yang / /de bzhin rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'dzin nyid chen po yang / /byang chub spyod pa rnams ci riltar/ /bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba yang / /sangs rgyas byang chub ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje gtum po cithar byed dang //phyag na rirdo rje yang ji ltar/ /dang po nerigs bskyed ji ltar lags/ /'dod pa'i thar pa rnam pa ci/ /mgon po rnam gsum ji ltar 'tshal/ /thams cad yang nyid ji ltar lags/ /ji ltar dang po snying po 'byung / /nye ba'i snying po de ji ltar/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /don yod dam tshig ji ltar lags/ /dkyil 'khor ji ltar gsungs par gyur/ /de yi rnam smin ci 'dra ste/ /thig gdab de bzhin rtog pa yis / /dngos grub ji ltar bshad pa lags/ /gsang ba lnga dang de nyid che/ /gang lags ci 'dra de bzhin te/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnams dang ni/ /rigs rnams kyang ni ji ltar lags/ /thams cad dbang bskur de nyid dang / /de nyid tshogs kyi phyag mtshan yang / /thams cad dgug dang mchod chen dang / /rang gi byin rlabs 7sogs grub pa/ /de rnams de nyid gsang chen dang / /dam pa dang ni don dam pa/ /dam pa'i yi ge grub don du/ /thams cad mi gsung 'os ma lags/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang 577—551

mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma /sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las de kho na nyid thams cad nges tshig gi rtog pa ste bcu brgyad pa'o// //de nas ston pa rdo je 'dzin/ /rtog pa kun gyi gtso chen pos/ /the tsom rikun gyi tshogs gnas nas/ /don dam 'dzin pa yang cibaka' stsal / /de la ji ltar rtog pa'i don rgyud gyiyin zhe na/ rnam par mi rtog chos dag las/ /sems can don du yongs su rtog /de phyir rtog par yang dag bshad/ /rtog pa yongs su dag phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar rgyud phyi ma yin zhe na/ /rgyud ni rab tu 'brel par bshad/ /phyi ma gong du phyung ba yin/ /de nyid gsang ba gsang chen rnams /de yang rgyud ni phyi mar 'dod/ /de la ji ltar dang po nyid kyi ye shes yin zhe na/ nam mkha' kun tu rab gnas pa/ /rdo rje kun gyi dngos po mchog /bde chen dgyes pa chen po de/ /dam pa'i yi ge gzhal yas khang / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas tshogasungs so/ /de la ji ltar gdod ma dang tha ma med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' yin zhe na/ yi ge ka sogs dzha yig mtha'/ /nga nya spangs nas 'jug par bya/ /yi ge dzha sogs ṣa yi mtha'/ /phreng ba gnyis pa yang dag bri/ /dbus gnas par ni a yig phreng / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bkod de/ /thig le zla 5tshes dang ldan par/ /tsheg drag zla ba gnyis yin te/ /a yig mi 'gyur bsgom par bya/ /dbus su rdo rje'i ngo bor gnas / /de dbus rtag tu bsgom 5pa ni/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas ri mo grags pa yin/ /de las 'gro ba g.yo mi g.yo/ /thams cad yang dag 'byung bas ni/ /nam mkha' las 77—55 2

byung mtshan ma'i phyir/ /gdod ma tha ma med mchog yin/ /rdo rje chen po dngos sems ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes 'dod do/ /de la bcom ldan 'das de gang 15zhe na/ dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rig pa lha / /rgyal po chen po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dam pa yi ge shin tu dga'/ /de la ji ltar yi ge rtog pa yin zhe na/ /yi ge a sogs ka mtha' ni/ /yi ger yang dag bshad pa ste/ /mi zad dga' ba'i rdo rje can/ /de nyid kun don mtshan nyid phyir/ /de la ji ltar sngags 'byung cib yin zhe na/ /rdo rje sems sogs 'khor lo la/ /gang rnams sngags su cher bshad pa/ /de rnams byung ba'i don du ni/ /rdo rje can gyis yang bka' stsal/ /gur gum la sogs byugs 0pa la/ /bri sku la sogs rnam brgyan nas/ /bla re la sogs bres nas su/ /rtag tu re'u mig bzhi brtsams nas/ /gru bzhi gzhal yas khang byas te/ /re'u mig phyogs bzhir 'bar bar byas/ /re'u ngamig sum cu tham rtepa la/ /bcu dgu dang ni ldan par bya/ /brgya phyed stan la gnas pa la/ /sde pa lnga mtha' thig le yis /spyi bo gtsug la rtag 5pa yi/ /ka dang sha zhes bya ba ni/ /dbus kyi re'u mig la bri'o/ / de yi ciphyi rol gnas brgyad dag /mtshams dang phyogs kyi re'u mig la/ /dbang 5ldan la sogs rim pa ru/ /ya dang sha yi sde bkod do //me mtshams la sogs re'u mig la/ /ma —yi yig 'bru bzhi po dang / /a yig sa bon la brten nas/ /sa bon bcu gnyis dgod ripar bya/ /dbang ldan la sogs re'u mig la/ /ka yig la sogs rim par dgod / /de ltar bzhi la rim par ni/ /thams cad rnam par gnas byas te/ /ka sogs re'u mig bzung nas su/ /yig 'bru dam pa phyung bar bya/ /shin tu dga' chen rgyal po 77—553

ni / /sbyor ba thams cad dbang phyug gtso/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa zla phyed gtsug phud zhal/ /de 'og sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /dga' ba rdo rje can gyis phyung / /re'u mig bcu bzhi zhes pa las tsho/ /gnas pa tsheg drag dang ldan pa/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi zla snyedang ldan//re'u mig sum cu rtsa gcig la/ /gnas pa nga ro thig le ldan/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa tsheg drag sbyor ba dbya/ /sum cu rtsa brgyad sbyor ba yis/ /de ni bzhi par rnam par bshad/ /bde ba chen po rgyal chen po/ /lha mo dam pa brtag pa'o/ /re'u mig bcu gcig la gnas pa/ /thig le nga ror yang dag ldan / /re'u mig brgyad pa la gnas pa/ /bcu dgu dag snani ldan pa ste/ /de 'og sum cu rtsa bzhi dang / /thig le nga ros brgyan pa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa tsheg drag sbyor ba'o/ /re'u mig gnyis pa la bkod pa'i/ /thig le nga ro ldan pa'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs btus pa'i/ /sngags phyung ba ni mchog yin te/ /re'u mig sum cu rtsa brgyad la/ /gnas pa'i thig le nga ro ldan / /dbus na nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ /dbus nas bcu /lnga zla ba can/ /re'u mig sum cu rtsa gcig gnas/ /dbus nas bcu 5lnga zla ba can/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa gcig gnas/ /bcu gcig zla ba dang ldan te/ /lha mo gling bu ma sogs kyi /sngags phyung rmad 7du byung ba'o/ /re'u mig bcu pa la gnas dang / /bcu gcig pa yang de bzhin te/ /re'u mig sum cu rtsa gsum gnas/ /bcu drug pa yang de bzhin te/ /me tog la sogs bsdus pa yi/ /'di ni sngags rgyung mchog yin no/ /rta mgrin 'phang tshamatho lcags kyu sogs/ /dang po byung 7ba'i sa bon nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgo la nan tan gyis 77—554

sbyor ro/ /zhes dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te// dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes snyepa'o/ /re'u mig gnyis pa can kho na/ /zla tshes gtsug dang ldan pa'i zhal/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal chen po/ /kun mchog sa riyi dbang phyug yin/ /re'u mig bcu lnga gnas pa la/ /thig le nga ro ldan pa'o/ /re'u mig bcu dgu la gnas pa/ /thig le nga ros brgyan tshapa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa lngar ldan/ /thig le nga ros brgyan pa'o/ /dbus nas nyi shu pa nyid la/ /thig le nga ros brgyan pa'o/ /chos gos ma tshogs tsho bzhi dag gis / /sa bon 'byung ba mchog 'di yin/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /thig le nga ros brgyan pa'o/ /re'u mig bdun pa de bzhin yang / /dbus nas bcu lnga pa dang ldan/ /thig le nga ro ldan pa ni/ /byang du sil snyan cha lang ngo / /dbus nas 5nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ /gnas pa bcu dgu dang ldan pa/ /thig le nga ro ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje rin chen cher brjod do/ /dbus nas bcu skabargyad pa dag nyid/ /thig le nga ros brgyan rshapa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /chos kyi dung gi phyag rgya che / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi re'u pamig la /gnas pa nyi shu pa ldan ni/ /khrag 'thung zhes pa'i rgyal po che/ /tsheg drag lhag chad gyur pa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa 'og na bcu dgur ldan / /re'u mig nyi shu gnas pa dang / /spyor ba tsheg drag ldan pa'o/ /tsheg drag dang ni rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa dbus nas labacu gcig ldan/ /re'u mig bcu gnyis pa spyor ba'i/ /tsheg drag ldan par 'dod pa'o/ /re'u mig bcu 77—555

bzhi la gnas pa/ /'og gi 'dren pa nyi shu gcig /bcu gnyis pa dang tsheg drag can/ /gsum pa can de bshad pa'o// /re'u mig bcu bzhi la gnas pa/ /bcu gnyis pa dang ldan pa la/ /tsheg drag dang ni mnyam sbyor ba/ /lha mo snod chen ma yi 'dod/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa dbus nas gnyis pa can /de bzhin thig le nga ror ldan/ /thig le 'byung gnas gsum pa ste / /dbus nas bcu pa gang yin pa/ /rtag tu tsheg drag ldan pa ni/ /dmar chen sogs pa'i lha mo yi/ /bzhi po dag ni phyung ciba'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /gnas pa'i thig le bcas pa'o/ /dbus las drug pa gang yin pa/ /thig le nga ro ldan pa'o/ /re'u mig de bzhin bcu bdun pa/ /thig le nga ros brgyan rupa'o / /re'u mig bcu dgu la gnas pa/ /thig le nga ros brgyan pa'o/ /lha mo mda' non 'dzin sogs kyi/ /sa bon byung ba de ngo mtshar/ /lha mo me tog ma sogs kyi/ /sa bon byung ba sngon bstan yin/ /gang dag sgo srung bstan pa yang — /gzugs mi mthun pa kho na'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas /de skad ces lagasungs so/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa bcu dgu'i gdan la gnas/ /nyi shu tsheg drag sbyor ba ni/ /padma rmugar gyi dbang phyug yin/ /re'u mig bcu bzhi la gnas pa'i/ /tshig loganyis rtsi ba de bzhin no/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas nas dbus nas dgu pa ldan / /rtag par thig le dang ldan ni/ /gnyis pa yi ni yongs dgrags pa/ /re'u mig sum cu rtsa gcig la/ /gnas par nga ro thig les brgyanapa/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /gnas pa dbus nas bcu gsum ldan/ /tsheg drag can 77—556

ni bzhi pa yi/ /khro gnyer ma yi :rgyud las grags/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir ldan / /dbus nas dgu pa'i thig ler bcas/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas /dbus nas bcu lnga dang ldan no/ /re'u mig bcu gcig la gnas pa / /tsheg drag gis ni sbyor ba'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /sum cu rtsa brgyad pa dang ldan/ /tsheg drag mnyam por sbyor ba ni/ /padma gar dbang mchog yin no/ /lha mo gling bu ma sogs nyid/ /de bzhin lha mo me tog sogs/ /lha mo lcags kyu ma sogs kyang / /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bskyed pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te / padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /dbus nas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /bcu gcig pa ridang ldan pa ste/ /bcu dgu zla ba gtsug lnga ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma 'byung ba yin/ /dbus nas bcu gsum gang yin pa/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la / /gnas pa bcu dgu dang ldan pa/ /re'u mig nyi shu gnas dang sbyor/ /tsheg drag ldan pas gnyis pa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /dbus nas bcu gsum pa dang ldan/ /tsheg drag lhan cig can dang ni/ /gsum pa yi ni grags pa yin/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /bcu gcig dang ni thig le ldan/ /re'u mig bcu bzhi la gnas pa/ /tsheg drag ldan pa 'dod pa'o / / re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /dbus gnas dgu dang zla ba'o/ /re'u mig sum cu rtsa gcig gnas/ /thig le nga ros brgyan pa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /dbus nas bcu gsum pa dang ldan/ /tsheg drag mnyam par ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma lha dag yin/ /lha mo gling bu ma sogs 77—557

kun / /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sbyor skyes yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun zhes ri sbyor ba ste/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug can ni/ /yul 'khor thams cad 'dul ba'o / /re'u mig bcu bzhi la gnas pa/ /bcu dgu pa dang ldan pa ste / /nyi shu tsheg drag sbyor ba ste/ /sna tshogs pa yi brjod pa yin/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas/ /gnas pa tsheg drag ldan pa 'dod/ /rta yi rgyal po'i ri dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje rgya gram zhes grags so/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpas rigasungs te/ rta mchog gi chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam // rdo trī dī /dri/ kānā ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog las chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i ri mo gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /phyi rol padma 'dab ( brgyad bri/ /de yi dang du rnal 'byor pas/ /a yig tshogs kyang bri bar bya/ /shar phyogs 'dab mar ka tshoyi sde / / lho phyogs 'dab mar tsa yi sde/ /tshanub phyogs 'dab mar ṭa yi sde / /ta yi sde ni de bzhin byang / /sde pa lnga yi dbus su ni/ /yi ge kṣa dang lhan cig 'dod/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma nas brtsams te/ /ya ra la wa rnam par gzhag /dbang ldan 'dab ma'i phyi rol du/ /yi ge ṣa ni 'jug par bya/ /me mtshams 'dab choma'i phyi rol du/ /yi ge sha ni 'jug par bya/ /bden bral 'dab ma'i phyi rol du/ /yi ge sa ni 'jug par bya/ /rlung 77—558

mtshams 'dab ma'i phyi rol du/ /yi ge ha ni 'jug par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dbus kyi mtha' ru gang yin pa/ /thig le dang ldan yi ge oṃ/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa gang / /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa la/ /'og tu sgra yig u spyor ro/ /shar gyi 'dab ma gnyis pa ni/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin no/ /lho nas de bzhin dbu ma la/ /me mtshams 'dab ma de bzhin snano/ /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa gang / /de nas byang gi dang po'o/ /dbus nas dbu ma'i sbyin gnas su/ /de tshe 'od kyi gong bur 'gyur/ /o yig tsheg drag dang ldan pa/ /de yi mtha' ru de tsher 'gyur/ /lho nas dbus ma gang yin pa/ /tsheg kyidrag dang ni ldan pa'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gang yin pa/ /u yig thig le sbyor bar bya/ /dbus kyi dbu ma gang yin pa/ /thig les mgo nas mnan pa dang / /rlung mtshams phyi rol gang yin pa/ /o yig tsheg ridrag sbyor bar bya/ /bden bral mtshams kyi phyi rol du/ /sgra yig u ni sbyor ba ste/ /me mtshams 'dab ri mar gang yin pa/ /byang gi dang por de bzhin yang / /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /byang gi ri dang po pa yang yin/ /dbus nas dbus skum bzung nas su/ /'od kyi gong bu mtha' ru 'gyur/ /de nas thig le sbyin byas nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das chags pa chen po rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /lho nas dbu ma gang yin pa/ /tsheg (midrag dang ni ldan par bya/ /dbus nas dbu tshom de bzhin du/ /lho nas dbu ma yang yin no/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa/ /rtag tu brjod par 'gyur ba 7yin/ /byang nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /me mtshams 77—559

dang ni shin tu sbyor/ /sgra yig a dang sbyar nas su/ /rtag par zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /me mtshams phyi rol bzung nas su/ /nub kyi dang po ldan par bya/ /sgra yig i dang sbyar nas su/ /'od kyi gong bu lnga pa yin/ /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa la/ /sgra yig a dang ldan par bya/ /de bzhin dbang ldan 'dab ma dang — /sgra yig i ni sbyor ba'o/ /shar gyi dang po pa /dang ni/ /de nas dbu ma'i tha ma dang ri/ /nub kyi dang po pa bzung nas/ /a med rtag tu 'gyur bar bya/ /de dag bzlas pa byas pa yis/ /mda' ru rab tu grub pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das cadapal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig u ni sbyor bar bya/ /thig le nga ro gnon genas su / /de nas dbus nas dbu ma'o/ /sto nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /me mtshams gyis dang sbyor bar bya/ /shar nas dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig e dang ldan par bya/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa gang / /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya / /shar gyi dang ngo bzung nas su/ /sgra yig e ni spyor ba'o/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor ba'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig u ni sbyor bar bya/ /thig le nga ros mnyam sbyor na/ / skal bzang skal bzang 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de bzhin gnyis pa dpa' bo ma/ /kun tu bzang mo gsum pa ste/ /bzhi pa zad med snon mtho/ /dpa' mo sangs rgyas sku ldan ma/ /de bzhin gzungs /ma zhal mdzes ma/ /sprin chen ma ni bdun pa ste/ /brgyad pa nam mkha'i spyan mtho/ /gling bu la sogs bsdus pa dang —/ /sgo sung lam sogs yang bsdus te/ /me tog ma sogs bsdus pa ni/ /77—560

dang po'i dkyil 'khor la bskyed :'dod/ /ces bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags chen po dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pas ridakyil 'khor la sngags ri'abyung ba'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /o yig thig le dang ldan pa/ /yi ge e yis ldan pa yi/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa dang —/ /me mtshams 'dab ma gnas pa nyid/ /sgra yig u dang sbyor bar bya/ /shar las dang po de bzhin du/ /dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las tha ma pa yang bzung / /dbang ldan 'dab mar gnas pa nyid/ /yi ge e dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa la/ /tsheg ridrag gis ni mnyam par ldan/ /de ni bcu par yongs grags te/ /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa la/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can dang ldan/ /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur nas su/ /byang las dbu ma de bzhin te//sgra yig u ni sbyor bar bya/ /me mtshams phyi rol pa de bzhin/ /nub las dang po pa dang ldan/ /bden bral phyi rol pa la yang / /dbu ma'i mtha' yang de yin te/ /dbang ldan 'dab mar gnas pa nyid/ /yi ge u dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /dbus las tha ma pa 'gyur nas/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa / /byang las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /'dren pa a yig dang lhan cig /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan par bya/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /thig le dang ni yang dag ldan/ /lho las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /shar las dang po pa yang yin/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le sku yig ldan par bya/ /dbus las gnyis pa gang yin pa//77—561

nub kyi dang po a med par/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol bzung nas su/ /thig le u yig dang ldan te / /dbus 〉las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho las dbu ma pa 'gyur te/ /shar las gsungs pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig u dang ldan par bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa la/ /sgra yig ye yis brgyan ri snyepa ste/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma'i gdan can ni/ /lnga par yongs su grags pa ste / /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa la/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /byang ri rilas bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can dang 'dra/ /dbus las tha ma yang yin te/ /dbang ldan 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig o ni sbyor bar bya/ /shar las gsum pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig o ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol gnas pa gang / /dbus las dbu ma dang ldan te/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa ni/ /me mtshams gdan dang ldan pa ste/ /tsheg drag yi ge i ldan pa/ /dang po yongs su grags pa'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa la/ /thig le yi ge u sbyor te/ /mkhas pas lan gnyis brjod par bya/ /dbus las dbus ma yang bzung ste/ /lho las dbu ma de bzhin la/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can dang ldan / /lho las dang po bzung nas su/ /thig le dang ni mnyam por ldan/ /nub nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /yi ge e dang mnyam ldan bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol gang yin pa/ /dbus las dbu ma dang ldan te/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /shar las gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /77—562

nub las dang po bzung nas su/ /dbus nas dbu ma ldan pa ste/ /thig le a yig ldan par bya/ /bcu par yongs su grags pa ste/ /shar las gsum pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig mi dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las yi/tha mar gzung rinas su/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa la yang / /yi ge a dang ldan par bya/ /dbus nas ri dbu ma gzung canas su/ /lho las gsum par 'gyur byas te/ /me mtshams gdan ni spyor byas nas/ /shar nas dang po bzung nas su/ /yi ge a yig ldan pa yi/ /dbus las dang po 'gyur byas te/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa la / /sgra yig e ci tshodang sbyor ba yi/ /dbus las tha ma yang yin te/ /shar nas dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig u yis sbyor bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig u dang sbyor ba ste / /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa la / /sgra yig u yis brgyan 7byas te/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa yang / /sgra yig u dang spyor bar bya/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig u yis brgyan pa ste/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa ni/ /gnyis brtsegs yi ge u dang ldan/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa la//byang las tha ma ldan byas te/ /tsheg 7drag mnyam por ldan pa la/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so / /rlung dzomatshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yis sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung ba dang / /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho nas dbu mar 'gyur bar bya/ /byang las tha ma bzung nas su/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig a yis brgyan par bya/ /dbang ldan 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig mi dang ldan pa yi/ /1—563

nub kyi tha mar 'gyur bar bya/ /lho yi dbu mar :de bzhin du/ /sto las bzhi pa gang yin 'byor/ /tsheg drag yi ge i ldan pa/ /'dus pa gsungs pa yin pa'o / /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yis sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin yang / /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho yi dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus rilas dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig gnyis pa caldan pa yi/ /byang gi dang po yang yin te/ /shar las dang po bzung ba la/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /lho las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /tsheg ridrag yi ger ldan pa'o/ /zhes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor byas te/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung ba dang — /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba la/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan par bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /de 'og me mtshams pa yin te/ /nub kyi tha ma de bzhin du/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las tha ma yang yin te/ /nub las dang po bzung nas su/ /a yig med par gyur pa'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yis sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin te/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho las dbu tshomar 'gyur bar tibya /dbus nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /thig le yis ni brgyan par bya/ /de bzhin dbus nas dbu ma yang / /lho nas dbu ma de bzhin te/ /me yi mtshams pa mnyam par ldan/ /yi ge a yis bsdu bar 5bya/ /nub nas tha ma bzung nas su/ /sgra yig o ni sbyor bar bya/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas /dbu ma'i tha ma dang ldan par/ /me mtshams lan gnyis brjod nas su/ /77—564

nub nas dang por ldan 'gyur bya/ /rtag tu a med brgyad pa ni/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin ma yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /tsheg drag o ni sbyor mebar bya/ /dbus nas dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams pas ni ldan pa yin/ /lho nas dbu mar 'gyur ba'o/ /shar nas dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbus nas tha mar bzung nas su/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las dbu ma gzung bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma la gnas pa/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /byang nas dang po bzung nas su/ /yi ge a dang ldan par bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma sbyor nas su/ /thig le nga ros bsdu bar bya/ /sna tshogs padma lha mo che/ /rdo rje sems sogs lha yi yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rdo rje mtshon cha dang / rdo rje rol ma dang / rdo rje dran ma dang / rdo rje snying po ma dag rirdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi yin no/ /o yig thig le dang ldan par/ /e cayig thig le yang dag ldan/ /dbus la tha ma bzung ba dang — /yi ge u dang ldan par bya/ /byang nas de bzhin bzhi pa'o/ /dbus nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /lho nas dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang sbyar nas/ /sgra yig i dang a bsdu bya'o/ /shar nas bzhi pa gang yin pa /thig le u dang ldan bya ste/ /nan tan du ni lan gnyis bzla / /rtag tu dang po'i 'gyur ba yin/ /oyig thig le dang ldan pa/ /dbu ma las ni dbu ma yang / /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa'i/ /lho nas dbu mar 'gyur bar bya / /dbus nas tha ma bzung byas te/ /sgra yig e dang sbyor bar bya/ /77—565

shar las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ / sgra yig e dang sbyar ba'o/ /shar las gsum pa gang yin pa/ //sgra yig u dang sbyor ba'o/ /bden bral 'dab ma la gnas pa/ /sgra yig u dang sbyor ba ste/ /nan tan lan gnyis bzlas pa'o/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /u yig me mtshams pa dang ldan/ /thig le nga ro gnyis pa'o/ /o yig jig le dang ldan pari / /rlung mtshams phyi rol la gnas pa / /tsheg ridrag dang ni mnyam por ldan/ /dbang ldan phyi rol la gnas dang //me mtshams 'dab ma can de bzhin/ /byang nas gsum pa gang yin pa/ /dbus las dbu mar gyur par 4bya/ /lho nas dbu ma pa la yang me mtshams 'dab ma can dang ldan/ /sgra yig i dang ldan sbyor ba/ /e riyig thig le dang ldan pa/ /lan gnyis gsum ni brjod byas te/ /lha mo gsum po'i )kho na'o /sngags 'byung bar ni grags pa yin/ /tsheyig thig le dang ldan par/ /shar nas gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal/ /dbus nas dbu ma de bzhin du/ /lho nas dbu ma pa la yang / /me mtshams 'dab ma can sbyor dang / /dus rnams thams cad spyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa de bzhin /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /de nyid phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig i dang ldan byas te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma gnas pa yi/ /sgra yig mi yis brgyan par bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor byas te/ /lan gnyis gsum du brjod pa'o / /de ni dzo dpag bsam shing sogs lha/ /rdo rje snying po ma dang / rdo rje sred med kyi bu mo dang / rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang / 'dod pa'i lha mo rnams shes tsho)pa lha mo bzhi yin no/ /o yig thig le dang ldan pa/ /yi ge e yis 7sbyor bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi 77—566

rol la gnas pa/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can de bzhin/ /yi ge e yis snamanyam ldan pa'i/ /byang nas dang por 'gyur byas te/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can sbyor ba'i/ /lho yi dbu ma pa yang de/ /yi ge e yis mnyam ldan bya/ /dbus las dbu ma ldan 'gyur dang / /bden bral 'dab ma la gnas pa/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor gebyas te/ /bden bral phyi rol la gnas pa/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor byas te/ /byang nas tha ma gang yin pa/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /byang nas dang po gang yin pa/ /me mtshams pa yi gdan dang ldan/ /nub nas dang po gang yin pa/ /rtag par a med 'gyur bar bya/ /gdod ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /lha mo rdo rje pi wang lama'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma gnas pa nyid/ /sgra yig i dang ldan byas te/ /byang nas dang por 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /lho nas dbu ma gzung bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang sbyor nas/ /bsdu bar bya ba yang yin te/ /shar nas gsum pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /byang nas dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor byas te/ /nga ro bzhi po tshodang ldan pa/ /rtag par lan gsum brjod bya'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor 7bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma pa la yang / /sgra yig e ni sbyar skyabar bya/ /byang nas dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can lhan cig /lho nas dbu ma 'gyur byas te / /rlung mtshams phyi rol la gnas pa/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /de bzhin bden bral phyi ba la/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor ba'i phyir/ /rlung mtshams phyi 77—567

rol pa nyid /ni/ /lan gnyis ched du brjod par bya/ /dbus nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /thig le e yig sbyor bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog la /rnga chen lha mor grags pa yin/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra riyig i cini sbyor bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma riganas pa yang / /byang nas dang po pa bzung ste/ /sgra yig i ni ldan par bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang sbyor ba'i/ /sto nas dbu ma pa dang yang — /byang nas mtha' ma bzung byas te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma ldan byas nas / /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /byang nas dang po bzung byas te/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma can sbyor nas/ /de tshe de ni yang brjod de/ /de bzhin dbus las dbu ma yang / /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dang po de bzhin du/ /de ni lan gnyis brjod par bya/ /lho nas bzhi pa bzung nas su/ /nga ro a yig ldan pa ra bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdza rnga ma zhes grags pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so /gling bu ma dang pi wang kun/ /rnga chen de bzhin rdza rnga kun/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /grwa yi lha mos mchod 'grub pa'o/ /a yig dang po byas nas su/ /dbus nas dbu ma pa la yang / /me mtshams 'dab ma can ldan par/ /lho nas dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dang po de bzhin du /sgra yig u ni sbyor bar bya/ /me mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las dang po yang yin te/ /e yig dang ni mnyam por ldan/ /dbus nas me tog ma phyung ngo / /a yig dang por byas nas gsu/ /dbus las dbu ma pa yang ste/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa'i/ /lho nas dbu ma yang yin te/ /77—568

byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig u dang sbyor bar bya / /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /rdo rje spos me rnam rigrags so/ /a yig dang po byas nas su/ /dbus rilas dbu ma pa yang ste/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can ldan pa'i / /lho las dbu camar 'gyur bar bya/ yi ge a las mnyam ldan te/ /bden bral 'dab ma gnas pa la/ /sgra yis o ni sbyor bar bya/ /shar gyi dang po de bzhin du/ /e yig ldan par gsungs pa'o / /a yig dang po byang nas su /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin yang / me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan par / /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ shar gyi gsum pa de la yang / /thig le dang ni sbyor bar bya/ /byang nas bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /yi ge e yig lhan cig 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas rdo rje me tog ma dang —/ rdo rje bdug spos nyam dang / rdo rje mar me ma dang / rdo rje dri chab ma zhes bya ba phyi'i lha mo bzhi gsungs so/ /rma yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma pa yang ste/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang lhan cig /lho las dbu ma 'gyur ba ste/ /a yig thig le mnyam gnon par/ /rtag par brjod par bya ba ste /shar las dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig u ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig i cini sbyor bar bya/ /tsheg drag mnyam por ldan pa ni/ /lho las dbu mar 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /phayig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /me mtshams pa dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma pa yang ste/ /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /77—569

rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal don yod shin tu dga' ba'i sems dpas gsungs so/ /lko44yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur ba byas / /me mtshams 'dab ma can ldan zhing / /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le nga ros brgyan sabyas te/ /shar gyi dbang sapo bzung nas su/ /sgra yig e dang mnyam ldan zhing / /bden bral 'dab ma can du 'gyur/ /dpral bar thig les brgyan ( pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas tshigasungs so/ /6yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma pa yin te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can lhan cig /lho nas dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /shar las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /thig le nga ros rnam par brgyan / /nub las dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig ye ni sbyor bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /tsheg drag dang ni mnyam ldan zhing / /o yig lhan cig 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rta mgrin tsho'aphang mtho'i lcags kyu ma dang /phag mgo mche zhags ma dang / nyi zla lcags sgrog ma dang / shi ba gso ba'i dril bu ma zhes bya ba sgo srung —ma bzhi gsungs pa ste/ dpal rdo rje sems 7dpa'i dkyil 'khor la sngags kyi tshogs kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /o skuyig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /tsheg 7drag u yig ldan pa ste/ /shar las gnyis pa can pa 4yang / /thig le nga ro gnon pa ni/ /thub chen rnam snang mdzad kyi'o/ /lko yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas 77—570

te / /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /byang nas dang po pa yang ste/ /dbus nas dbu ma pa ldan pa/ /dbang ldan phyi rol la gnas pa/ /thig le dang ni 3ldan pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /o ci yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang lhan cig /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can de bzhin/ /byang las dang por ri 'gyur byas te/ /byang las tha ma dang ldan pa/ /mjug tu me mtshams 'dab ma can/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas cagasungs so/ /6yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma par 'gyur te / /me mtshams 'dab ma can lhan cig /lho las dbu ma yang yin te/ /byang nas bzhi pa gang yin pa/ / dbus las dbu ma pa yang ste/ /me mtshams pa yi mgo gnon bya/ /dbus las tha ma gang yin pa/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma dang ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /shar las dang po bzung nas su/ /me mtshams can gyis tshoganon pa yi/ /dbus las dbu ma pa yang 'dod/ /byang las gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal//zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung ste/ /thig le nga ro ldan par bya'o/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung ste / /dbus las dbu ma dang ldan pa'i/ /byang las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /i 7yig me mtshams ldan pa ste/ /lho las 77—571

dbu ma 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /lho las gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /jig le e yig sbyor 〉bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams 'dab ma ldan pa yi / /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas shing / /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa nyid/ /byang las dang po de bzhin du/ /byang las tha ma dang 'byor pa / /sgra yig e dang sbyor ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal don yod shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so / /byang nas dang po bzung nas su/ /thig le me mtshams yang dag ldan/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams pa dang ldan pa la/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /byang las dbu ma yang yin te/ /dbus las tha ma dang ldan la/ /yi ge lhan cig 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /byang la sa bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /thig le nga ro ldan par bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /sgra yig i ni sbyar byas te / /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las cadabu ma pa dang ldan / /de bzhin dbus las dbu ma yang / /i tshoyig me mtshams dang ldan pa'i/ /sto las dbu ma pa 'gyur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so /dang po sangs rgyas dbyangs lam dang / /dbang ldan phyi rol can nyid la/ /sgra yig u dang sbyor bar bya/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa yang sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya/ /shar las gsum pa gang yin pa/ /e yig me mtshams pa dang ldan/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /thig le i payig ldan par bya/ /byang las dbu ma phul nas su/ /de nas dbus nas tha ma ste/ /77—572

nub kyi dang po rtag tu ni/ /a /yig med par brjod par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /shar las dang po gang yin pa/ /sgra yig e yis brgyan pa ste/ /dbang ldan phyi rol gang yin pa/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /lho las dang po gang yin pa/ /gnyis pa ru ni sbyor byas la / /thig le e yig ldan par bya/ /de yang drug par 'gyur ba ste/ /byang las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /dbu ma'i tha ma yang yin te/ /nub las dang po rtag tu ni/ /a yig med par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas /thig le e yig ldan par bya/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung ba dang / /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur byas te/ /yi ge a dang ldan par bya/ /dbus las tha ma bzung nas su/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas pa yang / /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /sgra yig a ni sbyor bar bya / /dbang ldan phyi rol pa nyid la/ /sgra yig e dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las tha ma bzung nas su/ /nub las dang po yang bzung ste/ /a yig med par byas pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi grags pa'o/ /gi rī rtsa rī pra mo ha/ /bee tā lī /zhes bya ba bzhi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dag yin/ /puska sri dang tsaṇḍa 'isku/ /snyam khrag 'thung 'dra ba bzhi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dag yin/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig e dang ldan par bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin ter/ /me mtshams 'dab ma stan ldan pa'i/ /lho las mdabu ma 'gyur 77—573

bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa nyid/ /sgra yig i dang ldan pa yi/ /byang las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dang po de bzhin du/ /thig le yang dag ldan pa'o/ /zhes /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /thig le nga ro yang dag ldan/ /dbus las tha ma bzung ba dang / /yi ge ma dang ldan pa yi( / /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas par 'gyur/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa nyid/ /byang las dang po yang riyin te/ /dbus las dbu ma pa yang bzung / /e yig me mtshams dang ldan pa'i/ /lho nas dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas / /tsheg drag o yig sbyor bas so/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /phayig jig le dang ldan pa'i/ /dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can ldan pa'i/ /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur ba'o/ /miyig dang ni ldan pa yi/ /bden bral 'dab mar gnas de bzhin/ /lho las dang po de bzhin du/ /yi ge i yig ldan pa yi/ /byang las tha ma yang yin te/ /dbang ldan 'dab mar gnas pa la / /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal thogs pa med pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /zla tshes thig le gtsug gi zhal/ /dbus las tha ma yang de bzhin /sgra yig a dang sbyor ba yi / /rlung mtshams phyi rol par 'gyur te/ /dbang ldan phyi rol gnas nyid la/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa ste/ /sgra yig medang sbyor tshobar bya/ /bzhi par yongs su grags pa yin/ /dbus las dbu ma pa —nyid dang tsho/ /me mtshams stan dang ldan pa yi/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor 777—574

nas su/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa yang / /sgra yig i dang sbyor byas te/ /tsheg drag lhan cig 'dod pa'o/ /de dag mda' rnon 'dzin ma la sogs pa grwa'i srin mo la sogs bzhi rnams kyi'o / /me tog ma sogs 'dus pa dang / /sgo srung rim sogs 'dus pa ste/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni/ /ji bzhin yang dag 'byung ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal thogs pa med pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i rgyal po rdo rje casems dpas gsungs te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor la/ sngags 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /o 5yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung byas te/ /bden bral phyi rol pa la sogs/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig a dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung ba dang / /dbang ldan phyi rol gnas pa la/ /sgra yig u dang spyor bar bya/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /rtseg mar de bzhin lci bar 'dod/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba dang / /byang nas dbu ma yang yin te/ /dbus las tha ma dang spyor ba/ /brgyad par yongs su grags pa yin/ /byang nas tha mar de bzhin du/ /o yig me mtshams dang ldan pa/ /byang nas dang po yang yin te/ /dbus las dbu ma dang sbyor tsho te/ /dbang ldan phyi rol gnas pa yang me mtshams 'dab ma bzung nas su/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol gnas pa la/ /me mtshams pa tshastan ldan byas te/ / /tsheg drag i yis sbyor bas so/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan par/ /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa yang / /me mtshams pa yi gnon cipa yi / /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /byang las dang po bzung nas su/ /77—575

sgra yig a dang ldan pa yis / /byang nas gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /shar las gsum pa gang yin dang / /byang nas dang po yang yin te/ /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /byang nas dbu ma pa la yang / /dbus las tha ma dang sbyor te /yi ge i dang gcig par 'dod/ /lho nas dbu ma bzung nas su/ /tsheg ridrag snyi ba kho na'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma pa bzung ba/ /me mtshams pa stan ldan pa yi/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung nas su/ /byang nas dbu ma pa la yang / /dbus las tha ma dang sbyor la/ /sgra yig i dang ldan par bya'o / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig e dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba dang / /byang nas dbu ma pa la yang / /dbus las tha ma pa sbyor la/ /sgra yig i dang ldan par bya/ /de ni lan gnyis brjod byas te/ /dbus las dbu ma 'gyur ba la/ /thig le nga ro ldan byas la/ /de ni drug por yongs grags so/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so//rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /tsheg drag o yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung nas ni/ /byang las dbu ma dang ldan pa'i/ /dbus kyi tha ma bzung ba dang / /nub las tha ma bzung ba la/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya/ /me yi 'dab mar gnas pa la/ /sgra yig a dang sbyor bar bya/ /lho las dbu ma bzung nas su/ /thig le nga ro ldan par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje sems dpas rnam par gzigs ma dang / sgrol ma dang sa 77—576

'dzin ma dang khro gnyer ma zhes pa'i padma'i gtso mo'i lha mo bzhi :gsungs pa'o/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba dang / /byang nas dbu ma gang yin pa/ /dbus las tha ma dang sbyor te/ /de ni rtag par snyi bar 'gyur/ /lho las dang po bzung nas su / /thig le dang ni mnyam por ldan/ /nub nas dbu ma pa nyid la/ /i yig dang ni ldan par bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las dbu ma dang sbyor bya/ /me mtshams 'dab mar gnas pa nyid/ /sgra yig u yis rnam par brgyan / /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa la yang / /yi ge mu dang mnyam ldan la/ /thig le nga ro yang dag ldan/ /dbus las gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /a med nub kyi dang po'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig e ni sbyor bar bya//dbus las tha ma bzung ba dang / /sgra yig e dang ldan pa yi / /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa 'gyur te/ /dbus las dbu ma pa nyid la/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa la yang / /dbus las dbu ma dang ldan bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba dang / /byang nas dbu ma pa la yang / /dbus las tha ma dang sbyar /te/ /de ni rtag lci la gyur pa/ /de bzhin dbus las tha ma yang / /sgra yig u dang sbyor bar bya/ /e —yig me mtshams can ldan pa'i/ /byang las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung la/ /sgra yig i ni sbyor bar bya/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma can gyi stan/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /thig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbu ma'i gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /nub kyi dang 5po 'gyur bar bya/ /de la a 77—577

yig med ces pa/ /bdag gis thams cad du ni bshad/ /ces bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas / /me mtshams pa yi stan dang ldan / /tsheg ridrag i yig ldan pa ni/ /dang po par ni yongs su grags/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba dang / /byang nas dbu ma yang yin la/ /dbus las tha ma dang sbyor te/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor ba yi/ /mkhas pas lan gnyis brjod par bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa la yang / /thig le u yig gis brgyan te/ /tha mar yi ge a la yang / /thig le dang ni ldan par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /tsheg drag o yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dang po bzung ba dang / /byang las dbu ma pa la yang / /dbus las tha ma dang sbyar te/ /sgra yig a yis brgyan par bya/ /dbus las dbu ma pa nyid la/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma )nyid la yang dzo/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las dbu ma dang sbyar 7te / /sgra yig a dang ldan pa ni/ /rtag par lci bar gyur pa yin/ /shar las dang po bzung nas ni/ /me mtshams pa yi mugadan dang ldan/ /dbus las tha ma bzung ba la/ /sgra yig a dang sbyor bar bya/ /shar las dang po bzung nas su / /me mtshams pa yi gdan dang ldan/ /dbus las tha ma pa yang yin/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung la/ /thig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /sto nas dkudabu ma de bzhin du/ /tsheg —drag lci ba can ldan no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas padma'i na bza' dang / rdo rje padma'i dbang rgyug ma dang /padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang / sna tshogs padma mazhes bya ba padma parigs kyi 7lha 77—578

mo bzhi kyi gsungs so/ /gling bu ma tshogs 'dus pa dang / /sgo sung ma tshogs 'dus pa ste/ /me tog ma tshogs 'dus pa yang / /padmas mtshan ma 'dzin par zad/ /dang po'i dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni/ /ji bzhin yang dag 'byung ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs te/ dpal padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor la sngags dbyung ba'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /6yig thig le dang ldan par/ /sgra yig i dang ldan pa'o/ /bden bral phyi rol pa la yang / /byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma can dang ldan/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /tsheg cadrag u yig sbyor bar bya/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig i yis brgyan pa ste/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma can dang ldan/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /sgra yig mu dang sbyor bar bya/ /de bzhin dbus las 0dbu ma la / /tsheg drag dang ni mnyam por ldan/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma can dang ldan/ /bden bral phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /tsheg drag mnyam por ldan pa yi / /dbus las tha ma pa dang ldan/ /de bzhin bden bral phyi rol pa/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /dbang ldan 'dab ma can dang ldan/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin pa/ /yi ge a dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa 'gyur bya/ /de bzhin dbus las dbu ma yang / /me mtshams pa yi stan 7ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma de bzhin dang / /byang las dang po sbyor ba yis / /byang las tha ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin 77—579

du /lan gnyis par ni brjod par bya/ /de bzhin nub kyi dang po yang / /lan gnyis par ni brjod par bya/ /me mtshams pa yi stan /ldan pa/ /byang las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /thig le ma yig ldan pa yi/ /nor chen rdo rje nyi ma yin / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung nas su/ /me mtshams 'dab ma'i stan ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /bden bral phyi rol gnas pa dang / /dbus las dbu ma sbyor ba dang / /tsheg drag mnyam por ldan pa yi / /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can de bzhin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams pa yi stan caldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /me mtshams 'dab ma can de bzhin/ /byang las dang po sbyor ba yi/ /byang las tha ma chi'agyur bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung la / /thig le u yig sbyor ba'o / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dbus las dbu ma bzung ba dang / /me mtshams pa yi stan ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin dang / /me mtshams 'og tu ldan pa yi/ /dbus las tha ma 'byung /bar bya/ /dbus las dbu ma 7de bzhin du/ /thig le dang ni mnyam ldan no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /dbus / las dbu ma de bzhin du/ /me mtshams pa yi gdan sbyor ba'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /shar las dang po bzung ba dang / /me mtshams pa yi mgor sbyor ba'i/ /dbus las tha ma 'gyur bar bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /tsheg 5drag e 6yig 77—580

sbyor ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas dbang bskur ma dang —/ mdzod gter ma dang / rgyal mtshan mchog ma dang / mchod chen mimo zhes bya ba lha mo bzhi rigasungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan pa/ /i yig me mtshams can ldan pa'i/ /dbus las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /yi ge e dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /byang las dang po yang yin te/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin dang / /e yig me mtshams can ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya / /nub nas catha ma bzung nas su/ / dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ / sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las tha ma bzung nas su/ /nub kyi dang po de bzhin te/ /rtag par a med 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan par/ /dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /me mtshams pa yi stan ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /i yig me mtshams pa ldan pa'i/ /dbus las dang po ri'agyur bar bya/ /yi ge e dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /byang las dang po yang yin te /me mtshams pa yi stan ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol la gnas pa/ /tsheg drag yi ge i dang sbyar/ /de ni 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /ces bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan dang / /thig le e yig ldan pa yi/ /lho las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /yi ge a dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /de nas byang gi dang po ste/ /dbus las tha ma de bzhin du/ /i yig dang ni sbyor ba yi / /nub kyi tha ma 'gyur bar bya/ /tsheg ngadrag o yig dang ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol par gyur pa'o / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan pa/ /77—581

dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /me mtshams pa yi stan ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /dbus las tha ma de bzhin du/ /yi ge e dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /me mtshams phyi rol par 'gyur te/ /de bzhin dbus nas 7tha ma dang / /yi ge a dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol 'gyur bar bya/ /thig le mu yig dang ldan pa'i/ /me mtshams phyi rol par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas mda' gzhu 'dzin ma dang / rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ma dang / rdo rje nyi ma mo dang / rdo rje bsreg bya za ba mo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje nyi ma'i lha mo bzhi rigasungs so/ /gling bu ma sogs 'dus pa dang / /sgo srung gem sogs 'du rib ste/ /me tog ma sogs 'dus nas kyang / /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la bskyed 'dod/ /ces bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las / sngags 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /6yig thig le dang ldan pa/ /de bzhin bden bral phyi rol pa/ /thig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin dang / /yi ge i dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /byang gi tha mar 'gyur bar bya/ /yi ge sku yig dang ldan pa'i/ /bden bral phyi rol pa yin te/ /dbus las bzhi pa gang yin dang / /thig le u yig dang ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa 'gyur te/ /rta mchog rgyal po chen po yis// /thams cad dus su bzla tshabar bya / /las rnams thams cad 'grub pa ni/ /'joms pa las grub dran las dga' / /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /lkoyig thig 7le 2dang ldan par/ /de bzhin dbus las dbu ma pa/ /sgra yig i dang sbyor bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyi rol de bzhin te/ /dbus las dbu ma dang 77—582

ldan bya/ /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin te/ /me mtshams pa 〉yi stan ldan pa'i//sto las dbu ma yang yin te/ /byang las bzhi pa gang yin dang / /me mtshams pa yi kyimanyam gnon pa'i/ /dbus las tha ma 'gyur ldan bya/ /lho las dbu ma yang yin te/ /tsheg drag i yig ldan pa ni/ /sna tshogs padmo zhes su grags/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /o yig thig le dang ldan par/ /mi yig dang ni mnyam ldan pa'i/ /dbus las dbu ma yang yin te/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /dbus las dbu ma ldan par bya / /dbus las dbu ma de bzhin te/ /me mtshams pa yi stan ldan pa'i/ /lho las dbu ma 'gyur bar bya/ /bden bral phyi rol bzung ba dang / /dbus las dbu ma ldan pa yi/ /byang las dang po 'gyur bar bya/ /tsheg drag dang ni mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa yang yin/ /rta yi rgyal po'i cadakyil 'khor la / /sna tshogs rdo rje zhes grags so/ /gang dang gang gi dbus la ni/ /rta mchog 'di ni gzhag subya na/ /de nyid de yi cadakyil 'khor yin/ /yul 'khor thams cad 'dul ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das thogs ri med shin tu dga' ba dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor la sngags 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi phyag rgya shes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par /dī dī /kha' 'gro sgyu tshom bde ba'i mchog las sngags 'byung ba'i rtog pa ste de la ji ltar shin tu dga' ba nyid yin zhe na/ skyon med rtag pa gtan du ni / /'dod chags thams cad rjes chags phyir/ /de nyid gsang ba bcom ldan 77—583

'das /'dod chags chen po dga' ba /che zhes so / /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po yin zhe na/ gtan du dga' ba kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag /byang chub sems mchog cho ga'o/ /de ji ltar bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gtso bo yin zhe na/ dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug che mchog phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje dbang chen thugs nar bsgyur/ /rdo rje snying po gtso bo'i gtso / /dam pa'i dang po skyes bu'o/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi sems nyid yin zhe na/ bsam med rgya chen zab pa ni/ /dngos grub thams cad zad med bde/ /kun gyi dri ma med pa ni/ /byang chub sems bdag bstan capa yin/ /de nas de'i yongs su las kyi khyad par ni/ /sems brtan nyid kyis sems dpa' ste/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa sems dpa' ste / /rdo rje nyid yin rdo rje las/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'byung ba'o/ /rdo rje rdo rje zhes gsungs ni/ /nyon cig rdo rje gang gsungs pa/ /zla ba 'dra bar yang dag blo/ /rdo rje zhes su rnam par bshad/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yin zhe na/ ting 'dzin la sogs rnam tshabazhi yis/ /gang gi bskyed pa yod bsgoms na/ /bsgoms na thams cad bdag nyid du/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs sbyor yang / /rang byin brlab pa'adi grub mchog ste/ /de nyid nyin re grub pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid thob 5bo/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yin zhe na/ gsungs pa/ snying stobs rdul dang mun pa yang / /ci phyir sems can don du 'gyur/ /de phyir kun tu bzang 77—584

po yi/ /ci bzhin byang sems spyod ces 'gro/ /de la ci riltar bcom ldan 'das bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba yin zhe na/ sems de kho na bdud yin te /sems de kho na de bzhin gshegs/ /rang sems 'dul ba'i don du ni/ /bdag ni bdud canyid nye bar 'gro/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das/ /mngon par byang chub dang sangs rgyas yin zhe na/ rang sems so sor 'bigs pa ni /byang chub sems mchog rdo rje nyid/ /de nyid de las de sangs rgyas/ /rang byin brlabs mchog bsgoms phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum mo mthar byed dang / phyag na rdo rje yin zhe na/ /dbyer med so sor 'jigs pa ni/ /snang ba thams cad nges par gnon/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje ni/ /byang chub sems rnams brtan pa yin/ /brtan pa thams cad 'grub don du/ /rgyal ba bdag gis kun bzang gi / /phyag la phyag mtshan de byin te/ /des de suphyag na rdo rje yin/ /de la ji ltar dang po'i rigs 'byung ba yin zhe na/ ma ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /pha ni thabs la mkhas pa ste/ /'dul phyir rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /skye ba bdag ni rigs yin no/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa'i thar pa yin zhe na/ dngos grub thams cad rjes chags phyir/ /'dod chags chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /kun grub zad med bde ba yin/ /bde ba chen po zhes 'dod do/ /gsang ba khrag 'thung zhes bya ste/ /phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa'i phyir/ /mchog ni padma 'dzin rgyal po/ /dam tshig dam pa shes ldan phyir/ /dgyes pa dam pa nyi ma ste/ /sbyin pa la sogs mchog sgrub 7phyir/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /rdo rje rta mchog las nyid phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos sems dpa' ste/ /rdzogs 77—585

sangs rgyas phyir rnam snang mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen po/ /ye shes rdo rje 'dzin mchog phyir/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rnam pa gsum nyid yin zhe na/ 'jig rten gsum dag mtha' yas phyir/ /'dul phyir srid gsum mchog gsum bdag /thams cad nyid phyir dkon mchog gsum/ /'jig rten gsum bdag khams gsum yin/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad nyid yin zhe na/ sems can bsod nams cher 'phags phyir/ /mi g.yo thams cad kho na bdag /sems 'du 'bral /phyir g.yo ba ste/ /kun byed thams cad kho na'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma bdag lha mor gsungasang / /thams cad mdzad pas skal ba bzang / /rnam par rtog pa skal ngan par/ /brda yis mtshan mar gsungs pa'o/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das dang po'i snying po dbyangs 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyu yin zhe na/ /gtan du srid pa yang dag 'grub/ /dbang phyug chen po 'grub don du/ /dpa' bo'i dngos grub kun don du/ /bskal pa'i dang po bcom ldan gsungs/ /'dod chags chen po'i phyir bcom ldan / /dam pa zad med shin tu dga'/ /gsang nyid phyir na /snying po'i dbyangs / /hūṃ yig dam pa zad med pa'o/ /de la ji ltar nye ba'i snying po de nyid kyi ye shes yin zhe na/ dkyil 'khor dag ni dman pa dang / /dam tshig dag ni spangs pa dang / /de nyid gsang ba mi shes pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub pa min/ /'dod pa bcom ldan sems dpa' ste/ /de kho na ni 'dod chags yang / /rdo rje phyag na rdo rje ni/ /chags bral de dang 'grub pa min/ /ling ga 'greng bar —rang 'byung ste/ / brla yi steng du bzhugs byas nas/ /ling ga mchod rten 5byin brlabs 7te/ /rdo rje dbyings ni rang bdag 'gyur/ /77—586

ling ga 'greng bar rang byung ste/ / brla yi /risteng du bzhugs nas su/ /ling ga rdo rjer byin brlabs ji te/ / rdo rje sems dpa' gnod med skye/ /ling ga 'greng ba rang byung ste/ /brla yi steng du bzhugs nas su/ /ling ga rdo rjer byin brlabs te/ /ri0khrag 'thung zhes bdag sngon skye'o/ /ling ga 'greng bar rang byung ste/ / brla yi ca)steng du bzhugs nas su/ /ling ga padmar byin brlabs rite /dag pa'i chos bdag sngon skye'o/ /ling ga 'greng bar rang byung ste/ / brla yi rkesteng du bzhugs nas su/ /ling ga rin chen byin brlabs te/ /rdo rje nyi mar bdag sngon bskyed/ /ling ga 'greng bar rang byung ste/ / brla yi tshosteng du bzhugs nas su/ /ling ga sna tshogs byin brlabs —rte/ /rta mchog dag ni sngon skye'o/ /bha gar ling ga bcug byas te/ /der ni khaṃ 7yig bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs dag 'od/ /sku gnyis ldan pa spro bar 5bya/ /bha gar ling ga bcug nas sum/ /de la : yig bsgom par bya/ /shin tu dga' 'dra'i gzugs dag ni/ /sku gnyis ldan pa'i spro bya'o/ /bha gar ling ga bcug ṅkanas su/ /de la trī payig bsgom par bya/ /khrag 'thung 'dra ba'i gzugs dag ni/ /sku gnyis ldan par spro bya'o/ /bha gar ling ga bcug nas su/ /de la bha yig bsgom par bya/ /padma 'dzin 'dra'i gzugs dag ni/ /sku gnyis ldan pa spro bya'o/ /bha gar ling ga bcug nas su/ /de la tram̐ yig bsgom par bya/ /nyi ma 'dra ba'i gzugs dag yod/ /sku gnyis ldan pa spyo bya'o/ /bha gar ling ga bcug nas su/ /de la snye yig bsgom par bya/ /: mdzad 'dra ba'i gzugs skudag ni/ /sku gnyis ldan par spro bya'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal tshordo rje sems dpas hogasungs so/ /de nyid gsang ba gsang chen yang / /snying po 77—587

yongs su grags pa yin/ /snying pos rjes su 'grub pa ni/ /nye 〉ba'i snying por yongs rigrags so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' /spya hūṃ / zlo bde ba'i mchog las gsang ba bsgrub 4pa'i rtog pa ste nyi shu rtsa de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po dang / rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig gi rgyud yin zhe na/ kun 'grub zad med bde ba ni/ /de ni rdo rje 'grub pa ste/ /don yod dam tshig 'da' dka' yin/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi don yin zhe na/ ji ltar gnas su gang 'khor lo / /de ltar sde dang 'gro ba bzhin/ /'khor dang yang dag 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor skyed mchog yin/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rnam smin gyi rgyu yin zhe na/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs lha yi/ /dkyil 'khor mngon sum mthong ba las/ /ci ci'adra brtag 9pa'i bsod nams su/ /phyi ni de bzhin bri bya'o/ /de la ji ltar thig gdab pa'i cho ga shes pa yin zhe na/ mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bya na/ /mtshams kun mnyam por 'dren par bya/ /shar dang nub dang byang sogs phyogs/ /thig skud bzhi pa re'u mig brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor skum po sangs rgyas kyi/ /rdo rje can gyi zla gam bzhin/ /padma padma'i tshul yin te/ /rin chen tshul ni rin chen gyi/ /sna tshogs kyi ni skum por gsungs/ /ci 7ltar 'dod pa ci bde bas/ /dang gi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa/ /re'u mig brgyad par 'dod pa'o/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor dbus 7gnas par/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor du ni 'dod/ /re'u mig brgyad kyi dbus gnas pas / /gtso 77—588

bo'i dkyil 'khor 'dod pa yin/ /zhes dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la ji ltar rtog pa'i dngos grub dam pa yin zhe na/ ji ltar bden par dkyil 'khor bdag /gang gis rtogs par nus pa ni/ /gang gis yi dam lhar sbyor bas /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ldog pa yin/ /bris sku bris pa'i sbyor ba yis //rang sems bris par sbyor ba yin/ /lhag chad cho cigar gyur na yang / / bsgrubs te bskyon du mi 'gyur ro/ / de la 0ji ltar gsang ba lnga'i de nyid yin zhe na/ sems dpa' gdod ma tha ma med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che / /kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snying po gtso bo'i gtso/ /gdod ma tha ma med phyir tshoyang / /dam pa'i dang po zhes 'dod do/ /'khor lo kun gyi gtso phyir ni/ /dam pa dam pa'i dbang phyug yin/ /de la ji ltar bcom ldan 'das gang lags ci 'dra ba yin zhe na/ 'dod pa chen po kun gyi mchog /yid rtabade bas ni tsho'adzum pa che/ /rtag par 'dzum pa'i bde ba des/ /dam pa bcom ldan 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas de yi 2zla skamadog ni/ /dam pa yig 'bru grub nyid phyir/ /chos rnams thams cad dag phyir dang / /gsang ba de nyid rnam dag phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin de zla ba'i mdog /de nas de'i sna tshogs dmar ba'i 'od 'bar ba ni/ ci laphyir bcom ldan ci'adod chags che/ /'dod chags kun la rjes chags phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid kyang / /sna tshogs dmar po 'bar ba'i 'od/ /de la ji ltar dbang bskur laba'i shes pa yin zhe na/thod phreng dzodabu rgyan las gzhan ni/ /khams gsum la ni dbu rgyan med/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag mngon bskyed ci/ /khams gsum las ni rin chen gzhan/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'dra ba med/ /77—589

sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen ces/ /dbu rgyan de yis rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nas ji ltar sems dpa'i kyil mo spung 〉yin zhe na/ yan lag g.yas pas mnyam gnon pas/ /g.yon pa'i yan lag gzir nas su/ /de yi sems dpa'i skyil krung can / /rdo rje snying po gtso bo'i rigatso/ /de nas ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i lha mo la sogs pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi shes pa yin zhe na/ kun mchog shin tu 'bigs pas na/ /dngos grub thams cad bde ba'i mchog /kun mchog rnam rgyal bkra shis pas/ /thams cad dbang phyug che ru 'phags/ /grub carnams de bzhin phun sum tshogs/ /dga' ba de bzhin ga mo bdag /rdo rje lha mo tshogs phyag rgya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gzugs yin/ /de nas ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po'i de nyid lnga yin zhe na/me long khrag 'thung zhes bya rnams/ /mnyam pa nyid la gar dbang mchog /so sor rtog la nyi ma ste/ /bya ba la ni rta mchog dang / /chos kyi dbyings la sangs rgyas ni/ /thub chen rnam par snang mdzad do/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid ni/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya de bzhin yang / /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar ni/ /de rnams de bzhin nyid kyis bsnyen/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'byung ba yis/ /rgya cher dngos grub ster bar 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas ji ltar phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i yan lag gi shes pa yin zhe na / 'phrog byed ma dang 'dzin byed ma/ /gzung thar ma dang tshe sbyin ma/ /nam mkhar 'gro dang lha mo dag /mkha' 'gro ma drug rab tu grags/ /gang gis skra ni bstan gyur na/ /de la dpral ba bstan par bya/ /mig la ston pa 77—590

gang yin pa/ /de la lte ba bstan par bya/ /gang gis lte ba bstan rtso pa na / /de la mchu rini rab tu bstan/ /gang gis ma mchu rab bstan na/ /de la so ni rab tu bstan/ /gang gis rtse ni bstan 'gyur can/ /de la gsus pa bstan par 'gyur/ /gang gis bha ga bstan gyur na/ /de la ling ga bstan par bya/ /gang gis ri rje tshongar bstan na ni/ /de la brla ni bstan ripar bya/ /gang gis brla ni bstan gyur tshotshon/ /de la rkang mthil bstan par bya/ /gang gis rkang mthil 7bstan na ni/ /de la sen mo bstan par bya/ /gang gis mchan khung bstan / 7gyur cod/ /de la smin ma bstan par bya/ /gang gis sgra sgrogs 7byed gyur ngan/ /de la cho nges pabya ba'o/ /gang gis mkha yang bstan na ni/ /de la zhags pa bstan 7par bya/ /gang gis gsal shing bstan gyur /rin/ /de la mdung thung bstan par bya/ /gang gis son mo bstan na ni/ /de la nu ma rab tu bstan/ /gang gis tshokhu tshur bstan na ni/ /de la mtshams su bstan par bya//gang gis 7rtse ni bstan gyur na/ /de la bshang tshogaci bstan par bya/ /gang gis mi sdug gzugs byed na/ /de la mdzes pa'i gzugs bya'o/ /gang gis he skad byed gyur rten/ /de la lag pa bstan par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas ji ltar mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mtshan ma yin zhe na/ nad pa'i mig gi 'bras 'dra ba/ /dpral bar tri shul te rumadung thung / /phyin log mig dang khro gnyer can/ /nu ma dag ni mi sdug pa/ /sna ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /gtsug gis bskor skab shes byas te / /ri mo gsum gyis tshoyongs su bskorari snye/ /de yi khyim gyi mtshan ma ni/ /tri shul tshung nge 0me long dang / /ral gri tshul dang rgyal mtshan dang / /rtse gcig khyim gyi 77—591

mtshan mar bstan / /'gro bar gyur na mkha' 'gro ma/ /'di 'dra'i mtshan ma bstan par bya/ /glo bur mi dga' bya ba dang / /don med par yang 'jug pa'o /rkang pa la yang ral gri 'gyur/ /tri shu ril dang 'dra ba'i tshul/ /skad dang bya rog 'dra ba yi / /de ni rtag par 'gyur ba'o/ /mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa/ /dam pa'i mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la ji ltar thams cad 'gugs pa'i rgyu yin zhe na/ rtog 0pa thams cad gsang chen po/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dril bcas pa sa / /bkug nas de nas bya ba nas / /dril bu rjes su dkrol ba'o/ /de la ji ltar mchod pa chen po thams cad kyi cho ga yin zhe na/ rtog pa thams cad gsang chen gyi/ /gang gis dga' nas mchod pa ni/ /rjes su mchod pa dang gzhan yang / /dbyangs dang sil snyan gar gyi yin/ /de la ji ltar rang gis rig pa'i lha thams cad bsgrub pa chen po'i rgyu yin zhe na/ rtog pa kun la sa bsgrub bya kun/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo 'gyur ba ste/ /rang gi yi dam lha sbyor nas /thams cad de ni 'grub par bya/ /de nas ji ltar thams cad rjes su 'grub pa'i rgyu yin zhe na/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin 'gyur nas/ /bzlas pa'i dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /rtog pa thams cad rjes grub pas/ /mchog gi dang po 'grub pa'o/ /de la ji ltar rjes su sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i bsgrub ngapa thams cad kyi rgyu yin zhe na/ o yig thig le dang ldan pa'i/ /nub las dang po yang yin te/ /shar las dang ngo bzung nas su/ /lci bar i yig ldan par bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /jig le u yig sbyor bar bya/ /sto las dbu ma bzung ba la/ /tsheg drag yang dag ldan par bya/ /the tshom med par de 77—592

las 'dis/ /rjes su sbyor bar ldan par 'grub / /lho las dang po bzung nas su/ /gnyis pa la ni ldan par bya/ /nan tan gyis rini i yig sbyor/ /skad cig ma las gcod 'gyur ro/ /de nyid thig le dang ldan pas/ /byang las dbu ma yang yin te/ /de nyid lan gnyis brjod par bya/ /rlung mtshams phyi rol pa la yang / /thig le sku yig ldan par ni/ /drug par yongs su grags pa yin /dbus las gnyis pa gang yin pa/ /nub las dang po yang yin te/ /de ni a med shes bya ste/ /skad cig mas ni bdud rtsi 'grub/ /o yig thig le dang ldan par/ /yi ge u yig mnyam ldan pa'i/ /dbang ldan phyi rol pa yang bya / /me mtshams phyi rol pa bzung nas/ /yi ge e dang mnyam ldan pa/ /shar gyi dang po ldan par bya/ /tsheg drag u yig ldan pa yi/ /dbus kyi tha ma ldan par bya/ /thams cad kyi ni sgrub byed pa/ /khrag 'thung cizhes pa 'byung ba'o/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bsgrub bya 'grub/ /de nas phyi na ci 'dod par/ /ci 'dod 'dod pa bya ba yis / /kun bzang kun byed de bzhin te/ /langs pa 'am ni 'dug pa 'am/ /'gro ba yis sam 'greng ba 'am/ /bzhad pa dang ni smra ba la/ /gang dang de ru ci de bzhin/ /gang gang dbang po'i las nyid pas/ /gang gang de de'i rang bzhin du/ /rang gi mnyam gzhag med sbyor bas/ /rang gis rig pa'i lha 'dren no/ /de nyid sbyor ba de yis ni/ /thams cad kho na 'grub pa'o /sangs rgyas kun dngos thams cad ni/ /rtag tu mthong na rab tu 'grub / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkhas pa gang zhig dad pas klog /de ni nyes pa rnam grol te/ /dngos grub thams cad dbang phyug 'gyur / /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma 77—593

ba/ ba'i /chog las rjes su sbyor ba dang ldan pa sgrub pa'i rtog pa ste nyi shu rtsa ga / //// sna tshogs rjes su chags pa'o/ /dga' ba padma rnam dag che ba yis / /gsal :bar rjes su gtsang ba rinam pa rtag par sbyin pa yis / /dam pa bde ba'i dngos pos dam tshig bdag la bde ba rjes su bsgrubazhu ri/ /dam pa'i dga' ba shin tu sbyor ba skal bzang dam pa shin tu dga'/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rang bzhin dag pa rtag tu rjes su 'grub pa'i 0rang bzhin dngos/ /dam pa dga' ba la sogs sbyor ba'i skal bzang 9 dam pa shin tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'grub pa'o/ /dag pa rjes su 'grub pa'i rang bzhin kho na so so rjes su sbyab pa sdude ba las dam pa'i gsang chen rgyud phyi ma'i 4phyi ma 'di yongs su gdī hūṃ/ga/ gi 'di ni dang ba'i pasnying po mchog /bde ba chen po mchog gi mchog 'gyur mthu chen po/ /kun mchog 'byung ba'i sems can rtag pa ci yi 7phyir / /kun mchog sa yi dbang po nyid ni sbyor ba po/ /mtha' yas thob med thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /tshul chen po yi 7chen po thams cad kyi/ /mkha' dang 'dra ba'i mchog gi dngos grub 'phel ba sbyin/ /gdod 5ma tha rim med pa smugang dag gis/ /rdzogs byed med pa nus pa tsham yin no/ / /sems can le lo can dang nyung tsam 'dod pa dang / /mi dad pa dang skog 7smra ba dang ma dag pa/ /rtag tu rjes su chags dang chags bral dga' ba dang / /de rnams phan pa'i don rdzogs pa'i don 'di yin no/ /gang gi khyim du gzung bar gang gis ri gyur pa dang — /bdag gis ji ltar ston pa sgrub 5par byed pa 'am/ /mthu yis thams 77—594

cad so sor mngon du gyur pa ste/ /dngos grub mchog gis rgyas /pa'i las dag mi /'grub pa'o/ /gang gis grub pa rdo rje 'dzin zhes sogs pa dang / /gzugs sogs thams cad 'di la ji ltar mos pa bzhin/ /yi ge snye yang ji ltar rab tu 'dod par bris byas na/ /des ni rang ri'adod dngos grub cho ga bzhin du 'thob/ /sems can don du las dag byed pa ma yin pas/ /rgyal ba cidag gis rnam par dag pa 'di la ni / /bgegs med de bzhin du ni bdud kyang med pa ste/ /rtog pa yis kyang dngos grub 'phel stobs byin gyis rlobs/ /gang gi rtog pa mchog chen 'di sgrub byed pa la/ /bdud nyid du ni mi 'gro mi brtan nyid kyang min/ /brtan dzopa'i rgyu ni bdag gis ston par mi byed de/ /myur bar mchog gi mchog nyid 'grub phyir bstan par 'gyur byed do/ /gang gis 7bdag gi snying pos bdag la rtag tu grub byed ni / /mchog chen dngos grub dang ni rtag par bde chen dang / /chags dang shin tu dga' dang brtan dang rgyas pa dang / /yig chen yang ni rtag par bdag gis ske'agrub par byed/ /de nas mchog skyes rgyal ba thams cad dga' nas su/ /'dzum pa chen po thams cad khyab 〉par rnam par 'byed/ /kun bdag dbyings kyi rdul phran dmachog chen gzugs dag gis/ /kun nas de la legs pa'i sgra ni dbul bar byed/ /bdag gis padabyings kun rjes su che mchog gzugs kyis su/ /pha cimachog gyur pa sangs rgyas kun gyis 7legs so legs/ /mchog gi rdo rje las byung khyod ni —legs so legs/ /dam pa'i chos nyid chos kyi bdag nyid legs so legs/ /dam pa'i las can mchod pa'i bdag nyid legs so legs/ /rtogs 5pa'i byin rlabs mdzod cig mnyam par byin brlabs cikyis/ /don yod cadangos grub 77—595
