grangs de dag gi /dang chud par/ /dge ba thub pas byas nas ni/ /re mig sum cu gnyis pa blang / /lnga pa yis ni khyad par bya/ /brgya byed byed pa yang dag blang / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yis phye/ /re mig sum cu drug pa blang / /gsum pa yis ni khyad par dbye/ /de nas sum cu gnyis pa blang / /lnga pa yis ni khyad par bya/ /de nas nyi shu lnga pa gzung / /nyi shu bzhi pa dag dang sbyar/ /sum cu gsum pa yang dag blang / /re'u rimig bcu (0lnga pa yis 40ldan/ /lnga pa dag dang yang dag bcas/ /mdzes pa'i mchog ni yin par 'dod/ / nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa dang ldan/ /bcu gcig pa yi mtshan pa'o/ /tshig gi dang po yin par 'dod / re mig bcu dgu pa gzung bya/ /me yi bu dang yang dag ldan/ /re mig gsum pas phye ba'o/ /ya tshogs brgyad pa'i sa bon la/ /re mig sum cu drug pa dang / /yang dag ldan pa'i yi ger gyur/ /slar yang tshig ni de dag nyid / /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed yin/ /de nas rang byung blangs nas ni / /re mig las ni lnga par sbyar / /spyi bor nā da thig ler 7sbyar/ /don kun sgrub ces bya ba yi / /tshig ni gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /re mig bcu dgu pa nyid la/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun pa yis bye/ /gsum pa dag dang yang dag ldan / /sum cu gsum pa legs blangs te/ /re mig gi ni gnyis par sbyar/ /nyi shu pa dang yang dag ldan/ /mdzes pa'i mchog ni yin par 'dod/ /de bzhin nyi shu gcig pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyi shu drug pa yin/ /lan gnyis bzlas pa'i tshig tu ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste btu/ /de nas go rims bzlog pas gzung sku/ /re mig las ni dang po nyid/ /bzhi pa'i mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin bcu lalnga pa dang bcas/ /chos don 'dod dang 77—656

thar pa yi kyi/ /tshig ni gsum pa yin par bshad/ /re mig gnyis pa'i sa bon dang —/ /re mig sum cu drug pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyi shu drug pa yang / /sum cu gsum pa yang dag blang / /re mig bcu gsum pa yir ldan/ /re mig las ni bcu pa nyid/ /go rims bsgrog byu pas sgrub pos blang / /re mig las ni bcu dgu pa/ /re mig nyi shu gsum pa la/ /re mig gnyis par yang dag ldan/ / steng du ri thig les rnam par brgyan / /de nas sa bdag gzung byas la / /brgyad pa yang ni de bzhin te/ /me yi bu yis khyad par dbye/ /yi ge snye gis mtha' ru sbyang ri / /'di ni khams gsum rgyal zhes bya'i/ /sngags tshig bzhi yis rnam brgyan ri tshopa'i/ /oṃ ni kun la gsal byed yin/ /sne ridang phaṭa ni mtha' ru sbyar / /rig rgyal 'khor los sgyur tshoba'i sngags/ /'di ni ma byung 'byung mi 'gyur / /de nyid bsdus dang dpal mchog dang / /bde mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed du / /khro bo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /skad cig gis ni sku brgyad 'gyur//bde ba'i dkyil 'khor bsrung 7don du/ /gdug pa thams cad khyad par gyis/ /'di ni rnyed pa tsam gyis kyang / /brtag skumi dgos par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i spyor bdag nyid kyis bzla/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras skyed skupa'o/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha lhu mi phaṭa/ oṃ groṇḍa gros rtu mu paphaṭa/ oṃ gros pa ya gri pa ya rtu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ ā na ya ho ཿbha ga ṭwāṃ ci/ bisgyu rā dza rtu gyi phaṭa/༵༵༵ spra shā ku'i nges par brjod pa las rdza rnga bcing ba'i sngags btu ba'i le'u ste de nas sha chen thams cad kyi/ /'jigs byed rdo rje skyes yin ri bshad/ /77—657

'di ni gdug (1pa thams cad kyi/ /'jigs byed mi bzad par bshad do/ /'di ltar khyi dang phag gi sha /zangs kyi gtsug dud tsho can de bzhin/ / mngon spyod kyi ni bya ba la/ / chibaza' dang sbyin sreg ( gtor ma bya/ /bya ba rnam spyod med par bya/ /ma lus lus pa med grub cing / /rgyal srid thams cad rab 'grub 'gyur/ /dung dang nya phyis mu tig gi/ /rgyu mtshan gsum po 'byung ba yis /chos kyi sku yi lus can gyi/ /thod pa la ni su zhig smod/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /zla ba phyed pas rgyan du byas/ /rnam pa de ciltar gyur pa nyid /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug yin par bshad/ /brda tsho)ni lnga po bstan pa dag /sgrub pa po yi palag g.yon gyis/ /'di ni dpa' bo'i gnas yin te/ /brda 7rnams kyi ni rab 'jug pa'o/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu dang / /'gro kun g.yon las byung ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mthe bor bzhugs/ /lhug mar de bzhin rnam snang mdzad/ /go cha'i rnam pa de lta bur/ /gtso bor padma gar mdzad de/ /bstan 5par dngos grub thams cad ni/ /rab stsol pa yi kṣidapa' bo bzhugs/ /mthe'u chung la ni mkha' snying po/ /mi zad sku dang ldan pa nyid / /sen mo'i ngos ni rta 'grin bgyi/ /gnas su gyur par bshad pa yin/ /'di dag thams cad dpa' bo ni/ /g.yon pa las byung 7rgyu yin no/ /lag mthil shrī he ru ka yi / /phag mo'i 'dus pa dga' byed yin/ /rgyab tu shin tu nges byas nas/ /bdag nyid lnga po bstan par bya/ /'di dag lag tu dgod pa ste /mdza' skyab thams cad 'dus pa yin/snye/ /rnam pa de lta'i cho ga yis/ /dpa' bo dam pa mchod par bya/ /sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ /chu khams mā ma tī ru brjod/ /me ni gos dkar mor bshad de/ /rlung ni sgrol mar rab tu 77—658

brjod/ /tsum tha ka ni stong pa ste/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa yin/ /dbus su dpa' bo kun gyi gnas/ /mkhas pas rgyab tu gshegs su gsol/ /gsang ba 'di ni mi bshad cing / /rab tu 'bad de sba bar bya/ /de ltar brda bya dpa' bo rnams/ /gcig tu zas la brtsam 〉par bya/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde mchog yin/ /dpal he ru ku'i nges par brjod pa las bza' ba dang sbyin sreg ci dang gtor ma'i bya ba la lag pa'i brda'i kyicho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /bza' dang ston mo 'dus pa ste/ /yang dag cho ga gang gis ni/ /dngos grub myur du rab 'jug pa'o/ /phyugs rnams kyi ni dgug pa nyid/ /sgrub pos sngar bstan rim pa 'dis/ /rgyugs 4rnams dang ni de bzhin lnga/ /bong bu ru sbal mi rnga mo/ /ce susbyang rta la sogs rnams kyis / /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyugs 'di dag ni sgrub yan lag /rigs rnams las ni rigs mchog phyugs/ /rkang bzhi rnams las glang por brjod/ /'dab chags rnams las ngang pa nyid/ /dud 'gro rnams las dud 'gro phyugs / /lha rnams las ni mchu g.yo ba/ /rnam pa de ltar brjod pa ste/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /phyugs de dag ni rnam par bshad/ /khu dang chu skyar ce spyang dang / /skye gnyis blon po chen po dang / /khrung khrung bzhad dang ka da / /bza' dang sbyin sreg gtor bya bas/ /'dod pa dag ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /khyi nag mo yi dzi'o thug ni/ /ma sha'i 'bras ni nag por ldan/ /'dod pas dogs pa med pa tshan/ /ji srid brgya rtsa brgyad kyi 77—669

bar / / ro yi 6)khar ni sbyin sreg ri bya/ /de nas yi dgas milangs nas ni/ /sgrub po de la 'dri 4byed de/ /ci bgyi zhes ni smra 'gyur zhing / /sa 'og las sam ral gri'am/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs nyid dag dang / / ril bu ⑥mig sman gter rnams sam/ /rkang mgyogs dag gam bcud kyis len/ /dngos 'di de bzhin gcig byin nas/ /'gro bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /steng dang ( sna'og tu pho nya 'grub/ /rgyud 'dir the tshom med pa yin/ /ba lang gnas dang lding ba nyid/ /lhag ma skam po rtsa de nas/ /bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bya/ /yang na ru sbal dag gi'o/ /'di de dngos grub sbyin 'gyur zhing / /phyag bzhi pa dang zhal bzhi pa/ /ji srid phyag ni 'bum gyi bar/ /sku ni dkar ba'i khro bo che /de nas drag shul gzugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje phag mo la gzigs pa/ /de yi sku mdog mtshon cha 'chang tsho/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sku la thal bas nye bar byugs/ /ral pa'i cod can mdud dang ldan/ /phyag rgya yis ni sku la brgyan / /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ /yi dgas mchen po skugadan du byas / /sgrub pa po yis dus rtag tu/ /sngags de shes nas bsgom par bya/ /de lta'i yon tan khyad 'phags pas/ /'dod pa yi ni dngos grub 'gyur / /dpal he ru ma'i nges par brjod pa las dud 'gro rgyugs dang / zlodi~X zlosgrub pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa de nas sgrub po'i mchog kun ni/ /sbyor ba kun la med pa'o/ /bza' dang bca' dang nya sha sogs/ /nus pa ji bzhin bya ba ste/ /med par gyur kyang 77—660

bza' ba ni0)/ /lnga po nyid du bya ba yin/ /bza' dang bca' ba rgya che ba/ /rtag tu mtshan mo nyid du bya/ /de nas pho nya rab sbyin zhing / /khyad par du ni sgrub pa po/ /rang gi pang snyedu mgo bzhag la/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rab tu mchod/ /ma 'am yang na sring mo 'am/ /bu rimo'am yang na chung ma gnyen/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i cho ga yis 0/ /bcings pa las ni rab grol bya/ /de nas sngags 'di 'grub 'gyur te/ /ji srid 'byung ba yod par du'o/ /slob dpon lus su legs gnas te/ /sgrub pa po las mchod pa len/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi stan ridag dang / /phyag rgya nyid du the tshom med/ /sgrub po shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /glu ri dang gar la sogs pa bya/ /ji srid lus can thams cad kyang — /rnal 'byor ye shes zhen ma gyur/ /de srid 'khor bar 'khor 'gyur zhing —/ /sdug bsngal mya ngan gyis g.yengs 'gyur/ /dngos po kun gyis sgrub pa pos/ /de nas phyag rgya mchod par bya/ /mchod pas mchod par 'dod pa ste/ /brnyas pa yis ni nges par sreg / rnal 'byor rgyud du mi rnams kyi/ //phyag rgya chen po dang po 'grub/ /dzorab tu 'bad pas mchod par bya/ /phyi nas dpa' bo rnams kyis 7ni/ /dpa' bo nyid la spyad par bya/ /de ltar mchod byas de nas ni/ /sa 'og sgrub po langs pa dang / /zhi ba nyid dang rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang dgug tshapa dag dang ni/ /gsad medang bskrad chipa la sogs dang / /rmugs dang rengs pa de bzhin te/ /dbye ba nyid dang tshar gcod mdang / /las kyi dngos grub mchod par bya/ /gang ci'ang rung ba'i las gyur la/ / nyon mi mongs —par 'grub 'gyur te/ /the tshom 5med par sgrub pa po'i/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal he ru rka'i 77—661

nges par brjod pa las gsang ba'i mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i/ /'khor lo zhes pa'i cho ga rgyas/ /las gang ci yang de myur bar/ /sgrub pa po ni the tshom med/ /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma/ /padma'i lte bar nges par byang/ /smin ma'i dbus su gzhug par bya/ /a ba zhu tī'i riganas de bzhin/ /dpa' bo'i 'chol ci bar byas chags par/ /bza' ba yang ni de nas bsreg /go māng 0ris dang ru rnyi ra/ /'bad pas bsreg bya lnga dag bya/ /de nas 'bar ba'i byin za (chil/ /sreg /blugs dgu ni sbyin par bya/ /'bar phreng rgya mtsho blta bar bya/ /kun nas sgo yi tsho'akhor lo nyid / /dpa' bo'i dbang po zhal bzhi pa/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i gnas de bzhin / /'dab la pho nya mo bzhi yin/ /dpa' bo kun dang gnyis med bde/ /cho ga ji bzhin rnam pa yis/ /khaṇḍa ro hā 7phyi rol ni/ /rang gi gzugs su rnam 5zhugs pa/ /'khor lo'i dbus su blta bar bya/ /'khor lo 'di dag gsal bar ni/ /rim pa ji lta ba bzhin bya/ /rig pa'i rgya mtsho'i skalas de bzhin/ /mdor bsdus nas ni gsungs pa yin/ /pho nya gnyis med sbyor ba'i bdag /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /dpal he ru na'i nges par brjod pa las pho nya mo'i sbyin sreg rshadang las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas las kyi rab mchog ni/ /ji bzhin rim gyis mtshon pa ste/ /mchod pa gnyis med sbyor ba'i bdag /las ni so sor sbyar bar bya/ /gang dag rab 77—662

grub byed pa'i sngags/ / de yi gyedabye ba rim bzhin bshad/ /kha dog pho nya sogs sngags gang / / mda' yi shugs kyis yongs su 'khor/ /phan tshun mdud rgyud dpa' bo ni/ /yul nyid kyis ni phye ba'o/ /sa bon phreng bas de nas gzung mi/ /sne ni mtha' ru gnas pa yin/ /bsgrub ribya 'gog par gyur pa ni/ /gom pa gcig kyang mi 'gro'o/ /kha sbyar sbyar bar gyur pa dang / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings pas/ /rdo rje dbye ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin gung ba ltar 'khor bya / /lcags kyu nyid kyis dgug pa dang / /gtun shing gis bskyod de bzhin te//rdo rje nyid kyis 'debs par bshad/ /dbug la mdas ri )ni sbyar bya ste/ /dus min 'chi ba blu ba la/ /yan lag kha ṭwāṃ ga dang sbyar/ /thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni/ /zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar/ /dpal lha ru na'i nges par brjod pa las gnyis su med pa'i las dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba blu tshoba'i cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas phyag rgya'i mchod chen dang / /sngags kyi dgod pa rab tu grags/ /myur du dngos grub byed par ni/ /phyag rgya'i mchod 'di the tshom med/ /mtshan ma gnyis la sngags sbyar te/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo gnyis med pa/ /snying po rnams kyis stude bzhin du/ /sngags pas mkha' 'gro ma la sbyar/ /blo ldan mkha' 'gro ma bsrub 7bya/ /dag pa'i lus ni rang pa'adod pa/ /dpa' bo mchod pa rnams byas nas/ /las ni 'bad pa nyid kyis bya/ /rnam dbye rang dgas sngags 7pa ni/ /phyin ci log tu nges par sbyar/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs don rnams la/ /las kyi dngos por rnam par sgom/ /de nyid dbye bar gye nas ni/ /77—663

rtsa yi tsalam du sbyar bar bya/ /rab tu sgrub pa'i sbyor don la/ / phyi rol ji bzhin nang de bzhin/ / 'di yis myur du lha dang ni/ /lha min mir bcas bsgrub par bya/ /dpal he ru rka'i nges par brjod pa las de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gzugs ni gnon pa'i cho ga ste/ /phan tshun sbyar ba'i gsang sngags ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gcig tu sbyar/ /bza' ba zos mid de nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i mthar ni skyug par bya/ /mtshan mo bdun ni rdzogs pa dang / /bza' dang btung ba dag la sbyar/ /'di yis ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /dbang du 'gro bar the tshom med/ /ser skya'i mar ni 'thungs nas su/ /bzlas pa'i mthar ni skyug par bya/ /de yis rang gi gdong bskus na / /gal te rtag tu khros gyur pa/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur / /til mar sā lu btags pa dang / /ldan pas lus ni bskus gyur cing — /snum khur sngags pas byas nas ni/ /bza' ba la ni rab tu sbyar/ /gal te las 'di ma btang na/ /ji srid 'tsho bar rtag dbang 'gyur/ /til dag dag ni zos nas su/ /ske tsher bcas 9pa phyugs pa dang / /ru rta bshang ba dang ldan pa/ /las skyes sto ba'i srin bu ni/ /rang gi khrag dang btags nas ni / /rang gi khu ba nyid dang sbyar/ /bza' btung mig sman gos la ni/ /byug pa nyid du rab tu sbyar/ /'di yis ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /dbang du 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /ba lang sha sreg sbyin sreg 7ni/ /khrag gis bskus 7na lha rnams ni / /de mod dbang du 'gyur ba'am/ /gal te ma 'ongs 'chi bar 'gyur/ /77—664

bdag nyid de yi tsa )mdun du ni/ /bsgoms nas mkhas pas sbyin sreg bya/ /sbyin sreg zhu0mthar ni gtor ma bya/ /khams gsum skad cig gis 'gugs pa/ /mtshan bdun gyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba'i//dam tshig spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rtag tu rang sngags sbas pa yis rab tu 'bad de gsang bar bya/ /sbas don rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing / /skal ba dman pas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams chung ba'i sgrub pos kyang / /nga camanyes byas pas rnyed par 'gyur/ /dpal he ru ku'i nges par brjod pa las dang gi bdag nyid kyi dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas brda ‘ rini mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /lus kyi mtshan nyid gang yin dang / / dpa' bo'i ji yan lag dbye ba ni/ /grub par gyur pa de 'grub 'gyur/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug mi 'dri zhing / /rnam pa kun du sba bar bya/ /gang gi thad du'ang mi gdon te/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod sgrub pa pos/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid mkha' 'gro yi/ /sngags rnams bag med pas 'don tshon/ /de la nga ni mi lta 7ste/ /mkha' 'gro stong phrag du ma yis/ /ngan pa'i bdag nyid can de za / /dam tshig 'joms shing ngan spyod de/ /bram ze gsod par the tshom med/ /sdig spyod rmongs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bslus 7gyur ngan pa'i bdag nyid de/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis zos gyur kyang / /de la nga ni skyob mi byed/ /gsang ba pa yi tshonang na ni/ /sgrub po de ni phyugs dang 'dra/ /bla ma dam tshig la 'khu ba/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten de las lhung / /he ru ka dpal lta skudaka'i rgyud/ /gang zhig srung skyabar byed pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro mar bcas dge sdong zhes/ /de la nga 77—665

ni rjes su 'dzin/ /bla ma la ni bsnyen bkur byed/ /gsong por byed pa'i sgrub pa po/ /mkha' 'gro ma la rtag dga' ba/ /de la dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur//sgrub pa po ni dpa' nyid 'gyur/ /khams gsum mkha' la rgyu ba'i bdag /sgrub po dpa' bo nyid 'dod pa/ /thams cad du ni mchod par 'gyur/ /de ni rnal 'byor la rab 'jug /yang dag sbyin pa'ang rig par 'gyur/ /he ru ka yi brtul zhugs /tsho'adzin/ /slob dpon dpa' bo mthong gyur na / /mthong zhing mthong zhing kun tu dga'/ /sgrub pa pos ni sngags 'di yis/ /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i gsang sngags mchog /lan bdun du ni brjod par bya/ /rab sngags snye la sogs pas phye/ /de rnams 'bad de phyag byas na/ /sangs rgyas la sogs thams cad mchod/ /rtag pa nyid du dpa' chen dang / /rol par ldan par ( the tshom camed/ / de yi bugs kur gnas phag mo/ /nga dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /pho nya rnams dang lhan cig bcas/ /de dang gyitshogang zhig legs skyes pa / /srog chags bsod nams mthong ba yin/ /'bab chu'i 'gram dang rgya mtsho dang — /ri bo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /lteng ka dang ni ( khron pa mtshe'u / /khang stong dang ni lam srang dag /thams cad du ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu zhen par lta la gnas/ /'jigs pa chen po dur khrod du/ /mkha' spyod de bzhin sa 'og dang / /ro langs kyang ni du ma zhig /'jigs pa'i gzugs dang stobs chen pos/ /de dang lhan cig dpa' bo che/ /ci bde bar ni rol par mdzad/ /ri sul tshang tshing gsang ba dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang gsang ba'i 7mi/ /phyogs ni de dang de dag tu/ /sgrub pa po dang sa steng rol/ /dpal he ru ga'i nges par brjod pa las rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub 7pa'i sa dang gsang ba'i 77—666

dpa' bo'i gnas kyi cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa sgyu brgyad pa'o// //de nas grub kyi pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /sngags ni ji rnam pa brgyad kyis rgod / /de nas 'di la yang dag mthong / /gsol bar 'gyur ba ( gdon mi za/ /'jigs pa'i sgra ni rnam mang po/ /mi bzad mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed pa/ /dpa' bo 'jigs par gyur na ni/ /skrag cing rnam par 'byer bar byed/ /gal te dpa' bo mi 'jigs na/ /lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas ni/ /rang gi gnas su khyer nas su/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni de dag dang / /rtag tu mngon par rtse byed de/ /bde ba can gyi gnas 'gro 'gyur/ /he ru ka dpal gus 'dod pas /mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su khyer/ /sgrub pa po ni sngags lus can/ /'khor bar 'chi dang rga ba med/ /dpal he ru ku'i nges par brjod pa las blta ba dang ha har rgod 7pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gang gis sa stengs tshodabang du 'gyur/ /dpa' bo'i sngags kyi zla ba yis / /rnal 'byor cho gar //gnas pas 'grub/ /sgron ma myos byed bcas pa dang / /nya yi sha dang ldan par ni/ /dpa' dbang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /nyi ma bdun gyis sgrub pa po'i / /mtshan mo'i sbyin sreg dbyed la gzhol/ /dngos grub rgya chen stsol tshabar 'gyur/ /brgya dang rtsa brgyad ldan nyid kyis/ /thun gsum du ni sgrub byed na/ /rgyal po dpung dang bcas par ni/ /nyin bdun gyis ni dbang du 'gyur/ /phyed kyis dpa' bo rshablon po ste/ / de yi 7byed kyis blon po yi / /rgyal phran la ni sum cu gnyis/ /77—667

bsreg mepa'i rim gyis sbyin sreg bya/ /nyi shus bram ze nyid la ni/ /nyi ma bdun gyis sbyin sreg bya/ /de bzhin rgyal rigs dag la bdun/ /sbyin sreg calnga po rje rigs la/ /dmangs rigs la ni sbyin sreg rigasum/ /tha ma la ni sbyin sreg gcig /de ltar dpa' bos rigs rim gyis/ /zla ba gcig ni yang dag spyad / /sngags kyi nus pa sgrub pa pos/ /'gro ba thams cad dgug 9 par bya / /dpa' pos cho ga snga ma yis/ /'dod pas bsten tshan thob par 'gyur/ /sa steng 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bzhin/ /dpal ldan skal pa bzang por 'gyur//sgrub po mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /yid 'ong 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /dpal he ru ku'i nges par brjod pa las rigs lnga po dbang du bya ba dang / phyag rgya chen po bsten pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas las kyi mchog rab ni/ /gang gis shes na sgrub pa pos/ /dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba dang / /gsad 5dang bskrad pa la sogs dang / /rmugs dang rings par bya ba dang / /rmongs dang de bzhin phur bus gdab/ /tshig 'phrog lkugs par 'gyur ba dang / /'on dang de bzhin long ba dang / /ma ning nyid du bya ba dang / /gzugs ni yongs su 'gyur ba ste/ /las chen bcu gnyis 'di dag ni/ /rtag tu sgrub pa po yis bsgrub / /dngos grub sgrub pa po la ni/ /dran pa 'grub 'gyur gdon mi za/ /thams cad bla ma'i gnas la sogs / /mkha' 'gro mas ni thams cad khyab/ /ye shes ldan pa'i rang skye gnas /yul dang yul du mngon par skye/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor gtso mo yin/ /de rnams mkha' 'gro ma ru bshad/ /ku lu ta cadang dgon pa tshadang / /siddha'i pa77—668

yul dang grong khyer dbang / /gser gyi gling dang sau rāṣṭa / /de bzhin lha yi khyim dang ni/ /yi dgas grong dang kha ba'i gnas/ / kā 'am la ka yi ciyul / /ka liṅga dang ko sa la/ /tri sha ku no o tre dang / / kā ma rū pa mā la wa —/ /lha mo'i mkhar dang rā ma'i dbang / /go da ba ri mthu ta/ /au can dzā la tshor dang / /pullī —ra ma la ya sogs/ /yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yis / /rnal 'byor ma drug ku lu tar/ /mya ngam 5yul na ma mo rnams/ /siddha'i skeyul na lā ma ste/ /rigs kyi gtso mo na cig rar / / la ka dang so rā mar/ /rigs kyi lha mo rnams yin no/ / yi dgas 7grong dang nags sna chen por/ /mkha' 'gro rū 7tha ka ru bcas/ /kha ba'i ri dang kārtsir ni/ /byis bcas ma ru bshad pa ste/ / pāñtsa la yi g.yul dag na/ /khyim gyi lha mo :ka liṅgaraci/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rnams yin no/ /ko sa lar ni sha za ba/ / yi dgas sagrong du de bzhin dus/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sbom dbang phyug /rmi sha ku der dum skyes ma/ /bullīr tsom la ya de bzhin/ /gser rir sme sha can rigs skyes/ /bud med stong phrag nyi shu gcig snye /lhag ma gzhan dag ji snyed 0pa/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yi ni/ /'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma yin no/ /he ru ka dpal sbyor ba che/ / de yi dkyil 'khor gtso mo yin/ /mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'dis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro ba kun ni 'di yis khyab/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dam tshig 'di/ /sprul pa sgom pa nyid yin te/ /bsam gtan la sogs gang ci'ang —rung / /sa steng gan ni rdzogs 'gyur ba'o/ /g.yon gyi spyod pa gcer bu yis / /mtshan mo rtag tu 77—669

mnyam bzhag pas/ /skyes pa'am gal te g.yon pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dpa' bo 'gro/ /phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /rang byung 4rtag tu mchod na ni /ma lus lus pa med grub cing / /g.yon pa'i mchod pa la rab 'jug /dpal he ru lde'i nges par brjod pa las yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig go // //de nas dpa' bo me tog chu/ /'thungs nas sngags 'di rjes dran bya/ /rtag tu 'di ltar bya ba nyid/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub pa pos/ /mtshan mo rtag tu sha bza' ba/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis lan gsum bsngags( / /myur du bde ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /'thungs dang de bzhin byin pa dang / /reg nas bzhag na gtso mo che/ /bden pas tshangs par spyod pa dang / /thog mthar bzhad pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /blta ba'i bsnyems pa drags ( ldan pa/ /mtshan mo'ang de bzhin nyin mo ni/ /'dis ni bzhad pa dag ritu bya/ /gzugs dang las kyi gsang ba gang / /ji ltar gnas pa dpa' bo nyon/ /rtag tu de yi tshomachi ma 'byung / /dad pas de yi spu yang ldang / /rdo rje la ni 'gom mi byed/ /de bzhin gcer bur mchod pa ste/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi rim pa nyid/ /dbugs 'byin skul dang rgod pa dang / /sgeg pa'i gar ni ngo mtshar bas/ /sna tshogs gang dag mdun byed cing / /phyag rgya sngags ni rjes dran bya/ /ha ha he he rnam brgyad bzhad/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug mchog tu dga'/ /hā hā zhes bya 'di nye babar/ /rtag tu mchi ma 'byung ba dang / /de nyid kyis de dgar 'gyur zhing / /bsam gtan gyi sngags 77—670

legs par sbyor/ /gtso mo rnams dang dpa' bo ni// /spu ldang ba dang lhan cig bde/ /rdo je 'gom par mi bya ba/ /g.yon pas yongs su brtags pa yin//dpal he ru na'i nges par brjod pa las bzhan pa'i sngags dang mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs kyi sgyu ma'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas spyan ras gzigs ribashad de/ /dpa' bo dang ni gnyis med mi/ /gnas kyi dbye ba cho ga shes/ /sgom ri la rtag tu mngon dga' ba'o / /lam gyi bzhi mdo 'am khyim dag gam/ /dpa' bo'i gnas dang ri bor ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis dam tshig gnas/ /ring po nas kyang gzigs par 'gyur/ /phyag rgyas rigacer bur ji mchod pa yi/ /lag pas go 'phang dam pa ste/ /gos nyid kyis ni bkab 7pa'am gzhan/ /'dod pa rnams kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin skra 3 grol gtsor gyur pas/ /las rnams thams cad brtsam tshapar bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang de bzhin gzhan/ /phyogs bcing bar ni 'jug pa yis/ /lha dang lha yi mtshogs kyis kyang / /ma mthong bar ni mchod par gyis/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang ste/ /mkha' la spyod la gyen du 'thor / /me tog de dag ma lhung zhing / /me tog sa la ma mthong na/ /gnas kyi khyad par la gnas dang / /mkha' la 'gro ba stong phrag gi/ /gnas la dbang ni byed par 'gyur/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ma rnams dang / /ngag gi dbang phyug 'gugs par 'gyur/ /lha dang lha yi mgatam shes shing / /rim pa ji lta bzhin du'o/ /skar ma'i rgyu ba shes par 'gyur/ /grong dang grong rdal rshade bzhin dgon/ /grong khyer dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /shing gcig dang ni dpa' bo'i khyim/ /ri rtse dang ni mtshan 77—671

drung du/ /snying po'am nye snying rtag dran na/ /lha dang mi yis mthong mi 'gyur/ /de bas yul phyogs 'di dag tu/ /sgrub pa po ni rtag tu gnas/ /yi ge bdun gyi bdag nyid can/ /shing rtser kha dog dmar bsams nas/ /myur du lhung ba mi phyed par/ /sa rnams kyang ni gzhan du min/ /bdag gi lus la rnam ( bkod de/ /sa la ku sha'i stan du nyal/ /yi ge bdun gyis bdag nyid sngags/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni nyid du bzlas/ /mi lam du ni bya ba kun/ /yid la 'dod pa ston par 'gyur/ /dus min 'chi dang bcom dang nyams/ /bya ba kun tu gang gyur dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan dag kyang / /thams cad mi lam dag tu ston /de bzhin sngags bzlas ral gri chu/ /mthe bo samar me me long la /sngags pa bdag nyid rtag rnal 'byor/ /pra se na ni 'bebs par byed/ /bsgoms nas lan bdun bzlas brjod pas/ /dge dang mi dge ston par 'gyur//de nas dpa' bo'i yi ge bdun/ /sngags dgod dbye ba nyid kyis te/ /nyi ma'i dbus su bsams nas ni/ /stong gi bar du bzla bar gebya/ /shel gyi rnam pa lta bur ni/ /nad kyis gdungs la bstan par bya/ /mthong ba tsam gyi mod la ni/ /nad kun 'jig par the tshom med/ /nad las rnam par grol 'gyur rin/ /ston ga'i dus kyi /zla ba 'dra/ /zla ba'i dbus su rnam bkod cing / /lag pa g.yon par 'khor lo nyid/ /yi ge shel gyi mdog ltar snang / /nad rnams kun la dgod par bya/ /rims dang gdon sogs brjed byed dang / /gzer sogs kun dang mdze can dang / /dug gis zin sogs nad rnams dang / /nad kun the tshom med par ni/ /zla gzugs yi ge bsams nas ni/ /phyogs bcur rnam par 'byer bar 'gyur/ /mtshan mo gsang ba la gnas te/ /go 77—672

māng 3)sa ni mngar gsum btags/ /yig bdun gsang sngags shes pa dang / /stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg ( byas/ /sngags pa nang par dus su ni/ /gser srang stong ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg ristong phrag bcu yis ni/ /yul 'khor dam pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /yang na gsang sngags rgyal po ni/ /gnas ni gang du bsams ci pa dang / /de dang der ni de yi tshe/ /skye bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za / /dkar po yis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /nag pos skad cig dag gis gsod / /dmar pos dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ /'phral du nges par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /ser pos thams cad gnon 'gyur te/ /'di ni bstan bcos nges pa yin/ /ser pos dpung ni gnon pa dang / /gru dang 'khrul 'khor glang po gnon/ /dkar po bsams pa tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba nges par slong /bar 'gyur/ /sbrul chen brgya 7yis zin pa ni/ /de yang myur du slong bar byed/ /dug gis brgyal stub rnams mthong nas/ /rab tu sad pas sad par 'gyur/ /rims dang gdon dang brjed 7byed ni/ /lag pa mthong bas 'jigs par 'gyur/ / rgyan po g.yul du khu tshur bcings/ /yid la rtag tu zlos byed na/ /khu tshur ma bkrol pade srid du/ /bya ba thams cad bsgrub 4par 'gyur/ /dgra bo gal te lag na ni/ /mtshon cha 'phyar bar byed pa yang / /ji srid khu tshur ma bkrol 7bar / /mtshon cha gtong bar mi nus so/ /gzhan yang bya ba thams cad ni/ /de bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed/ /'bras bu me tog 'dab ma dang / /so rtsi de bzhin zas rnams la/ /lus kyi sbyor ba dang po ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa nus pa yin / /gsum pa dag ni ngag nyid dom/ /bzhi pa dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /sngags kyi rgyal pos 'grub par 'gyur/ /sa gzhi shing dang bcas pa /shā /673/rgya

mtsho ska rags /btags de la/ /'dir ni 'grub par the tshom med/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu'i bar/ /dmod ri'adebs phan 'dogs nus pa yin/ /dpal ho ru ma'i nges par brjod pa las nye ba'i snying po'i las sgrub pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas pho nya la brten cite/ /yi ge bdun pa dang ldan pa/ /gang du las la yang dag brtsams/ / de yi mod la myur du 'grub/ /yi ge bdun pa'i cho ga yis/ /rnal 'byor ma drug rnam par dgod/ /'khor lor legs par gnas pa drug /rnam pa de lta'i cho ga yi / /g.yon pa nyid du bskul dang bcas/ /gang gis gzung 'dzin bsams nas ni/ /kha nas gsang sngags rgyal po zlos/ /gang la lag pa de bstan pa/ /de ni nges par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /tsandan dmar po'i rdul dang ni/ /de bzhin ske tshe lan tshwa dang / /bsgrub ci par bya ba'i rkang rjes la/ /gcig tu byas nas brtag ri par bya/ /lag pa gnyis kyis mnyes nas ni/ /rnal 'byor ma la sbyin sreg /bya/ /mtshan mo sme 7sha can me 'am/ /dur khrod me la phye ma bsreg /bsgrub par bya la mngon phyogs te/ /sbyor ba 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /ji srid brgya yi 5bar du bzlas/ /des ni nges par 'gugs par 'gyur / /bsgrub par bya ba'i bdag nyid dang / /nor dang skye bo dbang du 'gyur/ /sbyor ba 'di ni grub pa ste/ /gzhan du na ni nga mi smra/ /rdul de nyid ni blangs nas su/ /lcags phye dang ni rnam par bsres/ /dur khrod ras la btums cinas ni/ /lan bdun bzlas la bzhi mdo ru/ /sor brgyad tsam du sa bskos lapa/ /dgra yi ming dang bcas par ni/ /gang gi ming smos 77—674

sbas gyur ༅pa/ /de ni myur du gnon ci par 'gyur/ /phye ma de nyid bzlas nas su / /'bad de ba yi 'o ma yis/ /de ni slar yang gsos gyur na/ /'grub pa nyid du the tshom med/ /phye ma de ni blangs nas ni/ /myos byed lnga dang ldan pa ru / /de ni dur khrod ras kyis bcing / /dgra yi riming yang bri bar bya/ /bzlas brjod lan brgya byas nas ni/ /dur khrod du ni nges sbas na/ /bsgrub bya spyo ba nyid du 'gyur/ /bton pa nyid kyis thar bar 'gyur/ /bton nas ba yi 'o ma yis/ /'bad pas de bzhin bkru bar bya/ /slar yang gso ba de dag ni / /'grub pa nyid du cathe tshom med/ /dpal he ru na'i nges par brjod pa kāṭā/ rnal 'byor ma drug gi yi ge bdun gyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi de nas las kyi rab mchog ni/ /ngag gi dngos grub byed pa'o/ / ka ra bī ra'i me tog dmar/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni blangs nas su/ /'bad de ba yi 'o ma dang /bzlas brjod brgya 0yang bya ba yin/ /lan re bzlas pa'i me tog gis( / /ling ga'i spyi bor bsnun par bya/ /de ltar shin tu mnyam bzhag pas//nyi ma bdun du bya ba yin/ /de nas nyin zhag bcu gcig par/ /me tog dag ni blangs nas su/ /chu bo chen por song nas ni/ /re re nas ni chu la dor/ /de dag thams cad rim tsho bzhin du/ /lan re bzlas nas rab tu bya/ /chu bor me tog tha ma ni/ /rgyun las bzlog ste —rab 'bab na/ /chu dang bcas par blangs nas ni/ /sos ma reg par de 'thungs na/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las byung ba yi/ /sgrub po'i stotshig ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas skye gnas brgya 77—675

bcings la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /sngags pa bsgrub byar mngon phyogs na/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i lto bar gnas/ /de la yin kyi gnas bzhin du//blo ldan thun gsum mthe'u chung bskyod/ /bram ze gsod pa dag gis kyang / /zhag bdun brgya byin sogs nges 'gugs/ /tsandan dmar po'i rdul las ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs byas la/ /tsha ba gsum gyis lus la bsku/ /spra /tshil gyis kyang rab tu byug / sgrub pa po yi migasang gnas su/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis phug nas ni/ /seng ldeng mdag me du med la/ /mkhas pas nyi ma bdun du bsro/ /lan brgya bzlas te bzlas pa'i mthar( ri/ /mi yi bdag po mdun na 'don/ /btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /nges par 'gugs par byed pa yin/ /mi yi bdag po 'khor bcas pa/ /gro ga'i 'dab mar bri bya ba/ /gi wang dag gis bris nas ni/ /ming dang spel nas gang la ni/ /mngon par phyogs te brgya bzlas nas/ /seng ldeng me la de gdungs shing / /dur khrod me steng grub phyir bshad/ /ji srid sru tshil ma zhu'i bar/ /bsros par gyur na rgyal po ni/ /'khor los sgyur dang bcas par yang nges par 'gugs par 'gyur ba yin/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i rkang rjes las/ /tsandan dmar po nyid dang ni/ /dur khrod lhag ma thal bas spyos/ /sgrub /pa po yis gcig bsdus la/ /seng ldeng me ni du med la/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsro bar bya / /rdul de lag pa gnyis kyis ni/ /mnyes nas sbyin sreg byas nas ni/ /ji srid du ni bsregs 1pas 'grub/ /rdul de blangs nas ma yengs par/ /dbugs mi 'byin par sbas na ni/ / brgyal zhing mesems dang bral 'dra la/ / rmongs shing nyon mongs 5pa nyid dang / /rlung gi shugs kyis 'ongs nas ni/ /77—676

sgrub pa po yi steng du lhung / /phyugs sam yang na pho nya mo/ /mkhas pa yis ni dbye ba yin/ /de nas las kyi pho nya mor/ /bya ba 'di ni 'dzin pa nyid/ / ka ra bī ri ra'i lhug ma ni/ /rlan bcas dpung pa'i tshad mnyam blangs/ /'bar 'gyur ro bsreg cime la dor/ /ji srid de ni ma tshig pa/ /myur du song ste de blangs la/ /rig ripa lan bdun bzlas nas ni/ /gang zhig bzlas te bskor na ni/ /de ni de yi skad cig la/ /skyes pa'am bud med rang gzugs can/ /rlung gi shugs kyis ci 'ong bar 'gyur/ /ka ra bī ra'i me tog dmar/ /brgya bzlas rgyal gyi 7sbyor ba las/ /sgrub pos gi'u mewang gis byugs la/ /me tog chu la gnas pa la/ /chu bo chen por zhugs nas ni/ /lte ba man chod chur bcug ste/ /lag pa sbyar ba'i dbus gnas la/ /rig pa stong du bzlas nas ni//lag pa gnyis kyis phyer 7brlags ngate/ /chu dang bcas par btung bar bya/ /de nas sgrub pa po de geyis/ /tshig gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'am rgyal po'i chung ma ni/ /yin kyis langes par 'gugs par 'gyur/ /lhar bcas lha min mi rnams ni/ /myur du dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /khros pas tshig gis gsod 'gyur zhing / /dbye dang bskrad pa nyid kyang byed/ /sgrub pa po yi 〉tshig nyid kyis/ /tshar gcod par ni byed par 'gyur/ /tshig tsam gyis ni chu bo dzodang / /shing rta 'khrul 'khor rgya mtsho dang / /glang po rta dang de bzhin sprin/ /skyes bu'am yang na bya yang gnon/ /yid kyis yid la gang 'dod pa/ /tshig gis thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /dgug pa yi ri ni sbyor ba dag /bud med thams cad rmongs byed pa/ / ka ra gri ra'i me tog ni/ /dmar po yang dag blangs nas su/ /rig pa lan brgya bzlas pa dag /skye 77—677

gnas dbus su gzhug par bya/ /me tog de ni kha sbyar byas/ /gsang ba'i gnas su nges par sbyar/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor ldan/ /sngags pas brgya phrag gcig /tu bzlas/ /skye gnas dbus kyi me tog de( ri/ /sgrub pa po yis gcig blangs la/ /me tog gis rini gang bsnun pa/ /de3 mod la dbang du 'gyur /brgyal cazhing sems dang bral ba dang ri/ /yan lag tshigs kun gzhan dbang ste/ /mngon 'gyur sems ni zlog pa ru/ /skad cig gis ri tshoni dbang du byed/ /'di ni yid ches dngos grub ste/ /don yod dbang du byed pa yin / /dpal he ru ku'i nges par brjod pa las rnal 'byor ma drug dang tshig gi dngos grub lung bstan pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas yi ge ha lnga ni/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub rab 'jug pa'o/ / ha ho ho lha ཿhaḥ4yi ge ha lnga lag dzopa yis/ /bskul dang ldan pas mnyes na 7ni/ /kha nas kyang ni khrag 'dzag cing / /dgra bo de yi 7mod la 'chi/ /rang gi khrag ni thod gnas pa/ /srin lag gis khrag mnye bar bya/ /ji srid skams 7kyi bar du ste/ /des ni bsgrub dbya rnam par 'jig /gal te khro bo pa'abar ba dang / /mig dmar ba yis bzlas na ni/ /dpung tshogs bzhon 7par bcas pa yi7/ /rgyal po myur du 'chi bar byed/ /byi la dang ni ne'u le dang / /khā dang wa dang chu skyar ni /mkha' 'gro ma la stobs can sbyar/ /'di dag myur du 'grub skuyin par/ /rgyud 'di la ni the tshom 7med/ /ri bong la sogs gyis las ni/ /srad bu byas te lan stong bzlas/ /gang gi mu mgul du bcings gyur pa/ /de ni de dang 'dra 77—678

bar 'gyur/ /lag par bzlas brjod stong byas te/ / ka ra bī myura'i me tog dang / /yi ge re re mngon bzlas la/ /sbrum ma la ni reg gyur na/ /mngal ni rnam par 'pho 'gyur te/ /gtang na thar bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang la sdigs mdzub 0byas te 'chi/ /slar yang 'tsho bar byed pa yin/ /dpal he zlo / / /sa par brjod pa las yi ge ha lnga'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi snying po ste/ /'di ni brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /dngos grub thams cad skyed byed yin/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i rig pa chen po bzlas na rigs thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas pas ni dpal chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /mi rus kyi rgyu la phur bu sor drug pa byas la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas nas gang gi sgor sbas pa de'i rigs rgyud rnams gcod par 'gyur ro/ /zhing dang ra ba dang ma nye dang glang po che dang / rta'i gnas su bskos te sbas na thams cad brlag ri par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po'am rgyal po'i blon po dbang du bya bar 'dod na rgyal po'i sgor sa las cibyas pa'i gzugs brnyan sor brgyad pa byas tsho la mkhas pas bzhag nas nyin zhag dang po la ma tu lung ga'i tshame tog dang 'bras bu rnams dang ku 7su ma bsres pas sbyin sreg brgya stong byas na de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis dgug pa dang / gnon pa dang /skems papa dang / thongs pa dang / mugs pa dang 5/ tshig 'phrog pa dang /long bar byed pa dang / dig tshapa nyid dang / slar gtong bar byed do/ /de 77—679

nas skyes pa bud med du bya bar 'dod na skyes pa'i ro'i me tog dang / ka ga an di ma'i 'bras bu dang / khu'i sen mo dang / rkang pa'i 'og gi pags ri pa cha mnyam par byas la ri bong gi khrag dang btags te/ ril bu ribacu gcig byas la grib ma la skam mo/ /de bzhin du zhag bzang po la lag pa la ci bcings te nyi ma bcu gnyis pa la gang gi spyi bor phye ma bzhag pa de bud med du 'gyur ro /de nas skyes pa khyir bya bar 'dod na rgyal gyi lcags ne'u le'i mgo bor bzhag la mtshan mo bdun gyi bar du brgya stong sbyin sreg byas la nyin zhag brgyad pa la gur kum dang / mnyam por sbyar te lan brgya 9rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas nas phye ma'i sbyin sreg —byas la de'i thal ba gang gi spyi bor bzhag pa de khyir 'gyur ro/ /slar gso ba ni mtshan mo'i dus su mkha' 'gro ma rnams la mchod pa chen po byas te/ gtor ma byin na de'i 'og tu rnal tshamar 'gyur ro/ /rdzas rdzas ma yin par bya bar 'dod na/ gsor shing gi ma'abras bu sbyin sreg lkebargya rtsa brgyad byas na rdzas ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /a ru ra'i sbyin sreg 7byas na rnal mar 'gyur ro/ /de nas smyo bar bya bar 'dod na bya chen po'i gnas kyi sbyin sreg —byas na nyi ma bdun pa la smyo bar 'gyur ro/ /slar bzlog pa ni 'bras kyi phub ma'i sbyin sreg cibyas na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /byi la'i spu zla ba gzas zin pa'i tshe bsdus la gang gi ming nas smos nas sngags kyi sbyin sreg 7byas nas thal ba de gang gi spyi bor bzhag pa de byi lar 'gyur ro/ /slar bzlas na rnal mar 'gyur ro /bya rog gi rgyus pa la srad bu byas pa bzung la mngon par bzlas te gang gi mgul du bcings pa de bya rog tu 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang gi rgyus pas srad bu byas pa la mngon par bzlas te mgul du bcings pa de de dang 'dra bar 77—680

'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du /khu dang thi ba dang rma bya dang chu skyar dang / 'ug pa dang —/ khra dang bya rgod kyi gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ba lang gi spu las srad bu byas la lan brgyad brgya bzlas brjod byas te mgul du bcings na de ba lang du 'gyur ro/ /rkang bzhi pa la sogs pa gang dang gang gi spu las srad bu byas la mngon par bzlas te mgul du btags na de de'i gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /bkrol na thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras so ba la bzlas la nor gyi bdag po chen po'i khyim du bcug la lhag mas bdag nyid dbang bskur na mtshan bdun gyis so ba thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /dpal ho ru ku'i nges par brjod pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags kyi las thams cad kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi dge ba gang / /snying po rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /'dod don 0thams cad sgrub byed pa'o/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po g.yo byed cing / /rjes su dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /yang dag dngos grub rim gyis so/ /hā gu ṭapha hūṃ lhu ye gri tsho) chab dzrab —ye rī ki spre )bu rbas oṃ/ sngags 'di bklags 5pas 'grub lkepa ste/ /las rnams kun byed dge ba yin/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / khaṇḍa ro ha chos ma sogs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad kyi/ /sngags ni 'di nyid yin par grags/ /sa 'og yang na mtho ris sam/ /de bzhin mi yul dag tu yang / /las ni gang dag yod pa dag /sngags kyis de dag thams cad bsgrubaskya/ /dngos grub kun byed dge ba yin/ /dngos grub thams cad 77—681

rab stsol ba/ /'di las shin tu mchog gyur med/ /'jig rten gsum na ci yang med/ /gang phyir 'di ni bla na /med / /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed yin / /mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /mdor bshad rgyas par ma yin no/ /me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis / /ri bo bzang po bri bya zhing / / de yi ru snyisteng du rtag bsgom pa/ /mkha' 'gro de bzhin lā ma dang / /khaṇḍa ro ha ci rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' bo nyid/ /ha ha he nye zhes bya ba/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde mchog yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam snang mdzad/ /de bzhin padma gar dbang dang / /shrī he ru ka nyid dang ni / /mkha' snying dang ni rta mgrin /nyid/ /rin chen rdo rje stobs po che/ /mig mi bzang dang 'jigs byed dang / /rdo rje bzang dang rab bzang dang / /rdo rje rgyu mdzad dpa' chen ngo / /de bzhin rdo rje ral pa can/ /myu gu can dang rdo rje'i lus/ /rdo rje'i 'od ni nyid dag dang / /'od dpag med dang lha yi medagra /de bzhin mche ba rnam gtsigs dang / /keng rus keng rus chen po dang /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad khyab/ / dpa' bo 7rnams dang mkha' 'gro nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rab gtum sogs/ /bya ba kun la sgrub pa pos/ /'khor lor bzhugs par blta bar bya/ /grub 'dod shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid rtag tu bsgom / /sngar bshad pa yi mcho ga yis/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde mchog brjod / /'khor lo chen po grub kun gnas/ /de bzhin dngos grub kun gyi gzhi ci/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bye ba dang / /dpa' bo bye bas legs par gsungs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni re re yi/ /'khor ni bye ba dag tu 'gyur//77—682

rnal 'byor ma ni mkha' 'gro nyid/ /gzugs can ma dang dum skyes ma/ /de bzhin lā ma la sogs ni/ /dngos grub kun byed dge ba yin/ /dpal he ru rka'i nges par brjod pa las dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi gnas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /ji bzhin cho gas phyugs bsgrub bya/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'o/ /sngags pas 'bras kyi snye ma las/ /rim 3 bzhin du ni rgyugs gzugs bya/ /mi dang ru sbal rnga mo dang / /bong bu spyang ki chirta la sogs/ /de ltar sna tshogs phag dag ste / /phyugs 'di dag tu shes par bya/ /mtshan nyid ji ltar gyur pa dang / /'di rnams las ni bshad par bya/ /skye ba gcig dang skye ba gnyis/ /gsum mam bzhi 'am lnga nyid dam/ /skye ba drug dang bdun gyur pa/ /phyugs rnams su ni gdon mi za/ /gang gi kha yi ri dri zhim zhing / /mig mi 'dzums ri par rnam par blta/ /bden par smra zhing mthong na dga'/ /rtag tu dam chos dgar 'gyur zhing / /rang gi skye ba shes pa dang / /lus kyi dri ni rtag tu zhim/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag ldan par ni/ /skye ba bdun du 'byung ba yin/ /de ni zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha yi gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /mnams pa'am reg pa tsam gyis sam/ /gang zhig thig le byed pa de / /mod la 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ /'di ni rang dga'i gzugs 'chang 'gyur/ /de yi snying ku'i ro tsa na //mkhas pa yis ni blangs nas ni/ /snying po'i sngags ni bzlas nas su/ / de yi —thig le bya ba yin/ /sems can gang dang gang gi ni/ /gzugs su byed par 77—683

'dod pa na/ /de dang de yi /gzugs su ni/ /thig les 'gyur bar the tshom med /mkhas pas shing lo khu ba ni/ /ro tsa dar bcas blangs nas su/ /dpral bar thig le byas na ni/ /de gzugs 'gyur bar the tsom )med/ /phyugs nyid kyi ni ba spu yis/ /lag pa spyi bor bcing bar bya/ / de yi geyan lag lngar ldan zhing / /de yi spu dang rnam bsres pa / /lag pa spyi bor bcings na ni/ / de yi gzugs 'gyur the tsom /med/ /rnal 'byor pa ni bsgoms shing zlos/ /mi rnams nus pa ldan yin yang / /dka' 7zhing nyon mongs la dga' ba/ /dngos grub lam ni 'gog pa yin/ /glang po rta dang bong bu dang / / ru sbal rnga mo phag dang wa/ /khu dang lug sogs bya rgod dang / /khrung khrung khra dang sa ra la/ /gzugs bzang ba dang gzugs ngan dang / / lha yi rshagazugs su de 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor dpa' chen rang dga'i gzugs/ /skye 'gyur 'di la the tsom 5med/ /'di bas shin tu mchog grub pa/ /'jig rten gsum na yod ma yin/ /dpal he ru na'i nges par brjod tshapa las skye ba bdun sdo/ //ba —par bya ba'i gzugs yongs su brje ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa de nas sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /nges par dbang du byed 'gyur ba/ /yang dag cho ga gang gis ni/ /myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur bshad/ /go māng tshos ni myos byed bsre/ /lag pa g.yon pas sbyin sreg byas/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni dbang 'gyur na/ /phran tshegs mi tshoni smos ci dgos/ /kha chu so shing snyedag dang ni / /de bzhin rang gi lus mnyes cipa/ /myos byed ming gdang bcas pa yis //77—684

khams gsum dag ni 1dbang du 'gyur/ /zla mtshan gyi ni khrag dang ni/ /zos nas rlon pa'i zas dag dang / / mi yi rim dang ldan pa yis/ /mod la 'gugs par 'gyur ba yin/ /rang gi lus las skyugs pa 'am/ /mkhas pas rang spas sbyin sreg ri cibya/ /nim pa'i shing la rab sbyar na / /mod la dbye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mnyam par bzhag pas dha dur me/ /yungs mar tshan der bsgres pa yigaci/ /bya rog gshog pas sbyin sreg 7byas/ /'phral du 'chi ba'am skrod par 'gyur/ /nyal dang ma nyal 'dug pa'am / /zas dang sbyor ba sogs rnams la'ang / /mkhas pas rtag tu zlo byed na/ /de la bgegs ni yod ma yin/ /wa yi sha yis bsregs ngablugs brgyas / /yang dag bsregs cidrugs byed pa'i mi/ /de ni zla ba gsum rjes la/ /rigs kyi dbul ba 'jig tshepar 'gyur/ /sha chen dag gis la la zhig /myos byed ldan pas sbyin sreg —byed/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du ni/ /sgrub pa po ni thun gsum byed/ /ma lus sa rnams spyod pa dang / /zla ba drug gis dbang du 'gyur/ /tshim 'gyur mkha' 'gro ma de la/ /rgyal srid ster bar gdon mi za/ /lha rnams thams cad bsgoms rtsi nas ni/ /thun gnyis bar du sbyin sreg 7byas/ /rang gi lus ni de nyid kyis/ /mkha' la 'gro ba nyid thob 'gyur/ /go mā yu dang sha chang gis/ /phyi dang nang gi sbyin sreg ri bya/ /myur du de yi phulag tu 'gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu 'jug /sngags kyi bzlas brjod mtshan mo bzlas/ /yul 'khor yang ni 'gugs par byed/ /de ltar nyin re byas na snyeni/ /rgyal po nyid du de byed 'gyur/ /'di las cirab mchog gzhan dag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na yod ma yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po rang dgas 'chi/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni 77—685

'dzin cing rol/ / thal ba 4de bzhin pa la sha/ /u dum bā nyar nyid dag ni/ /sbyin sreg 'bum byas myur du ni/ /nor gyi bdag po chen por 'gyur/ /go māng sa dang myos byed bsre/ /rgyal srid 'dod pas sbyin sreg bya / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mnyes nebyas na/ /dbul po nyid du ga la 'gyur/ /go mā ci 7yu ni bsreg byas pas/ /ci bde bar ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /go mā lha yu yi 7sbyin sreg 7gis/ /myur du nor bdag mnyam par 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs gtsang spra med na yang / /bstan pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i tshe dang ku nyam/ / mun mā ṣa 7tsa na na /sbrang rtsi gtsigs ma ske tshe dang / /khyim gyi ta ma la 'dab blangs/ /kha bcing bar ni 'gyur ba yin/ /ci rung spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gang du dga' ba der gnas so/ / de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma yi pas dang gnas/ /nye ru ka dpal rgyu yan lag /thams cad brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid can/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing 'dir 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /smos 6ha ni mngon 'gyur nyid / /nye ba'i cas sbyang dka' ba/ /'dus pa ring du song ba yin/ /nye bar 'dus pa mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /shrī nye ru ka gzhung spyod pa'i / /'di ni nang gi bdag nyid sa/ /pha rol phyin bcu sa rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 5brda yi skad/ /mtho ris sa steng sa 'og tu/ /dpa' bo'i yan lag brtan g.yo'i bdag /pullīr cil sogs gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang tshabadag nyid can du gnas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing / /77—686

thams cad du ni spyan zhal dbu/ /kun tu thos ldan 'jig rten na/ /thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs3)/ /de nas dngos grub bsgrub bya ba/ /bsam gtan ldan pa'i sems kyis te/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i de ( nyid gsungs pa yin/ /dpal nye ru ga'i nges par brjod pa byi dī tādīkā gi sbyin sreg dang gnas la sogs pa'i sa bstan pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /man ngag shin tu rnyed dka' ste/ /dpa' bo'i brda yi ri riskad du ni/ /nga yis rgyud du sbas pa yin/ /gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /shes rab yan lag gur bu dra/ /ā li kā li zhes brjod pa/ /rgyu la sogs stong sngon 'gro ba/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid bsdus pa'i sbyor ldan pa/ /bdud rtsi tshim byed mya ngan 'das/ /lag pa'i mchod pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /go cha chen pos yang dag srung kyi/ /sngags rnams kun gyis mchod par bya/ /de ltar de nyid bcu bzhi ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pa yin / /mi mchog gang zhig kun spyod pa/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam dag bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa 'thob cing / /skye dang skye bar bde gshegs kyi/ /rigs skyes rgyal po chos ldan 'gyur/ /ji ltar sngon bsags sdig pa yitsho/ /mtshan nyid thams cad dman pa ste/ /gang zhig 'di ni rtag sgom tshapa/ /sa la 'dod pa / kun dbang phyug /dper na mar gyis gang ba'i snod / / me yi chadabus su bzhag na ni/ /mar sar steng du zhu 'gyur zhing / /snod kyi dri ma 'jig par 'gyur/ /de bzhin shrī he ru ka yi / /mtshan gyis ci77—687

sdig pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan sems pa ༅tsam gyis sam/ /klog cing kha ton bris pa yis/ /mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur ba'am da yang na 'khor los sgyur ba 'thob / /rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe/ /khrag 'thung dpal sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs glu yi limachod pa yis/ /'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid ri gepar byed/ /de 'dra'i dpa' chen rnal 'byor ma/ /sa stengs na ni rnyed par dka' / /dpal ldan he ru ku'i rgyud chen/ /gang zhig shes nas ma dad pa/ /dbul po sdug bsngal gyis gdungs par/ /de la rtag tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mgul rgyan gdu bu dpung rgyan dang / /rna rgyan tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / /do shal mgo bo'i phreng ba dang / /ske tshorags sil sil sgra sgrogs 7pa/ /ri stengs 7sna tshogs padma yi/ /lte bar a li kā 5li skyes/ /dkar mo bdag po rnam gnon cing — /rdo rje dril bus sku la 'khyud/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i phyed ldan pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs dang / /he ru ka dpal rgyal po che'i/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma'i/ /'khor bcas dbus su sbyor ldan pa/ /thams cad dgyes shing gnyis med 'gyur / /'byin dang sdud par mdzad pa yin/ /mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad de/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis gdul bya bang/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa la/ /gal te mos par ma gyur kyang dzi/ /smod pa dag tu mi bya ste/ /chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya/ /gang gis 'dir bdag yul min pa/ /gang lagis chos nyid mi shes yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas 77—688

dang de'i sras ni/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur tam/ /ma byung na yang rnam kun tu/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i chos nyid ni / /'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin/ /de ltar rnam par bzhag nas kyang — /'jig rten pa kun yong mi smad / /de yi bgrod pa bsam yas shing / /sangs rgyas rol pa bsam mi khyab/ /mdo sde bya ba spyod pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba bzhin/ /dpal he ru na'i nges par brjod pa 'bum pa'i nang nas phyung ba grub pa'i rtog pa rmad du byung ba ngo mtshar dang bcas par byed pa bstan bcos rithams cad kyi rgyal po dpal te ru ka dpa' bo chen po bklags pas 'grub tsho pa gzhan thams cad kyis —mi thub pa gdod nas grub pa'i bla ma yin no7/ /dpal he ru ke'i nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa rdzogs song// //tshagrags pa yid 'ong rgyal mtshan mtho ldan pa'i/ /rin chen dang mtshungs rin chen bzang po yis / /mkhas pa pasgyu —ka ra'i zhal sngar ni/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas kha che'i dpe las bsgyur / /lhag pa'i tshul khrims dri yis bsgos gyur cing / /dri med bka' tshodon 'thad pa dang bcas par/ /rtogs rnapa dang ldan grags pa'i zhal sngar ni/ /sgra sgyur dge slong pradzñā grirnyi dang / /mar pa sgra // rsha tu/dri ni dbang phyug gis/ /mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas yul dbus snyedape

bla ma zhes bya ba/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ a gi dha na utta ra tant+ra nā ma/ bod skad du mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji srid 'gro ba drug gi mthar/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par 'byung ri/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yis ni byed/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga yi cadangos/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor bzhugs/ /'gro ba sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji srid rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun du rtog pas bcings pa gcad / /'jig rten bya ba rab tu 'jug /de srid rtag tu phyag 'tshal bston/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig rin/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje khro bo dang / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogasang ba'i snying po la rnam par bzhugs te/ der 77—708

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad pa bcom ldan 'das thog ma med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' la zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje khro bo dang mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba mngon par brjod pa'i bla ma'i bla ma /snying po ngas bshad kyis /lag na rdo rje khro bo chen po'i bdag po 'khor sna tshogs pas rnam par 'phrul pa rgyas par bshad kyis ( legs par rab tu nyon la yin la zung shig /de la bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te thal mo sbyar ba btud pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /mdor bsdus pa ste rgyas par min/ /dpal ho ru ka yang dag sbyor/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed yin/ /bla ma las kyang bla ma ni/ /mngon par brjod pa'i phyi ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /gsang ba mchog gi tshodagyes tshapa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /'di 7ni rang byung 5bcom ldan dpa'/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom pa yin/ /thog ma med pa'i tshul chen 'di/ /bha gar sid pasgra gzugs skyes gnas/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul yin/ /thog mar chidabus mthar 7dri ma med/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ / srub dang bsrub —par yang dag sbyor/ /gang la de la ji ltar bzhin/ /rang bzhin dag pa 'od gsal ba/ /gsang ba'i gnas las byung ba yin/ /rtag tu nyes bral zhi ba ste/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pa/ /spro dang sdud pa byed pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa tshorang byung —ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bde ba ster/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan ldan pa dang / /sbyor nyid cho ga'i ye shes kyi/ /de dag rgyud 77—709

las gsungs pa dag /gsang ba'i bdag po rab tu nyon/ /dbugs 'byin bar ma mchog dag dang / /dri yi chu dang bcas pa dgas /mkhas pas ril bur ( byas nas ni/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dag la mchod/ /'byung ba'i dus kyi khyad par la/ /pho nyas lhan cig skyes pa 'grub/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste / /mthar thug dngos grub thams cad 'byung / /dga' ba yid la 'dod pa yi /dngos grub kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang rdzas thig les sangs rgyas dang — /byang chub sems dpa' mchod par ci bya/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /rang dang gzhan yang mchod par bya/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur te/ /de ltar 'di la the tshom med/ /rnal 'byor pa nyid bsod nams mchog /dag byed sdig pa 'jig par byed/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan dag pas kyang / /skye ba 'di la dngos grub 'gyur/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dam tshig la 'jug pa'i gsang ba sbas pa bstan pa ste le'u dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings la rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba khro bo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/dngos grub thams cad kyi gsang ba gsungs pa/ chags pa med cing chags pa dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la 'di lta ste/ dpa' bo chen po (cigazugs rdo rje zhes bya ba dang / dpa' bo chen po tshor ba rdo rje zhes bya ba dang / dpa' bo chen po 'du shes rdo rje zhes bya ba dang / dpa' bo chen po 'du byed rdo rje zhes bya 77—710

ba dang / dpa' bo chen po rnam par shes pa rdo rje zhes bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yigatso bo rdo rje dbang rgyug chen po dang —/ dpa' bo chen po gti mug rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po rna ba rdo rje dang — dpa' bo chen po sna rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po chags pa rdo rje dang /dpa' bo chen po phrag dog rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug ces )bya ba'i dpa' bo chen po dang / dpa' bo chen po sa rdo rje dang / dpa' bo zhu chen po chu rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po me rdo rje dang /dpa' bo chen po rlung rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po mkha' dbyings rdo rje dang /'di lta bu la sogs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sa chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas gtugs )pa mtha' yas pa rnam par 'phro ba'i gsang ba'i snying po 'byung bas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs 'dus pa gsang ba gsum gyi dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ dpa' bo chen po rdo rje thod pa'i dum bu dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje keng rus chen po dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje keng rus dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje lha dgra dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje dpag med dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje 'od dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje lus dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje myu gu dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje ral pa can dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje dpa' bo chen po dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje rgyu mdzad dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje rab bzang dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje bzang po dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo je 'jigs byed chen po dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje mig mi bzang dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje stobs po che dang /77—711

dpa' bo chen po rdo rje rin chen dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo je rta mchog dang /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje sna dpal he ru ka chen po dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje sems dpa' dang / 'di lta bu la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig gnyis su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rang gi gsang ba'i dam tshig gsang ba'i bha ga las 'byung ba rnal 'byor ma dang /dpa' bo'i gsang ba'i dam tshig gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i dam tshig chen po gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo snang byed ma zhes bya ba dang /rnal 'byor ma chen mo gsod byed ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'gugs byed ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo padma'i dra ba mo zhes bya ba dang /mkha' 'gro ma chen mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma chen mo rdo rje lā ma zhes bya ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma chen mo rdo rje dum skyes ma zhes bya ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma chen mo rdo rje gzugs can ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo rab gtum ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo gtum mig ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'od ldan ma zhes bya ba dang /rnal 'byor ma chen mo sna chen ma cizhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo dpa' ba'i blo gros ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo mi'u thung ma zhes bya ba 77—71 2

dang rnal 'byor ma chen mo lang ga'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo shing grib ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo sa srung /ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'jigs byed chen mo rizhes bya ba dang — rnal 'byor ma chen mo rlung gi shugs can ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo chang 'thung chom zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo sngo bsangs ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo rab bzang ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo rta rna ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo bya gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'khor lo'i shugs can ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo dum skyes ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo chang 'tshong ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'khor lo'i go cha ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo rab dpa' mo zhes bya ba dang —/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo stobs chen ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'khor los sgyur ma zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo brtson 'grus chen mo zhes bya ba dang / de lta bu la sogs pa sna tshogs pas nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs tshopa/ gar sna chogs byed cing rang gi dam tshig dang 'khyud dzopa dang / tsum pa nas snying rje chen po'i ro yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis gang bar mthong ngo —/ /mthong nas zhugs 5te/ dpa' bo'i mchog rnams kyis skedam tshig rjes su dran no/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje phag mo'i dam tshig gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yang dag par 'byung zhing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyi 77—713

rigs dang gsang ba gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ rdo rje ma mo khu gdong ma zhes bya ba dang —/ rdo rje ma mo lug gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje ma mo khyi gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje ma mo phag gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje ma mo gshin rje bsreg /ma zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje ma mo gshin rje pho nya mo zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje ma mo gshin rje mche ba ma zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje ma mo gshin rje 'joms ma zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta bu'i ma mo'i tshogs kyi phyogs ri thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang ste/ rigs kyi bdag po rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'byung ba dpal he ru ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig chen po rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig yin te/ chos rnams thams cad dngos po med/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rnam spangs pa / /bdag med 7chos las yang dag 'byung ci / /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje go cha zhes bya ba'i rdo rje dam tshig gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang rgyug chen po rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rdo rje he ru ka dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang jig chen po rdo je nyi ma dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rdo rje nurta mchog dang / rigs drug po de ni yan lag drug tsho tu dgod pa ste/ bsrung dhib gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig gi mchog de ni thabs dang shes rab gnyis 7su med pa las byung ngo / /rnal 'byor chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba sbas pa bshad par bya ste/ rdo rje dbang phyug chen mo rdo rje phag mo dang / rdo rje dbang phyug 77—714

chen mo ya mi ni dang / rdo rje dbang rgyug chen mo rmongs byed ma dang / rdo rje dbang rgyug chen mo g.yo byed ma dang / rdo rje dbang phyug chen mo skrag byed ma dang / rdo rje dbang rgyug chen mo tsaṇḍa /ka ste/ 'di lta bus yang nam mkha'i khams dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig yang dag par bsrung ri ba'i sbyor ba'i zugs gsang ba chen po ste/ de lta bu sna tshogs du ma'i rnal 'byor ma rang gi lag pas khrag dron mo mchog gis rimachod pa byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ mos pa mchog gis ci spyi bos gtugs so/ /de nas dam tshig chen po rnam par 'phrul pa rdo rje sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas sems dpa' sna tshogs spros te rgyung nas gdul ba du ma la thabs sna tshogs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings yongs su gang bar byas te/ sna tshogs pas mdun gyi nam mkha' yongs su gang bar mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs sna tshogs pa'i snying rje chen po'i khro bo'i cha lugs 'dzin cing sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/gnyis su med pa'i ro dga' ba sna tshogs kyi cho 'phrul rdul snyed dang mnyam pa bstan te/ khams gsum gyi bdag pos gsungs pa/ chu dang / me dang /rlung dang / dbang chen gyi steng du sna tshogs pa'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab sna tshogs pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i gzi brjid kyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du dpal rdo rje sems dpas chos kyi dbyings las rdo rje khro bo chen po phyung ri nas spros te/ rdo rje chen po'i gzhal yas risang dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyal por tsho)sprul pa la kun tu bzang po chen po byung ste/ rdo rje 'khor dang lhan cig byung nas brtan dzopar bzhugs so/ /phun sum tshogs pa sna tshogs pas brgyan 7pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i 77—715

rgyan gyis spud pa/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i mdog ltar sdug pa/ dril bu dang / rnga yab dang / rgyal mtshan dang / g.yer na'i dra bas mig mangs /ris su bris pa/rdo rje dam tshig gi srad bu chos kyi 'khor lo la 'jug pa'i sgra sgrogs ripa/ sna tshogs pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po chidang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang /grib gnon dang / ma rungs pa dang / shin tu gdug pa dang / ro langs dang —/ ro dang / ro sreg pa dang / khyi dang / ce spyang dang / ce /spyang mo'i sgra sgrogs dzopa/ dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i sgra dze 7dang / a la la'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dril bu dang cang te'u'i sgra sgrogs 7pa/mgo bcad cipa gar byed pas nye bar brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i spyod pa cadapa/ dge ba'i las kyis sgrol stab sems can thams cad la snying rje'i ros phan 'dogs pa/ rnam par 'khor bas bskor ba padma'i gar gyis gar byed cing thal mo sbyor ba/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa lag pa'i thal mo sbyar ba/sangs rgyas thod pa'i dum bu'i chos kyi mchog zab mo'i tshul dang / khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i 'dod pa ston pa/ sku lus chen po 'dzin pa/ zab mo'i sgra sgrogs 7pa / rang gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor can/ mngon par brjod pa'i bla ma chen mo nye bar 'byung ba/ mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa'i rgyal po'i dra ba'i dra ba can/ chos sna tshogs pa'i rjes su bstan pa'i paston pa/ sems can gyi bsam pa sna tshogs kyi bde ba ster zhing ston par byed pa sems dpa' chen po legs so legs so/ /lag na rdo rje legs par nyon cig /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las zhu ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //77—716

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la rdo rje 3gsang ba'i snying po gsungs pa/ snying gar zla ba bsgoms nas ni/ /rdo rje phra mo'i rnam 'phrul ba/ /bde gshegs thams cad gsang ba ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /der ni gsang ba byin brlabs ripa/ /snying po mchog ni legs par nyon/ /bla ma yi yang bla ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud saḥlasab 4dharmā swa bhā ba shud rto3 ha/ tshe shu rgya tā 1 na badzra swa bhā ba ātra ko3 ( ha/ oṃ badzra shud dma ཿsab ngadharmā / badzra shud stohu ha/ oṃ yo ga shud dma sasba dharmā 7yo ga shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ tsā skud lashud tsā sarba dharmā tshwa na shud snahwa ha/ oṃ sa ma 7ya shud saḥ sarba dharmā gyis ma ya shud ho3 ha/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shu n+ya tā a nu rā pa ga ṇa 5badzra swa sgyu ba ādma ko3 ha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra kṛ ta su ci'i shud dhā dharma sgro gtu tsā na rubadzra swa bhā ba ātra ko3 ha/oṃ mant+ra shud ciX hos dharmā mchu shud lhalha ha/ oṃ kro dha shud (ཿ sarba dharmāḥ5kro dha shud stohu ha/ oṃ tsista shud saḥ snyesarba dharmā ci sta gshud stohu ha/ oṃ bā ka 4shud sgyuḥtsosarba dharmā bā ka /shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ tā ya shud jiḥsngosarba dharmāḥ kā ya shud (lha ha/ oṃ sgro na a mṛ ta shud rsāḥ snyesarba dharmā —1 na a pi ta shud holha ha/ oṃ nā nā sa ma ya shud dma sarba dharmā canā nā sa ma g.ya shud stohu ha/oṃ tsārya na lhuya shud dma sarba dharmā rya na ya shud )lha ha/ oṃ tri yo ga pa ri shud saḥ snyesarba dharmā st+ri g.yo ga pa ri shud sgolha ha/ oṃ a gi ṣe —ka shud saḥ sarba dharmā a gi ṣe ka shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ gu gyudza shud saḥstosarba dharmāḥgagu dza shud )lha ha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dwa 5ya gu 5dza badzra swa bhā ba ādma ko3 —77—717

ha / tshe maṇḍal shud saḥ/sarba dharmā ri rimaṇḍal shud rto3 ha/ oṃ a rnyi pa ti shud dma ri sa dharmā cis rnyi pa ti shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ bī (ger shud saḥrtsisarba dharmā 0bī rir shud stohu ha/ oṃ yo gi gri dzishud sa skyasarba dharmā 7yo gi gri 7shud rnyo3 ha/oṃ ta patwa shud sgyuḥ sarba dharmā sta ltata shud rnyo3 ha/ he i ti he twa 7pa ga ta cisarba dharmā 7lha twa pa ga to3 ha/ ru i ti ru kā rā lopa ga taḥms dharmā tso ru kā rā lopa ga to3 laha/ ka i ti na kwa tsi ta hoḥ taḥ chesarba dharmā ho na kwa tsita gyi to3 ri ha/ oṃ dzha ṭi ta ka ci snyer shud saḥtsos dharmā byu dzha ṭi ta ka char shud lha3 ha / oṃ bha 0ba shud saḥ tshosarba dharmā sngo bha ri ba shud rto3 ha/ oṃ dza pa ji shud sa 6sarba dharmā snye dza pa shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ ā hā ri ra shud dma ji sa dharmā ā hā 0ra shud stohu ha/ tshe bha kṣa shud sa gyisarba dharmā ce bha kṣa shud mahwa ha/ oṃ a sa mā 7hi ta shud —8 snyesarba dharmā cis sa mā 5nyi ta dzishud stohu ha/ oṃ swa 7sam be da ce na shud dma gyusarba dharmā gsu gsam be da yun shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ de ṣa dzishud saḥdzisarba dharmā dzi de ṣa 4shud sgolha ha/ oṃ mo ha shud saḥ7sarba dharmā ri mo ha shud rnyo3 ha oṃ rā ga shud saḥ sarba dharmā snarā ga shud stohu ha/ oṃ mā mun shud rsāḥmasarba dharmā mā na shud stohu ha/ oṃ shīrṣa shud saḥ sa dharmā zhirsha 0shud stohu ha/ oṃ kha badzra shud dhā chos dharmāḥ kha badzra shud rto3 ha/ oṃ tri tsakra pa ri shud sa nya sarba dharmā snyi ci tsakra pa ri shud rnyo3 ha/ oṃ ḍā ki gri sku shun saḥ( sarba dharmā cirnga gi gli pa shud stohu ha/ oṃ shasku la shud dma sarba dharmāḥ7(sku ru la shud stohu ha/ oṃ mā tshormi shud saḥ sarba dharmā 7snga tri shud rto3 ha/ oṃ pi tre mashud rsāḥ sarba dharmāX 7pi tre tshashud ho3 ha/ 'di ltar ji srid ༄nye ba'i dur khrod kyi bar thams cad rnam par dag par shes par bya'o/ /pu dza snanga'am go rā de mā 77wa 718

ka ho tri ko ka la ka nyi pre gri so su na si ma ku/ sa bcu rnam par dag pa'i bdag /pha rol phyin bcu'ang de bzhin te/ /shes pa bcu yang rnam dag bdag /bcu po de dag rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo gsum yang yongs dag phyir /nyi shu rtsa bzhi bdag nyid dge/ /dus dang tshod rnams rnam grol bas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi yid dga' ba/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam dag don/ /mngon mtho he ru ka las byung / /mngon brjod rgyud ni bla ma'i bla/ /gsang chen mchog gi dam pa'o/ /g.yon dang g.yas su bskor ba yis/ /dgod cing mchod dang bskor ②bar bya/ /gang gis de nyid shes pa yis/ /brda ni lnga po bstan par bya / /gang yang dbang bskur med pa la/ /gzhan du de nyid ma bstan cig /mngon brjod rgyud la bla ma yis/ /dbang bskur slob ma dag la sbyin/ /gzhan du slob ma smyo ba dang / /brgyal dang rmongs pa dag ri 7tu 'gro/ /mnar med 'jigs pa chen po dang / /ngan pa der ni cing 7 bar 'gyur/ /glegs bam bshes min la ster ba/ /ngan pa de ma thag tu 'chi/ /phol mig rims dang dug dang nad/ /mkha' 'gro gdon gyis gtses par 'gyur/ /mi srun bgegs dang tshogs bdag gis/ /gsod cing dmyal bar snang bar 'gyur/ /ji srid 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma slob mas rim bzhin du/ /de nyid rtag tu sbas nas ni / /myur du sngags kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /bla mas thams cad rim bzhin du / /mngon brjod rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin/ /lha yi rnal 'byor la sbyor ba/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'gyur/ /de ma thag tu byang chub ste/ /mchog ni nges par rnyed par 'gyur/ /mi yi bu mo 'di 'dra spang / /bdag gi dam tshig mi shes shing / /drag cing log lta tsho)rang bzhin ngan/ /mi srun snying rje med pa 77—719

dang — /brkam /chags ser snar ldan pa dang / /spyang zhing ngan la phrag dog can /skyes pa gzhan la chags pa dang / /rnam par rtog pa mang ba rinang / /'di 'dra'i phyag rgya spang bar bya/ /sbyor ba'i dngos grub ring ba yin/ /pukka sī rteni mdzes sdug blang / /gzugs sdug gzhon pas rnam par brgyan/ /sbyor ba la ni gcig tu sems/ /brtul zhugs brtan zhing dam tshig shes/ /dpa' zhing chags bral ngo tsha med/ /nga rgyal med cing ser sna med/ /sngags pa rang gi spyod pa ste/ /rig ma brtul zhugs khyod kyis long / /phyag rgya lnga ni rtag tu 'chang /mgo la thod pa'i rgyan yang byas/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /thal ba'i rdul gyis rnam par byugs/ /rtag tu ma hā māṃ mas bza' thams cad btung bas myos pa dang / /ro yi gdan la 'dug pa dang / /pags dzopa chen po gos su gyon/ /rjes su mthun 7pa'i bza' ba za/ /zhag dang khrag gis tshim pa dang / /grong ngam dgon pa dag 7tu yang / /gang zhig yul du 'gro ba na /rtag tu chags pas mi gnas shing / /rtag tu dur khrod spyod byed la/ /yang na tshong 'dus gnas pa dang / /nyan thos 'jig rten skal med pa'i/ /mi shes gti mug gis khyab pa/ /nyan thos yongs su longs spyod pa'i/ /gtsug lag khang du gnas mi bya/ /ji ltar skyes bu dbul po bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gnas/ /rdo rje gar gyis rnam par rol/ /rtag tu dur khrod la gnas shing / /dri chen sha chen zas su bza'/ /myos byed btung bar ldan pa yi / /dpa' ba'i gtso bos rtse gcig pa'i/ /sems kyis rab tu bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po ma rnyed na/ /g.yeng ba thams cad rnam spangs pa'i/ /de ni ye shes 'byung gnas te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin las byung ske/ /gzung dang 77—720

'dzin 43pa mi dmigs pa'i/ /gnyis su med pa nyid la gnas/ /rtse gcig sems ni byas nas kyang / /bsgom pa'i spyod pa la gnas na/ /bde la dga' ba'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga'i rim/ /phyag rgya che dang nges par rol/ /sgom pa mngon du gyur pa yis/ /rnam grol sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /skye ba ri'adi la dngos grub 'gyur/ /g.yon pa'i spyod pa shes rab ste / /g.yas pa de bzhin thabs yin no/ /sgom par ldan pa'i mthu stobs ni/ /sum cu'i dbang phyug la dbang byed/ /rnal 'byor ma ni dngos grub dang / /gnod sbyin klu yi bu mo dang / /gzhan yang sna tshogs dri za mo/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod dag la spyod/ /de nyid gsang ba'i mchog gyur pa/ / ā li kā 4li rtag tu bsgom/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad de bzhin rnam par brtag /dpa' bos brda rnams bstan pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lag g.yon gyis / /brda ri rnams la ni 'jug par bya/ /dpa' bo'i gnas su gyur pa 'di/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro kun g.yon las byung ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mthe bong nyid/ /mdzub mor rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs/ /gung mor padma gar dbang gnas/ /srin lag dpa' bo dngos grub can/ /tha ma la ni mi zad sku/ /sen mo'i ngos la rta mgrin gnas/ /g.yon pa'i rgyu las byung ba ni / /dpa' bo thams cad yin par bshad/ /lag mthil pho nya 'dus pa'i mchog /rgyab tu shin tu nges byas te/ /brda ni lnga po bstan par bya/ /sgrub pa po yis shes par gyis / /sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ / chu khams mā ma tī ru bshad/ /5me ni gos dkar mo ru bshad/ /rlung ni sgrol ma dag tu grags/ /'o byed ma ni stong pa ste/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa yin/ /dbus kyi 77—721

dpa' bo thams cad ni/ /mkhas pas rgyab tu gshegs su gsol/ /gsang ba 'di ni mi bstan zhing / /rab tu 'bad de sba bar bya/ /de ltar brda yis dpa' bo rnams/ /de dang lhan cig bza' ba ri bza'/ /dpa' bos thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde mchog yin/ /phan tshun rjes 'gro thams cad kyi/ /sna tshogs brda ni bshad par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi mtshan nyid dang / /pho nya rnams kyi mtshan nyid dgal /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir /de dag thams cad bshad par bya/ /ras ris ri gyidang ni sku gzugs dag /'dri 0na de bzhin dam tshig dang / /sku mdog gi ni khyad par gyis/ /gang gis sgrub pa po 'grub pa/ /sna tshogs sngags kyis mdzes pa yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /lha yi dam tshig ri riyid 'ong ba/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sna tshogs mchog /dpa' bo sna tshogs yid 'ong ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ma ni yang dag 'dus/ /mkha' 'gro ma yang yang dag 'dus/ /rang rigs sna tshogs mchog dam pa/ /bla ma brgyud tsho )pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /slob ma la ni phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag po'i las la shin tu mkhas/ /sngags dang rgyud la legs par bslabs / /gzhan yang cho ga'i rim pa dang / /mngon brjod bla ma'i las la mkhas/ /phyugs kyi 7mtshan nyid sngags pas rtog /sna tshogs rigs kyi khyad par dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi spyod pa dang / /mkha' ma'agro ma yang de bzhin te/ /phyi rol ma mo'i phyag rgya dag /phag mo yi ni rigs las byung —/ /dpa' bo kun gyi spyod pa dang / /'khor lo'i spyod pa shin tu bslabs/ /phyi yi narnal 'byor dbang phyug gi/ /mtshan nyid spyod pa dag la mkhas/ /ho ru ka dpal rigs las byung / /dge ba'i spyod pa dag la bslabs/ /yul gyi spyod 77—722

pa'i khyad par dang / /slob dpon spyod pa dag la mkhas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud spyod dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni rgya che ba/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbye ba'i rim/ /thams cad rgyud rnams rnam par shes/ /'grub pa'i lung dang bstan bcos dang / /mdo sde skyes rabs de bzhin te/ /bla na med pa'i spyod pa dag /shes rab pha rol phyin las byung / /phyi rol bstan bcos yongs la mkhas/ /gun sum tshogs pa slob dpon mchog /sbyor ba'i sgom par ldan pa dang /tsho/ /yid gnyis med pa nyid kyis ( ni/ /bza' ba thams cad bza' bar ribya/ /yi ge brgya pas thams cad du/ /gsang sngags brtan par bsgoms nas su/ /rang gi ming dang ldan par ni/ /gcig tu spel nas bzlas par 4bya/ /rtag tu phreng ba'i sngags kyang bzla/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bla ma las kyang bla ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /gsang sngags btus pas go cha ridang / /snying po dang ni nye snying dang / /gsang sngags btus pa rjes su bsrung tsho / /dkyil 'khor shin tu mdzes pa la/ /yi ge'i dkyil 'khor legs bkod nas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams bskyed/ /'di ni gsang sngags thams cad do/ /ma mo rnams kyi dam pa mchog /gsang ba dga' ba sbas pa ste//gsang sngags thams cad bsdus pa yin/ /gsang sngags kun gyi gnas yin no/ /'gro ba 'byung ba'ang ma mos khyab/ /de nyid 'di ni mi bstan te/ /dngos grub 'joms par 'gyur ba yin ci/ /sgom pa 'di ni mchog yin te/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub bla na med/ /skye 'gros 'di ni bsgoms tsam gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang rnyed/ /byams pa'i go cha bgos pa ste/ /snying rje chos kyi go cha yin/ /shes rab mtshon char ldan pa yin/ /nyon mongs bdud ni rnam par 77—723

spangs / /phyir bzlog sgyuchen mos srung ri ba dang / /rdo rje zhal bzhis rnam par mtshan /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /kha sbyar gsum gyi rdo rjes mtshan/ /thams cad mchog gi sung ba che/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /bka' yi 'khor lo srung ba che/ /phur bus bgegs med dngos grub 'gyur/ /srung ba mchog ni 'di dag gi / /sgrub pa po la byang chub stsal/ /rdo rje phur bus ra ba dang / /rdo rje'i sa dang dra ba dang / /steng gi gur dang bla re yis/ /gdug pa'i bdud ni bskrad tshobyas nas/ /mi gsod gsod pa med pa yin/ /gang gis rang sems thul ba yis/ /bdag gi sems ni bcings pa yin/ /gang la gang gis gsod pa yod / /mnyam pa'i sems ni dri yin te/ /gru bzhi pa ni byug / pa yin/ /tsandan dkar po lus yin te/ /mnyam par gnas pa nyid yin no / /me tog bzod pa rnal 'byor pa/ /'bad pas gtor ba yin par bshad/ /rang bzhin dag pa bdug 2pa ste/ /mnyam pa'i sgom pa bdug ṅkapa yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma chen po las de kho na nyid kyi snying po'i don dam pa bstan pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gros de kho na nyid kyi gsang ba gsungs pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mngon brjod rgyud 5ni bla ma'i bla /bla ma brgyud pas bshad pa bzhin/ /phyi rol rnam rtog spangs nas ni/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog dam pa/ /rtog pa med cing dpyod pa med/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /tshes grangs med cing skar ma med/ /bslab pa'i cho laga'ang yod ma yin / /gtsang sbra med cing mi gtsang med/ /77—724

dag pa'i 7bya ba'ang yod ma yin/ /dus dang tshod las rnam par grol/ /dag pa'i spyod pa rnam par spangs/ /rang gi sngags rgyud sbyor ba shes/ /sems can kun gyi don yang byed/ / ri sul chodang ni ri rtse ( dang / /chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dag dang / /shing gcig dang ni dge ba'i gnas/ /ma mo'i khyim mam dur khrod dam/ /sna tshogs dam pa'i sdum ra dang / /lha khang dang ni mchod rten nam / /khyim mam bzhi mdo dag tu ni//sgrub pa po yis sbyor bsgrubs na/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras bu ster/ /gnas ni brtag ci pa byas nas kyang / /yid ni gang du dga' ba der/ /sna tshogs bde mchog dam pa ni/ /de ru bsgrubs na dngos grub 'gyur/ /sems sbyor med pa nyid las ni/ /du mar dbye riba'i bsgoms pa yis/ /ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsis ni / /sa ni byug pa byas nas kyang / /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa yi/ /me tog 'bad pas dgram par bya/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya yid 'ong gdan/ /mnyam par bzhag tshopas rgya cher bya/ /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis 7ni/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa bsgrubasko/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas te/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po bya/ /dge ba bcu yang dmigs nas ni/ /sems can kun gyi don yang bya/ /phyi dang nang du bltas na ni/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa yin/ /byang chub tshogs kyi mchog dam pa/ /sems tsam la ni rab tu gnas/ /rang gi snying ga zlumakha' dkyil du/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas par bsgom/ /de steng de nyid mchog gyur pa/ /ye shes lnga po zhi ba yin/ /sna tshogs 'od zer gsal 7ba yi/ /rnam par 'phro bas kun tu khyab/ /sngon grub pa rnams bskul nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab lapa'ang byed pa yin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni 77—725
