bsgom dga' bas/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni mthong ba yin/ /til gyi gang bu lta bu yi/ /lha dang khro bos khyab par mthong / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /byang chub sems dang bla ma'i gtso/ /lha mo sna tshogs mthong nas ni /bdag gis mchod cing rjed 〉par bya/ /sangs rgyas spros te sprul pa'i tshogs / /khro bo'i rgyal po rnal 'byor mas/ /'gro ba ris drug sems can rnams /sangs rgyas gnas su dgod par byed/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ni kun khyab pa'i/ /mchog de mthong nas bsdus nas su/ /thams cad gsum la skyabs su mchi / /byang chub mthar thug bar du ni/ /sems can ma lus gyur pa rnams / /sangs rgyas go 'phang cade la bzhag /de la sgrub pa pos gsol gdab /dge ba'i las las byung ba la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rmongs pa'i gzugs can nga rgyal dang / /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam dzishes de bzhin no/ / oṃ sum̐ rma dzrī ho : / de ni rnam par snang mdzad dang / /rdo rje nyi ma gar dbang phyug /rdo rje rgyal pos khyab pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog de bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje'o / /mig dang rna ba sna dang ni/ /rtse dang reg pa yin de bzhin / /oṃ sne ṭwāṃ māṃ khaṃ lha / gti mug dang ni zhe sdang dang / /de bzhin phrag dog 'dod chags dang / /ser sna dang ni rmongs pa nyid/ /skye mched dag ni thams cad la/ /dbang phyug rdo rje nyid yin no/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' nyid dag go/ / / rmā rmā dzā ṭwāṃ rsā / snang byed ma dang gsod ma dang / /'gugs byed dang ni gar dbang dang / /padma'i dra ba mo lha'o / /mkha' mnyam nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de ltar sung po khams dang ni/ /77—726

skye mched rnams ni rnal 'byor pas/ /tha mal dngos po'i rang bzhin ni/ /yongs su dag par shes par bya/ /tha mal chos kun yongs dag ste/ /bdag kyang yongs su dag pa yin/ /de nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /sngags kyi sku ru 'gyur ba yis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag /gyur nas/ /sems can kun gyi don yang byed/ /he ru ka yi go 'phang mchog /thob nas sems can ma lus pa/ /'di la 'jog cing 'god par shog / oṃ swa bhā ba ri shud saḥ kyisarba dharmāḥ swa bhā ba ri )shud sto1lha/ lan gsum bar du bzla bar bya/ /dngos med mdun sogs phyogs bcu ru/ /snying po'i phreng ba spro bar bya/ /des na snying po de mthong nas/ /dra ba ra ba de bzhin te/ /rdo rje sa sogs byin gyis brlabazhu / /bla re mda' yi dra ba dang / /rdo rje me ni 'bar bar bskor/ /phyi rol ring nas dgod par bya/ /oṃ me di bhā brdzu bha ba badzra ba na ta snye/ oṃ badzra mā tā ra snye tpa snye/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ra rgyu tpa rgyu/ oṃ badzra bi tā na snye khaṃ snye/ oṃ badzra sha ra dzā la tsā she spyo/ oṃ badzra dzwa lā na lārka 4kyi :/ he ru ka yi bka' 'khor lo/ /gtso bo brgyad po 'bar ba dag /de mthong nas ni legs pa ru/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom tsho/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhi ba ste/ /dag pa'i shel dang zla mdog 'dra/ /phyag rgya che dang mnyam par ldan/ /shes rab skyil krung 〉legs par bzhugs/ /thod pa'i phreng 'dra ldan pa'i dbu/ /mi bskyod pa ni dbu rgyan bzhugs/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /thams cad mtshan mas mtshan pa yin/ /dpe byad kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /rdo rje dril bus legs par 'khyud/ /zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin mdzad cing / /dpa' chen bde ba'i go 'phang bzhugs/ /77—727

dkar zhing ser la ljang khu /ste/ /zhal gdong gnyis po rnam par 'gyur/ /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog /tshul gyis/ /de yi rikhro bo brgyad dag ( caspro/ /rdo rje drag po na lārke / /rdo rje gtsug tor de bzhin de/ /thab tsho sbyor rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / /rdo rje nag po stobs po che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba/ /khro bo 'di dag rnam par dgod/ /sngo zhing ser la de bzhin dmar/ /ljang khu du ba'i mdog can te/ /dkar zhing dag la gur gum mdog /rab 'jigs thod pa'i dbu rgyan cing 7/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /thams cad na 'ira'i rus pa yi/ /rgyan gyis spud 5pa rab tu 'bar/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis ni/ /sna tshogs padma'i 7nang bzhugs shing / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dag /zhabs kyis mnan par rnam par bsam/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /zhags pa lcags kyu mchog kyang 'chang / /thams cad dril bu cang te'u/ /shes rab bde bas legs par 'khyud/ /dmar ser dbu skra dag gis brgyan/ /mche ba rnam dkugatsigs 'jigs pa can/ /stag gi pags mapa gos su mdabasas/ /'jigs pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan can te/ /des ni bdag nyid rgyan 7du byas/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rnam par bsgom/ /khro zhing 'bar la g.yo ba dang / /drag cing 'jigs la rnam par 'gyur/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis legs par brgyan/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /lcags kyu zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ 'chang / /dril bu rdo rje thod pa 'dzin/ /mgo yi do shal sku la 'chang / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i ska skurags can / /gdug pa thams cad zhabs 'og mnan/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam tshapar ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i stodabu rgyan can/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgom 77—728

par bya/ /khro bo gnyis po rnam par bsgom/ /steng du gtsug tor /'khor sgyur te/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par bsgom/ /'og tu rdo rje sa 'og go/ /dkar la sngo ba'i mdog can yin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /'khor lo dang ni mdung 'dzin cing / /zhags pa lcags kyu dril rdo rje/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /phur bu khro bor ribyas nas su/ /de ni phyogs bcur rnam par spro/ /de la bka' lung bsgo ba ni/ /bgegs ni myur du med par gyis / /gsang sngags rjes su dran nas su/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu mnyam par gzugs / /mthe bong sdigs mdzub 4sbyor ba yis/ /phyogs bcu dag tu se gol brdab / /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha snye snye phaṭa/ shar du'o/ /oṃ groṇḍa groṇḍi snye snye phaṭa/byang du'o/ /oṃ gro pa ya gri pa ya : snye phaṭa/ nub tu'o/ /oṃ ā na ya ho bha tshog bā na badzra mu rgyu phaṭa/ lho phyogs su'o/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /bgegs kun gyi ni klad pa la/ /rdo rje phur bus dgod cing mnan / /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog mapa yin/ /oṃ gha snya/ 'i pata ya sgyu ta ya / sarba du bi na tsha phaṭa/ tī la ya gri la ya tshosarba pā paṃ snye 0phaṭa/rgyu rgyu rgyu stobadzra tī la ya badzra dha ra adzñā snyepa ya ti kā ciya bā lartsitta badzra kri la ya snye phaṭa/ phur pa byurdo rje khro bo ru/ /bltas nas yongs su brtag —par bya/ /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog snyepa yis/ /dngos grub rdo rjes brdung bar bya/ /oṃ sngobadzra —muṅga ra badzra tī la ā ko loṭa ya rgyu : phaṭa phaṭa/ mkhas pas rdo rje khro bo'i tshig /gsang sngags tshig ni drag tu bzla/ /oṃ kha badzra lha ka badzra rdu kā ra cibadzra byu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzā na lārka byubadzra snye phaṭa/ oṃ brjo : gaṣa badzra snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra cikuṇḍa li badzra rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra yakṣa badzra rgyu 77—729

phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka rā la badzra ‘/sna phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ma hā ba ril badzra rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gi ṣa rin badzra rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzo: sa ṣa tsakra brti badzra ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sna tā la badzra snye phaṭa/ bka' 'di dag ni bsgrubs ( pa yisari )/ /de ma thag tu bgegs med 'gyur/ /māṃ ri sa rkang dang zhag kha chu/ /shu kra rakta ( )lhan cig sbyar / /rnal 'byor pa yis ril bur kyibyas/ /zos na dngos grub nges par 'gyur / /sngo zhing ser la ljang khu dzhani/ /rdo rje sne mdzad rang byas te/ /ser zhing gnag la ljang khu tshadang / /dud kha 7ser la ser skya dang / /dkar zhing ser la ljang khu cidang / /dmar zhing ser la ljang ba dag /de ltar bzhi ni bdag po bzhin/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan dam tshig can/ /bsgoms pas rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes/ /'di ltar khro bo thams cad kyang / /dam tshig las ni 'gal ma byed/ /'di ltar sna tshogs du ma yi/ /gtso po'i bka' ni blang bar gyis/ /rnal 'byor pa ni pagar gnas pa/ /bgegs rnams thams cad med par mthong —/ /gcer bu'am yang na mi gcer ba'am / /skra tshogrol thal bas yan lag byugs/ /'di skultar ji srid ma ngal bar/ /'khor lo dag gi bzlas pa bya/ /stong pa'i ye shes rdo rje ni/ /dad pas dran zhing mnyam par bzhag /oṃ shu rgya tā tshwa sngon badzra swa bhā ba ādma ko3 rtsa snaha/ /tshe a ni mitta tshwa na badzra swa sgyu ba ātra ko3 hoha/ oṃ a pra ṇi nyi 4ta tsā na badzra swa bhā ba ātpa ko3ha / zig rgyu tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /sems tsam du ni rnam par brtag /'di ni mkha' dang mnyam pa yin / /chos med chos min pa yang med/ /nam mkha' gos pa med pa ltar/ /dngos po med cing dmigs su med/ /gang gi snying gi —kha sbyar dbus gnas gsal/ /phra bar lta ba rang byung myong ba'i sems 'jug pa/ /77—730

khams gsum ma lus gnyis med par ni nyer 'gro ba me/ /gsal ba chos kyi dbyings mchog de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dngos ( po'i g.yo ba rta kun nang du nges sbyor (miba'i/ /ye shes rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i snod gyur pa/ /khams gsum ma lus gnyis med par ni nyer 'gro ba'i/ /mthong ba mkha' dang 'dra bar dri med dpal du gyur/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /chos rjes dran pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos kyi sku ni rang 'byung 'gyur/ /dbus na gsal byed rnam par shes/ /ye shes mchog ni shes rnams kyis / /shin tu bsgoms pa'i goms pa las/ /'bar ba 'di ni the tshom 3med/ /rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi / /thig le gcig pu yi ge med/ /skyes bus de ni bsgoms gyur na/ /ye shes skye bar gyur pa mchog /sems dpa' /rjes dran rnal 'byor gyis/ /sems dpa' rjes su dran par bsgom/ /sems dpa' rjes dran chos kyis ni/ /chos kyi sems dpa' khyad par 'byung / /bdag ni snying rjes phan 'dogs pa/ /smon lam dbang gis mthong ba dang / /mthong nas ji srid 'og tu ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' kun mkhyen dag /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /sngon po yi ni zhal dang bzhi/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam/ /yi ge yo las yang dag 'byung / /sngo ba'i mdog can gzhu lta bu'o/ /rgyal mtshan gyis ni mtshan par 7bsgom/ /dud pa'i phreng ba khyab papar dmigs/ /de yi steng du yi ge ri/ /me yi dkyil 'khor mchog dam pa/ /gru gsum pa la dmar ba'i mdog /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'bar bas khyab/ /nyi ma bye ba 'od mtha' yas/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa skyabasgom par bya/ /de yi steng du chu nyid de/ /yi ge mchog 77—731

las byung ba/ /du sha ra yi mdog 'dra ba/ /skum la 'od zer phreng ba can/ /de yi steng du sa dkyil 'khor/ /lo las byung ba ser po ste/ /zur bzhi pa la rdo rjes mtshan/ /'od zer ser po khyab par 'khrigs/ /rnal 'byor de steng bsgom pa ni/ /ri rab lhun po mchog gyur pa/ /zur bzhi pa la rin chen bzhi/ /rtse mo brgyad kyis rnam par mdzes/ /yi ge sum̐ las legs par byung / /'od zer gzi brjid mchog dam pa'o/ /de yi steng du bsam pa ni/ /rbu ni dkar po las byung ba/ /de steng 'khor lor bcas pa dag /khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par bsam /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis mdzes shing / /ba dan phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /zur gyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis brgyan cing / /phyi yi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /de yi dang du 'khor lo ni/ /brgyad po dkar po'i mdog can la/ /de yi dbus su padma che/ /sna tshogs 'dab /ma brgyad pa la/ /lte ba ge sar gyis khyab pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rig mar bcas/ /dkar po ser po de bzhin te/ /dmar dang ljang khu rizhal bzhi pa/ /zhi zhing rgod dang khro ba dang /rnam par 'gyur ba shin tu 'jigs/ /rdo rje dril bus mnyam par ldan /mdung dang dgra sta cang te'u dang / /gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /tshangs pa'i pags ri pa gos su mnabs / /zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo dag /phyag ni bcu gnyis de bzhin te/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs/ /dbu rgyan thod pa'i cod pan can/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /dpe tsho byad mtshan dang yang dag ldan/ /bugs kyi ye shes dam tshig can/ /cod pan 77—732

rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/ /ji ltar thabs bzhin shes rab de/ /phyag rgya lnga po byin gyis brlabs ci/ /rigs kyi dbye bas phye nas ni/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mchog /bde ba chen po'i thabs sbyor bas/ /sku ni gnyis su med par thim/ /mnyam pa nyid las byung ba'i sku/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'khor ni dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang bcas par byung / /g.yas bskum snyegayon brkyang tshul gyis bzhugs / /dkar sngo ser dmar zhal mdog ste/ /'khor lo dril bus 'khyud cipa'i phyag /sngar gyi rdo rje sems sogs pa'i/ /phyag mtshan rim pa 'dzin pa yin / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan dang ni/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba rlon pas spud/ /zla ba phyed pa rab 'dzin pa/ /zhal bzhi mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum phyag ni thobacu gnyis pa/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha zhabs kyis gnon pa na cira'i rus pa'i rgyan can/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ phyag rgya /drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags tshapa bgos pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas pang 7du 'khyud pa/ sku la thod pa dang gdug pa la rigs mdzub kyis zu'akhor lo 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis 'khril ba/ bde ba dang dgyes pas myos pa/ khams dang gung po dang / skye mched rnams byin gyis brlabs te sa'i khams ni lo ste snang byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams ni mi ste gsod —byed mtho/ /me'i khams ni re ste 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams ni yi ste gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams ni khaṃ ste padma'i dra ba ma'o/ /ser ba dang / sngo ba dang / dmar ba dang / dud kha skadang / sngo ba'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad / oṃ mdog dkar po/ tshor ba'i sung po rdo rje rin chen te i gser btso —ma'i mdog lta bu/ 'du shes gli 5ste 77—733

padma gar gyi dbang rgyug dmar po/ 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po ste yo ho ljang khuca /rnam par shes pa rdo rje sems dpa' ste mi dkar po'o ri/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid ni dpal nye ru ka geste hi mdog nag po/ mig bye ste gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ rna ba snye ste )zhe snang rdo rje nag po'o/ /sna ni khaṃ phrag dog rdo rje ste ser po'o/ /ngag chags pa rdo rje ste a dmar po'o/ /reg pa ni ser sna rdo rje ste haṃ ljang khu'o / /skye mched thams cad dbang phyug rdo rje ste haṃ dkar po'o/ /lus ni ste dkar po'o/ /ngag ni āX 7ste dmar po'o/ /yid ni oṃ ste sngon po'o/ /de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar byin gyis brlab cing dmigs so/ /de la shar gyi 'dab 7ma'i mkha' 'gro ma ni sku mdog sngon po'o/ /lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la lā ma ni ljang khu 7ste/ sngo sangs miso/ /nub phyogs kyi 'dab skum la dum skyes ma dmar mo/ byang gi 'dab tsham la gzugs can ma gser gyi mdog ser skya zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ phyogs kyi gos 'chang ba/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ 'jigs pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ thod pa dang /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / cang te'u dang / gri gug 'dzin pa/ zhal gdong rjes su chags pas gnas pa/ dgyes pa'i chags pas lta zhing reg pa'o/ /mtshams 7bzhir bdud rtsi lnga'i bum pa'i steng du byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i snod bzhi gzhag skogo/ /shar du pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma nag po/ byang du gri nyaha de ba tā ra rtsordo rje rin chen dang / dum skyes ma ser po / nub tu sau rā ra 5rta mgrin gdang / chang 'tshong lam dmar po'o/ /stor su bar na di hobar dam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ljang 77—734

khu'o/tsho/ /mer tsā cug rar ridapal khrag 'byung dang / rab dpa' mo cadamar po'o/ /bden bral du si ra ri padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen ma ste zla ba dang ser skya'o/ /rlung phyogs na ma rur /rnam par snang mdzad dang /'khor los sgyur 4 ma dud kha'i tshimadog can / dbang ldan du ku lu rshatār 7rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo dkar po'o/ /stobs po che la sogs pa'i dpa' bo ni zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ ral pa'i dbu rgyan 'chang skeb/phyag gnyis la 'khor lo dang dril bus 'khyud pa/ phyag gzhan la kha ṭwāṃ rshag dang cang te'u 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i shugs can ma la sogs 7pa'i lha mo ni gdong gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ thod pa dang / sdigs mdzub 'khor lo 'dzin pas 'khyud 7pa/ spyan gsum pa/ drag po'i gzugs can/ spa grol ba/ gcer bu gnyis su med par sbyor pabar mnyam par gnas pa/ phyogs kyi gos can ma mgrin pa'i nor bu dang —/ gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / rna cha dang tshangs pa'i skud pa dang /mgul rgyan mdang / mgo'i phreng ba dang / g.yer —khas sngo'og pag byas pa/shar dang / byang dang / nub dang / lho'i sgor slo gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma rnams so/ /me dang / bden bral dang / rlung dang dbang ldan du ni gshin rje sreg ma dang /gshin rje'i pho nya mo dang / gshin rje mche ba ma dang / gshin rje 'joms ma rnams so/ /ji ltar mkha' 'gro ma bzhi ni 4khu gdong ma la sogs pa'i dbye ba yang de bzhin no/ /mtshams kyi lha mo gzugs gnyis pa/ yid 'phrog pa'i tshul can/ yi gdags sakyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ drag po chen po thugs rjes sems 77—736

can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /dpa' bo 'di dag thams cad kyang dpral bar 'khor lo'i phreng ba can no/ /'di dag ni sku'i 'khor lo sa 'og na gnas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor la /bzhugs te/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnam pa sna tshogs pa chags pa'i mig gis lta gzhing / sna tshogs ro bcud bde ba ste / /chags pa'i bde ba chen po ni/ /de ring du ni bdag gis rnyed/ /a la la ho dgyes pa che / /bde ba chen po de nyid yin/ /bde gshegs lha ni shin tu mdzes / /glu 'di blangs pa tsam gyis ni/ /dga' bas srid pa dag las grol/ /bde bar gshegs pa dag pa cheri / /dkyil 'khor du ni rnam par brtag /mngal skyes glu yi dbang gyur par/ /rnal 'byor kha cig 'dod pa yin/ /mngal skyes sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bltas nas ni/ /mchod dang bstod pa byas nas gzhug /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par bsgom/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ma nor bar/ /bzlas pa khri 'am 'bum du bzla/ /skye ba can gyi lus grub ste/ /mkha' la spyod par the tshom ci med / /oṃ shrī ka ya/ ḍā ka ru /ru lu sum̐ rgyu phaṭa/ ḍā tshogi gli dzā la sasba raṃ stuswā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ haṃ ho ci rgyu phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ bu spre ska ni cho ro tsa rī ye sgro hūṃ phaṭa gā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ satha bu ḍā ma'i gli ye / snye sum̐ gyi phaṭa swā hā / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ sde tshom hā ba la rtu 7rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ratna 5badzra haṃ 7spyo ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ruro he lalhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ha laya gli bā gli lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇḍi snye'i ye rtu : phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ ā 0kā sha tsog rtu ri rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra wa tī ci ye rtu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ ki li shrī he ru ka ki li rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su ibī re gzu phaṭa/ oṃ si li 77—736

padma narte /tsho ra si li lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nyi li bai ro tsa gri 5gyi li lhu phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warnyi ri'i ye lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li badzra sa ta rnyi li lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bīḥ celhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ kā kra gye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sku lu tā phye ri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sha nā gye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su ka rā ri phye lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ ya ma dā snyi lhu 7 phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dra tī lhu hūṃ phaṭa// oṃ ya ma des nga hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ ya skem ma tha ni brtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tre ki gli 5lhu phaṭa/ oṃ lā me lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa tshar he lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi tī — rgyu phaṭa/ mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma sogs la/ /thog ma padma la gnas nas/ /mchod pa bya zhing sngags kyang bzla/ /rtag tu bdag nyid lnga po dag /'grub par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /zhi ba dang ni dbang nyid dang / /rmongs par bya dang gnon pa dag /sku yi mkha' 'gros byed pa ste/ /dngos grub dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig can dag langs dus su/ /yan lag drug tu bsgom bya ba/ /rnam dag ye shes mig gis ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams blta/ /oṃ ha 5snying ka tshol/na maḥ gyi mgo bo la/ zhwa hā hu spyi gtsug la/ oṃ bo 5 ṭa he go cha'o/ /rghaṃ snye ho mig la'o/ /phaṭa ha yan lag kun gyi mtshon cha'o/ /dkar dang snyeser dang dmar ba —dang / /sngo dang ljang khu sadud kha dang / /yid kyis mdog drug rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ baṃ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma ste lte ba la'o/ /ha layo —ya mi ni ste sku snying ga 4la'o/ / hri oṃ rmongs byed ma ste kha la'o/ /hri spyo g.yo byed ma ci ste mgo bo la'o/ /: rgyu skrag byed ma ste spyi gtsug la'o/ /phaṭa na maḥcitsaṇḍi ka ste yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha'o/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad/ /mkha' 'gro rnams ni bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi lha yi sbyor 77—737

shing mi)/ /ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya/ /rdo rje dam tshig can mchod nas/ /dus bzhi dag tu bsnyen pa bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las sku'i sdom pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor rnams tshubasgoms te / /sngar gyi dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /gsung gi 'khor lo ri rnam par bsgom / /rtsibs brgyad dmar po'i mdog can la/ /nang gi 'dab sam snga ma bzhin / /rdo rje sems dpa' yongs gyur pa'i / /gsung gi mkha' 'gro rternam par bsgom/ / zhal bzhi phyag ni ribacu gnyis pa / /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /padma'i mkha' 'gro mas 'khyud cing / /rtag tu bde ba che la bzhugs/ /padma 7dril bus yang dag 7'khyud/ / dbang phyug chen po'i mgo bsnams shing / /skudabang phyug chen po'i pags 7pa ni/ / bshus pa 'iphyag gnyis kyis brkyang 'dzin / /lhag ma ni snga ma'i rsharim pa bzhin du 'gyur ro / /dbang phyug chen po'i 'khor rnams ni / /zhabs kyis gnon par blta bar bya/ /dmar dang sngo dang tshode bzhin ser/ /g.yon pa dkar ba 7spyan gsum pa/ /ral pa'i dbu rgyan dag gis brgyan / /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la mdzes ba gyed pa 'chang ba dang / / cod pan sna tshogs padmar ldan/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / /'jigs pa'i zhal ni rnam 'gyur zhing / /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /stag gi pags copa gos su mdabs / /mi mgo rlon pa'i zeng ba can/ /mgul rgyan gdu tshabu rna cha dang / / mgo bo'i 7phreng 77—738

bas rnam par brgyan 〉/ /mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug tu rab tu grags/ /de dag pha rol phyin drug ste/ /phyag rgya drug gis /rgyas btab pa'o / /de yi pang gnas ri bcom ldan yum / /padma'i mkha' 'gro ma rang mdog /zhal gcig ciphyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /gcer bu dbu skra ri grol ba ste( / /dum bus brgyan pa'i ska rags can/ / gdug pa'i bdud kyi khrag ldan pa'i/ /thod pa phyag g.yon bsnams pas 'khyud/ /padmar ldan pas phyogs kun tu/ /gdug tshopa kun la sdigs mdzub mdzad / /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /khrag 'dzag pa la rtag tu dgyes / /byin pa gnyis kyis rnam par 'khyud / /bde ba chen po'i thugs rje'i bdag / dngos grub thams cad rab stol ba'i/ /tshamakha' 'gro ma sogs sngar bshad rnams/ /padma'i phyogs kyi gnas su dgod/ /sngar bshad dbyibs dang kha dog paste/ /'od kyang mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo / /dum skyes ma ni de bzhin gnag5 /lha mo gnyis po mdog de bzhin/ /phyag g.yon kha ṭwāṃ thod pa dang / /g.yas na 7cang te'u gri gug 'dzin/ /mtshams ni bzhi po dag tu yang / / bum pa'i nang du 'chi med lnga / /byang chub sems kyi snod kyang gzhag /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar du kā ma rū par myu gu can dang sa srung ma dkar po / byang du lkoder rdo rje ral chapa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo sadamar po / nub tu tri sha ku nir cidapa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma nag po / lho ru ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang nu 'thung ma nam mkha' ltar sngo sangs/ me'i 5phyogs su snyen ling gar rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs ma ser skya / bden bral du lam pa gar 5rdo rje bzang po dang rab bzang ma dkar mo snye/ rlung gi phyogs su na ra 77—739

'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma yi)ljang ku shudabang ldan te genyi ma lar ṭwāṃ rimig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs tshaso/ /gsung gi 'khor lo sa la spyod pa'o/ /myu gu can la sogs pa'i dpa' bo ni zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i skyicod pan dang / dar dpyangs dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis na padma dang dril bus 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag na kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yas na cang te'u/ phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pas bzhugs pa'o/ / e rā ba ti la sogs pa/tsho lha mo rnams ni phyag gnyis pa/ zhal gcig tshopa thod pa dang ldan pas 'khyud cing padma dang ldan pas sdigs mdzub byed 7pa/ mgul rgyan dang gdu bu dang dpung rgyan dang rna rgyan dang mtshangs pa'i skud pa dang ldan pa'o / /thod pa'i phreng bas mgul brgyan cing / /g.yer ka sgra sgrogs sku rags ldan/ /khu gdong la sogs dbye ba yis / /sngar bshad sgo srung pal sogs bzhin/ /gshin rje sreg stosogs lha mo rnams/ /mtshams bzhi 'di ltar shes par bya/ /dpa' bo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /dpral bar 7padma'i phreng / ba can/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams kun / /sku gsung thugs su rnam par brtag /sngar bshad pa yi cho ga bzhin/ /yi ge rnams ni dgod cing bsgom/ /thugs ni āḥste dmar po yin / /gsung ni oṃ ste dkar por bshad/ /rdo rje sku ni ཿ yin te/ /nam mkha' zla ba lta bu'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyang / /thams cad sbyor zhing bsgoms nas su/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /dbang bskur bas ni gzhug par bya/ /thams cad byung ste thim nas su/ /thams cad bsgom zhing bsam par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rim pa yis/ /spro bsdu dag gi spyor

bar bya/ /oṃ shrī bā ka ma ā ro lig /〉 phaṭa/ ha 7 rigi rī dzā la sa ba raṃ ci gā hā / snying po'o/ /oṃ a ro lig sgyuḥ snye phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ padma rnga ki gri ye riḥ rmelhu sne phaṭa zhwa hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba padma spre ki byu rtswa ye a lhu snye phaṭa swā hā / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ 7 tshogi nī ngaye 7lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ lā me lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he rtu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi tī ye 7lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa asku ri ka rtu snye 5phaṭa/ oṃ rā ba tī ye 4lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ da ha badzra dza ṭa li da ha lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bee ra ba 7lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa ma hā bī ra pa tsa lhu snye phaṭa / oṃ bā yu be ge rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bhakṣa badzra snye tā —ra bhakṣa ba sa ru rnyi ra ant+ra cimā lā ba la ne rtu phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhakṣa tshoye lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ gro su bha dra gro sa pā tā la lha gta bhu dzaṅga sa :bā/ tang ya tardza ya rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sgyu ma de bī la phaṭa/ oṃ a lakaḍa —rgya badzra badzra bha dra ā kuḍa rgya :lhu rghaṃ phaṭa/oṃ su bha dre lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ trī dzom hā rtse ra ba 'i lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya na rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ smo tha ru tsosna kṣa ye smo ri lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ kha hā gan ne lhu phaṭa/ oṃ tā kā phye lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ u lu tā gye rulhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ shā gnā gye —rtu sne phaṭa/ oṃ — su tā rā phye 0lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā snyi ye lhu rdu phaṭa/oṃ ya ma dra ti ye ci lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma de: tī ye lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha gli ye mi sne phaṭa/ rdo rje dam tshig gis rimachod nas/ /bzlas pa'i cho ga rab tu bya/ /dgug pa dang ni rgyas pa nyid/ /sna tshogs las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos can yid 'ong gyur pa ste/ /ngag gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur / /mchog dang bar ma thams cad dang / /tha ma thams cad mthar gnas la/ /de la thams cad gnas pa ste/ /sna tshogs gdul ba'i mchog dam 77—741

pa /'dod pa'i chags pas rjes su chags/ /'dod pa'i dga' bas myos pa dag /bdag nyid chen po sgrub pa po/ /de yi dbang du gnas pa yin/ /sna tshogs padma mdzes gnas nas/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnam par spyod/ / kur sna yi'adod chags chos kyi bdag /bde ba che la rnam par bzhugs/ /langs pa'i dus su dam tshig ni/ /dri chen rdo rje chu bza' zhing / /chos kyi phung po rdzogs gyur nas/ /rig pa'i rgyal po la sogs 'grub/ /oṃ haḥsnying ka la/ na maḥhi mgo la/ rig hā hu ca a ro lika chispyi gtsug la/ bo ṣa ṭa he go cha/ snye ho mig la'o/ /phaṭa ha mtshon cha'o/ /chos kyi rdo rje dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang — padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang rdo rje nyi ma dang rta mchog ste/ dmar ba dang / ser ba dang / dkar ba dang / sngo ba dang /dmar ba dang / gur gum gyi mdog dang / ljang khu ste bye brag go/ /oṃ ( padma'i mkha' 'gro ma ste/ lte ba la'o/ / hoḥyo padma ya mi ni dang / dzrī )mo khopadma ཿ rmongs byed ma dang / hro pa'i 7padma chagayo byed ma dang / rgyu ཿ padma skrag byed ma dang 5/ phaṭa phaṭa mnya padma tsaṇḍi ka —ste/ snying ga mdang / mgo dang /spyi gtsug dang / mig dang / chos kyi mtshon cha rnams so/ /dmar ba dang /sngo ba dang / dkar ba dang / ser ba dang / ljang khu dang / dud kha'i mdog can no/ /bzlas pa'i dus su dgod pa ste/ /ji ltar bde bar spyad par bya / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /go 'phang gnas ni bzhugs pa yin/ /mnyam par gzhag ri pas drod 'byung ba/ /rtse gcig dmigs pas blang bya ste/ /gsung gi rdo rje mnyam tshopa nyid/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis / /chos rnams thams cad rab tu brtag /rdo rje chu dang rnam snang dang / /sbrang rtsi mar dkar 77—742

lhan cig sbyar/ /rtse yi dam tshig sbyor ba yis/ /snying po'i /ye shes de nyid do/ /bdag po dbu rgyan la bsgoms la/ /ci bde bar ni bza' ba bza'/ /lha yi gzugs su gyur nas su/ /'dod pa'i lha yi bdag por skye/ /bza' ba 'o ma'i btung ba yis/ /nad dang rga ba rnam par spangs/ /sems can rjes su chags pa yi/ /lha mo glu 'dis bskul ba yis/ /byang chub chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /sems can don ni bla med mdzad/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa yis / /thugs rje bskyed cing bstan par mdzad/ /gsang ba'i chos ni bstan nas kyang / /ngag gi dngos grub mchog kyang 'grub/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji lta bar ni bstan pas grol/ /de nyid rnal 'byor mas bskul nas/ /sna tshogs du ma mang po yi/ /dam tshig mchod pa ngo mtshar med/ /mig phye (snyenas ni bstod mipa ni/ /ā pa ra ta ru su ra ta su khya cahā hā su kha me twa ris gyikhya ma ya/ sa ma ya ra ma ra ma ho/ su ra ta sau ri khya ya tre sa ma tsa ri te / su ga ta shānta ma ya pra bi 7kur ba bi kur ba/ su ra ta di ya padma dza 7le/ pra bi dzim ba dzim ba/ su ra tod stusu la kha mapadma dza lan/ pra bi nan tan ra ta su kha sa da na padma dza pale/ pra bi marda marda sasu ra ta ma bi sa pa'i shwa dza le ho ha : ha ha ho / dza ya ma hā su kha su kha te dze ma ya ra ma ra ma ho/ /su ra ki 7tu su kha ba snye bi ti dhe 7dza mu kra lodza ya te dza ra/ ha na ta ho ba rā 'i ha/ sa su kha ho snye ho ho su ra to twa rā 5ga su kha ra ti rī dzi na pa ra ma shrī ra ti ho/ pa ra ma he tu ma hā su kha ho / su kha ma nu yo na ra pa ra me shwa ra ho/ ho bha ga bān sam hā su khaṃ snye ho / ba rgyu rtso'i ti mtha ti bi sha dzā tshol ra ti bi shwa ma ho/ su ra ti su khaṃ ga tsid tra tshopa ra ma ma hā su kha ho / su kha ma nu gro ri rgyu ho/ su ra ta ud ta cham sa 77—743

na di /su khaṃ a ā ro lika a ma hā su kha gro rtsa ho/ glu ca'adi dag ni blangs tsam gyis/ /dga' zhing bde ba yang dag 'dus/ /bde ba chen po yid 'dod pa / /dngos grub kyang ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /'khor tshogs chen po byin brlabs nas / /dkyil 'khor chen po dgyes pa che/ /padma dra ba'i sdom pa yin/ /mngon zhu par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las gsung gi sdom pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /gzhal yas rtseg ma'i dbus dag tu/ /'khor lo mchog ni dgod par bya/ /sngon po'i mdog can gzi brjid che/ /gsang ba las byung rtsibs brgyad pa/ /de yi dbus su padma ni/ /sna tshogs padma ge sar can/ /'dab tshom brgyad du bshad pa ste/ /rnam dag gdan du byas pa yin/ /de yi dbus su zla ba stobasgom//der ni zla ba khyab par ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /lha mchog grol zhing bzhengs par gyur / /oṃ hūṃ a ma hā su kha a la la ho/ ma hā su ra ta st+waṃ /su ra ta su kha bi yo ga gsu ra tai ud ta ma cibo rnyi su khaṃ/ su kha ma nu sid dha maho/su ra ta ba ya sau lakhya ma ya oṃ aḥ ho / bha ga ṭwāṃ skum hā tshosu khaṃ ud ta ra ud ta ra/ sarba skud ta ma sau khya ma ya hūṃ/ a la la ho/ ma hā su kha st+waṃ/ pa ra ma su khā ma le du bi bi ud ta ma dzā tshol su khaṃ a la la ho/ su ra to sau 5khya ma ya/bcom ldan bde ba chen po ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa samanyam par bzhengs / /thugs kyi 'khor lo zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag bcu gnyis pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i zhabs kyis bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/sngo ba dang / dkar ba dang / ser ba dang / dmar ba'i zhal/ rdo rje dang 77—744

dril bus 'khyud pa/ khyab 'jug gi mgo bo phyag na bsnams pa/ khyab 'jug gi pags /pa zlon pa brkyang nas phyag gzhan gnyis na bsnams pa'o/ /lhag ma sku'i mkha' 'gro dang mtshungs so/ /thod pa'i phreng ba can/ mgo'i phreng ba 'chang ba/ mgo'i phreng bas sku rirags bcings pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ /zla ba phyed pa'i rgyan yang 'chang / /sna tshogs rdo rje cod pan gnon / /stag gi pags pa gos su mnabs / /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan / /mdun gyi mkha' 'gro ma ni zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ri grol ba/ gcer bu dum bus brgyan pa/ ska rags can/phyag g.yon pa thod pa thogs pas 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub can /ska tshorags g.yer ma'i sgra sgrogs —pa/ /chos kyi sgra ni yid 'ong ba/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba bye ba snyed/ /chos kyi dbyings te stong pa yin/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya byed pa yang de bzhin bsgom/ /sbyor ba mchog gi dam pa ste/ /rnam dag legs par brtags nas su/ /mnyam nyid chos kyi ro gcig byas/ /'khor lo la ni rnam par blta/ /shar gyi 'dab tshamar mkha' 'gro dang — /lho phyogs lā ma de bzhin te/ /nub phyogs dum skyes ma dang ni/ /byang phyogs gzugs can ma de bzhin/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang khu'i skumadog can mchog dam pa/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /cang te'u gri gug de bzhin te/ /spyan gsum pa la bzhin rnam sgyur / /gcer bu skra grol 'jigs pa can/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /'dod pa'i chags pas legs par 5myos/ /cung zad ngo tsha'i mig zur dang / /nu ma rab rgyas dga' ba 'dzin/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ /phyag rgya lnga 77—745

yis /rgya yang gdab/ /mtshams bzhi ru ni bum pa dag /ye shes bdud rtsis gang ba dgod/ /de steng byang chub sems kyis rini/ /yongs su gang bar gzhag par bya/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su/ /pu rili ra ma la ya na thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum ma ste dkar po'o/ /byang du dzā la cir na keng rus chen po dang / gtum mig ma ste ser po'o/ /nub tu o ḍi yā na chad keng rus can dang / 'od ldan ma ste dmar po'o/ /lho phyogs su mar bu da na mimache ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste ljang khu'o/ri/ /me'i phyogs na go dā tshab ri na lha dgra dang / dpa' ba'i 7blo gros ma nam mkha'i mdog can mtho /bden bral du rā me dku shwa ra tshan 'od dpag med dang / mi'u mthung ma ste dkar skya'o/ /rlung gi phyogs na de tha ko ṭa man rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang ga'i dbang phyug ma ste ljang khu dang / mu tig lta bu'o/ /dbang ldan na ma la ba rtson rdo rje lus dang / shing grib ma ste padma dang ser skya'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i dpa' bo ni gdong gcig pa phyag bzhi pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can 5thugs rjes khro zhing 'jigs pa rdo rje dang dril bu'i phyag gnyis kyis 7'khyud pa/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis la kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / cang te'u 'chang ba/ phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan 'i pa/g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa sdigs mdzub kyi thod pa 'khyud 7pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ser skya'i gzugs can no/ /spa grol ba/ gzugs gnyis pa gnyis su med par mnyam par ldan pa/ phyogs kyi gos can rnam par rol ba/mgrin pa'i nor bu dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / rna cha dang 77—746

tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / mgul rgyan dang mgo bo'i phreng ba dang g.yer na'i ska ①rags can/ sgo dang zur gyi lha mo rnams/ /khu ri gdong gshin rje sreg la sogs / /ji ltar mkha' 'gro'i mdog bzhin du/ /khu cigadong la sogs de bzhin rna/ /mtshams hūṃ rnams lha mo de bzhin te/ /gzugs gnyis 'dzin zhing gyiyid 'phrog pa'o/ /phyag sogs de ltar bsgoms nas ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /mchod dang bstod dang dbang yang bskur/ /bsgom pa rtse tshogacig byas na ni/ /bdag med ma yi go 'phang 7gnas/ /snying po ye shes dam tshig ni/ /sgrub pos 'dod pa kun gyi phyir / /sku gsung thugs la rnams 7bkod nas/ /sangs rgyas mchog ni rnam par paspro/ /rtag tu dam tshig bskyang mabya zhing / /ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi chu/ /dam tshig mchod pa'i spyor ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas par rshabya/ /oṃ shrī tsista 77 ki sgro dhika a khaṃ rtu sne phaṭa/ 7 —ka gli :dzā la sa ba ra lhu rdu phaṭa /snying po'o/ /oṃ sgyuḥ ha ha lhu snye phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra rnga ki gli rtu rgyu phaṭa / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba ḍā ki gli ye badzra bzla di'i ye lhu snye phaṭa gā hā / snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki rī ye lhu sne 5phaṭa/ oṃ lā same lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he galhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ni lhu snye phaṭa/tshe ka ra tsokhaṇḍa ka pā li na —ka ra rtu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ bra tsaṇḍi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ma hā gang kā la ku ru lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ tsa khri g.ye lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ brnya ke tā la brnya 7lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba tī rtu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya bi ka ṭa des ṇi tā snyes ya rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā 0se rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khyo bha ya su ra bee ri ṇa khyo bha ya rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma tī ye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ hre rim mi 77—747

tā bhā hre lhu ① phaṭa/ oṃ kharsha rī ye ‘ lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥ badzra pra ci sgyu hraX lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ lo ke shwa rī ye kyilhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dze badzra de ha nyi dze lha rgyu phaṭa/oṃ dru ma tsā ye lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā phye lhu 74 phaṭa/ oṃ sku lu tā paphye rtu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ shwa bon gye rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ sru ka rā bgye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā snyi ye sku : phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dru tī ye tsholhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma rda: tī ye /snyertu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha gli ye 7lhu phaṭa/ bzlas pa sgom par ldan byas nas /spro dang bsdu ba'i rim pa yis/ /sngags pa myur du 'grub pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang rnyed/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig dam tshig mchog /thugs kyi rnyed pas khyab pa la/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnam par spyod / /mkha' la spyod pa nyid thob 'gyur/ /'di ni khams gsum thams cad du/ /go 'phang mchog la legs par zhugs / /langs pa'i dus su dam tshig can/ /yan lag drug tu sbyor ba bshad/ /oṃ haḥsnying ga tshoste rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na maḥ gyi mgo la ste rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swā hā hu —spyi gtsug la mapadma gar gyi dbang phyug ste 4zla ba dang ser skya'o / /bo ṣa ṭa he go cha ste nye ru ka snyenam mkha'i mdog can no/ /snye snye ho mig la ste rdo rje nyi ma gser btso ma lta bu'o/ /phaṭa ha ni yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha ste rta mchog ljang khu ser skya'o/ /oṃ lte ba la ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nam mkha' dang ser skya'o/ /haṃ g.yo tshosnying ga 5la snyeya cimi rī gdakar mo'o/ / : oṃ 0kha la ste rmongs byed ma dmar po'o / /hre snyertswa snyomago la ste g.yo byed ma ser po'o / / snye rgyu spyi gtsug la ste spag byed ma sngon po'o snye / /phaṭa phaṭa yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha ste tsaṇḍi rten dmar ser ro/ /ji ltar bde bar cho ga bzhin du spyod cicing gnas ji so/ /'gro ba du ma'i bsam ci 77—748

pa la/ /thugs kyi rdo rje tshul can 'di/ /gnyis med sbyor ba mtha' yas pa /srid pa kun gyi dngos por gnas/ /dri ma med cing nga rgyal med/ /yi ge med cing brjod du med/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las thugs kyi sdom pa dang bla ma'i bsnyen bkur gyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig mchog gyur pa/ /'dod pa'i gsang ba kun ster ba/ /shin tu gsang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /bsgrub pa'i don ni bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma'i dbus su ni/ /padma 'dab rim brgyad pa bri/ /sna tshogs mdog can ge sar bcas/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras bu ster/ /de yi dbus su yi ge snye /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs / /dpe byad kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dgyes pa chen po'i sbyor ba yis /gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i mchog /byang chub sems kyi rgyu las ni/ /byang chub zla ba dri med pa/ /de mthong lha mo langs nas ni/ /glu 'di yis ni skul bar byed / /sne rol cig rol cig dgyes pa ho/ /bde ba chen po'i rdo rje ni/ /bde ba chen po rol nyid las/ /'di nyid du ni bzhengs su gsol/ /a la la ho dgyes pa che/ /khyod ni bde ba'i mchog yin te/ /khyod kyi zhal ni khums tsam gyis/ /bdag gis 'dir ni ro gcig rnyed/ /kye ma'o bcom ldan bde chen dgyes/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' legs dgyes khyod/ /ro dang ro mchog thams cad de/ /dgyes pa chen po bde ba rnams/ /rtag par dngos grub kun la yang / /rol cig rol cig lha mo la/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thams 77—749

cad dang / /bcom ldan rdo rje chen po ni/ /lha mo'i padma dgyes la rol a la la ho dgyes pa che/ /bcom ldan 'dod la dgyes pa khyod/ /'don pa'i dngos grub legs par stol/ /padma mchog la dgyes par rol sa la la ho dgyes pa che/ /tshogs kyi bde bas dus rtag tu/ /rdo rje mchog ni 'dzin pa yis /padma'i zhal mchog bye ba yi/ /padma la ni rol par mdzod/ /ji ltar bung bas sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /lha rnams padma nyid la rol/ /kye ma'o tsa grogs po dgyes chen 'dir/ /rdo rje mchog ni bde bar sbyar/ /dus kun bde ba 'dir rimadzod cig /de ring dus ni 'di nyid du/ /yang dag byang chub 'dus pa yin/ /a la la ho dgyes pa che/ /bde chen kun tu dgyes mchog rol/ /a la la ho dgyes pa che/ /glu 'di dag gis bskul nas su/ /mnyam nyid las ni bcom ldan dpal / /sdom pa'i rdo rje bzhengs par gyur/ /'khor dang bcas par gzigs nas ni/ /bcom ldan 'das ni zhal bzhi pa/ /sngo ba dang / ser ba dang — dmar ba dang / ljang khu'i sku zhal te/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams pas dam tshig rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ phyag gzhan gnyis po na ritshogs bdag gi pags pa 'dzin pa/g.yas pa'i gsum pa na cang te'u/ bzhi pa la dgra sta/ lnga pa la gri gug /drug pa la rdo rje mdung bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa'i gsum pa ( cin rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa la khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa la rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa la bdud bzhi'i mgo bo bsnams pa'o/ /ral tshopa'i cod pan rgyan cha can/ /dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba 'chang / /zla ba phyed pa dbu la 'dzin/ /dbu la sna 77—750

tshogs rdo rjes mtshan ri/ /'jigs pa'i mche ba rnam sgyur rizhal/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /stag gi pags pa gos su mdabs / /mi yi mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /mgrin nor gdu bu rna cha dang / /mgo yi nor bus rnam par brgyan/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa thal ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug tu rab tu grags/ /de yi pang ( na bcom ldan ma/ /dam tshig rdo rje phag mo ni/ /sku mdog de dang 'dra bar bya/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gnyis pa la skra grol ba/ /gcer bu ska rags 'og pag gis rnam par brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pas 'khyud pa ste/ bdud kyi khrag gis yongs su gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pang / g.yas pa na sdig mdzub tshardo rje dang bcas pas phyogs bcur sdigs 7par byed pa/ bskal pa'i me yi gzi brjid can/ /khrag la dgyes shing zhal nas 'dzag /byin pa gnyis kyis mnyam par 'khyud/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /chos kun gnas ni dge ba yin/ /ā li kā mali las byung ba / /rnam par rtog pa med pa ste/ /chos dang chos min rnam par spangs/ /pad 'dab nga mo dgod pa yis/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /g.yon phyogs bskor ba'i dgod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa tshal dngos grub snyol/ /gnag sacing ser la de bzhin dmar/ /ljang khu 9drag po'i gzugs can te/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum g.yas brkyang gnas pas bzhugs/ /gcer bu dbu skra grol ba ste/ /bdud bzhi zhabs kyis mnan 7pa dang / /chags shing zhen pas myos pa dang / /thod pa dag gi dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /gnag 7cing sngo la ljang ba dang / /shin tu 77—751

'jigs shing snang mig can/ /ser zhing gnag 〉la ljang khu ste/ /snying rje'i ro ni yongs su rdzogs/ /dmar zhing gnag ril ljang ba dang / /sgeg pa la sogs nyams kyis 'khor/ /ljang zhing gnag la ser ba dang / /'jam zhing khro bas 'jigs pa dang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /g.yon pa cang te'u gri gug ste / /mgo bo rdo rje mdung g.yas na/ /mtshams ni bzhi po dag tu yang / /bum pa bdud rtsi lnga yi chus/ /yongs su gang ba'i steng du yang / /byang chub sems kyis 0gang snod gzhug /khu gdong la sogs lha mo rnams/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /gnag dang sngo bsangs dzodamar ser skya/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can la/ /skra grol ba yis rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu yi dgas gdan du mnan/ /'dod pa'i snying rjes rnam par myos/ /g.yon par mgo bo kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yas na thod pa gri gug go / /mtshams ni bzhi po dag tu yang / /gshin rje sreg sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /spyan gsum pa la yi dgas zugadan/ /skra grol ba yang rab tu 'jigs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu 7sna tshogs gzugs can la/ /dga' zhing bde bas rnam par myos/ /g.yon la thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga/ /g.yas la cang te'u gri gug ste/ /g.yon nas bskor 6zhing dgod byas na/ /mtshams kyi dngos grub stsol tshabar 'gyur/ /khu gdong la sogs sgor dgod pa/ /g.yas nas bskor zhing dgod par bya/ /khams dang skye mched phung po rnams/ /sku gsung thugs su rnam par bsgom/ /sngar bshad rim 77—752

pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / cho ga 3bzhin du dgod par bya/ /dbang chen dang ni chu dang ni/ /me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /de yi dbus su bkod ripa ni/ /sa sogs ribazhi po dag yin no/ /snang byed ma dang gsod cam nyid/ /'gugs byed ma dang gar ma dag /de nyid nam mkha'i khams yin te/ /padma'i dra ba stong pa yin/ /gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad yin/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma yin / /'du shes gar dbang rgyal po ste/ /'du byed rdo rje rgyal po yin/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /bde gshegs kun nyid he ru ka /mig ni gti mug rdo rje ste/ /rna ba zhe snang rdo rje yin/ /sna ni phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /rtse ni chags pa rdo rje yin/ /lus ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched kun dbang rdo rje'o//rgyu ni thugs kyi rdo rje ste/ /aḥ zhes bya ba gsung du 'gyur/ /oṃ ni sku yi rdo rje ste / /he ni rdo rje ye shes yin/ /lus sogs rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par bsgom/ /bde ba'i chags pa bcom ldan 'das/ /chags pa med pa'ang de bzhin te/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /mchod dang bstod dang dbang yang bskur/ /rjes su chags pa'i sbyor ba dag /'jug pas mnyam pa'i bcud du 'gyur/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam bsgoms na / /spro tshodang bsdu ba'i spyor ngabyas nas/ /sbyor ba'i dam tshig mchod pa yis/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas par bya/ /oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kai rtu rdu phaṭa/ ḍā ki gli dzā la sam ba ra gā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ trīḥha ha lhu snye phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bee ro tsa gri 5ye lhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki nī ye badzra waṇḍi nī ye rtu rgyu laphaṭa zhwa hā / phag mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki 'i pa ཿ phaṭa / oṃ lā me lhu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ khaṇḍa ro he snye tsho phaṭa2 7/—7rdo3chu

spa tsā ye 15lhu snye phaṭa / oṃ kā kā phye rtu snye phaṭa4 / oṃ u lu kā sa phye sum̐ rgyu phaṭa / oṃ sha nā phye lhu sne phaṭa ri/ oṃ sna ka rā dzi phye lhu ཿ phaṭa / oṃ ya ma dā snyi ye 74 snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dru tī ye 7lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma de 7 tī ye colhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha gri ye 7lhu rgyu phaṭa/ sgro padang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bsgom pa mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi / /mchog tu gsang ba smras pa yin/ /bcu drug cha ni yongs rdzogs pa/ /sngags dang gsang sngags kun gyi gtso/ /sgom pa'i dus las langs nas ni/ /go cha gnyis ni rnam par dgod/ /oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' snying ga la/ /na maḥ nyi rnam par snang mdzad mgo bo tshol/ gu hā hu ci padma gar gyi dbang phyug spyi gtsug la bo ṣa ṭa ho 5khrag 'thung duste dpung pa la'o/ /snye ཿ ho rdo rje nyi ma ste mig la'o / /phaṭa ha rta mchog ste yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha'o/ /oṃ chirdo rje phag 5mo ste lte ba la'o/ /haṃ oṃ sal mi ni ste gasnying ga la'o/ /gli 4 rmongs byed ma ste rtse la'o/ / hre dzrī g.yo byed ma ste mgo bo la'o/ /rdu rghaṃ skrag byed ma ste spyi gtsug la'o/ /phaṭa ha gtum mo ste yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha'o/ /'di ltar dngos dang dngos med mnyam/ /thams cad chos su ro gcig ste/ /mnyam pa nyid la rnam par bzhugs/ /mnyam pa'i ye shes lnga po 'di/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyis skyongs/ /dus bzhi'am yang na dus gsum du/ /ci tsam nus pa bsrung bar bya/ /'di ni gsang ba'i mchog yin te/ /gang la yang spya / // / rdo ste/ le'u //// // brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma chen po las sdom pa'i dam 77—754

de nas cho ga'i gzhung bzhin /bshad/ /padma 'dab brgyad legs par mdzes/ /sna tshogs 'dab snyem yid 'ong ba/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /padma'i rgyal po rnam par bsam/ /lte bar sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'o/ /de la lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshan pa/ /de steng khu.ā li tā ci li ste/ /dbus su reg bya stong pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gi shekhyab/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal nyid/ /zhal gdong lnga la phyag bcu gnyis/ /spyan gsum rnam par 'gyur ba ste/ /g.yas brkyang gyib yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /g.yon brkyang ba yang de bzhin bzhugs/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan nyid/ /zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par bri/ /stag gi pags pa gos su mnabs( 3/ /bugs rje khro bos rnam par rol/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /ral dzipa'i cod pan rgyan du thogs/ /zla ba byed pa'i spyi gtsug la//sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu la mnan / /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /mi mgo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa ste/ /thod rlon phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /mgul rgyan gdu 7bu rna cha dang / /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa thal ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug po rnam par bsgom/ /phyag gnyis thod pa skedril bu yis/ /phag mo la ni rnam par 'khyud / /phyag gzhan gnyis po dag gis ni/ /'jigs byed chen po'i pags rlon mnabasang/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gsum pa la rdo rje gsor zhing ba dan gsum pa 'dzin pa/ 5bzhi pa la mdung rtse lnga pa/ lnga pa la dgra sta/ drug pa la rdo rje cang te'u rnams paso/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa la rdo rje zhags pa/ lnga pa la gri gug /drug pa la drag po'i mgo bo/ pang na gnas pa'i phag mo ni bcom ldan 'das kyi 77—755

mdog can phyag gnyis pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/gcer bu dum bus brgyan pa'i ska rags can/ phyag g.yon pa la byang chub kyi sems kyis /)gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pas 'khyud ripa/ phyag g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub rikyis gdug pa kun la phyogs su sdigs mdzub byed cing gri gug 'dzin pa/ bskal pa'i me yi gzi brjid can/ /khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /bde ba'i mchog gi dam pa'o /drag po'i gzugs can rnam par 'gyur/ /thugs rje'i chags pas rnam par rol/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ /he ru ka dpal rnam par bsgom /nam mkha'i mdog can ser ba dang / /dmar dang ljang gu ser skya'o —/ /khro dang bzhad dang sgeg pa dang / /rngam dang zhi bar ldan pa dang / /khams dang skye mched phung po dang / /reg pa'ang de bzhin bsgom pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma de bzhin te/ /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /phyag bzhi pa la gdong gcig pa/ /spyan gsum pa la drag po'i gzugs/ / skyil mo krung ni phyed par bzhugs/ /phyogs kyi gos can mchog yin no/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /spa grol ba yis rnam par brgyan/ /lha mo phyag rgya lnga 'chang zhing / /'dod pa'i rnam grol rab tu ster / /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang gi phyogs su rnam par dgod/ /dkar dang ser ba de bzhin du//dmar dang ljang gu chags pas myos/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /dril bu cang te'u gri gug 'chang / /mtshams bzhi dag tu bum pa bzhi/ /ye shes lnga yis yongs gang ba/ /thod pa 'o mas yongs gang bas/ /bum pa'i steng du gzhag stopar bya/ /g.yon nas bskor zhing bkod nas kyang / /ye shes sems dpa' 77—756

bkug nas su/ /mchod dang bstod dang gzhug par bya/ /yid ngag lus la bkod nas ni/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /snye aX oṃ ni rnam par bsgom/ /gsang sngags ji bzhin bzlas na ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /oṃ shrī badzra nye he ru ru kai lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā gi gli dzā la sa ra gu hā/oṃ gli ha ha lhu sne phaṭa/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bee ro tsa gli 3ye lhu rgyu phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ sarba bu spre ska gli ye badzra bsto gri ye lhu snye phaṭa gu hā / lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā gi gli ci sne phaṭa/ oṃ lā me lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he gelhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi tī ye lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i sprul pa 5 chikros nas ni/ /'gro ba gsum po rdzogs par byas/ /bsgom par bzlas par ldan pa yis/ /bdag gis spro dang bsdu bar bya/ /khams gsum ma lus kun tu yang / /lus ngag yid gsum ci bder spyad/ /dam tshig can bsgoms langs nas ni/ /go cha gnyis po bgo bar bya/ /oṃ haḥtshordo rje sems dpa' ste snying ga la'o/ /na ma 7nyi rnam par snang mdzad ste samago bo la'o//gā hā hu sapadma gar dbang ste spyi gtsug la'o/ /bo ṣa ṭa he dpal khrag 'thung ste dpung pa gnyis la'o/ /snye snye ho rdo rje nyi ma ste mig la'o/ /phaṭa ha 〉rta mchog ste yan lag thams cad kyi go cha'o/ /oṃ rdo rje phag mo paste lte ba tshala'o/ /haṃ yo —ya mi ni ste snying ga pala'o/ /rtswa tsho stormongs byed ma ste kha la'o/ /hro gli ri g.yo byed ma ste mgo bo la'o/ /: rgyu spag byed ma ste spyi gtsug la'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa oṃ ni tsaṇḍi skyika ste yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha'o/ /'di ni dam tshig ngo bo ste/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /sngags dbyibs chos bdag rnal 'byor ni/ /bdag nyid chos su spyor ba yis/ /ji ltar bde bar spyod par bya/ /mngon 77—757

par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las gnas kyi rim pa ste le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dpa' bo gcig pu'i cho ga ni/ /sngags pas lte bar rnam bsams pa/ /rlung dang me yi dbus su ni/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs padma/ /de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du thod pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i dbus su ā li kā li lugs su 'byung ba dang lugs las zlog pa'i tshul du nyis ltab tu byas la/ hūṃ byin gyis brlabs capa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba dga' zhing dgyes pa las byung ba ni dpal thugs rje'i bdag nyid he ru ka chags pas rnam par 'khor bar bsgom mo /de yang zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas pa tsibarkyang bas bzhugs pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ dpa' bo'i phyag rgya drug gis sku lus phyag rgyas btab pa/ 'jigs byed chen po dang / dus mtshan gnyis kyi mgo dang nu ma mnan pa/ stag gi pags pa mnabs 9pa/ snying rje'i ros 'khor ba rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis —la/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa / rdo rje dril bu / phyag gzhan gnyis la tshogs kyi bdag po'i pags pa'i stobs 'dzin pa g.yas pa'i phyag gsum pa zil rdo rje mdung / bzhi pa la lcags kyu/ lnga pa la rdo rje gri gug /drug pa la rdo rje cang te'u/ phyag g.yon pa'i gsum pa na thod pa rkang gis yongs su gang ba/ rnal 'byor gyi mchod phyir thogs tshadang / rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga /steng du rtse mo lnga pa'i rdo rje rab tu 'jigs pa'i rdo rje dril bu rab tu 'phyang ba/ sna tshogs ba dan rab tu dpyangs lapa/ dbus su sna tshogs rdo rjes 77—758

mtshan pa/ 'og nas rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje zhags pa/ lnga pa la tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ /drug pa la dgra sta bsnams pa zhal mdog sngo ba dang /ser ba dang / dmar ba dang / ljang gu merab tu 'jigs su rung ba/ sgeg pa dang / dgod pa dang / 'gying bag can du bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i mdun du ā li kā li las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'khyud nas bzhugs te/sku mdog dmar po/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu spa grol ba/ gcer bu dum bu'i ska rags can/ phyag g.yon pa na thod pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang gdug pa'i bdud kyi raktas riyongs su gang ba/ g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub can la rdo rje gri gug thogs pa/ phyag gzhan gnyis la cang cate'u dang / kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal khrag 'dzag cing khrag la dga' ba/ byin pa gnyis mnyam par bsnol ba /bde ba chen po'i snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ dmar ba dang ljang gu dang /ser ba dang sngo ba'i zhal/ gdug cing 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang sku mdog ji lta ba phyag dang sku mdog kyang de bzhin du bris te 'di la rnal 'byor pa mchog gis nang gi gnas la sogs pa'i rim par dgod do/ /bu ste thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum ma ni mgo la'o/ /dzā ste keng rus chen po dang / gtum ma'i mig can ma ni spyi gtsug la'o/ /yo ste keng rus can dang / 'od ldan ma ni rna ba g.yas par ro/ /a ste mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ni spyi bo'i rgyab tu ste gnas so/ /go ste 7lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma ni rna ba g.yon par ro/ /rā ste smin ma'i skudabus su ni 'od dpag med dang / mi'u lathung mtho/ /de tshoste mig gnyis su ni 77—759

rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang ku'i dbang rgyug ma'o/ /mā 4ste dpung rtsar ni rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma'o/ /nye ba'i gnas te thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /kā ste ma na rikhung gnyis su ni 4myu gu can dang / sa srung ri ma'o / /rma ste nu ma gnyis su ni rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo / /tre ste lte ba'i dbus su stobs po che dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o//ko ste sna rtser ni rdo rje rghaṃ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka ste kha la ni rab bzang dang / sngo sangs lha ri mo'o/ /la tshoste mgrin par ni rdo rje 'od dang / rab bzang ma ste tshan do ha'o/ /kā —ste snying la ni rdo rje 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma'o/ /nyi ste bshang sgo la mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshan do ha'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo sa la spyod pa'o/ /pre ste mtshan ma la ni stobs po che skadang / 'khor lo'i shugs ma'o/ /gro ciste gzhang la ni rdo rje rin chen skyidang dum skyes ma'o/ /'dus pa can no/ / sau ste brla lkuganyis su ོrta mgrin dang / chang 'tshong ma'o/ /su ste byin pa gnyis la ni nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /nā 7ste sor mo rnams la ni dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /si ste rkang bol gnyis su ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen khu mo'o/ /dur khrod do/ /ma 5ste mthe bong gnyis la ni rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /ku ste pus —mo gnyis su rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /nye ba'i dur khrod de sku'i 'khor lo sa 'og na gnas pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni rdo rje/ lā ma ni dril bu/ dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma byuni glang po che'i pags 4pa 'dzin pa'i khu tshur/ khu gdong ma ni rdo rje mdung /77—760

lug gdong ma ni lcags kyu/ khyi gdong ma ni gri gug /phag gdong ma ni cang te'u / gshin rje sreg ma /ni thod pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga ma/ gshin rje pho nya ma ni zhags pa ma/ gshin rje mche ba ma ni tshangs pa'i mgo bo ma/ gshin rje 'joms ma ni dgra sta ma/ byang chub kyi sems kyi snod ni zhal bzhi'i ngo bo/sa'i khams ni 'bebs ma/ chu'i khams ni gsod ma/ me'i khams ni 'gugs ma / rlung gi khams ni gar gyi dbang rgyug ma/ dam mkha'i khams ni padma'i dra ba can no/ /gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po ni padma gar gyi dbang rgyug /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid ni dpal rdo rje he ru na'o/ /mig gnyis ni gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba gnyis ni zhe snang rdo rje/ sna ni ser sna rdo rje/kha ni 'dod chags rdo rje/ reg bya ni phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad cini dbang phyug rdo rje/ yid ni mi 'khrugs pa/ ngag ni tshe dpag med/ lus ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /oṃ ha snying la rdo rje sems dpa'/ na maḥ nyi mgo la rnam par snang mdzad / gā hā hu spyi gtsug la padma gar gyi dbang phyug /bo ṣa ṭa he dpung pa gnyis la he ru ka /snye snye ho mig gnyis su rdo rje nyi ma/ phaṭa ha yan lag thams cad du rta mchog gi go cha'o/ /oṃ tpa lte ba la rdo rje phag mo'o/ /haṃ yi snying la ya mi ni'o/ /hri 3mo ni kha la rmongs byed mtho/ /hre 75 7ni mgo la skyod byed cama'o/ /hūṃ snye spyi gtsug la spag byed ma'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇḍi ka ste yan lag thams cad kyi go cha'o/ /mdzub mamo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por ngarab tu sbyar/ /de yi dpral ba'i dbus su rab 77—761

bzhag nas/ /bskor zhing bskor bas kun tu bskor bar bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng du blta/ /gyen du dze gi sgra sgrogs shing ri/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gugs/ /dzaX tpa hoḥ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sbyor bas dgug cing rab tu gzhug ste bcing la dbang du bsdu'o/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma des nam mkha'i dkyil yongs su gang bar mthong bzhin du thod pa bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang bas stangs thabs dang bcas pas dbang bskur dbul lo/ /ci ciltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a gyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya thi ye hūṃ rghaṃ/ rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa/ der yi ge a bskyed pa la/ ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba/ zla ba'i cha bcu drug pa la yi ge ཿ dang āḥtshe gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ yi ge gsum pa'i spro ba las 'khor lo gsum 'byung bar bsgom mo/ /oṃ sa ma ya shud dma tshosarba dharmāḥ sa ma ya shud jo3ha / chos thams cad kyi bcud mnyam par gnas par bsam mo/ /ye shes lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i 2chu btung ngo / /oṃ badzra a mṛ skuta u da ka rghaṃ/ ṭha lam tre tsham khaṃ ཿ oṃ/ ye shes bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo mchog ni rnam par spro/ /dung chen phreng ba blangs nas ni/ /de nas de la bzlas pa 7bya/ /rang srog rtsol ba byas nas ni/ /bsgoms pas de ma thag tu 'bar / /oṃ badzra shrī he he ru ru kai lhu phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki gli dzā la sa raṃ pas hā tshe trīḥha ha lhu snye phaṭa/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bee ro tsa snye'i ye lhu : phaṭa swā hā / oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ki dri ye badzra waṇḍi ni 7ye lhu 77—76 2

phaṭa gā hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /ci ste ngal bar ma gyur na/ /de ltar bzlas shing bsam gtan bya/ /ngal bar gyur na rnam dag bsgom/ /de la byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun te gang zhe na/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum mo'o / /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum ma'i rimig can ma'o/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen mtho / /ye shes kyi padma rnam par sbyang ciba'o / /dad pa'i dbang po ni brtan pa'i blo chen ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni lang rka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo rnam par sbyang ba'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srung ma'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o / /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo sangs lha mo'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni /shin tu bzang mo'o / /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta rna ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi 7yan lag ni khu gdong ma'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo rnam par sbyong ba'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dum skyes ma'o/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rmuchang 'tshong tshama'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha 77—763

ma'o / /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin tu dpa' mo'o9)/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o4mi/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni dpa' mo chen mo'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo rnam par sbyang ba'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khu gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni lug pa'i gdong can no/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi'i ri rigadong can no/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi'i sgo'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka ste / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje'i rang gi ngo bo ni bdag kho na'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed ri pa ni gshin rje sreg ma'o / /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par srung /rib ni gshin rje'i 7pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms mtho /dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnam par sbyang maba'o/ /'di ltar ma lus par 7bsgoms na/ /sgrub pos nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can don du rnal 'byor bdag /mnyam nyid dam tshig dam pa'o/ /'khor lo lnga po so so yi/ /cho ga so so'i dbye ba bsgom/ /mngal skyes so so'i dbye ba dag /'khor lo lnga yi mchog panyid can/ /rnal 'byor ma sogs gtsor sgom pa/ /so so'i dbye ba'i dbye ba yin/ /ji ltar rdo rje he ru ka /de bzhin lha mo'i dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sbyor tshab/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor de bzhin/ /rdo rje sku yi dpa' bo bdag /bha ga'i dbus su rnam par bsgom/ /ji ltar sgom pa'i rim pa yis/ /de ltar 'khor lo gsum du sbyor/ /bha ga lnga po bdag gis 77—7dzi

bsgom/ /dbus su mkha' 'gro ma sbyor dang / /padma'i mkha' 'gro ma /sbyor dang /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dbye la/ /bha ga'i dbus su 'khor lo gsum/ /he ru ka ni mchog nyid bsgom/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bsgoms pa la/ /dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /sna tshogs padma la sogs dbus/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i sbyor ba dag /de 'di bha ga'i dbus dag tu/ /'khor lo lnga pa dag la bsgom/ /dpa' bo gcig pu he ru na / /ji bzhin phag mo de bzhin du/ /sku mdog zhal dang phyag dang mtshan/ /de nyid sna tshogs padmar bsgom/ /de nyid padma'i dbus dag tu/ /he ru ka ni mchog nyid bsgom/ /thod pa lhan cig mnyam par ni/ /lnga yi dbye ba dag sbyor te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rim pa bsgom/ /bha ga'i dbus su rnam par bsgom / /'khor lo'i bdag po mthong ma gyur/ /'khyud pa yi ni phyag rgya can/ /dpa' bo 'khor lo de la bsam/ /rang rang gi ni rnal 'byor ma/ /snying du sbas pa rnam par bsgom/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ni/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par mdzes/ /gnyis ni 'khyud pa'i phyag yin te/ /gzhan ni sna tshogs mtshan ma 'dzin/ /phyag gnyis dag ni 'khyud pa dang / /de yi bha ga'i dbus su ni / /dpa' bos sgom pa ma mthong ngo / /kun rdzob sbas pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /sgom pa'i mchog kyang ma mthong ngo / /sgo nga las skyes rim sbyor ba'i/ /sgom pa'i rnam par bsgom pa ni/ /lnga po 'dus pa'i bsam pa ste/ /sgong skyes mchog ni bsgom pa'o/ /'khor lo'i dbye ba'i dbye ba yis/ /'di ltar rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o/ /ci ciltar bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /de ltar 'dod pa bsgom pa'o/ /bdag po'i dbye ba'i dbye ba yis/ /rigs kyi dbye ba rnam par 77—765

bsgom /lha mo'i dbye ba'i dbye ba yis/ /bdag po yang ni rnam par bsgom/ /ming /gi dbye ba'i dbye ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi sgra la sbyor/ /yang na sku gsum dbye gang gis/ /de ni bdag por bya gang yin/ /bdag po la sogs dbye ba yis/ /'khor lo'i dbye ba'i dbye rib yin/ /rigs kyi dbye ba thams cad kyis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yis dbye/ /mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis//sgom pa rnams ni yongs su brtag /sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste/ /sgra dang sgra nyams spangs pa'o/ /'di ni byurang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i mchog dam pa/ /kha cig dag ni rnal 'byor 'dod/ /kha cig rnal 'byor 'dod min te/ /glu sgra la sogs spangs pa yis / /dngos po med pa'i go 'phang bzhugs/ /phra zhing mi zad dngos po med/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa'o/ /glu sgra la sogs bcas pa yi / /go 'phang mchog gi longs spyod ni/ /glu sgra la sogs spangs pa yi/ /dngos po med pa'i go 'phang bzhugs//phra zhing mi zad dngos po med/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa'o/ /go 'phang mchog gi longs spyod ni/ /glu sgra la sogs bcas pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang / /phan dang snying brtser bdag gis bza'/ /sems can don la brtson pa yis/ /bzod pa brtson 'grus mchog dam pa/ /rnal 'byor pas glu mi smad tshocing / /mkha' 'gro mas ni phan par dgyes / /ho srid pa gsum na bde brnyes gtso/ /a la la la 4ho/ rgyal ba bde can phreng ba'i tshogs /padma la ni rdo rje rol/ /a la la la maho/ bde gshegs bral ba'i bzhan las grol/ /bdag po dgyes pa kun gyi bcud/ /chags pas rab tu dgyes mdzad cing / /srid pa pagasum na tshogs kyi bcud/ a la la ho/77—766

dgyes pas mngon par grol ba po/ /bdag ni 'dod las rab grol mdzod/ / ma li las ni byung ba yis/ /padma yi ni rnal 'byor pas/ /glu yi rgyal po 'di blangs pas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bde ba ni/ /padma'i dra ba las bzhengs so/ /'dis bskul bas ni mgon po rnams/ /bde chen bde phyir gzhal yas nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bzhengs 'khrungs te/ /rgyal ba ma lus skye bar 'gyur/ /glu dang bcas pa'i dngos po med/ /sgong skyes cha ni spangs pa yi / /de yi gzugs ni ma mthong ste/ /bde ba med cing sdug bsngal med/ /gnyis su med cing dngos po med/ /brtag pa'i spyod yul rnam par brtag /chos dang chos las rnam grol zhing / /sdig pa nyes pas mi gos so/ /thams cad gnyis med rnam grol ba'i/ /sgong skyes dngos po dang bcas yin/ /glus ni gnyid las sad pas na/ /rmongs pas mkhas pa mi smad do/ /ma rtogs pa dang rtogs bya'i phyir/ /sems can don du sangs rgyas so/ /zhing skyes lhan cig skyes lha mo/ /gnas skyes rnal 'byor ma de bzhin/ /rigs skyes lha 0mo skyes lha mo/ /mi snang mkha' spyod ma de bzhin/ /tha ma'i skye ba mchog nyid de/ /bar ma sna tshogs dam pa yin/ /sum cu pa ni sa la spyod/ /sa 'og spyod pa 'og na gnas/ /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang / /mi 'am ci mo dri za mo/ /lha mo thams cad sngon grub dang / /gzhan yang bde gshegs bsam pa can/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag dga' ba/ /thams cad phyi yi dkyil 'khor lo/ /sna tshogs glu ni nyer spyad cing / /rtag tu glu ni blang bar bya/ /sna tshogs ro yi bde ba yis/ /lha mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mchod/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ /sku yi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /mkhas pas chu la rab gnas nas/ /gsung gi 77—767

dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgom/ /me yi dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ /bugs kyi dkyil 'khor bde ba che/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor mchog dam pa/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor de nyid ni/ /de la /ribasam zhing rnam par bsgom/ /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs padma rnam par bsgom/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /dpa' bo gcig pu rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo padma'i rirdo rje phreng / /'khor lo gsum po yongs su bskor/ /ci ciltar dam tshig mchog 'khor lo/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng gis bskor/ /yi dgas rnam pa lngas de bzhin/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor yongs su bskor/ /phyi rol dur khrod ma rungs pa'i/ /sna tshogs mdog can mchog dam pa/ /sna tshogs shing ni nyams dga' ba / /khyi dang ce 5spyang 'jigs pa dang / /bya rog 'ug pa chu skyar dang / /bya rgod dang ni si mi ka /sreg /pa'i sa yang de bzhin te/ /keng rus gsal shing bskyon pa dang / /rag rog bsregs pa rnam par 'phyang / /de bzhin phyed tshig phyed ma tshig /mgo bo thod pa rje ngar dang / /khog pa lag pa mgo bo dang / /ce 0spyang sgra ni sgrogs 7pa dang / /sprul ni sna tshogs dga' bar gnas/ /seng ge phag dang stag dang ni /ra dang lug kyang de bzhin te/ /glang po khyi dang bong bu glang / /rnga mo sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog /bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /chang gi btung ba'i mchog rnams dang / /dpa' bo 'dus pa'i mchog dag dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni mchog sna tshogs/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /gri gug cang te'u mchog rnams dang / /sna tshogs lha yi rnga dag dang / /ro mchog bza' ba sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs tsum ba ā li kārsha/ /ku sha le mchog dam pa dag /77—768

de lta bu yi dur khrod du/ /gnod sbyin ro langs srin po la/ /gtor ma de la sbyin bya zhing / /nye ru ka yi gzugs rnams bsgom/ /cang te'u rdo rje dril bu dang / /sil snyan gar rnams rab tu bya/ /phyogs kyi gos can phyag rgya sbyor/ /snye phaṭa ca co'i sgra 'byin cing / /zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /kha ni dam tshig gis bkang nas/ /'di la gsang sngags rjes dran bya/ /oṃ aḥ.ā ra /li ho dzaḥrgyu bai hoḥ badzra ḍā ki gri sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ bya ri ho/ 'di ni cigasum mam bzhi lnga ru/ /yang dang yang du brjod par bya/ /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog pa yis/ /thod par de rnams la yang sbyin/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen phye nas/ /'di la gsang sngags gdab par bya//oṃ kha kha khā nyi khā nyi/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa ku tshon bre ta pi shā tsa/ sun mā da a pa smra tshar rnga ka ḍā gi rsā da yaX 5 i me ba li gro ’ tu / sa ma ya rakṣa lam ma sarba sirnyi smo 5pra yatstsha paya bee baṃ ya the// ku tha pi ba tha / dzi za tha /mā gti kra ma tha / ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya gsad su kha bi shu ye sa hā yi ke bha bskyo lhu cha phaṭa phaṭa tshag hā/ cho ga 'di yi rim pa yis/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru sbyin par bya/ /gcig pu bde bar gnas nas su/ /ma hā māṃ las don bya bstan / /rnal 'byor mnyam par bzhag snyenas ni/ /'di la thams cad bza' bar bya/ /nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo'i rim par phye ba bstan pa ste le'u dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dag pa'i gnas kyi cho ga ste/ /gsang ba'i cho ga'i gsang ba ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po mchog /gsang sngags 77—769

kun gyi gnas sbyor ba/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dbang phyug chen po'i rdo rje /'khor dang / /mngag gzhug dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro chen po dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams rang gi bdag po la phyag byas te gsol pa/ e ma'o bde ba'i sems dpa' khyod/ /e ma'o bde ba'i gtso bo yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gsang ba mchog /rang gi dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mchog gyur pa/ /rang gi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bde ba 'byung / /rdo rje rin chen padma che /sna tshogs sbyor dang sna tshogs gar/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor dag pa gsungs / rdo rje rnam snang las 'byung ba/ /cigazhal yas zur bzhi rab tu mdzes /sgo bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs /dkyil 'khor bde ba las byung ba/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo gnyis /thugs dang gsung gi 'khor lo mchog /rtsibs brgyad pa la sngo dang dmar /rdo rje padmas rnam par bskor/ /phyi rol 'khor los bskor bar bri/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog gi ni/ /phyi rol rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs/ /glu dang gar gyis rnam par rol/ /phyi rol yi dgas phreng ba yi/ /sna tshogs mdog ni mchog dam pa/ /lag pa'i gar gyis gar byed pa/ /gdong ni rnam sgyur rtse yang bskyod/ /de dbus stong par gyur pa ste/ /zla bar yi ge snye mchog yin /der ni rdo rjes khyab pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /sku gsum snying rje'i nyams dang ldan/ /phyag rgya 77—770

che dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis /bzhugs/ /sna tshogs padma'i gdan stengs su ri/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /dkar zhing sngo la gur kum rizhal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin / /rdo rje dril bus yang dag 'khyud/ /cang te'u tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'chang — /mi bskyod pa yi cod pan 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro'i gnas ni dgod bya ste / /dpa' po'ang de bzhin dgod par bya/ /khams dang phung po skye mched rnams / /sku gsung thugs su rnam par bsgom/ /lha mo'ang de 'dra'i gzugs can te/ /phyag rgya chen po bde ba yin/ /snying gar mi gyi sa bon ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /ho gnyis dang ni bcas pa ru/ /sngon du dngos grub rjes dran nas/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab ste/ /de ma thag tu lha mo yi/ /snying ga'i gsang ba'i padma la/ /chags par spyod par gyur nas su//mgon po chen po chags pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bde ba ches / /de dang lhan cig rol pa ste/ /dbang po gnyis ni sbyor bar 'gyur / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /yid ni dga' bar gyur nas su/ /dga' ba yi ni bsam dzhapa yis/ /cang te'u'i sgra yis bskul na ni/ /mnyam nyid dga' las bzhengs par 'gyur/ /a tsholi kā skoli mnyam sbyor ba/ /bde ba chen po dgyes par gyur/ /de nas nam mkha' dang chos kyi dbyings kyi mthar mgatugs pa thams cad kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa dang /gsang ba'i dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pas khyab pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen pos mdun du bdar ba/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang / phyi'i rig skama'i bdag 77—771

nyid pho nya dang / pho nya mo'i tshogs rgya che ba rnams ngo mtshar du gyur nas mig gis blta zhing mnyam par 'khyud de/ gar gyi rnam par 'phrul pa yis/ /dga' ba chen pos langs nas ni/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /byin gyi snyebarlabs kyis cadagyes pa yis/ /mgon po chen po dgyes pa yi / /glu 'di dag gis bskul bar bya/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar med kyi lugs/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar med kyi gsang / /e mtho bde ba las byung ba / /e ma'o kun tu bzang po'i don/ /e ma'o bde ba yang dag 'dus/ /ye ma'o bde chen dag pa ste/ /e ma'o bde ba ri bde ba'i mchog /e ma'o gsang sngags mnyam sbyor ba/ /ye mtho thugs kyi spyod pa ste/ /e mtho mnyam nyid phyag rgyar ldan/ /e ma grub pa yang dag 'byung / /e ma pha rol phyin pa yis/ /e ma rig pa rjes chags pa/ /e ma sna tshogs las chen po/ /ye ma kha sbyar gsum dag pa/ /ye ma rdo rje mnyam la sbyor/ /e ma padma rnam 'byed 9pa/ /e ma dbang po gnyis mnyam ldan/ /e ma zad byung mnyam pa ste/ /e ma dag pa'i gar chen te/ /e ma dri med glu re legs/ /ye ma rol mo legs sbyor ba/ /e ma phaṭa kyis mun sel ba/ /ye ma me tog na bza' mdzes/ /ye ma bdug pa gha ti sdugang /e ma sgron ma gti mug sel / /e ma dri mchog bsil ba ste/ /e ma rnal 'byor mnyam sbyor ba/ /ye ma sgyu 'phrul mkha' lta bu/ /e ma gdod nas sangs rgyas gdod nas rdo rje ste/ /ye ma gdod nas rin chen bde ba rab stsol ba /e ma gdod nas padma gdod nas bris pa ste/ /e ma sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa yin/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad sangs rgyas/ /e ma ngo mtshar 'di nyid rmad/ /e ma ngo mtshar sems can rnams/ /e ma ngo mtshar lha mo 77—772

yin /'dis bskul bas lha ni mgon po rnams/ /mchog tu sbyor ba'i sa bon las / /gur gum ci migyi ni mdog lta bu/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa mi'abyung bar 'gyur/ /zhal drug phyag ni bcu gnyis pa/ /phag mo yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dpa' chen 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ / kyil krung 4phyed par yang dag gnas/ /spyan gsum pa la rab tu bzhad / /drag cing 'jigs la rngam pa dang / /snying rje gar gyi nyams can te/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par bzhugs/ /yang na g.yas brkyang gnas pa yis / /rnal 'byor 'byung ba chen po skyes/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs padma dag la bzhugs/ /ge sar sar pa'i mdog can la/ /phyag rgya des ni rnam par brgyan/ /sngo zhing ljang la ser ba dang / /dmar zhing dkar la zhi ba ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyis rnam par mdzes/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /lha mo'i ku tsa 'tshir tshob dang / /tshangs pa'i skud pa 'dzin mdzad cing / /drag po'i 'jigs byed pags 7pa ni/ /rked par 'ching zhing bzhugs pa yin/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /ral gri utpal 'dab bsnams shing / /lcags myu zhags pa cang te'u/ /mgo bo gzhu yang de bzhin no/ /de yi sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhin/ /rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni / /chags pa chen po'i go 'phang gnas/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril / /dga' ba chen po yid 'ong ba/ /mgo po'i phreng bas sku lus brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par mtshan/ /'di ltar sngags pas bsgoms byas te/ / 'jam pa'i cirdo rje bde ba che/ /gnas sogs bdag por sbyor ba yis ye shes la sogs bdag po kun/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sbyor ba ste/ /sdom pa sdom 77—773

pa'i mchog yin no/ /thog ma thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ /shar phyogs kyi /rtsibs su pullī ra ma la yan thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum ma ste/ dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /byang phyogs su dzā la ra can keng rus chen po dang gtum mig ma ste/ ser ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /nub phyogs su ma ḍi yā na na keng rus can dang / 'od ldan ma ste dmar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /lho ru mar bu da na mche ri rib rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste ljang gu dzodang ser ba dang dmar ba'o/ /me'i phyogs la go dā ba rir lha dgra dang / dpa' bo'i blo gros ma ste dmar ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu'oskya/ /bden bral du rā me shwa ra na pa'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma ste/dkar ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu'o / /rlung gi phyogs su de wi ko ṭa na rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang ku'i dbang rgyug ma ste/ nam mkha'i mdog dang paser ba dang ljang gu'o / /dbang ldan du mā la pa /snyen rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma ste/ljang gu tshodang ser ba dang sngo ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i dpa' bo ni rab gtum ma la sogs pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi 'khor lor 0yang / shar phyogs kyi rtsibs su tā ma rū byu pa na myu gu can dang / sa sung 5ma ste/ dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /byang phyogs su me tre san rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo ste/ ljang gu 4dang ser ba dang sngo ba'o/ /nub tu tri gsha ku ne snyen dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma ste/ sngo ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu'og / /lho ru ko sa la na rdo rje snye mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma ste/ dmar ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu'o / /me'i phyogs su ka ling gar tshorab bzang dang /77—774
