sngo bsangs ma ste/ ljang gu dang ser ba dang dmar ba'o/ /bden bral du lo ba ri ka na rdo rje'i 'od dang / rab bzangs rim ste/ ser ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'ori/ /rlung gi ri phyogs su ṭwāṃ tsi kyin 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma ste dud pa'i mdog dang ser ba dang sngo ba'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su gyi ma la ya na mig mi bzang dang / /bya gdong ma ste/ gnam gyi mdog dang ser ba dang ljang gu'o( / /gsung gi 'khor lo ste myu gu can la sogs pa dang / sa srung ma la sogs pa ni padma dang / padma'i dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ de ltar mkha' la spyod pa dang / sa la spyod pa'i 'khor lo gnyis po yin no/ /gsum pa'i sku rdo rje 'byung ba ni zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa ste shar phyogs kyi sgor pre ta pu ri na stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma ste/ sngo ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu'o ri/ /byang phyogs kyi sgo la gro tshaha de wa tā 7na rdo rje rin chen dang /dum skyes ma ste ser ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /nub kyi sgor so rāṣṭa na rta mgrin dang / chang 'tshong rsham ste/ dmar ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu'o / /lho'i sgor su warna di pa tshan nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste/dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /me'i phyogs su nā ga ra na //khrag 'thung ma dang —/ rab dpa' mo ste/ nam mkha'i mdog dang ser ba dang sngo ba dang tsholjang gu'o / /bden bral du sin sgro na padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen ma ste/ ser ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /rlung gi phyogs su ma ru ta na rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los sgyur ma ste/ dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /dbang ldan du ku lu tā san rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /sku'i 'khor lo 77—775

stobs po che la sogs pa ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma la sogs pas 'khor lo dang —/ 'khor lo'i dril bu la sogs pas 'khyud pa'o/ /dpa' bo 'di thams cad g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / cang te'u dang / gri /gug bsnams pa/ci 5ltar dpa' bo'i phyag dang phyag mtshan bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang de bzhin te/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /rang rigi rigs kyi mchog gis brgyan /thams cad phyag rgya lnga 'dzin cing / /stag gi pags byupa gos su mdabs — /lha mo dbu skra grol ba ste/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /thams cad phyogs kyi gos 'chang zhing / /sku lus 'jigs pa rnam par bsgyur / /de'i dbus 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /zla ba byed pa 'dzin pa'i mchog /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam gnon pa'o/ /phag mo dbu skra grol ba ste/ /gcer bu thog pag ska rags can/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas ni/ /snga ma'i cho ga'i rim pa bzhin//bcug nas thim par rnam par bsgom/ /spyod pa bzhi ru byin gyis brlab / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rim par dgod/ /khams dang phung po skye mched rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam pa ste/ /snying po'i —ye shes mchog gyur pa/ /dbang bskur yang ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas go cha dgod 5bya ste/ /mkhas pas ye shes bzlas pa ni/ /srog rtsol bsdams te legs bzlas pa/ /bsgom pa'i bsgoms pas gsang skabar bya/ /oṃ āX nga rdu/ spro bsdu dag gi sbyor ba yis/ /gnyis med phreng ba'i sngags kyang bzla / /de nas dam tshig sems dpa' ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ shrī ma badzra skṛ —ka āḥ snye phaṭa / nge gi gli dzā la sam ba ra mi phaṭa su hā/77—776

oṃ badzra bā rā hi lhu rgyu phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇḍa ka pā li ni dzo/lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ pra tsaṇḍi /lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā rka tā la lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ tsa: kṣi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ brnya brnya he kai tā la lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba ti lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya bi ka ṭa tshon ṇi lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā 7se sum̐ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ khyo bha ya khyo bha ya su ske ri ṇi ske sna phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma ti ngalhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ hre hre sa mi tā bha lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ khab ri malhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥ badzra pra bha rtsi rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ lang ke sha ri tsholhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ dze dze badzra de ha rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ dru ma ngaye sum̐ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa ang ku ri ka rtu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ i rā sa ba ti lo snye phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badzra dzā ṭi la lhu phaṭa/oṃ ma hā lha ra bi ci snye phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā bī ra rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bā 5yu be ge lhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa badzra snye kā sar ba sa ru rnyi ra ant+ra mā lā ba lo bi de snye snye phaṭa/ tshe su ra bhakṣi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ griṇḍa groṇḍa 4su bha dra sa sna tā la ga ta ku dze ga sa bā ta snyeya tardza ya lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sgyu 4ma de wi galhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ā —ka ḍa rgya sna ā ka ḍa sgye badzra bha dra lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ su 0bha dre sum̐ snye phaṭa/ oṃ gli gli ma hā lha ra ba lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya na1 lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ ’ ’ bi ru pā kṣi lhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha khā can ne snye ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ rgyu ma hā ba le lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ ṭwāṃ snyeratna badzra rtu : phaṭa/ oṃ ṣaṇḍa tshor he lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ gri gli ha ya gli ba lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇḍi ni mi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ snye snye ā tā sha ga rbha 5lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇi —rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ gi li ki li he ru ka rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ si li si li padma nar te shwa ri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ 77—777

hi li nyi li bee ro tsa ni /lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti ni lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ 0snyi li rnyi li badzra satwa lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bī rī ri snye phaṭa/ dung chen phreng ( ba blangs nas ni/ /gsang sngags cho ga bzhin du bzla/ /dus bzhir spyor ba byas nas ni//bzlas dang bsgom pa rtse gcig bya/ /rnal 'byor myur du grub nas ni/ /gsang sngags grub pa'i rim pa yis/ /bdag nyid phyag rgyar ldan byas nas/ /sngags pas rtag tu mchod par bya/ /sngags pas dkyil 'khor zhugs nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni 'grub pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu snyol/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i sdu/ zlo 'om las 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa ste le'u de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rigs kyi dbye ba'i mchog dam pa/ /gnas sogs sbyor ba'i rim pa yis/ /phyogs kyi rim pas rirnam par dbye/ /thams cad mchog gi sbyor chen po/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rab tu 'grub/ /rdo rje sku las nges 'byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor dam pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / yang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad 'dus shing 'ongs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la / mig yangs dga' bas gar byed cing / /myur bas bsdus pa'i rim pa yis/ /rkang pa g.yas dang g.yon gyis ni/ /mdun du gom stabs spros pa yis/ /'di ltar rnam sgyur 9rikhros 77—778

pa'i spyan/ /zin ma 'degs dang 'khor bar ldan/ /skye med phyag rgyar 'gro ba dag /mig gi phyag rgyas phyag 'tshal te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chen po la rnam pa du mas //bskul nas zhus te/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo thams cad dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi de nyid dang / /dkyil 'khor mchog ni mdzes pa ste/ /dgyes pa chen po'i rdo rje ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas bde ba che/ /rol pa'i bde ba chen po ni/ /de ring du ni bdag gis rnyed/ /a la la ho/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bde ba chen po mchog tu dgyes / /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa yis/ /shin tu srid pa nges ldog pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa che/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rnam par brtags / /de nas bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa' dgongs shing spyan rnam par phye ste/ 'khor bzhi rnam par 'khor ba'i gar byugyis smin ma 'degs shing /mdun du gzigs shing gom stabs kyis/ /dregs pas snyems par rnam 'khor ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje rang / /de nyid 'di la bzhugs pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni dkyil 'khor ming / /rdo rje ye shes thugs la gnas/ /rtog pa med par bdag sbyor ba/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba ni/ /dgyes pa chen po'i rdo rje'o/ /ri mo mkhan gyi dkar po ltar/ /byang chub sems mchog 'di lta bu/ /sngo zhing 'bar ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i me lta bu/ /zla ba byed pas bdag nyid mdzes / /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dag la bzhugs/ /cha brgyad dkyil 'khor yid 'ong ba/ /'bar ba'i nyi ma dang bcas pa/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje rin chen de/ /bde ba mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /padma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba/ /lte ba ge 77—779

sar gyis khyab pa/ /padma padma nyid las ni/ /dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni mthong ba na/ /byin za 'bar ba ji bzhin du//las kyi rdo rje dkyil 'khor du/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ltar de dag mtha' yas pa/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab tu brtag /gang du gang la sprul pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung yin/ /thams cad bdag nyid kun tu bzang / /nam /mkha'i khams ni kun tu khyab/ /mkha' dbyings sa yi mchog gyur par/ /khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par bsgom/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus dkyil du/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ni rnam par brtag /sna tshogs padma mdzes pa la/ /ji lta'i gnas su rnam par ridagod/ /dbus ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /he ru ka ni rnam par bsgom/ /sngar bshad sku mdog gnas rnams dang / /phag mo'i bde la rnam par gnas/ /shar du pullī ra ma la yar thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum mtho/ /byang du dzā snolas rar keng rus chen po dang / rab gtum ma'i mig can ma'o/ /nub tu osnyi yā na na keng rus can dang / 'od ldan ma'o/ /lho ru ar bu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma'o/ /dbus ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i shar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dzodabus su go dā 7ba ri ra lha dgra dang / dpa' bo'i blo gros mtho / /shar 1phyogs su rā me musha rar 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma'o//byang phyogs su de wi ko ṭa zin rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang rka'i padabang rgyug ma'o/ /nub tu mā la ba na rdo rje'i skosku dang shing grib ma'o/ /lho phyogs su tā ma rū 7pa na myu gu can dang / sa srung sama'o/ /byang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lkotre tshon rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /shar du tro sha ku ne rtso 77—780

na dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /byang du ko sa la na /rdo rje snye mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma'o/ /nub phyogs su ka ling ka rin rab bzang dang / sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ /lho phyogs su lasba ka rin rdo rje rab bzang dang ga shin tu bzang mo'o/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ṭwāṃ nni can 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna mtho/ /shar phyogs su nyi ma la ya na mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong ma'o/ /byang du pre ta pu ri na stobs po che dang /'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /nub tu gro 5ha de wa tā na rdo rje rin chen dang / /dum skyes ma'o/ /lho ru sau rāṣṭa na rta mgrin dzodang / chang 'tshong dzoma'o lho phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su su warṇa di pan rtenam mkha'i snying po dang /'khor lo'i go cha mtho/ /shar du nā ga ra man dpal khrag 'byung dang —/ rab dpa' mo'o/ /byang du siddha cin padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen mtho /nub tu ma ru tshan rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los sgyur ma'o//sto ru ku lu tā tshan rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dang rab tshogatum ma la sogs pa thams cad kyang gzugs sna tshogs pa zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ spyan gsum pa/g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas rgyas btab pa/ lha mo gcer bu spa grol ba/ thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang cang te'u dang gri gug dang rdo rje dang dril bus 'khyud pa lha mo'i byin pa gnyis kyis 'khril ba/ dgyes pa chen po'i dga' ba'i ros rnam par myos pa'o / /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dpa' bo yi / /zur bzhi bum pa'i steng du ni/ /byang chub sems kyis yongs gang ba'i/ /thod pa'i snod ni bzhag cipar bya/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi zur la ni/ /bum pa'i thod 77—781

pa gnyis po dgod/ /mtshams kyi char mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi po gzugs byed pa bud med dbang phyug ma ste/ zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa/g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pas bzhugs pa/ phyogs kyi gos can/ spa grol ba/phyag rgya lnga brtan par 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje phreng bas yongs bskor ba/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi phyi rol du/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bri/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyang sna tshogs padma'i steng du yi dgas /kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ sgo bzhi'i shar phyogs su khu gdong ma khros pa'i mig can shel mig khros pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ gri gug dang / mgo bo dang thod pa dang kha ri( ga dang dril bu dang / cang te'u 'chang ba/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gsum pa/spa grol ba/ gcer bu/ sna tshogs pa'i mdog can g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/yi dgas ridang sna tshogs padma la bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs te/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /'ug gdong ma dang la khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma ni ji ltar khu gdong ma'i mdog dang phyag dang 'dug stangs dang gdan bzhin no/ /bong bu dang rnga mo dang ra dang byi la'i zhal te/ shin tu drag pos mngon du gsol ba'o/ /gshin rje sreg ma nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar ni gar byed pa'i dbang jig ma ste/ zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/phyogs kyi gos can/ skra grol ba/ sna tshogs padma dang yi dgas zu gnon zipa/phyag rgya lngas byin gyis brlabs pa/ thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mgo bo dang gri gug bsnams pa cang te'u dang rdo rje dang mdung 'dzin pa mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ thams cad kyang mi mgo'i thod pa'i phreng 77—782

ba rgyan du 'chang ba/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ /cod pan rdo rje'i phreng bas byas/ /rdo rje las byas rgyan can te / /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed kyis/ /dbu la mnan cing brgyan pa yin/ /ci ’ltar bcom ldan mdog bzhin du/ /rdo rje phag mo'i zhal mdog phyag /phyag rgya 'dug stangs las kyang de/ /gcer bu skra ni grol ba ste/ /dum bu'i ska rags rgyan can te/ /'on kyang rdo rje phag mo yi/ /steng gi zhal gdong dkar po ste/ /mche ba carnam par gtsigs pa'o/ /ji ltar gnas kyi rim pa dag /'bum pa mngon brjod rim pa las/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /le'u rdo rje sems dpas bshad/ /gzhan du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /mngon brjod rgyud kyi dang po yi/ /le'u la nges par 'gal ba med/ /snyems pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga ste/ /lnga po lnga pa'i bdag nyid sbyor chen po/ /sdom pa'i cho ga sbas pa gsang ba ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ma lus thams cad kyi/ /'di ltar gzhan du bka' yi phyogs bzhin du/ /bum pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bum pa sna tshogs cho ga bzhin/ /gser dang dngul las byas pa ste/ /sna tshogs gos kyis mdzes pa dang / /me tog 0phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /'chi med lnga yis yongs su bkang / /rnam lnga sman dang yang dag ldan/ /rin chen lnga dang bcas pa dang / /'bru lnga dag gis rnam par mdzes/ /dkyil 'khor phyogs dang mtshams rnams su//bum pa bcu drug bzhag nas kyang / /mkha' 'gro ma ni sna tshogs mchod/ /glu tshodang gar dang bde ba che/ /phyogs kyi gos can spa grol ba/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dag dang / /sna tshogs yi dgas 'phreng ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol yongs su bskor/ /de yi phyi rol mu khyud kyi/ /dbus su mkha' 'gro ma yin te/ /77—783

phyi rol ska /rags kyis bskor ba/ /dur khrod rnam par 'jigs pa dag /sna tshogs du mas rnam par mdzes/ /mdun du ye shes dam tshig gi/ /dkyil 'khor mchog rini mthong nas kyang / /mngon brjod dam tshig de bzhin mchod/ /rim pa bzhin du dbang yang bskur/ /mkhas pas lus la bkod nas ni/ /gcig tu bsdus te thim nas su/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /phung po khams dang skye mched gnas/ /go cha gnyis po bgo bar bya/ /'khor lo thams cad rnam bsgoms nas/ /phung po khams dang skye mchen dang / /lus ngag yid la rnam par dgod/ /ye shes sems dpa' snying la dgod/ /sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba yis / /dam tshig lha yi mchod pas mchod/ /ye shes bzlas pa'i bya ba dag /grangs med pa ni rnam par spros/ /dung chen phreng ba blangs nas su/ /mnyam par bzhag nas bzlas pa bya/ /der ni ye shes 'khor lo la/ /mkhas pas mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pa yis smon lam gdab/ /theg pa chen po'i chos rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis myur bar 'grub/ /oṃ badzra he he ru ru kai shrī rnga ki gli dzā la sa tshoraṃ lhu rdu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ 'iḥha ha lhu snye phaṭa/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o / /oṃ badzra bee ro tsa rtswa ye rtu rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ / oṃ sarba bu ḍā ki rī ye badzra bsnga rī ye 5lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o / /oṃ khaṇḍa ka pā li na ka ra ka ra lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍi 5lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā nang kā la ku 7ru ku —ru lhu rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tsa: kṣi nya snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ rkang kā la rdzobarnya brnya lhu rghaṃ phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ pra bha ba ti lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ bi ka ṭā rda ji ṇi tā las ya tā sa ya lhu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā nā cise sa 77—784

snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ su ra bai ri ṇi /khyo bha ya khyo bha ya lhu snye phaṭa rig hā/ oṃ bī rir ma ti ci rghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mi tā bha hre hre lhu rghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kharba ri lhu snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ badzra pra bha hraḥhraḥ lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ lang ke 7sha ri 7lhu snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ badzra de ha dze dze 5lhu rghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra dru ma ye rtu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ asku ri ka phaṭa phaṭa nga snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ i rā cib ti tsha snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ badzra dzā 7snyi la da ha da ha lhu snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ ma hā lha par bi skolhu sne phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ ma hā bī ra rnapa tsa pa tsa rtu snye phaṭa su hā/oṃ bā yu be ge rtu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ badzra snye kā ra bha kṣa bha kṣa ba sa ru rnyi ra mant+ra mā lā ba lo bi ni 5lhu hūṃ phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ su ra bhakṣi snye snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ tshe su bha dra ci groṇḍa groṇḍa gas sta pā tā la ga ’ ku dze ga 4 sa bā tā ya tā ya lhu rgyu phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ byā snyem de wi tsholhu rgyu phaṭa su hā/ oṃ badzra bha dra a ga ā ga lhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ su bha dre lhu hūṃ phaṭa su hā/ oṃ ma hā lha ra ba spyo sgyu ri lhu sne phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ ha ya rka1 ri lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi rū snyeg kṣi ’ ’ ci snye phaṭa gu hā / oṃ kha hā gan ne lhu rgyu phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ṭwāṃ sa rdu phaṭa gā hā/oṃ tsakra be ge lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ ratna badzra sne hūṃ sulhu rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he rtsu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ ha ya gyi stob ṭī gli rtso snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shoṇḍi ni hūṃ snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ ā 2kā sha gar bha snye hūṃ lhu snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ tsakra wami ṇa snye rgyu phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ he ru ka ki li ki li lhu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ su bī re lhu hūṃ phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ padma nar te shwa ra si li si li rtu snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba le rtu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ bee ro tsa na gyi li nyi li lhu snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ tsakra warti na lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ badzra sa twa dhi li dhi li rtu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ 77—785

ma hā bi /bye lhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ spre gi ni lhu ཿ phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ lā me lhu phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro nye ri snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ rū pi ṇi gelhu snye phaṭa gu hā/oṃ kā kā gye lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ u shā kā phye lhu rgyu phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shā nā ri phye lhu : phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ sna /ka rā 74 lhu rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ya ma tā snyi 7spyo sne phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ ya ma dru ti 5lhu sne phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ya ma rda sgri pa ju phaṭa su hā/oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ci hūṃ phaṭa gu hā/ 'di ni ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /gzhan la phan phyir dam tshig can/ /mchod dang sgom padang bzlas pa bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa 'phel/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dngos grub 'thob / /sgong tshoskyes dbye ba'i mchog dam pa/ /sbyor bas pa'adod pa thams cad stsolatsho/ /ji lta'i cilas rnams byas na ni/ /'grub par yang ni the tsom 5med/ /sbyor ba'i dngos grub dam pa'i mchog /bla ma'i ngag las rnyed par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma yi gnas / /brgyud pa'i rim pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /yang na sngon gyi dngos grub ni/ /rmi lam du ni ston pa yin/ /gzhan yang / bla ma'i go 'phang brnyes pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yis rab tu stsol/ /dam tshig mchog gi gsang ba dang / /sbas pa 'di ni bstan mi bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi thugs dang ni/ /sangs rgyas thugs ni mchog gyur pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po gsang / /rnal 'byor spyor ba'i mchog yin no/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dngos grub kyi gnas kyi rim pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas sbyor ba bshad bya ba/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa/ /bla ma las kyang bla ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi —dra ba'i sdom/ /phag mo bdag mo chen mo 77—786

ni / /rnal 'byor ma yis legs bsgrubs pa/ /'di ni kun gyi rnal 'byor te/ /rnal 'byor snying po bsdus pa yin/ /padma 'dab /brgyad la bri ba/ /sna tshogs mdog can mchog dam pa/ /lte ba ge sar bcas pa la/ /thams cad yongs su dag pa'i gdan/ /de yi dbus su zla ba'i cha / /de bzhin dag cing dri ma med//de steng ā li tā kyili ste/ /dbus su tpa gis carnam par brgyan/ /de dbus lha mo bzhengs pa ni/ /rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bcu gnyis/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal rnam bsgyur/ / skyil mo krung ni phyed par bzhugs /gar gyis rirnam par legs brgyan cing / /phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba/ /phyed ni bud med dbang phyug zhal/ /dkar la dmar ba'i gzugs 'dzin cing / /thod pa'i cod pan rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag na 'chang —/ /padma 'khyil pas rnam bskor cing / /dpral ba yi ni phyag rgya 'bar/ /gnyis kyis mi yi pags pa mnabs/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'chang / /zhags pa lcags kyu mchog kyang 'dzin/ /cang te'u gri gug tshangs pa yi/ /mgo bo gdong ni bzhi pa ste/ /sngo zhing ser la ljang ba yi / /zhal gyis lha mo rnam par brgyan/ /zhal gdong mche ba rnam gtsigs shing / /zla ba phyed pas rnam par brgyan / /sna tshogs rdo rje dbu rgyan mtshan/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol / /phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab cing / /lha mo dum bu'i ska terags brgyan/ /g.yer ku'i 7sku rags sgra dang ldan/ /rkang gdub dag gis legs par brgyan/ /dpung rgyan dag gis rnam par mdzes/ /dpral ba la ni rdo rje'i dzwaphreng / /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i 6phyag rgya can/ /sku lus mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa'o /shar gyi 'dab ngamar mkha' 'gro ma/ /seng ge'i gdong ste rnam par 77—787

'jigasatsa / /g.yon du phag gi gdong can te/ /lha mo lā ma rab 'jigs ma/ /nub tu lha mo glang po'i gdong / /dum skyes ma ni dbang mo'o / /sto ru lha mo'i tshul can ni / /gzugs can ma ste rta yi rigadong / /spyan gsum pa la sna tshogs gzugs/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /mgo dang gri gug phyag na bsnams /gcer bu dbu skra grol ba la/ /gar gyis kyang ni legs par mdzes/ /yi dgas rgyab la kyil krung ri phyed/ /bzhin rnam sgyur zhing rab tu 'jigs/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /lha mo'i zhabs kyis ri'og tu mnan/ /me sogs mtshams ni bzhi po tshol/ /byang chub sems la sogs pa'i snod/ /bum pa'i steng du rnam par dgod/ /dung dang kunda zla ba'i mdog /'khor lo rtsibs ni drug pa bri/ /mkhas pas de dbus bri ba ni/ /ma mo'i rigs ni bzhi pa ste/ /mā ma kri tshodang spyan dang ni/ /lha mo sgrol ma gos dkar mo / /sngo dang dkar dang dmar ba ste/ /lha mo rdo rje rigs dbang phyug /dkar dang sngo dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /lha mo rtag pa'i rigs yin no/ /ljang dang dkar dang dmar ba yi/ /lha mo las kyi rigs yin no/ /dmar dang ser dang ljang gu 7yi//lha mo padma'i rigs yin no/ /spyan gsum pa la skra grol zhing / /phyogs kyi gos mchog 'dzin pa yin/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ci'adzin/ /rang gi phyag mtshan bzhi pa ste/ /rdo rje 'khor lo kun rdo rje/ /padma dmar po mchog dam pa/ /thams cad de bzhin dril bu 'dzin/ /thod pa 'khyil bas rnam par bskor/ /bdud bzhi zhabs kyis rnam gnon cing / /gar dang glu yis bzhad pa'i zhal/ /sna tshogs padma zla dbus bzhugs/ /rigs kyi dngos grub rab ster ba'o/ /phyag 77—788

na mgo bo cang te'u bsnams/ /rdo rje gri gug gis rnam brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu ①rgyan can/ / mgo yi phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /zur gyi cha ni thams cad du/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rim pa dgod/ /shar du rtsibs drug 'khor lo la/ /ji lta'i rjes 'brang lha mo dgod/ /thog ma'i zur la bu gli ra/ /mā ril ya na rab gtum ma'o/ /gnyis pa dzā cal ra na gtum mig mtho/ /gsum pa au byon kyin 'od ldan ma'o/ /bzhi pa mar bu da na sna chen ma'o/ /lnga pa go dā pa ri na dpa' ba'i blo gros ma'o/ /drug pa rā tshome 7sha ra na mi'u 7thung ma'o / /gnyis pa byang gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs 7drug pa dang po de wī ko ṭa dkun lang ga'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /gnyis pa mā pal ba lan shing grib ma'o/ /gsum pa kā ma rū 7pa na sa srung ma'o/ /bzhi pa lko /she tshon 'jigs byed chen mo'i / /lnga pa tri sha tshoku ne na rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /drug pa ko sa la na chang 'thung ma'o /nub kyi 'khor lo gsum pa'i rtsibs drug gi shar du ka ling ga snyen sngo bsangs lha mo'o / /gnyis pa lam bā saka na rab bzangs lama'o/ /gsum pa ṭwāṃ tsi thon rta rna ma'o/ /bzhi pa nyi ma la ya na bya gdong ma'o/ /lnga pa pre ta pu ri na 'khor lo'i shugs can mtho/ /drug pa gro 0ha de ba tā na dum skyes ma'o/ /lho'i ga'akhor lo bzhi pa'i rtsibs drug gi ri shar la sau rā ṣṭa na chang 'tshong ruma'o/ /gnyis pa na gsu bsnga di pa na 'khor lo'i go cha mo / /gsum pa nā ga ra rin rab tu dpa' mo'o / /bzhi pa si na stobs chen ma'o/ /lnga pa ma ru tā na 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /drug pa ku lu tā na stobartson 'grus chen mo'o ri/ /thog ma dkar zhing ljang ba dang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /'khor lo cang te'u gri gug go/ /gnyis pa byang ni sngo la ser/ /rdo rje thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /cang te'u 77—789

dang ni gri gug go/ /gsum pa nub ni dmar la 〉ser/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /padma cang te'u gri gug go/ /bzhi pa lho yi lha mo ni/ /ser dmar sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /cang te'u gri gug thod pa dang / /kha ṭwāṃ ga yang yongs su 'dzin/ /lha mo de dag thams cad kyang / /byed ni bud med dbang phyug ma'o/ /spyan gsum pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /gcer bu dbu skra grol ba dang / / skyil mo krung kyiphyed gar bcas pas/ /yi dgas kyirgyab la zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /rkang rgyan dang ni ska rags dang / /dbu rgyan rdo rjes tsamatshan pa'o / /'khor lo de yi rgyab tu ni /shar du rdo rje phreng bas bskor/ /byang du 'khor lo'i phreng ba ste/ /nub tu sna tshogs rno rje phreng / /lho ru padma'i phreng ba'o/ /dbus su rdo rje phreng bas brgyan /zur gyi cha ni thams cad du/ /sna tshogs rdo rje mnyam par bri/ /de rgyab yi dgas sna tshogs kyi/ /phreng bas mkhas pas bskor bar bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor sgo rnams dang / /zur gyi cha ni bzhi po la/ /mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i gzugs de ni/ /mnyam par bzhag rgyanas bri zhing dgod/ /khu gdong shar du dgod pa ste/ /sngo la dmar dang yid 'phrog pa/ /lug gdong byang sgor dgod pa ste/ /ljang zhing dmar la legs par mdzes/ /khyi gdong nub kyi sgo la ni / /ser zhing dud kha —rab tu gdug /phag gdong lho ru dgod pa ni/ /ljang zhing sngo ba'i gzugs can no/ /spyan gsum bzhin bsgyur skorab gdug cing / /dam pa phyogs kyi gos 'chang ba'o/ /mig g.yon dang ni gzugs mi sdug /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /sna tshogs padma'i nyi dbus bzhugs/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sna 77—790

tshogs gzugs can yid 'phrog pa/ /gcer bu skra grol rnam par 'jigs/ /gshin rje sreg ma ma nye gdong / /me yi phyogs su rnam par bzhugs/ /gshin rje pho nya bong bu'i gdong / /bden bral phyogs su rnam par bzhugs/ /gshin rje mche ba rnga mo'i gdong / /gdug pa rlung phyogs rab tu bzhugs/ /gshin rje 'joms ma rta yi gdong / /'di dag chags pas rab tu myos/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'phrog ma'o/ /gcer bu dbu spa grol ba la/ / skyil krung /)byed par gar dang bcas/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /spyan gsum pa la g.yo ba'i sku/ /sna tshogs padma'i nyi dbus bzhugs/ /mi sdug rjes su chags pas myos/ /thams cad yi dgas ri steng na bzhugs/ /'khor lo sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /gri gug dang ni mgo bo 'chang / /phyag g.yas dag na cang te'u yi/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i sgra yang sgrogs / /phyi rol bskor ba'i tshul can no /gzhan du rnam pa du ma yi / /glu dang gar gyis rimachod pa dang / /sna tshogs dam tshig dam pa yi/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri dang phreng ba byug pa dang / /lha yi gos kyi rnam pa dang / /lha mo sil snyan mchog dam pa/ /phyi rol rnal 'byor ma dag mchod/ /de yi dbus mdun mtha' yas pa'i / /thams cad du ni 'khor yongs kyis/ /nam mkha'i khams ni yongs gang ba'i/ /phag mo'i ri mchog ni dam pa dang / /rnal 'byor ma gdug rnams kyang mchod/ /mchog 'di dag ni gsang zhing sba/ /su la yang ni mi brjod do/ /phyi rol yi dgas phreng ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi rang bzhin ni/ /rnam par 'phrul pa dgon bya ste/ /ci 5lta'i rim pas rjes su dgod/ /sen mo so ni rab gtum 77—791

ma'o / /skra dang spu ni gtum mig ma'o/ /pags pa dang dri ma ni 'od ldan ma'o//sha ni sna chen ma'o/ /rtsa rgyus ni dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'o/ /rus pa ni mi'u thung ma'o /mkhal ma ni lang na'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /snying ni shing grib ma'o/ /mig ni sa srung ma'o/ /mkhris pa ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o / /glo ba ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /rgyu ma ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /gnye ma ni sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ /lto ba ni rab bzangs lha mo / /snang pa ni rta rna ma'o/ /skra mtshams ni bya gdong ma'o/ /bad gan ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /rnag ni dum skyes ma'o /khrag ni chang 'tshong choma'o/ /rdul ni 'khor lo'i go cha mtho/ /tshil ni shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /mchi ma ni stobs chen ma'o/ /mchil ma ni 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /snabs ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /pullī ra ma ya ste mgo bo la rab gtum ma'o/ /dzā lan dha ra ste spyi gtsug la gtum pa'i tshomig can ma'o/ / o'i yā na ste rna ba g.yas par 'od ldan ma'o/ /mar bu da ste spyi bo'i rgyab tu sna chen ma'o/ /go dā ba ri ste rna ba g.yon par brtan pa'i blo can ma'o/ / rā me mushwa ri ste smin ma'i dbus su mi'u thung mtho/ /de bī ko ṭa maste mig tu lang na'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /mā ngal ba ste phrag pa gnyis su ni skyishing grib ma'o/ /tā ma rū —pa ste mig gnyis la sa srung ma'o/ /o ṭi —ste nu ma gnyis su 'jigs byed chen mo'o /tri ci ku ne 7ste lte bar rlung gi shugs can mtho/ /ko sa la ste sna rtser ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /ka ling ka ste khar ni bya sam de ba'i'o/ /la ka ste mgrin par shin tu bzang mo'o/ / ṭwāṃ tsi ciste snying gar ni parta rna ma'o/ /nyi ma la ya ste sa'adoms su ni snyebya gdong ma'o/ /pre ta pu ri ste mtshan ma la ni gyi'akhor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /gro 4ha de ba tā ste gzhang snyel ni dum skyes ma'o/ /77—792

sau rāṣṭa /ste ribarla gnyis la ni chang 'tshong cama'o/ /su bca di pa ste rje ngar gnyis la ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /nā ga ra ste sor mo rnams la dpa' po'i blo gros ma'o/ /si ste rkang pa'i bol la stobs chen ma'o/ /ma ru ste mthe bong gnyis la 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /ku lu ta 5ste pus mo gnyis la brtson chen mo'o / /sa'i khams ni 'bebs ma/ chu'i khams ni gsod ma/ me'i khams ni 'gugs ma/ rlung gi khams ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams ni padma'i dra ba ma'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad / tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po ni gar gyi dbang phyug /'du byed kyi sung po ni rdo rje chags pa/ rnam par shes pa'i sung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni rdo rje shrī cinye ru ku'o/ /mig ni gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba ni zhe snang rdo rje/4 sna ni ser sna rdo rje/ ngag ni chags pa rdo rje/ lus ni phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad ni dbang phyug rdo rje/ yin ni mi 'khrugs skurdo rje/ ngag ni dpag med rdo rje/ lus ni snang mdzad rdo rje/ 'di dag dgod par bya ba ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo mthong ba yin/ /sbyor ba 'di la gnas na ni/ /de yis thams cad bsgom par 'gyur / /dbang bskur mchod dang dam tshig dang / /sgom pa mnyam pa bcud du byed/ /de snying ye shes sems dpa' la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi bcud kyis mchod / /lus ngag yid kyi dam tshig rnams/ /sems dang sems min legs par brtag /bzlas dang bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs 5nas ni/ /dam tshig mchog gi bzlas pa yis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po mchog kyang 'grubs/ /oṃ bee ro tsa bhā —ye snye hūṃ phaṭa su hā/ oṃ sarba bu ḍā laska 77—793

gli /ye badzra basmu gri ye ཿ ri phaṭa swā hā/ bstod dang ming du yang dag sbyar/ / snye snye ri phaṭa dang ldan pa yi/ /rab gtum ma sogs gsang sngags dag /sbyar nas mchog gi bzlas pa bya/ /bzlas pa yongs su rdzogs nas ni/ /zhi ba'i bcung ba mchog kyang btung / /chos rnams thams cad geyongs mnyam pa'i/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog yin no( / /de bas de bsgoms rnam par dag /sum cu bdun pa'i go 'phang mchog /bdag med chos dang lam dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog la rab tu bzhugs/ /shes rab pha rol rnal 'byor ma/ /rnal 'byor las ni ngal bsos nas/ /mtshan med go 'phang gnas nas su/ /mtshan med la ni mnyam par brten / /chos rnams med cing mtshan ma med/ /chos min chos can dag /kyang med/ /rten 'brel chos kyang mkha' dang mnyam/ /dngos po med cing mtshan ma med/ /de nyid gzhi —la 'dir gnas na/ /ye shes mig gis mthong ba yin/ /gnas sogs 'khor lo nges par yang nyi zer rdul / dang mnyam par mthong / /spa yi rtse mo 'bum gshags mapa'i/ /cha yang yongs su rtogs shing mthong / /bha ga'i dbus na bzhugs pa yi / /he ru rnal 'byor ma lhan cig /'khor los sgyur skeb rab sbyor ba/ /khu mugadong la sogs phyi rol dgod/ /he ru ka dpal bdag po ni/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi yis yongs su bskor/ /phan tshun bdag po bya ba tshani/ /rdo rje sems sogs sbyor ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ma dang thun mong 'grub/ /sbyor ba gsum ni dam tshig mchog /khams gsum bdag po chen po ni/ /rnam par spyod par mthong ma gyur / /mi 'grub 'khor los sgyur tshab dang / /khams gsum bdag po'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /'grub / na de na rnal 'byor che/ /srid pa gsum gyi bdag po 77—794

'thob / /de bzhin cho ga'i sbyor ba yis/ /stobs kyis shi ba bza' bar bya/ /mtshams med pa ni byed pa dag /bkug la mkhas pas byin gyis brlab/ /gzhan du dngos grub 'jigs 0par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'tsho ba'i 'bras / /rgyugs gsad pa yi sbyor ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ma la zhus te bya/ /lha bshos bsgrub pa'i ci sbyor ba'o/ /ma dang sring mo lhan cig tu/ /mchog dang bar ma de bzhin te/ /gzhan du bu mo lhan cig tu/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor ba/ /mnyam pa mchog gi bsgrub ripa'o/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis /'dod pa lnga ni spyad par bya/ /phag mo ru ni bdag bsgoms te/ /lte bar sdigs mdzub ri thobazhag nas ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs 'khor lor bzhugs//lha mo rab tu dad byas nas/ /sgo dgu la ni zhugs nas kyang / /snying po padma phug nas ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni brgyab tsam gyis/ /mi skyes mchog ni btung bar bya/ /bsnun pa de yis zos na ni/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las/ rnal 'byor ma'i gnas bsgrub pa'i mtshan ma'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor dpa' bo'i cho ga dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi gnas 'byung ba/ /'dus pa bdag gis bshad par bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad/ /bla ma'i bka' las gzhan du min/ /thams cad mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ /nges par legs pa stsol bar 'gyur/ /re'u mig dgu pa dbus su ste/ /phyi rol du ni bcu drug bri/ /re'u mig dbus kyi dkyil du yang tsho)/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i padma bri/ /sna tshogs padma brgyad pa ste//77—795

lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /de dbus zla ba blta byas te/ /a la sogs pa rnam par sbyar/ /ā li kā mili mnyam byas te/ /hūṃ ni dang du chud par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpas kun khyab dpa/ /he ru ka ni rnam par bsgom/ /zhal lnga phyag ni bcu pa ste/ /phag mo yis ni yongs su brgyan / /dkar zhing sngo la de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu ser po steng du ste/ /spyan gsum pa la 'jigs pa'i zhal / /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan nyid/ /shin tu myos pas zhabs 'og gnon/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /zla ba byed pa 'dzin pas mdzes/ /sna tshogs rdo rje cod pan can//ral pa'i dbu rgyan dbu la bcing / /phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab cing / /sku la rdo rje'i rgyan gyis spud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /bde ba chen po'i bde ba mchog /rtse gsum dang ni cang te'u 'dzin / /rdo rje gri gug de bzhin te / /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ mtshangs pa'i mgo/ /dgra sta dang ni zhags 7pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag la ni/ / na ra'i pags pa gos su mnabs / /zhabs gnyis mnyam par 'khril chib ni / /phag mo yis ni kha sbyar byas/ /de mdog phyag dang bzhugs stangs can/ /dbu spa grol zhing gcer bu ste/ /stag gi pags —pa gos su mnabs / /dum bu'i rgyan gyis ska parags can/ /drag po'i thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /thugs rje'i chags pas rnam par myos/ /shar gyi 'dab tshol mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang du lā ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /nub tu dum skyes ma yin no/ /lho ru gzugs can mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnag dang sngo bsangs dmar ser skya/ /phyogs kyi gos 'chang g.yas brkyang bzhugs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /spa grol gnyis su med pa ste/ /zur gyi cha ni thams cad 77—796

du / /byang chub sems kyi snod kyang gzhag /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ dril bu dang / /cang te'u gri gug mgo bo thogs/ /zhal gsum spyan gsum bzhin rnam bsgyur / /drag po chags pa'i chags pas myos/ /bcom ldan bde bas gzigs nas ni/ /bde ba che la rjes su chags/ /mgo bo'i do shal 'chang ba yis/ /he ru ka ni cirnam par bsgom/ /'di ltar re'u mig dbus dkyil du/ /mchog de dag kyang bsgom par bya/ /de yi shar gyi re'u mig la pullī ra kyim la ya na thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum ma ste ser po'o/ /byang du dzā lan dzha ra na keng rus chen po dang / gtum mig ma ste sngon po'o/ /nub tu maṇḍi yā na tsho na keng rus can dang 'od ldan ma ste dkar po'o/ /lho ru ar bu da tshan mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste ljang gu'o / /me'i phyogs su go dā ba ri na lha dgra dang dpa' ba'i skublo gros ma ste/ dmar po'o/ /bden bral du rā cime shwa tshari tshan 'od dpag med dang / mi'u mthung ma ste padma'i mdog can no5/ /rlung phyogs su de bī ko ṭa tshan rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang ke'i dbang phyug ma ste dud kha ri sngon po'o/ /dbang ldan du mā la ba 5na rdo rje lus dang / shing grib ma ste ljang gu thodang mu tig lta bu'o/ /phyag na rdo rje dang dril bus 'khyud pa'o/ /de la re'u mig gnyis pa'i shar phyogs su kā rum rū pa san myu gu can dang / sa sung —ma ste dmar po'o/ /byang du o tre rtson rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste ljang gu snye/ nub tu tri sha ku ni na stodapa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma ste 0sngon po'o/ /lho phyogs ko sa la na rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma ste dkar po'o/ /me'i phyogs su ka ling ga na rab bzang dang / sngo bsangs lha mo ste nam mkha' ser skya'o/ /bden bral du lam pā ri ka na rdo rje 77—797

bzang po /dang rab bzang ma ste dmar po'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su ṭwāṃ ri po tsi na 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma ste ser po'o/ /dbang ldan du nyi ma la ya na mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong ma ste sngon po'o/ /padma dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ /re'u mig gsum pa'i shar du pre ta pu ri na stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma ste nam mkha' dang ser skya'o/ /byang du gro riha de ba tā na rdo rje'i ca'od dang / dum skyes ma ste ser po'o/ /nub tu so rāṣṭa (min rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma ste dmar po'o/ /lho phyogs su su chabasnga di pa na nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste sngon po'o/ /me'i phyogs su nā ga ra tshon dpal khrag 'thung dang rab dpa' mo ste dud pa'i mdog 7can rnam/ /bden bral du si na tshapadma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen skum ste ljang gu'ong /rlung gi phyogs su ma ru ta na rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur stum ste sngon po'o/ /dbang ldan du ku lu latā tshan rdo rje sems dpa' dang /brtson 'grus chen mo skuste dkar po'o/ /'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o /gzhan yang thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang cang te'u dang gri gug dang mgo bo 'dzin pa/ phyag drug pa/ zhal gsum pa ste/ zhal ni man ngag gi rjes su 7'brang bas bstan/ spyan gsum g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi pags ri pa gos su mdabs / /mgo po'i phreng bas brgyan pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /rdo rje phreng dang pad 'khor lo/ /ji lta'i rim pas dpral bar brgyan/ /lha mo skra grol gcer bu ste/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /ji ltar thabs bzhin shes rab ste/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya legs khyab pa/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta 77—798

babs bzhis 4)ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra byed kyis brgyan pa/ /dar dang phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo'i gzugs can la bkod nas/ /ci ri ltar mdzes par rab tu brtag /'di ltar phyi yi 'khor lo yi/ /de la sgo srung )rnams kyang dgod/ /mtshams dang zur du lha mo rnams/ /mkhas pas bri bar bya ba ste/ /cho ga du ma thos nas ni/ /'bad pas gcig tu bsdus pa yin/ /shar gyi sgor ni khu (shegadong ma/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gdong ni/ /bya rog chu skyar zhal yin te/ /mi'u thung la mi sdug zhal/ /byang gi sgor ni 'ug gu dang / /lug pa byi la rnam mdzes te/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gdong gi / /rtse bskyod 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma/ /nub tu bha ba ( tshogi zhes pa/ /khyi dang seng ge'i gdong pa can/ /g.yon pa dang ni g.yas pa yi/ /rtse bskyod shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /lho phyogs sa 'dzin lha mo ni / /phag gdong ma nye'i gzugs can te/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gdong ni/ /zab cing drag la 'jigs pa'o/ /thog ma khu gdong zhes bya ba/ /gnyis pa lug pa de 7bzhin te/ /gsum pa khyi yi gdong can la/ /bzhi pa dag ni phag nyid do / /sngo dang dud kha 7dkar po'i gdong / /ljang gu 7ser po dmar po ste/ /ser zhing dmar la sngo ba'i zhal/ /dkar dang sngo dang ljang gu'i 5mdog /dang po me nas dbang ldan bar/ /gshin rje sreg ma pho nya mo/ /gshin rje mche ba 'joms ma 7nyid/ /dmar dang ser dang ljang gu dang / /sngo dang ser dang ljang gu tshadang / /dud kha gser dang ljang gu skadang / /dkar dang ser dang ljang gu 7ste/ /de dag zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /spyan gsum g.yas pa brkyang bas bzhugs/ /phyogs kyi gos 'chang gsus pa 'phyangs / /dbu skra dag ni 77—799

grol ba ste/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rgyas btab cing / /'khor lo dag ni thams cad kyang — /yi dgas misteng du rnam par bzhugs/ /sna tshogs padma nyi ma dang / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la bzhugs/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga/ /zhags pa lcags kyu cang te'u dang / /mgo bo gri gug phyag na 'chang / /thod pa'i phreng bas rirnam par brgyan/ /dga' zhing dgyes pas rnam par myos/ /rjes su chags pa'i zhal gdong ni/ /'jigs pa'i sdang mig 'gyur ba'o/ /de nas gshin rje sreg casogs sgo/ /khu gdong la sogs mtshams su ste/ /rang gi thabs dang mnyam par bzhag /sbyor ba'i rim pa bsgoms nas ni/ /'khor lo dpa' bo thams cad kyang / /ji bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ /snga ma'i rjes su thams cad kyang / /mkha' 'gro ma sogs kun de bzhin/ /ji bzhin bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /ji ltar 'dod pa gnas de bzhin/ /ji ltar sems kyi khyad par gyis/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /bum pa sna tshogs sbyor ba yis / /thod pa yis ni yongs su brgyan/ /'o mas bkang ba'i thod pa ni / /bum pa'i steng du gzhag cipar bya/ /phyi rol yongs su bskor ba ste/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma gnas pa/ /glu dang gar ni nyer ldan pas/ /sna tshogs rol mo rnam par sprul/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /dri dang gos mchog dam pa ste/ /sna tshogs dam tshig ro yi zas/ /sna tshogs bza' ba chang gis mchod /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs mchog dam pa/ /phyi rol yi dgas kyis yongs bskor/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par bsgom/ /bla ma'i man ngag bka' bzhin du/ /rdo rje pad kor 'khor lo ni/ /zur bzhi bar ni rab tu gnas /mtshams su rdo rje byed pas mtshan/ /rdo rje ka ba'i mdun dbus su/ /77—800

re'u mig rdo rje ldan par bya/ /sna tshogs pa yi cho ga mchog /gnas sogs rim pas shādagod par bya/ /khams dang phung po de bzhin te/ /skye mched drug kyang rnam par dgod/ /ye shes rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo mthong ba na/ /a zhabs bsil dag gis mchod / /dam tshig sna tshogs mchog dam pa/ /sna tshogs pa yi khyad par gyis/ / māṃ sa rakta ridag gis mchod/ / go cha ciganyis po sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya ye shes mchog dam pa/ /ro gcig ma lus bsgoms na ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /reg pa yi ni khyad par gyis/ /mkhas pas sbyor ba gsum du sbyar//bsgoms pas rnam par dag pa'i don/ /mkhas pas sum cu rtsa bdun te/ /ye shes bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dam tshig gsum gyi mchog gis bza'/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bzlas pa'i sgom pa rnam par bsgom/ /dus bzhi dag tu dam tshig can/ /gnas sbyor mkhas pas bsrung bar bya/ /sa steng du ni mthong ba kun/ /thams cad he ru ka dpal gzugs/ /'gro ba drug po'i srid pa sbyangs/ /sems can don ni gzhal med byas/ /thams cad zhugs te zhugs sbyor bas/ /'dir ni thams cad gzhug par bya/ /'di ni sbyor ba nges pa ste/ /nges pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dung chen phreng ba dag gis ni/ /dam tshig mchog gi bzlas pa bya/ /tshogs kyi cho ga'i /rim pa bzhin /rnal 'byor pa yis sngags mchog bzla/ /oṃ shrī badzra nye he ru ru ke ḍā ki gli dzā la sasba ra snye shā phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ me phaṭa / snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bee ro tsa gli ye lhu snye phaṭa chog hā/ oṃ sarba bu ḍā ki dri badzra barṇa gli ye lhu hūṃ phaṭa / phag mo'i snying po dang / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /77—801

oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇḍa ka /bā li lhu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ pra tsaṇḍi lhu sne phaṭa0/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā gaṅgā la sum̐ sne phaṭa / oṃ tsa kṣi ( )lhu snye phaṭa / oṃ brnya brnya rkaṅgā (snyel sum̐ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba ti tsholhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tsā sa 7ya bi ka ṭa 7de skuṇi telhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se milhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ khyo mabha ya spyo ste ya su ra bee ri ṇi pa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma ti sku hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hre hre chos mi tā snye tsho rgyu phaṭa / oṃ kharba ri rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ hra hraḥ5badzra pra rtse lo rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ la ci ri sa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dze dze badzra de ho sa rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ dru ma 4ye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa asku ri ke salhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ i rā ba ti sgyu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ da ha da ha badzra dza ṭi la lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā lha ra tha hūṃ sne phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā bī ra lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa badzra snye kā cir ba sa ru dhi ra ant+ra mā lā 5ba lo bi ni 0lhu snye phaṭa / oṃ su ra bha kṣi snye rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ groṇḍa groṇḍa gsu bha dra sa sta pā tā la ga ta bhu ce rdza ga sa ji pā tadzdza ya tadzdza ya lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sgyu snyem de bi ci snye phaṭa/ oṃ ā stu na ā ga badzra bha dre lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ māṃ ṭwāṃ zhe ma hā lha ra bi lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya 41 〉lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ’ ’ bee rū pā kṣi ce lhu snye phaṭa/tshe kha hā gan ne sum̐ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ rgyu rgyu ma hā ba le lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ choratna badzra lhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ 7khaṇḍa ro he lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ shlau tī 4ha ya gri ce ba lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇḍi snyeni lhulhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ sne snye ā tā sha ga ga ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇi lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ si li si pali padma narte dhishwa re ngalhu snye phaṭa oṃ ma hā ba pale lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ nyi li gyi li bee ro tsa ni 0lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ 77—802

tsakra warti ni 1lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ dhe li rnyi li badzra satwa lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bīḥ spyo snye phaṭa/ oṃ spre gi ni ci snye phaṭa/ oṃ lā me lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi kyi rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā gye rtsu snye phaṭa/ oṃ u lu kā gye lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ shā nā ris lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ sru tshoka rā ngagye rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā snyi 7lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dru ti 5lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma de rtsi skulhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ngalhu snye phaṭa/ rnal 'byor cho ga bzlas tsam gyis/ /rdo rje bkug cing gnas nas su/ /'khrug cing rab tu g.yo ba ste/ /lus las 'od 'bar dgod pa dang / /de yi mig ni 'bar ba dang / /tshig 'jam pa dang 'bar ba dang / /rnal 'byor pas ni bzlas tsam gyis / /rdo je 'jug pa mthong ba dang / /sngags pa mnyam bzhag bzlas nas ni/ /dam tshig spyod pa ldan byas nas/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsdam —byas te/ /gsal byed rgyu muni brjod nas kyang / /chos kyi dbyings su spro bar bya/ /sems can kun la phan pa dang / /gdul dka' ba dag gdul tshoba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams mdun du spro/ /khro bo'i go 'phang de mthong nas/ /khams gsum dag tu bsdu bar bya/ /lus ngag yid la bcug nas kyang / /sa steng du ni spyod pa spyad/ /mnyam bzhag min pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /snying rjes brlan pa nyid kyis ni/ /sems can thams cad mthong ba na/ /srid pa gsum po he ru ka /sngags pa ci dang ci za ba/ /dam tshig mchog ni bsgoms nas kyang / /thams cad chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /mnyam pa nyid la rab tu gnas/ /dam tshig can ni langs dus su/ /bla ma mchod pa rjes dran nas/ /byang chub sems kyi chus tshos bya/ /yid 'ong phyag rgya la gnas nas/ /khro bo sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang 77—803

mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /go 'phang du ni byin brlabs nas/ /yid 'ong mchod pa dag tu bshad/ /mkha' dbyings dkyil 'khor khyab pa la/ /smon lam dag ni bya ba yin/ /de ma thag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu mthong ba na3/ /rang bzhin dag pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rang bzhin yang ni dngos med byas/ /sems can rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /srid pa mchog tu byas pa yin/ /rdo rje phag mo bla med pa/ /phyag rgya ru ni byin brlabs nas/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad 'di ltar rab tu brtag /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla sna /sdu pardo'u mig dgod pa dang / /gnas bsdu ba bstan pa ste le'u bcu de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /gnas dang 'dus pa mchog yin pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /mnyam par 'dres pa bcud du 'gyur/ /gnyis med blos ni mnyam bzhag ciste/ /'khor lo gsum mdog ldan par ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'i dbus dag tu/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor lo mchog /de yi dbus su padma che/ /sna tshogs padma legs par mdzes/ /'dab rim brgyad pa lte bar bcas/ /ge sar dag gis nye bar mdzes/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /phreng ba dang ni phreng phyed brgyan/ /mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ / ā li kā chuli zhu gyur las/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam par bsgom/ /de yi yongs su 'phel 'gyur bas/ /rdo rje he ru ka rnam bsgom / /dus mtha'i me chen 'chol 5ba yis/ /gdul dka' thams cad rab 77—804

tu gsheg(3 /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /zhabs kyi 'og tu rnam gnon cing / /zhal gyi mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum 'jigs pa rab tu 'jigs/ /sku lus dag ni sngon po las/ /sngo zhing 'bar ba'i sku yang sprul/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sangs rgyas lngas rini byin gyis brlabs / /sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ /zla ba phyed pa rnam par mdzes//zhal drug dpa' bo mi sdug pa/ /sgeg pa dang ni bzhad pa dang / /drag shul 'jigs pa'i sku lus can/ /phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab cing / /sku ni sna tshogs rgyan gyis thun/ /phag mo dang ni yang dag ldan/ /byin pa dag gis gnyis med 'khyud/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs gnas shing / /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /ha ha mdzad cing snye snye mdzad/ /nyi hi mdzad cing 'jigs pa can/ /rdu rgyu mdzad cing phaṭa phaṭa can/ / asgyu skyo yi sgra chen smra/ /sngo zhing ser la de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dkar po de bzhin te/ /steng gi zhal gdong gdug pa che/ /zas su gdug pa longs spyod cing / /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas/ /lha mo dag gi nu ma 'tshir/ /drag po'i pags tshopa'i gos mnabs 4shing / /khrag rlon 'dzag pa rab gsol te/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin / /mdung dang gri gug lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa dang ni mgo bo 'dzin//gdug pa gtum zhing cang te'u dang / /mdung ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya can/ /dpral ba dag tu nye bar mdzes/ /de lta'i phyag dang sku mdog bzhugs/ /dbu skra grol cing 7gcer bu ste/ /'di lta'i phyag rgya rnam par bsgom/ /dum bu'i ska rags kyis brgyan cing ske/ /phag mo yang ni 'di 'drar bsgom/ /rnal 'byor som nyi spangs nas ni/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam ldan pas/ /thugs 77—805

rje chags pa'i bde ba yis/ /sems can don gyi phyir byung ste/ /snying rje chen pos brlan pa yi / /nam mkha'i sbyor ba'i longs spyod kyis/ /thugs rje chen po'i bcud bde bas/ /'gro drug srid pa rnam sbyangs nas/ /sems can don ni mchog nyid mdzad/ /stong pa'i ye shes las byung zhing / /rtog ripa med pa'i gnas gzhi cal/ /rang bzhin med cing mchog tu phra/ /thig le sgra ni rnam spangs pa/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig mthong nas ni/ /phyi dang nang gi mchog gyur pa /snying po ye shes dam tshig ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /der ni phyag mtshan mdog mthong nas/ /zla ba'i rdo rje sa bon ni/ /de 'dir snying po bsgom bya ste/ /bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor dag tu brtag /mkha' 'gro la sogs rim pa yis/ /padma dag ni dgod par bya/ /shar du mkha' 'gro dgod par bya/ /byang du de bzhin lā ri ma ste/ /nub tu dum skyes ma yin no/ /lho ru de bzhin gzugs can ma/ /sngo dang ljang dang dmar ba dang / /ser te ri de bzhin bzhi po ni/ / bzhin rnam bsgyur zhing spyan gsum gdug /spa grol phyogs kyi gos can yin/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rgyas btab cing / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yon gyi dpung pa la brten cing / /cang te'u gri gug mgo bo ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dam tshig mchog /byang chub sems kyi chus gang ba'i/ /thod pa bum pa'i steng du gzhaga'i'akhor lo dgod par bya ba ni/ /sngon du grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /byin gyis rlab 7sogs rim pa yis/ /shar phyogs byang gi rim pa ste/ / pullī ra ma 5ya na thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum ma ste nam mkha' ser skya'o/ /dzā lan rmudha ra na keng rus chen po dang / gtum mig ma ste mdog ser po'o/ /yo ḍi yā na mi77—806

na keng rus can dang 'od ldan ma ste mdog ljang gu'o// /mar bu da na mche ba rnam par gtsigs ri pa dang / sna chen ma ste mdog nam mkha' ser skya'o/ /go dā ba ri na lha dgra dang dpa' ba'i blo gros ma ste mdog ser po'o/ /ra me sha ri na 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma ste mdog ljang gu/ de bī ko ṭa na rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma ste/ nam mkha' ser skya'o/ /mā la wa na rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma ste mdog ser po / kā ma rū /pa man myu gu can dang sa srung ma ste mdog ljang gu / o tre na rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste nam mkha' ser skya / tro sha ku ni mun 'jigs byed chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma ste mdog ser / ko sa la na rdo rje snye mdzad dang / chang 'thung —ma ste mdog ljang gu/ ka liṅga na skurab bzang dang sngo bsangs lha mo ste nam mkha' ser skya / lam bā ka sngon rdo rje bzang dang rab bzang mo ste mdog ser / ṭwāṃ tsi na 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma ste mdog ljang gci/hi ma la ya na mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste nam mkha' ser skyal/ pre ta pu ri na stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma ste samadog ser po / kṛ ha de wa tā snyen rdo rje rin chen dang dum tshoskyes ma ste mdog ljang gu'o / /sau rāṣṭa na rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma ste nam mkha' ser skya'o/ /su waṇḍi di pa na nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste mdog ser ri/ nā ga ra gan nye ru ka dang rab dpa' mo ste mdog ljang gu/ si tson padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang —/ stobs chen ma ste nam mkha' ser skya / ma ru tā snyen garnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma ste mdog ser / ku lu tā snyen rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson chen ma ste mdog ljang gu ci/ yang na sku gsung thugs kyi ni/ /77—807

ci 3'dod mdog ni dbye ba bya/ /g.yon gyi rim pa ji lta bar/ /sgo rnams dag ni bya ba ste/ /shar du khu gdong ma/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ nub tu khyi gdong ma/ lho ru phag gdong ma/ sngo ba dang ljang gu dang / dmar ba ridang ser po'i mdog can no/ /me'i phyogs su gshin rje sreg ma mdog dmar po/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su gshin rje pho nya ma mdog sngon po/ rlung gi phyogs su gshin rje mche ba ma dud kha'am cachar spyin gyi mdog lta bu/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su gshin rje 'joms ma mdog dkar po'am ser skya'o/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dang / rab gtum ma la sogs pa 'dra bar gdong gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa mnabs pa/ phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ lha mo'i zhabs kyis 'khyud pa / gcer bu mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas dpral ba brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang dril bus 'khyud tshopa/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i mnyam pa dang ldan pa/ lha mo'i tshan ma 'tshir ba/ thod pa dang / kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ cang te'u 'chang ba/yang na rigs gsum dbye bas rtsa ba'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad phyogs kyi gos 'chang zhing / /lha mo skra grol gdug pa mo/ /khu mugadong la sogs lha mo rnams / /skra grol phyogs kyi gos can la/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal rnam bsgyur / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can /mgo bo'i phreng ba'i se ral brgyan/ /thams cad phyag rgya lnga yang 'chang — /'dod pa'i chags pas rab tu myos/ /rang gi thabs dang lhan cig rshatu /mi g.yo ba dang de bzhin sbyor/ /lto ba 'phyang zhing lag pa 'phyang / /sku 77—808

lus 'jigs shing gdong yang bsgyur / /rab 'jigs nyi ma padma yi/ /steng ridu bsgrub mipar rab gnas nas/ /gang zhig ciji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rjes su chags pas zhal nyid ni/ /de lta bu yi bsam pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bsgom par bya/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /cang te'u gri gug mgo bo 'chang /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kun/ /yi dgas la ni bzhugs par bsgom/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /nye bsnyen rjes su rnal 'byor te/ /dpa' bo'i yan lag sbyor ba yis/ /bsgrub pa lhag pa'i snyoms par 'jug /sen mo dang so dag ni thod pa'i dum bu'o/ /skra dang spu dag ni keng rus chen po'o/ /pags pa dang dri ma dag ni keng rus can no/ /sha ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs rupa'o/ /rtsa rgyus ni lha dgra'o/ /rus pa ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /mkhal ma dag ni rdo rje 'od do/ /snying ni rdo rje sku'o/ /mig ni rdo rje myu gu can no/ /mkhris pa ni rdo rje ral pa can no / /glo ba ni dpa' bo chen po'o/ /rgyu ma ni rdo rje snye mdzad do/ /gnye ma ni rab tu bzang po'o / /lte ba ni rdo rje bzang po'o/ /sgang pa ni 'jigs byed chen po'o/ /skra mtshams ni mig mi 7bzang ngo / /bad kun ni stobs po che'o/ /rnag ni rin chen rdo rje'o/ /khrag ni rta mgrin no/ /rdul ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /tshil ni dpal he ru na'o/ /mchi ma ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /mchil ma ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /snabs ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /pullī ra skom la ya ste mgo bor ni marab tu gtum ma'o/ /dzā la ra 5ste spyi gtsug tu gtum pa'i mig can ma'o / / ske'i yā na ste 'irna ba g.yas par 'od ldan ma'o/ /ar bu da ste spyi bo'i rgyab tu sna chen ma ste gnas so/ /go dā chab ri ste rna ba g.yon par brtan pa'i blo 77—809

can ma'o/ / rā me shā ri 3ste min ma'i dbus su mi'u zung ma'o/ /de bī ko ṭa ci ste mig tu ni lang na'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /mā la ba ste phrag pa gnyis su ni ( shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/ /kā ma rū pa ste mchan khung dag tu ni ‘ sa srung ma'o/ /o tre /ste nu ma gnyis su 'jigs byed 7chen mo ste zhing ngo / /tri sha ku ni meste lte bar ni 5rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /ko sa la ste sna rtser ni chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka liṅga bste khar ni 5sngo sangs pa mo'o/ /lam bā —ka ste mgrin par ni shin tu bzang 7mo ste 'dus pa can no/ / ṭwāṃ tsi 7ste snying gar ni rta rna ma'o/ /nyi ma la ya ste mdoms byu su ni tsobya gdong ma ste nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /pre ta pu ri ste mtshan ma la ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o / gro ha de ba tā —ste bshang ba'i lam la sani 4dum skyes ma'o / /'dus pa can no/ / sau rāṣṭa riste brla gnyis su chang 'tshong ma'o/ /su ba di 4pa tshoste byin pa gnyis la 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /nā tshog ra ste sor mo rnams la ni :shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /si ciste rkang pa'i bol la ni hostobs chen ma ste 'di dag ni dur khrod do/ / ma ru 4ste mthe bong dag la ni snye'akhor los sgyur snyoma'o/ / ku lu tā ste pus mo gnyis la ni snyebartson 'grus ma cho chen mo'o/ /'di dag ni nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sa'i khams ni lhung byed ma'oci//chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam snyemakha'i khams ni padma'i dra ba ma'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o /'du shes kyi phung po ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste de 77—810

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni dpal he ru na'o/ /mig gnyis ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis ni zhe snang rdo rje'o/ /sna gnyis ni ser sna rdo rje'o / /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rje/ reg bya ni phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad ni dbang rgyug rdo rje/ yid ni mi 'khrugs /rdo rje/ ngag ni dpag med rdo rje/ lus ni rdo rje rirnam snang ngo / /'di dag sgrub capa'i rnal 'byor yin / /rang snying lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas su/ /de dag sprul cing bkod nas ni/ /ji lta'i rim pas dbang yang bskur/ /zhugs par gyur nas bcing bar bya/ /dgyes pas rjes su chags pas sbyor/ /rang gi ngo bo gcig gyur nas/ /de la go cha gnyis po dgod/ /oṃ ha snying ga la rdo rje sems dpa'/ na maḥ gyi mgo bo la rnam par snang mdzad/ gu hā hu kṣ-ispyi gtsug la padma gar gyi dbang phyug /bo ṣaṭa he phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka /snye snye hoḥ mig gnyis la rdo rje nyi ma / phaṭa ha lus thams cad kyi go cha ste rta mchog go/ /oṃ ༄ lte ba la rdo rje phag mo / haṃ oṃ ngasnying ga pal ya mi ni'o/ /sgyu lamo —kha la rmongs byed ma'o/ /sgro nyaspyo tshomago la skyod byed mtho/ /hūṃ snye spyi gtsug la skrag byed ma'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇḍi ka ste yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon cha'o / /mdzub mo mdud 5byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por rab tu sbyar/ /de ni dpral ba'i dbus su rab bzhag nas/ /bskor zhing bskor bar kun tu sbyar bar bya/ /rkang pa phyed mnan steng du blta/ /gyen du dze gi sgra sgrogs shing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams bkug /dzaX rgyu baṃ hoḥ/ sbyor bas bkug nas gzhug pa dang ci/ /bcings nas dbang du bya ba yin/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 77—811

rnams kyis/ / mkha' dkyil /yongs su gang mthong nas/ /ye shes chu yi bdud rtsi yis/ /gang ba'i bum pa blangs nas ni/ /lag pas de la dbang bskur bya/ /glu dang gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /dbang bskur dag ni dbul bar bya /de la sngags ni oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a gyi ṣe ka ta ris ma ya shri ci ye rgyu rgyu/glu 'di blangs pas bskul ba'am/ yang rin mkha' 'gro ma chen mo rnams thugs dgyes pa dang / rab tu dgyes par gyur te/ dbang bskur rol mo'i bde chen po /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po/ /dgyes chen gsol ba'i bde chen po/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po/ /gsal mdzad bde ba chen po ste/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po/ /a la la hoX gyi /mchog tu gyur pa bde chen po/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po/ /a la la hoḥ /bde chen ye shes dgyes nas ni/ /dam tshig dam tshig can la bzhugs/ /ye shes ro gcig bsgoms nas ni/ /ro gcig 'khor lo'ang de bzhin bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ /ye shes lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs dpa' bo gang —/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa la sogs brtag /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgul nas mgul du rnam par brgyan/ /lha mo'i snying po'i sngags kyis ni/ /phreng ba brgya phyed kyis brgyanacing / /gsang sngags yi ge bdun pa yis/ /nor bu rna cha legs mdzes shing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /pags tshopa'i gos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis/ /ska parags rgyan du byas pa yin/ /go cha drug po dag gis ni/ /phyag rgya lus ni rab tu mdzes/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i / /sngags kyi btung ba'i thod pa yin/ /rnam snang mdzad ma sngags gang gis/ /thod pas spyi gtsug rgyan 77—812

du byas/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams la rnam par brtag /de ltar bdag nyid rnam bsams te/ /tsham ngam sngags kyis legs par bsrung ( / /tshangs par spyod pa brtag 5gyur nas/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis mchod/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam caspangs te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bdag nyid bsam/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i ye shes bsgom/ /snyoms 'jug ye shes bzlas pa bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po sgrub chen po/ /rdo rje khro bo'i thig le las//khams ( gsum du ni spro bar bya/ /rdo rje'i sna yi rtse mo 'bar/ /spro bya nam mkhar thig le las/ /rdo rje phra mo mthong gyur pas / /ba spu'i khung bu'i bar dag nas//rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu bar/ /khro bo sangs rgyas sprin rnams spro / /rnam par dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rim pa yin/ /lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mā ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can mtho/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab gtum ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum mig ma'o/ /dpyod tshapa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o / /dad pa'i dbang po ni dpa' ba'i blo gros can ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u zung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni laṅka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srung ma'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can mtho/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni shin tu bzang 77—813

mo'o /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta rna mtho/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dum skyes ma'o/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni chang 'tshong /ma'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o / /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor los sgyur ruma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni dpa' bo chen mo'o /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni bya rog gi gdong can mtho/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug pa'i gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi'i gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gi 0gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ga'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed pa ni gshin rje sreg ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par srung 9ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong / ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed mapa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnam par sbyang ba'i —bsgom pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig 'khor lo dag /mnyam par bzhag 5ste bzlas par 4bya/ / ha ha/ hūṃ snye/ gyi hi/ phaṭa/ hūṃ rgyu/a a/— shrī badzra he nye ru ru kai snye snye phaṭa/ ḍā ki gri dzā la sa raṃ ci snye sne phaṭa tshog hā/ oṃ ri 0ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa gā hās/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o//oṃ badzra bee ro tsa nī ye hūṃ snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba bu ḍā 4gi gri ye lobadzra waṇḍi —77—814

gri ye snye shi phaṭa gu hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki ni / snye ri phaṭa tsā hā/ oṃ zhwa/ me sne snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he ri snye phaṭa gā hā/oṃ rū pi ṇi ཿ ci snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ khaṇḍa ka pā li /ni ka ra ka ra snye nga phaṭa /oṃ pra tsaṇḍi 7lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kai kā la ku ru ku ru lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ngakṣi 5lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ na la brnya brnya sum̐ snye phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba ti :lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bi ka ṭa dzā rtsi ṇi / tā sa ya tā sa ya sum̐ snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se 7lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su rā — ri ṇi 0khyo bha ya khyo bha ya lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma ti 5lhu ཿ phaṭa/oṃ a mi tā rtse hre hre ci hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba 5ri — rdu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pra bha hra hraX snye phaṭa/ oṃ laṅge shwa ri snye rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra de he snyom dze lhu sna phaṭa/ oṃ dru ma ༄ye sum̐ snye phaṭa/ oṃ asku ri ke ri phaṭa phaṭa lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ske rā wa ti ga snye phaṭa/ tshe badzra dza ṭi li snyed ha da ha lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā lha ra be smi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bī ra pa tsa pa tsa lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bā g.yu be 4ge lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ stobadzra rgyu kā snyer bha kṣa bha 4kṣa ba sa ru snyi ra ant+ra mā lā ba lambi ni lhu snyi phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhakṣi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre groṇḍa groṇḍa sa sta pā tā la ga ta snyeci ci ga sa 55 tadzdza ya tadzdza ya lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ byā ma de bi snye sne phaṭa/oṃ badzra bha dra ā na ā ga 4gyi snye phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rtse ra ba sna rtswa tso snye phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya na lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bi rū 2hākṣi ’ ’ snye rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ kha hā blon ne rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le sa sum̐ snye phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ratna —badzra hūṃ ṭwāṃ lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro nye ri lhu snye phaṭa oṃ ha ya gyi ba shlau ṭī 0lhu snye phaṭa/ tshe shoṇḍi ni 4lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ā kā sha ga snye snye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra wami ṇi 5lhu ཿ phaṭa/ tshe he ru ka ska li ki li lhu 77—815

hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bī re /lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ padma na rnye shā re ( risi li si li rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bai ro tsa ni 5nyi li hi li rtu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ tsakra warti ni 4lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ badzra satwa dhi li dhi li lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bī bye ne rdu phaṭa/ oṃ tā kā phye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sku lu tsho tā lho phye cho rgyu phaṭa/oṃ shā nā phye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sru ka rā phye 5lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā snyi palhu phaṭa tshe ya ma dru ti nga rgyu phaṭa/ tshe ya ma rda: pa snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni malhu ཿ phaṭa/ 'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /dung chen phreng ba blangs nas su /lag g.yon mthe bong srin lag gis/ /gsang sngags dag ni bzlas pa bya/ /dus bzhir ji ltar —'dod pa ru/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bzlas pa bya/ /bsgom pa rtse gcig bya ba ste/ /dam tshig dang ni dam tshig sbyor/ /bza' dang bzlas pa bsdus nas su/ /cho ga bzhin du gtor ma sbyin/ /dkyil 'khor la ni ci bde bar /gcer bu skra grol 'dug pa yis/ci/ /brtul zhugs 7can gyis gtor ma sbyin /rkang pa g.yas brkyang gnas nas gsu/ /mnyam par bzhag ste phyag rgya bcing /mdzub mo mdud 5byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por rab tu sbyar/ /dpral ba'i dbus kyi phyogs su rab gzhag nas/ / gcu zhing gcu cizhing bskor nas 'di brjod do/ /oṃ ā ra sgri hoX dza snye baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ruki rī sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ byu hoḥ 'di ni gsum dang bzhi dang ni/ /lnga yi bar du brjod par bya/ /skra grol gcer bur byung ba yis/ /rnal 'byor mtho ba'i gnas nas langs/ /lho phyogs kha bltas gnas pa yis snye/ /mtshan byed du ni gtor ma sbyin/ /ci lta'i las kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /de nyid gsum gyis mngon bsngags te/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen phye nas/ /gsang sngags 'di dag rab 77—816

tu brjod/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā gyi/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa nyas/ ཿ ta/ pre ta/ pi shā ritsa/ u na mā ri da/ a pa sgru ra/ ḍā ka nge ki sgyu da yaḥ / i me ba lo sgro tsā tu sa ma ya rakṣa ma ma tshosarba si smo pra yatstsha ya bee lta / ya the// sgru tha / pi pa tha dzi sgra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha / ma ma sarba pikā ra tā ya /sad su khaṃ tshab shu ye/ sa hā yi kā pabha was 7lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad/ /bde chen mtshan gyis gar mdzad cing / /bcom ldan sku gsung thugs la bzhugs/ /ā 0li kā li mnyam byas te/ /der ni re pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /steng du 'bar ba'i re pha ni/ /'og tu 'dzag par byed pa yin/ /'dzag pa'i khu ba'i tshul can ni/ /'chi med thigs pa'i gzugs su 'gyur / /srub dang bsrub pa yang dag sbyor/ /ye shes me la las kyi rlung / /rab tu bskyod par cibyas pa yis/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dud pa 'byung / /'od zer dag ni 'bar bar byed/ /dam tshig 'khor lo des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dag bsregs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi longs spyod kyi 'khor lor song ste/ thabs des lan gsum du skor —ba byas nas/smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas gnad 'byed pa'i sgo las 'das te/ byung nas phyogs bcu'i 0'jig rten gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs pa la ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi blangs te/ spyi bo'i gtsug gser sgo dzā lan dha ra zhes bya bar zhugs te/ so'i mtshams kyi bu ga'i dang du song nas longs spyod kyi 'khor lor ngal bsos nas bsregs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyidaga' ba bskyed nas lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /des skra'i rtse mo 'bum du gshags 0pa'i cha tsam yang 'byung ba dang / 'jug pa ma rnamathong ste/77—817

dga' zhing ji ltar bde bar gnas so/ /rang lhag lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad 'di ltar rab tu brtag /bsam pa med la bsam pa ste/ /sems kyang mtshon par bya ba min/ /bsam du med pa'i sgom pa yis/ /dngos dang dngos min rnam spangs yin/ /sems kyis bsam /pa'i sems de ni/ /rnyed pa gang yin gzung bar bya/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /ḍa ma ru sgra shes rab yin/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /mtshan mo rnal 'byor ma ru bshad/ /dag pa'i chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo dag gi gzugs su bstan/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu tshogs rnam par spangs/ /ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba / /ka ni gang na'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rnal 'byor sems ni ngal bsos la/ /mya ngan 'das zhes cibastan pa yin/ /rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /he ru ka sogs dpal rnal 'byor/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs bsnams/ /sna tshogs rgyal mtshan ba dan can/ /sna tshogs rol mo sgra sgrogs shing / /sna tshogs glu yis mchod par byed / /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khyer / /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i gnas kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba / /ma mo'i bsgom par dzodabye bar bya/ /gsang sngags kun gyi gnas sbyor ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad mdzad/ /bde ba chen pos kun la khyab/ /mgon po sangs rgyas kun bdag ste/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /7 rsā ma rmā/ zhi rghaṃ / tshe ma / oṃ oṃ/pi i āḥpa / 'di ni bcom 77—818

ldan de nyid kyi/ /he ru ka ni dbang phyug mchog /mkha' la dri med zla ba yi/ /lte ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ / ro rī/ 2 93/ mkha' 'gro ma ni pad 'dab bzhugs/ /kai khaṃ gi rghaṃ rnga / rtsa chi dzi : nya/ ṭaṃ 6 ṇḍa tsā/ rta the rda dhe rna/ pi tpa lha mi/ de yi thod pa'i dum sogs dang / /gtum mig ma la sogs kun gyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu sul/ /yo ri lo waṃ/ sho ṣi haṃ / de yi khu gdong la sogs dang / /gshin rje sreg sogs kun gyi'o/ /yi ge laḥ yi bdag nyid ni/ /bde ba chen po'i shu kra'i gzugs/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas yin zhing / /kun la khyab cing rtag tu stong /brjod du med cing phra ba'i dbus/ /'di ni chad med rtag pa'i thugs/ /rang sga gzugs ni mkha' lta bu/ /'di ni bdag nyid bcings pa ste/ /'di ni dgrol la mkhas pa yin/ /'di ni lte ba'i dbus bzhugs shing / /shu kra'i gzugs kyis bde chen gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo gsum gyi dbus su dgod/ /'di ni gsang ba mchog yin te/ /gang la yang ni bstan mi bya / /sngar bshad phyag dang phyag mtshan dang / /go cha yang ni de bzhin te/ /sngar bshad bzhin du bkod nas kyang / /phung po khams dang skye mched dag /dpa' bo'i yan lag rnam dag nyid/ /byang chub phyogs kyang de bzhin te/ /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog pa yis/ /sngar bshad 'khor lo rnam par dgod/ /thams cad dkar ba'i mdog can la/ /'khor lo gsum ni bcu drug go/ /dpa' bo yang ni so sor dgod/ /rnal 'byor ma yang so sor te/ /rang gi thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /gnyis su med pa'i gnas pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i rang gi 77—819

rig pa dang / /gnyis su med par gnas pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro sogs dang khyi gdong sogs/ /rang gi thabs dang gnyis med gnas/ /de ni rdo rje snying po'o/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dam pa ste/ /mchog tu gsang ba sbas pa dag /rdo rje snying pos zhus nas ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dpal he ru ka dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bsgoms pas bskyed pa ste le'u bcu /skulnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dang po'i las kyi bsgom pa ste/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i mchog gyur pa/ /cig car du ni bskyed pa dag /rdo rje snying pos gsungs pa yin/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal rnam sgyur / /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dgaci /g.yas brkyang ba yis mgo la mnan/ /rgyan drug sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /zla ba phyed pas rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi pags pa gos su mnabs ri/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams shing / /de ni rdo rje mchog kyang gsor /phag mos kyang ni rnam par 'khril/ /de yi mdog dang phyag gis gnas / /byin pa gnyis kyis mnyam par 'khyud/ /thod pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub tshokyis / /phyogs su bsdigs shing spa grol ba / /dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska parags can /'khor la chisogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa ste/ /phyag rgya lnga ni mnyam par sbyor/ /spyan gsum pa la drag po'i gzugs / /thams cad yi dgas lagadan la bzhugs/ /sgom pa mchog gi bsgom pa'o/ /dbus su khrag 'thung tshardo rje ni/ /sngo ba'i mdog can bde ba 77—820

che / /padma'i dbus su bsgom pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ser po'i mdog /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi khyad par ni/ /dpa' bo mdog ni dag po la/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dkar ba nyid/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo ni/ /dmar po'i snamadog can cher 'bar ba/ /mkha' 'gro'ang de bzhin nag po ste/ /sku mdog gnyis su rnam par bsgom/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo ni/ /zla ba ser skyas legs brgyan pas/ /de la mkha' 'gro ma yang dmar/ /ci mi'adod gzugs su'ang 'gyur ba yin/ /khu gdong la sogs kun ljang gurtse/ /gshin rje sreg sogs kun dud ka /de ltar mdog tshogi bye brag giri / /sgom pa'i mchog gis shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma thod kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin / /cang te'u gar gyis rnam par bzhugs/ /thams cad dbu skra grol ba ste / /phyogs kyi gos can bzhan pa'i zhal/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams/ /rdo rje dril bus legs par 'khyud/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thod rdo rje/ / sdigs mdzub yodang ni lhan cig bcas/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams / /7padma dril bus rnam par brgyan / /rnal 'byor ma ni thod padma/ / rigs mdzub skudang ni lhan cig bcas/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams/ /'khor lo dril bu rab tu 'bar/ /rnal 'byor ma 'khor sdigs mdzub pacan/ /thod pa zirkang gis gang ba'o/ /khu gdong la sogs lha mo ni/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin / /gri gug dang ni sdigs mdzub tshabacas/ /gshin rje sreg sogs lha mo ni/ /cang 7te'u mgo bo sdigs mdzub 5dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ / kyil krung 5phyed pas gar dang bcas/ /dpa' bo g.yas brkyang gnas pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi byin pas 'khril/ /gnyis su med par mnyam 77—821

ldan pa/ /thugs rje chags pa'i bde ba che ri/ /ye shes 'khor lo mnyam ldan pas / /bde ba'i bde ba gcig tu 'gyur/ /chos kyi ro las yang dag 'byung / /rang ming ris bon dang bcas pa/ /phreng ba'i sngags dang mnyam par sbyar/ /gsal byed mnyam par sbyar nas su/ /snye gnyis phaṭa dang yang dag sbyar/ /dpa' bo'i gsang sngags yang dag sbyar/ /rnal 'byor ma yang de bzhin bshad/ /rang gi ming gi sa bon dbus/ /gsal byed dang ni mnyam par ldan/ /lhu snye phaṭa kyang de bzhin te/ /sngags pas ri'adi ltar sbyar bar bya/ /dbus su khrag 'thung rdo rje ste/ /gsang sngags 'di ni mkhas pas bzla/ /oṃ shrī skabadzra ji lha nye ru ru kai lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ 'i ha ha lhu snye phaṭa/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bā rā hi ri rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bee ro tsa rī tsho ye rtu rgyu phaṭa/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /dus bzhi dag tu cho ga bzhin/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bzlas pa bya/ /mdun du ba spu'i khung bu las/ /chos dang longs spyod rnam par spro/ /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bstan par bya/ /'gro ba rigs drug grol nas ni/ /bla med gnas su 'jog dzipar byed/ /sngags pas ji ltar 'dod sbyor ba/ /rigs lnga rnams kyi dbus su yang — /gang gis rigs gsum dbus khyab pa/ /khams gsum gyi ni bdag po ste /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag 'dus/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba'o/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las las dang po pa'i 7sbyor ba'i bsgom pa bstan pa ste le'u bcu drug pa'o// //rdo rje snying pos rab bshad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa ste/ /77—822

phyag bzhi po yi cho ga yis/ /dbang po bar ma 4rnam par bsgom/ /cig car skyed cu pa'i spyor ba yis/ /sgom pa dag ni rnam par bsgom/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum drag po 'jigs pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi ciganas pas bzhugs/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan gnon/ /sku lus mi mgo'i do shal can/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan mchog can te/ /zla ba byed pas rimadzes pa yin/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes rnam par mtshan/ /phyag rgya drug po drag po'i gzugs/ /sku mdog dkar po 'jigs pa ste/ /sngo zhing ljang gu dmar po ste/ /steng gi zhal gdong rnam par bsgom/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rdo rje dril bu cang te'u dang / /rdo rje phag mo mnyam par ldan/ /lha mo'i ku tshotsa 'tshir ba ste / /stag gi pags )pa gos su mdabs / /phyogs kyi gos mchog 'dzin pa ste//spa grol dum bu'i ska khorags can/ /de phyag zhal dang mdog gis mtshan/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sngo la ser/ /lā ma ljang dang ser po ste/ /dum skyes ma ni dmar la ljang / /gzugs can ma ni ser la dmar/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /gri gug mgo ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /cang te'u'i 75 ni du ma sgrogs //gcer bu skra ni grol ba ste/ /thod pa dag gis cod pan byas/ /spyan gsum pa la drag po'i zhal/ /rang gi mdog dang phyag de bzhin/ / kyil krung 7byed pa'i gar can te/ /bdud bzhi zhabs 'og gnon pa dang / /'don pas lta zhing rtog pa ste/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo ni/ /sngo dang ser bar rnam par bsgom / /de bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'ang / /dkar zhing sngo bar rnam par bsgom / /thod pa dang ni kha ma/ 'dzin/ /rdo rje dril bus legs par 'khyud/ /cang te'u yi ni sna tshogs sgra/ /rdo rje sgra ni yongs su rdzogs/ /thod pa dang ni 77—823
