sdigs mdzub snadang / /gri gug dang ni mi thod 'dzin/ /lha mo'i phyag rnams de bzhin te/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /'jigs pa chen po bzhin rnam sgyur / /rdo rje phreng ba'i cod pan byas/ /dpa' bo rdo rjes rimatshan ma'o / /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo gang / /dmar zhing gnag ri la 'jigs pa ste/ /padma'i dpa' bos rnam par khyab/ /rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ /padma'i mkha' 'gro ma de bzhin /ljang dang dkar ba'i sku lus can/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo yang //ser dang ljang ba'i sku lus can/ /'khor los dpa' bo yongs su khyab/ /'khor los sgyur ba'ang ster bar byed/ /'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma de bzhin/ /dkar dmar dang ni yid 'phrog pa / /rang gi mtshan dang yang dag ldan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /khu tshogadong sogs bzhi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sna tshogs mdog can yid 'phrog pa'o/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /gri gug mgo bo cang te'u 'dzin/ /gshin rje sreg sogs lha mo ni/ /dud kha tshadamar po de bzhin no/ /gshin rje dbyug to 7gli gug go / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin /'khor gyi ma sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /yi dgas migadan la rnam par bzhugs / /byin pa gnyis kyis ngamanyam par 'khril/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dgyes pa chepa/ /spa grol phyogs kyi gos 'chang zhing / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can / /thams cad phyag rgya lnga 'dzin cing / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor//spyan gsum drag po rnam sgyur 7ba/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa'i zas la rol/ /chags pa'i ming gis —rnam par blta5/ /sngar bshad cho ga'i rim pa bzhin/ /gsang sngags rang ming sa bon dang / /dpa' bo gsang sngags 'di ru bshad/ /77—824

mkha' 'gro ma yang de bzhin te/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags 'di nyid ni/ /gsang sngags mchog kyang de bzhin no/ /oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kai /lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/oṃ gri ha ha lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bā rā nyi bee lhu snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ badzra bee ro tsa gli ri ye lhu rgyu phaṭa gā hā / thams cad bsgoms te mthong ba na / /bdag po dang ni 'khor la sogs/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /legs par dbang bskur gzhug tshopar bya/ /bsgoms pas gcig tu byas nas ni/ /bdud rtsi mchog gis tshim par bya/ /ye shes bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo tshogs mchog spros nas ni/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mthong ba na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rim pa yis/ /dam tshig can gyis bzlas pa bya/ /'khor sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te/ /don dam bzlas par bshad pa yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dbang po bar ma'i bsgom pa bstan pa ste le'u bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje snying po'i gsang ba ste/ /gang yang de nyid rim pa dag /sgrub tsho pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /dbang po rnon po'i bsgom pa bshad/ /skyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba dag /sgom pa de yis bsgom par bya/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / /lam gyi rnam mkhyen ye shes so/ /ā li tā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /bdag nyid he ru gar yang bya/ /mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum rnam par bsgyur tshoba'i zhal/ /g.yas brkyang —ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan gyi/ /mgo bo la ni zhabs kyis gnon/ / na ra'i pags / pa gos su mdabs / /zla 77—825

ba byed pas rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes ①dbu la mnan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sku lus phyag rgya drug gis btab/ /rdo rje phag mo mnyam par ldan/ /gnyis su med par sbyor ba yi / /byin pa gnyis kyis nulegs par 'khril/ /gcer bu spa cirini grol ba ste/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska ( rags can /thod pa yi ni phreng ba ste/ /snying rje'i bde bas rnam par phyos/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pa/ /'dod pa'i chags pas bde bar dgyes/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /ral gri dang ni cang te'u 'chang / /tshangs pa'i mgo bos phyag gzhan la/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /de yi sku mdog zhal phyag mtshan/ /'on kyang gri gug 'dzin pa yin/ /gnam mdog ser skya dmar dang dkar/ /rnam thar rigasum dang sku gsum dang / /thams cad 'khor sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum g.yas brkyang gnas pas bzhugs/ /yi dgas tshogadan la brtan par gnas/ /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dkar sngo dmar/ /lā ma ljang khu 7sngo la dkar/ /dum skyes ma ni dmar dkar sngo/ /gzugs can ma ni ser sngo dmar/ /'di dag ni spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ yi dgas 7kyi steng du g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang kha masdi ga dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang /gri gug dang mgo bo medang cang te'u bsnams pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma 6rnams la shar du thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab gtum ma ste sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /byang du keng rus chen po dang gtum mig ma ste dmar ba dang dkar ba dang sngo ba'o/ /nub tu keng rus can 77—826

dang 'od ldan ma ste dkar ba dang dmar ba dang ljang khu'o༅/ /lho ru mche ba rnam par gtsigs ( nyis dang / sna chen ma ste ljang khu midang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /me'i phyogs su lha dgra dang / dpa' ba'i blo gros ma ste dmar ba dang sngo ba dang dkar ba'o/ /bden bral du 'od dpag tu med pa dang / mi'u cithung ma ste ser ba dang / sngo ba dang dkar ba'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su rdo rje 'od dang /lang ga'i dbang phyug ma ste sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje lus dang / shing grib ma ste ljang ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su myu gu can dang sa srung ma ste/ dmar ba dang sngo ba dang dkar ba'o/ /byang phyogs su rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma ste ljang ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /sto ru rdo rje snye mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste ser ba dang sngo ba dang dmar ba'o/ /me'i phyogs su rab bzang dang / sngo sangs lha mo ste ljang ba dang ser ba dang dmar ba'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su rdo rje bzang dang rab bzang ma ste sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma ste dmar ba dang sngo ba dang ser ba'o/ /dbang ldan du mig mi bzang dang bya tshogadong ma ste dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma ste dkar po dang / sngon po dang ser po'o/ /byang phyogs su rdo rje rin chen dang / dum skyes ma ste ser ba dang —/ sngo ba dang ljang gu'o7/ /nub phyogs su rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong 7ma ste dmar ba dang sngo ba dang dkar ba'o/ /lho phyogs su nam mkha'i snying po dang 77—827

'khor lo'i go cha ma ste sngo ba dang dmar ba dang ljang gu'o3/ /me'i phyogs su khrag 'thung ridang / rab dpa' mo ste ljang gu ridang ser po dang dmar po'o/ /bden bral du padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen mo ciste dkar rib dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /rlung gi phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma ste ljang ba dang / dmar ba dang ser ba'o/ /dbang ldan gyi daphyogs su rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nam mkha'i mdog can sngo sangs dzodang ser ba dang ljang gu'o / /shar phyogs kyi sgor khu gdong ma ste sngo ba dang ser ba dang dmar ba'o/ /byang du lug gdong ma ste ljang gu skudang /dmar ba dang dkar ba'o/ /nub tu khyi gdong ma ste ser ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'omu /lho ru phag gdong ma ste dmar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o / /me'i phyogs su gshin rje sreg ma ste dkar ba dang sngo ba dang ljang gu'o'i/ /bden bral du gshin rje pho nya ma ste sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su gshin rje mche ba ma ste dud kha dang dmar ba dang / dkar ba'o/ /dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma ste dmar ba dang sngo ba dang dkar ba'o/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa rtsodang / rab gtum ma la sogs pa rdo rje dril bus mnyam par ldan pa ral gri dang / cang te'u dang / mgo bo dang thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ padma padma'i dril bu dang / /'khor lo 'khor lo'i dril bu ste/ /sku gsung dag ni gnyis po yang / /thugs kyi 'khor lo ji lta ba'o/ /lha mo cang te'u ral gri dang / /gri gug yang rshani de bzhin te/ khu gdong la sogs pa ni ral gri dang / cang te'u dang gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang mgo bo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /gshin rje sreg ma la sogs pa ni thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang 77—828

ral gri dang lcags kyu dang / cang te'u dang dril bu dang mgo bo 'dzin pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan /pa/ na ra'i pags tsho pa mdabs cig/ dpa' bo rnams ni g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa/thod pa'i zeng ba can / rang gi rigs kyi cod pan can/ yi dgas kyi steng na bzhugs pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril ba/gcer bu skra grol ba/ dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska rags can/ khu gdong ma la sogs pa dang / gshin rje sreg ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni gcer bu spa grol ba/ yi dgas tsho kyi steng du g.yas brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ gsus pa parlo ba/ skye gnas ring ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal mnga' ba/thugs rje'i chags pa'i ros rnam par myos pa/ 'jigs pa'i g.yo bas 'jigs su rung ba/ 'di ltar ma lus bsgoms nas meni/ /ye shes 'khor lo mthong ba na / /ye shes chu sogs arga skudang / /dam tshig mchog gis ngamachod par bya/ /mthong ma thag tu dbang yang bskur/ /mchod nas thim par byas nas ni/ /ye shes bzlas pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /btab nas 'thor 'thung rab tu bya/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i spyor ba yis/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub thob pa yin/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bzlas byas nas/ /'chi med ye shes lnga lhan cig /gsang sngags khro bo'i tshig gis bzla/ /bde ba'i dngos grub ster bar mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus thams cad bya/ /mnyam par bzhag ste bzlas pa bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga bzhin/ /rnal 'byor bzlas pa don chen ster/ /rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro dpa'/ /mngon sum du ni mchog kyang stsol/ /oṃ shrī badzra a 7nye he 77—829

ru ru ke lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ /a ā/ i yī/ u u/ e i/ bzhilhas / me aḥ snye snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ trīḥha riha lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bee ro tsa gli ye lhu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba bud dha rnga ki gli ye badzra waṇḍi rī ri ye lhu 3 phaṭa gā hā 3/dpal khrag 'thung dang / phag mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā gi gli ṭwāṃ lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me rmā rtu sne phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he khaṃ lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi tī ye rgyu /lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra rka lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍi lhu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ ku ru ku ru mi 'i sne phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇa 7 kṣi 7 snye phaṭa/ oṃ bharnya bharnya kai tsholhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba ti 5lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya tpa lhu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ ma hā nā 5se lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ khyo bha ya kṣiṃ bha ya sum̐ rtu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ bī ra ma ti 7lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ hre hre māṃ ci hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ra ba ri nya phaṭa / oṃ hraḥhraḥ lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ la shwa ri dngha rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ dze dze lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ dru ma ye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa i lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ i rā ba ti 5lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha bai rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rtse ra ba lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ pa tsa pa tsa mi lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa baṃ rib sa ru rnyi ra ant+ra mā salā —ba lo bi ni tsholhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhakṣi lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ groṇḍa gros sum̐ sa sta pā tā la ga ta bhu rdza ga sa bā ta ya ta ya lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ sgyu ri ma de bi lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā ga ā na snye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre ci hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hri sgyu mi lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya ku1 rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ smo ’ ga lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ kha hā rtson ne lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sde lhu hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ tsakra be ge lhu phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ traṃ lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro ho ce lhu phaṭa/oṃ ṭī ṭī garta lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇḍi ni ri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ snye ri haṃ snye snye phaṭa/77—830

tshe tsakra wa ṇi ①lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ska li ki li ho chi rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li bai lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le sum̐ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ nyi li nyi li 4lhu phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti ni lhu sne phaṭa/ tshe dhi li dhi li spyo phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā gri ri )bye lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā gye lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lu kā gye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ thā nā gye tsholhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sru 7ka rā gye 7lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma tā snyi ma sne phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dra ti 5lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma de brtu snye phaṭa/oṃ ya ma ma tha ni me snye phaṭa/ 'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /bzlas dang bsgom pa byas nas ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsi bsgom byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor bas gnas/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las/ dbang po rnon po'i sgom 7pa rjes su bstan pa'i le'u ste —bco 5brgyad pa'o// //rdo rje snying pos gsungs pa/ de nas mchog gi dam pa bshad/ /mnyam par sbyor ba'i sdom 7pa dag /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi sdom pa mchog /cig car 'jug pa mthong nas su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms nas spro/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /ho ru kur ni bdag nyid byas / /ser dang sngo dang ljang gu ste/ /steng ni dkar po zhi ba'o/ /dbu rgyan thod pa'i cod pan can/ /spyan gsum thugs rje drag po ste/ /phag mo yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan gyi/ /mgo la g.yas brkyang gnas pas bzhugs/ /drag po gdul dka' gdul 5mdzad cing / /bgegs rnams thams cad 'dul bar mdzad/ /zla ba gyed dang ral pa 'chang rī/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam par gnon/ /sku la phyag rgya drug gis mtshan/ /77—831

phyag rgya sdom pa mchog yin te/ /stag gi pags 0pa gos su mnabs(mi/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje phag mo dmar mo ste/ /gcer bu spa ni grol ba yin/ /de yi sku dang zhal dang mtshan/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril / /thod pa'i phreng riba'i dbu rgyan can/ /mchu dang mchu ni pi di dam/ /g.yer kha yi ni sku rags can/ /rigs kyi dga' bas rnam par myosari ri/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas/ /phag mo yi ni ku tsa 'dzin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /zhags pa lcags kyu mchog kyang 'dzin/ /tshangs pa'i pags tsho pa brkyang nas ni/ /mgo bo'i steng du phyag gis 'dzin/ /cang te'u'i /sgra ni snyan pa dag /chos kyi sgras ni rab tu 'gengs/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi thad du ni/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi po rnam par bsgom/ /g.yas phyogs mkha' 'gro ma lā ma/ /byang du dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /sngo dang ngur thig dkar la ser/ /spyan gsum rnam bsgyur drag po dang / /dkar sngon 2lngang dmar ngur thig ste7/ /de ni rab tu cher 'bar ba'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyogs su bsgoms nas ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /g.yon phyogs dmar dang sngo dang ljang / /dkar po steng gi zhal de bzhin/ /ljang dang dmar po ser po ste/ /steng gi sngon po bde ba'ang de/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /phyogs kyi cigos mchog 'chang ba dang / /spa grol ba ni 'jigs pa ste/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /bdud bzhi po ni zhabs 'og gnon/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rdo rje mdung 5ni phyag na bsnams/ /na lara'i pags —pa gos su mdabs / /dril bu cang te'u de bzhin te/ / mgo bo'i tshogi gug phyag na bsnams/ /g.yer kha'i —ska rags sgra sgrogs 'i pa/ /rkang lo77—832

rgyan ru lu ru lu'i sgra/ /sna tshogs padma'i steng du ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus bzhugs te/ /gdan gcig la ni rnam par bzhugs/ /snying la dam tshig ye shes ni/ /de mdog phyag dang phyag mtshan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /mi bskyod /3pa yi cod pan can/ /thams cad de ltar bsgoms nas ni/ /mtshan dang dpe byad dang bcas pa/ /ye shes gcig tu byas nas ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi sdom pa bzla / /oṃ aḥshrī badzra he ho ru ru kai rnga gi nī dzā la sa ba lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ trīḥha ha hūṃ snye phaṭa/ oṃ āX badzra bā rā nyi gye be/ spre ki gli dzā la sa re lhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ badzra bee ro tsa rī ye rtu snye phaṭa gā hā/dpal khrag 'byung dang phag mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni /lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra lā me lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra khaṇḍa ro ho nga snye phaṭa/oṃ badzra rū pi ṇi lhu rgyu phaṭa / 'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /bzlas pa dang ni bsgom pa bya/ /dus bzhi'i rjes 'brang rim pa yis/ /dam tshig sdom pa gnyis med pa/ /mar me lnga yang bza' bar bya/ /rtag tu dur khrod nang du bsgom / /nub bdun du ni sbyor ba yis/ /mi snang dngos grub nges par 'grub / /mthong bar byed par yang kun 'gro/ /sna tshogs gzugs can bde ba che / /bza' ba rnams ni bza' bya zhing / / skom gyi 5btung ba'ang de bzhin te /phyogs kyi gos can gang gis cini/ /myos shing myos pa lta 5bur gnas/ /grib ma yang ni med pa ru/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnam par spyod/ /ma hā ru snyi ra bcas pa'i / /dri chen chu 7ni mnyam ldan pas/ /rmā cis sna tshogs du ma dag /rtse gcig pa yi tshabaza' ba bza'/ /dang gi bdag nyid sbyor ldan pas/ /rtag tu zhen pas 'gro bar bya/ /mnyamapar ma bzhag sbyor ba'i bdag /ye shes 77—833

mig gis mthong ba yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sbyor ba'i sdom pa'i cho ga ste le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /cho ga bzang po bzhin du 6)ni/ /zhal brgyad pa la phyag bcu drug /yang na ri zhal ni bcu gnyis te/ /phyag ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o / /yang na sna tshogs phyugs kyi zhal/ /phyag ni brgya dang ldan par bya/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang gzungs ridang ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'ang de bzhin te/ /phan tshun bye brag can gyi cazhal/ /mdog gi bye brag sna tshogs dang / /phyag ni stong dang 'bum gyi bar/ /sna tshogs phyag mtshan 'dzin pa dang / /sna tshogs pa yi zhal ldan pa/ /sna tshogs pa yi gar mdzad cing / /g.yas brkyang ba yi g.yengs pas bzhugs/ /'jigs byed chen po dang / dus mtshan la sogs pa dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / nye dbang dang / drag po dang /khyab 'jug dang / kun 'gyed rigazhon nu dang / tārti ri )ka dang / dag po chen po dang / dga' byed dbang rgyug dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang /ku be ra dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / sna tshogs pa'i bdud dang /bgegs thams cad kha sgrub tu zhabs kyis mnan par rnam par chibaltas te /'jigs su rung ba/ bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba/ drag po mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ bzhad rtepa/ mi sdug pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa/ dpa' ba/sgeg pa/ rngam pa/ smin ma 7rnam par g.yo ba/ snyems pa/ zhi ba/ g.yo ba/mig zugayo ba/ zhal rnam par gdangs pa/ rnam par rol pa / ljags rnam 77—834

par skyod yi)pa/ sna tshogs pa'i nyams kyis mchog ster bar mdzad pa'o/ /thod pa'i phreng ba dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu la mnan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' spyi gtsug brgyan/ /spyan gsum stag gi pags pa mdabs / /mgo zla'i phreng bas sku lus brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug po sku la rdzogs/ /phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spun mdzad pa'o/ /sku la phag mos 'khril mdzad cing / /phyogs kyi gos can spa grol ba/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska rags can/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan can te/ /rdo rje sdigs mdzub thod pas 'khyud/ /byin pa gnyis kyis mnyam par 'khyud/ /dga' bas khyab cing rnam par myos/ /rdo rje dril bus mnyam par ldan/ /lha mo'i ku tsa 'tshir ba dang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /glang po'i pags ( pa brkyang ba ste/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dgra sta dang / /mdung rtse gsum pa mgo bo nyid/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug dang / /mda' dang gzhu yang de bzhin te/ /thod pa'i dbyug to dzomadung thung dang / / sdigs mdzub stodang ni gtun shing dang / /'khor lo ral gri rin chen dang / /padma sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /dbyug to yu ba rdo rje can/ /ga da mdung dang pa ti sa / /gshin rje dbyug to muchu gri dang / /dung dang rwa dung pa ṭa ha/ /pi wang skugling bu rdza rnga che/ /tshu rnga mtshon cha phyag mtshan bsnams/ /rtse mo rno bar bltas nas su/ /sna tshogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'byung / /ji srid phyag ni 'bum gyi bar / /phyag rgya sna tshogs de bzhin te/ /cho ga sna tshogs de bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs 'khor rnams dang / /dpa' bo dag ni thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni sna tshogs dag /mdog ni mtha' yas sna tshogs mdog /phyag 77—835

mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa yin/ /phyogs kyi gos 'chang skra grol zhing / /sna tshogs nyams kyi 0bde ba can/ /'jigs rung drag po ha ha bzhad/ /sna tshogs gar gyis longs spyod cing / /glu dang rol mo nyams de bzhin/ /sna tshogs dam tshig zas rnams dang / /me tog ri sna tshogs yid 'ong ba/ /dri dang bdug pa de bzhin gos/ /mar me phreng ba yid 'ong ba/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa rnams /mdog ni sna tshogs mchog dam pa/ /'di ltar sngags pas bsgoms nas ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis rdzogs byas nas/ /der ni phreng ba sngags kyang bzlas/ /yi ge nyi shu gnyis bsres nas/ /lha mo rdo rje phag mo ni/ /'di ltar de bzhin bsgom par bya/ /zhal gdong sna tshogs legs mdzes pa/ /phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa ste/ /phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba/ /byang chub pha rol phyin pa ste/ /sa 'dzin thams cad de bzhin no/ /'di ltar cho ga byas nas ni /phreng bas gsang sngags bzla bar ribya/ /oṃ shrī badzra ho he ru ru rka/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ brnya brnya/ tā cas ya tā sa ya/ khyo bha ya khyo bha ya/ hre hre / hraḥhraḥm tse/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha kṣa bha kṣa/ba sa ru rnyi ra/ ant+ra mā lā ba lo bi ni / groṇḍa groṇḍa / sasta pā tā la ga ta bhu rdza ga sarba ma pā tadzdza ya ta ya/ ā ke ā na / spyo spyo/ smo ’ / / hūṃ hūṃ/ shlau ṭī/ sne hūṃ/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ gyi pi nyi li/dhi li dhi li/ : rgyu rgyu phaṭa ngaphaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sasba ma dza snye phaṭa gā hā/'di ni snying po mchog yin te/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa dge/ /dpa' bos sa bon rang ming dang / /rnal 'byor mos pas gartag bzlas na/ /ma lus lus pa med 'grub cing / /'gro ba'i gnas su 'gro bar byed/ /dus ni de ma 77—836

thag tu yang / /sdom pa mchog ni grub pa yin/ /rdo rje phag mo'i gsang sngags 'di / /'dod pa'i bde ba thams cad stsol/ /oṃ badzra bā rā hi pro taṅge pro taṅge/ha na ha na/ pra ṇa na / skab ṇi / khikhri ṇi byusgro na ji na/ badzra ha ste/sho ṣa ya/ sho ṣa ya/ badzra ka pā la / kha 1sgo dhā ri ṇi/ ma hā pi sha te/mā na risna sha ni/ mā /nu ṣa adma ṅgā sbos / sna 7rgya na ra shi ro mā lā gran thi ta dhā ri ṇi/ su ni su rsha/ ha na ha na sbri ṇa na/ sarba pā pa sa tā rna /sa pa shu —4/ ma hā māṃ —sa: da grici/ kro dha 5rte rda rgyu ka rā li ni ma hā mu dre / shrī —nye ru ka de ba su / a gra ma gyi ṣi/ sa ha sra shi 5re/ sa ha sra bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra ā na ne/ dzwa 4li ta te dza se/ dzwa sal mu khe/ dzi ga stsol lo tsa ne badzra sha tso'i re badzra ā sa ne snye/ mi li mi li / ti mi li ti mi li he he ha ha ri snye rgyu kha kha/ sgro ji ru ru/ ji ru sgro ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a rwa te/ma hā yo gi ni pa khri ta si / dre lha dro lhaci/ gre gre he ho ha ha ga me ha sa ha sa / bī re/ hā hā ho ho — rghaṃ/ tre lo kya tha nā shā ni/ sha ta sa ha sra cako ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri bā ri te ga hūṃ phaṭa/ so ha ru pe khaḥg dza rū pe gaḥ tre snyelo mya da 6re/ sa mu dra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa snye rghaṃ phaṭa/ bī rā rwa te lhu snye hāḥhāḥ / ma hā pa shu chimo ha ni/ ma hā g.yo gli shwa ri āoṃ snye/ ḍā ri ki gri sarba lo tā mi / brnya glig/ sabya sa pra tya ya tī ra ṇi lhu snye phaṭa/ ཿ ta tā sa ni / ma hā bī re pa ra ma si yo gli — ri pyi phaṭa/ lhu snye phaṭa/ snye rgyu phaṭa rmuzhwa hā/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /'di ni rdo rje phag mo mchog /snying po mchog tu grub pa yin/ /gang gis bzlas dang bsgom pa yisapa/ /de yis las rnams kun 'grub riste/ /the tsom dzimed par mod la 'grub/ /bdag nyid 77wa 837

gnas su mchod pa ste/ /phyi rol nam yang ma yin no/ /grub pa'i khrag 'bung de nyid kyi/ /gsang sngags rtsa ba brgyad ldan pa/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa dzi te bī re shā ya lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā gawa a ga ni sa bhā snyeya lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭa mu miku ṭo da ka ṭā ya lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ de ka rā lo gra gli ṣa na mu khā ya lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza sgyu su rā ya lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho bya ta shu ru la kha ṭwāṃ ga khyu ri ṇi tsholhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ byā za dzi na me pa ra dha rā 7ya lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dma mārnya ske kā ra wa rshabu ṣā ya lhu snye phaṭa/ 'di ni khrag pa'athung lagasang sngags te/ /bdag nyid bsgom zhing mchod par bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti 7badzra bā rā gyi baṃ lhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ārya sngos pa rā ri dzi te tram̐ lo kya mā gte ma hā bibye shwa ri ci : phaṭa/ oṃ sarba sbru gta bha yā —ba he ma hā badzre lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ badzā sa de a dzi te a snyepa rā dzi te wa tsho/ ka ri ne tra bhā ma ṇi cho lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ sho ṣa ṇi snyer ṣa ṇi 5kro dha ni byu ka rā 4li ni rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ tā tsos ni mā ra ṇi risu pra sge gad ni pa rā dza ye lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tha dza ye dze bha ni rteste bha cini ci mo ha ni lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bā rā gnyi ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge rtu hūṃ phaṭa na maḥni thams cad du bya'o/ /gsang sngags 'di yis las kun bya/ /ā —li kā li rdo rje ni/ /phag mo bdag nyid bsgoms byas nas snye/ /rtsa chab brgyad kyi sngags ldan pas/ /bdag nyid kyang ni mchod par bya/ /zhal bzhi byin brlabs snyebyas nas su/ /oṃ su ni su sa mchod/ /yang na zhal bzhi kun rdo rje/ /de yi lte bar he ru dpal/ /bdag nyid bsgom pa byas nas 4ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'ang de bzhin bsgom/ /ba sha la sogs bza' zhing bsgrub —/ /bde gshegs bstan la snye'agro ba gdugag /skye ba can ni ba shar 77—838

grags /dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog dang / /mtshams med pa ni byed pa dang / /gang zhig slob dpon smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po smod pa dang / /phyugs de rnams ni bsad nas kyang / /rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig bza'/ /byugs de rnams ni dgug pa yang / /sgrub pos sngon du bskyed pas bya/ /phyugs bdun dang ni de bzhin phyugs/ /bong bu mi /dang ru sbal dang / /khyi dang rnga mo ce skuspyang rta/ /phyugs kyi mar me 'di rnams ni/ /grub capa'i dbye ba'i yan lag grags/ /rigs kyi kha dog dbye ba'i phyugs/ /rkang bzhi rnams la glang po che/ /bya rnams las ni ngang sgyur te/ /dud 'gro rnams las mchu g.yo ba'i/ /lha rnams kha ru lha bshos te/ /'di ni phyugs kyi brtag par bshad/ /grub pa'i sgrub pa rnam bshad pa/ /bya rog bya skya ce spyang dang / /skye gnyis dang sngags chen po dang / / khrung khrung ci bzhad dang nang bu ka /bza' dang sbyin sreg gtor ma bya/ /dngos 'grub tsho'adod pas bsgom bya ba/ /khyi mo dag mo'i tsha'o ma dang / /sran 7ma dag po 'bras dang ldan/ /ro yi khar ni sbyin sreg bya/ /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad par bya/ /de nas ro de langs nas sum/ /ci bgyi zhes ni smrar ca'agyur zhing / /sa 'og 'gro ba'am ral gri'am/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs nyid dang ni/ / ri lu 5mig sman gser rnams sam/ /rkang mgyogs tshadag gam bcud kyis len/ /gcig cig sbyin par byas nas ni/ /'gro bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /steng dang 'og tu pho nya 'grub/ /rgyud 'dir the tshom /shā ༵ byi py-i /ga'i le'u/ma ṭwāṃ py-i /kā /rjod pa'i rgyud 7bla ma'i bla ma las rnal 'byor gyi 77—839

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /srung /dang phyir zlog rim pa ni/ /rgyud gzhan las ni sbas pa yi/ /sung ba'i mchog ni rnyed dka' ba/ /rgyud 'dir rab tu bshad par bya/ /nges brjod rgyud ni bla ma'i bla / /the tshom za bar mi bya ste/ /sems can rjes su bsrung ba'i phyir/ /padma 'dab brgyad bri bar bya//padma'i lte bar ge sar can/ /de rgyab sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /gnod mdzes gsang sngags yang dag sbyar/ /de yi phyi rol ska rags bya/ /'dab tshom bcu drug bri bar bya/ /der ni cha rnams rnam bkod de/ /de yis phyi rol yongs su bskor /mkhas pas lte bar bri ba dzhani/ /rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ /de yi lte bar dgod pa ni/ /snye ni 'jigs pa rnam 'jigs pa/ /snye gi lte bar yi ge bo/ /rba gyi lte bar 5yi ge gsum/ /bsgrub bya'i ming dang spel zhing bri/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni bzhi po dag /de yi g.yon nas dgod bskor ba/ /ṭwāṃ lo bakhe rī bde ru dgod / / ṛ dzā bla lī 5lhan cig tu/ /mkha' 'gro dgod cing ming dang ni/ /rnam par spel zhing bri bar bya/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rim ci tshabazhin/ /mkhas pas 'dab rtsomar dgod bya ba / /khaṃ pre shar gyi 'dab tshom la/ /byang du kai rtsa rtsonyid yin te/ /nub tu kai tpa kho na'o/ /lho ru tpa mi nyid yin no/ /me sogs dbang ldan phyogs rnams su/ /sum̐ ri tpa ma 5kho bo lo hre / /'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yisaci/ /yi ge hūṃ dang spel nas su/ /sa bon dag ni bri bar bya/ /rka khaṃ gi rghaṃ rnga / rtsa chi dzi/ 'di dag ni padma'i ska rags risu bri'o/ /rdo rje cha ni bcu gnyis pa/ /bskor la bin dus rnam par brgyanas/ /'dab ma'i phyi rol bcu drug tu/ /'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa bri/ /de 'dir shar phyogs lha sogs pa/ /g.yon nas bskor zhing dgod par bya/ /mkha' 'gro dang ni dpa' 77—840

bo'o / / māṃ a mi mi / sum̐ sum̐ māṃ sum̐ rmu chirta dzi ci / mi rtsa ro khaṃ haṃ i rtsa ho sum̐ pi mi bo rtsa mi/ 'di ni hri dang spel nas su/ /oṃ dang spel zhing bri bar bya/ /bsgrub pa'i ming ni nang du bya/ /ji lta'i las kyi rjes 'brang bri//’ nya ṭaṃ rṣa ḍi snye ṇi/ rta the rda dhe /rna/ paṃ pho lha pa / phyi rol du ska rags bri'o/ /'khor lo'i phyi rol gru dzobazhi pa'i/ /nang du sgo ni 'brel zubar bri / /ji ltar/ khu zigadong la sogs rim pa'i bar/ /gshin rje 'joms sogs sa bon dgod/ /kai i sī sbo pa yam̐ yo yo/ yo ṛ lo waṃ sho ṣi haṃ sbyar zhing / rgyu ma stophaṭa dang rnam par spel/ /ming dang yang ni spel bar bya/ /sgo yi steng du rtse bzhi pa'i/ /rdo rje phyed pa bri bar bya/ /zur rnams su ni nyi zla dang —/ /rdo rje byed pa bri bar bya/ /de steng rkang brgyad kyis brjod pa'i/ /khro bo brgyad pa'i zhal du blta/ /phyi rol ska rags dbus dag tu/ /phyir zlog sku'adi dag bri bar bya/ /na maḥs manta tshokā ya bā ga tsista badzra nye ru kā rna / oṃ hūṃ badzra he 5ru ka tsakra warnyi snyesarba lo ki ka lo kod ta rā ci'i/ yant+ra mant+ra tant+ra tsā 5pra yo hā dri byuni ye na ke na tsid kri tā ni sablo ṇi a ku ā na /tadzdza ya ta snyeya/ groṇḍa groṇḍi / bha kṣa ya bha kṣa ya/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ rgyu / ’ sna / ma tha ma tha bi can sa ya tha can ya/ sha ta sa ha sra dha tsusto ya/ ci phaṭa/ badzra he ru ko: ṣa gtsakra ba sata gye ba mu khaṃ tsakyur 2brnya brnya/ snye rgyu/ a mu ka su gyushārnyi ku ru hūṃ snye phaṭa/ oṃ su hā / 'di yis yongs su bskor byas nas/ /kṣa yi lto ba'i dbus su dgod ci/ /yi ge kṣa yi phyi rol du/ /thā 0yis yongs su bskor byas nas/ / dbyangs kyi mtshan nyid kyis yongs bskor/ /he ru nar 77—841

bdag bsgoms byas nas/ /yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyang bzla1)/ /oṃ 'iḥ ha ha a mu ka su shārnyi ku ru shārnyi ku ru / rgyu 4)snye pā paṃ ri phaṭa/ rigs ngan yang na bram ze'am/ /rgyal po'i bu mo'i khyad par du/ /rang byung me tog blangs nas su//glang chen me tog dang bsres dang ge/ /byang chub sems ni mnyam ldan pa/ /ro tsa na dang lhan cig sbyar/ /padma rdo rje chu de bzhin/ /mig sman chen po dang bsres nas/ /lha mchog 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /rdo rje phreng bas rnam par bskor//mi yi pags pa'am gro ga'am/ /yang na skuyi dgas tshogos kyang rung / /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /mar dang 'o ma blangs nas su/ /gsang sngags rkang pa brgyad ni —brjod/ /de bzhin brtul zhugs can gyis mchod/ /gser ram dngul gyi bum pa dag /ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi / chus/ /gang ba'i dbus su bcug nas su/ /'khor lo srad bu dkar pos dkri/ /phreng ba'i gsang sngags de la bzla/ /de nas dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /nad yod pa ni nad med byed /nad med pa yang nad du byed/ /myos byed chang gi dbus su ni/ /mkhas pas de la bcug nas ni/ /nad med nad du byed pa ste/ /ji lta'i las kyi rjes su 'brang / /gang yang rung ba'i las rnams la/ /phreng ba'i sngags kyis rnam par bskor/ /rnal 'byor sgrub 7pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /mgo bo'i dang du sbas byas na / /mkha' 'gros de la byin rlabs ni/ /gdon mi za bar byed par 'gyur / /ci 'dod thams cad 'grub 'gyur te/ /bgegs med par ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las sung 7ba'i phyir zlog /rtegi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //77—842

de nas de yi bsgom pa bshad/ /sems can kun la phan 'dogs pa'i/ /skad cig gis ni bdag nyid dag /lha mo phyir bzlog /rim pa ste/ /zhal bzhi pa la 6phyag bcu drug /gdug pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /bgegs ni padma'i 'og mnan nas/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus na gnas/ /dkar zhing sngo la dmar dang ser/ /steng gi zhal gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /na bza' dkar ba'i rgyan dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi ridabu rgyan can/ /'chi cib yang dag 'tsho ba'i mchog /spyan gsum pa la 'jam pa'i ngag /gzhan ni gdug cing gtum pa la/ / sdigs mdzub rdo rje gsor mdzad cing / /dril bu zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchog /rdo rje ral gri mdung dang ni/ /dgra sta thod pa lcags kyu dang —/ /gzhu dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /mda' ni dam par 'dengs par byed /tho ba 'khor lo mi 'jigs pa/ /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ba'o/ /yang na 'di la zhal brgyad pa / /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i ngos dag tu/ /g.yas pa sngo zhing dmar la ser/ /drag shul ha har bzhad pa'o/ /g.yon pa ljang zhing dmar ba dang / /dud kha tshodag gi mdog can yin/ /steng ni mdzes shing zhi ba ste/ /sku lus zla ba'i mdog can no/ /de yi thugs kur 'khor lo ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /dad pas shin tu mnyam bzhag ste/ /'chi ba 'tsho ba'i rig 7sngags bzla/ /oṃ a sgo ta sa dzī bā ni/ ma hā a mṛ chota su mu khe ṭī me / pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ sarba badzra padma sa ma yo ge ma hā tshabo rnyi tsista bi 5 5tha ta myur te tsholhu rgyu / a ā/ me aḥ ha gsu hā/ 'di ni khri tsam bzlas byas pas/ /'chi ba thams cad 'tsho bar byed/ /dus min 'chi ba 77—843

zhi 'gyur zhing / /'chi ba las ni nges par slong / /gzhan du rnal 'byor ma dgyes nas/ /rmad du byung bar mdzad pa ni/ /so so nas ni gar /mdzad cing //gyi nyi dag gis dga' ba dang / /ho ho dag gis dgyes pa dang / /he he dag gis tshig tu smra/ / hūṃ hūṃ dag gis rdzogs pa'o/ / snye snye cadag ni bsam gtan no/ /phaṭa phaṭa dag gis gsod pa dang / / hūṃ snye ri phaṭa kyis phur bu'o /dzaḥ dzaḥdag gis legs par drongs/ /sa sa dag ni bden par byed/ /nges par legs so zhes pa'i sgra'o / /snye /bo —dag ni gsod pa'o/ /ཿ rbha ju dkuhūṃ snye dag ni thal bar rlog pa'o/ /ha ha dag gis gsal bar byed pa'o/ / sum̐ rtse skadag ni gzi byin byed/ / hro hro chodag gis legs par drongs/ / nu spya skudag ni mchod pa'o/ /sa sa dag gis dngos grub thams cad kyi 'bras bu ster ba'o /nyi hi dag ni rmongs pa'o/ /lo lo dag ni shis pa'o/ /di di dag ni 'dzin pa'o/ / dzi dzi tshadag ni legs par drongs/ / rgyu rgyu gdag ni 'khor ba'o / /tri tri dag ni gsod tshopa'o/ / dze rdza dag ni rmugs par mdzad pa'o/ /ho ho mdzad pa rjes su chags par bya'o/ /ha ha dag ni srung 5ba'o/ / ho ho dag ni dgyes pa'o/ / ṭa ṭa codag ni gdug skepa'o/ / hūṃ lha —dag ni me tog go / /gi gi ni dri'o/ /raṃ raṃ ni gsang ba'o/ /'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /zhi ba la sogs cho ga yi/ /rim pa 'di la rjes su gnas/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las 'chi ba slong bar byed pa'i las thams cad byed pa sgom pa bstan pa ste le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan gsang bshad bya ba/ /sngags kyi de nyid cho ga'i rim/ /rdo 77—844

rje snying pos bshad pa ste/ /gsang ba kun gyi mchog tu bshad/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma yi brgyud /pa'i rim/ /rigasang zhing gsang la mchog tu gsang / /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bsam gtan bsgom pa'i mchog yin te/ /bdag nyid he ru kur byas nas/ /mkha' 'gro mas ni yongs su khyab/ /sku lus dmar po 'jigs pa che/ /ye shes lnga las nges byung ba/ /dmar zhing sngo la ljang ba dang / /ser zhing zhi la steng zhal dkar/ /spyan gsum pa la phyag bcu gnyis/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ / 'jigs byed che dang dus mtshan dag /skyabs su 'ongs nas zhabs 'og gnon / /phyag rgya drug dang zla ba phyed/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ral pa 'chang / /glang po'i pags 4pa gos su mnabs / /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /ral gri mdung ni 'jigs pa'i mchog /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /zhags pa lcags kyu 'chang ba'i mchog /cang te'u tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /de mdun rdo rje phag mo ni/ /de yi mdog dang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /zhags pa lcags kyu 'chang ba'i mchog /cang te'u tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / /mgo po'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /gnyis med sbyor ba mnyam ldan pa/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /kṣaḥtshoyi ye shes las byung ba/ /de yi sku dang zhal phyag mtshan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom / /bcu gnyis cha las nges 'byung ba/ /dam tshig sems dpa' bde ba che / /thams cad mkhyen pa nges 'byung ba/ /sngags kyi rgyud ni 'di ru bzla/ /77—845

oṃ shrī badzra nye he ru ru kai/ a ā/ mi gli/ mu u/ e ma / o sna ri aḥ ḍā ki bhā dzā la sa ro ri hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a ā maX kyi phaṭa/snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra wā rā gyi/ a a/ i khyu/ u u/e i / rma yo/ me ma lhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ badzra bee ro tsa gli ye/ a ma e aḥ lhu snye phaṭa su hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki ni ro lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ lā me rī tsholhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro nye mu / lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi zu ngalhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ka pasna tshal kai lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ the lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ nang tā tshal khaṃ lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ rtsa lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nang kā la gi 0rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bre lhu rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi ka ṭa rda ji 5 rghaṃ lhu chahūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bee ri ni rnga cha sne phaṭa/ oṃ bi lhu ma phaṭa / oṃ a mi tā bha rtsa lhu tsha phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ lhu — phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pra bha chi lhu 3hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lo lhu ga phaṭa/ oṃ badzra de ha dzi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ snye sne lhu sne phaṭa oṃ i ku ri ka : lhu ga phaṭa/ oṃ ma rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dzā ṭi cil rnya lhu la phaṭa/ oṃ mi lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bī 4ra ṭaṃ ho rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ tpa lhu ci phaṭa/ oṃ badzra snye spru gyur 6 lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dra ḍa lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ snye lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra lha 'idra snye 5lhu sto phaṭa/oṃ sum̐ lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ snyem hā rtse ri ra ba ṇi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ha lhu 'i rgyu phaṭa/oṃ bi rū pā kṣi rta lhu ri rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba la tho lhu ci phaṭa/oṃ rtsa rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ratna badzra rda lhu lo phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ lhu sa phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya gli ba dhe sum̐ rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sho lhu sto phaṭa/ oṃ ā 4kā gsha ga rna lhu di phaṭa/oṃ rtsa lhu 5snye phaṭa/ oṃ he ru ka cho lhu dzi phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ rtu dzi phaṭa/ oṃ padma 77—846

na rte yi)sha ra tsho lhu ri ri phaṭa/ oṃ mi lhu ci phaṭa/ oṃ bee ro tsa na bee lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ rtsa lhu ri ta phaṭa/ oṃ badzra satwa rghaṃ lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ mi lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ yo lhu /risnye phaṭa/ oṃ re lhu tsha phaṭa/ oṃ lo rtu 7nu phaṭa/ oṃ waṃ lhu pa phaṭa/ oṃ sho gyi sku phaṭa/ oṃ ṣi lhu ci phaṭa/ oṃ sa rtu ma phaṭa/ oṃ ha lhu la phaṭa/'di dag ni dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor gyi snying po'i gsang sngags gsang ba'i mchog tu gyur pa de nyid sbas pa 'khor lo gsum gyi yin te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dmar/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sngon po ste/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /'jigs byed chen po bzhin rnam bsgyur / /zhe sdang gis khyab bde chen po/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dpa' bo dkar/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dmar po ste/ /padma dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /'dod chags gis mkhyab bde chen po/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo ser / /mkha' 'gro ma dkar me yi mdog /gti mug gis khyab bde ba che/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs lha mo rnams/ /sna tshogs mdog can snod chen po'o/ /khu sngogadong la sogs lha mo rnams/ /dmar ser dkar la ljang khu'o / /gshin rje sreg sogs lha mo rnams/ /sngo zhing ser la ljang ba dang / /de bzhin dkar ba'i mdog can no/ /'khor la nisogs pa thams cad kun/ /spyan gsum g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /dpa' bo stag gi pags mnabs 4shing / /lha mo thams cad gcer bu ste/ /skra grol ba ni —rnam par mdzes/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khyil/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska rags can/ /thams cad thod pa'i phreng ba 'chang / /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /dpa' bo dang ni lha mo rnams/ /thod pa rdo rje padma dang / /'khor lo yang ni de bzhin no/ /77—847

mkha' 'gro ma sogs khu /gdong dang / /gshin rje sreg sogs lha mo rnams/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /me long dri dang ro dang reg /gos mchog yin du 'ong ba dang / /cang te'u dang ni dril bu 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thod pa dang —/ /kha 5sdi ga yang 'dzin mdzad cing / /dril bu cang te'u gri gug bsnams — /khu gdong la sogs lha mo rnams/ /phyag mtshan 'di yis rab tu brtag /thams cad yi dgas gdan la bzhugs/ /phyogs kyi gos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /thugs kyi 'khor lo drag po ste/ /gsung gi 'khor lo bskyod pa'i zhal /sku yi 'khor lo zhi ba ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni bzhin rnam bsgyur / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin bsgoms nas ni/ /dbus kyi gtso bor rnam par brtag /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ /khro bo sna tshogs du ma 'am/ /kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ /ma mo rigs kyi khyad par dang / /'od zer can nam skul —byed ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin de bzhin/ /gang dang gang dag sgom pa yi / /yid kyi dbang po sbyor ba dag /de yis dregs par byas pa ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rin chen bzhin/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis 'gro bar gnas/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad mdzad / /bde ba chen pos kun khyab yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba'i dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi sgom pa bstan pa ste le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro'i skurigs kyi cho ga'i rim/ /sna tshogs du ma'i rigs su bshad/ /mdor bsdus na ni gsum dang lnga'i/ /drug 77—848

tu yang ni rab tu grags/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i bla ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma 'khor la sogs kun/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /rigs las yang dag 'byung ba yin/ /sku kun so sor 'byung ba ste/ /gzhan du thams cad ma mo'i rigs/ /dga' zhing dgyes la yid 'ong ba/ /yid las skye zhing 'byung ba yin /bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po bde ba'i rigs kyi bdag pos de kho na nyid kyi migasang ba'i snying po'i sa bon 'di bshad cing bstan pa/ snye snyi māṃ spyo rsā ṭwāṃ / de nas sngags chen bshad pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sras po rnams / /rab tu g.yo zhing brgyal nas kyang / /rdo rje'i rin shes rjes su dran/ /mi 'khrugs pa dang rtag pa'i rigs/ /rdo rje nyi ma de bzhin te / /'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas sku lus kyang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab tu grags/ /thog mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ /gnyis pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yin/ /gsum pa rin chen mkha' 'gro ste/ /bzhi pa padma'i mkha' 'gro yin/ /lnga pa sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /lnga po he ru kur shes bya/ /rdo rje dpa' bo yang de nyid/ /dam mkha'i zas kyis longs spyod cing / /bzla ba'i zas kyis longs kyang spyad / /sprul pa'i longs spyod nam mkha' ste/ /padma'i zas kyis longs spyod cing tsho/ /sna tshogs longs spyod sprul pa ste/ /sna tshogs rigs kyi mchog dam pa/ /mkha' mnyam dri med rnam par dag /gangs kyi rang bzhin lta bur bsil/ /dag pa'i mdog can mchog gi mdog /zla ba'i zer dang 'dra ba'i mdog /spyan gsum skal ba sna tshogs bzang / /sna tshogs padma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus na gnas/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs//77—849

thams cad ral pa'i cod pan can/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'ang de bzhin te / /phyag rgya drug ni thams cad rgya/ /rang gi gdan la legs par bzhugs/ /glang po seng ge rta dang ni/ /rma bya dang ni nam mkha' lding / /de yi steng du yi dgas gdan /bsgoms na dngos grub rab tu spyol/ /rdo rje lag gis sa la reg /rdo rje dril bu dkur bsten gcing / /zhal gyi mchu ni rnam par sgyur ri/ /'khor lo dril bu 'gying dang bcas/ /rin chen dril bu'ang de bzhin te // /padma'i dril bu'i rim pa dang / /dril bu sna tshogs rdo rje nyid/ /thams cad snyems par rnam bsgoms te/ /rigs kyi rdo rje mchog dam pa/ /dkyil 'khor drug ni bri bar bya/ /sgo bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje 'khor los bskor ba ste/ /rin chen padmas de bzhin bskor/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes bskor ba ste/ /dbus su rdo rjes bskor bar bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ /khang pa brtsegs pa yid 'ong mchog /rigs drug dag ni rnam par dgod/ /der ni gnas sogs rim pa dgod/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su dgod pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /de yi shar phyogs kyi sgo la/ / pullī ra ma /ya na thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma'o/ /byang du dzā lo ṇidha ra na keng rus chen po dang /gtum mig ma'o/ /nub tu cha rgyan shān keng rus can dang / 'od ldan ma'o/ /lho ru ar bu da na mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste dbus 5ni sa chodang po rab tu dga' ba ste/ dpa' bo sku mdog nag po/ mkha' 'gro ma thal ba dang / sprin gyi mdog can dpa' bo ni rdo rje dang / rdo rje dril bu dang /mkha' 'gro ma ni thod pa dang / rdo rje sdigs mdzub 7bo/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi padabus su bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 77—850

bde ba chen po'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor go dā phar ni /lha dgra dang / dpa' ba'i ( siblo can ma'o/ /byang du rā rime ci ri na 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma'o/ /nub tu de gri ko ṭa na rdo rje 'od dang / laṅka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /lho ru mā la ba ci rmen rdo rje sku dang / shing grib ma'o/ /dpa' bo'i sku lus dkar po / mkha' 'gro ma ni ser po'o/ /dri ma med pa'i sa ni cidabus ma ste sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /'od byed pa'i sa'i tshodabus na rin chen mkha' 'gro ste/shar gyi sgo ru tā ma rū pa na myu —gu can dang sa srung mtho/ /byang du rma //tre tshan rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'o / /nub tu tro sha ku ni cin dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /lho ru ko sa la tshan rdo rje rdu mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma ste dpa' bo ser po/ mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu'o / /'od 'phro tsoba'i sa'i dbus su padma'i mkha' 'gro/ de'i shar phyogs kyi sgor ka ling ga gan rab bzangs tshodang / sngo sangs 0lha mo'o/ /byang du lam bā ka na rdo rje bzang dang rab bzang ma'o/ /nub tu ṭwāṃ tsi na 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma'o/ /lho ru nyi ma la ya na mig mi bzang dang bya cigadong ma ste dpa' bo dmar po/ mkha' 'gro ma ni dkar mo'o/ /sbyang dka' ba'i sa'i cidabus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ de'i shar gyi sgor pre ta pu ri na stobs po che dang /'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /byang du kṛ 0ha de wa na rdo rje rin chen dang /dum skyes ma'o/ /nub tu sau rāṣṭa na rta mgrin dang / chang 'tshong snyoma'o lho ru su baṇḍi di pa na nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /dpa' bo nag po mkha' 'gro ma ser mo'o/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa'i dbus su sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ de'i shar phyogs kyi sgor nā ga ra ri na ho ru ka dang rab 77—851

dpa' ma'o// /byang du si tsan padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs can snyema'o / /nub tu ma ru ta can rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los sgyur ma'o /lho ru ku lu tā gyid rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson chen mo ri riste/dpa' bo ni sna tshogs kyi mdog can la mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i mdog can no/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rol du/ /yi dgas /phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /de yi phyi rol kun rdo rje/ /zur du mkha' 'gro ma yang bri/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang — /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /thod pa bzhi ni mtshams su bri/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor mtshams su ni/ /ring du song sa 7mkha' 'gro ma/ /lā ma mi g.yo ba yi sa/ /legs pa'i blo gros dum skyes ma/ /gzugs can ma ni chos kyi srin/ /sngo zhing ser la ljang ba dang / /bzhi pa dmar ba'i mdog can yin / /khu 7gdong la sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /sna tshogs mdog can yid 'phrog ma / /gshin rje sreg sogs tshamakha' 'gro ma/ /phyed ni bud med dbang phyug zhal /dpa' bo thams cad g.yas brkyang gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan /stag gi pags papa gos su mnabs / /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs kyi gos 'chang skra grol ba/ /yid 'ong mkha' 'gro ma yi rigs / /thams cad yi dgas 5steng 7du bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni rnam par bsgom/ /padma la gnas 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor sdom pa'i mchog yin no / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /cang te'u ni phyag g.yas na/ /'di ltar mkha' 'gro ma yi gzugs/ /phyag mtshan dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /khu gdong la sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs mtshan/ /g.yon pa :kha ṭwāṃ g.yas par ni/ /ji srid zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril 77—852

bu yang ni de bzhin no/ /gshin rje sreg sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /me long dang ni pi wang rkyadang / /dri dang ro ni g.yas pa na/ /g.yon la thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga/ /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ba'i/ /rang gi rigs kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thod pa'i steng na yang dag gnas/ /'khor lo so sor bsgoms nas ni/ /'khor dang bcas pas yongs su khyab/ /ye shes sems dpa' thugs kur ribalta//rnal 'byor kun gyi sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /bsgoms pas thim par byas nas snya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyis/ /dbang bskur nas ni rim par spro/ /oṃ ma be rdu/ 'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /srog dang stsol ba ( ririm pas bya/ /mnyam par spros nas dbang bskur byin / /ji ltar rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dogs pa med par bzlas bsgom bya/ /ji ltar gsang sngags rjes mthun tshopar/ /dam tshig can gyis bzlas pa bya/ /nga shrī ma hā su kha skyabadzra satwa ḍā ki gli dzā la sasba ra a rdu phaṭa gu hā / oṃ shrī bu rnga ka a la la la a —7 gi gri dzā la sa ra pa phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shrī ratna ḍā ka ṭwāṃ ā ā / ḍā gi gli —4 la sasbra ra sku phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ padma ḍā ka spyo spyo a snye tshornga ki gri dzā la sa ra sne phaṭa su hā/ oṃ shrī badzra ḍā ka āḥs phaṭa snye nge gi rī dzā la sa ra ci phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī bi sha ḍā ka ho khaṃ do —7 ki rī tsadzdza la sa ra snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ khaṃ snye phaṭa/ oṃ bai — phaṭa/ oṃ mi ci phaṭa/ oṃ 0rtsa rdu phaṭa/oṃ rka rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ pre : phaṭa/ oṃ bee snye phaṭa / oṃ mi rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ snye phaṭa oṃ bye 5 phaṭa/ tshe i snye phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ snye phaṭa/ oṃ rghaṃ —snye phaṭa/oṃ lo snye phaṭa/ oṃ rba snye phaṭa/ oṃ tram̐ gasnye phaṭa/ oṃ māṃ — phaṭa / oṃ ma gyusnye phaṭa/ tshe rdu phaṭa/ oṃ me snye phaṭa/ oṃ tpa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rtsa snye phaṭa/ 77—853

oṃ sum̐ snye phaṭa/ / 6 (mi phaṭa/ oṃ rdu phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ snye phaṭa/ oṃ mi ji rgyu phaṭa oṃ haṃ snye phaṭa/di phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ mi snye phaṭa/ oṃ rtsa : phaṭa/ tshe re sne phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ho snye phaṭa/ oṃ ri )sho ( 3 phaṭa/oṃ i snye phaṭa/ oṃ rtsa snye phaṭa/ oṃ ho tsho phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ rghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ snga phaṭa / oṃ mi snye phaṭa/ oṃ bo 7 phaṭa/ oṃ rtsa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rtse hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ me rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ṭaṃ ska phaṭa/ oṃ lo snye phaṭa / oṃ khaṃ snye phaṭa/ oṃ rī rgyu phaṭa/oṃ kai snye phaṭa/ oṃ rkyu sa phaṭa/ oṃ lha — phaṭa/ oṃ sum̐ phaṭa/ oṃ yo snye phaṭa tsha yo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ yo ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ yo snye phaṭa/ 'khor la sogs pa thams cad kun/ /bsgom la gnas nas bzlas pa bya/ /'khor los sgyur 7drug lhan cig tu/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma bzlas bya/ /dam tshig chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ / dam tshig dam tshig mchog gyur pa/ /gnyis med 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang sngags bzlas na dngos grub 'gyur/ /zla drug nges te gzhan min par/ /'khor los sgyur drug dngos grub 'thob/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rnam snang rdo rje nyi ma dang / /padma gar dbang rgyal po dang / /dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka /gnas sogs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /mkhas pas nges par bsgoms nas ni/ /rim par spyor ba'i rim pa dang / /brgyud pa'i gnas kyi rim pa dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi bka' dag ni/ /bla ma'i brgyud pas 'thob 5par 'gyur/ / gzhan du sngags pa 'khor byed cing / /bka' ni nam yang mthong ma yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las rigs drug gi 'khor los sgyur ba'i bka'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //77—854

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor lam ni rnyed dka' ba/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sbyor snying po/ / gnas kyi /rnal 'byor rjes mthun snyepar/ /yi ge las byung cig ricar tshul/ /cig car mtshan ma phyag mtshan yin/ /cig car rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /bde ba chen po bla na med/ /de ru 'jug cing de yi tshul/ /cig ( car he ru ka dpal mchog /ston ga'i nam mkha' dri med ltar/ /zar ma'i me tog dang mtshungs pa/ /phyag brgyad pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /'jigs shing rab tu 'jigs par mdzad/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /spyan gsum rnal 'byor ma yi gtso/ /zhal gdong g.yon dkar g.yas dmar te kyi/ /steng gi zhal ni ser la mdzes/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi byin rlabs 7can/ /stag gi pags /pa gos su mdabs /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /zhabs kyis padmar gnon 7par bzhugs/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam pas 'khyud / /phag mo yi skuni byin pas 'khril/ /gnyis med sbyor ba mnyam ldan pas/ /dbu skra grol ba phyogs gos can/ /sku mdog mnyam zhing mtshungs par ldan/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska rags can/ /de yi zhal dang phyag mtshan can//rnal 'byor dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rgyal ba'i pags 7pa steng du ste/ /tho ba mdung ste gzhan du ni/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bos —brgyan pa la/ /zla ba byed pa zhi ba 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes skadabu la brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku la brgyan/ /rdo rje mtshan ma dag gis brgyan/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /'og pag dag gis sku rags 0byas/ /dpung rgyan rdo rjes samatshan pa ste/ /sngags pa'i gtso bos gsang sngags ni/ /'di 77—855

ltar cho ga'i snying po shes/ /phag mo bde bar gnas pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i pags 3pa rnam par spangs/ /phag mo rgyal ba'i mtshan sogs las/ /cang te'u gri gug rnams kyis brgyan/ /bcom ldan 'das ni lte ba'i dbus/ /padma 'dab brgyad yid 'ong ba/ /sna tshogs padma mdog mdzes la/ /thams cad rnam dag mchog dam pa/ /shar gyi 'dab sogs phyogs cha la/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi po dgod/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma dgod cing / /byang du lā ma de bzhin te / /nub tu dum skyes ma yin no/ /lho ru gzugs can ma yin te/ /sngo dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dag ni bzhi pa'o/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /spyan gsum drag po gzi brjid can/ / skyil mo krung ni phyed par bzhugs /skra grol ba ni yid 'ong ba/ /phyogs kyi gos can mgo yi phreng / /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /dril bu cang te'u gri gug dang / /de bzhin gzhu dang mda' 'dzin cing / /rdo rje mdung mchog phyag na 'dzin/ /snyems pa'i phyag gis gar mdzad cing / /thugs rje chags pas rnam par myos/ /sngo ba dang ni ser ba dang / /ljang gu steng gi zhal dkar po/ /ser zhing sngo la ci nga ba dang / /steng gi zhal gdong drag la dmar//dmar dang sngo dang ljang ba dang / /steng gi zhal ni dkar la zhi/ /ljang dang dmar dang sngo ba dang / /steng gi zhal ni ser po mchog /bdud bzhi po ni zhabs kyis gnon / /bcom ldan 'das la gdong gis lta/ /zur gyi char ni bum pa dag /ye shes bdud rtsis yongs gang ba/ /de yi steng du thod pa ni/ /byang chub 'o mas rab bkang —ba/ /phyi rol dam tshig gsum 'khor lo / /khang pa brtsegs pa legs par mdzes/ /shar phyogs su ni gi ri ste/ /byang du de 77—856

bzhin rtsa /ri ma/ /nub tu rab rmongs ma yin no/ /lho ru yang ni ro langs ma/ /me la sbos byed ma yin te/ /bden bral du ni gtum mo yin/ /rlung phyogs sme mo ri nyid yin te/ /dbang ldan he ru ka ma ste/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma brgyad ni / /dkar mo ser la sngo ljang gu'o / /skul byed dmar la sngo ljang gu / /rab rmongs ma ni sngo ser ljang / /ro langs ma ni dkar sngo ljang / /spos byed ma ni sna tshogs mdog /dmar dang sngo dang ljang gu'o / /gtum mo yang ni ljang sngo ser/ /sme mo yang ni dud sngo ljang / /he ru ka ma sngo ljang dmar/ /'di ltar de dag thams cad kyang / /spyan gsum pa la skra grol ba/ /phyogs kyi tshogos 'chang gar dang bcas/ /yi dgas ngagadan la legs 7par bzhugs/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /kha ṭwāṃ thod pa dril bu dang / /cang te'u zhags pa lcags myu thogs/ /thams cad thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /mi bskyod pa yi rtecod pan byas/ /'di ltar gnas dang nye gnas kyi/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsal/ /'di ltar thugs kyi 'khor lor 5ni/ /lha mo dkar mo la sogs pa/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rab tu bshad/ /bsnyen pas bka' drin stsol mdzad de/ /thogs pa med pa'i 'bras bu 'grub/ /lha mo mkha' paspyod grub nas ni/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang rnyed/ /de yi phyi rol gsung 'khor lo / /shar du pi wang 4stangs stabs —ma/ /byang du gling bu'i stangs stabs ma//nub tu rdza rnga che stangs stabs / /lho ru rdza rnga'i stangs stabs 0te/ /sngo dang ser dang dmar ljang gu / /me sogs rdo rje bzhad lam ste/ /rdo rje sgeg ma rdo rje glu — /rdo rje gar te dmar ba dang / /sngo dang ser dang ljang gu'oru/ /de dag sazhal gcig 4phyag bzhi pa/ /gcer bu dbu spa grol ba dang / /thod pa yi ni phreng 77—857

ba can/ /spyan gsum pa la yid 'ong ba/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ /mo'adzin/ /tsham ngam lag pa'i stangs stabs )kyis/ /rdo rje dril bu stangs stabs 0can/ /mkhrig cim mnyam par byas nas ni/ /padma bskor ba'i stangs stabs ( can/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni/ /tshajo dang ni tshajo ha/ /de dag 'od dpag med dbu brgyan / /sku yi 'khor lo'i shar du ni/ /me tog ma byang bdug pa ma/ /nub tu mar me lho ru dri / /ser dang dud kha dmar dkar po/ /me long ro dang reg bya chos/ /me phyogs la sogs mtshams su tsho ste/ /zla ba'i mdog can dmar ljang dkar/ /de dag spyan ni tigasum pa / ste/ /gcer bu dbu spa grol ba dang //zhabs kyis kun tu gar byed cing / /phyag tu mchod pa thogs nas ni/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ rmug 'dzin cing / /cang te'u ni phyag na smubasnams/ /thod pa yi ni zeng ba can /lha mo de dag 'du sa cidang / /nye ba'i 'du sa dur 7khrod dang / /nye ba'i dur khrod dag yin te/ /rnam par snang mdzad dbu rgyan byas/ /sgo rnams rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje zhags pa rdo rje sgrog /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin te/ /sngo dang ljang dang dmar dang ser/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang ni/ /lho yi phyogs kyang de bzhin rna/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su ni/ /gshin rje sreg dkul sogs pa dag /dmar dang sngo dang dud kha paser/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga/rang gi mtshan ma cang te'u dang / /gri gug dang ni mgo bo 'chang / /spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba ste/ /gcer bu gar gyis gnas pas bzhugs/ /thams cad phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /thod pa yi ni phreng ba 7can/ /rang gi rigs kyi cod pan can/ /ji lta'i rim pas rjes su gnas/ /de yi snying gar rtson shes sems / /sku gsung zugs kyi 'khor lo gsum/ /gtso bo'i bdag po bsgom par 77—868

bya / /dkar dang dmar dang sngo ba yi// /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma lhan cig /ji lta bu yi ( bsgoms pa na/ /rjes su bstan pa'i bsgoms pa las/ /ye shes lcags kyu dag gis ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas ni/ /ji ltar rim pas mchod dbang bskur / /gcig tu bsdus te bstims nas su/ /ji lta'i rim pa bsgoms nas su/ /ye shes bzlas pa dag kyang bya/ /spro bsdu srog dang rtsol ba yis / /'thor 'thung rim pas byas pa yis/ /slob dpon gyis ni bzlas pa bya//oṃ āḥ ri kyi / 'di lta bu yi rim pa yis/ /grangs med par ni byas nas su/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur par/ /gong gi dam tshig 'khor lo ni/ /mnyam par bzhag )ste bzlas pa bya/ /dung chen phreng ba blangs nas ni/ /sdom pa mchog gi bzlas pa bya/ / oṃ thi badzra nye he ru ru kai snye snye phaṭa spre ki gli dzā la sa raṃ swā hā/oṃ badzra bā rā nyi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā gi ni lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ lā me lhu snye phaṭa/oṃ khaṇḍa ro he rtu sne phaṭa/ tshe rū pi ṇi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ gi ri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ rtsa ri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ pra mo he lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ be li lhu snye phaṭa/ tshe bukka si lhu snye phaṭa / oṃ tsaṇḍa li lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ gha sa ma ri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ he ru ka san ni rtse lhu ཿ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bī ne lhu rdu phaṭa/ tshe badzra baṃ she lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mṛ rda ge lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mu lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra hā sri lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra lā sri spyo snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gli te sum̐ snye phaṭa/ tshabadzra dzra tre rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra purje gyi : phaṭa/ oṃ badzra byu pe lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dri pe rtu snye phaṭa/ tshe badzra ga rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badzi rtu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badzi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sparsha badzi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dma tu badzi rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra i ku sha dzaḥgyi ཿ phaṭa/oṃ badzra pā sha lhu snye phaṭa/ tshe badzra sbo ṭa be lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra a 77—859

be sha hoX lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā snyi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dru ti lhu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ ya ma de: lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni /lhu snye phaṭa/ dam tshig can gyis tshig dag pas/ /mos pa'i yid kyis rtag tu bzla/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyor ldan pas/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can/ /rang gi thabs dang rigs pa'i lus/ /gnyis su med par mnyam pa'i bdag /khro bo sprul pa'i tshogs spros pas /'gro ba gsum po bcas par ni/ /ho ru gar ni byas nas kyang / /sa rnams gsum po ma lus par/ /thams cad der ni bsdus nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs la rnam par gnas/ /'di ni rnal 'byor cho ga ste/ /'khor lo bsgom pa'i bzlas pa'o/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu mthong ba na /dam tshig can nyid langs dus su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun gyis gsol ba gdab par bya/ /khro bo bde ba'i dgyes pa yi/ /longs spyod las ni byung ba yi/ /rab thongs ma yis bsnyen byas nas/ /bde ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs te/ /ra ma ho nad ṭa na su ra a ma hā su hu ba ra dzo i ni ka ma la su hu / a la la hoḥ su ra a usta ma ma snye/ ma hā sidzdza/ u ma dzo i ni dza la ma ho/ ā zhi/ a ā tshor ho/ a ru he 7byi nu su ba ya nā ha / su ra a su hu de hi ba ra ṭā i ni/ dzā la su gu mtha sa pha na ta ro ṇa ṇa pa de gyi ma hā su sna lamadza mu snu mamo klu pa la kṣa pa.u/ tu tu pas glu ṇa tshomi su su / ba sku mo khu su glu / i na i du/ khe snyel tha i mo khu su ཿci/ ba sa 4mi paṃ ka u madzdza ta nu na ba rā/ a lapa da tre / bhu dza ta nu mu ma tshohā su glu / i la da ra pā 2ya/ sku ma snu snye/ a ra 4gli a gi a paṃ u ra su/ 'di yis 77—860

mgon po bskul nas /ni/ /dkyil 'khor dngos grub nges pa ste/ /snyan cing 'jam pa'i mgrin pa'i dbyangs/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /mkha' 'gro'i dra ba dri med rnams/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ /rdo rje padma yid 'ong ba / /sbyor bas dngos grub thams cad 'grub/ /dgyes pa 'di yis bskul na ni/ /bde ba chen po stsol ba yin/ /sbyor ba yi ni dus dag tu / /rdo rje can gyis rab tu sbyar/ /thog ma dbus dang mthar thug par/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags bzla/ /'khor lo dag ni brtan byas te/ /dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /'di ni kun gyi cigasang sngags te/ /khro bo sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad snying gar brtan byas te/ /bsgoms pas thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /gal te bdag nyid dngos grub 'dod/ /dngos grub thams cad gnas pa yin/ /oṃ badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya / badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ rnyo me bha —ba/ su to ṣyo me bha 7ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/ sarba sirnyi me tsham yatstsha/ sarba name su tsa 5me/tsi thi yaḥ ku ru rgyu/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān/la badzra he ru ka mā 7me muñtsa he ru ka 5lha ba/ ma hā sa ma tshoya satwa aḥ snye phaṭa gu hā / 'dis 5ni bcom ldan kun khyab cing / /yi ge brgya pa mchog gyur pa/ /he ru ka mchog rang nyid yin/ /phyir bzlog snyepa ni gang yin pa/ /bcu drug 'dab rum la bkod cing / /rjes su bstan sapa'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /bdag gis bsgoms shing brtan par bya/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya / /rnal 'byor 'di 'dra bsgoms na 0ni/ /khams gsum pa yang mthong 'gyur te / /bdag nyid dpa' bo'i mtshan nyid de/ /de ltar srid pa'ang stong pa yin/ /77—861

bsgoms pas bdag nyid yang dag gnas/ /'dir 〉 ni bka' mithub bshad pa med /phreng ba med cing sngags kyang med/ /gzungs dang sbyin sreg ( las rnams dang / /cho ga'i rim pa'i gzhi yang med/ /rnal 'byor phyag rgya byed pa'ang med/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyi rim pa'ang med/ /rdo rje chen po dngos 'dzin pa/ /rang byung dngos grub kun mdzad pa/ /'gog pa nyid kyang mdzad pa med/ /bdag nyid bdag gis mchod par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba ni/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam par bsgom/ /yi ge gnas kyi mchog gyur pa / /lha yi gzugs su bsgom pa ni/ /de yi dbus su rnam par bsam sku gsung thugs ni 'dus pa can/ /de yi lus las 'das gyur te/ /sems kyi dngos kyang btsal du med/ /chags pa med cing chags bral med/ /chags bral dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /snying gi padma'i dbus su ni/ /brtags pas legs par rnyed pa ni/ /yid kyis ngal bsos byas pa ste/ /rnal 'byor ma kun bud med yin /phyag rgya mchog tu bshad pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng ridu brgya phyed brgyan )/ /ye shes sems ni bsam pa ni/ /mchog ste spyad par bya ba med/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam dang ni/ /sems ni mchog tu 'bad pa —yis/ /'di ltar zhi ba'i gnas de ni/ /'jig rten du mas ma rtogs te/ /sbyor dang sbyor ba bral byas nas / /go 'phang gcig pus khyab pa yin/ /'di ltar byang chub 'bras bu rnyed par dka' 7ba ste/ /dang por dbyangs kyi yi ge las byung gzhan du yang / /stegs mungan gzhung lugs log pa'i blo gros de nyid ni/ /ma ning shes rab long ba gzugs bzhin 'bras bu med/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las sku gsung thugs kyi gnas kyi rim pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa 7lnga pa'o// //77—862

de nas spyor ba bshad bya ba/ /thod pa sangs rgyas mchog dam pa/ /de nyid sbyor ba kun gyi mchog /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ba/ /gsang ba legs par sba bya zhing / /gang gis su la'ang mi bstan no// /de nyid mchog gi bsgom bzung ba / /rnal 'byor ma yi snying la gnas/ /gsang ba brtan ripar sba bya zhing / /bla ma'i ngag ni bsgom par bya/ /dur khrod gnas ni yid 'ong ba/ /sgrub pa po yis nges brtan ripa/ /bskyed ripa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa dang gnas kyi rim pa dag /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /yi ge hūṃ ni bsgom par bya/ /de yis khyad cadapar bdag nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas thod pa can gyi mchog /gnas med zhi zhing dag pa ste/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs yin/ / a li kā li las rang byung ( ni/ /gnyis med mchog tu zhi ba ste/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig /pa/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /'dzam bu'i mdog can mnyam pas khyab/ /'od zer phreng bas kun tu 'khrigs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /spyan gsum pa la bzhan pa'i zhal/ /sems dpa' kun gyi bsgom pa ste/ /gnyis med chos ni bla na med/ /stag gi pags 7pa gos su mnabs /na skyara'i pags pa steng du brkyang ske/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /mgo bo'i phreng mabs rnam par brgyan/ /de yi phyag g.yon thod pa ni/ /rkang gis rab tu gang ba dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /ye shes 'chi med lngas bsres 5pa/ /kha ṭwāṃ sngag ni lha'i rnal 'byor/ /thod pa dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs dag pa ste/ /'jigs pa ma lus mi 'jigs 77—863

grol / /gdug cing 'jigs pa ma lus kun/ /'dir ni zhabs kyis gnon par mdzad / /gdug pas 'jigs pa thams cad spong / /zla ba byed pa zhi ba 'dzin//sna tshogs rdo rjes :dbu la mtshan/ /rdo rje phreng bas dpral ba mdzes/ /rkang rgyan yid 'ong rgyan cha can/ /sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad kyi / /lte ba'i dbus nas cibazhengs pa ni/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /chags pa zhe sdang zhabs kyis gnon/ /ye shes sems dpa' de gzugs can/ /yi ge rgyu las byung bar bsgom/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i snying ga ru/ /nye ru ka ni rnam par bsgom/ /gsung gi 'khor lo kha la bsgom/ /sku yi 'khor lo snga ma bzhin /sngo dang dmar dang dkar ba dang / /phyag drug pa la zhal gsum pa/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /spyan gsum pa la bzhin rnam sgyur / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rtse gsum pa dang thod pa 'chang / /rang rig lus dang yang dag 'dus/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang gnas/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi yi dbus dag tu/ /yi ge gsum sogs las byung ba/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can// /rang gi mtshan ma'i mchog dang ldan/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rim sbyor ba/ /sdom pa gsum gyi mchog dam pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /padma'i phyogs kyi gnas la dgod/ /thod pa bzhi po mchog yin te/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni kha dog ser/ /lā ma pa la sha yi mdog /dum skyes ma ni sngon po ste/ /gzugs can ma ni dmar la 'bar/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs mchog yin te/ /sgo rnams su ni lha mo bzhi/ /khu dzogadong la sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /sngo dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu drag 5po'i gzugs can no/ /mtshams su gshin rje 77—864

sreg la sogs/ /rab 'jigs shin tu 'jigs pa ste/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin / /mi 'jigs mchog kyang de bzhin te/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug nyid/ /bdud ni bzhi po'i steng na bzhugs/ /spyan gsum pa la spa grol ba/ /phyogs kyi gos mchog 'dzin pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /me long ro dang dri dang ni/ /reg gi mchod pa bzhi po ste / /sa bcu dag gi rim pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis phyi dang nang gi chos rnams kun/ /byang chub phyogs kyi :rnam par dag /ka la sogs pa nyi shu bzhi/ /mgo la bin dus mnan pa ste/ /gsal byed snye gnyis dang yang sbyar/ /mthar ni phaṭa dang rab tu sbyar/ /dpa' bo kun gyi gsang sngags ni/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster/ /gsal byed mkha' 'gro ma yi ming / /mthar ni hūṃ snye phaṭa yin te/ /'di ltar rab gtum mkha' 'gro ma/ /sngags kyi de nyid bde ba ster/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /snye āḥ.i/'di ni rab tu gsang ba ste/ /padma'i 'dab la mkha' 'gro ma/ /gsal byed ma ning dang bcas pa/ /rgyu ni gnyis pa nyid yin te/ /mkhas pas mthar ni phaṭa dang sbyar/ /khu rigadong la sogs gsang sngags ni/ /ya ra la wa/ /gsal byed dang ni bcas pa ste/ /mthar ni hūṃ dang phaṭa dang sbyar/ /gshin rje sreg ma la sogs pa/ /sha ṣa sa ha/ gsal byed dang ni : gnyis dang / /phaṭa kyang de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /dbus su sangs rgyas thod pa yi/ /gsang sngags de bzhin rjes su dran/ /oṃ e st+waṃ/ oṃ āo / chu st+waṃ/ e i / aḥṣa swā hā/ khams dang phung po skye mched la/ /go cha rnams ni sbyar bar bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo dam tshig dag /mnyam pa'i ro yis mchod par bya/ /mchod pa 77—865

bzhi po'i gsang sngags rnams/ /rang ming gsal byed snye byas te/ /'di ltar dkyil 'khor dag dang sbyar/ /sangs rgyas thod pa las byung ba/ /rdo rje rgyan ni bgos pa ste/ /thams cad rim pa bzhin du sbyar/ /'thor 'thung du ni rab sbyar bas/ /gsang ba bzhi po bzla bar bya/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo gsum gyi rim pa dag /'dir ni cho ga'i sbyor ba yis/ /dus bzhi dag tu sbyar /nas su/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i bzlas pa bya/ /dam tshig mchog ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /dam tshig can gyi gsang sngags kun/ /sangs rgyas thod pa mchog yin te/ /mnyam par ma bzhag /sbyor ba yis/ /'di ltar thams cad rab tu brtag /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bya zhing / /ye shes 'chi med lnga yi mchog /yang na rang ming bzlas pa bya/ /sngags kyi ride nyid bzlas par bya/ /oṃ shrī bu ka pā li rbha āḥ sne ṭī gi gli dzā la sa raṃ 0rgyu phaṭa gā hā5 / 'di ni yid 'ong sbyor ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma yi ye shes mchog /gang du dam tshig nyams pa la/ /sbyor ba 'di ni sbyin par bya/ /zhi bar gyur nas bla ri med pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshodabang yang bskur/ /dus bzhi dag tu rim pa yis phyi dang nang gi chus khrus bya / /yang na dam tshig sdom pa blang / /bla ma la ni gsol ba gdab/ /bdag ni mi shes shārmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste / /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la skyabs su mchi/ /des 7ni the tsom skemed byas nas/ /nges par dngos grub can du 'gyur/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dam tshig las ldang ba sangs rgyas thod pa bskyed pa ste le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //77—866

gsang sngags kun ni bskyed pa dang / /'gro ba'i gnas dang 'gro ba dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo kun/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi miganas mchog yin/ /mi zad gnyis med rnam par dag /thog mar snyedabus mthar 5dri ma med/ / a yi ci ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhi ba ste/ /spyan gsum pa la thugs rje'i nyams/ /phyag rgya che dang yang dag ldan / /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /ral pa zla phyed dbu la brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes ci dbu la mtshan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cadabu rgyan can/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs / /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /ral gri lcags myu phyag na bsnams/ /rin chen zhags pa mdzes pa 'dzin/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /rnam thar gsum gyi gnas kyi mchog /ye shes sems dpa' snying ga ru/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mchog kyang bsgom/ /snye las thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ /de yi phyag mtshan sngon po dang / /ā las gsung gi 'khor lo ste/ /de yi phyag mtshan dmar po'o// /oṃ las sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /de yi phyag mtshan dkar po yin/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mnyam sbyor/ /sku gsung thugs ni dri ma med/ /ro las phyag rgya chen po rteste/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam par bsam/ /i las bha ga padma ste/ /byang chub zla ba dri ma med/ /u ni snying gar skyabasam pa ste/ /e ni mgo la rnam par dgod/ /i 5ni spyi gtsug dag tu dgod/ /lko ni mig tu 77—867

dgod pa ste/ /e ni go char byas nas su/ /a ni mdun gyi mtshon cha'o/ /bla las lha mo spyan yin te/ /ṛ di las dam tshig sgrol ma yin/ /rmā calas lha mo gos dkar mo/ /rī las rin chen yang dag 'byung / /rin chen sgron dang ye shes sgron /dkar zhing pa la sha yi mdog /dmar zhing 'dzam bu ri chu bo'i mdog/zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum dgyes pas rnam par myos/ /thams cad phyogs kyi gos can te/ /rang gi thabs dang mnyam par ldan/ /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /padma dmar po rin chen dang / /rdo rje dril bu lhan cig sbyar/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu stsol/ /ral gri mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /gzhu ni 'gugs par tsho'adzin pa ste/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /thod pa yi ni cod pan can/ /sna tshogs padma'i dbus su ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs/ /de dag sgo ru dgod pa ste/ /dbus su gtso bo'i zla ba'i gdan/ /zur la mchod pa rnam pa bzhi/ /phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /me long dang ni pi wang zudang / / dril bu dung dang bcud kyis len / /chang gi btung ba lag pas mchod/ /gzhan du ji ltar bdag po bzhin/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ / skyil krung maphyed par legs par bzhugs / /lag pa snyim pa'i thal mo yis/ /mchod pa lag tu thogs nas ni/ /'di lta'i cho gas thams cad mkhyen/ /ā li de nyid dri ma med/ /gsang ba mchog ni rnyed dka' ba/ /rdo rje sems dpas —bshad pa yin/ /sngags kyi de nyid cho ga dag /sku gsung thugs su yang dag sbyar / /oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badzra sa twa āḥ /ā rghaṃ ḍā ki rī gadzā la sa raṃ 5zhwa hā/ oṃ si 4lo tsa ni bla ca.āḥ77—868

rdu swā hā/ oṃ sa ma ya tā re tusta re tu re sgyutha rilha snye zhwa hā/ oṃ padmo rtse be sapāṇḍa ra bā si ni lī ri āḥ swā hā/ oṃ ratna dzā li ni dzā āX chos swā hā/ oṃ rū pa badzi dzha/ oṃ sha 7badzi snye/ oṃ ga skabadzi kho / oṃ ra sa badzi 'i dkuthams cad mkhyen pa dbang phyug mchog /bha ga'i dbus su gnas par bsgom/ /ā pali rdo rje gsang ba che / /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /gang gis dngos po kun gsang ba/ /de yi gsang ba bshad pa yin/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dus bzhi ru/ /bzlas dang bsgom par ldan par bya/ /som nyi thams cad spangs nas ni/ /sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus brtan/ /ye shes 'khor lo mthong nas ni/ /dam tshig can gyis mchod dbang bskur/ /de dag gcig tu bstims nas su/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /thams cad rdo rje 'dzin lta bu/ /'das pa dang ni da ltar dang / /ma 'ongs pa yi 5dus gsum po/ /de ltar sems can gsum po la/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang gnas/ /lhan cig skyes tshodaga' dag pa'i bdag /thog ma med pa'i mchog yin no/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las rdo rje sems dpa' skyed pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas mchog gi cho ga bshad/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub ri pa ni/ /mi gi 5ye shes las byung ba'i/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bde ba che/ /zhal drug phyag drug zhi ba ste/ /sku mdog dkar po dri ma med/ /spyan gsum rdo rje kyil krung 5can/ /phyag rgya drug ni 'bar bas brgyan/ /mi bskyod pa yi cod pan cican/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /zla ba phyed pa ruzhi ba 'dzin/ /ral pa'i 77—869

thor tshugs bcings pa ste/ /dkar dang sngo dang ngur smrig nyid/ /ser dang ljang gu 1de bzhin te/ /steng gi zhal ni zhi ba ste/ /lha yi midangos grub 'bras bu stsol—/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /ral gri ripo ti 'dzin pa ste/ /utpa la dang lcags kyu nyid/ /ye rishes lus can rnam par bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po ni/ /'khor lo'i dbus su rnam par bsgom/ /sngar bshad gnas kyi sbyor ba yis/ /ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' ltar kyi/ /gsang sngags 'di ni rjes su dran/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsang ba ni/ /gsang gsum ye shes dam tshig can /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sbyor ba'o// /oṃ shrī ma hā su kha ma rtebadzra ma me rgyu 7nge ki gri dzā la sasba ra 7su hā/ rang gis dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /brtul zhugs chen po gsang sngags bzla/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo maspros nas ni//khams gsum dag ni bsdu bar bya/ /'di ni mchog tu gsang ba ste/ /gang gis su la'ang bstan mi bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las 'jam pa'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /yi ge dgu pa bsgrub zipa ste/ /kṣa yi ye shes las byung ba/ /gdug pa thams cad za byed pa/ /za byed mkha' 'gro za byed 5cing / /rnam rtog zos shing zad par byed/ /mkha' mnyam stong pa las byung ba/ /nam mkha'i longs spyod za byed cing / /zhal drug phyag ni bcu gnyis pa / /spyan gsum pa la zhal rnam sgyur / /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis bzhugs / /gdug pa'i bdud ni za byed cing / /'jigs byed dang ni 'jigs byed mo / /kha sgrub 7zhabs kyis mnan par bzhugs/ /stag gi pags 7pa gos 77—870

su mdabs3ri/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /zla ba ricad las ( nye bar mdzes/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes 4riral pa mnan / /phyag rgya drug gis sku lus brgyan/ /zhal gyi mche ba rnam par gcigs( kyi / /'jigs byed rab tu cher 'jigs shing ri/ /sngo dang dud kha ri snaljang khu chodang / /dmar dang lnga pa ser po'o/ /drug pa dag ni bong bu'i mgo/ /steng gi zhal gdong rab tu 'jigs/ /thal ba sprin gyi mdog can la/ /gdug pa thams cad rab 'joms ma/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /dgyes pa'i longs spyod longs yi spyod cing / /pang mdu rdo rje phag mo ni/ /de mdog steng zhal phag mgo ste/ /gnyis su med par mnyam par ldan/ /skra grol ba dang phyogs gos can/ /byin pa gnyis kyis mnyam par 'khril/ /thugs rje'i chags pas rnam par myos/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing 7/ /tshangs pa'i pags 7pa mnabs 7pa ste/ /rdo rje mdung dang cang te'u dang / /gri gug zhags pa mgo bo dang / /phyag tu ral gri 'phyar ba ste/ /drag po gdug pa kun 'joms pa/ /snying gar 'iye shes mkha' 'gro ni/ /khu pagadong la 7sogs yongs kyis khyab/ /'khor lo 'dab brgyad dbus dag tu/ /g.yon nas g.yas su bskor nas ni/ /dur khrod dang ni nye dur khrod/ /mkha' 'gro ma mchog / dgod par bya/ /yam̐ ro lo waṃ/ sho ṣi tsho haṃ/ ye shes 'khor lo mkha' 'gro dgod/ /zhag bdun bar du bsgoms nas ni/ /gang yang thun ni bzhi yi rim/ /chu 'gram dang ni dur khrod du/ /bsgoms pas dngos grub nges par rnyed/ /'phrog pa dang ni gsod gyed cing / /gang du las ni ci 'dod pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los 'grub/ /las 'dir yid gnyis dpyod pa med/ /sngo dang pa la sha yi mdog /77—871

dmar dang bzhi pa 〉ser po ste/ /gshin rje sreg sogs bzhi po ni/ /sna tshogs mdog can mdzes pa'i zhal/ /dmar dang sngo dang dud kha riste/ /zhal mdog dkar po mchog tu mdzes/ /thams cad spyan gsum pa yi zhal/ /skra grol ba la phyogs gos can/ /khu chogadong g.yon dang g.yas kyi zhal/ /'ug gdong zhal yang de bzhin te/ /gsum pa khyi yi zhal gdong yin/ /bzhi pa phag gi zhal gdong ste/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i zhal gdong ni/ /drag mo'i rigazugs can cho ga bzhin/ /gshin rje sreg sogs zhal gdong ni/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa gnyis de bzhin/ / thug ri rnga mo rta dang ni/ /seng ge ra dang glang ma he/ /gzhan yang dom gyi zhal yin te/ /thams cad kyang ni mnyam par bya/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /zhags pa lcags myu phyag na bsnams/ /dril bu cang te'u gri gug dang / /thod pa'i /phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /yi dgas 7gdan la gar gyis bzhugs/ /mi'u thung la skye 5gnas ring / /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /thugs rje'i ro yis rnam par myos/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni/ /sgom zhing rab tu bsgom par bya//: āX / 'di ni gsang bar bshad pa ste/ /rdo rje padma 'khor lo dbus/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro snying ga —ru/ /mkha' 'gro'i yi ge'i 'khor lo ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /mchod cing thim par rnam par bsgom/ /mnyam par bzhag nas yi ge rnams/ /srog dang rtsol bas gsang pasngags bzla/ /rang gi 'thor 'thung 7byas nas su/ /gsang ba gsum gyi ye shes spro/ /oṃ shrī kṣa ḍā skugi 7gli dzā la sasba ra 0lhu : phaṭa zhwa hā/ /thog mar gsal byed ming dang snye/ /mthar ni phaṭa dang rnam par sbyar / /mkha' 'gro zla bas bshad pa yi/ /'dod 77—87 2

pa'i 'bras bu thams cad stsol/ /mchog 'di dag ni gsang ba ste/ /su la yang ni sbyin mi bya/ /zhag bdun gyis /ni dbang 'gyur te/ /rtse gcig pa yis bsgoms na ni/ /'khor lo gsum gsang mkha' 'gro ma'i / /dngos grub myur du thob lapar 'gyur/ /nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las kṣa'i mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas mchog tu bshad bya ba/ / ā li 0mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa ste/ /a li ye shes las byung ba/ /ā /li mkha' 'gro mchog dam pa/ /zhal brgyad pa la phyag bcu drug /spyan gsum 'jigs pa rab 'jigs pa/ /zhal gyi mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /zla ba byed pa ral pa 'ching —/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi gtsug mnan/ /dpral ba la ni rdo rje phreng / /stag gi pags 7pa gos su mnabs / /phyag rgya drug gis sku la brgyan/ /rnam par rtog pa 'jigs byed nyid / /sred dang phrag dog dus mtshan nyid/ /zhabs kyi 'og tu gnon par mdzad / /gdul dka' thams cad 'dul mdzad cing / /bgegs kyi mgo po'i phreng ba can/ /sna tshogs mdog can legs par mdzes/ /dkar ba'i mdog can rked pa phra/ /lha yi gzi brjid 'bar ba can/ /sngo zhing ser la dud kha cidang / /g.yas pa'i zhal yang de bzhin te/ /ljang gu padamar dang ser skya ste/ /g.yon pa'i zhal yang sna tshogs mdzes/ /steng gi thal ka mkhrin mdog zhi/ /chags shing rjes su chags pas blta / /thugs rje'i ro ni yang dag rdzogs/ /sku lus ldem zhing 'jo 7bag can/ /ā tsholi mkha' 'gro ma yi sku/ /phyag gnyis pa 77—873
