la gcer bu'i lus/ /thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan/ /spa grol ba yis rnam par myos/ /spyan gsum nag po 'jigs pa can/ /de yi mdog can sku rags ①can / /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /gnyis med sbyor bas yang dag gnas /rdo rje dril bu yang dag ldan/ /lha mo'i ku tsa 'tshir geba'o/ /ji ltar mkha' 'gro'i phyag rgya ltar/ /mkha' 'gro ma yang de bzhin sbyar/ /phyag gnyis dag ni brkyang pa la/ /khyab 'jug pags pa mdabs ripa yin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa 'chang / /mdung rtse gsum pa cang te'u nyid/ /dgra sta lcags myu de bzhin te/ /zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / /gri gug dang ni 'khor lo nyid/ /snying gar rtsibs ni bcu gnyis pa'i/ /'khor lo'i rgyal po legs par mdzes/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam par bsgom/ /de mdog zhal dang 'dug stangs dang / /phyag dang phyag rgya de bzhin te/ /shar du dam tshig mchog ces bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yi ge mi'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /byang phyogs su sna tshogs mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yi ge yī las byung ste bzhugs pa'o/ /nub phyogs su nam mkha'i mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yi ge e dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs su gnas kyi mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yi ge ma las yang dag par bzhugs pa'o/ /me'i phyogs la sogs tshopa'i mtshams rnams su/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi po dgod par bya ste/ thog ma che ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/yi ge u dang sbyar bar dzobya'o/ /bden bral du drag po mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yi ge spru dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su dpa' bo'i mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yi ge o dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /dbang ldan du khro bo'i mchog 77—874

ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yi ge cha dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin 'dir /ni mtshams bzhi ru/ dbang ldan la sogs phyogs dgod pa/ yi ge riri las dngos grub kyi mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / yi ge bla las dur khrod kyi mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / yi ge dzā las rnal 'byor gyi mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / yi ge snye las gtum pa'i mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma ni de kun gyi/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnam par dag /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /thams cad spyan gsum rnam sgyur la kyi/ /sku lus dkar po thams cad zhal/ /sngo dang ljang khu gnyis med bde/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i zhal gnyis ni/ /mkhas pas rnam par bsgom par bya/ /phyogs kyi gos can gar dang bcas/ /spa grol ba la rab tu 'jigs/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug mchog /mdung dang mgo bo thams cad kun/ /sna tshogs mdog dang phyag mtshan bsnams//ro yi mgo yi steng bzhugs shing / /bugs rje'i ro ni yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin pa ste/ /thams cad thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /mgo bo'i skuphreng ba 'dzin pa ste/ /thams cad a la la yi sgra/ /oṃ ni thugs kyi rdo rje ste/ /sa skeni gsung du 'gyur ba yin/ /a skuni sku yi rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje padma 'khor lo'i dbus / /'di ni mchog tu gsang ba ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sbyor ba mchog /rdo rje sems dpas ma gsungs pa skuste/ /rdo rje snying pos zhus pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor la sogs rtsapa thams cad dgod/ /ye shes 'khor lo de mthong nas/ /gcig pu chos kyi ro 7yang bsgom/ /ye shes bzlas 7pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi sngags kyi 'thor 'thung bya/ /dang gi 77—875

bdag nyid sbyor ldan pas/ /'khor lo mchog gi tshogs dang spro/ /mchog de mthong na slar yang bsdu/ /yan lag bcu gnyis mchog dam pa/ /sa ni bcu gnyis dag nyid de// /rdo rje sa ni bcu gsum pa/ /rab tu dga' dang dri ma med /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro ba/ /sbyang dka' ba dang mngon du gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /gzugs med pa dang ye shes ldan/ /de ltar sa ni bcu gnyis po/ /'khor lo'i lha mo rnam par dgod/ /dgyes pa chen po bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sa dbus bu'o/ /'khor la sogs pa kun gyi sngags/ /ming dang gsal byed hūṃ byas te/ /de dag mthar ni phaṭa dang sbyar/ /sngags kyi gtso bos gsang sngags ni/ /rang snying rang gi sa bon dgod/ /sku gsung thugs dang rnam par sbyar / /ye shes 'khor lo 'di mthong nas/ /gcig tu bsdus te mchod par bya/ /bdag gis phyi dang dang du yang / /mnyam par bzhag ste mi smra bzla/ /rang gi 'thor 'thung byas nas ni/ /blo ldan srog rtsol bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ shrī ā li ḍā ka a a e hūṃ ḍā ki rī dzā la sasba ra ma phaṭa su hā/ srid pa ma lus thams cad kun/ /dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid/ /sbyor ba yi ni bdag nyid rnams/ /sems can khams ni cha gnas pas/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid sbyor zhing mchod par bya//mnyam par ma bzhag sems kyis ni/ /sgom zhing rab tu bsgoms byas te/ /sngags dang dbyibs dang chos nyid de/ /chos gcig ro ni stong pa yin/ /chos rnams tshabadag med nyid yin te/ /rang bzhin med pa'i chos la ni/ /rjes su brtag par bya ba yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gsang ba 77—876

chen po'i gsang ba ā kyili'i mkha' 'gro sgrub snyepa ste le'u sum cu pa'o// //de nas sbyor ba bshad bya ba/ /sna tshogs gar gyi dbang phyug mchog /thams cad mchog ste rnal 'byor che/ /dngos grub chen po legs stsol la / /skyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgom zhing rab tu bsgom par bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /so oṃ rda las rdo rje 'byung / /de nyid yongs gyur bdag nyid de/ /gsal byed mkha' 'gro mchog gyur pa/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug sna tshogs mdog /thams cad rigs kyi mchog dam pa/ /zhal drug pa la phyag bcu gnyis/ /spyan gsum pa la g.yo ba'i sgra/ /zla ba byed pa zhi ba 'dzin/ /thod pa'i phreng bas spud pa ste/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dbu la 'chang / /spyi gtsug ral pa 'ching ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku la mtshan/ /lha yi rgyan gyis spud pa ste / /skal ngan mu stegs can rnams ni/ /zhabs kyi padma'i tsho'og tu mnan/ /lta ba lnga yi rim pa dag /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis —mnan/ / skyil krung 7phyed pa'i gar zhabs can/ /zhabs drug gis ni rnam par brgyan/ /khyab 'jug gi ni pags ngapa mnabs / /mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan pa ste/ /rdo rje lha mos rnam par 'khyud/ /gcer bu 'og pag ska parags can/ /skra grol ba la spyan gsum can/ /mchu dang mchu ni rnam 'tshir zhing / /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par 'khril/ /byang chub yan lag gnas 'tshir zhing / /byin pa gnyis kyis mnyam par 'khril/ /thugs rje chags pa'i ro yis bde/ /tshangs pa'i pags pa'i 7yan lag ni/ /phyag gnyis dag gis brkyang 5nas 'dzin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'chang / /dbang phyug chen po'i mgo bo thogs/ /mdung rtse 77—877

gsum dang ral gri dang / /cang te'u zhags pa lcags kyu bsnams/ /dkar dang sngo dang ljang ba nyid/ /ser dang dud kha ngur smrig 〉ste/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos dag tu/ /pi la dang ni nye tha ril/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni gnyis po sbyar/ /chos kyi mchog ces bya ba yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid ni/ /yi ge dwo las yang dag 'byung / /g.yon gyi phyogs su dgod par bya/ /yi ge si las nges byung ba/ /rgya mtsho'i mchog ces bya ba yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid 0ni/ /sna tshogs mdog can sna tshogs zhal/ /spyan gsum pa la bzhin ( rnam sgyur / / skyil krung tshobyed pas gnas pa ste/ /zhabs ni gar dang bcas pa'o /zhal lnga pa la phyag bcu pa/ /spyan gsum drag po 'jigs pa ste/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par bzhugs/ /mgrin pa dag ni ngadrug dang bzhi/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i ska rags 7can/ / rkang gdub skugayer ta'i sil sgra can/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /'khyud pa yi ni mchog dam pa/ /rdo rje gsor zhing sdigs mdzub ngakyis/ /gnyis su med par rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa gnyis med rnam brgyan te/ /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag na bsnams/ /thod pa dang ni gri gug mchog /sku gsung thugs kyi dbu rgyan can / /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol skyab/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dbus su/ /'khor lo gsum gyi thabs kyang bsgom/ /oṃ gyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ni/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su ste /sku gsung thugs kyi mkha' 'gro ni/ /rang gi snying gar stode dag bsgom/ /sngar bshad sbyor ba'i rim pa yis/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rjes rim pa de 77—878

ru bsam zhing rnam bsgoms te// /gsum po'i rim pa rjes su spro/ /des ni dngos grub gnyis med pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lhan cig bsgom/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i ro rnams ni/ /bsgoms la gsang sngags bzlas par ribya/ /oṃ shrī pra ṇa bod nutre ka ā ā ri oṃ snye tre ki rī dzā la sa ra oṃ zhwa hā/ oṃ hri dharma susta me / ma hā badzra rnga ki gri ye ru tsho snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ sī sna ga ra utta 7me ma hā badzra ḍā ki gli ya sgyu ma phaṭa su hā/ gsang gsum ye shes bzlas na ni/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma bzla 7bya/ /gsal byed rang ming snye gnyis dang / /mthar ni phaṭa dang sbyar bar bya/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo bsgoms nas ni / /gsum po bsdu zhing bsgoms nas su/ /dam tshig gsang gsum sbyor ba yis/ /bha ga'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /byang chub zla ba dri ma med/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo nā 7da gsum/ /gtso bo dag ni gsum yin te/ /mkha' 'gro ma gsum gsum mkha' 'gro/ /sdud cing skyed tshapar mdzad pa ste/ /bha gar rdo rje phag mo ni/ /gsang ba gsum du rnam par bsgom/ /de nyid sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis / /des man nga rgyal rnam 7spangs nas/ /dus bzhi dag tu sbyor ba yis/ /de bzhin bsgom dang bzlas pa bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bskyang bya zhing / /'o ma sna tshogs las byung ba/ /bram ze che dang sbrang rtsi mar/ /ma hā māng —sa mnyam ldan pa/ /de nyid gsum gyis mngon bsngags te/ / bza' ba ri dag ni bza' bar bya/ /'du 'dzi med cing sred pa med/ /yongs su gzung ba'i 'khor yang med / /longs spyod min pas longs spyod la/ /'chi ba med pa'i zas bza' zhing —/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yang bsten/ /longs spyod med pa'i zas bza' zhing / /rnal 'byor sgom pa'i skom yang btung / /gzhan du gang yang 77—879

btung ba min/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyor ldan pas/ /rang nyid byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ /bcom ldan mkha' 'gro pi la ba/ /rnal 'byor ma ni nye pi la/ /thabs ni pi la bar zhes ribya/ /shes rab nye ba'i pi la ba/ /grong khyer mthar ni pi la nyid/ /grong gi mtha' ni nye rib la/ /zla ba nyi ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /pi la dang ni nye pi yin/ /skad cig sbyor ba pi la ba/ /dga' ba nye ba'i pi la ste /mthu stobs du ma ldan par lani/ /skye ba 'di la 'grub pa yin/ /pa shu thams cad bza' bya yin / /lha bshos dag kyang de bzhin ba ba / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma 'dus nas/ /dus la mthun pa 'dus byas nas/ /glu dang gar dang bza' ba dang / /'dus pa mchog gis mchod par bya/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /dam tshig gi ni spyad pa spyod/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gsal byed mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa'i mtshan ma bstan pa ste le'u sum cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dngos grub sbyor ba'i rim pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang mkha' 'gro sbyor/ /dam tshig mchog gi sdom pa yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi sdom pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi bde ba che/ /mkha' dbyings tshordo rje'i dbus gnas pa/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig mchog dam pa/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /dbus su nyi ma'i gdan yang mdzes/ / ā li kā dzoli mnyam par ldan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus labargyan/ /byin gyis brlabs dzapa byas nas ni/ /rang gi sa bon las bskyed de/ /yi ge gyi las yang 77—880

dag byung // /dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs/ /zhal gyi mche ba rnam par gtsigs / /spyan gsum ljags ni bskyod pa'i zhal/ /gdug pa thams cad zhabs 'og gnon/ /khro ba ridang ni bzhad pa'i zhal/ /bskal pa'i mthar yang 'khrug pa ste/ /ral pa yi ni dbu rgyan can/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa yis/ /skad par ska rags bcings pa yin/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla byed 'chang / /dpral ba la ni rdo rje phreng / /khro bo mthong nas rnam par brtag /lha rnams thams cad tshar yang gcod / /keng rus can gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /'chi ba 'tsho bar byed pa'i mchog /gdug pa thams cad nges par gnon/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku lus brgyan /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spud pa ste/ /phyag drug pa la zhal lnga pa/ /sna tshogs ro yi bcud mchog can/ /sngo dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang khu dkar po zhi ba ste/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas / /phag mo yi ni sku lus khyab /lha chen pags pa 'dzin mdzad cing / /bla re tshul du brkyang bar mdzad /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /drug pa na ni cang te'u dang / /zhabs g.yon du ni dus mtshan mnan/ /g.yas pa yis ni 'jigs byed de/ /zhabs kyis 'og tu mnan mdzad cing / /rmongs shing rab tu myos par mdzad/ /rdo rje phag mo de mdog can/ /skra grol ba dang gcer bu ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyis ska tshorags can/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /mgul nas pa'akhyud cing myos pa ste/ /de yi phyag mtshan phyag rgya bsnams / /gri gug cang te'u mchog kyang 'dzin/ /drug pa la ni tshangs pa'i 77—881

mgo /'di 'drar rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /mkhas pas re'u mig dbus su dgod /shar du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ste/ /byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro yin /nub tu padma'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro yin/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar ba dang / /ljang khu ridang ni ser po'o/ /'khor lo dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis la)bzhugs/ /ljang khu 'iser po dmar po sngo/ /dkar po steng ltas dril bu dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje bde chen 'khyud/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi tshul gyis bzhugs/ /dmar sngo ( ser dang ljang khu dang / /dkar po yang ni de bzhin no/ /padma dril bus snyoms 'jug cing /lha mo'i nu ma 'tshir ba'o/ /ser po sngon po de bzhin dmar/ /ljang khu dkar po'i kha dog ste/ /rin chen dril bus snyoms par 'jug /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /de dag mkha' 'gro lnga yin te/ /sdoms yi pa lnga yang de nyid do/ /me dang bden bral rlung dang ni/ /dbang ldan de ni bzhi po ru /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro las mkha' 'gro/ /padma'i mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum pa la skra grol ba/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs kyi gos can gar mchog can/ /mgo yi 4phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rdo rje mda' la sogs pas brgyan/ /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag na mdzes/ /'dod pa thams cad stsol mdzad 5cing / /thugs rje'i ro ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bugs rje'i 'dod pas rnam par myos/ /cung zad ngo tsha'i mig zur can/ /dgyes pa stsol bas bde ba ste/ /de ltar sna tshogs du ma yis / /dkyil 'khor rnams ni 77—882

yongs su khyab/ /du ma'i gzugs dang gzugs sdug ma/ /rdo rje mchu dang 'od byed ma/ /rta gdong dang ni drag po'i gdong / /rdo rje drag mo 〉 snyan grags ma/ /rdo rje pho nya rdo rje senatsho ri/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma de bzhin/ /ldem po tsi yang de bzhin te/ /rdo rje ro langs ma dang ni/ /rdo rje ma mo'ang de bzhin te/ /dri can ma dang 'jigs byed zhal/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug de bzhin te/ /khro gnyer can dang sna tshogs gzugs/ /rdo rje gri gug de bzhin te/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang ni/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo grags byed ma/ /na lar ki dang ser skya ma/ /rdo rje 'bar ma thal sbyor ma/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ma nyid de/ /dkyil 'khor 'grub ripa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni de dag kun/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal rnam sgyur / /gsus pa 'phyang la skra grol ba/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs kyi gos can gar mchog ste/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan / /thams cad ro yi gdan la bzhugs/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'phrog pa/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag na bsnams /rdo rje mchog ni gsor mdzad cing / /dril bu dang ni cang te'u mchog /zhal gsum dpa' zhing sgeg pa ste/ /thugs rje'i nyams ni yongs su rdzogs / /spyan ni zur gyis gzigs mdzad cing / /dgyes pa'i rtsol tshobs g.yo ba ste/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad cing / /sgrub pa po kun rjes su chags / /zla ba drug gis sgrub pa po/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo 'grub/ /yid gnyis med par dngos grub mchog /mkha' 'gro thod par byed pa yin/ /dus 'dir de ma thag tu yang / /mkha' la spyod par the tshom 7med/ /dang gi pho 77—883

brang de nyid ni/ /re'u mig dgu sogs sgo dang bcas/ /sgo ru lha mo bzhi bkod ’la / /mkha' 'gro ma ni dngos grub ster / /phyi rol dkyil 'khor lha mo bri/ /snam bu'i mtshams bzhi de ru ni/ /lha mo nyi shu dgod bya zhing / /mkha' 'gro ma sogs phyogs mtshams risu/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor dag tu brdag /sgo rnams su ni lha mo bzhi/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster / /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /zur gyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis brgyan cing / /phyi rol dkyil 'khor zig gdab po/ /de yi dang du re'u mig dgu /sgo rnams kyang ni bya ba ste/ /'di ltar mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma/ /dra ba'i sdom pa stong pa ste/ /byang chub phyogs ni sum cu bdun/ /chos kyi rnam par dag pa yin/ /dbus su sa ni bcu gsum ste / /phyi rol gnas dang nye ba'i gnas /dur khrod dang ni nye dur khrod/ /'di ltar sbyor bas rnam dag par/ /sdom pa mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /de ni thugs kyi ye shes te/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /cho ga gnyis po sbyar bar bya/ /ye shes mchog gi sdom pa ste/ /gsang ba gsum gyi 'khor lo dgod/ /byed dang phyed du rnam par dgod/ /mkha' 'gro gsum ni 'khor lo'i dbus ri/ /dam tshig rnal 'byor 'byung ba che/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas ni/ /zhabs bsil byas nas gzhug par bya/ /ye shes chu yis dbang bskur nas/ /gtso bo dag ni rnam par bsgom/ /bdag med chos kyi ro kun gyi / /dam tshig mchog ni dri ma med/ /ba spu khung bu thams cad las/ /dam tshig gsang ba gsum spros nas /sems can ma lus dam tshig gi/ /mkha' 'gro ru ni rab gnas bya/ /77—884

'bad pa yis ni bsdus nas kyang / /gsang ba gsum du gzhug par bya/ /sngon /grub pa yi mkha' 'gro ni/ /byin brlabs gnas su dgod par bya/ /'di ni rdo rje theg chen te / /mkha' 'gro spyod pa'i gnas la bzhugs/ /sdom pa mchog ni cibazlas pa yis/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang ster/ /dus bzhi dag tu ci 'dod par/ /skyo ba med par rtag tu bsgom/ /lugs su 'byung dang bzlog pa yis/ /'khor lo mchog ni rnam par spro / /ba spu'i khung bu las mdun du/ /bde mchog spros nas mchod par bya/ /rdo rje gsum ni dbang bskur nas/ /'gog pa'i khro bo rnam par bsgom/ /ye shes khro bo lhan cig tu/ /sprin gyi 'brug sgra lta bur bzla/ /'gro zhing 'ong ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mi smra rdo rje brtul zhugs che/ /zhag bdun gyis ni nges par yang / /mthu dang stobs ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /g.yo zhing ldeg tshopar byed pa dang / /'tshog cing g.yengs dang gzhug pa dang / /nad med pa ni nad yod byed/ /nad yod pa ni nad med byed / /de ltar sgom pa byas nas ni/ /las 'dir the tshom 7med pa yin/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyor ldan pas/ /bsgom dang bzlas la dga' ba dang / /dam tshig zas la dga' ba ni/ /thogs pa med par tshe yang brtanam/ /'di ltar rang gi cho gas bzlas/ /sangs rgyas gnas su legs par 'jug /der ni dam tshig 'khor lo ni/ /mkhas pas bsgom mchod bzlas pa bya/ /gsang sngags 'di dag bshad par bya/ /oṃ shrī badzra ḍā ka a dhi ci / nge ki pa'i ladzā la sasba ra lhu rgyu phaṭa gu hā / oṃ shrī bu ḍā ka a tsho rgyu ḍā ki gli dzā la sasba ra lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī nam 7 ka a khaṃ rgyu ḍā ki gli dzā la sasba sar lhu : phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shrī padma ḍā ka a hri snye ḍā ki gli dzā la sa cir lhu snye phaṭa gā hās/77—885

oṃ shrī ratna ḍā ka ① snye zla ki gli ridzā la sa car lhu sne phaṭa gu hā/ mkha' 'gro bzhi po de dag dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /mgrin pa mnyam par bsnol ba ste/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /de yi mdog dang phyag dang zhal / /phyag mtshan rnams kyang rnam par bsgom/ /lha mo mngon du byas nas ni/ /snying po'i gsang sngags so so yin/ /oṃ shrī badzra bā rā hi ri lhu sne phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī ḍā ki ni ṭwāṃ spyo rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī lā me rmā lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī khaṇḍa ro nye tsho lhu snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ shrī rū pi ṇi rī — snye phaṭa su hā/ 'di ni lnga po'i bdag nyid kyi'o / /mtshams kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ shrī bu ḍā ki ni 7lhu rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī kurma muḥ ki ni ma ཿ phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī padma ḍā ki ni palhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ shrī ratna ḍā ki ni ma rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ sgo ru mkha' 'gro ma yi sngags / /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster/ /bzhi po sna tshogs mdog can te /ji bzhin rigs kyis lakun la khyab/ /oṃ — rū be lhu ju phaṭa/ oṃ snye dkusu rū pe lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra durnyi 7lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ pra bhā —ka ri lhu phaṭa/shar phyogs kyi ni snam bu la/ /lha mo bzhi po dgod pa ste/ /sku lus dkar po'i mdog can la/ /de yi gsang sngags bshad pa yin/ /oṃ badzra ba ḍa 5ba mu khi 5lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sto cir mu khi rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sto paṇi rtu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ya sha sri ni rtu rgyu phaṭa/ lho phyogs kyi ni snam bu la/ /lha mo bzhi po dgod par bya/ /sku mdog dag ni ser ba ste/ /de yi sngags su bshad pa yin/ /oṃ badzra dru —ti rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra na khi lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sngon mā ri tso snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kai po dzi ri lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ nub phyogs kyi ni snam bu la lha mo bzhi po sku mdog 77—886

dmar po can gyi sngags yin no/ /oṃ badzra pe tā /li lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sī ka ri snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gar ḍa riri sum̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ci'i ma ba dā ne rtsu snye phaṭa/ byang gi snam bu la lha mo bzhi sku mdog ljang gu de'i gsang sngags bshad pa yin no ri/ /oṃ tsand+ra she tshokha re rtu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sgro ngaku ṭi lhu rdu phaṭa/oṃ bi shwa miru pe 7lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka ta ya 7ni lhu rgyu phaṭa/ dbang ldan la sogs /cipa'i mtshams bzhi ru lha mo bzhi po gzugs gnyis pa'i mdog can te/de'i sngags bshad pa/ oṃ badzra shri kha le lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mā —'e / lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ badzra 7ya sha ska 0ri lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ badzā na ri lā 5lhu snye phaṭa/sgo rnams su ni lha mo bzhi po sna tshogs pa'i mdog can drag po'i gzugs dang ldan pa ste/ de'i sngags su bshad pa/ shar du oṃ rubadzra piṅga le dzaḥrulhu sne phaṭa/lho ru oṃ —badzra dzwa la ni snye spyo — phaṭa/ nub tu oṃ badzra kuṇḍa li rba ri rtu snye phaṭa/byang du oṃ ri badzra rtse ra ba ho lhu snye phaṭa/ thams cad gsal byed mtha' ru ni/ /shrī ni sbyar zhing mchog rim bzhin/ /sngags pas de ltar bzlas na ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni cadra ba yi/ /sdom pa'i dngos grub thob pa ste/ /zla ba drug gis cibade dbang 'gyur/ /gcig tu byas te bsdus na ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po gzi byin can / /dra ba'i mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags 'di dag thams cad ni/ /khri'am 'bum du 4bzlas na ni/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'grub pa yin/ /snying po dag ni bzlas pa yis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma grub cing / /rang nyid ji ltar 'dod par gyur / /gzhan gyi lus su zhugs 'gro zhing / /mi snang ba dag thob nas ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnam par spyod/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni 'dzin pa rteyin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las 77—887

tā pa /kā spra // pa 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sum de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i cho ga'i rim/ /sngar bshad sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yi/ /lung la sogs ripa'i rim pa bya/ /rnal 'byor lung ni mi shes pa/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs 4can yin te/ /rtag tu lung ni spang mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum ni mi spang zhing / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su 'gro/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dmigs na/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni dngos grub 'grub/ /cig ricar 'jug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi tsholus ni rnam par bsam/ /sngo zhing drag la bzhin rnam sgyur / /gtum zhing 'jigs la tsho'ajigs par mdzad/ /zhal gyi mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /ral pa zla phyed spyi gtsug 'ching / /sna tshogs rdo rjes ral pa gnon / /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su 5rdzogs/ /baṃ hūṃ badzra las byung sku lus can/ /phyag rgya drug dang yang dag ldan/ /stag gi pags mapa gos su mdabasang/ / skyil krung 5phyed pas lalegs —par gnas/ /spyan gsum drag po'i sku lus can/ /mgrin pa bzhi la zhal bzhi pa/ /bcu gnyis phyag dang yang dag ldan/ /stong pa'i ye shes yang dag mchog /gdug pa kun gyi thod pa'i phreng / /dus mtha' las byung do shal can /gdug pa kun ni zhabs 'og gnon/ /nyon mongs 'jigs byed mgo bo dang — /sred tshopa gti mug phrag dog ste/ /dus mtshan mo 0ni khas bub la/ /gdug pa'i bgegs ni 'jigs pa can/ /thams cad zhabs kyi 'og tu gnon/ /77—888

nam mkha' /dang ni skye ba dang / /dkar ba dang ni dmar ba dang / /ljang gu steng du bltas pa'i zhal/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pa/ /phag mo dag dang bde bar ca'akhyud/ /kun tu gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /chos rnams kun gyi ro gcig tu /sbyangs pa'i yon tan zhes bya ba/ /dpal gyi bde ba chen po ni/ /rdo rje he ru ka nyid yin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo khar gsil dang / /lhung bzed mdung dang zhags pa dang / /lcags kyu mgo bo cang te'u dang / /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis/ /na phyira'i pags pa brkyang nas mnabs / /shar du mā tang gli dang ḍombi — kā/ /ra dza tī dang bukka sri / /kha ṭa tī dang sha ba rī/ /dzi bā rī chodang sa ma dril/ /lha mo brgyad po de dag ni/ /ji bzhin rim pas rjes su dgod/ /ser dang sngo dang —de bzhin dmar/ /dud pa yi ni mdog can te/ /dmar dang ljang dang dud kha'i —mdog /brgyad pa dkar po nyid yin no/ /sgo rnams su ni dgod bya ba/ /khrag 'byung rdo rje gtum mo dang / /rdo rje sring mchog ma dang ni/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed drag mo ste snye/ /gdul dka' thams cad gsol mdzad cing / /thal ba spyin mdog ljang gu 4dang / /dmar dang sngo dang lhag par 'jigs/ /brgyad pa'i dbus su chos khar gsil / /thod pa cang te'u gri gug ste/ /phrag pa'i steng du gos 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo rnams su ni lha mo bzhi/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ 5mi 'jigs pa/ /chos kyi khar gsil cang te'u/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /yi dgas cigadan gyi steng du ni/ / skyil krung laphyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /bsod snyoms pa dang chos gos gsum/ /phyis mi len dang cog 0bu pa/ / gzhi ji bzhin dang stan gcig pa spya/ /bla gab med dang shing drung ba/ /dgon pa 77—889

pa dang dur khrod dang ①/ /khrod pa dang ni phying pa pa'o/ /'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnam dag bsgom/ /ye shes mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ro gcig tu ni rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badzra he nye ru ru kai ā lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ mi ma ṭwāṃ gli lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ḍi badzra ḍi bi rī lhu snye phaṭa / oṃ ri rā dza tī lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ rbu pukka sī lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ khaṃ kha ṭa tī lhu snye phaṭa ma sho sha ba rī lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ dzi dzi ba rī lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ sa ma rī lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ ho he ru tī lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ tpa badzra tsaṇa ḍi lhu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ snye badzra rākṣa sī lhu rdu phaṭa/ oṃ lha badzra lha ra bī ri rtu snye phaṭa/ de kun gcer bu spa grol ba /spyan gsum pa la zhi ba ste/ /mche ba rnam gtsigs rtse skyod cing / /phyag rgya lnga yis sku lus brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /bzhad dang zhi dang snying rje dang / /sgeg pa dang ni rngam pa dang / /drag cing khro ba'i nyams can te/ /bzlas dang bsgom pa spro zhing bsdu/ /lus ngag yid la bde bar gnas/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /gdul ba'i thabs kyis bde ba yi / /yul la yongs su spyod pa na/ /bla med ye shes 'bras bu 'thob/ /sems can thams cad 'di yis bde/ /'chi med bde ba'i longs spyod kyis/ /ye shes 'bras bu rnyed pa yin/ /'di ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'o/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las sbyangs pa'i yon tan skyed tshopa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /char dbab cho ga'i rim pa ni/ /padma 'dab ma brgyad mchog gi/ /lte ba 1ge sar bcas pa la/ /de yi dbus su rdo 77—890

rje che/ /mche ba rnam gtsigs 'jigs pa can/ /phyag brgyad pa la zhal bzhi pa//spyan gsum 'jigs /pa'ang rab tu 'jigs/ /rdo rje mtshon ni gsor mdzad cing / / sdigs mdzub zhags par ldan pa dang / /thod pa dang ni kha ri/ 'dzin/ /lcags kyu dang ni mdung bsnams shing / /dpa' po'i pags capa mdabs pashing 'dzin/ /cang te'u dang ni brgyad par bshad/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis ni/ /chu lha 'jigs pa myos pa gnon/ /zla ba phyed pa ral pa 'ching / /sna tshogs rdo rjes rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi pags pa gos su mnabs /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod tshaman mchog /mchus gnon 7zhal gdong rnam sgyur 7zhing / /khro bar blta mazhing 'jigs par gzigs/ /'dab cim brgyad la klu brgyad bri/ /mtha' yas dang ni nor rgyas dang / /'jog po padma padma che/ /dung skyong dang ni stobs kyi mergyu/ /dga' bo dang ni brgyad yin te/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar dang ljang / /ser dang dud pa'i mdog can te/ /ljang gu tshadang ni ser po ste/ /thal mo sbyar bar byas nas ni/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon phyogs pa/ /'jig papas bka' drin slong bar byed/ /skrag pas blta pazhing gnas pa'o/ /bcom ldan sku lus sngon po can/ /'jigs shing shin tu 'jigs par mdzad/ /g.yas pa dud kha tshadamar po ste/ /g.yon pa ljang gu hodud kha'o / /steng gi zhal ni mkha' ring gdong / /zhal rnam sgyur zhing 'jigs pa'o/ /nyi ma dmar po'i gzi brjid can/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis nyi mnyam 'od/ /phag mo dag gis mgul 'khyud cing / /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /yang na phyag ni bcu gnyis pa/ /bde chen mchog ni bcu 77—891

gnyis ba/ /gri gug tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / /rdo rje dril bu yang dag ldan/ /lha mo'i mchu ni rnam par 'tshir/ /gcer bu dbu skra grol ba dang / /spyan gsum pa la ska rags 〉can/ / 'dzam bu'i chu bo mchog gi sku/ /gnyis su med par sbyor bar gnas/ /klu ni rang gi chung mar bcas/ /chu lha'ang chung mar bcas pa dag /chu lha'i lus ni dkar po can/ /bka' drin dag ni slong bar byed/ /snying gar 4ye shes 'khor lo dag /de mdog phyag dang zhal yang bskyed / /de yi snying ga : rtswa snye dgod cing / /lus ngag yid kyang de bzhin te/ /klu yi rang snying /de nyid la/ /snye rmā snye ni rnam par dgod/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i cho ga ni/ /khro bo'i tshig ltar bzlas brjod bya/ /chu bo'i 'gram mam 7rgya mtsho 'am/ /khron pa'am klu yi mtsho dang ni/ /rdzing bu lteng ka rnams su ni/ /blo can khro bo'i 5bzlas pa bya/ /yang na klu yi gnas su ni/ /sgom pa bzlas pa dag la 'jug /oṃ thi badzra he he ru ru kai snye āoṃ nā ga bar ṣā pa ya hūṃ rnga ki nī dzā chil sasba par sne laphaṭa swā hā/ 'di dag bsgoms te khri tsam bzla/ /dus bzhi dag tu stong du'o/ /zhag bdun gyis ni nges par yang / /sa rnams kun tu char 'bab 'gyur/ /dam tshig sbyin sreg mchod dus su/ /glu dang gar ni nyer ldan pas/ /'o ma dag ni bza' zhing btung / /rnal 'byor pas ni klu brgyad bzla / /'o ma'i khrus kyi cho ga yis/ /'o mas risbyin sreg bsregs 〉blugs bya/ /'o ma'i shing gi 0bud shing bya/ /'o ma'i shing gi yam shing dang / /'o mar bcas pas sbyin sreg bya/ /bum pa 'o mas yongs su dgang / /me sogs mtshams dang phyogs rnams su/ /'o mar bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ i a na rul rgyu rna rgyu zhwa hā/ oṃ bai ci'i su kai sa rnye rgyu su hā/ oṃ rta takṣa ka ཿ rna snye swā hā/77—892

oṃ tpa padma sne āoṃ sne gu hā/ oṃ mi ma hā padma rgyu rnye hūṃ gu hā/ oṃ sho she kha pā la snye rnye gu hā/ oṃ kai kusko ṭa rghaṃ rmā rghaṃ gu hā/ oṃ i a na ba tasta : rnye : gā hā / oṃ snye tpa ba ru rngo ya nā gā ci pa ta ye dzon ga barsha pa ta ye rghaṃ rnye hūṃ su hā / 'di bzlas khro ba dang bcas pas/ /kun gyi bzlas pa khri tsam bya/ /'o ma 'bras rnying skuzas su bza'/ /dbang po thul cing yongs cimi smra/ /bri gzugs spangs pa'i mngon sum du/ /khri tsam bzlas na mngon du 'gyur/ /mngon sum du ni dngos grub cing / /smras pa tsam gyis char 'bebs te/ /'di la the tshom tshom byed cig /dngul gyi snod kyi nang du ni/ / yungs gar stodang ni chu blugs la/ /de la nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du yongs su bzlas te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la dri chu dang 'o ma bsres pas khrus byas te/ chu 'gram gyi sa sbrus pa las klu'i gzugs byas la nub tu mgo bstan te/ mgo bo dgu la chus dbang bskur te/ de nas chu bo'i nang du gzhug go/ /de ma thag tu lhas char 'bebs shing / 'dzam bu'i :gling du char 'bebs ci'agyur/ /sa rnams 'bru yis gang 'gyur zhing / /nags tshal rnams ni 'phel bar byed/ /sems can thams cad bde reg gnas / /phan tshun khro po'i gzugs can ni/ /bdag bsgoms rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rang gi snying ga kho nar ni/ /ho ru rdo rje bsgoms pa yis / /char pa yang ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /ri'i steng du 'jogs te rtse gsum pa la yongs su bzlas na ser ba gcod par 'gyur ro/ /cang te'u la yongs su bzlas na me mched pa'i me rengs par 'gyur ro/ /zhags pa la yongs su bzlas na 'gugs par byed do / /thod pa la yongs su bzlas na khrag 'gugs par byed do/ /dgra sta la yongs su bzlas na gsod par byed do/ /kha 77—893

ṭwāṃ ga la yongs su bzlas na zhi bar byed do/ /gri gug la yongs su bzlas na 'jig rten gsum du rgyu ba gsod par byed do/ /mgo bo la yongs su bzlas na 'chi ba slong bar byed do/ /rdo rje gsor zhing yongs su bzlas na sa 'og gi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /dril bu la yongs su bzlas na mi dga' ba yongs /su 'gugs par byed do/ /glang po che'i pags pa la yongs su bzlas te bting na bar snang la 'phur bar 'gyur te/ dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar 'gro zhing slar ldog go/ /phyag rgya drug la yongs su bzlas na pha rol gyi mdun du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sa steng du ni kun spyod cing / /ci bde bar ni gnas par 'gyur/ //rdon // //da pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las char dbab pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste sum de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gsang ba mchog ni mdor bsdus nas/ /skad cig gis ni bdag sgom pa/ /he ru ka dpal gzugs su bya/ /sngo zhing drag po rnam sgyur ba/ /drag po spyan gsum zhal drug mchog /zla ba phyed pa ral pa 'dzin /sna tshogs rdo rje dbu mchog la/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje phreng cabs rnam par brgyan/ /sku la mgo bo'i do shal can/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi pags pa gos su mnabasari / /phag mo yis ni sku la brgyan/ /zhabs gcig pa ni bzhengs pa ste/ /g.yas pa ser la dud pa'i mdog /g.yon pa dmar la ljang gu'o / /steng gi zhal ni rta gdong ste /dkar zhing sprin mdog drag cing 'jigs/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan /lha mo mchu ni 'dzir ba ste/ /rgyal ba'i pags /pa gos su mdabs / /77—894

mkha' 'gro ma yi rigs 'dzin cing / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rdo rje mtshan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag na bsnams/ /cang te'u dang ni mgo bo 'dzin/ /gri gug zhags pa de bzhin te/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis dag tu bshad/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyang / /zhabs gcig /tu ni rnam par bsgom/ /glang po'i gdong dang bye'u'i rigadong / /seng ge'i gdong yang de bzhin te/ /dang po khyi yi gdong yin te/ /gnyis pa lug pa'i gdong yang yin/ /gsum pa phag gi gdong yin te/ /bzhi pa khu gyiyi gdong can no/ /gnas kyi dbyibs kyi chos bdag nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni chen po 'dzin/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal grags pa ste/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad pa/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i sku lus 'chang / /de bzhin sgom zhing rnam bsgom ste/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rin chen bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po rnam par rol/ //spyanalnga pa/'o brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i le'u ste sum de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phag mo'i mchog ni bsgrub pa ste/ /skyed ri pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid sgom zhing rnam par bsgom/ /sku ni nyi ma bcu gnyis gzi/ /sku lus sin dur 'dra mi g.yo/ /me tog bco rika lta bu/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs / /sems dpa'i kyil mo krung tshogis bzhugs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /dbu skra mdzes pas 'khril ba ste/ /thabs kyi zhal mchu rnam 'tshir zhing / /mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa ste/ /rna 77—895

ba'i mthar thug 'gengs par byed/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /lcags kyu mchog gis 'gugs pa ste/ /padma dmar po'i dbus bzhugs shing / /'dod pa thams cad rab tu spyol/ /yang na phyag ni bcu gnyis pa/ /zhal drug lha mo'i sku lus 'byung / /steng gi zhal ni phag rgod gdong / /drag po gzi brjid 'jigs pa'i gzi/ /shar gyi 'dab la rdo rje gsang ba'i mchog /g.yon pa'i phyogs su rdo rje dam tshig mchog /nub kyi phyogs su rdo rje gzi brjid mchog /lho yi phyogs su rdo rje rin chen mchog /me yi phyogs su rdo rje ye shes mchog /bden bral phyogs su rdo rje rig mchog ma/ /rlung gi phyogs su rdo rje grub mchog ma /dbang ldan phyogs su rdo rje thal mchog ma/ /sgo la rdo rje 'bar mchog ma/ /rdo rje gzi brjid mchog ma ste/ /rdo rje khro bo mchog ma dang / /rdo rje mche ba mchog ma'o/ /lha mo de dag thams cad kyang / /dmar ba'i mdog can zhal gsum pa / /phyag drug pa la spyan gsum pa/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung cidu bzhugs /dbu skra dag ni grol ba ste/ /thams cad rgyan gyis rnam brgyan cing — /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas/ /rang gi lus kyi thabs la 'khril / /zhags pa dang ni lcags kyu dang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /grwa bzhi dag tu mda' gzhu dag /yongs su 'gengs pa gnas par gzhag /sgo ru g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /gcer bu rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ /thams cad yi dgas byugadan la bzhugs/ /rdo rje gsor /zhing sdigs mdzub —dang / /zhags pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /gzhan yang phan tshun dag tu yang / /ji ltar 'khor la sogs phyag 'tshal/ /de snying ye shes lha mo ni/ /sku gsung thugs dang bcas par tshobasgom/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /chos kyi ro ni 77—896

mnyam par thim/ /ye shes bzlas pa spros nas ni/ /cho ga'i rim pas yang dag bsdu /dam tshig mchog gi bzlas pa yis/ /zla ba'i de nyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ shrī badzra bā rā nyi a baṃ lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī badzra gu rgyasta rime lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī badzra sa ma yotta cime lhu snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra te dza utta me sum̐ rgyu phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra rasna sta me lhu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ṭī badzra tsā na utta me rtu rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī badzra bca /utta me lhu snye phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra sistotta —the rtu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī badzra bha smotta me lhu 7rgyu phaṭa gā hā /oṃ shrī badzra dzwa 7losta chime dzaX lhu : phaṭa gā hā / oṃ shrī badzra a mṛ tosta lame lhu hūṃ phaṭa su hā / oṃ shrī badzra kro sto tta cime lhu rgyu phaṭa gā hā / oṃ shrī badzra dosmo sta same hoḥzu sa phaṭa su hā / 'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /bsgom pa dang ni bzlas pa bya/ /bsdu cadang spro ba byas nas ni/ /chos rnams kun dang chos can ni/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor bas dag /sems can thams cad rab tu brtag /rnal 'byor gnas ni chos yin te/ /gsang ba gsum la rab tu gzhug /gsang gsum gnas ni chos yin te/ /chos kyang de bzhin de lta bu/ /bdag med chos ni chos yin te/ /chos las chos ni yod ma yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gsang ba gsum gyi dam tshig gi mchog ces bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma drug cho ga'i rim/ /padma 'dab salnga bris nas ni/ /lte ba ge sar khyab par ni/ /de yi dbus su phag mo ni /dmar zhing sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /zhal gsum pa snaX rjo/ 9/ga

mdzes /spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyogs kyi gos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog / skyil krung /byed pa gar dang bcas/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku brgyan cing / /mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa ste/ /gdug pa'i bdud ni thams cad dang / /dus mtshan kha spub mibyas pa la / /zhabs kyis kyang ni mnan par bzhugs/ /dmar dang sngo dang ljang ba ste/ /sangs rgyas lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag na bsnams/ /mgo bo dang ni gri gug 'dzin/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /snying gar can shes dam tshig ni/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor las byung —/ /shar phyogs lha mo ya mi ni/ /g.yon du bskor nas rnam par dgod/ /rmongs byed ma dang skyod byed ma/ /spag byed ma dang tsaṇḍi ka /spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba ste/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /sngo dang dkar dang ser ba dang — /ljang khu dud pa'i mdog can te/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /dril bu cang te'u gri gug dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs kyi gos can gar gyi mchog /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /mi bskyod pa yi cod pan 'chang / /thugs rje'i nyams kyi bde ba ste/ /gnyis med sbyor bas mnyam par ldan/ /rdo rje sems sogs mchog de nyid/ /phag mo dang ni rdo rje sems/ /ya mi ni dang rnam snang mdzad /rmongs byed ma dang padma'i gar/ /skyod byed ma dang khrag 'thung ste/ /skrag byed rdo rje nyi ma dang / /tsaṇḍi ka dang rta mchog ste/ /rdo rje sems spu dkar po ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad ser po yin/ /padma gar dbang dmar po ste/ /he ru ka dpal sngon po yin/ /rdo rje nyi ma dmar po ste/ /rta mchog dag tshoni 77—898

ljang gu'o 3/ /yang na so sor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum pa / /phyag drug spyan ni gsum pa ste/ /phyag rgya drug gi mtshan gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bu thod kha ṭwāṃ/ /ral gri cang te'u mgo bo 'chang / /na ra'i pags mnabs rigar dang bcas/ /rnam snang la sogs dpa' bo kun/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ dang / /cang te'u dril bus mtshan pa'i mchog /yang na thams cad phyag bcu gnyis/ /zhal gdong drug par bsgom par bya/ /de dag gsang sngags 'di yin te/ /oṃ shrī oṃ tpa lhu rghaṃ phaṭa gā hā/ oṃ shrī haṃ ci yo yaṃ lhu ཿ phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ shrī spyo mi 7me / lhu snye phaṭa gā hā / oṃ shrī hre 74 mas lhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ shrī snye hūṃ si rtu hūṃ phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ shrī phaṭa phaṭa rtsa lhu sne phaṭa chag hā/ de dag ni rnal 'byor ma drug gi gsang sngags so/ /oṃ haḥ ཿ phaṭa gā hā/ tshe na maḥhi pa snye phaṭa su hā/ oṃ zhwa hā hu pahri rtu — phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bo deṭa nye lha lhu snye me phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ rgyu ཿ ho statraṃ 0lhu ཿ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phaṭa haṃ lhu 5snye phaṭa gu hā/ 'di ni dpa' bo drug gi sngags/ /bzlas pa dang ni bsgoms tsam gyis/ /'khor lo drug ni mchog grub cing / /'khor los sgyur snyeb thob pa ste/ /'khor los sgyur sadrug rgyal por 'gyur/ /mi pham sargyal ba yang dag rdzogs/ /stobs chen rtsal mchog rnyed pa yin/ /phyag mtshan drug la rtag mchod cing / /cho ga bzhin du mngon bsngags rtson/ /de ni myur du grub nas ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po'i mchog kyang thob/ /mi snang la sogs 0grub nas ni/ /khams gsum dag tu rnam par spyod //'gro ba drug gi sems can grol/ /bsgoms pas rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs/ /yang na 'khor lo zur drug la/ /bde ba chen po rnam snang mdzad/ /'jam pa'i 77—899

rdo rje 'chang rgyal po/ /'khor los sgyur /ba bdag po ni/ /gur gum gyi rini mdog lta bu/ /gzi mdangs 'bar ba'i 'od can te/ /phyag rgya che ridang yang dag ldan/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang ngo bo/ /rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gis 'khyud/ /ral gri po ti kha ṭwāṃ ga /thod pa lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /utpa la dang cang te'u/ /gur gum mdog dang sngo ba dang / /dmar dang ljang gu steng zhal dkar/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dag pa che / /sems can khams ni rab grol byed/ /shar sogs g.yon bskor dgod pa ni /rta mchog tsa dzoba'i ka dang bcas/ /de dag de ru dgod byas pas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje rang nyid 'grub / /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang / /sngo dang dmar dang dkar sngo ljang / /yan lag drug tu dpa' bo dag /mkha' 'gro ma dang lhan cig bcas/ /rdo rje sems dang maphag mo dang / /rnam snang mdzad dang ya —mi ni/ /padma gar dbang rmongs byed bcas/ /khrag 'thung dang ni skyod byed ma/ /rdo rje nyi ma skrag byed ma/ /ljang dang dud pa'i mdog can te/ /de lta'i sku mdog rnam par bsgom/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa'o/ /lha mo rnams ni phyag gnyis pa'o/ /thod pa dang ni gri gug 'dzin/ /dpa' bo thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /rang gi phyag mtshan gnyis med sbyor/ /dril bu lhan cig yang dag ldan /cang te'u ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /spyan gsum pa la g.yas brkyang bzhugs /stag gi pags lapa'i shams mthabs can/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /mgo bo'i do shal 'dzin pa ste/ /thams cad yi dgas skusteng du bzhugs /dbus su 'jigs byed dus mtshan gnon / /lha mos 0byin pa gnyis kyis 'khril/ /skra grol ba la phyogs gos can/ /snying gar ri ye shes dam 77—900

tshig ni/ /sku gsung thugs dang rnam par sbyar/ /go cha gnyis pa yang dag sbyar//gnas kyi 'khor lo bsgoms nas ni/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgod/ /gsang ba gsum ni snying gar /gnas/ /khu gdong la sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyi rol sgo ru rnam par dgod/ /zur du gshin rje sreg la sogs / /thams cad gcer bu rnam par bsgom/ /sngar bshad mdog dang phyag mtshan te/ /yi dgas gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /drag po skra ni grol ba ste/ /thams cad thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /rang gi phyi dang nang du yang / /pha rol phyin drug rnam par dag /sgom zhing rab tu bsgom par bya /spro zhing bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bzlas pa bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma bzlas na/ /sgom zhing rab tu bsgom par bya/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i tshogs spros nas/ /'gro ba gsum po rdzogs par byas / /nang gi bdag nyid bsgoms pa yis/ /'khor lo gsum gsang bsgoms nas bzla / /de nyid gsum dang sngags lhan cig /dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /lhu ci phaṭa ni mtha' ru ste/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bzlas pa bya/ /rnal 'byor cho ga bzhin du ni/ /dam tshig can gyis de bzla 7bya/ /tshe shrī ma ngabadzra āḥ hūṃ mi lhu rgyu phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ haX badzra sa twa malhu snye phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ rba badzra ci'i rā gyi lhu ཿ phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ na maḥ gyi badzra 〉bee ro tsa na lhu snye phaṭa gā hā / oṃ ha oṃ ya ma 5ni rtu rgyu phaṭa gā hā/ tshe su hā hu 7padma darnye 0sha ri rtu snye phaṭa gu hā/tshe dzrī 5mo mo ha ni sirtu ཿ phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ bo laṣaṭa nye he ru ka 0lhu rgyu phaṭa zhwa hā lko1 0spyo ris tsa la ni rtu snye phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ rdu rgyu ho badzra gurya 0lhu rghaṃ phaṭa zhwa hā/ oṃ snye snye sa ci tā sa ni lhu snye phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ phaṭa ha pa ra mā gsha 77—901

lhu snye phaṭa gu hā// oṃ phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇḍi ka lhu rgyu phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ tā tā phye ri ci snye phaṭa/ oṃ u lu ritā phye 4lhu sne phaṭa/ oṃ shā nā gye rtsu snye phaṭa/ oṃ su chika rā /gye —6 rdu phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā 7snyi 7lhu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dru ti 7lhu rgyu phaṭa / oṃ ya ma de: ṇi 5lhu snye phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni palhu sne phaṭa/g.yon dang g.yas kyi lag gnyis su/ /go cha gnyis po bkod tshanas ni/ /gang zhig ji ltar 'dod pa ru/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa yin/ /the tshom tshamed par las byas na/ci/ /nges par dngos grub gzhan du min/ /yang na mgon po sa bcu'i dbang / /pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab drug pa 7ste/ /thabs dang stobs dang smon lam dang / /ye shes sgo skyong rnam dag pa'o/ /rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro can/ /sbyang dka' ba dang mngon du gyur / /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin / /'di yis rnam par dag pa bsgom/ /gshin rje sreg sogs bzhi po ni/ /'phags pa'i bden par rnam par bsgom/ /sdug bsngal dang ni kun 'byung dang —/ /'gog pa dang ni lam rnams te/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal//chos kyi dbyings kyi rnam dag ste/ /ye shes rang gi ngo bo yin/ /'di ltar rnam par dag pa bsgom/ /gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i lam/ /gsang zhing mchog skyitu gsang ba ste/ /rnal 'byor stobs kyis gsang ba mchog /sgrub cipas rjes su bstan pa dang / /ji bzhin bdag po'i dbye ba dang / /bla ma'i rim pa legs par bslabs / /'di ltar cho ga saganyis med par / /sbyor ba'i dam tshig mchog yin te/ /dngos grub kun gyi thabs kyi rgyu/ /rnal 'byor ma thugs 77—902

gsang ba che/ /las rnams kun gyi 'bras bu ster①/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gnyis su med pa'i go cha'i byu sbyor ba skyed ripa'i sgom pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /brda 5ni mchog tu gsang ba ste/ /brda ri ni yongs su mi shes par/ /sbyor ba'i dngos grub mi 'grub ste/ /'di ni nges par shes pa na/ /dngos grub 'grub par the tshom med/ /dwa zhes bya ba skyes bur bshad/ /di zhes bya ba bud med yin/ /pu tshozhes bya ba gnon pa yin/ /su zhes bya ba za ba nyid/ /ma zhes bya ba ma ru bshad/ /ya zhes bya ba chung ma nyid/ /bha 7zhes bya ba sring mo yin/ /gi zhes bya ba mdza' mor bshad/ /lu 7zhes bya ba bu mo yin/ /sri zhes bya ba khrag tu bshad/ /so ni zhi ba'i btung ba yin / /pe zhes bya ba thug pa ste/ /pi zhes bya ba de bzhin sha/ /ba zhes bya ba za ba yin/ /ku zhes bya ba 'dres pa yin/ /pi zhes bya ba dur khrod yin/ /du zhes bya ba ro yin no/ /ṭī 5zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma/ /gā zhes bya ba lā ma yin//tri zhes bya ba gzugs can ma/ /ku zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma/ /ha ni khaṇḍa ro nyid ma/ /dza zhes bya ba byin pa gnyis5/ /ba zhes bya ba gsong por smra/ /swa zhes bya ba legs 'ongs yin/ /mi zhes bya ba nya yin la/ /byo zhes bya ba bza' ba min / /phyo gozhes bya ba btung ba min / /ga ni bgrod dang bgrod min yin//ka zhes bya ba 'dod pa yin/ /sa zhes bya ba gzhan mi 'gro/ /ra zhes bya ba khyo med tshamo/ /du zhes bya ba spyod ngan mo/ /su zhes bya ba skal bzang 7mo na zhes bya ba skal ngan ma / /sa zhes bya ba dam tshig can/ /tshom zhes rdo sdu 0/ma

tshig med/ /zhi mizhes bya ba 'ongs pa yin/ /na zhes bya ba ma thongs yin/ /so zhes bya ba chags pa yin/ /'di dag yi ge'i brda riyin te/ /dbang bskur dus su rnal 'byor pas/ /bza' dang bza' med sbyin par bya/ /dbang bskur ba ni mchog yin cite/ /dam tshig mchog ni shes pa dang / /dam tshig can gyi dam tshig dus/ /dam tshig 'khor lo 'dus pa dang / /dad pa rnams la sbyin par bya/ /ma dad pa la sbyin mi bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las brda'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma yi mtshan nyid ni/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob / /bud med pad rtsa ltar dkar zhing / /padma'i 'dab ltar dkyus ring mig /rtag tu gos ni dkar la dga'/ /tsandan sar pa'i dri dang ldan/ /bde tshogashegs 'dus pa nyid la dga'/ /de rigs tshalas byung shes par bya/ /bud gang btso ma'i megaser 'dra zhing / /dmar dang ser ba'i gos la dga'/ /dzā ti tsam pa'i dri dang ldan/ /de yang bzang po'i rjes 'gror 'gyur/ /thams cad utpal ltar sngo bsangs/ /dri dang gos ni sngo la dga'/ /utpal sngon po'i dri yod pa/ /de ni dpa' po bzang rjes 'gro/ /bud med pad dkar 'dra mdog gang / /rtag tu padma'i rtsa ba dri/ /de yang de bzhin dpa' mo'i blo/ /dmar zhing ser skya'i bud med gang / /gzugs bzang gos ni dmar ba dang / /ma la ki dang utpal dri /de ni rdo rje'i rigs byung yin/ /ser zhing ljang ba'i bud med gang / /gos ni dkar la dga' ba dang / /mgo la me tog dri dang ldan/ /de bzhin 77—904

gshegs rigs rjes 'gro yin/ /bud med gang zhig kha dog dmar/ /de'i ①mdog can gyi snyegos 'chang zhing / /rtag tu ga bur dri dang ldan/ /rnam snang rigs kyi rjes 'gro zhing ri/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rigs rnams ni/ /de ltar bdun po ngas cibashad pa/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod la rtag dga'/ /rang gi mdog gis rigs drug ldan/ /rigs kyi rig pa'i yi ge yang / /kha dog drug tu 'gyur ba yin/ /rang gi phyag rgya 'ching ba dang / /rang rig las byung tshig tu smra/ /g.yon las 'gro ba'i bud med gang / /rnal 'byor pa la g.yon la rtag /lag pa g.yon gyis mtshon pa dang / /g.yon nas lta bas rnam par blta/ /lha mo rnams dang gar smra ba/ /de ni dam tshig ldan par bshad/ /bud med gang byas de nyan cing / /rigs kyi sa bon rab tu smra/ /rigs kyi bya ba mi spong ste/ /rang gis bstan bshad mi 'dor la/ /rang gi rigs kyi rig pa zlos/ /de ni dam tshig ldan par bshad/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni gang 'ching ba/ /g.yon pa'i lus kyis rtag tu 'dud/ /lha mo rnams dang kun smra ba/ /de ni nges par bde bar 'gro/ /mthe bong g.yon pas sa la ni/ /rkang pas ri mo 'dri tshobyed cing / /mgo ni 'phrug par byed pa dang / /zur gyis lta zhing lag pa ston/ /sgrub —pa po la khyad par du/ /de yis rang rig dran pa dang / /mkhur 7ba'am kos ko rmudag dang ni/ /sna dag tu ni thal 5mo ston/ /zur gyis lta zhing lan cig bsngags / /zlos shing rigs la rnam par blta / /bden par 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ /nges par dam tshig can yin na/ /de nas rnyed dka' rnal 'byor ma / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams yang dag 'byung //ya sami gli tshadang skrag byed ma/ /'dod ldan phag mo 'jigs gzugs ma/ /kun 77—905

tu spyod pa ba su ra/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnam pa bdun/ /mdor bsdus rang mtshan bshad pa yin/ /gzugs can ma dang tsum pi tā// /lā ma yongs gyur byis bcas mo/ /mi ldog ye nyi tā lha mo/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni mdun cadu bshad/ /mngon par zhen pas blta ba dang / /smin ma 'degs par gar byed cing / /sngon bzhin gzugs ni sdud byed la/ /phyis ni 'jigs par byed pa dag /gzugs can ma ni yin par bshad/ /gnyis med dpa' bos bsnyen par bya/ /sdug pa'am yang na mi sdug pa/ /byis pa 'khyud cing tsum pa na /de ni tsum pa krer shes bya/ /mkha' 'gro mchog kyang de nyid yin/ /zas mi lta bar zur du blta / /khro gnyer dang ni gdong dag dang / /smin ma sgyur zhing sdigs mdzub chodang / /'di ni gzhan yang dbugs mi 'byin/ /'jigs par byed pa gang yin pa/ /de ni lā ma yin par bstan/ /phag dang dred dang byi la dang / /ce 7spyang rigs dang stag dag dang / /thams cad der ni 'jigs byed pa/ /yongs su gyur par de bshad do / /shin tu dga' bas rgod —pa dang / /song nas slar yang mi ldog la/ /rjes su chags pas gsal bar rgodapa/ /dum skyes mar ni de bshad do / /yid ni kun tu skyo ba dang — /rkang pa lag pas bong ba'am/ /gos mtha' 'am yang na shing dag gis//des reg pa ni 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /mi ldog par ni shes bya ste/ /bsgrub skumin par ni de bshad do/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rigs phyag rgya/ /dpa' bos bsnyen cing mtshan ma blta/ /thod pa dgra sta mche ba dang / /ral gri kun tu spag byed yin / /rdo rje dang ni dung nyid dang / /rigs kyi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan ma'i le'u ste 77—906

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gang zhig yang dag shes pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la gnas pa'o/ /dmar zhing ser ba'i bud med gang / /padma'i dri ni rnam par gtong / /lta stangs rang bzhin zhi ba dang / /zhen pas lta ba'i rjes 'gro ba/ /bud med gang gi /sen mo dmar/ /mig ni kun tu zhen ripa dang / /khyim du padma 'dri rib ni//padma gar dbang rigs byung cayin/ /smin ma'i dbus na rtse gsum yod/ /lus ni sngo bsangs skya ba dang / /rtag tu rdo rje rigs bsgom pa/ /gang gi khyim du rdo rje 'dri / /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma de dpal ldan ni/ /he ru ka yi tshorigs byung yin/ /gang gi dpral bar rtse gsum ni/ /mdung thung dag ni snang 'gyur zhing / /mig dmar mdog ni dmar ser dang / /de bzhin rkang pa lag pa dmar/ /ra skyes khyim bya dag la yang / /rtag tu yid ni dgar 'gyur zhing zu/ /de yi khyim du rdo rje mtshan/ /rtag tu gang zhig mchod byed pa/ /shrī he ru na'i rigs byung 7ba/ /mkha' 'gro yin par gdon mi za/ /'khor lo gang gi dpral ba'am/ /lag par 7yang ni snang 'gyur ba/ /khrin sngon dag dang 'dra ba ni/ /rtag tu dpral bar 'chang byed pa/ /skal ba chen po kun tshogs shing / /mchog tu bden pa gang yin dang / /khyim du 'khor lo 'dri kṣ-ibyed cing / /rtag tu de la mchod byed pa/ /rdo rje phag mo rigs byung chaba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni stobs kyis dregs/ /gang zhig mig sman gnag pa'adra zhing / /so ni dkar skezhing mtho ba dang / /rtag tu gdug par gyur pa dang / /sems 77—907

stobs ldan par gyur pa dang / /rtag tu khrus la dga' ba dang / /mang du smra bar mi byed cing / /khyim du rdo rje 'dri /ba dang / /rtag tu dge bas mchod byed pa/ /rdo rje phag mo'i rigs 'byung rib/ /stong phrag bcu dang lnga pa yin/ /ser zhing gser gyi mdog 'drar snang / /mig mi g.yo cizhing kha spu ser/ /rdo rje gang gi dpral ba'am/ /lag par yang ni snang 'gyur ba/ /rtag tu rgyal srid dag la gnas/ /snyems shing bden par smra ba dang / /mā li ka yi dri 'byung zhing / /gang gi khyim du rdo rje ni/ /rtag tu 'dri /zhing cher mchod pa/ /dum skyes ma yi rigs las byung / /rnal 'byor ma yi dbang phyug mchog /gang zhig rtag par sha la dga'/ /skem zhing mig sman gnag —pa'i mdog /dpral bar mdung rtse lta bu yod/ /gang zhig gdug pa'i las la dga'/ /rtag tu dur khrod dag tu 'gro/ /'jigs pa med cing brtse med de / /gang gis dpral bar thig le dang / /khyim du thod pa 'dri —zhing mchod/ /dpal ldan he ru ka de yi/ /mkha' 'gro'i parigs las byung ba yin/ /sprin gyi mdog 'dra'i pabud med gang / /so ni mi mnyam par gnas shing / /rtag tu gdug pa'i las la dga'/ /g.yon gyi mche ba gtsigs —pa dang / /de yi khyim du dgra sta ni/ /'dri cizhing rtag tu mchod byed pa/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i rigs byung 7ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro mar ni the tshom med/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs 'di dag /shrī nye ru ga'i rigs las byung / /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid yang dag bshad pa yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //77—908

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sgrub pa po yis lā ma yi/ /mtshan nyid kyi ni khyad par dang / /yan lag tshogs ni shes bya ba'o// /gang gi bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /kun tu skum por snang 'gyur zhing / /kha yi sma ra rtag tu yod /spu dang smin ma ring ba dang / /gos bzang gtsang zhing zhi ba dang / /mi 'khrugs bden par smra ba dang / /rtag tu dam pa'i chos la dga'/ /dpa' bo sring mor de shes bya/ /padma'i phyag rgyar sbyin bya ba/ /yang na ru sbal phyag rgya bya/ /pags pa bum pa spyi blugs nyid/ /phyag rgya'i lan du shes par bya / /de ni tshes bcu'i res dag la/ /khyim du padma 'dri tshobar 'gyur/ /lā ma yi ni bud med kyi / /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin/ /gsus pa rlo zhing mig dkyus ring / /mig ni dmar zhing ser skyar gnas/ /phyug cing skal mubazang dpal yon can / /ser zhing tsam pa lta bur snang / /shin tu ring min thung ba'ang min/ /sna tshogs pa yi gos la dga'/ /dpral bar ri mo gsum yod cing / /mtshams kyi gyen du bltas pa chodas/ /dgod pacing dga' ba nyid dag dang / /lam ni rnam par gnon cing gnas/ /g.yul du 'chi —ba rnams kyi ni/ /gtam dag la ni rtag tu dga'/ /de lta'i rab dregs mthong na ni/ /mdung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bskum pa yisapa/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bstan par bya/ /g.yon pa dag ni yongs bzlog 7pa/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni yin par bshad/ /bcu bzhi dang ni tshes brgyad ni/ /de ni dus tshigs yin par bshad/ /khyim du mdung rtse gsum pa yang / /bris nas de ni rtag tu mchod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lā ma yi / /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin / /gang gi mkhur 5tshos dag tu ni/ /khung bur snang ba gnas gyur cing / /77—909

de bzhin rtag tu dmar zhing ser/ /mig ni ljang ser dag tu snang / /skra ni de bzhin 'khyil ba dang / /mgo dang dpral bar dar bcings snang / /ri mo gcig ①pa rab tu gnas/ /de bzhin mgrin pa ring ba dang / /rtag tu gos dmar la dga' zhing / /dgod 5cing glu ni len pa nyid/ /lan 'ga' rizhig ni khro ba dang / /sems ni rnam par g.yo ba dang / /rtsod pa la ni dga' ba ste/ /'di 'dra'i rab dregs mthong na ni/ /mdung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /gnyis pa nyid ni 'bad pa yis/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su ldog pa ni/ /phyag rgya'i lam cini yin par bshad/ /thung zhing byin pa sbom pa dang / /rtag tu gos ser la dga' zhing / /phrag pa dag na gos kyang 'chang tsho/ /de 'dra'i bud med mthong na ni/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan bya zhing / /'bad pa yis ni gnyis pa yang / /dung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /g.yon nas yongs su bzlog pa ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni yin par bshad/ /bcu bzhi de yi dus yin te/ /de yi khyim du rdo rje 'dri / /shrī he ru ka lā ma yi ri/ /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin/ /lus kun la ni ba spu yod/ /mig ni gnag 7cing ser ba dang / /sbom zhing rnam sgyur mi bzad —pa/ / bzhin 'phel mche zhing kha che la / /ma mchu rlo —zhing kha dog nag /mig skum sna ni nyams pa dang /rtag tu glu ni mkhas pa dang / /sprin gyi mdog can yid 'phrog pa/ /'di 'dra'i rab dregs tshomathong na ni/ /glu yi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /gnyis pa yang ni 'bad pa yis/ /mdung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /g.yon nas —yongs su bzlog pa ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni yin par bshad/ /tshes grangs bcu gcig de yi 5dus/ /khyim du mche nib 'dri cibar byed/ /rdo rje phag mo lā ma yi//77—910

mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ’las lā ma'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi brda rnams te/ /gang zhig ༷spun dang sring mo ru/ /yang dag shes par 'gyur ba'o/ /gang zhig lag g.yon ston pa ni/ /gsong por smra ba ston pa yin/ /gang zhig srin lag ston pa ni/ /gsong por smra ba lan 'gyur yin/ /gang zhig sto ba debs pa ni/ /bdag ni bkros par ston pa yin/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa ni/ /nam mkha' las ni 'ongs zhes pa'o/ /gang zhig khar ni sor mo 'dzud / /zos zin zhes ni smra ba yin/ /gang zhig rtse ni bskyod pa dag /za'o zhes ni smra ba yin/ /gang zhig pus mo la reg pa/ /ngal lo zhes ni ston pa yin/ /gang zhig sor mo'i ri 9rtse la reg /ngal sos zhes ni smra ba yin / /gang zhig so 7ni 'cha' byed pa/ /sha za'o zhes ni smra ba yin/ /lag pa g.yas pa ston pa ni7/ /'di ltar gyis zhes ston 2pa yin/ /gang zhig khro gnyer ston pa ni/ /bcings so zhes ni smra ba yin/ /gang zhig mkha' lding ston pa ni/ /grol lo zhes ni ston pa yin/ /gang zhig khu tshur ston pa ni/ /de la pa ta ti mabastan bya/ /gang zhig skra ni ston pa la/ /rnam par 'gyur ba bltas nas ni/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga ni de la bstan//gang zhig yan lag bskyod pa dang / /de la mche ba bstan par bya/ /gang zhig lag pas lag pa ston/ /gtor ma za zhes smra ba yin/ /gang zhig lag pa g.yas pa ston/ /de ltar gyis shig smra ba yin/ /gang zhig rna ba la reg pa/ /gnas par bya zhes ston pa yin/ /gang zhig sen mos sen mo reg /shi yis khyer zhes chi77—911

yin / /gang zhig nu ma la reg pa/ /bdag gi bu ni srungs zhes bya/ /gang zhig mthe g.yon sa la 'dri / /gnyen dag srungs shig pa ru bshad/ /gang zhig mig ni rnam 'dzums pa/ /de ltar bya zhes smra ba yin/ /gang zhig tshigs la reg byed pa/ /bde bar nyal zhes smra ba yin/ /pho nya ma ni gang yang rung //de dag kun gyis yang dag spyad/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las brda'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas yan lag phyag rgya yi/ /mtshan nyid nga yis bshad par bya/ /bud gang spyi gtsug reg byed pa/ /mgo bo de la bstan par bya/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa ni/ /de la mkhur tshotshos bstan par bya/ /gang zhig so ni ston pa la/ /de la rtse ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig mchu ni ston byed pa/ /de la dpung pa bstan par bya/ /gang zhig rked rgyab ston byed pa/ /de la sa ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig nu ma ston byed pa/ /de la kos ko bstan par bya/ /gang zhig lto ba ston byed pa/ /de la lte ba bstan par bya/ /gang zhig gsang ba ston byed pa/ /de la ling ga bstan par bya/ /gang zhig brla ni ston byed pa/ /de la 'og ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig pus mo ston byed pa/ /de la byin pa bstan par bya/ /gang zhig rkang mepa ston byed pa/ /de la rkang mthil skabastan par bya/ /gang zhig sor tshigs ston byed pa/ /de la sen mo bstan par bya/ /gang zhig sa ni ston byed pa/ /de la nam mkha' bstan par bya/ /gang zhig nam mkha' ston byed pa/ /de la nyi ma bstan par bya/ /gang zhig chu bo ston byed pa/ /de la rgya 77—912

mtsho bstan par bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las yan lag gi phyag rgya'i /tshomatshan nyid kyi le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /yan lag ji bzhin phyag rgya'i mchog /gang zhig shes pas spun nam ni/ /sring mor the tshom rimed 'gyur ro/ /sor mo gcig ci ni ston pa yis/ /legs par 'ongs zhes smra ba yin/ /sor mo gnyis ni bstan pa yis/ /legs 'ongs lan ni smra ba yin/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /yan lag phyag rgyar rab tu bshad/ / mdzub mo gnyis bkug mig gi rgya / /sngags pas gang la de bstan de / /de mod ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar/ /dbang du 'gyur bar the tshom tshomed/ /gang zhig gung mo ston byed pa/ /de la mdzub rshamo bstan par bya/ /gang zhig srin lag ston byed pa/ /de la rtse ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig pa ti / sa ston pa/ /de la mdun ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig spyi bo ston byed pa/ /de la mtshams kyi mtha' bstan bya/ /gang zhig sa ni ston byed pa/ /de la mkha' mni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig khro gnyer ston byed pa/ /de la mtshams ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig so ni ston byed pa/ /de la mchu ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig mgrin pa ston byed pa/ /de la kha ni bstan par bya/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston byed pa/ /de la lte ba bstan par bya/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /rim skebazhin yan lag phyag rgya yin/ /'di dag rtag bstan cigasang ba pa/ /yang dag lta bar ci'agro bar 'gyur/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las mkha' 'gro ma'i yan lag gi phyag rgya'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// // 77—913

gi /ring nas dpa' bo dang / /dpa' mo sring mor shes 'gyur ba'o/ /dam tshig can gang rjes chags pa/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod sa gzhi yin/ /gzhir ni sa gzhi byas nas su/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sdom pa mchod/ /go bzlog ripa yis lta ba ni/ /bzhin ni rnam par 'gyur ba nyid / /rtag tu bzhin gyi zin ma g.yo//sna tshogs myur du shes bya ba/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro las byung ba'o/ /rnam sgyur ( 'khyil par shes bya ste/ /ri mo gsum pa yongs su skum/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams nges 'gro ba'i/ /de yi mtshan ma shes par bya/ /gal te ldog par gyur na ni/ /sngar bshad don ni btang bar 'gyur/ /de yi dngos ni 'jig /gyur pa/ /rdo rje lta bur gsal ba yin/ /sgra ni khu byug skad lta bur / /gsal ba de ni rtag tu gyur/ /'di ni mtshan ma'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje lta bu me long bcas ral gri 'dra ba'i me long bcas/ /phyag mtshan mdung 'drar rtag tu 'byung / /de gsal me long yin zhes bya/ /mtshan mar byas pa'i gzugs dag ni/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag dang ldan pa/ /'di 0ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /mchog yin par ni shes par bya/ /po āoṃ gi zhes bya ba ni/ /gsong por smra ba'o/ /pra ti po rta gi zhes bya ba ni/ gsong por smra ba'i rtsi lan no/ /ga mu zhes bya ba ni 'gro'o zhes bya ba yin no/ /rlu spre zhes bya ba ni 'ong ngo zhes bya ba yin no/ /de gyi zhes bya ba ni zas zhes 2bya ba yin no/ /gri ha na zhes bya ba ni bram ze zhes bya 7ba yin no / /pi ra ṇi zhes bya ba ni snying nyid do/ / ma ra ṇa bzhes bya ba ni sgra ngan no/ / hān dha pazhes bya ba ni kur ni na'o/ /shi ro ni brdzun tshano/ /ka ra ni sto ba'o/ /77—914

ba ra ni 4sgra'o/ /shra ra ma ṇi ni rna ba'o/ /a sri rin gu ni bsrubs dpa'o/ /sa ma ga ma ni mi'o/ /ta li ka ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /na ra ka ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /a mo ka ni dur khrod do/ /ka li ka ni sgo'o/ /shwa sa ni bram ze'i rigs so / /pa ri rnyi ni rgyal rigs so/ /bi ra ti ni rje'u rigs so/ /kru ra ni dmangs rigs )so/ /man ta 'i tshoni sme sha can no/ /pa shu li ka ni khyim mo/ /ṭā 7ka 7ni sring mo'o/ /me la pa ka ni chu'o/ /gri ha ra ṇa ni rdo rje chu gtong ba'o//rtse so la reg pa ni ltogs par ston pa'o/ / tri shā 5ni dris bsgo ba'o/ /ku ta ni gnas che ge mo nas 'ongs so zhes bya ba'o / /ki ra na choni me tog go/ /tu mu la ni rgod pa'o/ /tan ta ni char dbab pa bzlog 5pa'o/ /tro lapa ta ni zhu ba'o//sgro 7ca ni shes pa'o/ /dri ha ni sprin no/ /sgro pa ni bdug pa'o/ /sa nu pani ri bo'o/ /sa ri ta ni chu po'o/ /a gu tsholi ni yan lag go/ /ba da na ni gdong ngo / /dzā ti ka ni rtse'o/ /a na ta na ni so'o/ /pakṣi ni rgyal mtshan no/ /tshajo ni phreng ba'o/ /tsa la ni rlung ngo / /pa shu ni ri dgas gso/ /yan ti snyeni dkyil 'khor ro/ /sha na ma ni bzhi mdo'o/ /pha la ku shaṃ cini skye po'og/ /ma hā kṣa ra ba ni phyugs chen po'o/ /ga ni ra skyes so/ /na ni mi'o/ /go ni khyu mchog go/ /ma ni ma lha'o/ /bha lani 0bza' ba'o/ /ha ni rnam grangs so/ /sa ni rgyal po'o/ /kha la reg pa ni zos so zhes pa'o/ /lce la reg pa ni ngoms so zhes pa'o/ /na ste ni snying po'o/ /hri ni ngo tsha'o/ /me /thu na gyis shig pa'o/ /brla la reg pa ni stong pa'o/ /steng du gcig 0go/ /'og tu med pa'o/ /phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan no/ /dpa' bo'i gsung gi gsang ba'i brda'o/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las mkha' 'gro ma'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi 77—915

de nas rnal 'byor rgyud du ni/ /rnyed dka'i dam tshig nga yis bshad/ /skyes pa'am bud med g.yon nas 'gro/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar byed/ /khyim dang zhing du rnam /gnas pa/ /shin tu ring yang shes par 'gyur/ /he ru ka las sbyor gzhan med/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor ma nyid ni/ /rgyud 'di ru ni sgrub pa po / /legs par gyur pa nyid yin te/ /brnyas mi bya zhing spang mi bya//nus pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /pho nya mo cibargyad 'di dag ni/ /mos gedang dad pa 'phel byed pa/ /rtag par dngos grub rnams kyi rgyu/ /dam tshig rnams kyang skyong ba'o/ /lha mo gzhan dag kun sbyor ba'i/ /'dod la rmongs par gyur pa dang —/ /gnyis su med dang thogs med dang / /dam tshig spyad par spyad nopa dang — /bud med dbang phyug shin tu sbyor/ /tshangs pa /spyod pa de bzhin gzhi/ /khro med rgyun gyi kun tu spyod/ /'di brgyad dam tshig kun spyod yin/ /sgrub pa la ni gnas pa yi/ /sgrub pa po yis rtag shes bya/ /rgyud kun gyi ni thun mong ste/ /rgyu med pa ni gzhom mi bya/ /dad pa nyid kyis blang bya yi/ /mig dang lag pas ma yin no/ /gsang ba 'di ni mi bstan cing / /rab tu 'bad te ngasba bar bya / /blo ldan mthe chung bskyod par ni/ /pho nya mo rnams yang dag gnas/ /dag dang ma dag 'dres pa ste/ /sgrub pa po ni gsum du gnas/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi'o/ /yul yul du ni dka' thub can/ /pho nya'i gzugs kyi mtshan ma brtag /pho nya ral gri so 'dra zhing — /dag byed bsod nams 'phel byed yin/ /de bzhin pho nya legs 77—916

'dres pas/ /sgrub pa po yis /dngos grub thob/ /bzlas mchod bsam gtan med par yang / /myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sgrub pa pos/ /mchod pa nyid la rab tu 'jug /'di las gzhan pa'i mchod med de / /de ltar bstan bcos nges pa yin/ /pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang / /sgrub cipa po ni dngos grub brtson/ /rig sngags phyag rgyar yang dag ldan/ /zas la rtag tu spyad par bya/ /sgrub pa po ni legs pa ru / /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rigs rnams ni/ /kun la nye bar spyad bya zhing / /bza' min par ni mi brtag go ) /'di nyid du ni de dbyer med/ /pho nya mo yi sgrub pa nyid / /dngos grub cho ga la spyod tshe/ /pho nya gcig pu kho na yin/ /byang chub phyogs kyi dngos grub ni/ /sgrub pa dag dang nye ba dang / /bla ma brgyud /rim gyis thob pa'i/ /dbang bskur bas ni sngags legs ldan/ /pho nya rnams su yang dag bshad/ /phyag rgya legs sbyor ngang tshul dang / /chags med gtong dang tshul khrims dang / /ye shes rgyu 7skyes yang dag rdzogs/ /sems kyi skyabadag nyid dang par langs/ /lus kyi bya ba kun byas te/ /lus la shin tu mtshon cha ni/ /lus la gnas par kun tu spyad/ /dag byed byas pa'i lus kyis ni/ /rtag 2tu sngags ni brjod par bya/ /rnal 'byor gnas rnams nges bstan cing / /mtshon cha rnams ni 'gom skumi bya/ /dam tshig can la khro mi bya/ /mngon par brtson las 'da' mi bya / /de dang lalhan cig bde bar bya/ /bdag gi don dang gzhan don du/ /dam 5tshig spyod pa nyid du bya/ /'di la lhan cig longs spyod bya/ /mtshan mo tshartag par nam mkha'i gos / /gnag dang dmar bar rtag 'gyur bya/ /srog chags yan lag las byung gyon/ /bde ba 'dod pas bde thob 'gyur/ /mchod 77—917

phyir thogs ni yongs spang /gtsang / /shrī he ru nas byin brlabs pas/ /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /dus kun tu ni yang dag ldan ri/ /rigs dang rigs min ngor mi blta / /spyi gtsug la sogs ( bcing ba spang / /pho nya gtsang sbra dang po yin/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba yin par 'dod/ /zas gcig ritu ni za ba nyid/ /gtsang sbra gsum pa yin par bshad/ /gtsang spra 'di dag rab sbyangs pas/ /gtsang ma'i dag pa'i tshorim thob na/ /dngos grub gang las 7'byung mi 'gyur/ /de nyid bsdus las gang gsungs dang / /de bzhin bde mchog las gang gsungs/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ /de bzhin dpal mchog dang po dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid las gsungs/ /bzlas dang brtul zhugs sogs pa 'grub/ /de 'dir bsam gtan tsam gyis ni/ /sngags pas skad cig gis 'grub 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor lam la dga' bas kyang / /gtsang sbra 'di ni yang dag spyad/ /bsod nams gtsang sbra las byung gang / /sgrub /1pa'i yon tan rgya chen po/ /stong phrag gcig pa'i zhal min par/ /kha gcig gis ni brjod mi nus/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung ye shes che/ /rnam dag mtshan nyid kun sgrub mapa/ /bde ba'i bsod nams chu 'thung ba/ /dag byed sdig pa 'jig rshabyed yin/ /reg pa dang ni smras pas kyang / /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /lus ngag skyon ni med pa yi/ /gang zhig spyod pa byed pa yi/ /mi mchog sdig pa thams cad ni/ /rnam dag bdag nyid bde mgashegs kyi/ /sa rnams kyang ni 'thob papar 'gyur/ /skye zhing skye bar de bzhin gshegs/ /rigs 'gyur chos ldan rgyal por 'gyur/ /de ltar rtag tu mchod byas nas/ /dad pa yis 7ni gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas mchod pa rnam dag pas/ /mya ngan 77—918

'das las byung dpa' bo tsho/ /de bzhin bdag nyid mchod pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun tshogs sras bcas dang / /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma/ /brtan pa dag dang g.yo ba dang / /spun gyi mchod pa'i dus 'dzin pa/ /zla ba'i dus la gnas pa yi/ /spun dang bu dang lhan cig tu/ /bde dang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba/ /sngags dang de bzhin phyag rgya dang / /ye shes der ni bstan mi bya /dag byed zas la spyod pa ni/ /rtag tu dam tshig spyod byas 'gyur/ /gsang sngags su la'ang sbyin mi bya/ /man ngag rnam par nyams mi bya/ /dam tshig gnas la ci rigs par/ /man ringag rnams kyang sbyin par bya/ /pho nya ma gtogs gzhan dag la/ /'dod pa rmongs pas ci'agro mi byed/ /rtag tu pho nya chags bral ba/ /mi 'da' ba yis longs spyod bya/ /skye gnas dman la mi gnas pa/ /bsnyen bkur nyid ni bya ba min/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang / /chung ma pho nya mo nyid gnas/ /'khor lo'am de bzhin grub pa la/ /dka' ba nges par zad par 'gyur/ /mchog dang tha ma lhan cig 'gugs/ /de ltar ngas ni rnam ci 〉nges yin/ /rnal 'byor pa rtag g.yon nas spyod/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du 'dor/ /lag pa g.yon pa yongs su bsgyur/ /g.yon gyi byed ni rab mchod byed/ /lus ni g.yon ni rnam par gnon/ /g.yon pa yis ni tshim dang za /brtul zhugs ci ma nyams brtul zhugs rdzogs/ /sgrub pa po ni dam tshig brtson / /dam tshig rigs la spyod pa dang / /lhan cig zas la spyod par byed/ /rigs lnga la ni kun spyod pa'i/ /rigs ni rnam pa bzhi ru bsgrags / /rigs gcig tshol ni kun spyod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub dzol rab tu mchod/ /ba lang sha dang rta sha dang / /khyi sha dag dang sna tshogs pas/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum 77—919

byas nas :ni/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /de bzhin dpa' bo rnams kyi zas/ /sngags pas phyag rgyar yang dag ldan/ /shrī ri he ru na'i sprul pa yi / /nyer spyod bstan bcos kun la brtag /rtag tu de dag gzung zhing bsrung ci/ /las rnams dag ni thams cad la/ /bgegs med ji bzhin 'grub 'gyur bar/ /'dir ni gzhan dag 'gyur ma yin/ /'di ni pho nya mchog bzang po/ /brtson zhing lhan cig ldan par yin/ /ma chags dga' ba'i longs spyod rdzogs/ /rnal 'byor rdzas kyi rnam dbye nyid/ /bla ma'i man ngag la dga' zhing / /de yi don ni mchog mtshungs pa'o/ /srun dang yang na pha dang ni/ /bdag po nyid du skad cis mthong / /rtse sbom mig ni dmar ser la//rtsub cing spu ni dmar ser yin/ /dngos grub kun gyi thun mong du/ /bzlas dang brtul zhugs la rtag dga'/ /dran pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /pho nya la sogs gnas dang bcas/ /mkha' 'gro ma mchog nyi shu bzhi/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras rab ster/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni rtag tu zlos/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /rnal 'byor 'bras bu rab ster ba/ /gsang sngags 'di las byung ba yin/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya dang bral gsang sngags ni/ /lus can rnams la byin mi rlob / /ji srid 'gro ba'i bya ba dag /shin tu sbyor bas rtogs par bya/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa/ /rnal 'byor pa la gang zhig snang / / khyi yi tshaskye gnas brgyar skye ste/ /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /dper na la la mar 'dod pas/ /'bad pas chu ni bsrubs gyur kyang / /mar sar pa'abyung bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /lus nyon mongs pa kho nar zad/ /'dzin cing mchod par 77—920

byed pa ni/ /'tsho ba'i thabs kyi rgyur gyur pa'i/ /rnal 'byor gzhan /la sten pa ni/ /gzhan du de bzhin don med 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor che mchog dpa' bo ni /yul phyogs gang na gnas gyur pa/ /rigs ngan rim klo yin na yang / /yul de )yongs su brtags pa yin/ /sems can rjes su bzung ba'i rgyur/ /da rung nga ni rtag tu gnas/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las pho nya'i grangs kyi le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po mchog /dpa' bo rnams kyi khyad par ni/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po g.yo byed cing / /rjes su dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /yang dag dngos grub rim gyis ster / /oṃ sarba bu tre ki gli ye badzra waṇḍi gli ye lhu rgyu phaṭa zhwa hā/gsang sngags 'di ni gsang sngags che/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa'i mchog/sngags chen bklags /pas 'grub pa ste/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub 7pa yin / /mkha' 'gro ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dum skyes ma dang lā ma'ang de/ /oṃ gliX ha ha lhu : phaṭa/ gsang sngags 'di ni gsang sngags che/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa'i mchog /'di ni bklags 5pa tsam gyis 'grub/ /gsang sngags kun gyi gsang sngags gtso/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo kun gyi snying po mchog /gsang sngags de dag mchog dam pa/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub —byed yin/ /bla ma las kyang bla ma ste/ /dpa' bo'i sdom pa cimachog yin no/ /'di ni kun gyi lagasang sngags te/ /'di ni sngags su grags pa yin/ /sa 'og dang ni mtho ris dang / /ji ltar mtshams kyang de bzhin te/ /gang yang 77—921

ji bzhin las rnams kyis/ /'jig rten gsum po 'grub 3)pa yin/ /de yis thams cad grub nas ni/ /gsang sngags mchog ni bla med pas/ /'jig rten gsum po 'grub snyepa yin/ /gang gis bla na med pa dag /sgrub pa pos ni thams cad 'grub/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo kun/ /mdor bsdus rgyas par ma yin no/ /ri mo ri mdzes par bris nas ni/ /sna tshogs me tog 'bras bur ldan/ /de yi steng du dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang dum skyes ma/ /dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo nyid/ /ha ha he nye zhes bzhad pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo'i rigs/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /sngar bshad dpa' bo dpa' ba'i mchog /dpa' bo'i mchog ni thams cad nyid/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo rnams/ /de yis ( 〉'gro ba grangs med khyab/ /dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang de bzhin te/ /'khor lo'i gnas su rnam par blta/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub byed cing / /'khor lor bzhugs la rtag tu mchod —/ /legs par mnyam bzhag 'dod pa 'grub/ /sngar bshad cho ga bzhin bzlas shing / /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra tsho ba'i sdom/ /bsams 7pas 'khor lo chen po yi/ /dngos grub kyang ni thams cad 'grub/ /sangs rgyas bye bas gsungs pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni re re la/ /'khor gyi grangs kyang bye ba snyed/ /rnal 'byor ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma ni khyad par du/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa dge/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo'i las kyi rim pa sgrub rtsi pa rnal 'byor ma dang rgyu dpa' bo gnyis su med pa'i snying po'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //77—922

dung chen dag ni kho na las/ /mkhas pas gzugs ni bsgrub bya ste/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /yan lag dang ni nying lag mchog /mos pa'i yid ni sngon 'gro ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pas ni gzung /zhing bsgrub / /dri chen chu dang rakta gyidang / /shu krar ci bcas pas mchod par bya/ /na ra dpal chen bdug spos ni/ /dpa' bo'i las kyi sgrub pa ste/ /bla ma yi ni go 'phang 'grub / /de nas bdag nyid mchod byas te/ /'dod pa thams cad 'thob kyi'agyur zhing / /rgyal po'i bud med rnyed par 'gyur/ /ji lta'i las kyi tsho rjes 'brangs rinas/ /lag pa'i mchod pa rab tu bya/ /pags tshochen ri mo bris nas ni /sgrub pa po yis mnyam bzhag tshan/ /zhag bdun gyis ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /the tshom 7med par rnam par spyod/ /rnal 'byor ma dang bla ma mchod/ /mkha' 'gro'i gnas su de bzhin skye/ /des ni bde ba rnyed nas kyang / /las ni rtag tu byed par 'gyur/ /rtag tu bla ma mchod nas ni/ /de yi dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sgrub 7pa yis/ /glang po'i pags skul sku gzugs bri//rnal 'byor ma yi sgrub cipa yis/ /ba lang pags pal ri mo bri/ /mkha' spyod dag ni sgrub tsos yis / /rta yi pags pal ri mo bri / /sa la spyod pa'i sgrub pa yis/ /ma lha'i pags rtsol ri mo bri / /sa 'og spyod pa'i sgrub pa yis/ /phag gi pags snyel ri mo bri/ /gnod sbyin mo ni sgrub chopa yis/ /shing spang leb la sku gzugs bri/ /lha yi bu mo sgrub sapa yis / /tsam pa'i spang leb sku gzugs bri/ /klu mo sgrub —pa dag gis ni/ /klu shing spang leb ri mo bri/ /mi 77—923

ni bsgrub /par 'dod pa yis/ /dur khrod gos la sku gzugs bri/ /pha rol blta ba'i sgrub pa dag /bong bu'i pags ril sku gzugs bri/ /nor rnams bsgrub cipar 'dod pa yis/ /byi ba'i pags la sku gzugs bri/ /chang ni 'gugs par 'dod pa yis/ /spre'u'i pags la sku gzugs bri/ /khrag ni 'gugs par 'dod pa yis/ /thod pa la ni sku gzugs bri/ /sa bon 'gugs par 'dod pa yis/ /phug ron pags la sku gzugs bri/ /lha ni 'gugs par 'dod pa yis/ /thang shing spang leb sku gzugs bri/ /grong khyer 'gugs par 'dod pa yis/ /ce /spyang pags —la sku gzugs bri/ /zhi ba'i las la bram ze mo /zla mtshan byung dus gos la bri/ /des na zhi bar gyur pa yin/ /rgyas pa rgyal rigs mo yi ni/ /zla mtshan byung dus gos la bri/ /dbang la rje'u rigs mo yi ni/ /zla mtshan byung dus gos la bri/ /mngon spyod la ni dmangs rigs kyi/ /zla mtshan byung dus 7gos la bri/ /brgyal bar bya ba dag la ni/ /rgyal mtshan gos la ri mo bri/ /rengs par bya ba rdo leb ste/ /dgar ba la ni rnga mo'i pags//dgug 5pa la ni seng ge'i'o / /las kun la ni bya yi pags / /yang na lcags ni kho na'o/ /gzhan du sna tshogs las rnams ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis nges par 'grub /bgegs rnams med par bya ba'i phyir/ /ri bong pags mepa dag la bri / /bgegs ni ldang bar byed pa la/ /shi ba'i pags papa rnams la bri/ /gser dang dngul la sogs —pa la/ /zangs dang shel dang thang shing dang / /rdo rje las ni bya ba ste/ /dngos grub mchog ni khyad par yin/ /tsandan dang ni thang shing dang / /tsandan dmar po tsam pa ka /a sho ka ni grub pa'o/ / shrī bṛ 7kṣa ni sngonor sbyin 'gyur/ / a ga ru 5 dang sta rga 5shing / /'o ma shing gi bye brag 77—924
