dang / /stag 3pa'i shing la sogs ripa rnams/ /grub pa yi ni dngos grub 'gyur / /sbal pa'i rus pa las byas dang / /klu shing dag gi cabye brag dang / /ru rusbal rus pa glang po'i so/ /khyad par du ni char yang 'bebs/ /bram ze'i rus pa zhi ba ste/ /glang po'i rus pa rgyas pa yin/ /dbang la rta yi rus pa ste//gsad pa la 9 ni ma he'i rus/ /dgar ba la ni rnga mo'i rus/ /snang la rta dang ma nye'o / /rengs par bya la khyi yi rus/ /dgug pa la ni seng ge'i rus/ /sa yi 'og tu 'gro ba la/ /phag gi rus pa dag la bya/ /sa dkar ngadag las byas pa ni/ /rtag tu zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyas pa la ni ser ba'i sa / /dbang la dmar po'i sa yin rtel/ /gsod pa la ni sa nag ste/ /'di ni mdor bsdus cho ga'o/ /dri chen chu dang zhag dang khrag /mig sman chen po de bzhin te//mi yi —rus pa brdar ba yis / /mdog tu palhan cig sbyar nas kyang / /rang byung me tog sa bon dang / /rigs ngan dang ni bram ze dang / /gdol pa mo 7dang g.yung mo dang / /khrus mkhan ma dang gar mkhan ma/ /ma'am yang na sring mo 'am/ /bu mo yi ni gye brag gi/ /'di dag drung du blangs nas su/ /skoshu kra rakta'i 7khyad par dag /sna tshogs 'di dag bsres nas kyang / /cho ga bzhin du sku gzugs 'dri / /grog mkhar 5gyi ni sa dag la/ /shi ba'i skra dang rus pa yis / /pir gyis snyedam pa bri bar bya/ /thig skud shi ba'i skud pa yis/ /sku gzugs thig skud mchog yin no/ / yi dgas saphreng sogs bsnyen sanas ni/ / ba sas —kyang ni mar me bya/ /dpa' bo chen po'i bdug spos dang / /rkang gis lha bshos bya ba ste/ /dri chen rdo rje chu yi dri/ /thod pa dag gi bum pa ste/ / asgo'i snod 0ni thod pa'o/ /argha rinas pa'i tsā stoste/ /'bad pas skyes bu 77—925

dbul /'byin no/ /ji ltar nus pa dag tu spyad/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis /thabs dang shes rab ldan par ni/ /sku gzugs yang ni ri mo 'am/ /gzhan yang mkhas pas cho ga bya/ /ji lta'i las kyi rjes mthun shupar/ /de lta'i (rigos kyi rjes 'chang zhing / /gcer bu spa ni grol ba dang / /gzugs mdog dag ni bsgyur nas kyang / /gtso bo dang ni rnal 'byor pa/ /slob dpon yang ni de bzhin te/ /phyag rgya'i rigs par gnas nas su/ /dri chen chu dang dpa' bo bzang byu/ /mnyam par bzhag nas bzlas pa bya/ /rnam pa du ma bye brag gi/ /glu dang gar ni rnam pa dang / /bza' btung mchog ni spyad par bya/ /de dag rdzogs kyi bar bya ste/ /de 'di cho ga'i rim pa'o/ /rab tu gnas pa'i dus dag tu /nyis 'gyur tshogs kyis spel ba ste/ /gdu bu dang ni rkang ka dang / /dpung rgyan gos kyi bye brag dang / /sor gdub dang ni mchod phyir thogs/ /rkang rgyan dang ni thod pa dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab de bzhin te/ /sna tshogs skyes bu sbyin zhing dbul/ /sna tshogs dpa' bo mchog dam pa/ /myos byed btung ba'i bye brag rnams/ /dam tshig cho ga'i mchog rnams dang / /sna tshogs ro dang bcud rnams dang / /sna tshogs me tog mchog rnams dang / /lha mo mchog gi lus /rnams dang / /rol mo sna tshogs sgra rnams dang / /slob dpon phyag rgyar sbyor ba dang / /slob ma'i tshogs kyi khyad par rnams/ /bza' ba'i mchod pa dag gis mchod/ /bdug pa'i dri mchog rnams dang ni/ /sna tshogs rgyal ba'i bdug pa dang / /khyad par du ni mar me'i phreng / /gdugs dang bla re de bzhin te/ /me long dang ni rnga yab dang / /dra ba dang ni dra gyed dang —/ /chun po dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /bum pa ras dang ldan pa dag /77—926

ye shes bdud rtsis yongs gang ba/ /rin chen lnga dang sman dang ni/ /dri yi bye brag dag gis ni/ /argha'i /snod ni khyad par du/ /tsu ta pa la ba lnga dang / /me bu rdza bu ka da / /thal ba gri dza pu ras dgang / /ba la mo ta kri ta rtsa /ke ri )dri ka ri kur ldan pa/ /e ka bī ra sa ha de/ /sman rnams kun shes bya ba la/ /lnga po de dag shes bya ste/ /mkhas pas bum par gzhug par bya/ /gser dang dzā ti ri tshopha la dang / /gla gor zho sha de bzhin no/ /gser gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ni/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /sgrub pa po kun gcer bu yis/ /bkra shis glu yis glu len zhing 7/ /rnam par dag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dad pa'i blo ni sngon 'gro bas/ /dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /sna tshogs rgya che'i mchod par bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i /sdo / /byi / sdu/ dīkā ras ris la sogs 5pa rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /mngon mtho he ru ka zhes bya/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa yin/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag masgrub pa pos/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur dngos grub 'thob mi 'gyur/ /sbrang rtsi mtshal dang ga pur bcas/ /dmar bdang tsandan sbyar ba ni/ /tshogs kyi nang du zhugs pa ni/ /thams cad bcud kyis len 5du gnas/ /thams cad rdo rje'i mtshan ma 'dzin/ /sbom po mtha' ltag rtse sbyar bas/ /rnal 'byor rim pas rtag tu spyad/ /zhi ba'i btung ba —bzhin myangs na / /dngos grub rtag 77—927

tu 'thob 0par 'gyur/ /'di ni mi 'chi bcu byed 'gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad 'jug pa yin/ /mchod bzhi de bzhin dpa' bo ni/ /dbang gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa yi / /snyoms par 'jug pa'i de nyid 'dzin/ /sngon ridu bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ /cho ga bzhin du 'bum du bzla/ /'khor lo'i gsang sngags 'bum bzlas shing / /rang gi lha'i yang 'bum du bzla/ /gzhan ni khri ru bzla bar cibya /bka' bzhin 'khor lo bri bya zhing / /mdangs ldan mi mchog dag gis ni /dkyil 'khor bri zhing dgod par bya/ /sngar bshad gnas ni gang yin pa /der ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /sa ni yongs su sbyar bar bya/ /brdung zhing legs par brdungs rinas su/ /mnyam zhing zug rngu /rnam par spang / /sa la ma lhung lci ba yis / /dkyil 'khor sa ni nye bar byug /dur khrod thal bar ldan pa dang / /mi 'chi bcu phyed bcas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni nyer byugs te/ /der ni dkyil 'khor yang dag brtsam / /dur khrod du ni kun spyod cing / /ro bsregs sol ba'i phye ma dang / /dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa yis/ /slob dpon legs par mnyam bzhag ste/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bri bar bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /mtshan ma ngan pa kun spangs shing / /yang dag shes shing rgyud shes pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes/ /khro med gtsang zhing mkhas pa dang / /sbyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro/ /thod pas spyi bor chobargyan byas shing / /yan lag thal bas byugs pa dang / /gug skyed dag gis lus brgyan cing / /rus phreng rus par yang dag gnas/ /dum gcig —spyi por brgyan pa dang / /rus pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga ni lag na gnas/ /bdag nyid shrī he ru kur ni/ /77—928

byas nas de yi 'og tu ni/ /dpal ldan nye ru ka dran bya/ /'khor lo 'di yi snying gar /dgod/ /de ltar bdag nyid go bgos nas/ /ra ba rnams ni phyogs su dgod/ /'og tu'ang mtshon cha dgod par bya/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid bkod nas ni/ /steng du mda' yi dra ba dang / /bdag nyid mtshon cha'i dra ba bya / /de ltar go bgos sum cu ni/ /rtsa gsum pas kyang gzhig mi nus/ /de ltar bdag nyid rab bsrungs shing / /sngags dang phyag rgyas rnam brgyan nas/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya/ /de nas sems med srad bu la/ /ru dhi ra ni chen pos brlan/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung grong mchog gi/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa thig gdab bya/ /gru bzhi pa la khru brgyad pa/ /sgo bzhi kun nas zur bzhi pa/ /sngags pas nyis 'gyur tshornam spyod cing / /mkha' 'gro dra ba bde lamachog bzlas/ /de yi dbus su bzhag 7pa ni/ /'dab chags lte ba 'bar dang bcas/ /ge sar yang dag ldan pa yi/ /sna tshogs padma 'dab 5brgyad pa/ /lte bar dgod mabya dpa' bo ni /'jigs byed chen po'i gzugs can la/ /mdangs dang ldan zhing rab tu 'bar / /ha ha zhes byar sgra cher bzhad/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan/ /bzang po spyan gsum zhal bzhi mnga'/ /glang po'i pags pa rnam par bgos/ /smin ma bzang po rdo rje 'byes/ /phyag na kha ṭwāṃ rig bsnams shing / /brgya phyed phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /de mdun gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /rdo je phag mo zhes bya ba/ /rab 'jigs 'jigs byed che la phyogs/ /spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can bya/ /ka pā la 7ni ant+ras —bkang / /kha nas ru rnyi ra 'dzag cing //lha dang lha min mir bcas dang / /phyogs kun tu ni sdigs mdzub byed ci/ /77—929

mkha' 'gro ma ni nyi shu bzhi/ /phag mo yi ni rigs las byung / /phyogs dang phyogs kyi mtshams rnams ni/ /'khor lo'i lte bar mchod par bya/ /de bzhin 'dir ni dpa' bo yang / /'khor lor /yang dag gnas pa mchod/ /sgrub po gal te dngos grub 'dod/ /gnyis med dpa' bo mchod par bya/ /de nas bum pa bya ba ni/ /rtsa ba dag po la sogs med/ /mu tig gser dang rin chen dang — /byi ru dngul dang zangs ma ste/ /bza' ba kun gyis legs bkang ba'i//snod ni steng du gzhag ripar bya/ /mgrin pa srad bus dkri ba cadang / /kha ni 'dab mas brgyan par bya/ /gos zung gis ni legs dkris pa/ /brgyad ni sgo ru rnam par dgod/ /gos zung gis ni dkris pa yi/ /bum pa dgu pa dbus su gzhag /gser ram dngul lam rin chen nam/ /mu tig rnams ni mdzes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu rin chen dang / /gser rnams kyis ni mdzes par spyad/ /grong mchog yid 'ong mchod nas ni/ /grub pa nyid du the tshom /med/ /bdag nyid kyi ni gdong lus kun/ /dri yi chu yis legs par (bsang —/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /mar me brgya ni dbul bar bya//nam mkha'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ /yid kyis thams cad steng du dgod/ /sa stengs mkha' 'gro ma gang yin/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu dgod par bya/ /gang yang sa 'og rnams su dgon/ /ma mo thams cad phyogs dang ni/ /phyogs mtshams rnams su dgod par bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /dri dang me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me brgya yang dbul bya zhing / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor gnas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mchod bya/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang gnag tshadang ser skya dang / /de 77—930

bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang / /me tog phreng ba du ma dang / /bla re dag dang dar 39bcas pa'i/ /mda' ni shin tu mdzes pa dang / /de bzhin bza' bca' btung 7ba yis/ /rab mnyam bzhag riste mchod par bya/ /de nas sgrub pos dngos grub kyi / /dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /grub 'dod shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /ci nus par ni bla ma mchod/ /dril dbyangs me tog spos kyis brgyan/ /shin tu sgra snyan dril bu gyidakrol/ /sgrub pa po yis rnga brdung zhing mi/ /ha ha zhes ni brjod par tshobya/ /de ltar cho ga bzhin dkyil 'khor / /'dod pa kun ldan mchod nas ni/ /de yi bu sdug gdong la ni/ /dar gyis tshalegs par bkab nas su/ /me rtog gis bkang thal mo dag /padmas 7gtor nas bskor ba ni/ /g.yon phyogs bskor nas phyag byas te/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra yang brjod/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pa yis/ /dngos grub sras po gzhag mapar bya/ /thal mo me tog gtor nas ni/ /gang du 'babs glupa'i bsam pa ni/ /skor ba dag kyang byas nas su/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa yis/ /sgrub pa po yis byas nas gzhug /de nas yon 7thogs grong khyer du/ /g.yas pa'i phyogs su brten nas ni/ /snyim pa'i me tog dkyil 'khor dor/ /dkyil 'khor gang du me tog babs/ /de yi rigs ni bstan par bya/ /de nas slob dpon legs par ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag skuste phyag rgya mchod / /de nas slob ma gnyis pa la/ /mtshal chen lan gsum bzlas pa yis/ /de la thig le bya ba 7yin/ /de nas slob ma'i gdong phye la/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bstan par bya/ /gang gi lha yi gnas gang yin/ /der de yang dag bstan par —bya/ /slob dpon dang ni lhan cig tu/ /rab tu btud pa byas 77—931

nas ni/ /g.yon nas brtsams pa'i rim pa yis/ /de nas bskor sna ba rab tu bya /dkyil 'khor dang ni bla ma la/ /ji bzhin cho gas phyag bya'o / /de nas bla ma dag la yon / /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ridabul/ /gser ni brgya stong dbul ba dang / /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang / /glang po rta 'am yul 'khor ram/ /rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu dang / /mgul gdub sor gdub dam pa dang / /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo rnams/ /phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya/ /deng nas brtsams te bran du ni /khyed la bdag ni 'bul rilags zhes / /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bya/ /de ltar nges par bya ba ni/ /sgrub pa po yis —rab nges byas/ /de nas de la mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes par 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /sgrub po skemakha' 'gro ma lhan cig /de dang rnam spyod 'gro ba kun / /sgrub pa po ni de dag gi/ /ci ngabagyi byed par the tshom 5med/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni 'grub 'gyur sked/ /'jig rten gsum du mi zlogs shing —/ /mi snang phug chodang gnas mkha' rgyu/ /rkang mgyogs de bzhin bcud kyis len/ /sgrub pa po ni 'dod tsam gyis/ /rtag par rgyun tshodu bskyed par 'gyur/ /gzugs ni du ma byed pa dang / /nam mkha' la ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ / mkha' 'gro rnams kyi khyad par du/ /des gnon 'gro ba thams cad kyang / /lan cig 5bltas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /skad cig gis ni sbyor nyid skyed/ /sngags pas snyedakyil 'khor ma mthong bar/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod/ /mkha' la 77—932

khu tshur gyis deg dang / /smig rgyu'i chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni mchog rab dang / /sbyor ba kun gyi dam pa /yin/ /gang zhig rtag tu 'dod gyur pa/ /de ni lha mi zil gnon 'gro/ /de nyid bsdus par gyur pa'am//gsang ba'am rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rgyal ripo 'di/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bshad dang ma bshad gang ci'ang rurung / /de kun dpal ldan khrag 'thung gnas/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sbyor ba'i mtshams dang yang dag ldan/ /chu med pa ni mtshams yin te/ /gos pa med cing chags spangs pa/ /mtshams ni 'byung po thams cad pa / /de ni sems can thams cad de/ /mtshams ni srid pa dag pa ste/ / dbyangs skyong he ru ka nyid yin/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom zhing bzla/ /cig car 'byung bar snang ba ste/ /dung dang kun da'i mdog kyang 'dzin/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis mtshan pa ste/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /spyan tshogasum pa la thugs rje'i nyams/ /skra grol dpral bar thod pa ste/ /spyi gtsug tu ni zla ba'o/ /he ru ka dpal yang dag ldan/ /mtshams rnams grub pa'i mchog dam pa/ /thun bzhi ru ni bya ba'o/ /dga' ba bzhi ngo dga' ba dang / /lte ba'i snying pad nu ma'i dbus/ /rtse yi rtsa dang mgo steng du/ /dga' ba dang ni mchog dga' nyid /dam par dga' dang lhan cig skyes/ /dang po 'dab 5ma drug cu bzhi/ /gnyis pa brgyad pa skemachog yin te/ /gsum pa 'dab ngam bcu drug pa/ /bzhi 77—93 3

pa sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dab / /phag mo'i lte ba'i rtsar ri gnas pa/ /lhan cig skyes dga' khrag 'thung mchog /sbyor ba'i dus kyi mtshams su ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bsgom sabya/ /sdug bsngal sprul pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /kun 'byung chos kyi 'khor lo yin/ /'gog pa longs spyod 'khor lo ste/ /lam ni bde ba chen po yin/ /de ltar mtshams su byin brlabs nas/ /rnal 'byor nges pa byas pa ste/ /dkar dang sngo dang ljang ba dang / /spyan gsum thugs rje stong pa'i nyams/ /rnam thar gsum dang sku gsum gyis/ /yongs su dag par rim par sbyor/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /mgo bo gri gug phyag na bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs/ /zla ba yi dgas pad dbus su/ /skra grol phyogs kyi gos can yin/ /dgyes pa'i nyams kyis myos pa ste/ /dus rtag tu ni mtshams bsgoms na/ /sdom pa mchog ni grub pa yin/ /dri chen rdo rje chu dang ni/ /rin chen snang ba mtha' yas dang / /don yod grub pa'ang de bzhin te/ /de dag rtag tu bsres nas su / /rnal 'byor rtag tu mtshams la 'dud/ /gsang sngags 'di dag rtag tu yang — /nye ru ka ni dbyangs skyong mchog /oṃ shrī he ru tā /ya bad ma ho 7thab rā dza ya thad skom nye ta bī rā pra dzo da ya aḥ'i / rtag tu mtshams ni rnam 7bsgoms na/ /dbyangs skyong mchog gi bzlas pa bya/ /dbyangs skyong ming ni rig byed de / /las rnams thams cad byed pa dge/ /dus min 'chi bar mi rtso'agyur zhing / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang yang 'grubasku/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /don ni sngags pas 0rtag tu smra/ /dngos grub 'di ni rab tu 'grub//de ma thag tu grub chen bcas/ /'jig rten gsum po 'grub 0pa yin/ /sgrub 77—934

po'i dbang pos rnam bsgoms te/ /khrag 'thung cho ga bzhin shes nas/ /zhag gsum brtul zhugs la gnas na/ /lha yi gnas su 'gro ba yin/ /lha yi ye shes thob nas ni/ /lha yi lus kyi mchog kyang 'dzin/ /ngag rnams kun la dbang thob cing / /thams cad mkhyen par gyur nas su/ /rga dang 'ji ba rnam par spangs / /sangs rgyas lha yis bsten pa ste/ /srid par sangs rgyas rol par mdzad/ /nyin zhag gsum gyi bar du yang / /phyag rgya lhan cig 'byung ba 3spyad/ /mthong nas sring mo yang dag bsgrub / /zhag gsum bar du mchod byas nas/ /rdo rje he ru ka dpal lha/ /thams cad kyang ni 'byon ripar 'gyur / /pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /de yis phyag ni byas nas kyang / /sgrub ri pos rtag tu mchod par ri bya/ /sgrub po 'dod la dga' bas ni/ /mod la dpa' bos thams cad mkhyen/ /gtso bo thams cad 'dzin pa ste/ /khams gsum kun tu rnam spyod cing / /sgrub pa po ni mchog tu 'gyur / /'di ni dpal 9chen dpa' bo ste/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /de ni rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sa gzhi ska —rags kyis bskor ba/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams kyang / /sgrub 7pa po ni de nyid kyi/ /mod la dbang du gyur pa yin/ //sditā dīkā brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dbyangs skyong gi mtshams kyi le'u ste de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /yi ge bdun pa sgom pa ste/ /yi ge snye las yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba che/ /phyag drug zhal gsum spyan gsum pa/ /mtshan rnams thams cad kyis mtshan cing / /dpe byad bzang 77—935

po brgyad cur ldan/ / ā li tā li /las byung gtso/ /phag mo dang ni mnyam par ldan/ /stong zhing thugs rjes khyab pa ste/ /rdo rje dril bus mnyam par ldan//na rira'i pags pa gos su mdabs / /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /g.yas pa'i phyag na mdung rtse gsum/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad stsol/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ral pa 'chang / /zla ba gyed pa'i spyi gtsug 'chang / /phyag rgya drug gis sku lus brgyan/ /'jigs byed chung mar bcas pa dag /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis mnan/ /sna tshogs padma nyi steng bzhugs/ /'khor lo drug gi dbus su bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor ma drug mnyam par sbyar/ /myur du dngos grub stsol ba yin/ /dang po khrag 'thung lha mo ste/ /gnyis pa rdo rje 'jigs byed ma/ /gsum pa drag gtum ma yin te/ /bzhi pa rdo rje nyi ma mo/ /lnga pa rdo rje drag mo ste/ /drug pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /g.yon gyi phyogs nas dgod par bya/ /lha mo de dag cher gtum zhing / /spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba ste/ /phyogs kyi gos mchog 'dzin pa yin /thams cad yi dgas nyi stengs bzhugs/ /sngo zhing ser la ljang ba dang —/ /dmar dang dud kha /de bzhin dkar/ /cang te'u dang ni dril bu 'dzin / /thams cad na ra'i pags —pa 'dzin/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul gyis bzhugs/ /yi mgo drug las yang dag byung / /lha mo gzigs pa mtshan ma yin/ /ji ltar mgon po'i lamadog bzhin du/ /phag mo yang ni de bzhin te/ /phyag rgya phyag mtshan de bzhin no/ /sngo dang ser dang ljang ba dang / /stag gi pags skupa gos su mnabs / /lha mo'i byin par mnyam par 'khril/ /mchog tu dga' bar rnam par mos tshe 77—936

gliX ha ha lhu snye phaṭa/ yi ge de las mkha' 'gro ma/ /yan lag drug pa rnam par bsgom/ /bdun pa dbus su dgod pa ni/ /yi ge hūṃ las he ru ka /dbus su dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste bcom ldan 'das dpal nye ru na'o /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje he ru ka ma'o / /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje 'jigs byed ma'o//dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni drag gtum ma'o / /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje nyi ma ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje drag mo'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ste/ byang chub yan lag 'di bdun bsgom/ /ji lta'i rim pas sbyor zhing bsgom/ /gsang sngags gzhal med pa bzlas shing / /khro bo kun gyi gnas mchog ste/ /bsod nams chung ba'i sgrub pos kyang / /zla phyed dang du dngos grub ste/ /rtag tu zhag re bsgoms pa ni/ /zhag bdun gyis ni the tshom med/ /dpyid zla tha chungs nya la ni/ /ma sring bu mo tsha mo dang / /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ /nyin mtshan bzlas shing bsgoms byas pas/ /tho rangs dpal khrag 'byung mnyam 'gyur/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud shā /byi panā ma las nye ba'i snying po bsgoms pas skyed pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa gzhan yang snying po bshad bya ba/ /sems can kun la phan 'dogs pa/ /rgyu gi ye shes las byung ba/ /bde ba chen po bde las byung / /sngo zhing dkar la drag po ste/ /zhal brgyad pa la shin tu 'jigs/ /spyan gsum pa 7༷ rjo/ 3/cu

drug /mgo yi phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /zla ba phyed pa'i ral pa 'chang / /sna tshogs rdo rjes /dbu la mnan/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku la brgyan/ /'jigs 5byed chen po 'jigs pa ni/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnon/ /dus mtshan shin tu 'jigs pa yang / /g.yon brkyang ba riyi zhabs kyis gnon/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas/ /phag mo yi ni ku tsa 'tshir/ /tshangs lpags bshus nas rgyan du 'dzin/ /mdung rtse gsum dang dgra sta dang / /kha ṭwāṃ cang te'u gri gug mchog /brgyad pa la ni lcags kyu thogs/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams de bzhin no/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /mgo bo zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchog /tho ba sdigs mdzub ( dam pa ste/ /shrī yi ye shes yang dag rdzogs/ /pang tshodu phag mo'i gzugs yin te /drag cing dmar la dkar ba yin/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril /spa grol ba la spyan gsum pa/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /de yi zhal dang phyag tu gnas/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyi ska marags can/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /phyogs kyi gos can chags pas gzigs/ /skad pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya yang che/ /sngo zhing dkar la de bzhin dmar/ /ser zhing ljang la dud ka / ste/ /du ba thal ba sprin gyi mdog /'di 'dra'i zhal dang gzugs su gnas/ /lha mo mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing / /tshangs pa'i pags rmupa rnam par spangs/ /sna tshogs padma'i steng du ni/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus su bzhugs /'khor lo brgyad pa'i dbus bzhugs par/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgom/ /padma'i lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /bcom ldan 'das ni nges par dgod/ /oṃ ni shar gyi 'dab tsham la/ /gsal byed mkha' 'gro ma yang 77—938

dgod / /ba ni byang gi 'dab /la ste/ /rta gdong mkha' 'gro ma yang dgod/ /dzra ni rdo rje drag mo ste/ /mkha' 'gro nub tu dgod par bya/ /nye ru lho phyogs 'dab ( skal dgod/ /gser gyi mdog can mkha' 'gro ma/ /ser dang sngo bsangs dkar dang dmar/ /zhal gsum rnam sgyur ridrag po ste/ /phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba/ /ro yi steng du bzhugs pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang ba yis bdud bzhi 'joms/ /thod pa'i phreng ba drag po ste/ /padma sbom po'i 'dab ma la/ /chags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs shing bzhed / /thugs rje'i nyams kyis bde ba yin/ /mda' dang gzhu yang 'chang ba ste/ /zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i mchog /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ bsnams/ /cang te'u ni sgra yang sgrogs(gyi /ser dang ljang gu /sngo ba dang / /sngo bsangs tshadamar dang dkar ba dang —/ /dkar dang ljang gu 7sngo ba dang / /dmar dang sngo dang ljang ba ste/ /'di ltar mdog ni khyad par gyis/ /dam tshig mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /mtshams bzhi ru ni bum pa dag /byang chub sems kyis gang bar bzhag /shar gyi phyogs su he yin te/ /ming ni he li ka zhes bya/ /byang gi phyogs su ru yin te/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ru tsa tī / /nub kyi phyogs su ru yin te/ /ru tsa ka ma lī 'ozhes bya/ /lho yi phyogs su ka 7yin te/ /keng rus ma zhes grags pa yin /me yi phyogs su hūṃ mdzad ma/ /bden bral phyogs su phaṭa mdzad ma/ /rlung gi phyogs su ḍa ma ri/ /dbang ldan ki li ki la ste / /de brgyad lha mo chen mo ste/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /ji ltar zhal dang gzugs bzhin du/ /de bzhin 'dir yang 'gyur 5ba yin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 7'dzin / /dril bu cang te'u gri gug dang / /spyan gsum pa la skra grol ba/ /77—939

phyogs kyi gos can g.yas brkyang bzhugs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan can te/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag ldan/ /drag cing gtum la rab 'jigs par / /thams cad ro yi steng bzhugs bsgom /spyan gsum pa la chags par 5myos/ /dbang ldan zur la utpal sngon po zhes bya ba/ /rlung gi phyogs la dra ba'i mchog ces bya ba ste/ /bden bral phyogs la gsus pa 'phyang ma zhes bya ba/ /me yi phyogs la sha ba ri zhes bya ba ste/ /ser dang sngo bsangs sngo ba dang / /dmar ser dang ni bzhi pa ste/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /gri gug cang te'u mchog yin te/ /bzhi pa rdo rje mdung yin no/ /phyogs kyi gos can chags pas rol/ /bzang mo lto ba 'phyang ma ste/ /skye gnas ring la rgya yang che/ /spyan gsum rnam par 'gyur zhing drag /spa grol ba la rab tu 'jigs/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis ruspud pa'o/ /shar sgor bai las gtum ma zhes bya ba'i —mkha' 'gro ma dang / lho'i sgor ro las rol gtum mo zhes bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / nub kyi sgor sa las 'bar ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dgod do/ /byang gi sgor ha las phreng ba rnam par rgyal ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i mkha' 'gro ma ste/ sngo dang dkar ser tshonyid yin te / /lcags kyu dang ni cang te'u 'dzin/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams te/ /gri gug mgo bo sdigs mdzub —dang —/ /dkar dang sngo dang ljang ba dang / /zhags pa dang ni cang te'u 'dzin/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / / sdigs mdzub 5gri gug mgo bo 'dzin/ /dmar dang sngo dang ljang gu —ste/ /lcags sgrog 7cang te'u gri gug dang / /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /mgo bo dang ni sdigs mdzub mchog /ljang dang dkar po 77—940

'dres pa dang / /ser dang dmar ba'i zhal mchog yin/ /dril bu cang te'u gri gug dang / /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa dang / /mgo bo dang ni sdigs mdzub :phyag /skra grol ba la gdug pa che/ /spyan gsum rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ /zhal gdangs ljags ni bskyod pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang tshul gyis bzhugs / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyogs kyi gos mchog 'dzin pa ste /ro dang padma'i nyi dbus bzhugs/ /mgo po'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thams cad phyag rgya lnga 'chang zhing / /mgo po'i cido shal rnams kyis brgyan/ /mi bskyod pa yi cod pan 'chang pi/ /rnam sgyur spyan ni g.yo ba ste/ /yi ge nyi shu gnyis las byung / /snying gar mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /'di ni gsang sngags thams cad kyi/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis mchog /oṃ shrī badzra he nye ru ru kai rgyu 7 ki rī dzā la sa ba ra tsho 'phaṭa zhwa hā/ yi ge re re dgod pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying de bzhin/ /hūṃ shrī lha dang lha mo ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba'o / /dbus su rnam dag bcom ldan 'das/ /sgom zhing rnam par bsgom par bya /rnam par thar brgyad sgo sna tshogs/ /gzugs su lta ba stong pa ste/ /nang gzugs med par phyi rol gzugs su blta rteba'ang stong pa yin/ /sdug dang mi sdug mthong bar byed pa blta 5ba'ang stong pa yin/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dag tu blta —ba'ang stong pa ste/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dag tu blta skuba'ang stong pa yin/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched dag tu blta stoba'ang stong pa yin/ /'du shes med cing 'du shes med min skye mched rnams kyang stong pa'o/ /'du shes dang ni tshor ba'ang 'gog par lta ba stong pa yin/ /phyag bcu drug pa'ang stong pa ste/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang 77—941

stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus /tshobyas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de/ ci ltar bcom ldan 'das bzhin du/ /phag mo yang ni de bzhin te/ /gnyis med gzugs can bcom ldan 'das/ /he ru ka dpal rnam par shes/ /pas mo nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /lha mo bzhi yi rnam dag pa/ /gsal byed mkha' 'gro ma nyid ni ri/ /don rnams so so yang dag rig /rta gdong ma gang yin pa'o / /chos rnams so so yang dag rig /rdo rje drag mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /nges tshig so so yang dag rig /gser mdog can gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /spobs pa so so /yang dag rig /lha mo de dag 'dab ma'i dbus/ /rton pa rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /he li 7ka ni don la rton pa ste/ /ru tsa ki ni tshig 'bru ston 7pa yin/ /ru tsa ka mi le 7ni ye shes ston —/ /keng rus ma ni rnam shes rton pa yin/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang ni /lho phyogs kyi ni 'khor lo la/ /chos kyi mdo ni bzhi po dgod/ /hūṃ ni 'du byed thams cad mi rtag pa'o/ /phaṭa ni 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal ba'o / /ḍa ma ri ni chos thams cad bdag med pa'o/ / ki li tī skul ni chos thams cad zhi ba'o/ /me cidang bden bral rlung dang ni/ /dbang ldan 'khor lo de dag kun/ /lha mo yis ni rnam par dag /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dngos po'i 77—942

chos thams cad rtogs pa la 'jigs pa med pa ni utpa la sngon po ma'o/ /chos thams cad ston pa la 'jigs pa med pa ni dran pa'i mchog go/ /nges par 'byung ba'i lam la 'jug pa la 'jigs pa med pa ni gsus pa :'phyang ma'o/ /zag pa zad pa shes pa la 'jigs pa med pa ni sa ba ri ma'o/ /mtshams su dkyil 'khor lha mo ni/ /'di yis zur bzhi rnam par dag /sgo bzhi dag tu lha mo ni/ /gtum byed ma ste dad pa'i dbang po'o/ /rol gtum ma ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'o/ /'bar mchog ma ni dran pa'i dbang po'o/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i mchog ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ni/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung rdo rje'o/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan rnams ni/ /'phags pa shes rab bcom ldan ma / /rdo rje phag mo nyid yin no/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi snying po bsgoms pas skyed ripa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa ciganyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni rnam dag pa / /'byung ba kun gyi spyan yin te/ /rnam par snang mdzad thig tu grags/ /bha gas khyab pa'i rim pa ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig tu shes/ /dus ni sna tshogs rigs su shes/ /mchod pa sna tshogs cho ga bzhin/ / pullī ra ma 0padma ma'o/ /dzā lan dha ra thugs 'khor lo/ /sku can gsung gi 'khor lo ste/ /mthu da tsho)ni sku'i 'khor lo/ /go dā —ba ri tshazur bzhi po/ / ra me shwa rā 5me phyogs so/ /de gli ko ṭi skabaden bral yin/ / mā la ba ngani rlung gi zur/ /dbang ldan tā ma rū pa ste/ /grwa tshabazhi rnam par dag pa ni/ /'di la the tshom tsha77—943

med pa yin/ /o tre /dag ni shar gyi sgo'o/ /tri ri ku ni ri phyogs sgo/ /ko sa la ni nub kyi sgo'o/ /ka liṅga ni byang sgo ste/ /shar gyi rta babs la ka /ṭwāṃ tsi lho yi rta babs yin/ /nyi dzom la ya nub phyogs so/ /pre ta bu ri byang yin te/ /gri 4ha de ba 7lha snam bu/ / sau rāṣṭa tshoni rin chen sa/ /su bar dī skopa —dra ba pagyed/ / nā ga ra lani rnga yab dang / /dril bu rgyal mtshan ba dan no//si 7rdo rje thig skum po/ /ma ru ti ni gyisgo khyud do/ /ku lu tā ni rdo rje dang — /rin po che dang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /thig ni bla na med pa yin/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra byed kyis brgyan zhing sa/ /dar dang phreng stobs rnam par brgyan/ /zur gyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis brgyan zhing —/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i sku nyid ni/ /don yod grub pa rnam par spyod /gsung sagi 'khor lo 'od dpag med/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mi bskyod pa /padma'i dbus ni rin chen 'dzin/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor tshul can ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnam par bsgom/ /tshor ba sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /'du shes gsung gi 'khor lo 0yin/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo 'du byed de/ /rnam shes padma gdon mi za/ /ri mo lnga pa mchog gyur pa/ /de yis rnam dag rang bzhin can/ /sa dang ri mo thams cad kun/ /dpa' bos yongs su dag par bsgom/ /ri mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ /de dag dpa' bos rnam par dag /'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma yis dag /lte bar phag mo'i sa bon kṣaX /he ru ka dpal mchog yin no/ /'dab rim mkha' 'gro ma yis dag /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog dag ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag /dkyil 'khor snying po mdor bsdu sngon/ /77—944

dkyil 'khor dang po yi ge ste/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa phyag mtshan yin/ /gsum pa lag pa'i /phyag rgyar bshad/ /bzhi pa gzugs su gyur pa ste/ /lnga pa me tog mchod pa yin/ /drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /dbus ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /padma'i lte ba dang bcas pa/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo dri ma med / /gsung gi 'khor lo 'od byed pa/ / sku yi 'khor lo 'od 'phro ba/ /zur bzhi pa ni sbyang dka' cib/ /ring du song ba sgo bzhi yin/ /zur gyi cha ni mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros rdo rje'i thig /chos kyi sprin ni rta babs yin/ /'di lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /rtag tu bsgom zhing mchod par bya/ /dngos grub rgya chen 'thob 0par 'gyur/ /sdom pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi de nyid ni/ /he ru ka dpal ye shes mchog /bha ga'i padma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /phag mo'i sku lus mchog gyur pa/ /de ni dkyil 'khor 'dus pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bde chen mchog yin no/ /dkyil 'khor dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis med kha sbyor dkyil 'khor yin/ /bdag gi de nyid ting 'dzin yin/ /lha yi de nyid de bzhin te/ /sngags kyi de nyid phyag rgya yin/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor dam pa'i mchog /yan lag kun bsgoms las 'das shing / /rtog dang rnam rtog rnam par spangs/ /phyi mo'i thig le las 'das shing / /de ni dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ /chos rnams thams cad brtag dzotu med/ /chos dang chos min rnam par spyod/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa ni/ /rnam dag nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ /chags dang chags med chags par mnyam/ /padma rā ga chu mnyam byung / /rang sems chags pa dmar po'i mchog /de dag dkyil 'khor mchog yin te/ /yid ni 77—945

khams rnams thams cad de/ /gzugs dang gzugs med dri ma med/ /bskul zhing sad pa yid yin te/ /sems ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /dkyil 'khor lus su bshad pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha ga yin par bshad/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems yin te/ /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu ba/ /sa 'og sa stengs sa blar khyab/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las dkyil 'khor gyi sgom pa bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa /tshogasum pa'o// //de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /sems can kun la phan stsol pa/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi grong khyer mchog /dra ba dra byed kyis brgyan pa/ /dar dang phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje che/ /zhal bzhi pa la rnam par 'gyur/ /de la lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo lte bar bcas/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo brgyad pa ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus dag tu/ /sna tshogs padma 'dab ri brgyad pa/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes rnam 'dres pa/ /lha yi bzhugs gnas nyi shu pa / /lte ba'i dbus su bstan pa ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rgyu las he ru kur byas te/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /spyan gsum sku lus dkar po ste/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas/ /phag mo yi ni ku tsa'ang ri )'tshir / /stag gi pags pa gos su mnabs / /phyag rgya drug gis sku la brgyan /gdug pa kun gyi klad tshopa la/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis mnan / /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /brgyal zhing rnam par myos pa yi /klad pa la ni zhabs kyis mnan/ /gcer bu 'o dod 'bod pa mnan/ /77—946

rgyal ba'i pags 3)pa steng du ste/ /lcags kyu phyag gis 'dzin pa dang / /gzhan yang cang te'u de bzhin te/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga yang 'dzin/ /gzhan du yang ni mgo bo 'chang tsho ri/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu la mnan/ /zla ba phyed pa dbu la 'chang / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /mi bskyod pa yis spyi gtsug brgyadage/ /tshangs pa'i do shal 'dzin pa ste/ /bdag gi khro bo bdun spros nas/ /ji ltar bcom ldan mdog bzhin du/ /phag mo mchog dang de bzhin te/ /sku lus nag po dmar ba'i mdangs/ /gzi byin mdangs kyis mdzes pa ste/ /gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /dril bu cang te'u mdung dang ni/ /lcags myu zhags pa de bzhin no/ /lha mo phyag ni brgyad pa ste/ /dka' zhing sngo la ljang ba'o/ /steng gi zhal ni dmar po mdzes/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gdong ni/ /ser zhing ljang ba'i gzugs can te/ /gzhan du bdag po ji bzhin du/ /phag mo yang ni de bzhin gyur/ /gcer bu spa ni grol ba ste/ /ma nyams dum bu'i ska rags can/ /padma bzhi la mkha' 'gro ma/ /zur la bum pa thod pa ste/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo sngar bshad pa'o/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma de bzhin/ /gsung dang sku yi 'khor lo gnyis/ /shar dang byang nub lho ru'o/ /sgo rnams su ni sgo srung stesku / /khā gdong la sogs tshothams cad do/ /zur la gshin rje sreg la sogs / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i khyad 7par ni/ /rdo rje snying pos bshad pa ste/ /kha cig rnal 'byor ma ru 'dod/ /bla ma'i gnas kyi rjes rim pa/ /sngar bshad sna tshogs rigs rnams ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pas bsgom par bya/ /gzhan yang zhal dang mdog rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi mdog bzhin dang / /phyag mtshan phyag rgyar sngar bshad bzhin/ /gnas sogs rim pa 5de ltar dgod/ /77—947

sngar bshad pa yi cho ga bzhin/ /gsang sngags ji bzhin rim par dgod/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam dag don/ /sgom pa mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /ā li kā /li'i dang byung ba/ /sgom zhing rnam par bsgom par bya/ /chos dbyings grong khyer rnam dag par/ /sems can khams ni rab tu 'jug /rnal 'byor 'di ni gsang ba ste/ /su la yang ni bstan mi bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i /kā / // bla ma las chos kyi dbyings kyi grong khyer sgom pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /bha ga padma sgom pa ni/ /rdo rje snying pos zhus pa las/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /yang dag gsang ba nges gsang ba/ /ā li kā li zur gsum gnas/ /padma 'dab rigasum rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje phag mo he ru ka /lte ba la ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro lā ma dang / /gsum pa dum skyes ma nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das ni dmar la sngo/ /phag mo yang ni dmar sngo ste/ /mkha' 'gro sngo la ser ba dang / /lā ma ljang la ser ba ste/ /dum skyes ma ni dmar la ser/ /zhal gcig 4pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /bcom ldan mgon po zhal bzhi pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /dril bu rdo rjes legs par mtshon/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa ste/ /zhi ba zla ba byed pa 'chang / /mi 'khrugs pa ni spyi gtsug 'ching / /rtag par gsang ba'i gos mdabs shing / /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /phag mo'i zhal mtshan de yin te/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs 'khyud cing / /gcer 77—948

bu dbu spa grol ba la/ /spyan gsum pa la legs chags 'khril/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan gnyis / /zhabs kyis rnam par gnon pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /sku lus phyag rgya drug 'dzin zhing / /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / /thugs rje'i chags pas rnam par myos/ /g.yas pa dkar rizhing g.yon ljang gu / /steng ni sngo skya sku lus dkar/ /gzugs can ma ni bha gar brtag /ā li kā li bha ga'i mchog /gzhan yang zur gsum dbus dag tu/ /padma'i 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs padma dag tu btag /dbus su he ru ka phag mo/ /'dab mar mkha' 'gro ma sogs dgod/ /zur du thod pa dkar po dag /thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la spyod/ /shar gyi zur la sku 'khor lo/ /rlung gi zur gyi 'khor lo la/ /khu tshogadong la sogs —rnam brgyad do/ /gsung gi 'khor lo bden bral zur/ /'khor lo bzhi po zur gsum la/ /shar ni sku yi mkha' 'gro ste/ /rlung phyogs gshin rje'i mkha' 'gro'o/ /bden bral gsung gi mkha' 'gro ste/ /dbus su rdo rje he ru ka /sngo zhing dkar po dud ka / dang / /sngo zhing dmar ba bzhi po yin/ /rang gi phyag mtshan mnyam par ldan/ /gzhan du rang bdag mdog skobazhin du/ /dpa' bo 'khor lo mdog 5de bzhin/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dmar ba'i mdog can rnam par bsam/ /dpa' bo'i mdog ni nag po la/ /gnyis med 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dag /sku lus dkar po rnam par bsam/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ser po'i mdog /dpa' bo gnyis ni rab tu sbyor/ /khu gdong gshin rje brtan la sogs / /gzugs ciganyis phyed ni bud med nyid / /// dzee / sdus

lo'i dpa' bo dmar/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ljang gu'o①/ /sngar bshad rim pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /de yang rigs kyi dbye bas so/ /thams cad yi dgas khugadan la bzhugs/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thams cad phyag rgya lnga 'chang zhing / /phyag rgya drug gi ribadag po dgod/ /thams cad rang rigs cod pan can/ /ji lta ba yi rim pas bsgom/ /mkha' 'gro'i dus kyi sbyor ba yis/ /ji lta'i rjes su rnam bsgoms nas/ /go cha'i gsang sngags dgod par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rim pa dag ri /sngar bshad cho ga'i sbyor ba yis / /dpa' bo'i yan lag rim pa bsgom/ /gsang zhing sba ba'i zhi gnas ni /mkha' 'gro ma yi bde 'khor lo/ /rtag tu mnyam par bzhag nas su/ /sbyor ba'i mchog ni rtag tu bsgom/ /'di ni su la'ang mi bstan te/ /de nyid su la'ang brjod mi bya/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba dag /rtag tu bsgoms na dngos grub 'gyur/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsrung bya zhing / /bza' dang bca' zhu ba'ang spyad par bya/ /'gro zhing 'gro zhing dus kun du/ /'char nub dag tu rnam par sbyang / /gang zhig ye shes 'di nyan pa / /sngags pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gsang ba sbyor ba'i sgom pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gsang ba'i ye shes mchog gyur pa/ /rigs lnga gsang sngags rgya che ba'i/ /sgom pa bdag gis bshad pa yin/ /log pa'i shes pa'i shes pa can/ /gang la'ang 7khyod kyis bshad mi bya/ /bla ma'i 77—950

rim las ji ltar bstan/ /gang gis myur du shes 'gyur ba/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /sgyu 'phrul ye shes kyis bskul zhing / /dad pa yang dag bskyed pa dang — /rnal 'byor spyod tshul gnas pa yin/ / smugs shing glen la sdig ngan can / /byis pa'i shes pa'i shes pa can/ /sems can yongs su ma smin dang / /phyi rol bstan bcos kyis 'chal pa / /de dag kun gyis mi shes te/ /mi shes mun pas khebs pa dang / /khengs pa la ni rtag par dga'/ /nga rgyal la sogs sa gdug sems can / /de kun gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi/ /spyod yul gsang ba mi shes so/ /ho ru ka dpal yang dag 'jug /slob dpon bdag nyid chen po yis/ /myur du dngos grub skyed byed de/ /'phral du yid ches byed pa yin/ /sna tshogs sdom pa shes pa yis/ /cho ga'i bya ba bstan par bya/ /srid pa gsum po ma lus ni/ /de ni kun mkhyen bstan pa shes/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur ba/ /de ltar de ni the tshom med/ /lha rnams bzlog ste bkod /pa dang / /sngags kyi dbye ba bzlog pa dang / /dkyil 'khor kun yang bzlog pa dang / /so so ngabasgom pa'ang mi bya ste/ /bzlog pa'i yi ge btus nas ni/ /sgom pa gsang ba bzlog pa de/ /snying po thams cad sgrub 7pa yin/ /rtog 5pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /rgyud rnams kun gyi spyi yi ni/ /sems ni yongs su smin pa dgam /'dir ni sbyor sogs sngags rnams kyi/ /dam tshig de ltar bstan pa yin/ /bde gshegs dbugs 'byin gsungs pa yin / /dag pa'i lus ni skyon med pa/ /bsod nams chung ba'i sngags pas kyang / /nga tshadaga' bas ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /de na srung 4med bza' ba med/ /dkyil 'khor 77—951

dkyil 'khor bdag po med/ /bzlas dang brtul zhugs sbyin sreg med/ /mdor na sems bsdus tshul can yin/ /bzung /byas rnam shes ye shes ni/ /bla mas bstan las brtson las te/ /phyi rol gyi ni bstan bcos la/ /lam de shin tu ring ba yin/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams thabs kyis ni/ /bla ma'i bsnyen ribakur la brtson pa/ /ston pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa yin / /dpa' bo'i de nyid bstan pa dang / /skad cig rnam par rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig rnam par phyag rgyar ldan/ /kun nas thams cad skad cig ste / /skad cig gis ni gsang sngags brjod/ /pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /bdag nyid kyis ni gsol ba gdab / /bcom ldan lha mos zhus pa ni/ /go 'phang rgya che gnyis med pa/ /'di ni 'byung po kun la gnas/ /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu rol/ /rdo rje snying pos gsungs pa ni/ /ci rigs bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /brtags pa'i yid kyis gzung bar gyis/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs par/ /gang zhig sngar ni bshad pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor lus ni yin par bshad/ /de ni sgo dgu dag tu 'gyur/ /de la lte ba'i 'khor lo che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa zhes byar bshad/ /rdo rje can ni der zhugs pa/ /cha med cha tshoni rnam spangs pa/ /lus can rnams kyi dang na rol/ /lus las 'das shing gos pa med/ /la lar gzugs can dag tu bzhugs/ /la lar sna dang ngag dag dang / /la lar rna bar sgra dag dang / /la lar dri chen rdo rje chu/ /la lar tshor bar bcas pa'i sems /la lar skom dang la lar bkres/ /la lar khro dang la lar zhi/ /la lar bde la rnam par gzigs/ /la lar bud med 'dod chags te/ /la lar gsod dang 'joms pa ste/ /la lar rol mo thung mabar mdzad/ /la lar me 77—952

tog 'bras bur gnas/ /la lar rol cing spyod par 'gyur/ /la lar srog tu rnam par gnas/ /la lar sa dang chu dang me/ /la lar 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /la lar rigs kyi bye brag gis/ /bram ze dang ni gdol pa dag /la lar ma dang sring mo ru/ /la lar chung ma bu mo ru/ /la lar tshangs dang dbang ldan dang / /khyab 'jug dang ni nyi ma nyid/ /la lar zla ba skar mar bcas/ /la lar nyid dang mtshan mor gyur/ /la lar khams gsum pa rnams kun/ /byed pa po dang mi zad rgyal/ /la lar zhi ba'i dbang gis zhum/ /mi gsal stong pa'i rdo rje can /la lar byang chub chen por gshegs/ /la lar pha rol bdud las rgyal/ /la lar byis pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /la lar nas shing 'khogs pa'o/ /la lar nad chen gyis zin pa/ /la lar rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /la lar sngo dang le brgan dang —/ /la lar dkar dang ser ba'o/ /la lar sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /la lar sgrol ma gos dkar mo/ /la lar spyan dang mā ma tī/ /la lar dka' zlog rizhi ba mo/ /la lar 'dab richags mkha' lding dang / /nam mkha' dang ni mkha' 'gro nyid/ /la lar klu dang sbrul chen po/ /la lar smad 'tshong spre'u dang ni / /la lar mi lam mthong ba dang / /la lar gnyid kyis log pa nas/ /la lar rlung dang mkhris pa dang / /la lar khrag dang pags cipar 'gyur/ /la lar mya ngan du ba dang / /la lar sreg pa'i me dag yin/ /la lar mtho ris skye ba ste/ /rnam par 'phrul pa 'di lta bu/ /thams cad bdag nyid bzhugs 'di la / /lha gang cha ni rnam spangs pa'i/ /de yi sgyu ma'i sna tshogs 'di'o/ /rtag pa min pa rdo rje can/ /gzugs med par ni bha ga'i nang / /lte ba'i nang na padma che/ /bcu drug thig gis thig gdab bar/ /yi ge dang yang mnyam sbyor 77—953

bas/ /kha sbyar /bya ba byas pa yin/ /de dbus rtag tu gsang ba che/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa'o/ /de nyid rang nyid rdo rje can/ /gcig pu rang byung che ba'i lha/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun dngos zhes/ /mtshan ni rab tu bshad pa yin//gsang ba'i mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thams cad mkhyen pas 'di bshad pa'am/ /mi 'gyur ba yi lam bshad pa/ /skra yi nyag ma brgya yi cha/ /mchog gi gzugs can bsam pa ste/ /stong pa ma yin dmigs su med/ /yi ge med cing stong pa'ang med/ /gos pa med cing sa bon med/ /gzugs med mtshan ma'ang med pa ste/ /rnam shes rang gi dngos po ni/ /rnam shes ye shes dag tu gzung ci/ /thams cad gsal byed sgron ma ni / /dang po'i rimatshan ma dag tu blta/ /gsal byed klog cigi cha tsam ste/ /mtshan ma gnyis pa dag tu brtag /dkar po'i 'od kyi tshul can ni/ /phyogs bcu dag tu blta byas te/ /nyon mongs 'byin pa gsungs pa yin/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rnam par brtag /'dod pa'i lha yi 7longs spyod ni/ /bzhi pa rnam shes dag tu bstan/ /gzugs dang reg sogs lha mo ni/ /phyogs kyi ye shes lnga po yin/ /drug pa gzugs med ye shes te/ /bdun pa dag ni chos kyi dbyings /brgyad par rang nyid 'dod bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu dag yin no/ /sbas pa lta dang lag pa dang / /'khyud dang gnyis gnyis la sogs pa /de bzhin gshegs pas dbugs 'byin gsungs/ /dgu pa bla ma bla ma ste/ /thams cad 'dir ni bstan pa yin/ /rnam pa gzhan dag rna 40dang 'dra/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi /srog /de nyid mi 'gyur dam pa yin/ /de nyid thams cad khyab byed de / /lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /de nyid sangs 77—954

rgyas ye shes te/ /ho ru ka dpal yin par bshad kyi/ /skyes pa ma ning la sogs nyid / /phra ba'i snying po'ang 'dzin pa yin/ /ye shes rtag ritu 'byung de la/ /gang zhig sa la gnas rnams dang / /bstan bcos dag ni ma lus dang / /rig byed grub mthar gnas pa rnams/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ /de med par ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rig byed grub pa'i mtha' rnams la/ /'di ni snying po rab tu bshad/ /'dug dang ldang ba nyid dang ni/ /'jug pa rdzogs pa nyid dag dang / /byin gyis brlabs dang dbang bskur dang / /ting 'dzin mchod pa bsdus pa yin/ /de nas cho ga ming gzhan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /de nyid du ni kun skyes pa/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yin/a ā/ mi khyu/ mu spru/ ṛ dzā/ bla 'a / e i/ bzhiyo/ me aḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ja ḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dzha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ 'di ni bcom ldan lha de yin/ /mchog nyid lhag par gnas pa yin/ /lha kun gyi ni bskyed pa dang / /bsgrubs byas de bzhin shes byas nas/ /don dam mchog kyang de bzhin te/ /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi theg pa ste/ /sngags kyi spyod pa la gnas na/ /des ni 'di ni nges rgyal te/ /thams cad shes rab thabs kyis 'gro/ /thog mar gsang sngags brjod par bya//dge dang mi dge gang yin pa/ /de ni lha tshogs rgyan yin te/ /ska tshorags gnas rnams thams cad yin/ /rtag tu 'di ni 'dzin byed pa/ /chos rnams thams cad rtogs pa yin/ /a li kā li mdun tshabasams na/ /rnal 'byor chen po ngal bsos 7te/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sems nyid de / /sems kyang brtag skepar mi bya'o/ /sems de nyid kyang mi bsam ste/ /des chan 'dzin pa mthob par 77—955

'gyur /gang gis rgyud kun las gsang ba/ /khyod la yang ni bshad pa yin/ /'di ni 'bad pas sba bya ste/ /gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i sdom/ /rnal 'byor ma sogs thams cad dang / /dpa' bo'i yan lag thams cad kyi/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'bras bu 'thob / /srid pa'i nang nas 'byung ba yin/ /bla ma'i rgyud kyi thabs la ni/ /bsnyen bkur med pa la mi bshad/ /gal te bshad na sdug bsngal zhing / /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems kyang 'khor/ /sems ni rnam 'khor rnal 'byor pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar bud med byis gtam rjes yi rang / /kun smra bsten pa'i gtam yang rjod ripar byed/ /lam yang ma bshad 'ching bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rnal 'byor lam ngan de dang 'dra bar bshad / /ho ru ka dpal sku'i yan lag /sku kun brtan rigayo bdag nyid can/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /'dun pa mngon du gyur pa nyid/ /nye ba'i 'dun pa sbyang dka' ba/ /'dus pa ring du song ba yin/ /nye bar 'dus pa mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin / /shrī he ru ga'i gzhung spyod pa/ /'di ni dang gi bdag nyid tshocan / /pha rol phyin bcu sa rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni brda yi skad/ /mtho ris sa stengs ngas 'og tu/ /dpa' bo'i yan lag brtan mgayo'i bdag /thog cimed dus su gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing / /kun tu mig dang mgo bo'i zhal/ /kun tu thos ldan 'jig rten na/ /thams cad g.yogs te rnam 77—956

par bzhugs/ /de nas dngos grub bsgrub /bya ba/ /bsam gtan ldan pa'i sems kyis te/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i de nyid gsungs pa yin /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /man ngag shin tu rnyed dka' ste/ /dpa' bo'i brda riyi skad du ni/ /nga yis rgyud du sbas pa yin/ /gos ni 5phyag rgya lnga la sogs / /shes rab yan lag phur bu dra / /a li kā li zhes brjod pa /rgyu la sogs stong sngon 'gro yin/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid bsdus pa'i sbyor ldan nyid/ /bdud rtsi tshim byed mya ngan 'das/ /lag pa'i mchod pas dbang bskur tshob/ /go cha chen pos yang dag bsrung / /sngags rnams kun gyis mchod pa yin/ /de ltar de nyid bcu bzhi ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pa yin/ /mi mchog gang zhig kun spyod pa/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam dag bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa thob cing / /skye dang rga bar tshabade gshegs kyi/ /rigs skyes rgyal po chos ldan 'gyur/ /de ltar cho ga ldan byas na / /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stol/ /zla ba nya la sa steng du/ /'di ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na/ /de yi bsod nams gyur pa yin /lha klu mi la sogs pa kun/ /de yi bsod nams gang gyur des/ /bdag gzhan yang dag ye shes ldan/ /bsam gtan sems pa tsam gyis sam/ /klog cing 'don dang bris pa yis/ /mtho ris longs spyod 'thob nga'agyur ba'am//yang na 'khor los sgyur skab 'thob/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung lasogs mkha' 'gro/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs glu yi mchod —pas mchod/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' 77—957

la 'gro ba'i gnas su 'khyer// /de 'dra'i dpal chen rnal 'byor pa/ /sa stengs su ni rnyed par dka' / /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gsang ba'i yi ge skyed cicing sgrub pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /cho ga'i rim bzhin sngags btu ba/ /gcig tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mkhas pas sa ni mnyam ri nas su/ /bshang gci yis ni byug par bya/ /ma hā rakta byugs tshonas kyang / /bdag nyid he ru gar byas nas/ /rigs ngan shan pa mo blangs nas/ /me tog la sogs gdab par bya/ /dpa' bo chen po'i bdug spos dbul/ / zhag la sogs tshapa mar me sbar/ /cang te'u dril bu brdung bar bya/ /glu dang gar gyis mchod par bya/ /lha yi rol mo'i bye brag dang / /phyogs spyi gos can spa grol ba/ /lus ni phyag rgya drug dang ldan/ /ā li tā li mnyam byas te/ /sde tshan la ni thim par bya/ /bzhi bzhi ru ni shes byas la/ /bub pa'i mchog gis rgyas par bya/ /der gnas dpa' bo btu bar bya/ /don 'dod thams cad grub byed pa/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa gang yin dang / /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /dang po'i gsum pa gang yin dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ /bzhi pa'i dang po gang yin dang / /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni gnyis pa dang / /sum cu pa ni yang dag blang / /nyi shu drug pa nyid dang ni /de bzhin brgya yi byed phyed dang / /de nas sum cu rtsa gsum dang / / dang po'i dang po nyid dag dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /dang po yi ni gsum pa nyid/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis pa nyid 77—958

ni / /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /lnga pa yi yang bzhi pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi dang po dang / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po gang yin dang / /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa dang / /dang po yi ni dang po dang / /de bzhin bcu gcig ①pa nyid dang / /de bzhin mkhas pas bcu drug pa/ /gsum pa'i zhu dang po gang yin dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ /bzhi pa'i gsum pa gang yin dang / /utpa riyi ni gnyis pa nyid/ /dang po'i dang po gang yin dang —/ /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa yang ngo / /dang po yi ni gsum pa dang / /lnga pa yi yang bzhi pa dang / /de bzhin sum cu rtsa gcig cablang —/ /bcu ri lnga pa ni nyid dag dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /dang po'i gnyis pa gang yin dang / /de bzhin nyi shu drug pa dang / /yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ / spa ṇa hūṃ ni tha ma nyid/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis pa nyid dang / /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /u༅ tsho)yi ni gsum pa dang / /gzhan yang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ / marnya sgyu yi dang po dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig tshopa/ / arnya 5 5yi gnyis pa dang / /de bzhin yang ni sum cu pa/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / udma mayi ni dang po nyid / /de bzhin yi ge bya nyid dang / /bzhi pa'i dang po gang yin dang / /u 'i codang po gang yin dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ /dang po'i gnyis pa gang yin dang / /gsum pa'i dang po nyid dag dang / /dang po'i dkugasum pa gang yin dang / /bzhi pa'i bzhi pa gang yin dang / / anta 5 yi taiganyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i yang ni lnga pa dang / /yi ge bya ni de nas blang / /dang po yi ni bzhi pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa dag /de nas 77—959

brgyad pa nyid dag dang / /bzhi pa'i lnga pa gang yin dang / /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa dang — /nyi shu rtsa gsum pa yang blang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / /bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /slar yang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug pa /nyi shu rtsa lnga yang dag blang / /sum cu rtsa gsum nyid dag dang / /bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis 3pa blang — /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /dang po'i dang po nyid dag dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ / anta sgyu riyi bzhi pa dang /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig cipa/ /sku yi ni gnyis pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ /thog ma yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa nyid/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa nyid/ /thog ma yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /drug pa yi ni gsum pa dang — /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /bzhi pa yis ni sbyar bar bya/ /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /bzhi pa yi ni gnas su bya/ /lnga pa yi ni thog ma la/ /steng du sbyar zhing me dang bcas/ /utpa yi ni gsum pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi thog ma dang / /bzhi pa yi ni thog ma la/ /gzi brjid can gyis gdan du byas/ /bdun pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /drug pa yi yang dang po ste/ /ka dang sha yi yi ge ni/ /thog ma dag ni blangs nas su/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi dang po ste/ /de bzhin yang ni bsdus te blang / /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /bdun pa yi ni dang po dang / / utpa ṇa yi bzhi pa blang / /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dag /rdo rje sems dpas 77—960

gye ba yin/ / mug ṇa yi bzhi pa nyid/ /nyi ma yang ni gdan du byas/ /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /me yi 'og tu sbyar bar bya/ /gshegs su gsol dang yang dag ldan/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /de bzhin nyi shu gnyis pa nyid /drug pa yi ni gnyis de bzhin/ /bcu gcig pa dang nyi shu gnyis/ /gsum pa'i dang po blangs nas ni/ /bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa dang / / sum ṇa riyi bzhi pa nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /bdun pa'i bzhi pa blang bar bya//nyi shu rtsa gcig cade blangs nas/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa yi yang thog ma dang / /gnyis pa yi ni yi ge drug /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /kṣa yi yi ge de bzhin no/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi de blangs nas/ /slar yang bsdu ba bshad pa yin/ /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang / / udma ṇa ni gsum pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa la / /nyi mas slar yang gdab par bya/ /yi ge nyi shu btab nas ni/ /bcu drug pa yis stan du bya / /'og tu me yi gzi bajid can/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /drug pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang / /nyi shu rtsa lnga pa yis —dbye/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang —/ /gnyis pa yi yang gsum pa dang / /nyi ma'i bu yis rnam par dbye/ / mu ṇa yi bzhi pa tshadang / /dang po yi ni gsum pa la/ /gzi brjid kyis ni gdan du byas/ /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /bco ngalnga pa yis cigadan gnyis bya/ / u ṇa 7yi gsum pa nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni thog ma la/ /bcu drug pa yis gdan du byapa/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig tshode yis blangs/ /bzhi pa yi ni thog ma dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa 77—961

dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /dang po yi ni gsum pa dang / / udma ṇa ①yi gsum pa nyid/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig /de bzhin te/ /nyi ma yis ni mnyam par mnan/ /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /gzi brjid kyis ni gsal bar bya / /mthar gnas pa yi thog mar shes /der cayang bcu drug pa yis gdab chi/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang //de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa dang / /thog ma yi yang dang po dang / /bzhi pa yi yang gsum pa dang / /thog ma yi yang dang po dang / /gnyis pa yi yang dang po dang / /de bzhin du ni bcu bzhi pa'o/ /bcu bzhi utpa gyibazhi pa dang / /nyi shu rtsa bdun gdan du byas/ /ya sogs brgyad po'i ri sa bon dang / /nyi ma yi ni gzi brjid can/ /gsum pa yi yang gsum pa dang //bcu lnga pa yis tshogadan du byang/ /gnyis pa yi yang gsum pa dang / /gsum pa yi yang lnga pa dang / /ka sha'i yi ge sa bon te/ /nyi shu lnga pa gdan du bya / /slar yang bsdu bar bya ba ste/ /sku ni legs par btu ba ste/ /dbang chen gyis ni gdan du bya / /udma 5yi ni bzhi pa dang / /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /ya tshogs 4brgyad po'i sa bon dang / /de bzhin sum cu gsum pa nyid/ /sum cu rtsa gsum de bzhin te/ /lnga pa'i bdag nyid kun bsdu ba'o/ /de nas kyang ni btu bya ba/ /gnyis pa yang ni de bzhin te/ /yoganyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang / / utpa ṇa 7yi gsum pa dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /drug pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /lnga pa yi yang bzhi pa dang / /drug pa yi yang gsum pa dang / /gnyis 77—962

gnyis rkang pa bzhi pa ste/ /ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ brnya brnya/ tā sa ya tā yi)sa ya/ /khyo bha ya/ khyo bha ya/ hre hre / hraḥhraX / dze dze/ phaṭa phaṭa/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru snyi ra/ ant+ra / mā lā ba lo bi de griṇḍa gros( / sasta pā tā la ga ta/ su pa ga sa bā/ tang ya tardza ya / ā ( 7ka ji / ā 9ka lta/ spyo spyo/ ’ sna / sde rgyu/ shlau gli/ tī gling/snye snye/ gi li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li / sne 'i phaṭa phaṭam/ rig pa'i rgyal po gsang sngags te/ /bya ba thams cad sgrub byed pa'o/ /'di las shin tu mchog gyur pa/ /'jig rten gsum na yod min te /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sngags shes na/ /gzhan dag snying po med rnar 7mtshungs / /rtsa ba'i sngags su bshad pa yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla sdu dī // sdu zlos rtsa ba'i sngags kyi yi ge btu ba'i rdo rgyus kyi cho ga'i le'u ste lnga bcu gzhan yang yi ge nyi shu gnyis/ /snying po'i yig bdun nye snying po/ /ya tshogs brgyad po'i pas bon dang / /de bzhin gug skyed bcu gnyis kyis/ /yi ge bar ma dor byas pa/ /yan lag drug ni he 7ru ka /dpa' bo drug dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /re'u mig drug tu bsgom pa ste/ /he ru ka yi bdag por 'gyur/ /yi ge gcig 0tu yang dag gnas/ /oṃ na maḥ swā hā bo ṣa ṭa / /snye sne phaṭa dang yang dag ldan/ /sgrub pos snying por shes par bya/ /dang po snying ga nyid du ste/ /gnyis pa spyi bor shes par bya/ /gsum pa spyi gtsug dag tu sbyar/ /bzhi pa go char gyur pa yin/ /lnga pa mig tu gyur pa ste/ /drug pa mtshon cha zhes 77—963

byar 'dod/ /de nas dbyangs yig bcu gsum nyid/ /yi ge gnyis pa dag dang sbyar/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig yang dag sbyar/ /yi ge drug pas yabargyan par bya/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pa nyid kyang ni/ /yi ge bdun pa nyid kyang sbyar / /dbyangs yig bcu gcig cipa nyid ni/ /mkhas pas yi ge brgyad par sbyar/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba'i/ /yi ge dgu pas ri brgyan par bya/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa nyid/ /yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang sbyar/ /dbyangs yig gnyis par ldan pa ni/ /yi ge nyi shu gcig pa gzung / /mkhas pas yi ge bcu bzhi pa/ /yi ge nyi shu pa dang sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pa nyid dag rini/ /yi ge bco /lnga pa ru ngasbyar/ /dbyangs yig bco 1lngar yang dag ldan/ /yi ge bcu drug pa mdzes bya/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa'i/ /yi ge bcu bdun pa ru 'dod/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa nyid dang ni/ /yi ge bcu skubargyad pa ru 5sbyar/ /dbyangs yig gi ni gnyis pa nyid/ /yi ge nyi shu gcig sapar sbyar /phyi mo'i lnga pa dang yang sbyar/ /yi ge nyi shu gsum par sbyar/ /skudabyangs yig bcu gsum pa nyid ni/ /yi ge nyi shu bzhi par sbyar/ /sde tshan dang po blangs nas ni/ /yi ge nyi shu lalnga par sbyar/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan par/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa drug 'gyur/ /yi ge nyi shu brgyad dag ni/ /yi ge bco rtselnga pa dang sbyar/ /gsum pa'i skudang por yang dag ldan/ /'og gi cha ni me dang bcas/ /de bzhin dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa dgu pa /yi ge sum cu rtsa gcig 7par/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dag dang sbyar/ /yi ge sum cu gnyis pa yang / /dbyangs yig gnyis par ldan par bya/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ /nyi mar yang dag ldan par bya/ /phyi mo'i bzhi pa nyid 77—964

dag ni/ /yi ge sum cu bzhir ldan pa'i/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub byed yin//phyi mo'i 3lnga pa nyid dag ni/ /sum cu bdun par yang dag ldan/ /mkha' 'gro rim rnams sgrub byed yin/ /sum cu brgyad pa nyid dag ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba/ /lha rnams thams cad sgrub pa ni/ /'di nyid yin par the tshom med/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa nyid ni/ /me dang 'og tu bsgrub par bya/ /bzhi bcu gsum pa nyid dag ni/ /dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dang sbyar/ /yi ge bzhi bcu lnga pa ni/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis par sbyar / /dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dag kyang / /bzhi bcu rtsa drug par ldan pa/ /dpa' bo thams cad rab mchod cing / /bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa nyid ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu 'dod/ /de bzhin lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ /dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dag gis/ /mdzes pa mchog ni yin par 'dod / /lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa nyid ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba/ /lha rnams thams cad 'grub byed pa/ /'di nyid yin par the tshom med/ /de bzhin lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'ang / /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa dang sbyar/ /yi ge rnams las 'di mchog ste/ /dgra rnams nges par gsod byed yin/ /sde tshan bzhi las bya nyid do/ /yi ge lnga bcu rtsa drug pa/ /dbyangs yig drug pa dag dang sbyar/ / anta 5 tshoyi bzhi pa dang / dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar bar bya/ /de bzhin bco lnga pa dang sbyar/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa yin / /yi ge lnga bcu rtsa dgur 'gyur/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa gcig nyid/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dag dang sbyar/ /'di nyid mchog ni yin par bshad/ /de bzhin drug cu rtsa gnyis pa/ /dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar ba ni/ /mkha' 77—965

'gro ma yi mchog tu 'dod/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa gsum nyid/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig 3)dag dang ldan/ /mdzes pa'i yi ge kun mchog yin/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi pa nyid ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phye ba dag /dbyangs yig gnyis par yang dag ldan / /grub sbyin thar pa chen po'o/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ /me la gnas par yang dag ldan/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang sbyar ba/ /dngos grub kun sbyin bde gshegs gsungs/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa drug pa( / /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang sbyar ba/ /bya ba kun las grub sbyin par/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa bdun pa/ /yi ge gnyis pa yang dag ldan /rnal 'byor ma yi dgos sa pa kun/ /'di nyid byed par the tshom gemed/ /drug cu brgyad pa nyid dag las/ /der ni yi ge ba sbyar ba/ /'og gi char ni brtag par bya/ /yi ge bdun cu rtsa gcig pa/ /yi ge gnyis par yang dag sbyar / /yi ge kun la mdzes pa ni/ /'di nyid yin par the tshom med/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi pa nyid ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar ba dag /gdod nas grub pa yin par ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas gsungs/ /yi ge bdun cu lnga pa nyid/ /ma mo'i drug pa dang ldan pa/ /'di ni rnal 'byor mchog yin te/ /dge ba kun las dam pa yin/ /bdun cu rtsa drug pa nyid ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan zhing / /'og tu me dang ldan pa las/ /gzhan dag mdzes pa yod ma yin/ /yi ge bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ /der ni da dang ( )sbyar bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi mdzes par 'dod/ /bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa nyid ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dag dang sbyar/ /rgyu yi mchog ni yin par 'dod/ /yi ge brgyad cu rtsa gcig ci pa/ /bzhi pa'i mtha' yis khyad par dbye/ /gdod nas 77—966

grub byed 'di yin te/ /dngos grub kun la 'jug byed pa'o/ /yi ge brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa/ /de bzhin dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar/ /phyi mo yi ni lnga pa la/ /de bzhin yi ge brgyad cu brgyad/ /ma mo yi ni lnga pa dang / /brgyad cu dgu pa de bzhin te/ /ma mo lnga pa blangs /byas te / /de bzhin yi ge dgu bcu pa/ /ma mo'i lnga pa blangs shu byas te/ /yi ge dgu bcu gcig cipar sbyor/ /ma mo yi ni gnyis pa dang / /yi ge dgu bcu rtsa drug pa/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa ldan pa yi / /yi ge dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa/ /gdug pa thams cad skrag byed pa/ /ma mo kun gyi bde ba'i gnas/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gsum pa/ /yi ge gnyis pa dag dang ldan/ /ma mo bcu gsum pa nyid ni/ /yi ge lnga pa dag dang sbyar/ /gdug pa thams cad 'khrug byed de/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi bde ba'i gnas/ /dbyangs yig bcu bzhi pa yis ni/ /yi ge brgyad pa dag dang sbyar/ /bcwa lnga pa yis rab tu sbyar/ /dbyangs yig bcu bzhi pa nyid ni/ /yi ge dgu pa dag dang sbyar/ /steng du thig le yang dag gnas/ /yi ge dag ni bsgrub di pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi khyad par yin/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa nyid ni/ /yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang sbyar/ /steng du than dus rnam par brgyan/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gcig tshopa/ /yi ge bcu gsum pa dang sbyar/ /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ /'byung po kun ni skrag byed cing / /sgrub pa pos ni dga' ba yin/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge lnga pa la/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pa nyid dag ni/ /yi ge sum cu gsum dang sbyar/ /ma mo gnyis pa nyid dag dang / /yi ge sum cu rtsa bzhir sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa dag dang ni/ /yi ge sum cu drug dang sbyar/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa dag /yi ge sum cu 77—967

bdun dang sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gsum pa ni/ /yi ge bzhi bcu dang sbyar ba / /ma mo bcu gcig /pa nyid ni/ /yi ge bzhi bcu gcig dang sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa ni / /yi ge bzhi bcu gnyis par sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pa dag dang ni/ /yi ge bzhi bcu bzhi dang sbyar/ /ma mo'i byuganyis pa nyid dang yang / /yi ge bzhi bcu brgyad par sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa dag /yi ge bzhi bcu dgu dang sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa dag / yi ge lnga bcu gnyis par sbyar/ / phyi mo'i lnga pa nyid dang ni/ /yi ge lnga bcu lnga dang sbyar/ /yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ /yi ge lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa/ /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis par sbyar/ /yi ge lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ /thig les mgo la mnan par bya /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa dag /yi ge drug cu drug cu sbyar/ /phyi mo gnyis pa nyid kyang ni/ /yi ge drug cu bdun dang sbyar/ /gdug pa'i dngos grub kun 'grub cing / /sgrub pa po la dpal yang stsal/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi pa dang / /yi ge bdun cu pa dang sbyar / /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ /phyi mo yi ni bzhi pa yis/ /yi ge bdun cu gsum dang sbyar/ /bco ngalnga pa ni rab blangs te/ /dbyangs yig bcu bzhi pa dang ni/ /yi ge bdun cu bzhi par sbyar / /phyi mo'i bcu bzhi dag dang ni/ /yi ge bdun cu gsum dang sbyar/ /de bzhin bco 5lnga pa dang sbyar/ /dbyangs cikyi yi ge gnyis pa ni/ /yi ge bdun cu bzhi dang sbyar/ /phyi mo'i yi ge gnyis pa yang / /yi ge bdun cu bdun dang sbyar/ /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ /phyi mo yi ni gnyis pa yang — /yi ge bdun cu brgyad dang sbyar/ /thig le ciganyis kyis rnam par 77—968

brgyan/ /phyi mo yi ni gnyis pa yang / /yi ge bdun cu dgu dang sbyar/ /ma mo'i bzhi pa nyid dang ni/ /yi ge brgyad cu pa dang sbyar/ /thig les mgo la mnan par bya/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa dag kyang ni/ /yi ge bdun cu dgu dang sbyar /thig le sgra yis bskyed pa ste/ /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan/ / dbyangs kyi yi ge gsum pa dag /yi ge bcu drug pa dang sbyar/ /'og dang steng gi yi ge grangs/ /dgu bcu rtsa bdun bshad pa ste/ /'di ni rtsa ba'i gsang sngags su/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /dngos grub kyi ni gnas yin zhing / /mkha' 'gro'i snying ni 'joms pa na / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung ci rigs rgyal/ /bklags pas grub pa don yod pa/ /oṃ ni dang por sbyar bar bya / /sne hūṃ phaṭa ni mthar sbyar ba/ /'di ni rtsa ba'i gsang sngags te/ /grub pa thams cad grub byed yin/ /de nas rang gi bdag nyid kyi/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dra ba yi/ /'khor lo bde mchog yin par 'dod/ /byuhā gu raṃ ba sa la dzā gri gi tre ṭapha hūṃ snye ke ru ru he he dzrab rushrī tsho.oṃ / rig pa'i rgyal po'i snying po ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ṭa pha rgyu ༄ha ha griḥshā / /yi ge dang oṃ dang ni/ /yi ge mi dang hri nyid dang //snye dang phaṭa ces bshad pa yin/ /oṃ baṃ badzra bā rā hi/ ha oṃ 4ya mi ni / spyo mo tshamo ha ni/ sgro hro gas/ tsal ni / snye snye sa tā tshos ni/ phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇḍi ka /rnal 'byor ma ni drug tu bsgrags/ /re'u mig drug la rnam par bsgom/ /pa/ spya pa/ sdo /kā pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las go cha'i snying po sgom pa'i le'u ste lnga

de nas gzhan yang lha mo yi/ /snying po bla med bshad par bya/ /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa rī ye snye rgyu phaṭa su hā/ lha mo'i snying po'i spyor ba ni/ /bcu gsum pa ni bdag nyid dge/ /padma /dbus su phag mo ste/ /'dab ( ma la ni lha mo dgod/ /sgo bzhi dag gi phyogs su ni/ /lha mo'i snying po rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ las byung ba'i rta gdong dang / /rdo rje snying po gdug pa'i sgra/ /drag po yang ni g.yo ma dang —/ /mi 'phrog ma dang dri med ma/ /snye mdzad ma dang ldan lha mo/ / bsregs blugs rim dang phaṭa byed ma/ /rang byung snyim dang bcu gnyis te/ /ha mdzad g.yas pa'i gtso bo yin/ /rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad pa/ /sngo dang ser dang dmar ba dang / /ljang khu gesteng zhal dkar po ste/ /spyan gsum pa la bzhin rnam sgyur/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing thod phreng can/ /gsus pa rlo zhing skra grol ba/ /phyogs kyi gos can 'dzin pa ste/ /rang gi thabs dang sbyor bas gnas / /'jigs byed tsa muṇḍi mi'ajigs smos / /zhabs kyi 'og tu gnon pas bzhugs /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /mdung dang gri gug cang te'u dang / /rdo rje dril bu zhags pa dang / /lcags kyu tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / /dgra sta dang ni sdigs mdzub stodang / /na skyara'i pags tshapa steng du brkyang dku/ / ska rags dkudang ni dpung rgyan dang / /phyag rgya lnga yis marnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ /bugs rje khro gnyer 'jigs pa ste/ /'dab tshol lha mo thams cad dgod/ /ma mo dag ni brgyad pa ste/ /ser dang dmar dang ljang ba dang —/ /lho ni sngo ba'i mdog can te/ /me phyogs dmar la dud kha 7ste/ /sngo ba dang ni dkar ba dang / /dbang ldan du ni dgod pa ste/ /spyan gsum pa la spa 77—970

grol ba/ /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ / skyil spung /phyed pas legs par bzhugs / /thod pa yi ni dbu rgyan can/ /phyogs kyi gos can bzhin rnam sgyurari kyi / /thams cad yi dgas rigadan la bzhugs/ /thugs rje cachags pas rnam par myos/ /rdo rje'i mchog ni gar mdzad cing / /thod pa raktas bkang ba dang / /dril bu cang te'u sgra yang sgrogs / /lha rnams dga' bar byed pa yin / /sgo rnams su ni sgo srung ste / /dbang po'i steng du rnam par bzhugs/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /spyan gsum pa la dbu skra brdzes/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spud pa ste/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ ga( /rdo rje mgo bo phyag na bsnams/ /thams cad rnam sgyur tshogasus pa 'phyang / /thams cad mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /sngo dang ljang dang dkar po ste/ /sor zhing phyag bzhi mdog gnyis pa/ /gcer bu padma'i rgya yang che / /rang gi rigs kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thams cad rang thabs gnyis pa ste/ /bcu gsum pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /snying po mchog ni sgom pa yin/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu stsol/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las go cha dang lha mo'i snying po sgom pa bstan 7pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dgod pa ste/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub 'grub pa'o/ /sa yi cha ni mnyam yid 'ong / /tsandan gyis ni nye bar bsku/ /dri bzang studro ldan sa la ni/ /me rtog sil ma gcal dgram zhing / /spos kyi dri yis nyams dgar bya/ /bdag gi bya ba kun byas shing / /phyogs bcing ba ni 5byas nas su/ /de nas rdza rnga'i lta77—971

bcing byas te/ /re mig bzhi bcu dgu skum la/ /yi ge'i phyi mo dgod par bya /der gnas pa las dpa' bo ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub byed btu/ /rim bzhin 'byung dang rim min sa/ /dbyangs dang yi ge sgrub pos so/ /thub pa de lta'i grangs 'gyur las / /re'u mig sum cu gnyis pa blang / /lnga pa yis rini khyad par bya/ /brgya phyed phyed pa yang dag blang / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yis bye/ /re'u mig sum cu drug pa blang / /gsum pa yis ni khyad par dbye/ /de nas sum cu gnyis pa blang / /lnga pa yis ni khyad par bya/ /de nas nyi shu lnga pa gzung ca/ /nyi shu bzhi pa dag dang sbyar/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yang dag blang / /re'u mig bco lnga pa yir ldan/ /lnga pa dag dang yang dag bcas/ /de nas nyi shu gnyis pa gzung / /bcu gcig pa yang de bzhin no/ /mdzes pa mchog ni yin par 'dod/ /re'u mig gi ni bcu dgu pa/ /me yi bu dang yang dag ldan /re'u mig gsum par rnam par dbye/ /ya tshan 9brgyad po'i ngas bon skyal / /re'u mig sum cu drug pa dang / /yang dag ldan pa'i yi ger 'gyur/ /slar yang yi ge de dag nyid/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub byed yin/ /de nas rang byung blangs nas su/ /re'u mig la ni lnga par sbyar/ /spyi bor thig le dag dang sbyar/ /de nas nyi shu gnyis pa gzung rte/ /bcu gcig skupa yang de bzhin no /don kun grub byed ces bya ba'i/ /tshig ni gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /re'u mig bcu dgu pa nyid la/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun pa yis phye/ /gsum pa dag dang yang dag ldan/ /sum cu gsum pa legs blangs te/ /re'u mig ni gnyis par sbyar/ /nyi shu pa dang yang dag ldan/ /mdzes pa'i mchog ni yin par 'dod / /de bzhin nyi shu gcig chipa nyid/ /de bzhin nyi shu drug pa yin/ /77—972

lan gnyis bzlas pa'i tshig tu ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste btu/ /de nas go rims ri bzlog pas gzung / /re'u mig las ni dang po nyid/ /bzhi pa'i mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin bco lnga pa dang sbyar / /de nas nyi shu gnyis pa bzung / /bcu gcig pa yang de bzhin no/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa yi/ /tshig ni gsum pa yin par bshad/ /re'u mig gnyis pa'i sa bon dang / /re'u mig sum cu drug pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyi shu drug pa dang / /sum cu gsum pa yang dag blang / /re'u mig bcu gsum pa yir ldan/ /re'u mig las ni bcu pa nyid/ /go rims bzlog pa sgrub pos blang / /re'u mig las ni bcu dgu pa/ /re'u mig nyi shu gsum pa la/ /gnyis pa dag ni yang dag ldan/ /steng du thig les brgyan par bya/ /de nas chu yi sa bon gzung kṣ-i/ /brgyad pa yang ni de bzhin te/ /me yi bu yis khyad par dbye/ /yi ge snye phaṭa mtha' ru sbyar/ /'di ni khams gsum rgyal zhes bya/ /sngags tshig bzhi yis rnam brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ ni sku la gsal byed yin/ /rgyu dang phaṭa ni mtha' ru sbyar /rig rgyal 'khor lo sgyur ba'i sngags/ /'di ni ma byung 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de nyid bsdus dang dpal mchog dang / /bde mchog rdo rje 'jigs ngabyed du/ /khro bo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /sku brgyad dang ni bcas pa ru/ /dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i don du ni/ /gdug pa kun la khyad par du/ /'di ni rnyed pa tsam gyis kyang / /brtag mi dgos par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sha chen dag gis thams cad kun/ /rdo rje yang ni med par bshad/ /rnal 'byor thun mong brjod pa ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bskyed pa'o/ /oṃ su ni su lhu rgyu phaṭa / tshe gri ṇḍa gri tsā 7lhu : phaṭa/ oṃ gri : cipa ya gri smo 5pa ya sum̐ snye phaṭa/77—973

oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga ṭwāṃ /badzra lhu snye phaṭa/ 'di ni gdug pa thams cad du/ /'jigs byed mi bzad par bshad do/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi sa yi mchog /padma'i lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /rdo rje snye mdzad rnam par bsgom/ /gdug pa thams cad nges par gnon/ /phyag ni bcu drug yang dag ldan/ /zhal brgyad pa la bzhin rnam sgyur / /zhal gyi mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ /thams cad kun gyis rnam par spun/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phyag rgya drug /sku lus drag po cithugs rje'i nyams/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /dbang ldan gyi ni thod pa gnon/ /u mā mchog gi ku tsa gnon/ /khros pa'i spyan gyis rnam par gzigs / /sku la mgo yi do shal can/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba dbu la bcings/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya can/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal de bzhin te/ /lcags myu sdigs mdzub ru'aching tshob ste/ /dpral ba'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /thugs ka —dpral ba phyag rgya ste/ /bgegs 7ni rnam par gnon pa yin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /ral gri lcags kyu 'chang ba ste/ /mdung dang mgo bo cang te'u dang / /na zura'i pags 7pa'i steng du ste/ /phyag ni bcu drug de bzhin no/ /stag gi pags 5pa gos su mnabs / /rang rig gnyis med bde ba'i sku/ /sngo dang dkar dang ser ba dang / /dmar po de bzhin g.yon pa mdzes/ /dkar dang sngo dang ser ba dang / /steng gi zhal ni dmar po ste/ /spyan gsum pa la dmar ba'i spyan/ /khro bo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa dge/ /'don pa'i rdo rje rdo rje sngon/ /bskyod pa'i rdo rje nyid dang ni/ /mi g.yo ba yi rdo rje ste/ /sngo dang ljang dang dmar ba dang / /dud kha —ngur 77—974

smrig bsres pa ste/ /mche ( )ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis ni/ /bdud bzhi po ni rnam par gnon/ /na ra'i rus pas sku brgyan cing / /sna tshogs khro bo'i rigs kyang 'phro/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rdo rje sdigs mdzub ribarkyang ba ste/ /rang gi rig ri dang gnyis med 'khyud / /khro bo'i lta bas thugazigs mdzad cing //dril bu phyag mtshan yang dag ldan/ /'dzin pa'i phyag rgya 'ching ba ste/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal phyag rgya yis / /khro bo thams cad bcings pa yin/ /stag gi pags gepa gos su mnabs / /spyan gsum mi bzad tsa'ajigs pa ste/ /tho ba dbyug to mda' dang ni7/ /ral gri dril bu de bzhin te/ /yang na rdo rje dril bu dang / /thams cad khro bo'i rigs rjes 'gro/ /'khyud pa'i phyag kyang de bzhin te / /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /thams cad spyan gsum dngos grub mchog /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor dngos grub mchog dam pa/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag /yi ge'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya /oṃ su ni su lhu me phaṭa/ oṃ gri ṇḍa gri tsā lhu ma phaṭa/ oṃ gri : pa ya gri ‘ pa ya rtu cho phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga ṭwāṃ badzra lhu pa phaṭa/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mthong nas/ /thams cad bskyed par rnam par bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 7sbyor ba ste / /kha sbyar 4lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dkyil 'khor yin/ /snying po mchog gi sgom pa yin/ /de bzhin khyi dang phag gi sha/ /zangs kyi gtsug pud can de bzhin/ /mngon spyod kyi ni bya ba la/ /bza' dang sbyin sreg gtor ma bya/ /ma lus lus pa med 'grub locing / /rgyal srid thams cad rab 'grub ci'agyur/ /dung dang nya phyis gsu tig 77—976
