ste / /gsum char rgyu las byung yin na / /chos kyi ye shes lus can gyi / /thod pa la ni su zhig smod / /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba 'chang / /zla ba byed pas rgyan ridu byas/ /dpa' bo'i dpa' dbang yin par bshad/ /khrag 'thung ri rdo rje can rnam pa / /mngon par /brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las srung zub zhal bzhi par byin gyis brlabs pa khro bo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rdo rgyus kyis bris pa rdo rje hūṃ mdzad skyed pa'i le'u ste drug cu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sde tshan brgyad ni rnam sgom pa/ /mkha' dbyings padma'i dbus zloganas par/ /khrag 'thung rdo rje rnam par bsgom / /zhal lnga pa la phyag bcu pa/ /spyan gsum shin tu dmar ba ste/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis rmubazhugs/ /zhal rnam sgyur cizhing 'jigs pa ste / /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /thod pa'i phreng tshabs rnam par brgyan /drag po zla ba phyed pa 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes padabu la mnan/ /ral pa'i cod pan 'ching ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug gi mtshan gyis brgyan/ /stag gi pags 7pa gos su mdabs / /rig pa gnyis med bde ba'i nyams/ /sku la thod rlon dzodo shal can/ /thugs rje'i nyams kyis khyab par myos / /dkar dang sngo dang sprin gyi gzugs/ /sku ni sgeg cing ldem bag can/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal dag ni/ /ser dang dmar rtenang ljang ba dang / /dud pa yi ni mdog can no/ /rdo rje dril bus mnyam ldan pas/ /rang gi rig dang yang dag 'khril / /tshangs lpags 5bshus nas mnabs par mdzad/ /rgyab tu nges par 'dzin pa yin/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing / /mdung dang cang te'u

gri gug dang / /thod pa dag ni 'dzin pa ste/ /bcom ldan tpa hūṃ nges 'byung ba/ /'jigs byed rang gi chung mar bcas/ /zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par sbyar/ /shar 'dab /lha mor dgod pa ste/ /ji srid lho phyogs de bzhin te/ /me la sogs pa'ang dgod par bya/ /de srid dbang ldan sogs de bzhin/ /a riyi mkha' 'gro ma dang ni/ /ka yi mkha' 'gro ma de bzhin / /tsa yi mkha' 'gro ma dang ni/ /ṭa yi mkha' 'gro ma dag ste/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang / /sngo ba'i mdog can lho phyogs so/ /dmar dang dud kha ljang gu dang / /ser po dbang ldan yang dag gnas/ /ta yi mkha' 'gro ma dang ni/ /pa yi mkha' 'gro ma de bzhin/ /de nas ya yi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sha yi mkha' 'gro ma brgyad pa/ /de dag kun ni spyan gsum ste / /zhal gcig tshopa la phyag bzhi pa / /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po yi/ /rkang pa g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis gnon /rnam sgyur mche ba rnam gtsigs zhal/ /phyogs kyi gos mchog 'dzin pa ste/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /spa grol thugs rje khro bo bzhin/ /drag po yul 'khrug byed pa ste/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub byed yin/ /'gro ba thams cad smon 7byed de/ /thams cad ci 'dod rdzogs pa yin/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /dril bu cang te'u yis brgyan pa/ /sde tshan mkha' 'gro bde ba ste/ /'di dag rnal 'byor ma yis bsgom/ /yang na phag mo dgod bya ste/ /bdag mo yang ni gzhag 5par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag po ste/ /mkhas pas kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba dag /sa 'og sa steng rab tu 'khrug /oṃ āḥ ma ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha sum̐ hūṃ phaṭa / brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba'i bdag /ma lus ji snyed pa'adi yis 'grub/ /sde tshan mkha' 77—977

'gro dam pa mchog /bha ga'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /a sha/ tā kai/ tsam tsa ṭa ta pa ka /ta pa sa ta tha/ pa ba na rdza /yaṃ ma bha ha tsa/ shar bha tsa ta tha / sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas pa ni/ /rtag tu dus su 'di brgyad bza'/ /rgas dang na dang 'chi med par/ /skye ba 'di la dngos grub 'gyurari / /chang gi btung ba dang bcas pa/ /zos pa tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur/ /de ma rnyed na'ang sna lus bya/ /skye ba thubadun pa'i nang gnas shing / /rgyugs ni zas su rtag spyad na/ /skad cig gis ni mkha' spyod 'gyur/ /'di la yid gnyis dpyod pa med/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las lde tshan gyi sbyor ba'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis ga rda ba / /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor sngar bshad do/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs mkha' 'gro ni/ / ga rda ba 7yi gzugs su bya/ /phag mo'i gzugs ni de nyid kyang / /zhal ni garda ba 7ru bya/ /sngar bshad gnas dang phyag mtshan dang / /zhal ni gzhan yang rtogs par bya/ /sngar bshad mtshan ma'i rim pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni lag mdung thogs/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo thams cad kun/ /mkha' lding gdong ni 'jigs pa can/ /gsung gi 'khor lo rma bya'i gdong / /sku yi 'khor lo seng ge'i gdong / /khyi dang phag dang lug pa dang — /khā yi zhal gdong de bzhin te/ /zur la gshin rje sreg sogs kun/ /ma he ri dgas zhal gdong yin/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus can rnams kyang / /spya/ 7gsusdu /ga ni shin tu dmar/ /'di ni rnal 'byor mchog dam pa/ /sdug

bsngal thams cad zad par byed/ /rnal 'byor blo gros dngos grub dag /rnal 'byor mchog ni ster bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag dang / /ngag gi dngos grub rab tu ster/ /ma thos pa yi chos ston pas/ /sems can rnams ni srid las grol/ /bla na med pa nyid bstan pas/ /mi snang la sogs dngos grub 'gyur/ /su yang rung bas 'jig rten gsum/ /de kun de ma thag tu mthong / /sngar bshad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i/ /gsang sngags rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /mkha' 'gro ma mo de bzhin no/ /sngar bshad sngags kyi bdag po rnams / /bzlas na dngos grub rab ster zhing ri/ /rtag tu bde ba thams cad 'thob/ /rnal 'byor nye ri snying bzlas na ni/ /garda'i dngos grub mkha' la 'gro//brtul zhugs med pa'ang brtul zhugs 'thob/ /mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar 'gyur/ /dbul po'ang nor gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /nad yod pa yang nad med kyi'agyur /long ba yis kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob 'gyur / /bong bu'i sha dang rta sha dang / /khyi dang ba lang glang po mi/ /rnga mo ce spyang de bzhin te/ /brgyad po'ang /mnyam pa mchog yin no/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis de brgyad bza' / /dri chen chu dang sprang rtsi mar bsam gtan bsgoms te bza' byas nas/ /yang ba'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /gzugs yongs bsgyur ba'i dngos grub cing / /rang gi gzugs su'ang 'gyur ba yin/ /rnal 'byor gang dang gar gnas par/ /bza' ba yang ni bza' 'ibar bshad/ /'gro dang mi 'gro de bzhin te/ /btung zhing btung zhing dngos grub 'gyur/ / ma dang bu mo sring mo dang / /rang gi gnyen dang tsha mo dang / /blo ldan ji ltar 'dod pa yis/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya chen po 'grub/ /garda'i mkha' 77—979

'gro bsgoms na ni/ /myur du 'gugs pa'i dngos grub 'gyur/ //tshomachog 'di yang ni gsang ba ste/ /su la yang rini brjod mi bya/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las ji ltar 'dod pa'i bong bu'i mdzad pa dngos grub kyi rgyu sgrub pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi rirnam sgom pa/ /rigs las skyed cipa'i cho ga yin / /gdan dang phyag mtshan sa bon te/ /'di ni sa bon mchog gyur pa'o/ /nga nya ṇa na ma zhes pa/ /'di ni sa bon mchog grub pa/ / nga ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ /nya ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yin/ /ṇa ni rin chen mkha' 'gro ste / /na ni padma mkha' 'gro yin/ / ma ni sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/ /sumakha' 'gro lnga ni mchog yin te/ /zhe snang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /chags dang phrag dog de bzhin te/ /rigs ni lnga po 'di dag gis /'dod las grol ba'i 'bras bu stsol/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang / /padma ral gri lnga pa yin/ /sngo dang dkar ba nyid dang ni/ /ser dang dmar po ljang gu dang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya byang chub mchog /rin chen phyag rgya'ang de bzhin te/ /padma'i phyag rgya bzhi pa ste/ /ral gri'i /phyag rgya lnga pa yin/ /glang po seng ge rta dang ni/ /mi bya mkha' lding de bzhin te/ /khyab 'jug tshangs pa nyi ma dang / /dbang phyug che dbang po yang de/ /rang rig yan lag dang bcas pa /gnyis med bde bas yang dag gnas/ /shar dang sto dang nub dang ni/ /byang du yang ni de bzhin 'dir/ /dpa' bo'i 'khor dang bcas par dgod/ /lnga po yang dag lnga sangs rgyas/ /lnga po bdag nyid lnga yin no/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 77—980

'khor dbus su ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar du'o/ /lho dang nub dang de bzhin te/ /byang na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// /yang na dbus su zla ba ste/ /shar du yang ni nyi ma'i gdan/ /de dag dpa' bor gyur pa ste/ /'di lta ste/rdo rje thod pa dang / rdo rje mkha' mnyam dang / rdo rje snying po dang / rdo rje sra ba dang / bzhi po de dag ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor te/ glang po che'i gdan khri bya'o/ /rdo rje zla ba dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang / rdo rje sgra dang / de dag ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor te/seng ge'i gdan khri'o/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje srin ridang / rdo rje ṭa ha ra dang / rdo rje bzhad pa cadang / de dag ni rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor te / rta'i gdan khri'o/ /rdo rje me snyodapal dang / rdo rje 'joms pa dang —/ rdo rje sreg byed dang / rdo rje dri bral dang / de dag ni padma'i dkyil 'khor te / rma bya'i gdan khri'o/ /rdo rje ba dan dang / rdo rje glu dang / rdo rje dpa' bo dzodang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / de dag ni las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor te/ mkha' lding gi gdan khri'o/ /dpa' bo de dag kyang rang gi rigs dang / thod pa'i phreng ba can spyan gsum pa/ rang gi shes rab dang 'khyud pa/ rdo rje kyil mo krung gis yi dgas / kyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing rnam par 'gyur thab/ stag gi pags 7pa gos su mnabs zhes/ zhal gcig tshapa/ phyag bzhi pa/ thod pa dang mkha ṭwāṃ ga —'dzin pa/ cang te'u'i pasgra snye dang bcas pa/ mgo bo'i 7phreng ba'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ rang gi rigs kyi dbu rgyan can/ral pa dang zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i shar dkar po/ byang 77—981

ljang gu/ nub dmar po/ lho ser po/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i shar ser po/byang sngon po/ nub dkar po/ lho dmar po/ padma'i mkha' 'gro'i shar dkar po / byang ljang khu / nub sngon po/ lho ser po/ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i shar ljang gu / byang ser po/ nub dkar po/ lho sngon po/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i shar sngon po/ byang ljang gu / nub dmar po/ lho ser po —/ 'di dag ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang / /padma rin chen phreng ba yi/ /chas ni yongs su bskor bar bya/ / grwa bzhir ma mo bzhi bsgom ste / /ma mo rmongs byed ma dang ni/ /ma mo zhe snang nyid yin te/ /chags pa yi ni ma mo dang / /phrag dog ma mo de bzhin te/ / me yi tsho phyogs la sogs dzopar dgod/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar dang ljang / /spa grol ma la bzhin rnam sgyur / /spyan gsum pa la gcer bu ste/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin pa yin /phyag bzhi pa la zhal gcig 7pa/ /yi dgas ngagadan la rnam par bzhugs /dbang chen me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag tu gnas / /rigs kyi gdan la bzhugs pa yin/ /'khor lo rdo rje padma dang / /ral gri thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /gri gug yang ni phyag na 'chang / /ma ning las byung lha mo bsgom/ /thod pa yi ni phreng ba can/ / kyil mo krung pani byed pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje srung lab dang / rdo rje 'gying ba dang / rdo rje rta gdong dang / rdo rje dred gdong dang / rdo rje bde mchog dang / rdo rje dam tshig dang / rdo rje rta mchog ste / khro bo'i rgyal po de dag ni/ /sgo rnams dang ni mtshams su ste / /sngo dang ljang dang dmar ser po/ /dmar dang sngo dang dud kha 0dkar/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog ri dang / /dril bu thod pa 77—982

kha ṭwāṃ ga /cang te'u yang ni de bzhin te/ / tho ba dbyug tho /mdung dang ni/ /dgra sta thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /mgo bo phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /dbu spa dmar ser gyen du brdzis / /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin pa ste//stag gi pags capa gos su mnabs / /thod pa yi ni phreng ba 'chang mgo bo'i do shal rnam par brgyan/ /nyi ma padma'i steng du ni/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /phyogs skyong brgyad kyi khri la bzhugs/ /mche ba rnam gtsigs rnam sgyur zhal/ /spyan gsum rang rigs cod pan can/ /rang gi rig dzo dang gnyis med sbyor/ /snying rje yi ni nyams can te/ /phyi rol rdo rje yi dgas tekyis/ /yongs su bskor bar bsgom par bya/ /thog mar gsal byed ming dang rghaṃ/ /mtha' ru phaṭa dang sbyar bar bya/ /sngar bshad cho ga'i srung ba bya'o/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /lus ngag yid la tshabasgom par bya/ /mkha' 'gro zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis/ /rang gi mtshan ma dril bu yis/ /gnyis su med par mnyam par ldan/ /mdung dang lcags kyu mthod pa dang / /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang mgo bo dang / /cang te'u dang ni gri gug dang / /na chara'i pags papa 'dzin pa yin/ /sngo dang ser dang dmar ljang gul/ /dud kha 7dang ni dkar ba dang / /dkar dang sngo dang ser dmar dang / /ljang dang thal ba'i mdog lta bu'o / /ser dang sngo dang dkar ba dang / /dmar dang ljang gu snyepadma'i mdog /dmar dang dkar dang sngon po dang / /ser dang ljang dang nam mkha'i mdog /ljang dang dkar dang dmar ba dang / /sngo dang ser dang dkar ba'i mdog /de dag mkha' 'gro lnga yi ni/ /zhal mdog gi ni khyad par yin/ /yang na zhal gcig 7phyag gnyis bsgom/ /phreng ba'i gsang sngags ming dang bcas/ /77—983

mkhas pas zur bzhi mtshams nas so/ /mthar ni lhu rgyu phaṭa dang sbyar/ / oṃ ma hā su kha badzra nge ka hūṃ/ ḍā ki rī dzā la si ba ra āḥ phaṭa su hā/ oṃ ma hā su kha bu ḍā ka myu ḍā ki gli dzā la si ba ra āḥ phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ ma hā su kha ratna ḍā ka hre ḍā ki rī dzā la si bar āḥsnyi phaṭa gu hā/ oṃ ma hā su kha padma ḍā ka griḥ ki rī dzā la si ba ra āḥ/ phaṭa su hā/ oṃ ma hā su kha bi shwa ḍā ka khaṃ spre ki rī dzā la /ba ra aḥ phaṭa su hā/ de dag ni mkha' 'gro lnga'i snying po'i gsang sngags te/ 'di ni ye shes kyi snying por 5gyur pa yin no/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ka nge ཿ phaṭa / oṃ bu ḍā ka nye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna ḍā ka ṇi snye phaṭa/ oṃ padma ḍā ka rna snye phaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ka me snye phaṭa/ ye shes dam tshig ro gcig pa/ /mkhas pas bsgom par byas nas su / /dam tshig gis ni legs dbang bskur/ /sna tshogs mchod pa rnam par bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyang / /go 'phang dran nas dbang yang bskur/ /sna tshogs phun sum tshogs pa'i mchog /de bzhin 'khyud dang tsum na/ /bha ga ling ga'i sbyor ba dag /ye shes rnam smin dpa' ba'i mchog /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya drug /rnam par blta tshozhing nges par brtag /dga' ba dang po ye shes te/ /mchog tu dga' ba mnyam par sbyor/ /bde bar dga' bar grub pa che/ /lhan gcig skyes dga' bla med yin/ /sbyor ba dang ni shin tu sbyor/ /sbyor ba che dang ye shes sbyor/ /de dag cho ga'i rim pa'o /thig le'i gzhung gi sbyor shes na/ /phra ba'i sbyor bas blta bar bya/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyu/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi go 'phang thob/ /cho ga nges par bsgrubs nas ni/ /myur du rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub/ /'di ni nges pa kho na'o/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las gsang ba'i ye 77—984

shes kyi le'u ste drug cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /thugs kyi snying po mchog gyur pa/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /ye shes zla ba rnam par bsgom/ /a /yi yi ge las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /kha ba kunda'i mdog lta bu/ /dag pa'i shel dang mtshungs pa'o/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhi ba ste / /spyan gsum pa la thugs rje'i mnyam / /sna tshogs padma ci dbus bzhugs/ /stong pa'i ye shes las byung ba/ /zla ba phyed pa ral pa 'ching / /thod pa yi ni dbu rgyan can/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /rang gi lus dang sbyor bar gnas/ /snying rje chags dang mngon gyur pa/ /dkar zhing sngo la dmar ba'i zhal/ /rnam thar gsum gyi rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /lha mo'i mchu ni rnam 'tshir te/ /rdo rje mdung dang thod pa dang / /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin/ yi ge āḥtshodang nyi dbus bzhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' tsharnam par bsgom/ /i las rdo rje zla ba ste/ /khri las rdo rje sgyu 'phrul lo/ /e las chos kyi rdo rje ste/ / 7las sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul ma/ /lha mo bzhi po de dag ni/ /de yi zhal mdog 'dzin pa'o/ /spa grol ba la mig po che/ /snying je chags pas parnam par myos/ /rang gi thabs dang lhan cig bcas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs yi dgas 7steng du bsgom/ /gtso bo shes rab kyil —mo krung dku/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bus mnyam par ldan/ /mdung dang gri gug phyag na bsnams/ /thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 77—985

'dzin cing / /dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ /ji ltar dpa' bo'i rnal 'byor bzhin/ /de yi mdog dang phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /lha mo bzhi yi kha sbyar gsang — /snying po sbyor ba mchog yin no/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /gsang /ba kun gyi mchog de nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po mchog /gsang ba'i ye shes dam tshig ste/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin/ /mu ni snying khar bsgom pa ste/ /u ni mgo bor de bzhin no/ /o ni spyi gtsug dag tu ste/ /ma cani mig tu dgod par bya/ /i ni go char dgod pa ste/ /aḥni mtshon du rnam par dgod/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsgom par gnas/ /ye shes dam tshig sbyor ba yis/ /bla med mchod dang dbang yang bskur/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis/ /chos kyang de bzhin mnyam pa yin / /dngos po kun ni ro gcig neste/ /gnyis su med pa'i mchog grub pa/ /dam tshig thun mtshams bzhin du ste/ /dus bzhi dag tu rnam par bsgom/ /kha sbyor bzhi yi sbyor ba ni /thun bzhi la ni rnam par bsam/ /snying rjes kun la 'gro bya zhing / /cha med par ni rnam par bsgom/ /thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /shes rab cha med rjes su 'gro/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug sbyor/ /bdag nyid rdo rje bdag po yin/ /bgrang du med pa'i rus pa yin/ /ye shes bzlas pa yin par bshad /bzlas pa ye shes bsgom pa ste/ /sprul pa drug ni spro ba'o/ /de bas dam tshig bzlas pa ni / /cho ga bzhin du bzlas pa bya/ /la aḥ.a a i zhi u lca/ e i/ meyo/ i aḥme su hā/ dung chen phreng ba blangs nas ni / /rtag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /dag byed bsod nams chen po ste/ /77—986

dge zhing nyes pa 0'joms pa yin/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms byed cing —/ /dge ba kun gyi 'bras bu ste/ /gsang sngags kun gyi ston pa ste/ /rnam par dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po yi/ /dgyes pa'i bde ba las byung ba/ /lha mo bzhi po dga' ba ste/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog tu bde/ /rigs kyi bde ba bcom ldan 'das/ /rang byung rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las lha mo bzhi'i gsang ba kha sbyor gyi le'u ste drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas sbyor ba'i mchog bshad pa/ /gdug pa thams cad za byed pa/ /ma rungs phyi dang nang 'joms pa/ /nam mkha' stong pa lta bu las/ /yi ge kṣa las mngon byung zhing / /mkha' 'gro'i dra ba bde mchog ni/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig ripa/ /spyan gsum pa la 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /g.yas brkyang pa yis gyubazhugs pa la/ /ma rungs bdud kyi dgra gnon cing / /phyag rgya chen po mnyam ldan pas/ /thod pa dril bus yang dag 'khyud / /thod pa'i dbus su yid 'ong ba'i/ /rdo rje mchog gis rnam par mtshan/ /ye shes bdud rtsis yongs gang ba/ /lag pa g.yas par bzhag tshonas ni/ /sna tshogs pa yi sku lus la/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku yang brgyan/ /zhal gdong mche ba rnam gtsigs ngashing /spyi gtsug 7thod pas rgyan du byas/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan/ /zla ba phyed pa ral pa 'chang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sgom pa yin/ /dogs pa rnam par spangs shing yongs su dag pa'i blos / /rnam par rtog 5pa'i dri skuma'i khyad par med par byed/ /byams dang 77—987

snying rje'i rgyan gyis lus la rgyan 〉du byas/ /'dzem med bde ba'i rnal 'byor legs par bslabs pa'i bdag /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dud 'gro'i hūṃ dur khrod chen po na/ /ro langs srin po risna tshogs sgra rnams sgrogs sa par byed/ / dze gyi sgra byed pa yi 'jigs pas khyad par byed/ /gzhan yang sgrub po ri rnal 'byor mthun pa'i yul du bsgrub / /yang na zhal ni bzhi pa dang / /'di la phyag brgyad rnam par bsgom/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar ser po/ /zhal dag bsgyur zhing 'jigs par thamadzad/ /mdung dang rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga /cang te'u mgo bo gri gug thogs/ /sna tshogs phyag la bskyod pa'i ljags/ / ha hā nyi tī lhu snye dang ska/ /phaṭa ces bya ba'i sgra sgrogs shing la/ /dpa' bo gcig 5phu 'jigs mdzad pas / /gdul dka' thams cad 'dul mdzad cing / /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo'i sprin ni mkhas pas spro/ /bsam gtan dga' ba bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /khro bo yi ni sku ru bsgrub / /dam tshig bza' zhing bzlas pa bya/ /dam tshig kha sbyar byas nas bzla/ /mnyam par gnas shing bzlas nas su/ /chos rnams ma lus bsgom par bya/ /oṃ akṣa snye phaṭa/ srid gsum sdig pa zad byed cing / /mtshams med lnga yang zad par byed / /sdug bsngal thams cad zad byed cing / /srid pa dag kyang sbyong bar byed/ /sbyor ba yi ni mchog dam pa/ /bkrags 0tsam gyis ni nges par 'grub/ /gdug cing gnod byed sems can dang / /ma rungs las la chags pa dang / /log par lta dang bcas pa las/ /'di dag nges par bza' bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sprul ba'i rgyan rnams spro/ /khams gsum dag ni sgrol bar byed/ /sngags pas sngags kyi mchog de ni/ /ming dang bcas pas lhan cig bzla/ /oṃ phaṭa che ge mo bha kṣa 77—988

ya phaṭa/ kṣaḥ/snye phaṭa/ bdag nyid khro bo'i sems kyis ni/ /āoṃ sa bza' zhing gcer bu dang / /skra grol ro la mnan pa dang / /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag gis 'dzin/ /gsang sngags cho ga bzhin du ni/ /khri phrag stong du bzla zhing bsgom/ /rnal 'byor cho ga bzhin du ni/ /khams gsum po dag gsod ripar 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni 'khor bcas pas/ /bza' bar yang ni rnam par bsam /bdag nyid rdo rje khab thogs pa'i/ /khro bo snying du gzhug cipar bya/ /snying dang rgyu ma rkang dang rus/ /sha dang khrag rnams 'dral byed cing / /mtshams med lnga rnams byed pa dang / /gdug pa can rnams bza' bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro lte bar bzhugs nas ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lhan cig sbyor/ /rdo rje blo ldan rab sbyor bas/ /zhag bdun gyis ni phebs par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan byas pa tsam gyis ni/ /gdug pa bdag gis zos par 'gyur/ /nyi ma phyed dang mtshan byed dang / /las 'di dag la 'jug par bya/ /gcer bu skra grol byed pa yis/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su kha bltas te/ /khyim bya'i stan gyi sbyor ba yis/ /me yi gsang sngags bzla bar bya/ / phaṭa rdu me ro ro/mtshams med pa 'di tshozhes bya ba/ /re re re hūṃ phaṭa/ ji bzhin bzlas pa byas tsam dzogyis/ /nyid zhag bcu bzhi 7dag gis ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon sum pa'ang —/ /'chi bar yang ni the tshom mumed/ /gal te sdig can slar log na/ /'di la zhi ba'i las rnams bya/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa cher byas nas/ /'dis kyang zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /oṃ su hā/ a ā nga a mu kai 5pa pa gri ter ho — bha bi 5gyi 7) ta su/ si ba shārnyi bha bskyo / bee i aḥs gu hā/ 'o ma btung gzhing gos dkar gyon/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis stong nyid gnas/ /dkar 77—989

po'i 〉dri yis lus byug go/ /bya rog khyi dang byi la dang / /na ku la yi sha rnams bza'/ /thams cad rab tu gnas gyur te/ /'di la yid gnyis dpyod pa med/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las khro bo rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bdag po'i kha sbyar gnon pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /srid pa'i dang na skye ba bdun/ /sna tshogs pa shu'i dam tshig ni/ /lha yi gzugs can yid 'phrogs pa/ /lha yi gzugs can gzi brjid dpal/ /ba shu'i dang na rgyal po yin/ /skal bzang yid 'ong bde bar 'gro/ /spa yi myu tshog de bzhin ring / /mig ni dkyus ring mig kyang dmar/ /padma'i 'dab rnam 'dra ba'i gzugs/ /de yi lus la rdul zhim 'byung / /lus las lha yi dri 'byung zhing / /kha yi dbugs ni ga bur dri /ldan pas sbrang ma rtag tu 'khor/ /gcin dang phyi sa gla rtsi bro / /tshig ni ci'ajam par gyur pa cidang / /lag pa dang ni rkang pa 'jam/ /utpa la yi dri dang ldan/ /spa dkar gnyer ma las rnam grol/ /lus kyang snum zhing mnyen —pa dang — /snying dang thod pa lte ba ste/ /des na ro tsa na ru 'gyur/ /grib bdun ngang pa'i 'gros su 'gro/ /snying rje'i bsam pa can yin te/ /dkon mchog gsum la rtag tu dad/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims dag dang ldan/ /'di 'dra rnal 'byor pas rtogs na/ /mi gsod me yis tshig mi 'gyur/ /srog chags sna tshogs gdug 7pa dag /gang yang rung bas /caza mi nus/ /de ni tshomatshan mo mi mthong ste/ /mi snang ba yi dbang phyug mchog /'di 'dra sngags pas rtogs —nas ni/ /bdag gis blangs te sbyin pa spyad/ /dri chen chu dang byang chub sems//77—990

mkhas pas blangs te ril bu bya/ /lcags gsum gyis ni rnam dkris te/ /blo dang ldan pas bsgrub par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni rab sbyar nas/ /nye ba'i snying po lan 'bum bzlas / /de 'di lag tu byin nas ni/ /sbyin pa 'di las bdag la byin/ /de 'di de ma thag tu yang / /mi bskyod pa yi bya ba rnyed/ /de ni dben par khyer nas su/ /mnyam par bzhag ste bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan yang las rnams rab bshad bya/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i mchog dam pa/ /de yi spyi bo'i spa bcad nas/ /gzhan yang dud 'gro'i spu dang ni/ /de bsres 0the gur byas nas su/ /gang gi mgul du bcings tshobyas pas/ /de 'dra ba yi gzugs su 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyang byed pa yin/ /de yi pags 9pa blangs nas ni/ /de la nye ru ka dpal bri/ /mngon sum khro bo'i dngos grub ni/ /he ru ka dpal byed pa yin/ / rkang lag pags —pa blangs nas ni/ /'byung po'i skra dang bcas bsres nas/ /phye tshoma'i ril bur 7byas nas su/ /mngon par bsngags te cho ga bya/ /mkhas pas rgyal gyi nyi ma la/ /lcags gsum gyis —ni rnam dkris nas/ /lag pa g.yon pas de blangs te/ /the pabong sbas pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /khu tshur de ni mgor bzhag na/ /de ma thag tu rkun ma rengs/ /rang gi tshalag gis dpung gnyis blangs/ /rang skra zhags pa blangs nas thogs/ /g.yas pa lcags kyu thogs nas ni/ /the gu lnga yis rnam par dkri / /phyogs gar nor gyis gang ba yi/ /de yi phyogs mthong blang bar bya/ /khyim du bkod cing steng 'dug nas/ /sngags bzlas nas ni mkha' la spyod/ /oṃ dzaḥ a phroṃ ba snye ba sne a ba rā na du 5khe tsa ri dza ri 'iḥ swā hā/ nor dang 'bru dang de bzhin gos/ /yid la gang 'dod ci yang rung / /de dag thams cad myur du 77—991

'gugs / /khyim ni gang bar yongs su mthong / /ṅgā /sa dag ni zos nas su/ /lha yi lus su 'gyur ba yin/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje'i lus gyur te/ /des ni shi ba dbang du 'gyur/ /chu ba cho ga bzhin blangs nas/ /spa dang bsres nas de bsgril cite/ /the gu cho ga bzhin du ni/ /bsgril nas zhags pa dag tu bya/ /g.yas brkyang gnas shing khro gnas par/ /gang gi ming gi bzlas brjod kyis/ /zhags pa btab na de ma thag /lha mo 'gugs shing de mdun gnas/ /de yi rus pa'i phye ma yis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /'di la dkyil 'khor dngos grub ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni de la gnas/ /gzhan yang rgyan du byed pa dang / /rdo rje mtshan gyis mdzes par bya/ /chu ba dag gis mchod phyir thogs /de ru bdar ba'i tsandan gyis/ /byugs pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ni / /mkha' la spyod par 'gyur ba yin/ /sgrub pa til mar chen po yi/ /mig sman nges par byas nas ni/ /grib ma yang ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor zhag gis bskus na ni/ /mtshan mo'ang nyid par lta bur 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor rkang dag zos nas ni/ /tshim par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /ji srid gnas par mi bkres 4shing / /yid gzhungs dran pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor sngon gyi skye ba dran/ /rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyu ma phye mar byas nas su/ /mkhas pas grib ma la yang bskam / /gang gis mgo la gzhag ’pa na/ /de ma thag tu dbang du 'gugs/ /sngags pas glo ba zos na ngani/ /de ma thag tu nad med 'gyur/ /rkang pa blangs nas sar bsnun na/ /char gyi rgyun ni 'bebs par byed/ /blo ldan gsang ba blangs nas bskama'i/ /tsandan dmar po dang bsres nas/ /de ni phye mar byas nas su/ /bud med gang la byin 77—992

na ni/ /'dod pas gdungs pa'i bud nyamed gang / /dbang du gyur te mngag gzhug byed/ /pus mo'i rus pa tī la ya/ /sor ni ribacu gnyis tshad tsam zhig /gang gi ming bcas sbas pa yis/ /de yi rigs brgyud med par 'gyur//rnal 'byor dzi hwa zos na ni/ /ngag gi dngos grub dag tu 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dzo da zos na ni/ /sems ni thub pa nyid du 'gyur/ /so yi rgyal po bzhi po dag /steng 'og dag ni blangs nas kyang / /bung ba yi ni gshog pa dang //tshub ma'i 'dab dzom rdul dang ni/ /rdul 'dis bsgrub —pa byas na 7ni/ /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu rmongs/ /rtsa 5rnams phye mar byas pa yi/ /bud med thams cad skams 7par 'gyur/ /rang byung me tog ro tsa na/ /a lag ta dang gur gum —gyis / /thig le sngags pas sbyar na ni/ /'khor los sgyur ciba'ang dbang du 'gyur /rnal 'byor mig 'bras phye ma yis/ /pha rol sde ni 'byed par 'gyur / /—nu ma zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /de ma thag tu 'o ma 'gugs/ /rnal 'byor mtshan ni zos tsam gyis/ /bud med sa bon mod la 'gugs/ /rnal 'byor so dang sen mo gyes/ /gang dang cigang gis mgo la gtor/ /grub pa brgyad po 'grub pa yin/ /pha dang bu ni yin na yang / /rnam par snang bar byas par 'gyur/ /mchu phyer 4byas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /kha ni gnon par 'gyur ba yin/ /sna phyer byas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dbugs ni gnon par 'gyur ba yin /rna ba'i sbyor bas 'on par 'gyur/ /mgo bo'i pags pas mngon btags 5te/ /kha yi drung du mngon bzlas na/ /lha rnams kun gyi gtso bor 'gyur / /thod pa yi ni sbyor ba yis/ /rakta ca'agugs par byed pa yin/ /thod pa kha ni sgrub pa yisarsā/ /gnod par byas pa kho na yin/ /ind+ra ba ru ro tsa na/ /77—99 3

de gnyis gcig /tu bsres byas nas/ /gang la jig le gcig gyur na/ /dbang po'i gnas ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /ro tsa na dang myang spras dag /lhan cig tu ni byugs pa yis/ /thub pa med pa'i stobs 'gyur te/ /pha rol dag ni gnon par 'gyur/ /pu tran dza li ro tsa na/ /lhan cig tu ni phyer byas nas/ /bud med gang la phyes gtor na/ /de ni 'dod pas myos gyur nas/ /ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du gnas/ /ro tsa na dang pu tras gnyis/ /lhan cig tu ni bskus pa yis/ /'byung po kun dang 'byung mo rnams/ /ci bgyi zhes ni smra bzhin du/ /de yi drung du 'khod par 'gyur/ /ci 'dod pa dag ster bar 'gyur/ /ro tsa na dang dzi ban ti / /lhan cig tu ni phyer byas te/ /shi ba'i mig dang mig sman sbyar /bskal par gnas kyi bar du ni/ /'tsho bar yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /chu srin lag ni ro tsa na/ /lhan cig tu ni byer byas nas/ /nā ga ma do /lhan cig tu/ / ril bu dzodag tu byas nas kyang / /rdo rje gzi brjid dang bsres nas /mig gi sman ni byas gyur na/ /nor skyong gi ni glang po yang mngon sum du ni gnas nas kyang / /de la bdag gis zhon na ni/ /glang chen 'khor ni mang po dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol sde ni 'joms 2byed cing / /gzhan gyi yul la dbang byed pa'i/ /ci 'dod pa ni ster bar 'gyur / / bras gludaṇḍi char tsa ni/ /lhan cig tu ni sbyor ba yis/ /rig 5byed rgol dzib med par 'gyur/ /rma bya'i —mkhris pa'i ro tsa na/ /ri bong khrag dang lhan cig tu chi/ / ril bu rtag 0tu bsgrubs byas nas/ /rma bya'i mjug 5mas bcings na ni/ /bung ba bzhin du 'phur 'gyur te/ /lha rnams 'gugs pa'i dngos grub cing / /rig pa 'dzin pa thongs par 'gyur/ /de yi lan ni 77—994

'ga' tsam gyis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa ster bar 'gyur/ /lha yi gzhal med khang 'phrog cing / /lha yi bu mo'ang 'gugs par 'gyur/ /'dod na dbang du sdod byed cing / /mi 'dod sems can don yang byed/ /mjug :ma thur bltas byas na ni/ /gter rnams kyang ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /blangs pas sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin/ /sa 'og gter gyi sgo dag la// mjug ma skor ba byas na ni/ /sgo dbye bas ni 'jug par bya/ /lha min bu mo lhan cig rol/ /lha yi bcud dang bcud kyis len/ /'phrog cing des ni zos gyur te/ /'dod pa'i lha yi rigazugs su 'gyur/ /grub pa'i rdzas ni blangs pa yis / /sems can don rnams byed cing 'gro/ /de nas yan lag lnga pa yi / /cho ga dag tu 'gyur ba ni/ /spu dang pags pa sha dang ni/ /rus pa rkang pa blangs nas su/ /dri chen chu dang shu kra dang / /mtshal rnams dag ni lhan cig tu / ril bu byas nas bsgrub par bya/ /lcags gsum gyis ni rnam dkris nas / /kha yi nang du sbas na ni/ /nam mkha' la ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ro tsa na dang lhan cig tu/ /khams gsum du ni rgyal chen /'gyur/ /mngon par // ༵ pa'i dru /da pa sdi ma'i bla ma las skye ba bdun pa'i phyugs chen sgrub —pa'i le'u ste de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rang gi chos kyi yid sgom pa/ /rang gi chos kyi yi ger sbyor/ /bdag med chos ni yang dag bsgom/ /rang chos yi ge mchog dga' ba/ /chos kyi dzosku lus rang byung yin/ /yi ge he las nges byung 5ba /nye ru ka ni —rnam par bsgom/ /yi ge hi las nges byung cib/ /rdo rje 77—995

mkha' 'gro rnam par bsgom/ /hūṃ gi ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje snye mdzad rnam par bsgom/ /hūṃ gi yi ge las byung ba/ /mi bskyod pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /bee gyi ye shes las bskyed pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ : oṃ : /las byung ba/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rnam par bsgom/ / me ṭwāṃ ro swa las byung ba/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro rnam par bsgom/ / hri hro a las nges 'byung ba/ /padma'i mkha' 'gro rnam par bsgom/ /khaṃ ho ha carta las byung ba/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro rnam par bsgom/ /ḍā las mkha' 'gro ma nyid do / /yo las rnal 'byor ma de bzhin/ /: las lha mo sa la spyod/ /bee las mkha' la spyod 0pa yin/ /mi las ma mo nyid yin te/ /dpa' bo'i btsun mo snyan grags ma /te ni thugs kyi gtso bo ste/ /ru las ngag ni byung ba yin/ /ka ni lus kyi rdo rje ste/ /yig gsum las byung he ru ka /mi las 'jam pa'i rdo rje ste/ /si las kun tu bzang po yin/ /lo las 'jig rten mgon po ste/ /kṣiṃ /las sa yi snying ngo 'o/ / las phyag na rdo rje ste/ /me ngalas byams pa nyid yin te/ /khaṃ las nam mkha'i snying por grags/ /gi las nam mkha'i mdzod yin no/ / las sgrib pa kun sel ba/ /gi rtelas spos kyi glang po yin/ /sgro skalas ye shes tog —kyang yin/ /i cilas blo gros mi zad —pa/ /pre las spobs pa brtsegs cipa ste/ /si dzolas ngan song kun 'dren pa/ /si sgrolas ngan song kun 'joms pa /dzi las dra ba can gyi 'od/ /rtsa 5las zla ba'i 'od yin te/ /re las byung ba'i rin chen 'od/ /snyi —las nyi ma'i 'od yin no/ /bai rilas rdo rje 'od kyang yin/ /mi 4las mthu chen thob pa ste/ /sum̐ ni su dha na yin no/ /bee snyolas bzang skyong nyid yin te/ /si las blo gros rgya mtsho'o/ /kun tu bzang 77—996

po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'jig rten mgon po sa snying po/ /phyag na rdo rje byams pa dang / /nam mkha'i snying po nam mkha' mdzod/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / /spos kyi glang po nyid yin te/ /mi zad pa dang ye shes tog /spobs pa brtsegs pa mchog yin te/ /mya ngan kun 'joms nyid yin no/ /ngan song kun 'dren nyid dang ni/ /dra ba zla ba rin chen dang / /nyi ma rdo rje 'od mchog ste/ /su dha na dang rin chen thob/ /rgya mtsho dang ni bzang skyong ngo / /de dag sngon nyid grub pa ste/ /phreng ba'i gsang sngags rnam par sbyar/ /de dag dam tshig tu bshad de/ /dngos grub kyi ni grub pa stsol/ /rdo rje pho nya ma nyid dang —/ /skul byed dang ni rin chen sgron/ /rdo rje nyi ma de bzhin te/ /ro langs rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ /kai po dzi dang de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ma de bzhin/ /ye shes sgron dang rdor 'jigs ma/ /ye shes sgron dang rgyal byed ma /sgrol ma dang ni gos dkar mo/ /spyan dang mā ma tī mchog dang / /rgyal mtshan so sor 'brang ma dang / /rma bya dang ni ri khrod ma/ /lu gu rgyud dang phyir zlog ma/ /lha mo gtsug tor rdor 'jigs ma/ /sngon grub pa yi lha mo ste/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad stsol/ /gsal byed ming dang bcas par ni/ /mthar dzoni sne phaṭa sbyar bar bya/ /mtha' tshamar gu hā mnyam par sbyar/ /sngags kyi dngos grub rab tu spyol/ /gshin rje'i gshed dang rta mchog rgyal/ /bgegs ni gnon par mdzad pa yin/ /shes rab mthar byed bzhi po ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub rtebyed yin/ /'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che/ /brgyad par mi g.yo grags pa ste/ /khro bo chen po sngon grub pa/ /gdug pa thams cad nges par gnon/ /dkar mo sogs dam tshig lha mo/ /khrag 'thung lha mo 77—997

brgyad pa yin/ /sngar bshad mkha' 'gro ma rnams te/ /khro bo brgyad tsa dang gnyis med gnas/ /rtsa ba'i brgyad dang ldan pa'i sngags/ /ming dang yang dag sbyar bar bya/ /gsal byed oṃ ni kun du yang / /mthar ni rghaṃ phaṭa swā hār sbyar/ /gsal byed ming dang snye dang ni/ /mthar ni phaṭa dang swā ri hār sbyar/ /gzugs dang sgra yi lha mo dang / /dri dang ro yi lha mo ste/ /'dab ma bzhi la rnam par sbyar / /phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ma/ /reg pas reg pa'i rdo rjer grags/ /gnyis su med par yang dag gnas/ /dbus su khrag 'bung /rgyal po ni/ /lha mo'i reg pas bde bar bzhugs/ /snying po chos kyi dbyings su grags/ /shes rab pha rol phyin las byung / /ye shes sems dpa' gnyis med bzhugs/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbyings ma ste/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ye shes ni/ /chos kyi dbyings de mi dmigs pa'o/ /de ni gsang ba de nyid mchog /rdo rje can ni yang dag stol/ /che ba'i mchog ni 'dus pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /sbyor ba rgyud kyi rjes 'brang ba / /bgrod dang bgrod min rnal 'byor ma /rig pa'i rgya mtsho mchog yin te/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro nyung zad cig /sgyu 'phrul sdom pa'i rgyud yin no/ /rnal 'byor ma ni 'byung ba'i rgyud/ /gsang ba'i rgya mtsho rgyud yin te / /nges brjod rgyud ni bla med pa/ /'dus pa mchog ni bshad pa yin/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i khyad par gyis/ /sems can rjes su gzung ruba'i rgyur/ /'dus pa mchog gi dam pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'bras bu ster / /rigs ni rnam pa lnga bshad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' du ma dag /ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar ni/ /bdag po nyid du bya ba yin/ /ji ltar ming tshagi rjes mthun rnapar/ /nges brjod rgyud kyi rim pa dag /rdo rje sgrub pa 77—998

po yis ni/ /nges brjod rgyud kyi las rnams bya/ /yid kyis dogs pa kun spangs te/ /gnyis su med pa'i sgom pa nyid/ /theg pa chen po'i dam pa mchog /dngos grub che dang ldan par 'gro/ /de nas phyag mtshan mchog bshad bya /gzugs dang mdog gi cho ga'i rim/ /yi ge ho /las nges 'byung ba/ /bdag nyid he ru kur bsgom bya/ /sku lus dkar la drag shul che/ /mche ba rnam gtsigs 'jigs pa ste/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal lnga pa/ /phyag drug zhabs ni bzhi pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /ral pa zla phyed dbu la bcings / /sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku lus brgyan /stag gi pags pa gos su mdabs / /mgo po'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu cisteng zhal sngo ba'o / /bzhad dang dpa' dang sgeg pa dang / /rngam dang zhi dang drag po ste/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pas/ /rdo rje reg pas gnyis med gnas/ /rgyal ba'i pags pa mchog kyang 'dzin/ /bde ba kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /rdo rje mdung ni phyag mchog ste/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /bdud bzhi po ni /zhabs 'og gnon/ /reg —pa'i rdo rje ljang ba dang —/ /dkar ba'i mdangs kyi gzugs can la/ /ljang dang ser dang dmar ba dang / /dkar ba'i g.yon pa'i zhal gdong ste/ /steng gi zhal gdong sngo la 'jigs / /skra grol ba ni rnam par myos/ /seng ge'i rnam grol phyag rgya can/ /byin pa gnyis ni legs par 'khril/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /spyan gsum shin tu dmar ba ste/ /rdo rje thod par mnyam par ldan/ /dril bu cang te'u yis brgyan/ /mdung dang kha ṭwāṃ phyag na bsnams/ /chags pa chen po 77—999

me yi 'od/ /phyogs kyi gos can zhi ba'i nyams/ /gdul dka' thams cad 'dul nyamadzad cing / /sna tshogs sems can 'dul bar mdzad/ /thugs rje'i nyams ni yongs su rdzogs/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus su yang / /sna tshogs padma'i dkyil na bzhugs/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /zhabs kyis gnon par rnam par bsgom/ /'khor kun dag ni zhal gsum pa/ /thod pa'i 4phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /drag cing zhi ba nyid yin te/ /rigs gsum glis ni phye ba'i gzugs/ /rigs gsum gyi ni phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /lha mos bye ba'i gzugs can ni/ /dam tshig gnyis su med par sbyor/ /thams cad yi dgas gdan la bzhugs/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis gnon/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khril/ /shes rab thabs ni rnam par bsgom/ /mtshams rnams su ni bum pa dag /thod pa zla ba yongs su gang / /zur rnams su ni sgo srung ste / /ji ltar mdog gi cha rnams so/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /'jig rten skyong ba zhabs 'og gnon/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /thugs rje khro bas rnam par myos/ /dkar po la sogs tshomadog sbyor ba/ /ji ltar g.yas pa'i zhal rim bzhin/ /phyag rgya rim pa'ang de bzhin no/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog —par ni/ /'khor sogs mchog kyang dgod par bya/ /rdo rje padma'i dbus su ni/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo gsum dkyil na/ /rang gi byin rlabs 7'chang ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas mu stegs can la sba/ /'di ni rab tu gsang ba ste/ /bla ma'i ngag la gnas pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma yi drin yin no/ /gnas la sogs 7pa'i rim sbyor ba/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam dag dgod/ /shes rab thabs bdag 'gro ba yin/ /sa bcu pa 77—1000

yi mchog kyang 'gugs/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas/ /sbyor ba gsum gyi rnam dag don/ /'di ni dri med sgom pa mchog /mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las bdag nyid chos kyi yi ge las bskyed pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgom pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas mchog tu bshad bya ba/ /bdag nyid cho ga'i sgom pa'i rim / /mā ma tī ridang spyan dang ni/ /lha mo sgrol ma gos dkar mo/ /'od zer can dang dza la/ /lha mo skul byed sa 'dzin ma/ /rang gi sa bon las byung sgrub/ /phyag bcu gnyis kyis rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum pa la g.yas brkyang bzhugs/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung gis gnas/ /rig byed bzhi yi zhal gdong ste/ /phyogs kyi gos can ro yi gdan/ /skra grol ba la 'jigs pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /khro bas blta zhing bugs rje'i nyams/ /shes rab pha rol phyin lha mo/ /de nyid ye shes mchog las byung /so so yang dag sbyor ba'i bdag /de nyid ye shes gdon mi za/ /khro bo sna tshogs gzugs can ni/ /dpa' bo rang nyid las byung ba/ /khro mchog mkha' 'gro 'byung ba yang / /gos pa med par nyams pa yi/ / bdag po nyid du sbyar bar bya/ /tshobadag nyid lasgom pa nyid yin no/ /mnyam par ma bzhag spyor ba yis/ /sgom zhing rnam par bsgom par bya/ /phra ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje can /snying ga'i 7padma'i dbus su ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro thugs brtse can/ /'di nyid du ni gnas mdzad cing / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun byang chub sems/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di la gnas/ /'di nyid kyis mchod pa nyid kyis/ /mchod 77—1001

'os thams cad mchod pa yin/ /gang zhig 'di la rtag blta 3ba/ /de ni rgyal bas mchod par bzhed / /dang gi sbyor ba rdo rje yis/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje can du 'dod/ /de bas rdo rje mchod pa yis ri/ /yid 'dod rnams kyi 0lus la 'dod / /mchod pa lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /gang 'di rgyud las gsungs pa dag /de ni pha rol gzhan du 'dod/ /dngos med bzhi la dgod pa yin / /lha yi gzugs su bsgom pa yi / /mnyam nyid mchod pa chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bsgrub pa'o/ /sngags dang de nyid bstan pa yi/ /bstan pa tsam du legs 'byung ba'i/ /rgyud ni don dam ma yin te/ /don dam yang dag skyes pa na/ /ston pa med cing bstan pa'ang med /nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yi / /gnas sogs 'di nyid la gnas te/ /de bas de ru 'khor ba nyid/ /skyo bya de nyid can gyis min/ /gal te de nyid med gyur na/ /de yi 'khrul pas ci zhig bya/ /'on te de nyid ldan gyur na/ /de la 'khrul pa ci zhig yod/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas mchog rnams/ /bstan tshopas dri ma med par 'gyur/ /yang na mi nus bag med pa'i/ /mi yi gnas ni bsgrags par bya/ / nga yis 'di ltar bshad pa ni/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis te/ /bsam gtan las gzhan bde med phyir/ /de bas bsam gtan mchog gzhol bya/ /rnal 'byor pa ni phyi rol 'khor/ /de yi khams rnams zad par 'gyur/ /de bas phyi rol spangs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor rol pas gnas par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor can/ /rnam dag ye shes spyan gyis ni/ /thugs rje thugs gdungs ring po nas/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor can dag gzigs/ /de rnams dgyes pas dngos grub mchog /ci 'dod par ni 77—100 2

stsol bar 'gyur/ /des ni rje btsun ye shes kyang / /rab tu 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /sna tshogs spyod pa yang dag ldan/ /spyod dang brtul zhugs spyad pa yi//spyod dang brtul zhugs 'dir spongs la/ /de nyid brtul zhugs la dgar bya / /gang yang rung ba'i zas gnas pa/ /rnam pa des byas brtul zhugs can/ /bsam gtan zas mchog gzhol 'gyur bas/ /smyon pa'i spyod pas gnas par gyis / /gcer bu 'am yang gcer bu min/ /gang rung ji lta de ltar 'gyur/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha dmigs la/ /de nyid gcig ris rnam par bsam/ /lkugs pa'i dngos por gyur pa yis / /zla drug tsam gyis nges par ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis nyer bsten na/ /rnal 'byor chen mo 'di gsal 'gyur/ /ye shes sgron ma'i mchog mthong na/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams legs 'dus te/ /padma'i 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar/ /ngang pa'i tshogs 'dus ji bzhin no / /mig 'phrul mkhan ltar 'jig rten du/ /'gro kun don ni byed pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin par ni/ /mngon 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /spyod pa 'di la nges par ni/ /ji skad bshad pa der 'gyur bar/ /sems ni dag par gyis shig ces/ /sems can rnams la bdag gsol 'debs/ /gang gis zad byung snying rjer ldan/ /gang gis gsung ba de nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje drag po'i sbyor ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni snying gar dzodagod/ /snying gar lardo rje lcags myur 7sbyor/ /thugs kyi rdo rjes nang sbyar 5te/ /gzhan yang rdo rje dgod bya ba/ /chos kyi dbyings su rnam par brtag /rang gis rtenam mkhar sbyor nas su/ /gzi brjid gzugs ni 'dzin par bsgom/ /rang gi chos kyi yid ngadagod pa/ /rang drod rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rang gi sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi chos 77—1003

kyi 〉yi ge bsgom/ /ji lta ji ltar rtogs pa yi / /gzhan nyid gzugs kyi sgom pa la/ /yin kyi gti mug grub pa yi/ /dbang po gzhan ma ribasgom par bya/ /ji lta ji ltar mos pa yis/ /gzhan nyid gzugs la blta bar bya/ /mngon par pa/sdo lta/ rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las bdag 'dul ba'i mchod pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsang ba'i ye shes gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /rang bzhin bdag med chos rnams ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /stong nyid rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /legs so bya ba rnams byin nas/ /rgyud skyes pa yi sbyor ba las /legs so legs so ye shes che/ /nges par brjod pa mchog gi mchog /legs so rdo rje tshul drag po/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bka' drin rab/ /legs so gnyis med sbyor ba ni/ /mchog dang mchog ni grub pa la/ /legs so zhes bya nges par sbyor/ /'dod pa med pa'i sgom pa ni/ /legs so thams cad 'gro ba'i mgon/ /theg pa chen po bstan pa 'di / /gnyis med ye shes mchog dang ni /man ngag thob pa'i dang po ste/ /legs so rdo rje bla ma kun/ /de la ribastan pa rnal 'byor ma/ /legs so 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /dngos grub bla na med pa byin/ /rdzogs te cang mi gsung bar gyur to / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rdo rje rnams nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla na med pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba'i sdom pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par 77—1004
